dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1428yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ta cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad shar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu kho//spung lha'i bod rig pa dpe na khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kye rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes/ smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de g.yin la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag cam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las gar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khrag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser ra khrog nang bstan dpe rnying 'tsho lob phyog sgrig khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla blta pa'i tshes 7la/

bsdu sgrig gab55 nga tand/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa sde/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgregs dang dpe skrun zhu la dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang / de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum po de stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa 4

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lta ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags 6) 'a) rtoganakhong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags 6) (cha) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (jas (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags smyon) ste rgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod nams mchag ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags 6)sde zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags (tha)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags6)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags (da)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)sde phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (phen ste 'dul ba'i

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags ltab)ste bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (pa) (mo) (tsa)ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza)ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma sgob)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma (ngon ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañja mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du la lha'i yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/thog ma'i zhu dag dang /bskyar zhus/yang zhus/zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing /tshig phrad dang /lhag bcas/rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang /tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/mtshams la 'tshams/mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/med la smad/byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/grwa la gra klong la slong /rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/rig gnas la rigs gnas/rigs pa la rig pa/gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang /nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang /shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad skar ram/yig thogazhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang /pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang /mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o//mer gtsā gonang brten dpe rnying 'chos ba phyogs ga khang nas/bod sa glang 31re sa ga zla ba'i tshes la/

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / g.yin yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags spyon zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'brungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyo lo 1617lor lho kha 'phrongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku zhabrungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ni'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'a shes la bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang ning pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ g.yin yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhedas/ chos gnyis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i lhag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin r+ṣa 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa g.yin don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam g.yin mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser ga khu gnang bstan dpe rnying 'chos ba phyogs ga khang nas/10

dkar chagagangs can yul gyi sa la spyod pa'i mtho ris kyi rgyal blon gtso bor brjod pa'i deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (1)mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba (1)rgya gar gyi rgyal rabs brjod pa/ (4)gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir rgyal ba'i 'phrin las 'jug tshul las gnya' khri btsan po nas gnam ri srong btsan bar gyi rgyal rabs brjod pa/ (9)chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po nas khri lde gtsug brtan bar gyi rgyal rabs brjod pa/ (15)chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan nas glang dar bar gyi rgyal rabs brjod pa/ (40)'od srung nas brgyud pa'i mnga' ris stod kyi rgyal rabs dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha gdan drangs pa sogs kyi skor/ (62)dpal ldan sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rabs kyi skor/ 470)lha gzigs rlangs kyi gdung rabs brjod pa dang / phag gru'i rgyal rabs kyi skor/ (93)rin spungs pa'i skor/ (126)gzhis ka snel pa dang / rgyal mkhar rtse pa/ 'ol kha ba sogs kyi skor/ (138)mdzad byang / (156)lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long (161)mchog dman bar pa rnams la lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya gsal bar ston pa'i rim pa zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (193)

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (246)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing bya lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (246)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me khyi sogs la bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (271)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me phag lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (283)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa byi sogs la bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (292)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu sbrul lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (342)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing rta lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (349)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing lug lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (359)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me sprel lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag 〈365)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me bya lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag 4368)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa khyi lor bris pa'i 'ang shog 'phrin yig khag (379)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa phag lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (393)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags byi lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (401)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags glang lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (404)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu stag lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (414)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu yos lo ra bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (427)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing 'brug lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (436)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing sprul lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (445)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me rta lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (457)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me lug lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (463)

rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa sprel lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag 4470)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa bya lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (486)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags khyi lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (490)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags phag lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (497)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu byi lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (504)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu glang lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (513)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing stag lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (522)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing yos lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (531)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me 'brug lor bris nga 'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (547)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me sprul lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (555)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa rta lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (560)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa lug lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (570)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags spel lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (581)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags bya lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (594)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag 4597)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu phag lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (601)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing byi lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag (603)

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu' dga' ston dpyad kya rgyal mo' glu dbyangs/ (por༅༅//gangs can yul gyi sa la spyod pa'i mtho ris kyi rgyal blon gtso bor brjod pa'i deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs rbe rgo//mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/༄7//bra su rab ti a bhi thal slab dha:rma yu khyo dza pa rgyud na pikhyakā:sumaḥsan kan ka ma sgyur kirtiḥstub la3bha ya ya kan+ta:2spyonag r+ya sums du ñca ka lnga shubha bskal pa bzang po'i lta na sdug pa'i grong khyer dbus na 'jigs bral snying stobs gser gyi gdan khri la//grags snyan nor bu'i rna rgyan 'od gzi mngon par rab 'bar chos kun ma lus gzigs pa'i mig stong can//2na ) adhi da sha ba la2shushosna da nān+ta du de t+yā bha gsen du nu:dzi rgyus ha swā ha ta tri bi bi shabha rake6tsa)ya kar+ya tri lo ge praṅgā ni:rā dhi kyi u nā su ut+ta r+ya〈/mtha' gnyis bcud bral sder bcas bcom pa'i rgyal rnga stong brdungs stobs bcu mnga' ba mkhar nyal tshogs kyi dpal//bla ma mtho ba'i khyu mchog zas gtsang sras po 'chi med gtso bos 'jig rten gsum du dge legs mdzod//ba ) shā shwa tamaḥyu kar pa ro bi koṣaḥta bha ba nā sha ya ku ro bodz+ratsan pra mā rdi na mi khu ñca do hanas nā tan yu bibha baḥ'achi sdeb sbyor zab mo' dbyangs/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)ba'i dngos po rnam par 'joms pa'i gzhom med tshe yi g.yung drung rtag pa'i rdo rje gang //longs su spyod la zad mi shes par 'dod pa 'jo ba'i 'byung gnas mchog gi gan mdzod kyi/ /ldan)shā yu bi pā ka ka bla ta ru tsā gaPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBtsa u yu nut+ta ra pa ris tsā pa ri mi taḥsu bātsu kuru dwa/khyab bdag dbang por dus gsum rgyal ba yongs kyis legs bsngags tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med//tshe dpal yongs 'du'i ljon pa dus su smin pa'i dngos grub 'bras bu bla na med pa stsol/ /3ba ā:sdom spyi rā kumā ra bā58ku khyen keg r+ya tsā sa:3 lashad+ma tsit+ta ha te ca dz+nyā yaḥpar bsirta 'a/tshar du dngar ba'i mkhyen pa'i ge sar gzhon nu'i lang tsho'i lcags kyu yis//chos kun ri dwags mig can ma yi snying la bsnun pa'i rang dbang du//4na kra he pa〉u ha da ya ya4tagaṇa dar+sha ñca nā ṭa kya sto〉pā ka'okapha si ri mu ra 5 (sna / pasu ri su a ba gtā gi naḥkumā ra shu lha 'du 'bral zlos gar ri mo'i snang brnyan chosanyid me long gcang ma'i ngos//rjen par 'char ba'i byed po zur phud lnga pa mgrin pa'i rgyan du bzhugs//4ba la k+ta su rmā ma yu khya hā ra guṇa tsā liṅgā spobashe par smi:྅bhabatsalaḥsam tā pa wal1lha tad n+ti rgya tsa/snang mdzod 'bum gyi dra bas 'khyud pa'i byu ru'i rdul brtsegs la//brtan g.yo'i dngos kun dbang du byed pa'i yon tan yongs rdzogs pa'i//ldan shwat+ta bha lika ya ya ro bi ka kuru ra tha tha rgyu adhi ra wa yartitsāde lo bya t+ta r+ya ka ro ti kul+la na ya rnatā ma tri bha bya smar//zur mig nyag phran tsam gyi dge ba'i gzugs can 'dus ma byas//'dar mdzad rig byed lha mos srid pa gsum la mnga' sgyur cig/5bcu khaman kā rnye3swā par dwa :ma bā sgyuPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBPROBti be+eḍū pra dhar mi tok+ta sho pa sidhi/rā ṭa kra/yid 'ong bzhin ras zla gzhon 'khor

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhan nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (dzanalo gnyis skyes la/ /'khrul pa ster yang 'phyang mo sel byed mgo skyes kyi/ /be+eḍūr mthing kha'i lan bur rab 'phyang dbyangs can ma/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug ngag gi rgyal po nyer grub mdzod/ /gangs can lha lam yangs pa'i khyon 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa bcu gnyis bdag po'i gur khang mchog /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i nam mkha'i gru yis nye bar 'dren mdzad chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum dang / /rgyal ba kun dngos mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i rtsa lag thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho'i/ /bka' drin gzugs can dbyig 'dzin sto 'dir shong 'gyur min na kun mkhyen srang las gang gis gzhal/ /li khri'i lcug phran mkhyen pa'i snang ba can/ /'jam (6nasgo gon blo yi lang tsho bzang po'i tshon/ kha dog so sor bkra ba'i grags pa'i rgyan/ /phyogs bral rna lung 'god mkhas rtag tu rgyal/ /dpal ldan chos kyi rang bzhin ngos yangs par/ /gnas lnga bang mdzod 'byor bar lhun grub pa'i/ /mnga' sgyur bgrod byed ban dhu dzi wa ka /rmad byung cod pan mchog tu rnam par bsngags/ /rgya hor lung dang rigs kyis mngon mtho zhing / /bka' khrims gser 'khor mchog dman gnya' gnon pa'i/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon dpal ldan rlangs kyi gdung / /chos ldan sa skyong rgyal por su mi dad/ /smra ba'i 'bab stegs mdud pa'i rgyar bcings kyang / /mthon po'i khri la dregs pas khung min pa'i/ /legs bshad gtam gyi 'byung gnas blo ldan can/ /gang du gnas kyang dad pa'i spro ba 'phel/ /ya rabs dam pa'i spyod tshul pad dkar tshal/ /ches cher bdo ba snyigs ma'i bsil zer gyis/ /zum pa'i dus 'dir deb ther gtam rgyud sogs/ /brjod pa rang nyid ngal ba'i rgyu ru zad/ khyad par bcu phrag rig pa'i chu gter che/ /blo gros gzings kyis sgrol 'dod rig byed pa/ shes bya'i tshul la ma sbyangs bstan bcos dag /rtsom par rig pa'i tshul la yid mi gtod/ /'on tang stobs kyis yangs pa'i nor 'dzin la/ /'khor lo sgyur ba'i bka' yi dri bzhen gyis/ /deb ther rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston mgron/ /'bod byed ma la ya yi rgyud 'di spro/ /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyergya gar gyi rgyal rabs brjod pa/shis pa brjod pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro tam bu ra'i rgyud las nye bar drangs te/ bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zad mi shes pa'i 'byung gnas za (6ba)ma tog dbang gi rgyal po rmad du byung ba'i thugs kyi gsang mdzod dpal be'u'i mdzes rgyan du spud pa'i bskal pa bzang po 'di'i 'dren mchog stobs bcu mnga' ba stong gi mi lhung 'phreng ba'i dbus nas chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba /sna bur mngon par 'phags shing / mda' yis bcings pa'i rlabs po che'i smon lam gyi mthu phul du byung ba'i bden stobs dri ma med pas pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i rnga bo che srid pa gsum gyi khor mo yug brdung ba'i rgyal ba bu ram shing pa 'di nyid kyi bstan pa rin po che ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i legs byas grangs med pa'i zong gis bsgrubs pa'i phan bde kun gyi rtsa lag ste/ de yang 'byung zhing 'phel ba dang / yar ldan du rgyas pa'i byed po ni yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi khyon la mnga' sgyur ba'i rgyal po chen po zhig la rag lus pas na/ 'o skol gyi ston pas kyang rigs dang / yul dang / dus dang / brgyud dang / bud med de gzigs pa lnga la gzigs nas/ zas gtsang gi sras su bltams par mdzad pas/ thog mar 'di nyid kyi gdung rabs cung zad brjod par bya ste/'phags pa'i yul gyi mi phal che ba 'chi med kyi gnas nas chad pas/ gzhal du med pa'i tshe dang 'dod rgu la longs spyod cing mtha' yas pa'i yon tan du ma la dbang 'byor pa'i tshe/ 'bad rtsol gyi mthu la rag ma las pa'i bdud rtsi sa'i bcud dang / sa'i zhag /myu gu'i tshal/ ma rmos pa'i 'bras sa lu rnams la longs spyod pas/ lha las chad pa'i yon tan phal cher las gzhan du gyur cing / ma rmos pa'i 'bras kyang rnam par g.yeng ba'i gzhan dbang du (7na)gyur pa zhig gi byed pa la brten/ so nam gyi bya ba la brtsams pas/ phan tshun du rtsod pa dang mtshang 'bru ba byung ba rnams la dang po'i thig gis —4

deb zer rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ ('gacod pa'i zhal lce bar/ kun gyis bkur zhing 'dud pa las/ mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po zhes rgyal po la snga bar grags shing / de nas rim bzhin 'od mdzes/ dge ba/ dge mchog /gso sbyong 'phags te sngon gyi rgyal po sde lngar brjod la/ gso sbyong 'phags kyi spyi bor sha rmen zhig byung ba las nga las nu/de'i brla g.yas par sha rmen zhig byung ba las mdzes pa/ de'i brla g.yon par sha rmen zhig byung ba las nye mdzes/ de'i rkang pa g.yas par sha rmen zhig byung ba las mdzes ldan/ de'i rkang pa g.yon par sha rmen zhig byung ba las nye mdzes ldan te/ 'di lnga la 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po lngar grags shing /phyi ma bzhis ni gling bzhi nas gcig gi bar la dbang sgyur bas/ gser dngul zangs lcags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po yin no/ /rgyal po 'di dag nas rim par brgyud de zas gtsang yan chod du/ sa ya chig 'bum nyi khri chig stong lnga brgya bcu bzhi byung bar grags la/ 'jig rten gdags par/ rgyal po 'bum phrag brgyad sum khri bzhi stong lnga brgya sum cu rtsa bzhi yod par bshad pa'i lugs gnyis ka snyigs dus kyi lo rgyus smra ba kun gyi gtsug rgyan/ gzhon nu dpal gyis 'dren par mdzad pa las gsal bar ma gsungs pas/slad nas kyang lo rgyus la 'dris par 'dod pa'i blo ldan dag gis dpyad par bya'o/ /de yang ston pa 'di nyid kyi gdung la nyi ma'i gnyen dang bu ram shing pa shākya (7bzhas brjod pa ni/ yul gru 'dzin du rgyal po brgya tham pa byung ba'i mtha' ma rna ba can gyi bu go ta ma dang bha ra dh+wa dza gnyis las/ sngon mas rab tu byung ste lo ma'i spyil po yid du 'ong ba'i bsam gtan gyi khang bur gnas pa'i tshe/ g.yo can pad+ma'i rtsa lag dang bzang mo dga' mgur spyod pa'i dus las yol bas/bzang mo bsad pa'i ral gri khrag can lo ma'i spyil po'i nye 'dabs su bor ba'i rkyen gyis go ta ma bsal shing la bskyon pa'i dus/ drang srong mdog nag gi rdzu phrul gyis gru char gyi thigs pa dang / dri bzhen lus la reg pa'i rkyen gyis 'dod pa'i gnas rjes su dran pa'i yid kyi shing rtas drangs te/khams kyi dwangs ma gnyis lhan cig tu lhungs pa las sgo nga gnyis su gyur pa nyi 'od kyis bskyangs shing —5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyekhye'u gnyis bu ram gyi shing gseb tu zhugs pas ming de ltar du grags la/ bu ram shing pa'i brgyud la rgyal po brgya byung ba'i mtha' ma 'phags skyes po/ 'phags skyes po la sras bzhi byung yang btsun mo /ri das te slar stobs ldan gyi rgyal po gzhan zhig gi bu mo khab tu blangs par sras byung na rgyal srid du dbang bskur bar khas blangs pa'i dam bcas/ sras sngon ma rnams spyugs pa rang rang gi sring mo dang bcas te chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram du ming sring lhan cig tu 'dus pa las shākya'i brgyud ces grags pa yin no/ /de yang kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen 'di nyid 'khrungs lor mkhas grub rnams kyi bzhed tshul mang du mchis kyang don grub ces pa sa lug dbyar zla 'bring po'i chu stod kyi nya ba'i tshes bco lnga'i dus su/yum gso sbyong la gnas pa'i lhums su glang po che'i phrug gu thal (8na)dkar gyi rnam par gyur nas zhugs/ zla ba bcu phal cher lon pa legs par sbyar ba lha'i skad du 〈 〈pe zhes pa bsil ldan pa rnams drag por brjod pa/ rgya nag pa dbang thang dang bstun pa'i ming ging shing / bod yul du lcags pho spre'ur 'bod pa'i dpyid tha sa gas nya ba me tog can gyi zla ba/ rgya nag pa si yol du brjod pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bdun gyi res gza' 'od zer bdun pa dang / las skar rgyal la babs pa na lum+bi ni'i nags su sku bltams/ de nas lang tsho'i kun da rnam par rgyas pa'i zil mngar gyi sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi'i yal 'dab kyi yon tan kun la rang gir bgyis shing / pa d+me'i snyems pa thogs pa'i ri dwags mig can gyi don yongs su tshang ba'i grags 'dzin ma dang sa mtsho ma sogs btsun mor dbang bskur te lo nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar du nyi 'og gi rgyal phran gnyis 'thung gi spyi bor 'jigs pa med pa'i rgyal thabs kyi bya ba'i skad gsang mthon pos rang byin du 'gying bar dbang thob na'ang / mchog gi sprul sku'i mdzad pa ston pa'i ched du/ dgung lo nyer dgu pa kun 'dzin zhes pa sa pho byi ba la rang byung gi sgo nas/rab byung gi dngos po yongs su rdzogs te/ lo drug tu dka' ba spyad pas lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa las gzhan du gyur pa na/ dga' mo dang dga' stobs mas ba stong gi 'o ma lan bcu drug gi bar du —6

deb zer rdzogs ldan gzhan nu'i dga' ston dbyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (nunying khur byas pa'i 'o thug sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyi sku su waṇi'i mchod sdong nyi gzhon 'bum gyis 'byud pa ltar gyur te rdo rje gdan du byang chub kyi shing drung na 'chi med bdag pos rtsa 'tshong gi rnam par (8ba tshe sprul te phul pa'i rtsa'i gdan la bzhugs nas/ chu srin rgyal mtshan can sde dang bcas pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bsgrengs te/dgung lo so lnga pa rgyal ba zhes pa shing rta'i sa gas nya ba'i bco lnga'i skya rengs shar ba na ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsi mngon du mdzad do/ /mdo las/ de'i nyin mo zla ba sgra gcan gyis bzung ba dang / sgra gcan 'dzin dang bdud rtsi zas kyi khyi'u zhig kyang skyes par bshad pa'i gza' 'dzin gyi ri mo ni gza' gnas su gcig chu tshod so brgyad zla skar gyi skar gnas su bcu drug chu tshod stong pa sgra gcan gdong gi skar mar bcu drug /chu tshod nyer dgu byung bas gza' 'dzin gyi ri mo ni tshad ma'i ā dar+sha gtsang ma'i ngos su gsal bar shar ba yin no/ /de nas zhag zhe dgu'i bar du dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i sgo brgya ma phye ba'i tshul bstan pas/'jig rten gyi byed po gser mngal can gyis skal ba mchog gi bzang po'i dpal dang ldan pa'i don du gsol ba la brten nas/ mchog dman gyi gdul bya so so'i blo dang 'tsham par zab rgyas chos kyi sgo glegs rnam par bkral nas theg pa che chung gi rigs can gyi yol go /rang 'dod pa'i tshogs mtha' dag gcig tu 'jo ba'i ro zad mi shes pa mkha' khyab tu bro ba'i 'khor lo bskor te/ mthar gyad kyi yul rtsa mchog gi grong du dgung lo gya gcig pa dpa' bo zhes pa lcags 'brug gi lor mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po chos kyi sku'i mkha' klong du sna tshogs pa'i sprul sku'i zlos gar gyis rol pa'i chu 'dzin gyi gzugs sku tha mi dad pa'i mdzad pa bstan to/ /de ltar bstan pa rin po che yul dbus su 'gyur nas (9na sgor dus kyi dal 'gro'i klung rang babs su 'khru/ra ba'i spu ti shis lugs ba'i zha tha grur khyab pa las/ 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ge gya gcig —7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)pa chu 'brug la nag nyar shrī khyu n+ya ka ṭa gar gsang ba kun gyi gan mdzod rnam par 'dzin pa'i mi'i dbang phyug zla ba bzang por sho lo ka stong phrag bcu gnyis kyi bdag nyid can gyi dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gsungs pa sham bha lar spyan drangs nas ma la ya'i skyed tshal du sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi snang brnyan ye shes kyi gzi byin mngon par 'bar ba'i sgyu ma'i gar gyis brtson pa'i 'dren byed kyi dga' ston gsar pa bskrun te/ rdo rje theg pa'i bgo skal ka lwa pa'i grong khyer gyi skye rgur 'byed pa'i mu mtha' bral ba'i mdzad pa nas bzung 'jigs pa med pa'i gdong lnga'i khri la bgrod byed rtsibs stong 'khor lo'i ri mo mchog tu bkra ba'i chos rgyal rigs ldan sum cu rtsa gsum du byon pa mtha' dag gis phyi nang g.yin gsum sbyor ba'i gsang chen nā da'i sgra dbyangs kyi nor bu'i phyang 'phrul las ldan gyi rna bar spud par mdzad pa'i tha ma/ drag po'i 'khor lo can gyis dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa brgyad par kla kle'i dpung tshogs mtha' dag ming gi lhag mar byas nas bla na med pas sa chen po'i khor yug kun tu khyab par mdzad do/ /de yang rigs ldan drag po dgung lo lnga bcu'i steng du kla klo bcom par bzhed pa ltar na/ kla klo'i gnas tshad stong dang brgyad brgyar bshad pa las lo grangs bzhi bcu rtsa bdun tsam mi 'grig pa'i skyon yod cing / de dag rags rtsis su 'chad na zhib rtsis ni 'byung (9ba)ba'i skabs med pas gzur gnas kyi shes ldan rnams soms shig /—8

deb ther rdzogs ldan gas nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (dzadagangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir rgyal ba'i 'phrin las 'jug tshul las gnya' khri btsan po nas gnam ri srong btsan bar gyi rgyal rabs brjod pa/de ltar sham bha las mtshon te/ o rgyan bal yul/ rgya hor sogs su bstan pa byung tshul ni mtha' yas kyang mang gis dogs pas ma spros la/ skabs su bab pa rang cag gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug bshad tshul ni/de yang zla gzhen lan brgyar bzhu ba'i khu bas byugs pa'i man shel gyi lhun po'i 'phreng ba tshar du mngar ba lta bu'i gangs ri'i 'dab ma khor mo yug tu 'khrigs pa'i yul ljongs 'dir mi'i 'gro ba chags tshul la/ mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed tshul mtha' klas shing / 'ga' zhig ni rang nyid kyi lugs kho na la zhen pa'i lung rig dpyad pa med par lugs gzhan dag rnams tshad ldan ma yin pa kho nar smra ba'i gtam gyi 'brug sgras/ chos spong gi rma bya rang dbang med par dga' ba'i las kyi sgrib pa'i sgro gshog phyogs bcur skyong ba 'ga' mchis na'ang / ris su ma chad pa'i gsung rab kyi rgya mtsho chen po'i lding las rnam dpyod gru gzings kyis rang dbang du spyod pa gzhen nu dpal ba'i gsung las/ bod kyi yul 'di yang rgya gar dang 'dra bar/ yul dang mi la sogs pa gnas pa'i bskal pa nas byung bar byas na yang / lung dang rig pa'i gnod pa med cing zhes spyi khyab tu gsungs nas/ lugs g.yin yang 'dren par mdzad pa'i gung 'grig mi 'grig gi brjod bya tsam las mtha' gcig tu gsal bar ma gsungs la/ lha las phul byung gi bstod 'grel las bshad pa'i rgyal po ru pa ti dpung bcas/ ri kha ba can gyi khrod du zhugs pa (10na)las 'phel ba'i rigs kyang yod srid/ gtso bo ni phyag na pad+ma'i thugs rje'i 'phrin las kyi 'od zer 'gog pa med par shar bas/ gangs khrod kyi 'gro ba'i pad tshal rnam par —9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)rgyas pa zhig ste/ de dag gi tshul gnas lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā nas ka ba shing lo can gyi byang ngos nas bzhes pa'i bka' 'khol ma dang / ma ṇi bka' 'bum sogs gangs can gyi ljongs na dar ro cog gi thugs rje chen po'i chos skor du ma zhig dgongs pa'i khog gcig pa las/ spre'u dang brag srin mo lhan cig 'dus pa'i phrug gu gdong dmar sha zan gyi rigs su bshad pa ltar/ rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi tshad med pa'i thugs rje'i mngal khur las thon pa'i gsung gi snang bstsal ba la brten nas/ bod chen po'i rgyal khams su 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon pos dri ma med pa'i 'dren byed kyis gzigs pa na/ stod mnga' ris kyi cha ni glang po che dang ri dwags kyi yul/bar dbus gtsang gi cha ni ri dwags dang spre'u'i yul/ smad mdo khams kyi cha ni spre'u dang brag srin gyi yul/ de yang stod g.ya' ri dang gangs ri/ bar brag dang spang ljongs/ smad rtsi shing dang nags tshal gyi yal ga stug pos dbyig 'dzin gos su klubs pa lta bur rgyu ba'i 'gro ba kun kyang srog gcod sogs ngan song gi rgyu la bag med du longs spyod pa'i rkyen gyis yul gru de dag gi 'og tu mi zad pa'i duḥkha'i 'byung gnas dmyal ba'i lcags kyi za ma tog 'dra ba'i nang du lhung bar ye shes gzigs pas mkhyen nas 'phags pa rnam gsum bka'i bgro ba las thog mar 'jig (10ba〉lhan dbang phyug gis 'dul ba'i phul du byung ba'i dgongs pa la bzhugs te 'phags pa phyag stong spyan stong gi sku'i rnam pas lha sa'i thad kyi 'dzin ma'i ngos su byon pas dmyal ba'i gnas kyang yid du 'ong ba'i 'chi med bdag po'i dga' ba'i tshal la skyengs pa ster bar gyur pa lta bu'i snang ba dang bcas te der gnas pa'i sprin mgrin phal cher lha'i bde ba la spyod par dbugs dbyung nas/ bod kyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad par yang dud 'gro ni glen zhing gti mug pa'i ngang tshul can la blang dor gyi gnas tshul bzhin ston pa'i mthu dman pas mi'i rigs spel bar dgongs/ 'phags pa'i thugs rjes rigs bsgyur ba'i spre'u zhig dang / 'phags ma sgrol ma'i byin rlabs kyi ri dwags gzugs brnyan blo'i zla gzhen dngas pa'i ngos su shar ba'i brag srin mo gnyis tshogs pa las rigs drug nas tshe 'phos pa'i spyod tshul mi 'dra ba'i phrug — 10

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pegu drug byung ba yang / pha rigs rnams 'char sgo myur zhing snying rje che ba khog grims pa/ ma rigs rnams gdong dmar sdig las la brngams shing ro gyong pa byung ba de dag las rim par 'phel bas bod mi'i rgyal khams su gyur te/ rus chen bzhi las gyes pa'i khams/ ye sang dkar po gnam gyi 'ju thag can dang gcig /ye smon nag mo khro chu'i pha bong 'dra ba dang gnyis/ spyang khrig ye shes lha'i sgron me dang gsum/ mon rdzu nag po phyi'i rnga ljang can dang bzhir dbye ba byung /de yang rgyal phran bsil ma mang du byung yang 'phags pa mchog gis byin gyis brlabs pa ma mchis shing / khyad par 'gro ba yongs la (11na)mnga' sgyur ba'i rgyal po zhig med na/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'byung dka' bar dgongs nas/ mang pos bkur ba'i brgyud las byung ba'i rgyal po dmag brgya pa zhes bya ba las sras 'phags pas byin rlabs kyi byed pos mi las 'das pa zhig bltams te/ mig mas 'gribs su yod pa/ g.yu'i smin ma can/ so dung so 'khor mar yod pa/ lag pa 'khor lo'i yan lag can lta bur yod pa'i mtshan ldan zhig byung ba/ yab kyis lha 'dre'i sprul par dgongs nas sprugs pas/ pad dkar 'dzin pa'i ye shes mchog gi 'od zer gyis snang ba bsgyur nas/ lha ri gyang tho'i rtse la byon nas gzigs pas/ yar klung gi yul ni mtho ris kyi yon tan sa la 'phos pa ltar bzang zhing / yar lha sham po'i gangs ri 'di lhun po'i mdzes sdug la chags pa'i chu shel gyi dbang po nya gang bas 'khyud pa ltar mkhyen nas/ lha ri rol po'i rtse la gshegs nas lha skas la babs te/ btsan thang sgo gzhir zhabs zung gi 'khor lo bskyod pas bon po sogs yon tan can gyi mi bcu gnyis phyugs skyong bas mthong ste gang nas 'ongs zhes gtam dris par/ mkha' la mdzub mo ker bas lha las chad par go nas bod khams kyi rjer 'os so zhes gnya' bar khri byas bteg nas 'ongs pas rje gnya' khri btsan por grags la/ deb sngon du khri btsan po 'od lde zhes pa dang don gcig /rje 'dis pho brang yum bu bla sgang brtsigs/ tshe mi gshen gyi rmu rgyal gyi don bsgyur/ nga dang gnam mug mug gi sras mu khri btsan po/ de dang sa ding ding gi sras (11ba)ging khri btsan po/ de dang so tham tham gyi sras so khri btsan —11—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)po/ de dang dog mer mer gyi sras mer khri btsan po/ de dang gdags kyi lha mo dkar mo'i sras gdags khri btsan po/ de dang srib kyi lha mo'i sras srib khri btsan po/ 'di rnams rmu thag la byas nas mkha' la yal bas bang so med par grags shing / gnam gyi khri bdun no/ /srib khri bcan po dang / sa bcun rlung rje'i sras gri gum btsan po/ de dang klu btsan mer lcam la sras gsum byung yang / blon po lo ngam dang 'thabs pas rgyal po bkrongs/ bod du khrab kyi thog ma 'di'i dus smar khams nas blangs/ sras rnams yab mes kyi dkor mdzod nas rte'u glang ru dkar zhes pa'i glang 'phur shes la zhon nas kong po'i phyogs su bros shing yug cig blon pos rgyal srid bzung / mi ring bar rgyal po'i btsun mo dang yar lha sham po'i sprul pa cig 'dus pa las byung ba'i blon po ru las skyes kyi lo ngam bsad de/ sras bya khri rgyal sar bskos/ rje gri gum nas rmu thag chad pas bur byung ba zangs kyi ga'ur bcug ste lcags gzer btab nas chu la bskyur ba kong chu rlag tu khyer ba chu srin bye ma lag ring gis brnyed nas jo mor phul ba mdzod du sbas pa las bton nas/'phying yul dang thang du bang so brtsigs de bang so'i thog ma yin zhing / yum gyis lha la dmod bor bas nam mkha' nas khyod kyi bu de kun las rgyal bar 'gyur ro zhes pa'i sgra byung bas bya khri'i mtshan la spu de gung rgyal zer/ yab kyi ring la zhang zhung dang / bru sha'i gshen gyi dur bon byung zhing / sras kyi ring la sku mkhar phying ba stag rtse brtsigs/ sgrung dang lde'u gnam (12na)bon gshen po che byung / ru las skyes dang sras lha bu mgo dkar te blon po gnyis kyi ring / chu yung bar drangs/ spang zhing du rmos/ rdo bzhu bas dngul zangs lcags gsum bton/ chu la zam pa btsugs/ rgyal po de dag bar gyi steng gnyis yin/ bang so g.ya' dang rdzo la btab bo/ /spu de gung rgyal dang bom thang rmang mnya'i sras e sho legs/ de dang rmu lcam bra ma na'i sras de sho legs/ de dang klu sman mer mo'i sras thi sho legs/ de dang btsun mo gur sman gyi sras gu ru legs/de dang mtsho sman 'brong ma'i sras 'brong zhi legs/ de dang sman bu mo'i sras i sho legs/ de rnams — 12

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dbyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (posa'i legs drug ste bang so g.ya' spang mtshams su btab bo/ /i sho legs dang rmu lcam smin legs kyi sras za nam zin lde/ de dang mtsho sman khri dkar gyi sras lde 'phrul nam gzhung btsan/ de dang se snyan mang ma'i sras se snol gnam lde/ de dang klu mo mer ma'i sras se rnol po lde/ de dang 'o ma ste mo mtsho'i sras lde snol nam/ de dang khri sman rje ma'i sras lde rnol po/ de dang se btsun gnyan rje'i sras lde rgyal po/ de dang sman btsun lug sgong gi sras lde sprin btsan/ de dag lde brgyad de bang so chu bo'i gzhung la btab bo/ /lde sprin btsan dang nyi btsun mang ma rje'i sras/ rgyal to ri long btsan/ 'di yan chad kyi rgyal po rnams lta klu'i bu mo 'ba' zhig btsun mor bsten pas yum rnams grongs pa'i tshe bur ma byung zhing / 'di man nas 'bangs dang gnyen bsres te/rgyal to ri long btsan dang 'o ma lde bza' khri btsun byang ma'i sras su khri (12ba)btsan nam/ de dang sman bza' khri dkar gyi sras la khri sgra dpung btsan/ de dang sman bza' klu steng gi sras khri thog rje btsan te gdung rabs nyer bdun gyi ring chab srid sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs pa yin no/ /smras pa/ phyag na pad+ma'i gsang ba gsum gyi ngos/ /bsil ldan ljongs 'di'i rje 'bangs ri mo'i gar/ /blo gsal yid ngor bsgyur ba'i gtam gyi dpya/ /lo rgyus zong gis bsgrub pa'i skal bar byin/ /stobs dang longs spyod 'khyog po'i yal ga de/ /blun rmongs tshang tshing khong na mang mchis kyang / /phra ldem gnyen lcug dri bzang phon po can/ shes ldan ma la ya dbus g.yur za ldem/ /myang na dngar ba'i dpal ster zhim pa'i ro/ /yig tshang sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyi nying khu can/ /'chal gtam myos byed rdzas kyis ma bslad par/ /rkang drug mdzod kyi glegs bu med du byung / /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de yan chad du don gyi thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyi mthu phul du byung ba las bskrun pa'i rgyal rigs sha stag kyang gnas skabs su chos ldan gyi rgyal po ma byung zhing / 'di nas dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes pa yin pas/ khri rje thog btsan dang / ru yong bza' stong rgyal na mo tsho'i sras su dpal dge —13

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyelegs kun tu 'bar ba'i bzang po'i snang ba can gyi rnam 'phrul/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan zhakhrungs te/rgyal po 'di'i ring la pho brang yum bu bla sgang gi yang thog gi steng du spang kong phyag rgya pa/ gser gyi mchod rten/ mdo sde za ma tog gi snying po yi ge drug pa/ ge ma ṇi'i skor phor (13na sgoms mkha' las babs te/ gdung rabs lnga nas 'di'i don shes pa 'byung ba'i lung bstan gyi sgra nam mkha' las bsgrags pas/ ngo mi shes pa ltar bcos kyang / ngo mtshar du bzung nas/ pho brang gi dkar khang du ming gnyan po gsang bar btags nas mchod pa dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol ba'i mthus rgyal po dgung lo brgyad cu pa slar na tshod dar la babs pa'i lang tsho ltar ya mtshan du gyur cing / yongs su bsgril bas lo brgya nyi shu'i bar du bzhugs so/ /deb sngon du rnal pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i lugs dang sba bzhed gtsang ma gung bsgrigs pa mkhas pa'i gsung yin kyang / rnal pa paṇ+ḍi tas nam mkha' las babs pa mi 'thad par smra ba ni blo chung gi gtam ste/ bstan pa'i dbu brnyes pa'i rten 'brel du 'phags pa'i gang zag gi sprul pa dang thugs rje bsam las 'das pas so/ /de rnams la btsan lngar grags shing bang so phying lung dar thang du btab bo/ /btsan po de dang rno za mang po rje'i sras khri gnyan gzung btsan te bang so don mkhar mdar brtsigs/ de dang 'brong bza' mo dur yangs gzher la sras 'gro gnyan lde'u ste btsun mo mchims bza' klu rgyal ngan bu mtsho khab tu bzhes pas de klu'i rigs yin pas sbal pa'i ro mar khur btsos pa'i za ma'i rigs mdzod phugs su bzhag pa gzigs pas rnam par rtog pa'i dbang du gyur nas snyun du klu nad kyis thebs shing sras kyang dmus long zhig byung bas ming dmus long dkon pa bkra zhes btags pa la zhal chems su/bsam pa bzang po gser dang 'dra ba ste/ /bzang po'i gros ni bdud (13ba)rtsi yin zhes nyon/ /ngan pa rnams kyang me dang 'dra bas gsos/ /mi chos rtog pa yin gyi rnam rtog skyungs/ khyod yab mes kyi gnyan po gsang bar mchod pa gyis/ /'a zha'i yul nas sman pa bos la mig phye/ mig ma byung na sum — /4

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (7pa'i yul na bon po zhig gi chung ma rgya mo rgya lcam bya ba la nub cig 'grogs pa'i shag mo tsam pa la skyes pa'i sum ri ring mo bya ba yod pas de bos la gcen chol rgyal sar chug gsungs nas bang so zhing mdar brtsigs pa yab yum gson por bzhugs skad do/ /de nas sras kyis yab kyi gsung bzhin byas pas mig bye ste/ skyid sna/da stag mo ri la gnyan 'dug pa gzigs pas stag ri gnyan gzigs su grags/ bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs so/ /rje de dang 'ol gong bza' stong btsun 'gro dkar gyi sras gnam ri srong btsan te 'di'i ring la rgya nas rtsis dang sman byung zhing / ba dmar mo'i 'o mas sprus pa'i 'jim pa las brtsigs pa'i pho brang khri brtsegs 'bum gdugs zhes bya ba brtsigs/ brag gsum lding ma'i mtsho 'gram nas rta mdo wa cang shes brnyed par chibs nas/ phung g.yag thal dkar ru ring zhes bya ba'i 'brong bsad pa'i sha sga la btags pa sa la lhungs pa las tshwa rnyed/ bang so don khar mdar brtsigs pa yin no/ /smras pa/ gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin rgyal sras mchog gi legs par byas pa'i gru gzings kyis/ /thabs mkhas 'phrul gyi sgo 'phar las 'ongs gnyan po gsang ba'i yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu dbang rgyal bod 'bangs yongs kyi rgyal mtshan rtse mor legs 'god pa'i/ /skal pa (14nasgo chog gi dbyangs su len 'di dri za'i rgyud la rnam par 'khu/ zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po nas khri lde gtsug brtan bar gyi rgyal rabs brjod pa/de ltar dam pa'i chos kyi 'chi med bdag po'i ba gam mngon par mtho ba dag gi sgo glegs grangs med dus gcig tu phye ba'i srol gyis dge legs kyi 'dod rgu rnam par bkra ba'i sde bzhi'i 'bras bu zad mi shes pa'i bdog pa ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba kun la gtong ba'i phyag ring du —15

rgya pa dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebarkyangs pa'i dge mtshan du che ba'i mi rje srong btsan sgam po ni/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/'di nas skye ba gzhan gyis ma chod par/ /bod khams mgon med yul du bde bar song / /bod ni rgyal po dag la tshad mar byed/ /ces dang / thang yig tu/ kha ba can du gnam ri zhes bya'i brgyud/ /srong btsan snam po zhes bya rgyal bur skye/ /zhes sogs dri ma med pa'i lung bstan gyis bsngags pa ltar/ yab rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan/ yum tshe spong bza' 'bri ma thod dkar gyi sras su/ kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen zhi ba chos dbyings su mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong dang lnga brgya nyag ma brgyad 'das pa/ 'gal ba zhes pa sa mo glang gi lo la pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa na yab kyi 'jigs pa med pa'i seng ge'i khri la stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por dbang bskur/ de'i tshe rgyal ba'i thugs dgongs la/ ngas kha ba can pa'i 'gro don byed pa la dbang bskur ba po zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam du dgongs pa'i tshe/ dpal kun tu bzang pos rin po che'i bum pa lha'i bdud rtsi'i chus gang (14ba)bas sku khrus gsol zhing / a mi de was rgyal po'i bu la reg nas dbang bskur bas brjod par dka' ba'i sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed pa dang gzigs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mchan ma mtha' klas par gyur te/ po ta la'i ri 'di'i rtse la pho brang btab nas bzhugs na mtha' bzhi'i gus ldan gyi rgyal po thams cad kyis rang dbang med par gus pas 'dud pa'i dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan mtha' dag lhun gyis grub par dgongs nas bshul du zhugs te ge re'i 'phreng du phebs pa na/ yig drug rang byon zhal gzigs nas sku khrus gsol zhing gsol ba btab pas/ de las dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i kha dog sna lnga 'phros pa pha ri brag la spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma/rta mgrin gyi sku'i snang brnyan rang byon du shar ba la phog /de las kyang yi ge drug pa la tshur phog pa'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba 'dren byed kyi yul du ngo mtshar ba'i gzigs mor gyur pa 'ja' mdangs zhes skye bo rnams gleng ngo / /de nas bal po'i lha bzo dag gis sor mo'i sgyu rtsal gyis sku dang gsung gi rten rnams ji ltar — 16

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pebyon pa bzhin du gsal bar brkos/ rim bzhin rgyal po 'khor bcas po ta lar phebs nas 'chi ba med pa'i pho brang sa la 'phos pa ltar yid du 'ong zhing kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram stegs ltar mtho btsan gyi pho brang bzhengs nas sprul pa'i dmag dpung dang lhan cig tu bzhugs pas/ mtha'i rgyal po thams cad kyi rna bar da lta bod kyi yul na rgyal po mgo gnyis pa thogs pa med par sprul pa'i dmag 'gyed thub pa'i rgyahrūl yod pa thos pas 'jigs rngam gyi dbang gis dus gcig tu yong ba'i (15na thad so yod pa ltar pho brang gsar du brtsigs pa la legs jar bsnyad pa'i don zhu gsol gus 'dud lhur len gyi skyes bzang po'i yi ge dang bcas blon po mngags pa rnams lan gyi chab shog so so'i yi ger btab cing / bzang po'i gsung dang gya nom pa'i dngos pos tshim par byas te brdzangs pas/ rgyal po kun yid rang dbang med par dga' bar mdzad do/ /rje btsun 'jig rten dbang phyug mi rje'i tshul gyis 'gro ba skyong bar shes bya thams cad la lkog tu gyur pa'i mun pa mkhyen pa'i 'od stong gis cha tsam yang med par bsal na'ang / blo dman gyi 'gro ba'i snang ngo dang 'tsham pa'i phyir du/ rgyal srid lugs zung gi khrims rnam par dag pas 'dzin pa la ye ge 'di yon tan thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bur dgongs nas/ mgon po zur phud lnga pa'i byin rlabs kyi ga bur gsar pa'i thigs pa snying la 'phog pas/ rmongs rtul gyi tsha gdung lhag med bcil ba'i mdun na 'don gnyal nas/ thon mi a nu'i bu saṃ bho ṭa bran dang bcas par gser phye bre gang dang gser gyi pa ṭa sogs rig byed smra ba'i ston pa yid rang dbang du byed pa'i dngos po dang bcas nas 'phags yul du yi ge slob par bkas gnang ste/ bshul du 'tshe ba dang bral nas bgrod de bram ze li byin la yig rigs sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / paṇ+ḍi ta lha'i rig pa'i seng ge la sgra pā ṇi byā ka ra ṇa/rtogs sla ba rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos/ ka lwa pa/ rtogs dka' ba paṇ+ḍita lugs kyi bstan bcos/ tsan+d+ra pa rnams kyis ris/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig dang bcas pa bslabs nas/ bdag cag blon (15ba)po thon mi la/ /ma lus gnang ba thugs la btags/ /rgya gar yul du —17

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)phyin pa yin/ /mkhas grub khyed dang mjal ba yin/ /zhes don du gzo ba'i gsung bram ze la byon te bod du phebs nas/ rgyal blon gnyis pho brang ma rur lo gsum mtshams gcad de yi ge dang sgra rnams slob pa'i tshul mdzad pas mkhas pa'i dpyid du gyur kyang de'i nang du bod skad la nye bar mkho ba'i sgra dang yig rigs mi 'dug par dgongs nas blon por gsungs pas/ thon mis 'jam dpal dbyangs la gsol ba btab pa'i thugs rje'i char gyis yid kyi zhing sa brlan pa las/ bod kyi yi ge'i gzugs sdeb kyi rnam 'gyur gyi myu gu shar ba'i 'bras bu mngon du gyur tshul ni/ dbyangs bcu drug las i u e o bzhi dang gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi la log pa lnga 'thug po lnga ṣa k+ṣa rnams dor ba'i steng du a drangs pa'i rtsa bzhir/ gcig /chos/ 'jig rten/ gzhon nu/ gzi brjid/ 'o ma sogs kyis mtshon par rgya skad la/ e ka /dharma/ lo ka /ku mā ra/ te dza sra/ pa yas brjod pas/ ca cha ja zha za 'a rnams mi dgos pa 'dir bsnan te/ dbyangs bzhi gsal byed sum cur gtan la phab nas/ la rdzo la dpe byas nas dbu chen/ wa tu la dpe byas nas shar ma sogs yi ge'i gzugs dang brda gsal bar byed pa'i sum rtags sogs bod la nyer mkho'i bstan bcos brgyad mdzad nas rgyal po la phul/ spyan ras gzigasakyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs chos du ma bsgyur ba ni ljongs 'dir dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba'i thog ma yin no/ /rgyal pos bstan pa rin po che'i btsas su dgongs nas blon po la bkur sdi rgya cher mdzad (16na)pas/ blon po g.yin phrag dog par/ thon mis/ yul mtha' 'khob bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ /mi mkhas pa sleb pa'i sngon ma yin/ /nga mun pa sel ba'i sgron me yin/ /rje rgyal po nyi zla'i tshul du bzhugs/ /grogs blon po'i khrod na nga tsam med/ /bod kha ba can pa'i mi rnams la/ /nga thon mi bka' drin mi che'am/ /zhes gzhan gyi 'gran sems kyi brag ri dri ma med pa'i dpyod ldan gyi mdzad pa dang gsung gi gnam lcags kyi thog mdas sil bur btang ngo / /gsung 'di dag la dpags na dus skabs bzang po de dag tu yang blun pos shes ldan la gshe — 18

deb zer rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pob 'di yod tshod du 'dug go /de ltar yi ge 'dri klog gi srol legs par btod nas/ dge ba bcu'i khrims kyi steng du dkon cog la gus pa/ dam chos bsgrub pa/ pha ma la bkur ba/ yon tan can gong du bkur ba/ rigs mtho dang rgan la phud dud/ mdza' bshes la gzhung / yul mi la phan 'dogs pa/yid drang ba/ mig ya rabs la lta ba/ zas nor la spyod shes pa/ drin can la phan lan/ bre srang la g.yo sgyu med pa/ spyi snyoms shing phrag dog med pa/ bud med kyi kha la mi nyan pa/ ngag 'jam zhing smra mkhas pa/ theg pa che zhing blo khog yangs pa ste/ mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims/ btsan posaphyag rgyas btab ste 'bras ldan dus kyi mkha' la rta ljang gi dbang po shar ba ltar gsal zhing / gser gyi gnya' shing 'dzin ri ltar lci bar mdzad pas/ bod chen po'i rgyal khams kyi khyon kun la gnas pa'i skye rgu mtha' dag mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i dga' ston (16ba tshe pan cig min par myong bar mdzad do/ /smras pa/ 'gro ba'i bsod nams dpyid kyi mngal khur las/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i rgyal sras mtshar sdug can/ /'thon pa'i phyag na pad+ma mi yi srid/ /bzung 'dis rdzogs ldan dri de ring nas 'gugs/ /mkha' me'i srad bur brgyus pa'i ka 'phreng la/ /rgya mtsho dbyangs kyis brgyan pa'i yi ge'i brda'i/ /rin cen phyang 'phrul rin du gser ldan ldo/ /nor bu'i thong gis bkang yang khugs sam ci /shugs drag mi dge'i mun pa sa 'dzin rkang / /rnam dkar dge ba'i 'od stong zhi 'thung rus/ /lag nyal grub pas bcom tshe khrims kyi gzi/ /legs byas sa srung steng na 'od du 'bar/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas rgyal pos 'gro ba rnam thar pa bla na med pa la 'god par byed pa'i grogs su yi dam gyi lha zhig la brten dgos par mkhyen pa na/ lha'i bu mang pos nam mkha' las lung bstan pa ltar/ smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu las sprul pa'i dge slong a ka ra ma ti shi la byon pa pho nyar mngags te/ rgyal po u ṭa ma ṭa ge sar zhes bya ba dpag par dka' ba'i pahrūl gyis btul te/ nang pa'i bstan pa la —/()

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyebacug nas rgyal po'i dpung dang bcas nas 'phags pa'i mthus skad cig la rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi bye gling na byon nas sa brkos pa'i 'og tu tsan dan sprul gyi snying po'i gar du byung ba bcad pa'i nang nas thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal dang / po ta la nas tsan dan gor shi sha'i dum bu/ rgya mtsho'i gling gi 'jag ma dang gnas chen brgyad kyi bye ma/ chu bo ni rañja'i bye ma rnams sangs (17na)rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas pa bzhugs pa gzigs nas bye ma'i thum bu dang / rtswa'i phon po/ mchod rten pad+ma'i 'khor lo can nas/ 'khor ba 'jig /'od srungs/ shāka thub gsum gyi ring bsrel snyim pa re dang bcas pa bsnams te rgyal po la phul/ slar yang yi dam gyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyi brngas bstan pa ltar sprul pa'i dge slong gis bal yul nas tsan dan ha ri'i sdong po las 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra spyan drangs te/ rgyal po'i smin mtshams su thim mo/ /de yang bka' gdams glegs bam las/ rje dkon cog 'bangs ni bod du 'gro /bod glo bur rgyal po chos la spyod/ /bod mtha' 'khob yul rnams 'dul bar byed/ /nga rgya nag yul nas der drangs te/ /mi kho la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /nga 'jig rten sgron ma zag med la/ /mi kho bo'i btsun mo byed do skad/ /rgya nag pa'i mchod gnas bod du 'dren/ /bod yul gyi dbus su byed do skad/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan gyi bdud rtsi'i bum pa lus can 'chi ba med pa'i dga' ston du spyod pa'i dus la bab sde/ 'phags pa mchog gi 'phrin las kyi 'a kyig pa kun gsal gyi mtha' klas par 'char bar byed pa'i thabs su jo mo khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa lha gcig khri btsun bya ba lo bcu drug lon pa lang tsho'i zil mngar dar la babs pa'i mtshan bzang can/ zhal nas ha ri tsan dan gyi dri bro ba zhig dang / rgya nag po'i grong khyer na jo mo sgrol ma'i sprul pa lha gcig kong jo bya ba lo bcu drug lon pa/mtshan dpe'i mdzes sdug rnam par rgyas pa'i dpal (17bsta1na can/ zhal nas ut+pal dri bro ba zhig yod pa las/ rgyal pos yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba btab pas/ 'phags pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul pa'i zlos gar bud med kyi srid bzung ba gnyis yod pa btsun mor spyan 'dren dgos pa'i lung —2(/—

deb ther rdzogs ldan gas nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pebastan gyi sgra nam mkha' las byung ba dang / sprul pa'i rgyal po'i spyan gnyis las 'od zer 'phros pa shar nub tu song ba la/ dri ma med pa'i lha'i spyan gyis gzigs pas/ nub phyogs bal po'i yul gye grong khyer ya 'bu ya 'gal bya ba na/ bal po'i rgyal po ni sam 'bri sho bya ba'i chos srid kyi 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang phyug dam pa la yid du 'ong ba'i sras mo lha gcig /rin po che'i dkor mdzod/ rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad kyi snang brnyan dang / rgya yul grong khyer bkra shis sgo khri na rgya kong rtse 'phrul chung bya ba/ stobs kyi 'khor los sa la rang dbang du spyod pa'i mi rje la sras mo mi las 'das pa'i lha gcig mig skya'i longs spyod la rnam par 'khru ba'i 'byor pa'i bang mdzod/ rgyal ba bu ram shing pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku brnyan sogs tshad ma'i yul du gyur pa las/ lha gcig gnyis khab tu bzhes na/ rgya bal gyi phun sum tsho gos pa'i yon tan gyi dngos po thams cad khab len gyi rdo dang lcags kyi snang tshul ltar 'byung bar dgongs nas 'jig rten mi'i chos lugs dang sgo bstun te/ gnas skabs su bod mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal por gyur pas/ pho nya ba tsam mngags pa la mi ster bar dgongs nas/ rgyal po nyid kyi spyan g.yas pa'i 'od zer las/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po (18nasgo tsha rna dpe dang ldan zhing / rta/ glang po/ blon po/ dmag dpon/ btsun mo/'khor lo/ nor bu ste/ sngon du 'gro ba'i dpung tshogs yan lag rnam bzhi dang bcas pa'i sprul pa bal po'i rgyal po'i sgo drung du phyin te/ blon po rin po ches brda sbyar nas/ nged kha ba can gyi yul 'phags pa phyag na pad+mas byin gyis brlabs shing / 'phags pa nyid rgyal po'i tshul bzung ba yin pas/ rgyal po khyed kyi bu mo khro gnyer can ma'i sprul par 'dug pa nged kyi jo mor bsu bas/ rten skal shākya mu ni/byams pa chos 'khor/ tsan dan gyi sgrol ma rnams rdzongs su skur zhig /de ltar mi byed na yul 'dir kha ba can gyi rgyal po'i pho brang 'debs so zhes bal skad du smras pas/ bal po'i rje 'bangs kun skrag nas rang dbang med par khas blangs te/ yab kyis lha gcig la 'gro bar gsungs pas/ lha gcig gis yab la zhu ba phul ba/ kye ma yab khog ga rgyal po lags/ /bod ces ( bya ba dmangs rigs gdol —21

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)ba'i rigs/ /blun zhing mtha' 'khob ston pas zhabs ma bcags/ /mchod gnas med cing tshogs gsog rten ma mchos/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor bzhi grogs bzang dge 'dun med/ /chos dang chos min mi shes mun pa'i smag rum 'dra/ /zhe sdang gdug sems che ba gnod byed srin po'i rigs/ /'char la snyom bag che ba byol song spre'u'i rigs/ /de 'dra'i mtha' 'khob gnas su bdag mchis na/ /bdag gi bsod nams gsog pa'i rten dang mchod gnas su/ /yab kyi mchod gnas shākya mu ni dang / /byams pa sgrol ma bdag la gnang bar zhu/ /bod ces (18ba)bya ba yi dwags grong khyer te/ /mi ltogs rgyal khams yin par rgyal bas lung bstan pas/ /rin cen bang mdzod mang po bdag la rgyu/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams bsil zhing grang / /tshe gcig drod pa'i gos shig bdag la zhu/ /de ltar ma 'dris mi yi khrod nang du/ /bsam rgyud spyod pa bya ba ji ltar bgyi/ /yab gcig rgyal po bdag la bka' stsol cig /ces zhus pas/ rgyal pos/ kye ma mig 'bras 'dra ba'i bu mo tshur gson cig /bod ces bya ba khyad par 'phags pa'i yul/ /ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul/ /bsil la dro ba lha gnas gzhal yas khang / /chu bo bzhi 'bab rgya mtsho bzhi yis mdzas/ /'bru sna sna tsho gis rin cen sna tshogs 'byung / /rkang 'gros sgur spyod rtsi thog mar la spyod/ /rje ni lha yin 'bangs ni mi yis byas/ /'khor bzhi med kyang byang chub sems dpa'i brgyud/ /dam chos med kyang rgyal po'i bka' khrims gnas/ /dge 'dun med kyang rgyal po sprul pa yin/ /zhes bod kyi rje 'bangs yul gru la bsngags pa mdzad nas/ lha gcig gi spro ba bsrings te/ bod kyi sprul pa'i blon po rin po che dang / lha gcig rgyu mtshan mthun pa'i mchod gnas dam pa 'chi ba med pa'i bdag po mchod sbyin brgya pas sbyin bdag byas te/ sprul pa'i bzo bo las sna tshogs pa'i sor mo'i 'du byed las bskrun pa'i shākya mu ni dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad can rgyal ba nyid kyis rab gnas mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyis rab gnas mdzad pa'i byams pa chos 'khor/ tsan dan gyi sgrol ma rang byung / nor bu rat+na da wa/ stag (19na tha de wa/ be+e ḍūr+ya 'a lhung bzed sogs/ rin po che'i bang mdzod bdun gyis thog drangs mkho dgu'i yo byad rnams skal rdzongs —22

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (gesu mdzad de/ khri btsun la bslab bya 'di ltar/ sngon tshe bu mos pha yul bzung ba med/ /de phyir bu mo khyod kyang bod yul song / bka' btags chos lugs bzang po dar bar gyis/ /rje yi sku mkhar pho brang btsan po 'chos/ /chos bzhengs dkon cog gsum gyi rten yang tshugs/ khyad par 'phags pa'i rten yang bzhedas su gsol/ /btaḥg lag rgyal ba'i sku gzugs dam pa ba che khas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa yi/ /dge 'dun ston pa'i bstan pa dar bar mdzod/ /ces sogs 'phral yun du dgos pa'i bslab bya dang bcas te bod du brdzangs/ de'i tshe skyes bu mchog dman bar pa gsum la snang ba mi 'dra ba gsum byung ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gzigs ngor/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang jo mo khro gnyer can mjal nas mkha' la 'od zer dang bcas te bod du byon nas bzhugs par gzigs/ bal po'i rje 'bangs rnams kyis/ khri btsun btsun mo rin po che'i chas su zhugs nas bod du bzhud par mthong / bod 'bangs rnams kyis be+e ḍūr+ya'i khrab kyis rten dang bcas te bod blon rta pa lnga brgya bal yul du rdzangs pa rnams kyis khri btsun rgyal po'i btsun mor spyan drangs pa mthong / de nas rgyal pos bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa'i bsu ba dang / dga' ston rgya chen po mdzad de lha gcig btsun mo rin po che'i khri la dbang bskur ro/ shwakya mu ni sogs skal rdzongs (19ba)kyi rten khyad par can rnams dang / sngar sprul pa'i dge slong gis spyan drangs pa'i rten rnams lhan cig tu mchod pa'i khang bzang yid du 'ong bar bzhugs su gsol nas/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod cing / btsan po yang sku rnams kyi thad ka nas 'ben tshad gang las ring du mi bzhud par bzhugs pas/ khri btsun gyi thugs la/ rgyal po 'di lha dang mis khyad par du 'phags pa'i yon tan mnga' ba zhig 'dug na'ang / pho brang gyi phyi rol du mi 'byon pa ni mtha'i dmag la 'jigs par gda' bas/ pho brang btsan po zhig rgyag par bzhed nas/ dmar po ri'i sa phyogs su lcags ri'i 'phreng ba gsum du bskor ba'i nang du mkhar dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu /dmar po ri'i rtser gcig ste stong yod pa de dag rnams la dril bu dang rnga yab mu tig gi dra ba phyed kyis mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/—23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shernam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang la 'gran pa/ rgyal po dang btsun mo'i pho brang gi bar du dngul dang zangs kyi zam pa sbrel ba/ mkhar gyi rtsa bar shin tu rno ba'i mdung la ba dan lhab lhub tu 'phyo ba stong btsugs pa phyogs bzhi na 'dod rgu'i yo byad mtha' dag rang dbang med par 'du ba'i sgo bzhi la lcog bzhis rnam par brgyan pa/ phyi rol tu rta'i rgyugs/ zabs su 'dom do/ /zheng 'dom bco brgyad snyungs su 'dom sum brgya yod pa/ de la spang leb bsgrigs pa'i steng du so phag bting ba/ rta gcig brgyugs kyang du ma brgyugs pa'i sgra 'byung ba/ mdor na srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu'i grong khyer bsod nams kyi mthus gangs can gyi ljongs su (20na skor phos pa lta bu zhig brtsigs nas/ rje blon 'bangs 'khor mtha' dag 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la longs spyod pa'i skabs su/ sprul pa'i rgyal pos shar phyogs nas rgya rje'i sras mo kong jo spyan 'dren pa'i nyer bsdogs su spyan g.yon pa'i 'od zer las 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po sogs sngar ltar sprul nas/ rgya'i pho brang ke ru'i khri sgor phebs te blon po rin po ches/ nged bod kyi rgyal po thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa yin pas khyed kyi lha gcig 'di sgrol ma'i sprul pa yin pa btsun mor spyan 'dren pas skal rdzongs su shākya mu ni dang bcas pa gnang bar mdzod cig /de las phyi rol du gyur na rgya yul 'byin cing / tshul bzhin bsgrubs na rgya bod kyi 'khrug pa phyisanas rgyun gcod do zhes rgya nag gi skad du brda sbyar bas/ rgyal blon rnams shin tu 'jigs pas khas blangs te lha ba khyag la 'gro bar gsungs pas/ lha gcig gis mdza' gcug bas kyis bcings pa'i gnyen 'khor dang mi 'phrad cing / chos dang srid kyi 'byor pa las g.yin du gyur pa'i yul der mi 'gro bar zhus kyang / bod kyi rgyal po'i bla na med pa'i sprul pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal thabs kyi gzi byin rgya rjes ma bzod pa'i dbang gis bka' ma gnang bas/ lha gcig gis bdag kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su 'gro dgos na/ lha shākya mu ni/ bod lha srin ma rungs pa'i yul sa rgod rdo rgod la sogs pa'i dgra rnams 'dul ba'i gtsug lag gi gab rtse dang 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dngos po zad mi shes pa'i rin po che'i gan mdzod gnang bar zhus pa bzhin brdzangs te/ rgya rje'i zhal nas/ (20ba)kye ma bu mo bdag —24

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (dzadal tshur gson dang / /bod ces bya ba kha ba can gyi yul/ /yul la khyad du 'phags pa de yin te/ /gangasari rang byung mchod rten ya mtshan can/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa ni/ /mtsho bzhi g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal bkram pa 'dra/ /thang bzhi rang bzhin mchod pa bshams pa 'dra/ /chu bo bzhi yi mgo bzhi rang bzhin can/ /ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi ljongs/ /bkra shis nyams dga' g.yung drung bris pa 'dra/ /rgyal khams gzhan gyi mi rje mi yis ni/ /byas pa la ni ngo mtshar che rgyu med/ /bod yul mi rje lhasabyas ngo mtshar che/ /mtha' bzhi'i rgyal po kun gyis legs par bkur/ /chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa mi drug ldan/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa'i rgyal po yin/ /zhes spro ba bsrings nas/ bu tsha yig tshang slob cing dge ba dag la sbyar/ /dkon cog dbu 'phangs bstod cing dad dang gus pa skyed/ /chos 'khor gtsug lag bzhengs shing gnas grar dge gnas tshugs/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs bzheng zhing dam chos gzhung yang bris/ /thos bsam sgom pa bya zhing dam chos nang du spyad/ /dge 'dun rnyed bkur bya zhing dam tshig sdom pa srungs/ /dam chos dus dran byas la de ring nyid nas 'bad/ /chos la long yod mi sems tshe 'dir chags mi bya/ /skyabs chen lha ru gzung la dkon cog skyabs 'gro bya/ /las dang 'bras bu sems la sdig spong dge la 'bad/ /'khor ba'i nyesadamigs bsam la nges 'byung blo gtad bya/ /'khor ba'i nyon mongs spangs shing (21na)de yi gnyen po sten/ /byams dang snying rje bsam la byang chub sems kyang skyed/ /byang chub spyod pa spyad cing theg chen lam bgrod bya/ /de ltar byas na bkra shis dge bar 'gyur/ /gtam gyis mtha' ma yin no bu mo de ltar mdzod/ /ces sogs chos dang srid la mkho ba'i zhal gdams mang du gsungs nas bod kyi rgyal po'i btsun mo rin po cher brdzangs so/ /dus der mthong snang gsum byung ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs byang sems rnams kyi gzigs mor rje btsun phyag na pad+mo dang jo mo sgrol ma gnyis phan tshun du thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i mthus/ bod khams kyi don du gshegs par gzigs/ rgya nag po rnams kong jo bod kyi —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyesprul pa'i rgyal po'i btsun mor 'khyer bar mngon/ bod 'bangs rnams kyis ni/ dpa' mdzangs 'phrul ldan kyi blon po mgar sogs rgya rje'i pho brang du lha gcig spyan 'dren pa'i rten du be+e 'i ḍūr+ya 'a rmog dang bcas te mngags pa rgyal khab tu sleb pa dang / rgya rje yab yum sras lha gcig dang bcas pa mtha' dag bod la ster ma 'dod pa'i bsnyad du/ rgyal po chen po g.yin zhig la ster bar gros mthun kyang /nang gses kyi yab chos la dgyes/ yum longs spyod 'dod/ sras dmag la dga'/ lha gcig gzugs yid du 'ong ba la 'dod pa'i dbang gis pho nya so sor mngags pas/ rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po/stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po/ ge sar dmag gi rgyal po/ gzugs mdzes khrom gyi rgyal po bzhi'i blon po lnga brgya yang lha gcig spyan 'dren pa'i ched du/ rgya rje'i pho brang du sleb pa las/ rgya (21ba)thams cad bod la mi dga' yang / khrims la nye ring mi brtul ba'i dbang gis blon po rig pa su rno ba zhig la ster bar byas te/ btsan po'i bla g.yu phub tsam la mig gcig mtha' na yod cing mig gcig dkyil na yod pa nang gi mig kyang phub kyi spa rim ltar yod pa'i khyad 'phags zhig yod pa de gtad nas mig tu dar yug sus tshud la sbyin no zer bas/ blon po gzhan rnams kyis nyi ma mang po'i bar du thabs sna tshogs byas kyang ma tshud par/ mgar gyis rgya'i grog ma gzan gyis gsos pa'i mthe bong tsam zhig gi rked pa la dar skud dang / de'i sne la dar yug btags te dbus kyi mig tu bcug nas phus btab pa mthar 'thon te lha gcig gnang bar zhus kyang / bod la ster ma 'dod pa'i bsnyad kyis/ de tsam gyis bya ba ma rdzogs pa skad du/ bya ma brgya bu brgya/ shing zlum po rtsa rtse/ nyin gcig mi res lug sha sbugs re za ba lpags pa mnyes zin pa dang / chang ban re 'thung ba/ ma bzi ba sogs 'grub par dka' ba'i rig pa mang po 'gran bcug pas/ mgar gyis sbang ma gtor bas bya ma bu shes/ shing chu la bskyur bas rtsa rtse shes/ lug rnams kyi sha lpags so sor spungs nas sha nyung ngu re tshwa la bgres te zar bcug pas zos zin pa/ pags pa rnams gral 'go nas rim bzhin phur pa re byas pas thul/ chang snod chung ngu rer 'thung bskor byas pas ma bzi bar btungs zin/ sngon po gzhan rnams de las phyi rol du gyur —26

deb zer rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (dzadana'ang lha gcig ma byin par/ nub cig gi tshe rnga bo che brdungs byung bas/ rgyal po gzhan rnams kyi blon po pho brang du song (22na tha dang / mgar gyis rnga de skyon can du go nas/ rang gi gnas kyi phyi sgo'i ya them la rdo rje dang / ma them la g.yung drung mtshal gyis bris/ sgo g.yin rnams la yang mtshan ma re btab ste pho brang du phyin pas/ rjes do nub lam ma 'dzol bar rang khyim du sus sleb par ster zer bas/gzhan rnams lam nor/ mgar gyis sgron me bteg nas sngar rgyab pa'i rtags rnams dang bstun nas 'ongs pas rang khyim du bde bar sleb/ 'on kyang rgya rje'i zhal nas sangs nyin thang la yid du 'ong ba'i na chung sum brgya tshogs pas/ de dus sus ngo shes pa la ster zer bas/ mgar gyis sngar nas 'dris pa'i rgya mo zhig yod par gser gyi rngan pa byin/ rgya'i rtsis khog tu mi tshud pa'i thabs byas te dris pas/ kong jo'i sku dbyibs dang cha lugs rnams nges par byas nas/ nang par blon po gzhan rnams kyis chas dang gzugs la bltas te bu mo 'ga' zhig khrid pa'i rjes su/ bod blon rnams kyis lha gcig gi gos kyi gong ba nas mda'i lhong gis bzung ste khrid pas/ lha gcig mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur byed par/mgar gyis spro ba bskyed pa'i ram mthon mi dang 'bri se ru gung thun gnyis kyis bteg nas/e ma ngo mtshar che/ lha gcig kong jo khyed/ /bdag gi tshig la gson/ /bkra shis nyams su dga'/ /bod kyi rgyal khams na/ /rin cen sna las grub/ /rgyal po'i pho brang na/ /mi rje lha yis mdzad/ /srong btsan sgam po de/ /rigs gzugs dpal gyis brjid/ /mthong na sems yid 'phrog /thugs rje chen po lags/ /rgyal srid (22ba)chos bzhin skyong / /'bangs rnams bka' la nyan/ /rgyal blon 'khor 'bangs rnams/ /dga' skyid glu ru len/ /chos kyi nyi ma shar/ /dpal gyi sgron me bteg /ri la shing sna tshang / /sa gzhi yangs pa
