la/ /'bru sna lnga yi tshogs/ /go mtshams med par skye/ /gser dngul zangs lcags sogs/ /rin cen du ma yod/ /gnag rta lug gsum rgyas/ /dga' skyid de ltar yod/ /e ma ngo mtshar che/ /lha gcig kong jo gson/ /zhes snyan pa'i dbyangs su blangs pas/ lha gcig gi thugs bsos/ rgyal pos lha gcig nga sko/la —27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyedu zhugs pa'i skyes thung la byon pa'i gral du/ 'bri se ru gung thun gyis phrag dog gi gtam la brten nas/ rgya rjes mgar rgya yul du sdod dgos par gsungs pa la/ 'dod pa ltar bcos nas bsdad pas/rgya rnams bag yangs su gyur cing / blon po rig pa can gyi brgyud pa 'byung ba'i ched du mtshar sdug gi lang tsho can zhig jo mor byin kyang na ba ltar byas te ma 'brel bar blon po'i nad la phan pa'i lto bcos su/ dar zab bsregs pa'i thal ba/ tsan dan bsregs pa'i sol mdud/ lug gi mtsher khrag sogs mi 'grub pa bsgrub tu bcug pa dang / nas rnams brngos te sa bon du 'debs pa sogs thabs 'phrul du mas ma hā tshi na'i rgyal khams cham la phab ste thabs mkhas kyi bod du yong khar/ dwa ri dra zhig la/thag ring gi ra pho rgya bo la ngo shes mi bya'o/ kha rog sdod la ku co thong / /nag po lcags mkhar thub nas yod/ /lung pa phu rdugs mda' rdugs su/ /thu ru cog brag khong la bzhog /(23na bor dkar sgril la dar nag rkyong / /zla bas nyi ma'i rtse ru sleb/ /ces rgya yul du ngan byas pa dang / khong rang thabs kyis 'ong ba sogs kyi log skad kong jo dpon g.yog la springs so/ /de nas mgar gyis nad 'di bod kyi lha ma dga' bar 'dug pas lha gsol ba'i chas/ rta mog dro mgo dmar dang / tshwa chu byugs pa'i sha skam sogs sta gon byas nas bod kyi ri mthong sar gyad mi bzhi dang bcas te 'ongs pa dang / mgar gyis gyad mi bzhi la sha skam byin pas skom pa'i nad mi bzod pas gdungs te/ chang gi btung ba mang por longs spyad pas/ ra ro ba'i bar du mgar gyis gyad kyi rta'i sug po bregs/ mtshon cha rnams bcag /rta mog dro mgo dmar de zhon nas 'di skad zer ro/ /dar zab me la bsregs pa'i thal ba de/ /rgyal po nye ring can de'i na bza' mdzod/ /snye ma 'bru med thal ba nag po de/ /btsun mo ser sna can de'i brgyags phye mdzod/ /nags la me rgyab sol ba'i mdud shing de/ /rgyal bu lus rtsal can de'i mdung shing mdzod/ /lug la mtsher khrag med par bsad pa de/ /lha yi drung du sdig bshags smon lam bya/ /lus la nad med mal du nyal ba la/ /sngas —28

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pomagor sman pa bos nas ci zhig bya/ kho po mi sdod rang gi yul du 'gro/ /zhes zer nas 'ongs pas/ sgo gdong sgo mo'i rtsar kong jo dpon g.yog gi rjes zin skad do/ /de ltar thabs sna tshogs kyis rgya mo bza' kong sngo bod rgyal po'i btsun mor thob pa mthong ngo / /smras pa/ legs lam mchog gi man shel gsar pa'i gos/ /klubs pa'i mi bdag thugs (23ba)rje'i lcags kyu yis/ /rgya bal phun tsho gos dngos kun bsdus pa na/ /gser mngal can yang 'dud snyam 'phyang mo yug /ngal ba med par mkha' dbyings lus phra mas/ /bzhin ngos 'khor los sgyur thabs smin ma'i slog /kun gyi gzigs mor mtshang ba'i 'phreng ba 'dis/ /rgyal thabs rdo rje'i gzegs ma 'phros snyam byed/ /e ma ri dwags mig can 'bum phrag gi /byed pos lang tsho'i tshogs kun bsdus pa'i dpyid/ /rin cen btsun mor grub pa'i phan bde'i nor/ /bod 'bangs yol go'i nang du 'phyur bur gtams/ /zhes bya ba ni skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas kong jo 'khor bcas rnams lha sa'i phyogs so sor 'khod pa'i skye bo rnams la sprul pa'i dbang gis mthong snang mi 'dra ba du ma byung yang / don du byang phyogs nas byon te lha gcig rtsis kyi gtsug lag la mkhas pas/ bod srin mo gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i dbyibs su gzigs/ klu'i pho brang gi steng du jo bo bzhugs na non par mkhyen nas/ de nyid du sku'i phyogs bzhir ka ba btsugs nas/ dar gyi yol bas mtha' bskor te/ jo bo shākya mu ni la mchod pa'i rol mo dri za'i rgyud mang lta bur dkrol bas/ bal mo bzas ci yin snyam nas pho brang gi rtse nas bltas pas/ kong jo dpon g.yog byon pa mthong nas/ phrag dog ste/ rgyal po dang kong jo mjal ba'i gegs byas par/ blon po mgar gyis khri btsun la/ kong jo spor thang gi rtsis la mkhas pa'i dbang gis gtsug lag khang gi dpyad sogs 'dri dgos pas/ rgyal po dang mjal du bcug pa 'thad ces gros btab nas/ (24nasgo jal 'phrad kyi dga' ston 'chi ba med pa'i dpal la 'gran pa byas pa'i dus su/ bal bzas/ rgya mo lun shing ko jo khyod/ /dka' las byas nas snye bos bkug /bod kyi yul du byon na yang / /nga ni snga bas chen ma yin/ /—29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyezhes sogs smras par/ kong jos/ 'gran pa'i 'gran sems med mod kyang / khyod kyis 'gran no zhes smras pas/ /them pa snga brgal chen ma khyod/ /lha khang rgya mtsho'i stengs su bzhengs/ /zhes sogs kyi lan brjod pa'i chen chun gyi gtam byung skad/ de nas lha gcig khri btsun gyis btsan po la lha khang rtsig pa'i gros zhus pas/ khyod rang gang legs su brtsigs shig gsungs pa ltar/ la gdong gi ne'u khar brtsigs par mtshan mo lha 'dres bshig pas/ g.yog mo zhig la gser phye bre gang bskur nas/kong jo la rtsis byed par zhus pas/ spor thang brgyad cu skor gyi steng nas brtsis pas/ kha ba can gyi yul 'di srin mo gan rkyal du 'gyel ba lta bur 'dug pa las/ 'o thang gi mtsho 'di srin mo'i snying khrag /dmar lcags kyi ri 'di snying gi rus pa'i rnam par 'dug na'ang / mtsho'i steng du shākya mu ni bzhugs pa dang / ri'i rtser rgyal po'i pho brang yod pas non cing / de dag gi mtha' skor na sa dpyad skyon yon gnyis las/ yon tan ni/ shar na mchod sdong btsugs pa 'dra ba/ lho na rin po che'i mchod rten 'dra ba/ nub na malji'i steng na dung phor bzhag pa 'dra ba/ byang na pad+ma kha phye ba 'dra ba ste/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i ri bzhi/ de'i nang bskor du nyang bran 'phan dkar gyi ri la gdugs/ mal grong gi ri la nya/mdongs mkhar gyi brag (24ba tshe pa pad+ma/ grib kyi 'khyags rul la dung / rdzong btsan gyi ri la bum pa/yug pa'i ri la dpal belā 'phan dkar gyi ri la rgyal mtshan/ brang bu'i sras la 'khor lo ste bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad/ lcags kha ri/ shug pa gdong / ra kha brag /jo mo ze rnams la gser dngul zangs lcags kyi gter kha/ shar gyi stag dga' gdong 'og ma/ lho'i g.yu 'brug gtsang chab/ nub kyi bya rti bu gdong / byang gi rus sbal pha bong kha/ mdor na gnam la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dang / sa la pad+ma 'dab brgyad de gtsug lag khang rtsig pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yod la/ 'on kyang skyon ni/shar bye ma'i ri la srin mo 'doms bzed pa lta bu/ lto na sdig pa gzan la rub pa 'dra ba/ nub shun gyi brag la bdud bya ra byed pa lta bu/ byang nyang dogs kyi bar na glang po che g.yul du zhugs pa lta bu'i ri/shar lho mtshams na btsan gyi rgyu sa/ lho nub mtshams na 'dre'i 'du phung / byang na ma mo'i nyal sa/—30

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pogazhan yang skum pa ri la chu srin dre'u khrid pa 'dra ba/ gnam sgo bye ba gnam ral gri 'dra ba/ sa sgo bye ba phag pa'i sna 'dra ba sogs sa dpyad ngan pa rnams gnon par byed pa'i thabs su/ thog mar rgyal po yab yum gsum gyis skyid shod nyang bran pha bong khar sgrub pa mdzad nas/ sgrub pa'i rtags thon pa dang / srin mo'i yan lag dang srin lag gnon par byed pa la/ g.yon ru khra 'brug /g.yas ru gtsang 'gram/ spus ru bka' tshal/ ru lag grum pa rgyang gi lha khang ste/ mtha' 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi/ kong po bu chu/ lho drag mkho mthing / byams sprin (25na dge rgyas/ byang pra dum rtse ste/ yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi/ khams slong thang sgrol ma/ spa gro skye chu/ tshal rigs shes rab sgrol ma/ tshangs pa rlung gnon te/ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang rnams brtsegs/ sngar bshad pa'i nye skor gyi sa'i dgra ngan pa rnams la mchod rten/ rdo'i seng ge /dbang phyug gi rten/ bya khyung / dung dkar sogs kyis bcos/ de rjes mtsho bsubs pa'i steng du gtsug lag khang brtsigs te rgya bal gyi lha rnams bzhugs na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing / phyis dbon sras rnams kyi ring la'ang dge 'dun gyi sde dang mdo rgyud kyi bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas su 'byung bar 'dug gsung / g.yog mos 'phrin snga phyi rnams nor zhing 'ga' zhig 'tsheb pas/ khri btsun gyis ra la sa bkal nas mtshor blugs pas rnyog ma long du song nas zubs su ma 'dod pas/ rgya bzas ngan bslabs par go nas/ rgyal po la zhus pas/ de ma thag tsan dan gyi sku la gsol btab pa dang / spyan g.yas las 'od zer byung nas mtsho thams cad khengs pa gzigs pas/rgyal pos/ khri btsun lhan cig tu mtsho 'gram du byon nas gser gyi sor gdub mkha' la 'phangs pa gang babs su lha khang gi rmang 'ding bar dmod bor te bskyur bas/ mtsho nang du babs te 'od kyi dra bas gang bar/ rgyal po'i zhal nas lha gcig khri btsun/ bal po rdo bzo bas 'od kyi dra ba'i rjes su rdo rgyob cig gsungs pa ltar byas pas/ rdo'i spre'u mchod rten lta bu zhig byung bar/ me chu'i gnod pa mi 'byung ched du rdo rje'i 'jim pa byugs pa'i shing rnams kyi rtse gtad (25ba)pa'i khar khro chu'i pha gu bkram/srubs rnams mkhar ba'i chus bsdams de'i steng du bso bag dang sa bzang ba rim pas gtang nas —31—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyematsho bsubs te/ chos rgyal dgung lo nyer lnga pa chu mo glang gi lo la 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi rmang btings nas brtsigs kyang / sngar kong jos brtsis pa'i bcos thabs rnams ma byung bar brten/lha 'dres bshig pas slar kong jo'i rtsis rnams zhib par rgyal po'i snyan du gsan nas shin tu dgyes te skyid shod nyang bran pha bong kha'i brag steng du sa phag khro chu la sbyar nas mkhar dgu thog yod pa brtsigs nas phyogs bzhir lcags thag btags/ brtan par byas te sgrub pa mdzad pas zhag bdun na rigs gsum mgon po mkha' la byon nas/ khyod kyis smon lam rgya chen po thob cig /nged kyis smon lam mtha' dag 'bad med du 'grub pa'i dpang po byed pa yin gsungs nas rdo la thim pa'i rang byon bal po'i lha bzo bas ji bzhin brkos pa ding sang yang lus can kun gyi 'dren byed dga' ston du gsal bar yod cing / de nas btsan pos sprul pa bkye ste/ mi 'gyur ba'i gzer gyi gtsug lag khang bcu gnyis brtsigs/ lha ma srin gdug pa can rnams kyi dpung rnams bzlog pa'i phyir du rgyal po rang gi sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i thugs rje chen po'i sku zhig bzheng bar dgongs te/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po bdar ba'i phye ma dang / gnas chen brgyad kyi sa/ chu bo ni rañja na'i bye ma rnams ba dmar mo'i 'o mas sprus pa'i 'jim pa rnams sta gon byas te/ bal po'i lha bzo khro ba zhes bya bar bzheng ba'i bka' gnang bar nang par spyan ras gzigs bcu (26na)gcig shal gyi skur grub nas gda' bas/ rgyal pos lha bzo ba la sku 'di shin tu legs te tsan dan gyi sku dang mchod sdong thugs gar bzhugs sgyu yin pa la gsungs pas/ de ma thag zhabs g.yon pa'i sham thabs pus mo'i gong du brdzes te zhabs mthil las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis de rnams drangs te thugs mar thim mo/ /de nas lha khang rtsig par mngon du phyogs pa na lho nub gla ba'i tshal na lha ma srin rnams 'tshogs te/'dre sgang po bdud mi zan bya ba gcig na re/ burnya dharma saṃ gha zer ba rnams la skyabs su 'gro ba'i srog gcod/ sngar brtsigs pa'i lha khang bzhig /chos byed zer ba la rims nad dang / bod khams su lo nyes gtong ba'i mdun ma byed pa rgyal pos gzigs nas/ rang byon thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab —32

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (popas/ jo bo ba 'ad pa'i zhal nas 'od zer byung ba mer gyur/ khros pa'i zhal nas 'od zer byung ba rta mgrin dang bdud rtsi 'khyil bar gyur/ khro bo me dang bcas pa skar mda' 'phangs pa ltar song 'dre'i 'du phung bshig nas/ dus mtha'i rlung ngang ma'i shugs la 'god par nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis gdug pa can mtha' dag phyi'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du bskrad/ zla ba tshal gyi brag la snang ba mtha' yas/ kha sa dru ṇi/ rta mgrin gsum rang byon du byon pa ji lta ba bzhin bal po'i lha bzos gsal bar brkos so/ /de nas rgyal pos sprul pa mtha' yas pa bstan te char zim bu 'bab pa'i na bun gyi 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i ngang du gtsug lag khang gi 'og khang rnams brtsigs nas/ nang par sprul pa rnams kyis shing (26ba)bzo byed pa'i skabs/ khri btsun rang gis zhal skyem 'dren du byon pa la/ g.yog mos sgo srubs nas bltas pas/ dar thod can gzhan las che ba zhig la 'dren gyi 'dug pa mthong bas/ sprul pa kho nar 'dug ces bgad pas/ rgyal po spyan yengs nas ste'u kha thal bas seng ge brgya'i sna bcad/gzong kha thal bas bug pa brgya phub/ sog le kha thal bas ka ba brgya'i zur nyams skad/ de'i mtshan 'og khang gi thag phub/ de nas khri btsun gyis bal yul nas bzo bo mkhas pa du ma bos nas/ steng khang rnams bzhengs pa dang dus mtshungs par kong jos rgya'i bzo bo mkhas pa rnams bkug nas ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs te/ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug yab yum gyi ye shes sgyu mas sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po rdzogs par grub nas/ ji srid rta bdun gyi dbang pos gdung byed kyi yul de srid skye rgu kun la phan pa dang bde ba bla na med pa 'byung ba'i sgo dam pa mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal pos 'phrul snang gi gtsang khang byang ngos su rang byon thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor spyan 'dren pa'i sta gon mdzad pas/ mtshan phyed la pho brang gi mthong khong nas gshegs te gtsang khang byang mar phebs/ nang par rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis lha rnams spyan 'dren pa'i bya ba la zhugs pa tshe sku rnams mi snang bas the tshom du gyur pa na/ sprul pa'i ba tso zhig gis sngar gyi rgyu mtshan rnams brjod pasadon la gnasapar gda' bas rgyal po dgyes te/ lha dang mi las khyad par du 'phags pa'i dngos bshams yid kyis—33—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesprul pa'i chu 'dzin gyi 'phreng ba mtha' klas par 'khrigs pa las (27nasgo cho de pa'i gru char mi zad pa'i bdag nyid can gyi legs byas kya myu gu skal bzang skye rgu'i dbyib du smin par mdzad do/ /de nas ra sa'i gtsug lag khang gi gtsang khang dbus mar de bzhin btage gas pa mi 'khrugs pa gtso 'khor dgu/ gtsang khang g.yas la sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas gtso 'khor dgu /gtsang khang g.yon du byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo gdan drangs te 'khor du sgrol ma brgyad/ gtsang khang lho na jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje gdan drangs pa'i 'khor du khro bo dang gnod sbyin stobs ldan gyis bskor ba/ gtsang khang byang du rang byon thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum gyi steng du yi ge drug pa/ don zhags/ kha sa dru ṇi/ 'jig rten dbang phyug /rta mgrin/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba rnams bzhengs/ klu sbrul mgo nyi shu/dga' bo/ 'jog po/ gnod sbyin nā ga ku be ra/ dri za zur phud lnga pa/ dpal lha mo rnams so sos bskul ba bzhin bzhengs/ g.yin yang bon dang sgrung gi gtam rgyud las byung ba'i bkod pa mtha' yas pa yang bri bar mdzad/ ra mo cher shākya mu ni gtso 'khor rnams bzhugs su gsol te/ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rmad du byung ba'i zhing khams dam par bde bar gshegs pa zhi ba dang khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram par rlung gi rgyal mtshan gyis 'khyud pa ltar rnam par bkra shing / mdzes sdug rnam brjid kyi rnam 'gyur grangs med pa 'dren byed kyi yul du chog mi shes pa ston par mdzad pa'i mchog gsum dam pa'i sku brnyan gyis gang ba'i ra sa 'phrul gyi gtsug (27ba tshe pag khang zung la rab tu gnas pa'i dga' ston gyis mchod pa'i yo byad bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa bshams nas/ chos rgyal yab yum blon 'bangs rnams kyis phyag tu me tog gi 'phreng ba bzung ba dang bcas bden tshig gi smon lam rgya chen po'i rta bdun gyis drangs pas/ bde stong gnyis med zung du 'jug pa'i 'gyur ba med pa mchog gi dbyings las/ rang snang lhun gyas grub pa'i gzhal med khang chen po nas/ bde bar gshegs pa zhi khro rab 'byams kyi nyin byed dbang po 'gog pa med par rgyu bas/ mtha' 'khob bsil ldan gyi sa gzhi kun la/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa pad+ma —34

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (sedakar po'i 'dab brgya rnam par rgod pas bod 'bangs ra yig gnyis pa'i tshogs kun dga'i gar dang snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro srid rtse'i bar du sgrogs par gyur to/ /smras pa/ ma smad legs byas mngal gyis lci ba'i khur/ /ngo mtshar snying po ye shes sgyu ma'i gar/ /phan bde zla shel gsar pa'i ga bur thigs/ /'bum phrag 'dzag pa'i rnam par dkar ba'i rgyun/ /gcig tu bsdoms pa'i ke la sha yi chus/ /srid 'dir 'khor ba'i ma rig dri ma'i tshogs/ /drungs nas byung byed lha ldan yid bzhin dbang / /bde legs snang ba'i gzi byin 'od du 'bar/ /de phyir rna ba brgyad pa pad dkar mig /mgrin sngon mig stong can sogs 'chi med rnams/ /snyim par med byung mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /thogs te lha lam khyon kun dog por 'god/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas rgya bza' dang bal bza' (28na gnyis la sras ma byung bar/ ru yong bza' dang / zhang zhud bza'/ mong bza' khri lcam rnams khab tu bzhes par/ sngon ma gnyis la sras(ma byung yang / brag lha dang / thim bu lkog gi lha khang bzhengs/mong bza' la sras gung ri gung btsan 'khrungs/ yum sras gnyis kyi rten skal du 'phags ma sgrom ma'i dbyibs can gyi ri/ dpal gyi yer ba'i lha khang bzhengs/ lo bcu gsum lon tshe rgyal sar dbang bskur/ btsun mo 'a zha bza' kho 'jo mong rje khri dkar ti shags bya ba khab tu bzhes pas sras mang srong mang btsan 'brungs/ gung ri gung btsan dgung lo bco brgyad lon nas gshegs/ bang so don mkhar mdar brtsigs/ slar yab rgyal pos rgyal srid bzung ste/ mi bsrun pa'i skye bo rnams yang dag pa'i khrims la 'jug pa'i slad du/ mi 'ga' zhig gi mig bton pa dang / mgo lag bregs pa sogs lcags ri'i kha na rgyun mi chad par sprul pa'i dus/ thugs rje chen po bod kyi rgyal por yod pa'i lung bstan byung ba la brten nas/ ched du 'ongs pa'i li yul gyi dge tshul gyis/ khrims bcad pa'i mgo lag mthong bas/ log lta skyes pa bsal phyir a mi de wa bstan cing dam pa'i chos kyis tshim —35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyepar mdzad nas/ skad cig la li yul du sleb pa'i rdzu 'phrul mdzad pa dang / khra 'brug gi mchod rten rtse lnga'i drung na rab byung gi rtags can hrul po zhig la phyag mdzad nas/ nga bod kyi rgyal po zhig gis bstan pa la bsams te khyod la phyag btsal ba ngo mtshar ram gsungs pas/ rab byung des mchod rten sor mo'i rtse la blangs te 'di ngo (28ba)mtshar ram zer bar/ lan du rgyal pos a mi de wa bstan pas/ btsun pas gri gug gis brang kha phye nas sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga bstan pa sogs dpag par dka' ba'i rdzu 'phrul mdzad cing / rgyal pos kyang ka ba shing lo can na chos gter/ seng ge lag zan dang sbrul mgo can la drag sngags/ bum btsan la rin po che'i gter/ klu khang na klu gter dang rin po che ra tā de wa/ dkyil 'khor 'og la rin po che stag sha chu dar gyis bsgril/ sprul lpags kyis gtums pa/ them pa'i nye skor na be+e ḍūr+ya 'a lhung bzed rnams sbas/ skal ldan rnams la thugs rje chen po/ rta mgrin/ gshin rje'i gshed sogs yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zab chos dang / ma 'ongs lung bstan/ rje 'bangs yongs la zhal gdams mtha' yas pa stsal ba phal cher yi ger btab nas/ rgyal po'i bka' bzhin blon po rnams kyis gter du dkor mdzod dang rta mgrin gyi zhabs 'og tu sbas so/ /de nas thun mong zhes pa lcags pho khyi'i lo la las can 'ga' zhig gi snang ngor chos rgyal yab yum gsum gtsang khang byang mar byon nas gsum ga 'od kyi gong bur byas te thugs rje chen po'i thugs shar thim par/ mong bza' khri lcam gyis/ rgyal po yab yum gsum de ltar mdzad na/ nged bod 'bangs rnams ji ltar byed ces smre sngags bton pas/ thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas rgyal po dang / nu ma gnyis nas khri btsun dang kong jos dbu nyug mdzad de zhal gdams 'ga' zhig gsungs so/ /de nas da lta'i rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu lug 'di yan la lo dgu brgya dang sum cu rtsa gnyis song / de nas (29na)thugs rje chen po rang byon lnga ldan gyi thugs ka las 'od zer ston sga'i zla ltar dkar ba shar nas/ gtsug lag khang gi phyi nang thams cad gsal bar byas pas bskul te rta mgrin/sgrol ma/ sman bla/ byams pa chos rje/ jo bo mi bskyod pa/ rme ba brtsegs pa/ 'od dpag med/ mar me —36

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pemadzad rnams kyi thugs ka las 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros te/ 'phrul snang gi bar mtshams med par khyab pas 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad du grags so/ /dus der blon po sna chen po dang khri lcam gnyis ma gtogs med pas/ slar g.yin rnams 'phrul snang du 'tshogs te the tshom du gyur pa na/ sngar gyi byung tshul rnams bshad pa dang / thon mis li yul gyi dge tshul dang / khra 'brug gi sprang ban la rgyal pos sprul pa bstan pa'i lo rgyus bshad pas nges shes su gyur/ 'on kyang 'bangs byings kyi snang ngor bran mo zhig rims nad kyis btab pa bal mo bza' la 'gos/ de las chos rgyal dang kong jo gnyis la yang mched de/ yab yum gsum ka 'phan yul zal mo'i sgang du gshegs pa'i pur yar klung 'phyong rgyas su spyan drangs te bang so brtsigs so/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi ring la rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang brten pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhed ba/ dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba dang / thos bsam sgom gsum sogs kyi srol legs par btod pas/ rang cag gangs can pa rnams kyis ni 'di nyid kyi bka' drin 'dzin ma'i khyon mtha' dag yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches bkang yang 'khor ba'i thabs rnyed pa ma yin no/ /chos rje bsod nams (29ba)grags pas/ rgyal po 'di nyid kyi ring la bstan pa'i dbu brnyes par 'chad pa ni deb ther yig tshang sogs la zhib cha dman zhing / rtog ge'i rig pa tsam rgyas rang bzo la thal ba'i skyon yin no/ /de yang rgyal po bka' chems dang lung bstan mangs pa'i nang du/ bstan pa rin po che 'dzin pa dang / khyad par 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang 'di la phud dud mdzad pa'i dam pa rnams kyi lung bstan mtha' yas pa yod pa'i khrod nas/ dge slong byang sems shar phyogs sku 'khrungs pa'i/ /gsang sngags 'chang zhing rnal 'byor chen po ni/ /snying po'i mtha' can skyes chen dam pas ni/ /zhal yang bsgyur zhig rnyed bkur dam pa mdzad/ /ces pa'i don shar phyogs tsong kha'i yul du sku 'brungs shing 'jam dpal snying po'i mtshan can —37—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)gyis shākya mu ni sprul sku longs skur bsgyur zhing / cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad tshul gyi rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i lung bstan mngon sum gyi tshad mas grub pa la/ dpa' bo gtsug lag 'phreng bas/ byang chub sems dpa' shar lhor sku bltams pa/ /zhes bcos byas nas/ dwags po sgom tshul gyi lung bstan du smra ba ni/ rang nyid chos brgyad kyi chang gis bag med du myos shing / blang dor la blta ba'i mig phyogs lhung drag po'i rab rib kyis ldongs pas/ rang dang rjes su zhugs pa mtha' dag gtam ya mtshan can du 'dod kyang / don du mkhas pa'i dbang po 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung las/blo ngan las la spyod pa la/ /rang gi 'bad pas thob par sems/ khyi rgan ya rkan phug pa'i khrag /rus pa'i bcud du bsgoms nas 'cha'/ /(30na smo pa pa ltar shes ldan rnams na kyas brtags tshe ba 'ad gad kyi gnas te/ sgam po tshul khrims snying po gnyal bod snyir 'khrungs pas/ lho rgyud gnyal zhes kun la grags shing / mkhas pa kun gyis gleng ba'i lung bstan la bzo bcos byed pa ni byed pa po rang nyid blun por dngos su bstan pa'i phyir na tshig gzhan rnams la legs nyes kyi rtog dpyod bya ma dgos so/ /gzhan yang chos kyi rgyal po thugs rje chen po'i thugs skar thim pa'i skor der gtam rgyud sngon ma 'ga' zhig gi lugs bskyar ba las/ rang lugs dang ga 'an lugs kyi dbye ba phyed pa'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab kyi dpyad pa med pa'i dgos med kyi tshig tshogs sogs kyis mtshon pa la rmongs pa rnams yang dag par 'dod srid na'ang / blo ldan dag ci'i phyir rjes su 'jug ste/ mi gtsang ba'i ngan skyugs kya phung po la khyi phag sogs kyis longs spyod na'ang / mi'i 'gro ba su zhig gis za bar mi byed pa bzhin no/ /de nas dbon sras mang srong mang btsan gyis rgyal srid bzung / dus der rgya rnams kyis sprul pa'i rgyal po ma bzhugs par shes nas dmag 'ongs pa 'phrul snang du sleb pa dang / rme brtsegs kyi sku las sprul pa'i dmag byung bas phyir bros/ de'i lan du mgar gyis bod dmag 'bum tsho khrid nas rgya rnams bcom/ mgar yang dmag thog tu grongs/ de nas slar rgya dmag gi skad chen po byung bas jo bo —38

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (polho sgo me long can du bcug /sgo la zhal ba byas nas 'jam dbyangs kyi sku bris/ mi ring bar rgya dmag rnams lhags te po ta la'i pho brang me la bsregs/ jo bo shākya mu ni 'khyer (30bsgo thub kyang mi bskyod rdo rje snga dro gcig gi sar gdan drangs so/ /mang srong dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun la gtsang gi bar snang sgang du gshegs/ bang so gung srong gi g.yon du brtsigs/ rje de la 'bro bza' khra bo khri ma lod khab tu bzhes pa'i sras 'dus srong mang po rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po yab 'das nas zhag 'ga' zhig song ba dang ga spungs/ 'di'i ring la rngog ring la nag pos glang po che'i phru gu theg pa/ rngog gling gam gyis g.yag grus po che theg /gnon rgyal mtshan gyis mda' ste'u kha mas bya khri'i rked pa gcad/ dbas rgod sdongs btsan gyis mig rgyang gsum la mda' rgyang gis sleb/ 'gos g.yag chung gis sha ba'i rlid bu bye mas bkang ba klad la bskor/cog ro 'brong shor gyis 'brong 'thur du brgyugs pa gyen la 'then/ gnon khri btsun g.yu sbyin gyis rta g.yang la mchongs pa gyen la 'then nus pa ste/ rtsal po che bdun byung / bang so mang srong g.yon du brtsigs/ rje de dang mchims bza' btsan mo rtog ge'i sras khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshoms pho brang ldan mkhar du 'khrungs/chos rgyal srong btsan snyam pos/ da ste gdung rabs lnga na nga'i dbon sras rgyal po lde zhes bya ba'i ring la dam pa'i chos 'byung ba'i lung bstan zangs kyi byang bu la bris pa brnyed pas/ rang nyid du go ste/ gangs ti se nas paṇ+ḍita sangs rgyas gsang ba dang sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis gdan drangs kyang ma 'drongs/ 'on kyang pho nya bas theg pa chen po'i mdo sde lnga blo la bzung nas 'ongs pas/ glegs bam lnga po bzhengs te/ bzhugs khang du brag dmar mgrin bzang / brag dmar ke sa gsang mkhar (31na)brag /mchim po sna ral/ ma sa gong gi lha khang dang lnga bzhengs/ rgya yul zhing shi nas gser 'od dam pa dang 'dul ba las rnam par 'byed pa dang / sman dpyad kyi rigs 'ga' zhig bsgyur/ li yul nas rab tu byung ba spyan drangs nas gus par mdzad kyang bod kyi mis rab tu byung ba ni ma byung / phying ba stag —39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shertse nas nor khyad du 'phags pa g.yu zhig rnyed/ 'jang mo khri btsun khab tu bzhes par sras mjang tsha lha dbon zhes pa lta bas chog mi shes pa'i mdzes sdug can zhig 'khrungs par bod na de'i btsun mor 'os pa'i na chung ma rnyed pas/ rgya rje yag 'jam li khri bzher lang ma'i sras mo kong jo bsu ba'i skyes kyi dngos po dang pho nya mngags par legs nyes ston pa'i me long zhig yod par bltas pas yar klungs kyi yul dge bcu'i yon tan yongs su tshang zhing / rgyal bu de lha'i khye'u ltar mdzes pa zhig tu mthong nas byon na'ang / gnyags kyi bu mo ma blangs pa'i 'khon gyis gnyags khri bzang yang 'don gyis rgyal bu bkrongs/ bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/ dus der kong jos me long la bltas pas/ rgyal bu bzhin mi sdug pa zhig tu mthong ba bzhin bod nas gtam ngan pa skyel mi byung na'ang byon/ jo bo rgyal rabs gsum du mun par bzhugs pa lho sgo me long can nas bton te gtsang khang dbus mar bzhugs su gsol nas mchod pa btsugs/ mchims phur mes ag tshoms kyi btsun mor mnga' gsol lo/ /smras pa/ legs byas sa 'dzin dbang pos bsrubs pa'i 'phags mchog thugs rje'i chu gter las/ /mngon par 'thon pa'i srong btsan nyin byed (32bcub phyogs chu lha'i ltor gzims kyang / /slar yang khri srong bsil sbyin mkhan po dbang phyogs ri bo'i spor son pas/ /phan dang bde ba'i kun da ba 'ad do lus can gnyis skyes gar byos kye/ /bgrod dga'i yul kun dal ba brgya phrag gis/ /dā ri dri bzhin myul bar ma phyin kyang / /brtan g.yo'i chos kyi gnas tshul kun 'char ba/ /skyes thob shes rab me long gsar pa'i drin/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan nas glang dar bar gyi rgyal rabs brjod pa/de yang mgon po zur phud lnga pa'i 'phrin las su wa ṇa'i 'khor lo'i lta ba lhun gyis grub pa'i mchod sdong tshen po bod kyi rgyal po'i rigs kyi skyes bu mi'i khyu mchog tu 'phags par sprul nas lugs —4(lha

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ ('azung gi rtsibs stong thogs pa med par 'khor ba'i ched du yab khri lde gtsug brtan dang / yum kong jo gnyis kyi sras su sna tshogs zhes pa chu rta'i lo pho brang brag dmar du rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan sku bltams/ dus der rgyal po'i btsun mo rnam snang bzas kyang rgyal po'i sras zhig mngal du chags pa skad zer nas kong jo'i sras phrogs te khong rang las skyes pa ltar byas pas/ rje blon rnams the tshom du gyur pas zhal lce gcod pa'i sbobs pa ma byung zhing /kong jo yid ma rangs par bod kyi sa dpyad bzang ba 'ga' zhig nyams su bcug /mi ring bar sras zhabs 'dzugs kyi dga' ston la btsun mo gnyis kyi pha ming dang blon 'bangs rnams 'tshogs pa'i dbus su/ rgyal pos 'bras chang gis bkang pa'i gser gyi phor pa sras kyi lag tu gtad/ snod gser skyogs chang gis gang ba 'di/ /bu khyod rang gi zhang po'i lag tu thod/ /ma gang (32na than gyi yid ches de la byed/ /gsungs pas/ sras kyis rin po che'i phor ba rgya rnams kyi lag tu gtad nas/nga khri srong lde btsan rgya tsha yin/ /rnam snang gang gi don mi 'tshal/ /gsungs pa dang / kong jo yid rab tu dga' ste/ tshe sngon ma'i las kyi 'phen pa yis/ /nga rgya nas 'ongs pa'i bu mo la/ /rje 'gran med rgyal po'i sras shig 'khrungs/ /zhes sogs kyi gtam smras nas/ sngar sa dpyad nyams su bcug pa rnams bsos skad/ /dpa' bo gtsug lag 'phreng bas/ chos rgyal 'brungs lo la sba bzhed bu ston gyi lugs sogs yig tshang mang po zhig gi 'dod pa bskyar zhing / sba bzhed kyi lugs de 'khrul bar bshad ma thag tu/ sba bzhed kyi gtam rgyud tshang bar bris pa la/ rang lugs 'thad ldan du bzhag pa dang / gzhan lugs mi 'thad par dgag pa'i rnam dbye med par mig gis mthong tshad dang rna bas thos tshad yi ger bri ba ni sos dus kyi nya ma 'phul byed kyi thabs ni yin mchis/ mkhas pa chen po bu ston zhabs kyi gsung phal cher tshad mar gda' bas/ rgyal po sa rta la 'brungs par gsungs pa 'di yig mkhan gyis nor ba'i rgyun 'byams pa zhig yin nam/ gang ltar chos rje bsod nams grags pa sogs 'ga' zhig gis/ rgyal po —4/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)khri srong lde btsan sa rta la 'khrungs pa dang /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po me glang la 'khrungs par byed pa ni/ gtsug lag rtsis kyi gzhud lugs la blo gros kyi 'jug pa shar ba zhig gis brtags tshe lo grangs bcu gnyis tsam mi 'grig pa'i mu cor gyi gtam du zad do/ /sras (32ba)dgung lo chung ngu'i dus/ rgya yul du sang shi gtsug lag 'ga' zhig len du btang bar lam du sdogs pa dang / rgya yul gyi ju zhag mkhas pa zhig gis/ da ste zla ba gsum na nub phyogs nas bod btsan po'i pho nya rtags dang sha tshugs 'di 'dra ba 'byung zhes gzugs brnyan bris nas rgyal por gsol ba bzhin byung bas/ rgya rje dgyes pa'i bka' stsal zhing / mthing shog la gser gyis bris pa'i glegs bam sogs bya dga' chen po gnang / dus skabs de dag na bod du yab rgyal po dgung lo drug cu re gsum la gshegs/ bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/ sang shi slar bod du yong ba'i lam du ha shang mngon shes can zhig la bod kyi bde dog dris pas/ btsad po gshegs/ rgyal bu nar ma son/ bdud blon rnams kyis khrims bu chung bcas nas chos bsnub pa sogs kyi lung bstan/'on kyang rgyal bu nar son pa na glegs bam gsum po 'di rnams rim gyis snyan du gsol/ za hor gyi dge slong shan+ta rak+ṣi spyan drongs shig ces zer ba yid la bzung nas hwa shang gcig khrid nas bod du 'ongs pa na/ ma zhang sogs kyis rgyal po sku tshe thung ba dang bkra mi shes pa chos kyis lan pas chos byar med pa'i khrims bcas te/ shākya mu ni rgya yul du skyel ba'i thabs byas kyang ma theg par sa 'og tu sbas/ 'phrul snang du bshas ra byas dus der sna rnam khri thog rje thang lha 'bar bya ba rgyal bas/ lcog ro skyes bzang rgyal mgo byad bskams nas shi bas/ ltas mkhan dang mi phal cher gyis lha sa 'og tu sbas pas lan zer bas/ skyid grong du bskyal/ brag dmar mgrin bzang bshig 'dug (33na)pas/ sang shis rgya'i glegs bam rnams mchims phu'i dzo la sbas/ hwa shang slog /skabs der sba gsal snang gi bu mo shi ba/ hwa shang gis ro'i khar mu tig mtshal gyis byugs pa'i mtshan ma byas bcug nas ma'i mal 'og tu sbas/ bu mo ma'i bur skye ba'i lung bstan pa bzhin btsas pa'i skabs su kha na mu tig byung bas/—42

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ ('tshe phyi ma yod pa'i nges pa rnyed nas/ gsal snang chos kyi ched du lho bal du 'gro bar rje la gsol pas mang yul gyi khad dpon du brdzangs/ sba bzhed du/ gsal snang mang yul du song ba'i rjes su sang shi rgya nag nas 'khor bar bshad 'dug pa dang / dpa' bo gtsug lag kyang de'i rjes su 'brangs na'ang /gong 'og tshig gi 'gal 'du yod med ma brtags pa'i bab col te/ hwa shang ni rgya'i chos ston pa'i slob dpon yin zhing / chos khrims bzhig pa'i don gyis ra mo che'i hwa shang sogs bod na yod pa kun phyir bskrad zin/ gsal snang gi bu mo bur skye ba'i lung bstan byed pa po de sang shis gsar du khrid yongs pa'i hwa shang der ngos 'dzin dgos pas/ snyigs dus kyi mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu gzhen nu dpal ba'i deb sngon dang / shes bya kun la gzigs pa'i spyan ldan sprul sku ngag dbang nor bu'i chos 'byung bstan pa'i pad+ma rgyas pa'i nyin byed du/ sang shi bod du sleb nas gsal snang stod du song ba'i go rim mdzad pa 'di 'thad do/ /mi ring bar rgyal bu sku nar son te/ mes rnams kyi yig tshang gzigs pas chos mdzad par dgongs pa'i gtam mdzad pas sang shis sngar hwa shang gis lung bstan pa'i (33ba)dus der go nas glegs bam rnams dzo khrod nas blangs te/ dge ba bcu'i mdo/ rdo gcod/ sa lu ljang pa rnams gzigasasu phul bas lta spyod dag cing zung du 'brel bar go nas dad de/ rgya me mgo dang kha che a nan+ta sa skad 'gyur byas pas ma zhad sogs kyis bkag /chos blon rnams kyis sang shi stod du brdzangs/ gsal snang gis byang chub chen po dang / na len+dar mchod pa byas/ mkhan po rin po che dang mjal te mang yul du spyan drangs/ gsal snang gi btsad po'i drung du 'ongs nas mkhan po'i gsung dang rgyu mtshan rgyal por gsol/ ma zhang gi chad pa byung dogs nas gsal snang yibs su bcug /btsad pos lkog tu 'gos rgan sogs chos blon rnams dang bka' bgros nas/ mo rtsis pa sogs lung bstan mkhan po rnams la bya dga' byin te/ rgyal po rgyal srid dang bcas pa la chags chen po bdog pas/ de'i rim gror blon po che ba zhig zla ba gsum gyi bar la dur du 'jug dgos par bsgrag tu bcug ste/ 'gos kyi rkang pa —43—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyel bya rgod kyi lham gon pa sogs thabs 'phrul du mas ma zhang dang lhan cig bar dur nang du phyin nas phyir bros pas ma zhang gis bsnyabs kyang rgod spu snyim pa gang las ma byung / de ma thag dong kha bcad de/rje blon kun chos byed pa'i chad so byas/ de nas rigs kyis mngon par mtho ba za hor rgyal po'i gdung las 'khrungs shing / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos kyi brgyud gnas lnga rig pa'i nyag phran gyis bkug pa'i mkhas pa mtha' dag gi bla na mtho ba rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims dri ma med pa'i ma la ya'i rlung bzhon gyis sdom brtson gnyis (34na)bzung gi tshogs la dga' mgur spyod pa'i dpal ster ba/ bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes mngon du mdzad pa'i grags snyan kuṇ+ḍi ma'i cod pan phyogs kyi 'gram par 'god pa'i mkhan po rin po che bo dhi sa twa spyan 'dren pa'i pho nyar gsal snang brdzangs pa bzhin rim gyis phebs te/ 'om bu tshal du mjal/ mkhan pos rgyal po la dge ba bcu dang khams bco brgyad la sogs pa'i chos mang po bshad pas/ bod kyi lha srin rnams khros nas dmar po ri'i pho brang la thog brgyab/ lo nyes dang mi phyugs la nad chen po byung bas/ sdig blon rnams kyis 'go byas pa'i bod 'bangs phal cher gyis chos byas pas lan zer nas mi dga' ba byas pas/ btsad pos rgyu mtshan mkhan po'i snyan du gsol ba la/ mkhan pos yab mes kyi ring la gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhing ba/ chos bsgyur ba sogs mdzad na'ang / lha srin rnams ma btul bas/ btsan po 'ga' zhig gi sku tshe la bar chad dang / chos la sked nyag sogs skyon 'ga' zhig byung 'dug pas/ sa gzhi 'di dag drag pos 'dul ba'i ched du/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'dzam bu gling na che ba'i rigs sngags mkhan zhig yod pa de/ rgyal po nyid dang sngon mchod rten bya rung kha shor bzheng ba'i dus su smon lam gyi 'brel ba yod pas spyan drangs na/ btsad po'i rnam par dkar ba'i thugs kyi bzhed pa mtha' dag 'grub par lung bstan nas/ mkhan pos bal por byon/ de nas slar btsan pos thabs la mkhas pa'i mdzad pas 'bangs mtha' (34ba)dag chos bya bar khas blangs/ mkhan pos lung bstan pa de rmi lam du byung ba ltar mdzad nas/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes mchog —44

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ ('gi zlos gar las sin dhu rgya mtsho'i gling du sku 'brungs shing 'chi med tshe'i rigs 'dzin dang phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa/ dus gsum cig car du mkhyen pa'i slob dpon chen po mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya snga ltang du brdzangs shing / slar sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms sogs lam du bshad drag pos rin po che'i phyag rten dang bcas te mngags pas pho nya rnams ngal zhing dub pa slob dpon gyis mkhyen nas/ rdzu phrul gyis mang yul gung thang du phebs pa na mjal/ slob dpon gyis nyi zla thang la 'bab pa/ chu bo gyen la bzlog pa sogs sku'i bkod pa'i rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa bstan te pho nya rnams ldog tu med pa'i mos pa brtan po thob/ phyag rten gyi gser rnams mnga' ris phyogs su gtor te/ ma 'ongs par bod du gser gyi 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i rten 'brel mdzad/de nas rim gyis lam du zhugs te phebs pa na/ bod kyi lha 'dre stobs po che phal che bas go mtshams par/ gsang ba gsum gyi mtha' klas pa'i nus mthus srog gi snying po blangs nas dam la btags/ stod lung gzhong pa mda' ru phebs pa na/ lha bzang klu dpal sogs blon po rnams kyis bsu ba dang mjal nas dro 'debs par chu med pa la slob dpon gyis phyag 'khar btab pas nyal 'gro'i rgyun babs pa/ gzhed pa lha chur grags/ de nas mnga' bdag rgyal po 'khor bcas bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te mjal nas/ (35na)brag dmar mgrin bzang du bzhugs/ slar mkhan po gdan 'dren gyi pho nya mngags te phebs/ dus der rje blon gtsug lag khang rtsig pa'i bka' bgros nas 'bangs rnams bsags te/ zhang po rgya'i yul mthong ba'i mkhar zhig rtsig gam/ shel gyi mchod rten shar ri dang mnyam pa zhig rtsig gam/ gtsang po sbubs su 'jug gam/ lha khang bre tshad tsam zhig rtsig gam/ zhes 'dam ka btang bas ga skun rnams blo'i yul las 'das te lha khang rtsig par kha 'cham/ shākya mu ni mang yul nas gdan drangs te 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su bcug /slob dpon bod du yun ring bzhugs ma bzhugs kyi lo rgyus du ma snang ba/ mchog dman gyi blo ngor shar tshul yin yang / rgyu mtshan ma go bar so so'i lugs la chen te gtam sna tshogs smra ba ni/ rje sa paṇa —45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)gyis/ mkhas pa rang gis dpyod shes kyi/ /blun po grags pa'i rjes su 'brang / khyi rgyan ku co 'don pa na/ /rgyu mtshan med par gzhan dag rgyug /ces gsung ba'i rnam thar 'dzin pa yin zhing / bya ba sprul pa'i sku pad+ma dkar por grags pa'i snyigs dus kyi mkhas pa chen po de'i gsung las/ de ni dus gcig la sku'i bkod pa sna tshogs ston pa'i rdzu phral can yin pas/ de dag la go rim mi dgos kyi gtan tshigs su bsgrub dka'o/ /zhes pa ni rnam dpyod kyi rtsal dang ldan pa'i legs bshad kyi gsung yin no/ /de nas slob dpon gyis sde brgyad thams cad dam la btags te lha 'dre rnams dga' ba'i mthun rdzas dang bcas/ dregs pa zil gnon gyi mgur gsungs nas nam mkha' la rdo rje'i gar mdzad cing sa (35ba)gzhi byin gyis brlabs/ rgyal pos dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol/ gser gyi sta re thogs nas rmang brkos pas khru gang tsam gyis 'og nas sa zhag dkar ser dmar gsum ro phun sum tshogs pa bro myur bas btsan po thugs dgyes so/ /de nas mkhan pos gtsug lag khang gi bzo dbyibs kyi bkod pa mdzad par bzhed de/ sngon mu stegs kyi rigs 'dzin zhig gis ro bsgrubs pas dngos grub len par nye ba na/ grogs rtags mtshan dang ldan pa zhig dgos pas/ dbus 'gyur 'chang gi dge slong sgrub pa po'i dge tshul la ldan par shes nas/ gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dge slong la rin du phul nas/ dge tshul dang lhan cig du sgrub khang du phyin te/dge tshul la ro'i lce gcod tshul bslabs te/ lce gser gyi ral grir 'gro ba bzung nas yid la gang yod sar 'gro nus pas ded la thong / ro gser du 'gro ba khyod la rngan par byin na zer bas/ lce dar sham tsam pa lan gnyis su byung yang ma zin/ der mu stegs kyis/ nga lan cig 'ong ba de ma zin na/nged rang gnyis kyis 'go byas pa'i srid pa gsum gyi sems can gsod pas sgrims shig zer ba dang /lce sos bzung nas bcad pa ral grir gyur pa dge tshul gyis nam mkha' la dbyugs nas ri rab kyi khar phyin/ gling bzhi gling phran lcog dang bcas pa legs par bltas nas slar gri mu stegs la gtad/ro gser du gyur pas yo byad byas nas/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa la dpe byas nas —46

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (dzadabazhedas pa tse/ tan+ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang zhes bya ba la mtshan can zhig yod pas/ de la dpe bya bar gsungs te/ dge byed ces (36na)pa chu pho stag gi lo la bsil ldan kha bas bskor ba'i do rar 'khod pa'i lus can kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing rlabs po cher gyur pa dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi rmang btings/ rgya khyon gyi tshad/ btsad po rang gi mda' rgyang gang bar gsungs pas/ blon po rnams kyis lkog tu bgros te/ rje'i mda' rgyang gang la g.yin gyi gsum yod pas de tsam mi 'grub cing / bka' bcag pa yang mi rigs pas thabs shig byed par mthun te/mda'i smyug sdugs su dngul chu blug pas gzhan gyi mda' rgyang gang dang mnyam pa byung la/ de yang dbu rtse ri rab gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ yak+ṣa gong 'og nyi zla/ mthar lcags ri/ zur bzhir mchod rten/ sgo bzhir rdo ring khyad par jo mo'i gling gsum dang bcas pa/ slob dpon gyis dregs pa can thams cad las la bkol bas nyin mis brtsigs pa bas/ mtshan lha 'dres brtsigs pa mtho bar gyur/ dus der rgyal po'i mnal lam du/ has po ri'i rtser byon pas shākya thub pa gtso 'khor dgu sangs rgyas dngos kyis byin gyis brlabs pa 'dug pa gzigs pas dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad pa'i ngang la mnal sad de/ nang par blon po khams pa go cha khrid nas gzigs par byon pas/ bye ma'i 'og nas rdo sku rang byung 'thon te gtsang khang du spyan drangs pas sa g.yos pa sogs ltas khyad par can byung ba'i/ jo bo byang chub chen po nang rten du bzhugs pa'i ma hā bo dhis thog drangs/ 'og khang bar khang steng khang 'khor sa bar ma dang chen mo/ gling gzhan (36bsgoms kyi bde gshegs zhi khro 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku'i snang brnyan thams cad 'dren byed kyi dga' ston med du byung ba'i zil mngar du gyur/ khyad par mchod rten dkar por ma ga dha'i rgyal po'i sgo mdun gyi rin po che'i bum pa nas blangs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i gdung ring bsrel dang / mes kyi gnyan po gsang ba dang mdo lnga bzhugs pas byin rlabs mchog tu che bar grags shing / 'gro bza' khri rgyal mang mgo btsun gyis dge rgyas kyi lha khang la/ pha ming thag ring zhing sras med pas/ zhig gsos dang mchod pa 'byung bar dka' bar bsams te/ rtsig pa so phag —47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyel zha nye'i chu sbyar/ zangs kyi thog bkab/ mchod par rol mor cong btags/ mar mer rin po che margad sku gzugs kyi dpral bar btab zer/ pho yong bzas bu tshal gser khang logs la rtsig pa med pa/ nang na ka ba med pa sogs bzo sna bcu gsum gyis khyad par du 'phags skad/de yang lo rgyus smra la zla med dpal ye bzang rtse pas/ rgyal po'i 'khrungs lo gsal bar ma mdzad 'dug cing / mkhas pa'i dbang po bu ston rin po che sogs sa rta la 'khrungs par bzhed la/ sba bzhed du rgyal po yos la 'khrungs pa'i dgung lo bcu gsum pa yos steng du gtsug lag khang brtsigs par bshad na'ang / rgyal po'i dgung snying rta lor 'dod pa rnams kyis gtsug lag khang yos la brtsigs pas smra ba khungs che bar ma mthong zhing / blo chung rnams gtsug lag khang rgya khyon ha cang che bas lo lnga tsam la mi 'grub snyam pa 'char yang / dus de'i mkhan slob chos gsum sogs du ma zhig /bde bar gshegs pa dang byang (37na skra sprub sems dpa' mi'i srid pa bzung ba'i sprul pa'i zlos gar mu mtha' med par ston pa la/ /skye bo tha mal pa'i snang tshul dper bzung mi dgos so/ /de ltar dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang zil gnon zhes pa me pho rta'i lo la rdzogs par grub ste/ mkhan slob gnyis kyis rab tu gnas par mdzad pas/ dbu rtse'i lha rnams phyi rol du byon pa/ rta mgrin gyis rta skad thang gsum bton pa/ pad+ma'i sdong po skyes pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par du 'phags pa byung ba'i grags snyan dbyangs bdun brgyud du 'brugs pa'i rnga bo che srid rtse'i bar du bsgrags so/ /de ltar rab gnas dga' ston gyi tshe/ rje 'bangs thams cad kyis phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan gos bzang po spras te lha dang mi'i 'dod yon longs spyod thams cad byed pos gcig tu bsdus pa lta bu'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang / mkho rgu'i yo byad kyi dpal 'byor rmugs 'dzin gyi bang mdzod la dga' bder spyod pa lta bu dang bcas te/ tam bu ra'i rgyud las nye bar drangs pa'i snyan pa'i dbyangs dang dga' ba'i gar gyis 'dzin ma'i khyon mtha' dag rnam par gang bas skabs gsum pa thams cad —48

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dbyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (dzadame tog gi char sogs mchod sprin mngon par spro ba'i zol gyis lta bar lhags so/ /smras pa/ zhi ba mchog gi mkha' dbyings lus phra'i mig /sdom gsum dbang gzhu'i ri mo rnam bkra'i 'od/ /thun mtshams dar phab gzhen nu 'gugs byed pa'i/ /nges legs sa bon srog 'tsho'i sman gyi bcud/ /log 'dren dregs pa'i rdzu 'phrul lcags kyi zong / /mkhyen brtse nus (37ba)pa'i rtsis bsgyur 'dzam bu'i gser/ /mi mthun g.yang du lon pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /mun gling bsil zer can las gcig tu dkar/ /rin cen sna bdun 'dod rgu spyod pa lha'i/ /phan bde'i sgo 'phar brgya phye gtsug lag khang / /legs byas nor bu char du bsnyil ba'i gzis/ /ru bzhi'i skye rgu'i cod pan gtsug na 'bar/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de yang sba bzhed sogs sngon gyi yig rnying rnams su bsam yas brtsigs pa'i dga' ston lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du byas pas rje blon rnams rtse spo la yengs nas gtsug lag khang gi mchod pa dang zhabs tog ma byung bar brten/ lug gi lo la thams cad yod smra'i dge slong 'ga' zhig spyan drangs nas/ sba khri gzigs kyis rab tu byung bar bshad pa sogs ni lhad zhugs pa'i blun tshig ste/ de ltar na sba bzhed du gtsug lag khang yos nas yos la brtsigs grub par bshad/ dga' ston lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du byas pas/ yos nas stag gi bar du dus ston gyis yengs pas de la brten nas sbas rab tu byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ thams cad yod smra'i dge slong yos kyi lo la gdan 'dren dgos par/ lug tu byas na lo bzhi tsam gyi 'khyams rgyug pas/ bstan bcos kyi 'gor bris pa'i lo tshigs rnams la bsam blo ma btang ba'i gtam yin zhing / spyir yang skye bo ya rabs dag kyang rang gis 'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i bya ba yal bar mi 'dor na/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan lta bu rje btsun bstan pa'i 'khor lo 'gro ba'i mgon du rgyal po'i tshul gyis (38na sgom par rol pa'i sprul pa'i gang zag gi phan bde'i sman yon du thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa brgya phrag gis brtsigs pa'i gtsug lag khang dga' ston gyi gzhan dbang du btang nas mchod pa dang zhabs tog med par smra ba dam pa'i yul la skur pa btab —49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shepa'i sgrib pa dpag tu med pa gsog cing / skye bo tha chad pa 'ga' zhig dus ston du ming gis btags pa'i chang sogs kyis bag med par myos te/ chos srid kyi bya ba mtha' dag yal bar 'dor ba'i rnam pa chos kyi rgyal po de dag la 'char ba'i tshig 'di rnams la brtags na/ mkhas pa phal cher gyi sba bzhed la khungs su mdzad kyang bslad pa ma zhugs pa'i khungs thub pa zhig dka' bar snang ngo / /de ltar rab gnas kyi dga' ston grub nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas su 'byung bar byed pa ni dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las pas/ bod yul gyi mis rab tu byung ba'i bslab pa bsrung nus mi nus brtag pa'i phyir du/ me mo lug gi lo la rgya gar du rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi las thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa bod du legs par dgongs nas/ dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs/ gnas lnga mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tshos mkhan po mdzad de/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa mchog gis yongs su zin pa'i sad mi mi mdun gyis bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa'i sdom pa mnos/ de'i rjes su blo gsal zhing ya dgazhungs pa'i las ldan gyi skyes bu du mas rab tu byung nyid / shes rab kyi rtsal dang ldan pa dag la lo tsā bslabs pas/ byā ka ra ṇa'i gnad mtha' dag la sgro 'dogs chod cing / gzhung lugs (38ba)kyi don khong du chud pa'i 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu skad gnyis smra ba mang du byon/ lo paṇa de dag gis dam pa'i chos bsgyur zhing bshad nyan gyis gtan la 'bebs par byed pa la mi bsrun pa'i skye bo rnams rang nyams kyis spyod par mi nus pa'i khrims btsan po zhig dgos pas/ mes srong btsan sgam po sogs kyis bkas bcad pa'i khrims yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bar skabs su mi dge bar spyod pa'i dri mas cung zad sbags pa rnams slar byi dor mdzad nas/ rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing ltar ci bas mchog dman kun gyi gnya' ba gnon par mdzad do/ /de nas rgya gar sogs yul gru du ma'i paṇa grub 'ga' zhig spyan drangs/ rgyal po'i bkas/ sde pa g.yin gsum bod la mi 'tsham pas/ thams cad yod smra'i lugs kyi 'dul ba'i sdosnod dang / gzhan yang mdo gle dang / mngon pa'i sdosnod rin po che rnam pa gsum/ rgyud sde'og ma rnams bsgyur bar bkas —50

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dbyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (poganang ba bzhin bka' bstan bcos mtha' dag bsgyur te/ bod chen po'i rgyal khams kun tu dam pa'i chos kyi nyin byed dbang pos lung dang rtogs pa'i pad tshal rgyas par mdzad/ rnal 'byor chen po sogs theg pa'i rtse mo khyab gdal du mi bsgyur bar/ snod ldan rnams kyis spyad byar bkas gnang ste/ lo tsā ba chen po be+e ro tsa na/ dge slong nam mkha'i snying po sogs snga phyir rgya gar du byon te zab don bla na med pa'i bdud rtsi'i zil mngar shing gi bum par gtams te/ bod du byon kyang sdig blon rnams kyi phra ma'i dbang gis re zhig sprugs na'ang / slar spyan drangs/ paṇa chen bi ma la (39na〉ye tra'i grags snyan gyi nor bu btsan po'i 'gram par 'phyang bas gdan drangs te/ rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi zas ro brgya bas tshim par mdzad/ sngar bod 'dir bon dar zhing phal cher de'i rjes su 'jug pas/ chos sgrub pa'i gegs mang du byung yang / dus der lo paṇa rnams kyi sa bon gyi ring lugs mtha' dag dri ma med pa'i gtan tshigs rig pas tshar bcad/ slob dpon gyis mchims phu sogs su nges gsang rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sgrub thabs mang du bsgyur te/ 'jigs pa med pa'i sgrom bur rgyas btab nas las can la smon lam dang rje 'bangs du ma smin grol du mdzad pa'i mthu phul du byung ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i rtags kyi grags pa'i rna rgyan phyogs bral gyi rna ba'i lam du dog por 'geng bar mdzad do/ /de nas gtsug lag khang gi srung mar mkhan slob chos gsum bka' bgros te/ rgyal po'i dmag gis bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa bcom pa'i ka ca'i rjes su dpe har 'brangs te byung bar dkor srung bcol/ 'ga' zhig tu mkhan slob chos gsum gyis pho nya 'phrin yig mngags pa ltar/ g.yu'i thub pa bse 'bag /za hor rgyal rigs dharmā pā la rnams kyis sna drangs pa'i rjes la dpe har byon par bshad pa 'di skye 'gro rnams la smyo 'bog sogs 'tshe ba che drags par/ slob dpon gyis ar la gtad pas bha ta hor gyi yul du bros par bshad pa dang go rim 'grig par mngon no/ /smras pa/ /mdo rgyud chos phung yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /mkhas grub lo paṇa gangs ri'i zhal sgo las/ /'ongs pa'i glegs bam dal 'gro'i mdza' na mos/ /rgyal bstan rtsa lag mi (39ba)phyed dam —5/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyedu 'khyud/ /skyon bral rten bzang rgyud kyi zhing sa la/ /myang 'das sems kyi sa bon gsol bzhi'i brlan/ /rnam par ba 'ad pas tshul khrims myu gu'i 'bras/ /mngon mtho'i dpal yon bla na spel bar shis/ /gsang sngags mthu grub rje 'bangs nyer lnga yi/ /brjod bral blo las 'das pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'phags yul grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa rnams/ /'brog dgon dben pa'i gnas su yibs sam snyam/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /re zhig nas rgya'i hwa shang ma hā ya na bod du 'ongs te/ lus ngag gi dge ba byas pas 'tshang mi rgya/ ci yang yid la mi byed pas 'tshang rgya zer nas sgom bslabs pas bod 'bangs mang po log pa'i lam la khrid/ bcan po yang bkas bcad dka' bar gyur kyang mkhan po'i gsung dran te/ rgya gar nas ka ma la shrī la gdan drangs pa bzhin byon te/ ton rtsen rtsod pas ton mun pham ste hwa shang rgya yul du brdzangs/ de'i lugs mi byed par bkas bcad/ ka ma las sgom rim gyi bstan bcos brtsams/ sba bzhed du/ bcan pos rgya'i chos 'di min nam byas pas ton mun dang / lus la me gtong ba'i brtse ba de chos min nam byas pas brtse min par grags par bshad pa ni lhad zhugs pa'i blun tshig gi rtog btags las rgyu mtshan med cing / ton mun dang rtsen mun zhes pa rgya nag gi skad de/ bod skad du cig car ba dang rim gyis par 'gyur zhes mkhas pa'i dbang po bu ston zhabs gsung ba legs so/ /de yang rgyal po rnam gnon zhes pa lcags pho 'brug gi lo la bod 'bangs (40na)byings kyi snang ngor tshad pa'i snyun gyis mya ngan las 'das la/ las ldan rnams kyi yid ngor chos dbyings bde ba'i rang bzhin zad mi shes pa'i chu gter chen por sna tshogs sprul pa'i bkod pa nyal 'gro'i rgyun kun gnyis med kyi ngang du mdzad de rje btsun 'jam dpal rdo rje'i thugs gar thim mo/ /bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/ chos kyi rgyal po 'di la btsun mo 'ga' zhig yod kyang tshe spong bza' la sras gsum byung ba'i che ba mu ni btsan po rgyal sar bskos/ 'bangs kyi ltogs phyug lan gsum du stoms kyang / mi 'gyangs par sngar bzhin gyur par/ lo paṇa rnams kyis sngon gyi sbyin pa'i 'bras bu yin par gsungs —52

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (dzadapas/ rnam dkar gyi las la lhag par mos pa thob ste/ bsam yas su sde snod gsum gyi mchod pa btsugs/ mdo sde'i mchod pa deng sang yang yod/ rgyal srid mdzad nas lo gcig dang zla ba bdun la yum gyi dug btang nas grongs/ bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/ mu khri btsan po dang 'di gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin pa ma go bar dpa' bo gtsug lag gis/ 'di'i gcen du mu khri btsan po byung ba'i tha chad kyi gtam smras shing / chos rje bsod nams grags pas/ lo gcig dang zla ba bdun gyi ring la ltogs phyug lan gsum snyoms long med ces zhib pa ltar smra ba ni mu cor te/ sngon gyi las 'bras kyi shugs dgag par ma nus pa'i byed pos dbul po rnams la mkho rgu'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa byin kyang mi ring bar phongs pa yin la/ skabs shig na ltogs phyug snyoms pa tsam du ma zad 'dus byas thams cad 'jig pa'i (40ba)chos nyid can yin pas so/ /'bring po mu rug btsan po ni sngar rgyal po dang blon po zhang gnyis 'dzam gling gsum gnyis dbang du bsdu ba'i gros mdzad tshe/ sras kyi bka' bgros sar byon pas/ zhang gi bu 'u rings kyis rje blon bka' 'gros sar re zhig ma 'byon byas par/ sras chu gri bsnun te bkus/ blon po 'gos kyis zhal lce 'dar gsum dang dga' gsum bcad de/ sras re zhig spyugs pa slar mon nas spyan drangs te rgyal srid la bsko bar rtsom pa na/ blon po'i shul mi zhang sna nam gyis bkrongs so/ /de yang dpa' bo gtsug lag gis/ mu yi btsan po yab kyi dgung lo so bzhi pa chu stag la 'khrungs bar bshad pa ltar na/ chu pho stag gi lo chos rgyal dgung lo so bzhin sleb pa dngos su bstan pas/ shing sbrul la so bdun pa'i dgung skag yod pas/ gong du rgyal po lcags pho rta la 'khrungs pa dag pa'i phyogs bzung ba dang / sba bzhed du yos la 'khrungs pa'i bzhed pa bsgyur ba sogs gang dang yang mi 'grig pa'i nang 'gal gyi tshig mngon sum du ston pa 'di 'dra ni/ gzhung lugs la thos bsam byas pa lta ci smos shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa sus kyang mi smra bas gzur gnas kun legs par soms shig /sras chung ba mu tig btsan po sad na legs 'jing yon gyis dgung lo bzhi'i steng du rgyal srid bzung /—53—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)slob dpon gyis chos skal stsal/ rgyal rabs 'ga' zhig tu rgyal po 'di'i mtshan la khri lde srong btsan du 'chad pa ni sgra sbyor bam gnyis pa sogs ma mthong ba'i skyon no/ /yab mes kyi gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod pa/ shul na bzhugs pa'i 61 paṇa rnams la phul (41na)du byung ba'i bsnyen bkur dang bcas te/ sngar ma 'gyur ba'i gsung rab 'ga' zhig bsgyur/bod kyi rgyal po la nga che bas lha khang nyi ma tsam zhig rtsig go gsungs pas/ slob dpon mdzod mkhan gyis nyi ma'i rgyar dpag chad lnga bcu rtsa gcig yod pas/ bod 'dir mi shong zhes zhus par/ zla ba tsam zhig rtsig gsung bar de yang sngon dang 'dra tshul smras/ skar ma tsam zhig rtsig gsung bar rgyang grags bco ba pyo da yod chul bzhin/ byang 'brog gi thang yangs sa zhig tu rtsig par bka' gnang bas/ blon po kun gyis byang du brtsigs na lha khang stong par lus 'gro tshul zhus pa dang / slar rje 'bangs kun gros mthun par/ rgyal sde dkar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs/ bod kun phan pa dang bde ba'i lam du 'god par mjad nas gshegs te/ bang so 'phrul rgyal mdun na brtsigs so/ /de yang lha sras mu tig btsan po dang / sad na legs mjing yon don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin cing / rgyal sras lha rje de'i sras yin pa sogs rang nyid kyi rgyu mtshan go rim ma nges par/ dpa' bo gtsug lag gis/ yig cha gzhan dag la phyi rabs kyi rtsom rigs kho nar snang ba'i dpyad mi bzod pa sogs smra ba ni/rje bcun sa paṇa gyis/ khā tas mi gtsang zos pa'i mchu/ /gtsang ma'i ngos la 'bad de 'phyid/ /zhes pa'i don dang mtshungs pas/ phu thag mchod pa'i cal col gyi gtam nyung bar byos shig /rgyal po de la sras gcang ma/ lha rje/ lhun grub/ dar ma/ ral pa can dang lnga byung kyang / lhun grub chung ngur (41ba/gshegs pas bang so med/ lha rje ni dgung lo bco lnga la gshegs pa'i bur skye ba bdun pa shel gyi brag la rgyas btab bo/ /smras pa/ dpal ldan gsang ba kun gyi gan mdzod las 'ongs 'dzam bu nā da mchog /lus can —54

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (peyongs kyi bla na spyod pa'i mi bdag mchod sdong rab 'bar bar/ grub pa'i rang gzugs zlos gar gsar pa khams gsum man shel rtsig ngos la/ khar ba'i sa spyod 'gro 'di'i bsod nams 'bum phrag zong gis khugs yas ci/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /sras che ba gtsang ma ni/ srid pa'i phun tshogs kyi dga' ston mtha' dag lha lam lus phra'i bzhin ras kyi ngos su 'dren byed rlung gi rgyal mtshan 'khyug pa ltar mi brtan zhing / nyes pa brgya phrag bskyed pa'i rtsa bar gzigs te mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa mchog gis zin pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la zhugs/ de 'og dar ma ni/ rnam par dkar ba'i dge tshogs bsgrub pa'i bsam pa las phyi rol tu gyur te/ chu srin rgyal mtshan can gyi rjes su 'jug pa'i ce spyang la rgyal khrims dam pa'i chos kyis skyong ba'i rje bo gdong lnga'i dbang po 'khod pa'i gdan khrir mnga' gsol ba/ gtsug lag lugs gnyis dang mi mthun par 'phrul ldan rig pa'i sras kyi khrims kyi cang shes kha lo mngon par sgyur ba rnams kyis rtogs te/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag po rje btsun phyag na pad+ma dang / zur phud lnga pa mi'i srid pa bzung nas dge legs kyi mtshan ma mchog tu dwangs pa'i ri mo snang brnyan slar yang dpyad pa gsum gyis ra ri'i dri ma tsam yang (42na)drungs nas phyung ste rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa bla lhag tu ston pa'i ched du 'jig rten kun gyi cod pan la zhabs sen pad+ma dkar po'i chun bu mdzes byed kyi rgyan du spud pa'i rigs stobs kyis khyad par du 'phags pa'i za ma tog tu dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan 'phyur bur bltams pa'i mnga' bdag khri lde srong btsan ral pa can bod 'bangs yongs kyi ral pa'i lan bu rnam par 'dud pa'i seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa'i khri la mnga' gsol/ de yang mnga' bdag 'di mi zad pa zhes pa me pho khyi'i lo la 'khrungs pa nas bzung ste lang tsho gzhon nu'i dus nyid nas sngon gyi bag chags bzang po sad pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang mdzad cing / khyad par khri thog tu phebs nas rgyal thabs kyi bya ba legs byas kyi rgyur bsgrubs nas 'bras bu'i dga' ston la spyod par rab tu chas pa/ chos blon bran kha dpal gyi yon tan gyis byas/ sgra sbyor bam gnyis —55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)pa las/ rta'i lo la btsan po khri lde srong btsan pho brang gi'u shang rdo na bzhugs/ stod smad kyi dmag rje dang rkun chen btul/ gar spog gi pho nyas phyag 'tshal zhes sogs ltar/ nyi 'og gi mkhan po dze na mi tra/ su ren tra bo dhi/ dha na shī la sogs paṇ+ḍita du ma dang / lo tsā ba ska cog sogs gdan 'dzom par byas te/ sngar yab mes kyi ring la mdo sngags kyi chos phal che ba bsgyur zin na'ang / yul dbus khrur/ o rgyan/ bal yul/ rgya nag sogs skad du ma la brten nas bsgyur ba'i bod skad la bsgyur du ma btub pa 'ga' zhig so so'i rang skad du bzhag pas go dka' zhing / brda rnying dang sdeb 'ga' zhig la brten nas 'gyur mi bde ba dang klag (42ba)dka' zhing legs sbyar gyi skad dang mi mthun pa rnams dbus 'gyur gyi rgya dpe saṃ skṛ ta'i lugs gzhir byas pa rnams dang sgo bstun/ rgya dpe'i bcad lhug spel ma'i sdeb sbyor sogs bod skad la ji bzhin mi 'byung zhing / de dang bstun na go mi bde bas don rtogs sla ba gtso bor byas/ rgya skad du tshig bsdoms pa rnams de ltar bsgyur na gangs can ljongs kyi skad du 'phyugs 'gro ba dag phral te bsgyur ba/ ku sha la i gaṇa gyi rkyen byin pa'i ko shi ka lta bu sgra gcig don mang gcig tu 'chad par gtan tshigs kyis bsgrub dka' ba kun rang sor bzhag /mdor na byings las ming dang tshig gis bsgrubs shing / rnam dbye de phan nye sgyur tshig phrad sogs mtha' dag la zhib mor dpyad/ de nyid bod kyi skad la don 'gyur gtso bor byas te gtan la phab/ chos kyi rgyal po mes dbon gyi ring la mchog dman mtha' dag gi sems kyi ri dwags rang nyams su 'khyam par mi nus pa'i zhags pa dam pos yangs pa'i rgyal khams mtha' dag rang sar bde ba'i khrims kyi bya ba mtha' klas par mdzad pas/ yid 'phrog ma'i gtam rgyud las/ byang phyogs lnga ldan skyid cing rgyal ba de/ rgyal po de yi rgyal khrims chos bzhin spyad pa dang / 'bangs 'khor g.yog rnams kyis rgyal po'i bka' la nyan pas skyid pa yin zhes pa'i don dang mthun par gyur cing /de yang khrims ni bod rgan po ya rabs rnams kyi gleng ba'i srid pa'i khog rub chen po la don sum cu rtsa gnyis su grags pa'i bcu dgu pa khrims chen po la/ khri rtse 'bum gzher gyi khrims/ gser —56

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pothang sha ba can gyi khrims/ rgyal khams dpe blangs kyi khrims/ mdo (43na skolo na zhus bcad kyi khrims/dkon cog gi chos khrims/ jo mo mnga' dgas kyi khrims dang drug tu phye bas/ ngan la chad pa gcod cing bzang la bya dga' ster/ mtho ba'i gnya' nas gnon cing dma' ba thabs kyis skyong ba'i bka' khrims kyi srol bzang po'i 'od snang srid rtse'i bar du khyab pa'i bde skyid kyi puṇ+ḍa ri ka ches cher rgyas pa bar skabs su/ sdig blon mi gtsang ba'i 'dam gyi dri mas cung zad sbags pa lhag ma tsam yang dag par mdzad de yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi khyon kun tu dril bsgrags gzhan yang sman gyi bcos lugs bzhi/ dpyad mkhan gyi gab rtse lnga/ ya rabs(kyi skyen bdun/ mdzang bas pa'i mig bcu gnyis/ pho ltang gi nyer brgyad/ mo ltang gi nyer bcu gnyis/ phyag rgya drug /rgyal po'i gdan bzhi/ blon po'i gral brgyad/ phyag rka rtsa bu brgyad/ mdza' sdum bzhi sogs bod 'bangs kyi gtam dang yig tshang du grags shing / lag tu ster 'os pa rnams len pa'i srol chos kyi rgyal po 'di yan du ma nyams par gnas pa yin no/ /dpa' bo gtsug lag gis/ gsang sngags rdzogs 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyu/ /nor bu mi btsong snying la bcang / /zhes pa'i khrims/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skabs byung bar smra ba ni blun tshig ste/ chos rgyal gyi dus snod ldan 'ga' zhig la btsan po rang gi thugs rje chen po zhi khro sogs gnang ba las/gsang sngags kyi chos nor gyi phyir 'tshong pa lta bu'i khyab gdal du grags pa med pas/ khyad gzhi med pa'i khyad chos dang / dge bcu'i khrims kyi steng du mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims mdzad par/ de gnyis dril bas bcu drug yin pa ltar smra ba sogs/ 'chal (43ba spro shin tu mang ngo / /'di'i dus su rgya bod gnyis ma mthun par/ gtum drag rngam brjid dang ldan pa'i dmag gi dpung tshogs chen po rgya nag po'i yul du g.yul bshams te/ tsi na'i rgyal khams du ma bcom zhing /mi dpon dang / dpa' bo stag shar mang du bsad de cham la phab/ de nas rgya'i hwa shang dang bod kyi lo paṇa rnams kyis bar du bzhugs de tshig gi sbyangs bshad kyis dbon zhang mthun par mdzad/ rgya'i gung gu rme rur rdo ring zhig btsugs te rgya bod kyi sa mtshams su bcad nas phan tshun gnyis gas sa mtshams —57—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shelas phyi rol du bsgral ba'i dmag gi g.yul bshams pa sogs mi byed pa'i dpang du lha klu gnyan po bzhag ste bro bor ba'i yi ge lha sa/ rgya rje'i pho brang / rme ru gsum gyi rdo rings la bris/ dus der rgya bod gnyis mthun zhing 'brel bzang bar byung bas/ gnam la nyi zla zung gcig dang / sa la btsan po dbon zhang zhes gleng skad/de yang btsan po'i thugs su 'gro ba kun la phan pa dang bde ba ma lus par 'byung ba'i sgo dam pa ni lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che la rag las shing de 'dzin zhing spel bar byed pa dge 'dun la ltos par dgongs te/ dbu skra la dar yug btags pa'i steng la rab tu byung ba rnams bzhugs su la jug pa dang / dge 'dun mi re la 'bangs mi khyim bdun du bcad de 'bul ba sogs 'phags pa'i yul du byung ba'i chos kyi rgyal po rnams kyi mdzad pa las bla lhag tu gyur pa'i mdzad pa bzang po'i gtam kun gsal gyi mtha' klas par khyab bo/ /de nas mes rnams kyi gtsug lag khang la rnyed bkur zhig gsos mdzad cing / gsar du gtsug lag khang 'og thog gsum (44na rdo/ bar thog gsum sa phag /steng thog gsum shing las grub pa/ thog re re bzhin bya 'dab/ sgo pha gu dra phyed sogs kyis rnam par mdzes shing / steng gi rgya phub rlung gis bskyod tshe gdugs ltar 'khor ba'i ngo mtshar gyi chu 'dzin 'phreng ba yid kyi skabs gsum pa'i lam du 'khrigs pa las/ ched du brjod pa'i dbyar skyes kyi rnga gsang phyogs bral gtsug phud can gyi rna bar sgrog pa'i 'u shang rdo dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i steng thog tu mchog gsum dam pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bzhugs/ bar gyi thog gsum du lo paṇa rnams klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan gyis dus mda'/ 'og thog gsum du rje blon rnams sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag mngon par phye nas mchog dman kun la bde skyid kyi dpal 'byor char du bsnyil lo/ /smras pa/ sde bzhi'i cha shas yongs rdzogs rgyal thabs kyi/ /'khor lo lha lam 'dzin mar rgyu ba'i 'od/ /phan bde'i sa smos 'phreng ba rab ba 'ad tshe/ /legs byas ga bur gsar pa'i thigs pa —58

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (dzada'adzag /gangs can kha ba'i ngos su sum rtsen mdangs/ /dri bral gsar du 'phos pa'i sgyu ma'i grong / /sngon med gtsug lag gzugs brnyan ngo mtshar gtam/ /skabs gsum pa rnams gleng ba'i ca co sgrog /rtsod ldan sa 'dzin bgrod pa khrims gnyis kyi/ /gzhom med rdo rje rtse brgyas bcom pa'i tshe/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i mgron de 'gugs pa'i slad/ /phan bde'i gnyis 'thung sna zhabs ring du rkyong / /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de ltar tshul (44ba)bzhin rnam par spyod pa ma yin pa'i stobs kyi khengs pas dregs pa mtha' dag rang nyams su byed pa'i lugs kun chu shing gi snying po lta bur mdzad de rab tu lci ba'i rin po che'i gdan khri la g.yo ba med pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gdugs dkar po'i khor yug bde skyid kyi grib bsil la/ skye rgu mtha' dag ngal gso'i bde ba la spyod pa'i skabs/ nag po'i phyogs kyis yid rnam par brlams pa'i sdig blon rnams mi bzod ba'i zug rngu chen pos mnar bar gyur te/ chos khrims 'jig pa'i gros bshams nas/ mo rtsis mkhan po rnams bya dgas tshims par byas nas/ lha sras gtsang ma ma sprugs na/ rgyal srid 'jig par lung bstan pa bzhin du mon la sprugs/ sbas stag snas blon po bran kha dpal yon dang btsun mo gnyis mthun zhes rgyal po la phra ma bcug pas/ btsun mo ngang tshul lcebs/ bran chen pos lcags kyi srog rtsa bsgrubs pas ma 'grub par bkum/ de rjes btsad po blo ngan zhes pa chu mo bya'i lo la sbas stag sna sogs sdig blon rnams kyis zhal ltag pa'i ngos su ga khri kha/te bkrongs nas bang so don mkhar mda'i g.yon phyogs su brtsigs so/ /de nas ri dwags mtshan ma can gyi ko mu di rna ba brgyad pa'i byed pos/ swā la'i nags ljongs kyi yul grur khor yug tshar du dngar ba'i sprin gyi so can dag gi longs su spyod pa'i shed las skyes mtha' dag gi bde legs kyi mthu shin tu phra bar gyur pas/ gya gyu'i bro gar rtse ba'i mdun na 'don bzlog tu med pa'i las kyi mthu mi zad pa'i chu 'dzin gyi 'phreng ba stug po las/ mi dge ba bcu la bag med par spyod pa'i skyin thang drag pos legs byas (45na)dpyid kyi ma ma'i mngal khur las 'das pa'i thub —59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyebastan myu gu'i 'khri shing gsar pa ming tsam du gyur pas/ tshangs 'joms sder bcas rnam par dge ba'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i ku co drag po 'don bzhin du/ glang dar ma 'u dum btsan rgyal srid du dbang bskur/ sbas stag snas nang blon byas te/ chos bsnub par bsams kyang bsnyad ma rnyed pa'i skabs su/sang sar mu ge nad yams 'ga' zhig byung ba la bsnyad gdags par 'dod de 'bangs rnams la rgyu mtshan dris pas ma shes zer bar/ btsad pos rgya mo kong jo zhes bya ba'i gnod sbyin mo zhig gis gnod sbyin gyi lha shākya mu ni bya ba bod du khyer 'ongs pas lan te/de yang dang por lha 'di ri rab kyi rtser 'ongs pas lha rnams kyi g.yul pham zhing 'ongs/ de nas o rgyan ma ga dha rgya nag sogs su rim gyis 'ongs pas mi shis pa byung ba sogs yid nag po'i gdon gyis bskyong ba'i gtam du ma smras/ lo paṇa phal cher gzhan du bros shing / ma byon pa 'ga' zhig bkum/ rab byung phal cher 'dul ba'i sde snod las gsang ba'i rtags dang bral zhing / mi nyan pa rnams rngon pa byed du bcug /gsung rab phal cher lha sa'i brag la sbas shing / 'ga' zhig me dang chur sbyangs/ gtsug lag khang rnams 'jig pa'i thog ma 'phrul snang nas bya bar brtsams te/ jo bo rnam gnyis chu la bskyur ba'i gtam smras pa dang / blon po chos la dga' ba rnams kyis/ sku gzugs ha cang lci bas sku las nus par bsnyad btags te bye ltongs su sbas/ byams pa chos 'khor yin pa ltar byas nas rdo mtsho la bskyur te ku sgra chen po bton (45ba)pas/ bsam yas/ ra mo che rnams kyi gtsug lag khang gi sgo la zhal ba byas/ rgyal po dgyes su re nas btsun pa chang 'thung ba sogs kyi gzugs brnyan gyis/ 'on kyang khyim pa gos dkar gyi rten la gsang sngags sgrub pa dag ni nang gi de nyid rgyal blon gyis ma rtogs shing / rab byung gi rtags med pas gnod pa ma byung ba dpag med yod pas/ kun mkhyen ye bzang rtse pa'i zhal nas/ de ltar 'dul ba'i bstan pa la 'phel 'grib byung mod kyi/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags ni deng sang gi bar du nub ma myong la zhes gsung ba yang 'di la dgongs so/ /dus der yel par lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje ting nge 'dzin la khor mo yug tu gnas pa'i skabs/ dpal —6(snyi

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhan nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (0lha mos/ deng sang bod na grub thob khyod las med pas/ rgyal po sdig can bsgral ran zer ba'i brda zhig byung bas/ nang par bran la rgyu mtshan dris par lo rgyus rnams zhib tu bshad pas bsgral bya'i zhing du dgongs te/ rta dkar po la sol ba byugs/ gos phyi nag nang dkar gyon/ lha sar 'ongs pa dang /btsad po rdo ring gi yi ge klog pa'i skabs su 'grig pas/ phyag byed pa ltar byas te mtheb ltong sbyar/bden pa bdar te brgyab pas brang la phog /de ma thag bros te grib kyi ma gdong gi chu la bshan pas sol ba dag ste rta dkar por song / gos phyi nang bskyur bar grags shing / don du mchog gsum dam pa'i thugs rje dang rang gi grub pa'i mtshan ma sogs kyis sna tshogs pa'i mthong snang grub bo/ /btsad po lag pa gnyis kyis mda' la 'ju zhing / yang na lo gsum gyis gsod pa sngas/ yang na lo gsum gyis 'phyis zhes smra ba'i mus la (46na〉snga pa'i lam du gyur to/ /bang so 'phrul dang rgyal chen bar du brtsigs pa 'phror lus skad/ dus der btsad po'i btsun mo chung ba la sras shig btsa' bar nye skabs su yod par btsun mo che bas shes te/ lus la gos mang por bkris nas mngal du sras chags pa skad smras mi ring bar chung ma la zla dus thims pa dang sras 'khrungs pa shin tu gces pas mtshan mo mar me'i 'od kyis bsrungs pas gnam lde 'od bsrungs su grags shing / chen mas kyang spang phrug cig rin gyis nyos te/ mdang 'di skyes pa yin no zhes bstan pas/ so 'dug pa mthong ste/ mdang skyes kyi bu chung la so ni gda'/ 'on kyang yum gyi bka' brtan du chug zer bas/ khri lde yum brtan du ming chags/ de nas mnga' bdag gnyis lang tsho yar ldan du gyur pa dang / chos blon rnams kyis rgyu mtshan brjod pa ltar/ jo bo rnam gnyis dang byams mgon rnams so so'i khri la bzhugs su bcug cing / gtsug lag khang rnams su mchod pa'i rgyun 'dzugs pa sogs mdzad/'on kyang mnga' ris la ma 'cham par 'od bsrungs kyis g.yon ru dang / yum brtan gyis sbus ru bzung ste 'khrug long chen po byung bas/ de dag nas bzung ste rje gnya' khri btsan po'i gdung brgyud kyis bod kyi spyi la dbang ma sgyur skad do/ /—61—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)'od srung nas brgyud pa'i mnga' ris stod kyi rgyal rabs dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha gdan drangs pa sogs kyi skor/de nas mi ring bar gyen log byung ste/ de yang gyen log ni/ nam mkha' la bya gcig 'phur bar bya gzhan mang po 'dus te gnod pa byed par dpe byas/ /thog mar khams nas log /de yang rkyen blon po bran kha dpal yon nyes med du khrims la sbyar ba'i rkyen gyis gnod sbyin du skyes nas bskul ba po byas te lha 'dre gdug (46ba)pa can du mas mi rnams brlams par/ bu ston gyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rin cen bang mdzod du bshad cing / gyen log gi rjes su bang so phal cher kyang brus te bshig go /de ltar yum brtan gyi brgyud pa skyid g.yor kun la shin tu mang zhing / 'od bsrungs gshegs pa'i bang so 'phrul rgyal gyi rgyab tu brtsigs/ de nas bang so rtsig pa'i srol nub cing / de'i sras mnga' bdag dpal 9shes ra btsan/ de la sras khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dang / khri kyi lde nyi ma mgon gnyis 'brungs/ nya ma mgon gyis mnga' ris su byon te chab srid bzung / sras gsum byung ba'i che ba dpal lde rig pa mgon gyis mang yul bzung / bar pa bkra shis lde mgon gyis spu rangs bzung / chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyis zhad zhung bzung / lde gtsug mgon la sras kho re dang / krong nge gnyis byung ba'i/ gcen gyis rab tu byung ba'i mtshan ye shes 'od du grags/ 'di'i dus bstan pa sga dar nyams te paṇ+ḍi ta 'byon pa'i srol nub nas yun ring bar song zhing dus der bal po sle ru rtse bya ba'i lo tsā mkhas pa zhig gis paṇ+ḍi ta phra la ring ba dang / paṇ+ḍi ta : ti gnyis gdan drangs te 'ongs pas/ lo tsā ba shi /paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis kyis bod skad mi shes pas yun ring por 'khyams/ 'e tis rta nag tu lug rdzi mdzad/ 'on kyang ring mo zhig nas mkhas pa 'dra dang phrad pas gnyis gas khams su byon te bshad nyan gyi 'phrin las 'ga' zhig byung / : tis smra sgo mtshon char grags pa'i bstan bcos mdzad —62

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pedo/ /lar ni dus skabs de dag tu yang bod ston gsung rab kyi gnas la blta ba'i mig dang bral (47na)ba'i dregs ldan blun po dag la bkur zhing / paṇ+ḍita smri ti lta bu'i mkhas pa yang rdzi bo sogs ngan pa'i las 'tsho me ba 'di dag la dpags kyang / rje btsun sa paṇa gyis/ tsu ta'i yul du phyin pa na/ /rkang gnyis pa la mir mi rtsi/ /zhes dang / tsan dan gser las rin che ba/ /blun pos sol bar byasazhes grags/ /zhes gsung ba thugs med par snang ngo / /lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dharma pā la spyan drangs nas 'dul ba'i bshad pa dang lag len rgyas par mdzad/ slob ma pā la rnam gsum byung ba stod 'dul bar grags/ kho re'i sras lha zhes paṇ+ḍi ta su bhu ti shrī shān+ti gdan drangs nas sher phyogs kyi bstan bcos mang du bsgyur/lo chen rin cen bzang po dbu'i mchod gnas su mdzad cing / lo tsā ba 'di gu ge'i sa'i char snyung waṃ rat+na du zhes bya bar 'khrungs shing / lo gnyis lon pa'i tshe dbyangs gsal gyi sngags gsung zhing sa la ri mo 'bri ba sogs tshe rabs sngon ma rnams su blon po lug lta bu'i skye ba ma yin par mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta rim par brgyud pa'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar ba bstan/ khyad par rgya gar du 'byon pa'i bskul ma/ paṇ+ḍita bsod snyoms pa cig gis rgya dpe klog ma mkhyen pas thugs phyung nas/ shing gi grib ma la gzims pa'i mnal lam du mkha' 'gro'i rtags ldan gyi bud med cig gis/ srin bu'i kha chus rang lus bcings pa ltar/ /yul la zhen pas bdud kyi rgya ru tshud/ /de 'dra thar bar 'dod pa'i mi su dag /byang phyogs kha che'i yul du phyin nas kyang / /rgya gar shar nub chu bzhin myul nas (47ba)ni/ /dam chos rgya mtsho bod du bsgyur na bde/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan byung bas rkyen byas te/ dka' spyad du mas kha cher byon/ ka la wa ri bya ba'i grong du sleb/ bram ze zhig gis phyag gi ri mo bltas te shis pa brjod/ rkang mgyogs yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel bya ba la brten nas grong khyer ta ma la sa rnyir byon nas/ paṇ+ḍita shudha ko ra warma dang mjal te/ yo ga'i rgyud sgrung thabs rnams gsan cing bsgyur/ paṇ+ḍita g.yin mang po la'ang sgro 'dogs bcad de bod du 'byon par bzhed pa'i tshe/ rmi lam gyi ltas la brten nas paṇa chen nā ro pa dang / ka —63

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyem la gup+ta/ dzi na mi tra sogs la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos dpag tu med pa gsan/ mdor na paṇ+ḍi ta'i bla ma yang bdun cu rtsa lnga bsten pas gsung rab rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol du son cing bstan pa phyi dar la skad gnyis smra ba 'di nyid 'gran zla thams cad dang bral bas/ mkhas pa'i dbang po ye bzang rtse pas kyang bstan pa snga dar las phyi dar sngags kyi bstan pa bod du dar ba yang / lo tsā ba 'di kho na'i bka' drin yin zhes che ba mdzad pa yin no/ /lha lde la sras 'od lde/ zhi ba 'od/ byang chub 'od dang gsum las/ chung ba dge slong byang chub 'od bya ba/ phyi nang gi chos dang lo tsā la shin tu mkhas pa zhig bzhugs shing / de yang ye shes 'od rang gi gcung la rgyal srid gtad zin kyang / gar log dang 'thab pa'i dmag dpon du byon pas g.yul pham ste bcon du shor ba na/ gar log gis/ dkon cog gi skyabs 'gro 'dor ram/ lus kyi ljid dang mnyam pa'i gser gang yang rung ba byung na phyir gtong zhes pad+ma kha byung (48na)bas/ dbon sras rnams kyis gser mang du btsal kyang yun du 'gor zhing / ye shes 'od kyis gsung las/ da nged na tshod mthon por gyur pas 'di nas thon kyang bstan 'gro la phan par dka' bas/ gser rnams kyis paṇ+ḍita spyan drongs la chos dar bar byed pa'i bka' gnang ste/ mi ring bar grongs/ las chen kun rgyal bas/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od gser 'tshol du byon pa/ gar log gis btson du bzung bar bshad pa ni/ skye bo phal pa nor slong ba lta bu'i rnam par shar ba blo gros dman pa ste/ 'di nyid mnga' ris kyi btsad po chen po yin pas/rgyu mtshan zhib tu ma dpyad pa'i skyon no/ /dus skabs de dag tu rnga la zhen nas nam mkha' la 'phur thub pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ a ra mo ban : bco brgyad sogs kyi lugs 'dzin du mas skye bo mtshon gyis gsod pa dang / sha chang bud med bag med du spyod pa dang / 'dul ba'i bstan pa yang gong du bla chen po sogs nas brgyud de dar rgyas che bar yod na'ang / bstan pa snga dar gyi paṇ+ḍita'i phyag srol phal cher nyams/gsar du paṇ+ḍi ta tshad thub mang du ma byon pa sogs kyis/ bod ston rnams kyis so so'i 'dod sbyar gyi lugs re byas pas/ bslab bya'i gnas phra ching 'i kha pa mtha' dag lung sde bzhi/ de dag gi 'grel pa dang —64

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (7bcas pa'i dgongs pa bzhin 'phags yul mkhas pa'i lugs dang mthun pa zhig med par mkhyen nas lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/ log par rtogs pa'i tshul min gyi mun pa drangs nas byung bar bya ba'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa (48bskodha ljang gi dbang po lta bu zhig spyan drang bar dgongs so/ /'on kyang las chen kun rgyal bas/ a tsar+ya dmar pos gsang sngags thig le'i skor bsgyur nas rab byung du ma khyim par phab pas chos log mkhan po yin zhes smra ba ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta rang gi rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi dod ma mnyam pa'i rab tu byung ba 'ga' zhig sngags kyi de kho na nyid ma rtogs par 'chal ba'i skyon byung ba bden na'ang / paṇ+ḍi ta gsang ba shes rab lta bu'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chos log mkhan po zhes ngan smras byed pa ni/ rang nyid ngan song mu mtha' med par bsgrub pa'i rgyu yin pas shes ldan rnams bag yod par byos shig /smras pa/ yid srubs byed pa'i dpung gi sngo bsangs ma'i/ /bde srid rnam par ba 'ad pa'i 'dab stong tshal/ /zum tshe slar yang skal bzang rta bdun gyis/ /thub bstan nyin byed gsar pa drangs so kye/ /nus pa'i stobs ldan dpa' dang rtul phod pa'i/ /dpal ldan phyogs las rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i sde/ /rnon po'i nyag phran rgyud las 'phos pa'i tshe/ /sdig can btsad po'i snying la zug rngu byin/ /e ma mkhas btsun bzang po'i snyan grags kyi/ /yon bor blta ba'i mig gi lcags kyu yis/ /byang chub 'od stong gsal mdzad sgra 'dzin gyis/ /zhags pa'i phon po yang yang 'gugs sam snyam/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas mi g.yo ba'i snying stobs phul du byung ba'i rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che bskrun pa la bag tsha ba mi mnga' zhing / rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i dal 'gro'i klung gis/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa mkha' lding rgyal mtshan can gyi bgrod byed la sri zhu'i (49na dka' thub kyi brtul zhugs yang dag par bzung / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas kyi ya lad —65

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)btsan po gyon zhing / mdzangs pa'i yon tan gyi du kū la'i ba dan dkar po srid pa'i rtse mor g.yo ba'i paṇa grub dam pa dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nya na'i snyan grags/ lha bla ma'i snyan gyi dbang por son pa la brten nas/ nag tsho lo tsā ba rgya gar du chos slob par phyin par slar rang yul du 'khor ba/ zhabs sen gyi pad+mo rnam par bskyod pa'i pho nyar/ rin po che gser gyi phyag rten sogs gya nom pa'i dngos po dang bcas rdzangs pa lam du nyes pa'i skyon dang bral nas/ bri ka ma la shi lar slebs te/ rgya brtson seng ges mjal ba'i
