grogs bgyis te/ jo bo'i spyan sngar phyag rten rnams dang bcas/ sngar bstan pa la 'phel 'grib byung tshul/ deng sang bstan pa dang yang sde snod lag len du 'debs par dka' zhing / de dag gi tshul la blang dor gyi gnas ston par jo bo lta bu las gzhan pa'i paṇ+ḍi tas phan thogs par dka' tshul rnams zhus te/ lo tsā ba re zhig slob gnyer byed pa ltar bsdad/ jo bos yi dam gyi lha dang grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma la dri ba mdzad pas/ spyi sgos mtha' dag tu 'phrin las kyi sgo che zhing / khyad par u pa si ka zhig la brten nas phan thogs 'byung bar lung bstan par brten/ thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pas mnga' ris su byon te/ mtho lding gi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs nas/ lha bla ma sogs las can rnams zab rgyas kyis chos du ma gsungs shing / bod du chos bab col du spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por byang chub lam gyi sgron mar grags pa'i bstan (49ba)bcos khyad par mdzad/ sngar rgya gar nas phebs khar lo gsum la phyir phebs pa'i khas len gnas brtan shi lā ka ra'i drung du nag tshos khas blangs pa bzhin 'phags pa'i yul du 'byon par chas pa'i tshe/ 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas jo bo bse btsun gyi drung na yod skabs/ mnga' ris su paṇ+ḍi ta phebs pa'i gtam gsan pas mgyogs par bshul du zhugs te jo bo dang mjal/ dbus phyogs su lha sa dang bsam yas kyi thog drangs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyi bsngags brjod mdzad pas/ jo bo chen po dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis phyag lan grangs mang por gnang bas spobs pa lhag par skyes te/ dbus su 'byon par gsol ba bzhin zhal gyis bzhes/ dus der 'brom gyis bod ston rnams la/ shing rta'i dbyibs 'dra 'dzam —66

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pegling gi /zhes sogs 'phrin yig brdzangs pa bzhin bsu ba la byon/ de nas rim gyis g.yas ru gtsang gi sa'i char phebs te/ yol chos dbang la sogs pa'i slob ma khyad par can 'ga' zhig smin par mdzad/ khu ston gyi yul yar klung bzang ba'i bsngags pa brjod pa la brten nas thang po cher phebs kyang / bsnyen bkur tshul bzhin ma byung bas dros stabs su bsam yas la phebs/ rgya dpe rnams slongs pas sngar ma gzigs pa mang po mchis pas/ slob dpon pad+mas mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas blangs pa yin nam gsungs/ de nas bang ston dang rngog sogs kyis bteg nas/ snye thang / lha sa/ yer pa/lan pa sogs su phebs te/ gdul bya'i blo mchog dman dang bstun pa'i theg pa che chung gi chos kyi man (50na/dha ra ba'i 'phreng ba spel legs kha ba ri ba'i lus can rnams kyi grong du 'ching bar mdzad do/ /'od lde'i sras rtse lde'i dus su dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi sde snod 'dzin pa phal cher 'dus te/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bsnyen bkur dang bdag rkyen mdzad/ zangs mkhar lo tsā bas tshad ma rgyan yang dus der bsgyur/ rwa lo/ gnyan lo/ khyung bo chos brtson/ btsan kha bo che/ rngog blo ldan shes rab/ mar thung dad pa shes rab rnams dang bsdebs te/ dwags po dbang rgyal rnams kyi chos 'khor lo la bsnyegs te byon/ btsan kha bo ches sa rdzo nal byams chos bslabs/ rā gnyan gyis chos 'khor thon nas rgya gar du byon/ de nas mi ring bar dge bshes brag dkar bas skyid shod nyang bran pha bong khar dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs te bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel/ de dag dang dus mtshungs su bka' gdams gzhud pa glang shar/ gdams ngag pa lo/ bya yul/ rgya ma rin chen sgang pa rnams kyis lha chos bdun ldan gyi brgyud pa'i bstan pa spel/ gsang phur rngog lo yab sras kyis rig lam nas drangs pa'i bshad nyan/ pa tshab lo tsā bas dbu ma'i gzhung / rgya 'dul 'dzin/ mtsho sna ba sogs kyi 'dul ba'i sde snod/ gnyal zhig yab sras kyis phar tshad/ rngog ār+ya de wa 'dul ba 'gos lugs/ bya sgang pa bsod nams rin cen gyis 'dus pa mar lugs/ bla ma chog pa yab sras kyis mar lugs gur brtag sam gsum/ zur chung pa dang rje sgro phug pa sogs kyis lung gi mdo bdun/ sgyu 'phrul sde —67

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyebargyad/ sems sde nyi shu'i skor/ rwa chos rab/ rong (50ba)pa rga lo/ dpyal lo/ glo bo lo tsā ba/ 'bro lo tsā ba sogs kyis gshed skor dang dus 'khor/ sa skya ba dkar po rnam gsum slob brgyud dang bcas pas 'brog mi lugs kyi gsung ngag gur brtag sam gsum/ bde mchog skor/ rje btsun mi la/ sgam po pa/ 'brug pa/ khro phu/ 'bri stag sogs kyis phyag rgya chen po dang chos drug gi skor/ paṇa chen shākya shrī sogs kyis mdo sngags gnyis ma'i rig lam spel bar mdzad pas/ dus tshod der/ stobs bcu mnga' ba zas gcang sras po'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum pa'i chu shel dbang po ltar 'chad rtsod rtsom pa dang thos bsam sgom pa'i cha shas kyi nya yongs su gang ba yin cing / mkhas grub de dag dgung lo bsres gzhon ma gtogs phal cher dus mtshungs par/ mkhas pa'i dbang po ye bzang rtse pa zhi ba chos kyi dbyings su sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i rjes su/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol du son zhing / thub bstan yongs kyi rtsa lag gcig pu grangs med rgyal ba'i 'khor lo'i dbang phyug 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal pos yul de wi ko ṭa ming gzhan pha bong kha'i dkar chag tu bka' stsal to/ /rtse lde'i sras 'bar lde/ de'i sras bkra shis lde/ de'i sras bha rbe/ de'i sras nā ga de wa/ de'i sras btsan phyug lde/ 'dis ya tsher byon/ de'i sras bkra shis lde/de'i sras grags bcan lde/ di'i sras grags pa ldes gser phye bre bdun las grub pa'i 'jam dbyangs dang / dngul dkar stong phrag bcu gnyis las grub pa'i byams pa sogs sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhengs/ de'i (51na)sras a so ldes rdo rje gdan du mchod pa'i rgyun btsugs/ de'i sras 'dzi dar mel dang a nan mel gnyis/ phyi mas gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzhedas/ de'i sras ri'u rmal gyis dngul dkar bzhi bcu la sman bla mched brgyad dang / 'phrul snang du gser thog phub/ de'i sras sa ṅgā rmal/de'i sras 'dzi dang mel gyis sras a 'dzid rmal gyis rgyal sa ma thob gong du sa skyar rab byung mdzad/slar srid bzung / de'i sras ka kun mel/ de'i sras bar btab rmal/ 'di nas ya tshe'i gdung brgyud chad de pu rang na mnga' bdag bsod nams lde spyan drangs nas srid bzung bas bu khyu rmal du grags so/—68

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pokhri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal la sras dpal lde/ 'od lde/ skyid lde gsum byung ba'i che ba'i brgyud pa gung thang pa/ klu rgyal ba/ spyi ba lha rtse glang lung rtsang bskor rnams dang / chung ba'i brgyud pa 'jad rta nag tu phog pa las mched pa'i 'byo ba/ g.yas ru ru lag nyang / mus sogs kyi btsad por grags pa mang zhing / 'bring po la sras pha ba de se/ khri lde/ khri chung / nyag pa bzhi las/ dang po dang bzhi pa gtsang rong gi phyogs dang/ gnyis pa mdo smad tsong khar yod cing / gsum pa khri chung gis yar klungs su bzhugs nas sku mkhar 'phying ba stag rtse bzung / de'i sras 'od skyid 'bar la sras bdun byung ba'i g.yu can gyis bya sar bzhugs/ de'i sras jo dga' la gsum las dar ma la sras bzhi las jo bo rnal 'byor gyis 'ban tshigs su bzhugs rje spyan snga rin po che la mchog tu gus shing gdan sa chen po dpal phag mo grur phud dud ma smad pa mdzad/ de'i (51ba)sras gsum gyi jo 'bag la sras lnga las shākya mgon gyis pho brang gnas chub bzung / rje sa skya paṇ+ḍita chos 'khor bskor ba'i mthun rkyen mdzad/ de'i sras shākya bkra shis kyis pho brang rnying ma brtsigs/ sras gnyis byung ba'i chung ba mnga' bdag grags pa rin cen gyis 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i zhabs phyir gong ma'i drung du byon/ 'ja' sa blangs nas brag kha'i pho brang btab/ gnas lnga rig pa shākya grwa'i ring lugs pa jo gdan tshogs par bsnyen bkur phul du byung ba mdzad/ sras bzhi byung ba'i gnyis pa mnga' bdag shākya mgon pos lo tsā ba legs pa rgyal mtshan sogs mkhas grub du ma'i 'khas nas bteg /pho brang yum bu bla sgang du gtsug lag khang bzhedas/ de'i sras chos rje shākya rin cen lde ste/ 'di yan chad kyi nang nas dar ma las gzhan du gyur pa kun/ mnyam med stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bstan pa rin po cher sri zhu dang / sa chen po la spyod pa'i skye rgu mtha' dag la bde skyid ma la ya'i rlung gzhon gyis duḥkha'i tsha gdung bcil ba'i lhag bsam be+e ḍūr+ya 'a ri bo chu shel dbang po'i gos kyis klubs pa ltar dkar ba'i khur 'chang ba sha stag tu byon pa'i snyan grags ha ri tsan dan gyi sdong po zla 'phreng grangs med pa'i sa 'dzin gyi khong las brgal bar g.yur za ldem mo/ /smras pa/ skabs gsum rmu yi nyag thag las brgyus sa mtsho'i mu tig 'phreng ba can/ /gnam gyi —69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geskas las bde bar babs pa'i 'khor lo rin cen rgyu ba'i shugs/ /tshangs bcom sder bcas mgo bo bregs tshe sa 'dir 'phos pa'i rā ma ṇa/ /mtho ris ngo mtshar gtam gyi ut+pal skal ldan rna ba'i rgyan du spud/ /(52na)rigs kyi mngon mtho'i nye ba'i tshal na ldem ldem 'khrigs pa'i lag 'gro'i snying po'i sa skyes dpal/ /dpal khyim ltar dkar legs lam yal ga ling ling g.yo bar dge bcu'i lcug phran bya ma rta/ /rta mchog srab skyogs khrims kyi me tog long long 'dab ma pad dkar gzhon nu'i chun po bzhin/ /bzhin ngas phan bde'i rgyan mchog ze'u 'bru shig shig spungs pa'i byang grol dri bzung bla na mtshar/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /dpal ldan sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rabs kyi skor/de ltar phul du byung ba'i snying stobs kyi go cha btsan po gyon nas rno ngar mi bzad pa'i mtshon chas bdud sde'i snying la brnag nus las 'das pa'i duḥkha ster ba'i byed po lha lung dpal rdo rjes/ me tog mda' can gyi 'dab brgya rnam par ba 'ad pa'i ze'u 'bru glang dar ma 'u dum btsan nyi ma'i bu'i gangs ri'i dum bu gsang du chad pa'i 'phreng ba lta bu'i mche ba'i grong khyer du spyugs pa'i mjug tu/ rje 'bangs kyi go rim rnam par zhig nas lo sum brgya lhag pa 'das pa'i dus/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khri la gnam skos kyi rgyal po hor gyi lung byung ba yin la/ de yang ma hā tsi na'i yul gru chen por stobs kyi dpung pas sa la rang dbang du spyod pa'i rgyal po mchog gi seng ge rkang pa brgyad pas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri la zhabs zung gi pad+mo mngon par 'du bgyis te/ rin po che sna bdun sngon du 'gro ba can sa la spyod pa'i mtho ris kyi rgyal po gang yin pa dag ni 'jam mgon zur phud lnga pa'i byin rlabs kyi bsil zer snying la 'phos pa'i kun dga'i bdud rtsi 'bum du 'dzag pa sha stag 'byung bar grags shing / de yang sa skyong (52ba)chen mo kun dga' rdo rje'i gsung las snyigs dus kyi mkhas pa'i dbang —70

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (7po 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis bzhus par/ spyi bo'i rgyal po sum cu rtsa drug /dzin hri hang gi rgyal po gnyis/ han gyi rgyal po bcu gnyis/ ang mang gnyis/ han nyi shu rtsa drug /mo'o tsha lnga/ tham gcig /te'u cing gcig /ba si cing gcig /ching sang brgyud pa su'i g.yang di yi la rgyal po bcu 'i gnyas byung bar bshad pa sogs rgya dang mi nyag gi rgyal khams thams cad la dbang du byed pa ni/ nag mo a lan la nyi ma dang zla ba'i zer las skyes pa'i bu bo don char mu gan gyi rigs brgyud las byung ba tshe ring gnam gyi she mong las/ yangs pa'i sa chen po kun la dbang sgyur ba hor jing gir rgyal po yin la/ de la sras mang du yod pa'i ga gan la go yug gan dang / go dan rgyal po sogs las phyi ma'i dus/ dor rta nag pos gtsos pa'i hor dmag bod du lhags te/ 'jig rten na mngon par mtho ba gtsug na zla ba yang zhus par byed pa'i dgra thabs kyis bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams thams cad spa bkong bar byas/de yang chos rje bsod grags pas/ jing gir rgyal po/ sbor ta che'i brgyud pa yin pa ltar bshad pa ni ma nges pa ste/ du bun mer gan nas brgyud pa chad de/ nag mo a lan la bu nyi zla'i zer las skyes pa yang bshad cing / gtam rgyud 'ga' zhig tu gzhen nu kha dog ser po can zhig gur gyi mthong nas babs te dga' mgur spyad nas phyir 'gro ba na gur gyi sgo las khyi'i gzugs 'thon pa zhig gi bu byung bas gnam gyi bu zhes btags par grags shing / gang ltar bo don char mu gan yin pas/ ma nges pa'i gtam mang po smra ba ni rang nyid gsal bar (53na sko lho na pa'i rgyu yin la/ rwa sgreng dang rgyal lha khang du hor dmag gis dge 'dun du ma bkrongs pa'i gling log de ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to ba dang dus mtshungs pas dus tshod 'di dag las snga bar mngon no/ /de nas mi ring bar rgyal po rnam par dkar ba'i las la 'jug pa'i bsam pa skyes te rgya sman dang / dbon po dor rta bod du btang bar sog mjal mor babs/ rje spyan snga rin po che la dun thang du byon te/ sgom pa shāka rin sna len du btang ba gsod par brtsams pa na/ spyan snga rin po ches sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas rdo char babs par/ spyan snga rin po che la gus par byas te/ bod shing sgo can —71—

rgya pa dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)phal cher gyi babs blangs nas/ shar kong po'i yul yan chad nas/ nub bal po dang / lho mon la thug pa tshun chad kyi btsan po'i mkhar rnams bskyel zhing / gong ma rgyal po'i lung las mi 'da' ba'i rgyal khrims bcan pos gnya' ba mnan te pho brang chen por pho nya ba mngags nas/ bod mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal khams na/ dge 'dun gyi sde ni bka' gdams che/ ngo bsrung ni stag lung chos rje mkhas/ gzi brjid ni 'bri gung spyan snga che/ chos ni sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas par 'dug pas gang spyan 'dren gyi lung stsol cig /zhus par/ tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs mtha' dag 'dzam gling 'di na jing gir rgyal po'i lugs bzhin spyad pa las lhag pa ma mchis pas/ 'jig rten phyi ma phan chad du thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bzang po ston pa'i bla ma zhig gal che bar 'dug pas/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta spyan 'dren pa'i bka' mchod dang / chos rje sa skya bar (53ba)chab shog dang bcas pho nya phyir son pa bzhin/ rgya sman gyis sa skyar phyin te lung bsgrags pas/ rje sa paṇa ci yang / rje btsun grags pa'i zhal chems su/ khyod kyi tshe mjug la zhwa khra 'phur ba 'dra ba/ lham phag gi sna 'dra ba gyon pa/ yul skad rigs mi gcig pa'i rgyal khams nas gdan 'dren pa 'byung bas/ dkon cog gsum gyi sgra mi grags pa'i sar/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dang rgyas 'ong bas the tshom med par song zhig pa'i bka' dran te zhal gyis bzhes pa yin la/ de yang rje btsun chen po 'di nyid kyi rigs ni/ gnam nas lce ring g.yu ring / g.yu bse mchod gsum las/ chung bas mi rje mdzad de/ g.yu bse byi la spun bzhi byung ba/ gdong gi rus chen bco brgyad dang 'khrugs pas gnam la g.yu ring gi rogs mdzad de btul nas dran du bkol/ g.yu ring gi rmu'i bu mo dmu sa ldem khab tu bzhes par sras ma sangs spun bdun byung ba'i che ba drug dang yab lha yul du byon/ chung ba'i sras thog tsha dpa' bo stag byung bar mon bza' mtsho mo rgyal khab tu bsus pa la sras g.ya' spang skyes 'khrungs/ srin po skya rengs khrag med bsad/ g.ya' grum bsil ma phrogs te khab tu bzhes par sras zhig byung ba de srin po dang 'khon pa'i bar du skyes pas ming 'khon par skyes su btags pa la 'khon gyi gdung brgyud ces pa'i don de ltar yin zhing / chos rje dkon cog —72

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhan nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pelhun grub pas/ de ltar 'chi med 'od gsal lha yi rigs/ /ma rig las 'khon 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku/ /sa skya pa ces/grag bas pa gsal ldan pa/ /ceXg gsungs pa yang zur gnab/kyis bltas na rang bzhin (54na)brjod pa'i rgyan du mchis so/ /'khon par skyes kyis jo mo btsan mo bza' lce sman gnyis la sras dpal po che 'khrungs pa/yab kyis yul gang bzang ltar btang bas/ la stod gnyan se thar gyi ya tshangs la yul gyis mtshan brgyad mthong ste bzung / mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyi mdun na 'don du gyur te/ rlangs lo tsā ba'i bu mo lha sa khrim bu khab tu bzhes par sras khren mdzes/ lha legs/ tshe la dbang phyug /'khon klu'i dbang po tshe 'dzin rnams las klu'i dbang pos mkhan po rin po che bo dhi sa twa'i drung du rab tu byung zhing / slob dpon ོ po'i byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsi snying la zhugs/ gcung gi sras rdo rje rin cen slob dpon wo pos rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du smin par mdzad/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po de la sras drug byon pa'i lnga pa yan gyi rus tsho mang du gyes shing / drug pa shes rab yon tan grom par byon pa la sras gnyis byung ba'i chung ba byang du chad par 'khon tsho stod smad du gyes/ che ba yon tan 'byung gnas la sras gsum byung ba'i bar pa tshul khrims rgyal po/ de la sras gsum byung ba'i che ba rdo rje gtsug tor shes rab/ de la sras bdun byung ba'i chung ba dge skyabs/ de'i sras dge mthong / 'dis shab tu bzhugs shing / sras bal po zhes pa 'khrungs pa tsha mo rong gi brag la sgrub pa mdzad pas yab mes kyi yi dam gyi lha rdo rje phur pa zhal gzigs/ de'i sras shākya blo gros kyis g.ya' lung 'jag gshongs btab/ de'i sras gnyis las/ gcen 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims/ 'di yan la yi dam gyi lha'i zhal gzigs shing / (54bsgo chog thun gyi dngos grub thob pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa brgyud mar byon pa yin la/ gcung 'khon dkon cog rgyal po/ sngags gsar ma'i lo tsā ba bla chen 'brog mi/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rmang lo tsā ba/pu rang lo tsā ba/ gnam kha'u pa sku mched sogs bla ma dam pa du ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mo spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsten cing / gsung gi bdud rtsis myos par mdzad de/ gra bo lung par dgon pa zhig btab pas sa skya —73

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)gog por grags shing / de'i tshe ri'i rtse nas gzigs pas/ dpon po ri'i ngos 'gram nas dkar zhing snum pa bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang ldan pa'i yul du mkhyen te/ bdag po rnams la nor bu'i 'phreng ba sogs kyi rin gyis nyos te/ dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon pa btab/ 'khon dkon cog rgyal por jo mo ma gcig zhang mo la snga ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po 'khrungs te mdo sngags kyi chos du ma la thos bsam sgom pa phul du phyin pa mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i gsang ba gsum gyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang bas/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul du shes ldan mtha' dag gor ma chags pas dpal sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi rigs zhes grags shing / khyad par gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pas/ rgya gar du yang birnya pa'i sprul pa sa skya pa bya ba'i grags snyan gyi ze'u 'bru phyogs bral thos 'dzin 'dam skyes kyi ngos su g.yur za ldem zhing / mdor na dus gcig tu sku'i bkod pa mi 'dra ba mtha' yas pa ston pa sogs rje btsun sa ra has mtshon pa'i 'phags yul gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug mtha' dag gi khengs pa'i (55na)rgyud 'gugs par byed pa'i kha sbyor bdun ldan gyi bla na med pa'i lam gyi pad+ma dkar po'i chun po 'dod pa'i bde ba gnyis med mtha' klas pa'i con pan rnam par bcings pas 'bras bu'i theg pa la gcig tu bka' drin che la/ dam pa 'di la sras bzhi byung ba'i che ba 'khon kun dga' 'bar rgya gar du byon pa tshad pas gshegs/ de 'og mi thub zla ba'i sprul pa 'khon bsod nams rtse mo ni yab mes kyi chos 'bras bu'i theg pa dang / gsang phur cha pa la rgyu'i theg par thos bsam mdzad/ de'i gcung 'khon grags pa rgyal mtshan ni rdo rje 'dzin pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid la mnga' sgyur bas grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po de thos bsam sgom pa'i gru gzings la brten nas zung la jug nor bu'i gling du gshegs pa/yon tan gyi dngos po brjod pa'i mtha' dang bral zhing / kha che paṇa chen gyis nyi zla gza' 'dzin 'byung bar lung bstan pa/ rje grags pas rtsa rlung la gzir bas ma byung ba dang / rdo rje dang dril bu nam mkhar 'jog nus shing rang sgra 'brol ba/ ma mgon lcam dral bran du 'khol nus pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad —74

deb zer rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (popa shin tu mang / de'i gcung 'khon dpal chen 'od po che'i sras gnyis las/ che ba 'khon dpal ldan don grub ni skye ba nyi shu rtsa lnga la mi'i srid pa bzung zhing / 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi byin rlabs ga bur gsar pa'i thigs pa snying la sim pas mi shes pa'i tsha gdung rgyang ring por bsrings pas chung ngu'i dus nas saṃ spro ta'i skad smra ba/ lañca dang wartu'i yi ge 'dri ba sogs sngon gyi bag chags sad pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma mdzad cing / rje grags pa'i drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs pa'i mtshan kun dga' rgyal (55bsgo tshan du btags/ gzhen nu'i dus nas sgom chen rgan po'i rnam thar 'dzin pa'i rdob ga gi mi tshe don med du stong par yol ba'i lugs rnams chu shing gi snying po lta bur gzigs nas mkhas pa dang grub pa'i bla ma du ma bsten te/ bzo rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ gtan tshigs rig pa/nang rig pa ste che ba lnga dang / snyan dngags/ mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor/ zlos gar/ skar rtsis sogs mdor na rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs shing / sa skya paṇ+ḍita zhes snyan pa'i grags pa dbus 'gyur rdo rje gdan gyi mdzes rgyan du sbud/ bod 'dir gnas lnga rig pa'i srol 'byung ba 'di nyid kyi bka' drin yin cing / ming dang don mthun pa'i mkhas pa zur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos/ sems kyi chos nyid rjen 'char ma mthong kyang / /tshe 'dir mkho ba'i shes bya'i tshig don shes/ /zhes gsung ba yang gangs khrod kyi blun sgom rnams kyi tshul la dpags na thugs shin tu mad do/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍita chen po shākya shrī bha dra'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa mnos te/ mkhan po'i mtshan gyis mtha' can du byas nas kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi mjug tu dpal bzang po sbyar/ mu stegs kyi ston pa 'phrog byed dga' ba lta bu sgra tshad kyi rig pa'i lus stobs rnam par rgyas pa'i gnyis 'thung yang / 'jigs pa med pa'i rtsod pa'i nga ros tshar bcad/ 'on kyang 'phrog byed dga' bos rdzu hrūl gyis nam mkha' la 'phur bas/ slob dpon 'dar 'phyar rogs su sbran nas btul te nang pa'i bstan pa la 'jug par khas blangs/rab tu 'byung bar zhus kyang / mu stegs kyi rtags ma bor bar yod rnams ngo mtshar ba'i ched du khrid byon pa (56na/slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes bstan ma bcu gnyis la bka' bsgos pa'i mthus/ 'phrog byed kha —75

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyenas khrag skyugs te shi ba'i ral pa'i con pan dpal ldan sa skya'i ka pa'i mdzes byed du yod do/ /de nas hor rgyal po'i lung byung ba bzhin rgya hor gyi rgyal khams su byon te/ dpag par dka' ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa du mas mtha' khob kyi rgyal khams mtha' dag dam pa'i chos kyis gsal bar mdzad cing / rgyal pos bdag gi nad kyis thebs pa las rnam par grol ba'i mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa snga na med pa stsal/ shar pad+ma'i sder mdo phyogs kyi bshad pa/ lho dbang gi sder dbang byas brgya rtsa/ nub rgya mtsho'i sder klu'i rgyal po rnams dbang du bsdus te dam la btags nas char chu dus su 'bebs pa sogs 'jig rten kun tu 'bru nor longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i 'dod 'jo char du 'beb par mdzad/ byang du sgyu ma mkhan gyi sprul pa'i grong khyer la me tog 'thong bas sgyu ma bshig ma thub pas sprul pa'i sde zhes ya mtshan can du grags shing / sku'i bkod ka yang sprul pa'i sde nyid du bsdus/ chos rje'i gcung zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan la sras lcam sring brgyad byung ba'i ma gcig kun dga' skyid kyi sras bla ma 'phags pa dang / phyag na gnyis las lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyi skye mtha' 'phags pa rin po che ni chung ngu'i dus nas gsung rab la thos bsam legs par mdzad cing / hor yul du 'byon pa'i dus/ dbus kyi sa'i char rab tu byung ba'i mtshan blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol zhing / chos rje sa paṇa dang rgyal po gong ma mchod yon zhi bar gshegs rjes/ se chen rgyal po gong ma'i khri thog tu byon (56ba)pa dang / 'phags pa rin po che dgung lo bcu dgu lon pa rgyal po'i ti shing gyur nas/ gan din gu shu' mdzad med g.yang ṭi'i dam kha/ gser dang mu tig gas brgyan pa'i snam sbyar/ rin po ches spras pa'i phyam rtse/ rin po che'i las zhwa/ gser gyi gdugs dang / khri'u sogs bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa'i dngos po du ma dang / gzhan yang gser bre dngul bre/ rta rnga mong /ja gos dar sogs bdog pa'i yo byad kyi 'dod rgu mtha' yas pa phul/ de nas mdo khams su phebs nas mkhan po grags pa seng ge'i drung du spong bdun 'khor bcas kyi tshul khrims yang dag par mnos te/ slar gong ma'i pho brang du phebs/ hong yig gsar bslabs pa'i yig phud la/ ban+de shed skyes kyi —76

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ ('a'aja' sa thog ma gnang / rgyal pos rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston lan gsum du spyad pa'i dang po'i dus su bod khri bskor bcu gsum phul/ gnyis pa'i dus su bod chol kha gsum phul/gsum pa'i dus su rgya'i mi yur chen mo dang / rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i gdung skal gyi bde bar gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung rnams phul/ rgyal pos bod gyi ban+de rnams sa skya pa'i chos lugs ma gtogs gzhan byed du mi 'jug pa'i gsung snga phyir byon pa na/ 'gro mgon 'phags pas so so'i lugs bzhin byed du 'jug par zhus pas/ rgyal pos bla ma de ltar gsung na rang rang gi lugs bzhin gyis la/ nged la smon lam thob gsung ba'i 'ja' sa gnang / dbus gtsang gi phyogs su chas rkyen du ma brdzangs pa la brten nas/ dpon chen shākya bzang pos gser 'od/ nang rten thub chen/ phyi rten gser 'bum bzhengs/mi ring bar bla ma yang sa skyar phebs/ gser (57na skor bum bkra shis sgo mang dang / phyi'i skya 'bum bdun la gser zangs las grub pa'i gdugs chos 'khor dang / sa paṇa gyi gser 'bum la gser thog bzos/ rgyal ba'i bka' po ti nyis brgya lhag tsam gsar gyis bzhengs slar gong mas gdan 'dren gyi gser yig nan chen mngags pa la brten/ bshul du bzhugs pa'i zhar byung du gye re lha khang du phebs nas gzigs rtog mdzad de/ mi la nye gnas go chod 'di 'dra byung 'dug gsungs pas rkyen byas te/dpon chen shākya bzang pos gye re lha khang la thig tshad blangs te khri bskor bcu gsum bskul nas lha khang chen mo brtsigs/ 'gro mgon pho brang chen por phebs pa na/ rgyal pos gnam gyi 'og /sa'i steng /rgya gar gyi lha'i sras po/ yi ge rtsom mi/ sprul pa'i sangs rgyas/ rgyal khams 'jags su 'jug mi/ snyan ngag gi rgyu/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'phags pa ti shri zhes pa'i mtshan du mnga' gsol/ /'bul ba lan re la tshan che ba/ dngul bre chen stong ra can tshan pa gnyis/ gos dar lnga stong dgu brgya bzhi bcu phul/ skabs shig ga rma bshes chu la 'dzul ba/ mkha' la 'phur ba/ pha bong brdzi ba sogs rdzu 'phrul du ma bstan pa na/rgyal pos/ rang re'i ti shri 'phags pa 'di sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas mi'i gzugs su sprul pa zhig yin kyang / rdzu 'phrul dang rtogs pa rtogs ldan rgyal po 'di mtho bar 'dug gsungs pas/—77

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyebatsun mo cha lus bla ma'i drung du rgyu mtshan rnams bskyar te/ pak+ṣi la mchod gnas kyi gtso bo bcol nas sa skya'i gdung brgyud rnams la gnod pas rdzu 'phrul ston par zhus pas/ rgyal blon gyi dbus su bla mas ral gris dbu dang (57ba)phyag 'khas rnams so sor phral te/ rgyal ba rigs lngar byin gyis brlabs te bstan pa sogs sprul pa ngo mtshar ba du ma 'dren byed kyi dga' ston du stsal/ de nas slar gdan sa dpal ldan sa skyar phebs te/ dge 'dun 'bum du nye ba la bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa'i dus ston khyad par can chu mig chos 'khor du grags pa mdzad/ dus der kun dga' bzang po dpon chen du yod pa bla ma'i thugs dang 'gal ba 'ga' byas zhes nye gnas kyis gong ma se chen la phra ma zhus pas/ hor dmag gis bya rog rdzong phab dpon chen bsad/ bya rog rdzong du dmag gi khrims rnga brdung / /snying med po tsho gser phye chu la 'bo/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan dus thog tu babs/ de'i sngon ma'i lo nang du bla ma 'phags pa lha khang bla brang du zhi bar gshegs pa 'ga' zhig nye gnas kyis hor dmag drangs pa bla mas mkhyen dogs nas lkog tu bkrongs kyang zer/ 'di dag gi dus dpon chen 'ga' zhig gi byed pa la brten bod du mi bde ba du ma byung bas/ sna thag sa sa byas hor dmag bod du yong / /ngan song zer yang de 'dra'i sdug ba jal med/ /ces pa'i lung bstan gyi dus skabs yin zhing /'gro mgon gyi gcung phyag na chos rje'i phyag phyir gong ma'i gam du byon/ bod kyi dpon du bskos shing hor chas byed du bcug /zangs tsha'i jo mo shab kyi jo 'grom la slob dpon rin cen rgyal mtshan dang /lcam 'di le gnyis byung ba'i gcen gyi rgyud lung man ngag du ma mkhyen cing / 'phags pa rin po che bod du byon pa'i shul du gdan sa mdzad/ spyir bal po nas mdo khams yan gyi rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog dge 'dun rnams kyis klog pa'i bsnyen bkur dang / rgya bal (58na〉5tshams na bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa 'ja' ma li'i gong ma 'phags pa mched gsum pa de gdan sa chen por gdan drangs/gser gling lhun grub sdings kyi dgon pa btab/ slob dpon zangs tsha jo mo gung thang lha gcig mdzes ma la slob dpon ma bsod nams 'bum dang nyi ma 'bum gnyis byung / de'i nye gnas ma rje rong ma rdo —78

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (porje ldan la slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas 'khrungs/ 'jangs yul gyi rgyal po hū tu ka ra rje'i bla ma mdzad/ slob dpon zangs mo'i jo mo jo lcam hor mo la slob dpon rin cen 'gyung gnas 'brungs pa chung ngu nas gshegs/ 'gro mgon phyag na'i jo mo ma gcig mkha' 'gro 'bum la sras dharma pā la rak+ṣi ta zhakhrungs/ slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas kyi sras su bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal ba bo dong er 'khrungs/ 'phags pa rin po che gshegs rjes 'gro mgon phyag na sku dbang btsan pas dharma rak+ṣi ta khong rang gi sras su song bas gdan sa'i mthil du bzhag /gong ma'i drung du bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal ba sa skya'i gdung brgyud min tshul sogs kyi snyan phra phul pa la brten/ rgyal po'i lung gis rgya mtsho chen po'i chu 'jam nyi shu bsgral ba'i gling chung zhig tu phebs dgos pa byung / de'i bar du dharma pā la rak+ṣi ta yab sras gshegs pas/ sa skya'i dpon chen sogs bka' gros la dbang ba rnams kyis bla ma bdag nyid chen po gdan drangs chog pa'i gong sar mi sna btang kyang don ma mthong bas/chos rje khu dbon gyi mgon po'i bka' babs kyi slob ma gya a snyan dam pa kun dga' grags kyi byon te/ rgyal po'i pho brang steng du (58bakhi'u'i rdo char dang / bya rog re'u chung gi bong tshod tsam lcags kyi mchu sder can zhig skad sgrog cing ga9|ga pa brdeb pa sogs byung bas/ dam pa kun grags pas/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po sa skya pa'i zhal ngo yin pa la brnyas pas lan pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ bdag nyid chen po pho brang du spyan drangs/ bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas gdan sa chen po'i khrir phabs su bcug /bar skabs su zhal ngo nyag phra ba la brten/ shar pas khri bskor bcu gsum la lung gtong ba byung / snga ma bdag nyid chen po'i sras bsod nams bzang po mdo khams su grongs/ dbus gtsang du jo mo bdun blangs pa'i kun dga' 'bum gyi sras kun dga' blo gros hor yul du byon nas bu yan rgyal po/ gi gan rgyal po/ ye sun the mur gsum gyi ti shrī mdzad/ ma gcig yon bdag mo'i sras che ba chung ngu'i dus grongs/ kun dga' legs 'byung gi ye sun the mur kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis ran+ta shrī dang tho gan thi mur gyi bla mar hor yul du byon/ ma gcig nam mkha' rgyal mo la sras nam mkha' —79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyebashes gnyen nam mkha' legs pa/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gsum byung ba'i nam mkha' legs pas gdan sa chen po'i khri thog tu bzhugs/ ma gcig gzhon nu 'bum la kun dga' nyi ma/ don yod rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gsum 'khrungs pa'i chos rje bla ma ni/ rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la phul du phyin zhing rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa chen po mnga' brnyes pas bstan 'dzin kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam par gyur pa la/ khyad par gong ma sde srid phag mo gru pa'i yongs 'dzin du gyur pas khyad par 'phags/ ma gcig nyi (59nasgo rin cen la nyi ma dpal/ kun dga' legs rgyal/kun dga' rgyal mtshan gsum 'khrungs/ kun spangs lcam mo la blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / khang gsar dpon mo la bsod nams blo gros dang grags pa rgyal mtshan gnyis 'khrungs/ de yang ti shri kun dga' blo gros kyis gcung po rnams la bla brang bzhi so sor dgos te gnang bas/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa'i sras ta dben kun dga' rin 'byung / de la btsun mo gnyis las che ba'i sras gu shri blo gros rgyal mtshan chung ba'i sras slob dpon grags pa blo gros dang / kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan/lcam gcig dang gsum byung / grags pa blo gros kyi sras su blo gros dbang phyug 'khrungs/ yab sras 'di gnyis la chu mig bdag chen du grags/ kun dga' blo gros kyi sras kun dga' dbang phyug 'khrungs/rim par byon pa'i gdung brgyud 'di rnams la bzhi thog bla brang zhes so/ /bla ma dam pa'i gcen don yod rgyal mtshan gyi sras nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang / zla ba rgyal mtshan gnyis/ phyi ma'i sras bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ de la 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang / zha lu ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan lcam sring gnyis 'khrungs pa las/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi sras rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan dang /bdag chen rdo rje 'chang lcam bzhi dang drug 'byungs/ zha lu ba'i sras slob dpon grags pa rgyal mtshan te/ rin cen sgang bla brang du grags la gsang chen blo bshad sogs dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zab don gyi bdag po rim par byon / ti shri kun dga' legs 'byung gi gcung kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sras ta (59ba)dben chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / ta dben blo gros rgyal mtshan gnyis snga ma la jo mo gsum —8(/

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pelas dang po'i sras theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ gnyis pa la dharma dh+wa dza/ rin cen rdo rje/ gsum pa la slob dpon bsod nams bkra shis/ de'i sras slob dpon bde legs bkra shis/ de'i sras bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ shākya seng ge /bsam grub rgyal mtshan/ don grub rgyal mtshan/ shākya seng ge'i btsun mo che ba'i sras kun dga' bkra shis/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' snying po gsum lasabar pas khams kyi phyogs su phebs par sras chos kyi rgyal mtshan sa kun dga' blo gros legs pa'i 'byung gnas mched gnyis 'khrungs/ 'di rnams la lha khang bla brang du grags/ slob dpon nyi ma dpal gyi gcung po kun dga' legs pa la jo mo gnyis las/ che ba'i sras slob dpon bsod nams 'bum/chung ba'i sras bla chen bsod nams blo gros/ ga 'an nu la gshegs pa gcig /dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'di la jo mo gnyis las/ dang po la kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros dang / dbang rnam srasargyal mtshan 'ganyas gzungs/ gnyis pa la chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ dbang rnam sras par jo slo gnyis las/ dang po'i sras kun dga' blo gros/ gnyis pa la dbang nam mkha' legs pa dang lcam lnga 'khrungs/nam mkha' legs pa la jo mo gnyis las/ dang po la lcam gnyis/ gnyis pa la dbang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de la jo mo gsum las/ dang po la lcam gcig /gnyis pa la nam mkha' rin chen/ gsum pa la nam mkha' bkra shis/ de'i sras sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ bdag chen (60na)ngag gi dbang phyug /'jam dpal grags/ nam mkha' don grub/ de'i sras kun dga' bsam grub dang sngags 'chang chen po kun dga' rin cen/ snga ma'i sras bdag chen kun dga' bde legs/ de'i sras bsod nams lhun grub/ kun dga' lhun grub/ 'jig rten dbang phyug /de'i sras bsod nams blo gros/byams pa bsod nams lhun grub/ ngag dbang bsod nams lhun grub rnams 'khrungs/ kun dga' rin cen la jo mo gsum las/ dang po la lcam gnyis/ gnyis pa la ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po/lcam gsum/ gsum pa la grags pa blo gros/ de la sras lcam sring drug las/ sras bgres pa gnyis gzhen nu nas gshegs/ de 'og kun dga' dbang rgyal/ mthu stobs dbang phyug /ngag dbang kun —81—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)dga' bsod nams gsum zhabrungs te/ 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rin po che dang / mdo rgyud kyi bstan pa ni deng sang gi bar du gnas pa yin na'ang / srid kyi stobs 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ni/'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa nas/ 'gro mgon bsod nams pa'i bar du lung gi bskos pa'i dpon chen gcig gnyis slar ldab pa dang bcas pa'i nyi shu'i bar du dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ mdo smad rta'i chol kha ste/ bod chen po'i chol kha gsum gyi rgyal khams kun la mnga' sgyur cing / khyad par la stod lho byang / gur mo/ chu mig shangs dang / zha lu ste gtsang khri drug rgya ma/ 'bri gung / 'dzi5 pa/ thang po che pa/ phag gru/ g.ya' bzang ste dbus khri drug /dbus gtsang gi mtshams su yar 'brog khri bskor gcig (60bsti bod kyi khri bskor bcu gsum gyi nyes la chad pa dang bzang la bya dga' ster ba sogs khrims kyi byed po ni/ sngar smos pa'i dpon chen shākya bzang po dang /kun dga' bzang po gnyis kyi rjes su zhad btsun ban dkar ba gnyis kyi las ka bzung / de rjes byang rin bskos pa so thin si'i dam kha dang / shel dam byung yang shangs kyi sdong mo thang du g.yog gis bsad/ de rjes kun gzhen dang gzhen dbang gnyis kyi rin la dbus gtsang gi che gsal chen po dang khrims kyi zhib cha byas/ de rjes dpon rben byang rdor/ de nas a len/ 'dis ngas skya' lcags ri phyi ma dang / bon po ri'i lcags ri/ khang gsar gling rnams brtsigs shing / sa 'bri nang 'khrugs pas/ ang len gyis khri bskor bcu gsum gyi dmag 'bri gung du drangs te/ lha khang me la bsregs pa sogs 'bri gung gling log tu grags pa de byas shing / dwags po sogs su dpung khyer byas pa'i sa mtshams kyi brag la ang len gyi ming bris 'dug zer ba sogs dpon chen zhig la drag shul 'di nyid che zhing / de'i rjes su gzhen dbang bskyar nas bskos pa lam du grongs/ de nas legs pa dpal/ seng ge dpal/'od zer seng ge 'dis swon jing dben gyi dam kha bzung / de nas kun rin/ don yod dpal/ yon btsun/ yang 'od zer seng ge /rgyal ba bzang po/ dbang phyug dpal/ bsod nams dpal/ yang rgyal ba bzang po/ dbang brtson/ 'di gnyis kyi dus phag mo gru pa dang ma mthun pas/ dpyid kyi ma mas —82

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dbyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (po'i bskyangs pa sos dus kyi lang tsho mngon par bdo ba na/ dgun gyi grang reg mtha' dag rang shugs kyis 'jig pa dngos po'i chos (61na snyad du snang ba ji bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi mes po tshangs pa'i lung gis sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor mtha' dag sde srid phag mo gru pas rang byan du mdzad pas/ de'i rjes su nam mkha' brtan pa sogs dpon chen 'ga' zhig 'dren yang dpon chen snga ma rnams ltar bod chol kha gsum la lung sgyur ba ni ma byung ngo / /de ltar dpal ldan sa skya ba'i rigs rus cho 'brang chos srid kyi ngang tshul 'di la dpags na/g.yung po'i rigs can gyi dregs ldan mtha' dag pha wang nam 'phang spyod pa'i tshul ltar nges pas/ mi shis gdol pa'i phrug gu 'phongs pa yi/ /'khor gyis bteg la 'jig rten 'dren pa zhes/ /smig sgyu 'bab chur sgrog pa'i grags stong sgras/ /'jig rten yangs mor byed dang 'di mi mtshungs/ /zhes chos rje dkon cog lhun grub gsung ba yang dag pa'i gtam mo/ /smras pa/ gser ldan lto ba 'khod snyoms lus phra mchog gi bzhin ras ngos yangs par/ /rigs rus nag klung sdug po'i 'khri shing mig sman g.yo ba'i gar bsgyur dbus/ /'khon rigs su la'i ljon pa'i dbang po ma 'dres 'khyug pa'i zur mig can/ /chos srid 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud pa'i mdzes sdug rnam 'gyur ci yang bkra/ e ma rtsod dus gser 'khor can/ /sal rgyu ba'i gnam gyi sras/ /gang gi lung bzhin bod 'bangs gtsug /bde 'byung ral pa'i zla tshes ltar/ /mdzes byed rgyan du spud pa'i dbyid/ /bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /gdung rabs ha la'i ke la sha /blo gsal bde 'byung mgrin par mdzes/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de yang mon gor rgyal (61ba)pos 'bri gung pa/ se chen rgyal pos tshal ba/ hu la hus phag mo gru pa rnams so sor mchod gnas su bzung ste/ bod rnams rgyal po so sos ris su bcad de bdag po mdzad pa rnams mchod gnas so sor sbyar ba'i mon lug mgo steng tshun chad/ gnyal stod smad/ gru shul/lo ro dkar nag /bya po/ e che ba'i nang nas e chung / thang po che/ 'phyong rgyas/ 'phyos/ mon mkhar/—83—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyemakhar ltag do bo/ sregs lte/ 'on sna/ nam zhal lnga/ bsam yas shar sgo gdong man chad dang / lho brag shar nas/ mchod sde/ ba zhi bod 'brog gnyis/ mnga' ris nas ko ron mdo yan chad/ spu rig la rtsa man chad rnams rgyal po hu la hur gtogs pa'i don gyi phag mo gru pa'i 'og tu yod pa dpes mtshon te 'bri gung dang tshal pa rnams la yang de dang dod mtshungs pa yod pa'i dbang gis/ g.ya' bzang ba khri bskor gyi kha grangs su bgrangs kyang don phag mo gru pa'i 'og tu gnas pa ltar/ sna dkar rtse pa 'bri gung pa'i 'og dang / des mtshon khri dpon gzhan rnams phag 'bri tshal gsum la chos srid gnyis ku'i sgo nas 'gran par mi nus pas 'di gsum khri dpon rnams kyi nang nas mngon par mtho ba yin la/de yang chal pa ni zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po'i rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las kyi gdugs dkar po dbyig 'dzin gyi khyon kun khyab pa las brgyud de khri dpon du gyur ba yin pas/ lha dbang brgya byin gyi sprul par grags pa nye gnas dar ma gzhen nus/ 'gro mgon rin po che'i thugs sras mdzad de/gung thang gi gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i 'khas tog phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs/ 'gro mgon gshegs (62na skobar sde gtsug lag khang gnyis kyi bdag por bskos te/ phyi'i khyams smad dang mgon khang /nang du gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar dang / sku 'bum chen mo'i 'phro sogs grub par mdzad/ de'i rus dbon 'byung gnas btsun 'grus kyis dpon gyi go sa bzung nas lugs zung gi bya ba mi dman pa 'ga' zhig byas shing / de'i dbon ye shes 'byung gnas kyi srid ma bzhi bu brgyad du grags pa'i skyid smad kyi yul grong mang po mnga' 'og tu chug /de rjes dpon sangs rgyas dngos grub ni gnam gyi mthong nas mi yul du babs pas/ mgar tshe nam tsha 'brug /de nas mgar bla ma mkhyen chen po/ mgar stong mes khri chags/ de'i sras mgar stong btsan yul bzung gis chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i blon po mdzad/ lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pas rje'i zhabs tog dang bod 'bangs la bka' drin che/ de'i sras btsan po yon tan rgyal bzung / de nas rim bzhin lha gcig snyan ldem bu/ khri zangs dum bu/ khri gnyer khri lcags/ de'i sras stong mes khris snang / khri sto ro stag gzung / blon chen chas pa sgo drug /de'i sras —84

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pormu bza' dang 'phags gzigs/ de nas rim bzhin mgar thog yang rgyal/ rgyal le/ mgar rgyal ba 'byung gnas/ 'di dang zhang rin po che mchod yon du gyur te/ sras phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i lung bstan dang mthun par dpon sangs rgyas dngos grub 'khrungs pa dpon du bskos/ dge 'dun tshal pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa ba btsugs/ de'i sras dpon chen rin rgyal gyis dpon gyi las ka bzung ste gong du byon/ se chen rgyal pos skyid shod (62bsko lhod smad/ stod lung / gra thol/ 'phyong po/ rgyal sman/ e dwags gnyal gsum sogs lha khang zhig gsos byed pa'i mi sde shes su chug gi 'ja' sa gnang / gung thang du byon te gzims khang shar dang khyim gra chen mo brtsigs/ 'di la sras gsum las che ba nyi ma shes rab kyis 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i phyag phyir gong du byon te 'ja' sa blangs/gnyis pa dpon dga' bde mgon po bya rog gdong can gyi sprul par grags shing / tshal pa'i dgon sde'i don du gong ma'i drung du lan bdun byon/ mi chen zam kha lha pa'i nye gnas 'dam ring gi gzhan dbang du gyur te/ dpon dga' bde la rtsa ra mang du byas pas/ lkog tu rgyal por zhus par gong ma'i na bza' 'brug sder lnga pa zhig gnang ba de 'og tu gyon skabs/ zam khas khrims rar khrid de steng gos bshus pas/ rgyal po'i na bza' 'dug pa mthong ste zam kha 'jigs/ mi ring bar zam kha la nag phog pas/ dga' bdes snying tshim gyi chang drangs nas/ nged rang gnyis po khyad par che/ /nga ni dge 'dun tshal pa yin/ /dga' bde dpal/ blo bde dpal/ skyid pa'i dpal/ da lta tshal pa'i dga' bde dpal/ zhes glu blangs skad/de nas rgya'i bzo bo mkhas pa dang bcas te/ bar khang rgya phibs/ gser 'phru sogs rten dang brten par bcas pa mtha' dag phul du byung ba'i bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa bzhengs/ chos 'khor gling btab nas mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa dang / dbus gling du sngags grwa 'dzugs pa sogs rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa rgya chen pos gong ma shin tu dgyes/ 'di'i gcung po rin cen dbang phyug rab tu byung / dga' bde'i sras gnyis43na tshe pas/ che ba rin cen seng ge /chung ba smon lam rdo rje/ 'di nyid —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyekyis lha sa'i bar skor dang / brag lha klu sbug gi rgya phibs/ jo bo dang thugs rje chen po gnyis kyi dbu thog tu gser thog /'bum mo che'i gañji ra/ bka' 'gyur dang / dbus gling 'od gsal 'phrul gyi lha khang bzheng ba sogs/ dkar phyogs kyi mdzad pa bla na ma mchis pa mang nyid / srid kyi mnga' thang lnga kun gsal gyi 'gram pa la reg pa lta bur gyur/ 'di'i sras che ba dpon kun dga' rdo rje yab mes kyi chos dang rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhyen pa mchog tu yangs shing / gong nas phyir byon te/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang ri bo dge 'phel 'debs pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa mi dman pa mtha' yas/ slar yang khri dpon gyi las ka gcung po grags pa shes rab la gtad de rab tu byung ba'i mtshan drung chen thams cad mkhyen pa dge ba'i blo gros su grags/ mkhas pa'i dbang po bu ston rin po che tshal du bka' 'gyur gyi rab gnas la gdan drangs skabs/ tshal pa dpon po'i kha ya byed dgos pas rang dgar phyin na mi yongs gsungs nas/ phyag dpe mang po bsnams te lam du gzigs skad/ chos rje bsod nams grags pas/ chos 'khor gling drung chen smon lam rdo rjes btab pa dang / si tu dge ba'i blo gros dang drung chen kun dga' rdo rje so sor 'dren pa sogs ni yig tshang gi zhib cha ma nges pa'i 'ol tshod kyi gtam ste/ 'di dag la 'dris pa chung ba'i dbus su wa skyes rgyal po'i rnam thar 'dzin pa'i tshul yin mchis na'ang / deb ther la 'dris pa rnams kyis brtags tshe ba 'ad gad kyi gnas so/ /(63ba)drung chen kun dga' rdo rje'i sras si tu dge legs bzang po/ de la sras tre hos dpal 'byor bzang po/ legs pa rgyal mtshan/ legs ldan bzang po dang gsum gyi dang po'i sras tre hos dga' bde bzang po dang dngos grub rgyal mtshan gnyis 'brungs gdung brgyud rim par byon pa de dag thams cad kyang gong ma'i lung dang las gas mngon par mtho zhing / chos dang srid kyi mdzad pa mi dman pa sha stag tu byon/ 'on kyang dpon kun dga' rdo rjes / sa skya'i dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po/dbang brtson g.ya' bzang ba sogs dang bsdongs te/ sde srid phag mo gru pa la ngan bshoms mang du byas pas/ 'dab chags phal gyis mkha' lding gi rjes su snyeg pa rang nyid ngal ba'i rgyur 'gro ba ba chin —86

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (podu sngar dpon dga' bde dang / drung chen smon lam pa'i dus mtha' sgyur ba'i gong ma'i 'ja' sa'i nang gi 'bangs ni phal cher shor ro/ /dpal phag mo gru pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun las/ sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che'i dgon gnas slob rgyun dar rgyas su spel bar mdzad pa po ni skyu ra rin po che yin la/ gdan rabs bzhi tsam gyi bar du dam pa'i chos kho na don du gnyer ba las/ 'jig rten gyi stobs dang gong ma'i lag rtags sogs med 'dug pas/ si tu rin po che'i bka' chems deb ther las/ de dus kyi bla ma de spyan snga rin po che yin/ sgom pa shāka rin yin te dam kha ma the ba rjes tsam yang khyed bla dpon la med/ rgyal po'i bla ma ti shri yang ma byas gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de yang bstan pa snga dar gyi dus skyu ra'i rig sngags 'chang ba zhig la mkha' 'gro'i rig can gyi sna nam bza' bya ba'i jo mo (64na zhag blangs pa mi las 'das pa'i sprul sgyur sna tshogs ston pa zhig byung ba/ deng sang 'bri gung a phyir 'bod pa 'di yin la/ de gnyis kyi sras la nam mkha' dbang phyug gi brgyud las a mes dbang rgyal gyi sras bzhi pa rdo rje la jo mo rje btsun ma bya ba blangs pa'i sras su 'bri gung rin po che 'brungs te 'gro mgon rin po che'i drung du zab rgyas kyi chos bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan zhing mtshan rin cen dpal du grags/'gro mgon gshegs rjes zhang sum thog pa'i mjug tu gdan sa mdzad kyang 'phrin las bzhed pa bzhin ma byung bas byang phyogs su byon nas rtogs ldan mi nyag sgom rin gyi dgon pa nye gnas kyis phul bar phyag phab ste dar rgyas su mdzad pas 'bri gung thel zhes gangs ri'i khrod kyi sgrub brgyud pa'i gtsug na mngon par mtho ba byung zhing / skyob pa rin po che'i khu bo dkon cog rin cen gyi sras a mes grags rgyal/ de la sras mched gsum las che ba dpon rin po che/ 'bring dpon brgyud rdo rje seng ge /chung ba gcung rin po che rdo rje grags pa las/ gcung rin po che ti li ba'i sprul par grags shing / 'di'i dus su sgom pa la khri dpon gyi 'ja' sa lon te/ byar dgas tshun lung gis mnga' sgyur bas stobs 'byor gyi longs spyod shin tu che/ de dag la bsams nas phyis su gong ma si tu rin po che la 'bri gung sgom —87

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)pas/ da lta sa skya pas bdag byed pa 'di sngon nged 'bri gung pas byed par snang zer ba'i khengs dregs kyi gtam smras skad/ 'on kyang sgom pa gsum bzhi'i ring la sa skya pa dang ma mthun pas/ 'bring po'i sras zog kha pa rin cen seng ge dang spyan snga mtshams (64ba)bcad pa'i rjes su gnubs gdan sar bzhugs thog gling log chen po de byung skabs 'du khang la me brgyab pas dge 'dun khri tsho tsam gnam g.yang nas mkha' la 'phur zer zhal ngo kong por bros/ mnga' thang yang cung zad bri/ de rjes rdo rje rin chen/ rdo rje rgyal po/ nyer gnyis rin po che/ don grub rgyal po rnams rin par byon te spyan snga'i gos dang sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa spel ba kho na las/ 'jig rten gyi srid 'dzin pa ni sa skya'i dpon chen gyi dod po lta bu 'bri gung gi sgom pa yin pas/ de dag gi go rim ni/ sgom pa rdo rje seng gi kya rin cen/byang she/ byang chub/ sbang ras/ chos seng / rin cen seng ge /sgom pa dpon po/ sgom pa shākya dang / rin cen grags/ ye shes dpal/ 'di grongs pa'i dus si tu rin po che 'bri gung du 'phrad mol byon/ bkra shis ljongs su rin po che dang mjal/ si tu rin po ches kyang rin cen rdo rje sgom pa che ba la bskos/kun rin chung ba la bskos na legs pa'i rgyu mtshan phul ba bzhin mdzad/ de nas rin rdor 'das rjes kun rin la gong ma'i lung med na'ang / dbus gtsang slon wi si ba rnams kyis khyon bskos byas/ spyir gdan sa phan tshun gnyis zung 'brel yin pa dang / khyad par sgom pa rang la si tu bka' drin che bar/slob dpon kun rin gyis sde srid phag mo gru pa la ngan nga pa|mas kyi gra sgrig 'ga' zhig byas pa la brten/ 'bri gung gi srid la phan pa che ba ma byung zhing / de rjes shākya bzang pos sgom pa'i las ka bzung /de nas rdzong ji bsod rin dang sku zhang tshul rgyal sogs kyis srid 'dzin pa'i srol byung 'dug na'ang /chos rgyal rin cen dpal (65na)bzang gi thog bla dpon sbrags te chos srid kyi lung bzang po yongs su bzung / sras gnyis 'khrungs pa'i chung ba bco lnga rin po che chos srid kyis mngon par mtho ba'i go sar byon/ sras gsum byung ba'i che ba phag mor byon/ 'bring po chos rje kun dga' rin cen gdan sar bzhugs/ 'di'i dus zhal ngo nang mtshams ma mthun pa dang / snga thog 'bri gung pa dang dga' ldan —88

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (popa gnyis lugs gnyis kyi 'brel zab pa'i mu can du yod na'ang / 'di nyid kyi 'bri gung mnga' 'og na yod pa'i dge lugs kyi dgon pa rnams kyi zhwa bsgyur ba dang / dgon pa gzhan la'ang dpung gi sbyor ba sams pa sermegs sde 'a9/ga kho nas dus 'da' bas/ 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa la phan pa cher ma byung ba'i ngang du grongs/ gcung chos kyi rgyal pos sbu lung bzung ba'i sras dpon rin cen phun tshogs ni rgya bod kyi mkhas grub 'ga' zhig gi skye ba gsal bar dran zhing gdan sar byon/ rat+na'i ming can 'gro ba'i kha lo sgyur/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan dang mthun par mnga' thang gung du 'phel/ 'di'i rjes su phag mo nas dpon rin po che gdan sar byon/ thog kha nang sos kong dmag drangs/ 'bri gtsang srid du bsgril pa dang / gong ma sde srid la 'bangs gyen log gi rnam pa mdzad pa la brten/ dus mi bde ba mang du byung / de rjes su zur pa'i sras rje chos rgyal phun tshogs rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi sprul par grags shing / de la sras rje bkra shis phun tshogs rje drung dkon cog yan lag gi sprul sku/ rje dkon cog rin chen/ rje dkon cog phun tshogs bzhi las/ da lta chos rje rin po che dkon cog phun (65ba)tshogs gdan sar bzhugs te chos srid kyi mnga' thang gi rgyun gnas so/ /de ltar gong du smos pa bzhin khri skor gzhan rnams kyis 'bri gung dang tshal pa'i mnga' thang dpal 'byor la 'gran par mi nus na'ang / sna dkar rtse pas 'brog khri dpon gyi lung dang lag rtags lon zhing / 'bri gung du gling log gtong ba'i sa skya'i dpon chen ang len zhes mgon po gur gyi sprul par grags pa'i dpa' rtags kyi grags snyan can de yang 'di'i zhal ngo yin/ sde pa bstan 'dzin pa'i dus rin po che las grub pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten brgyad las/ rten 'brel gyi sgo nas myang 'das mchod rten gyi tshab tu mchod rdzas kyi rim pa bzheng ba sogs rnam dkar gyi dge las che zhing /yar 'brog stag lung gi btsan rdzong yang 'di nyid kyi dus bslangs pas chos srid gnyis ka nas grags che/ gtso bor dpal ldan sa skya pa dang / chos rje bo dong pa'i bstan pa la phu dud ma dmad pa mdzad/ grub mtha' gzhan dag la'ang kun slong skyon can gyi sbyor ba mi rtsom pas mtshan jus brtan chags shing / zhal —89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyengo rim par byon pa rnams mkhyen sgo yangs pa dang thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pas ding sang sa skyong kun dga' dbang chen phun tshogs mched kyi bar du chab srid la 'pho 'gyur med par yod do/ /byang pa bdag po ni phun sum tshogs pa'i bsod nams kyi dpal las grub pa'i dbang phyogs rgya nag gong ma'i khri la gnam gyi lung gis dbang sgyur ba mi nyag si'u rgyal po nas gdung rabs bdun pa mi nyag rgyal rgod las rim par brgyud pa'i rigs las mi nyag seng ge dar/ de'i sras rdo rje dpal gyi rje btsun grags pa (66na)rgyal mtshan gyi 'khas la ga khugs nas/ dpal sa skya pa dang 'brel ba'i 'go tshugs/ de'i sras dkon cog /de la sras gsum las/ 'bum sdes chos rje sa paṇa la gus 'dud lhur mdzad/'di la sras drug las grags pa dar gyi gong ma se chen rgyal po'i lung bzhin rin po che'i dam kha dang si tu'i las ka blangs/ byang ngam ring gi chos sde chen po btsugs/ dpon chen grags pa dar ming gzhan yon btsun zhes grags snyan can de'i sras rdo rje mgon pos yab mes kyi srol bzhin sa sku'i dpon chen gyi las ka bzung / tshogs sdebazhi la bkur sti bla lhag tu mdzad/ de la sras drug las/ nam mkha' brtan pas gong sar byon nas stag mgo nor bu gsum pa gu'i gung gi mtshan shel gyi tho shu rnams gnang / slar ta dben gu shri ming dang shel gyi dam kha blangs/ dpal ldan sa skya dang ngam ring gis gtsos pa'i chos sdo rnams su bsnyen bkur sogs lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pa bzang / de la sras rin cen rgyal mtshan dang / nam mkha' rin cen gnyis las/ gcen gyis yab kyi chen po'i las ka rnams blangs/spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par grags/ 'di'i sras snga tshar gu'i gung chos grags dpal bzang gis si tu chang gu'i las ka blangs/ sras phyi tshar zla ba rgyal mtshan/ 'khon ston bsod nams pa'i yum rnams 'khrungs/ gcung 'jam dbyangs pa rje btsun sa paṇa gyi dus su 'khor du skyes pa dran/ shes bya'i gnas la blo gros kyi 'jug pa mchog tu yangs shing / kwa ding gu lha'i las ka bzung / yab dang gcen gyi bka' bzhin rab byung gi bslab pa phul/ sras lcam sring gsum (66bskor grangs/ gu'i gung chos grags pa'i —9(lha

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pesras che ba bdag chen rnam rgyal grags bzang gis ta'i si tu'i las ka dang / gcung dkon cog legs pas shi'i zi'i dre hos kyi las ka bzung te srid kyi 'byor pa shin tu che/ khyad par gcen gyi lo chen byang chub rtse mo sogs dam pa du ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi myang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po shā ri bu tra dang / bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal ba la zab rgyas kya chos mang du gsan/ khyad par dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pas/ mkhas pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / mi nyag chos grags bzang po sogs kyis/ chos rgyal 'di nyid kyi zhabs la gtugs nas/ dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'grel gsan/ rtses thang pa sangs rgyas lhun grub kyis rigs ldan 'di nyid kyi drung du dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel mthar phyin par gsan nas/ slar dbus su paṇa chen byams pa gling pa'i drung du rig gnas kyi thugs sbyong mdzad pa'i skabs/ bdag chen 'di nyid kyis legs par bshad pa'i dus 'khor gyi gsung gleng byung bas thugs ha las te/ nyid kyi gsung 'di ltar na nged kyis sngar brtsams pa rnams la yang bcos byed dgos par 'dug gsungs skad/mdor na dbus gtsang mtha' dag tu zur gnas rnams/ rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po slar byon pa yin thes gleng zhid / g.yin yang theg pa che chung gi gsung rab mtha' dag la mkhyen spyan yangs pas/skabs shig dus bzhi cig car ba dang rim gyis pa'i skor la bdag chen nyid kyis na bza' ber gyi phu dung brdzes te thal 'gyur 'phen pa sogs mkhas pa rnams spa bkong bar mdzad/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs 'grel dang / 'jig (67na rten mes po'i gtsug lag mi mthun pa'i nad kyi rtsa ba drungs nas dbyung bar byed pa'i gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs kun gyi yang snying rje btsun g.yu thog pa chen po'i ring lugs gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos/ log smra tshar gcod pa sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos kyi nying khu ka lwa pa'i mdo rgyan/ bzo rig pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi phyag tshad/ bstan pa'i gnas tshad/ gsang ba sngags kyi lha'i sgrub thabs kyi rim pa/ ma 'ongs mngon sum gsal bar ston pa gtsug lag rtsis kyi skor/ mkhas grub chos rje'i rtsod lan sogs legs par bshad pa'i rtsom pa'i —91—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)rig ji snyed cig mchis shing / dus kyi 'khor lo'i blos slongs sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzheng mang du mdzad/ mnal lam du slob dpon chen po zhal gzigs pa dang rje sa chen la thugs dad shugs drag po 'khrungs pas sa chen dbu gcug nas thim pa'i snang ba sogs rtogs pa'i yon tan kyang mtha' yas shing rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pas rgyal po paṇ+ḍi ta zhes snyan pa'i rgyud kyis rgya gar mkhas pa'i khengs dregs kyi gzhu yongs su 'gugs shing / rin po che'i rgyan sogs mi chen gyi cha lugs dang ldan bzhin dus dge'i mtshan nyid kyi slob dpon mkhas pa rnams la gsung rab mtha' dag brgal brtag gis gtan la 'bebs pa'i bgro gleng mdzad pa sogs 'chad rtsod rtsom pas dus 'da' bas spyir yang ngo mtshar che/ khyad par 'gro ba'i 'dren par rlom pa'i dregs ldan chos smra ba'i lce mdud pa brgya phrag gis bcings pa rnams kyi snang tshul la dpags na rjes su (67ba(sku rang ngo / /de rjes nam mkha' tshe dbang rdo rje/ de'i sras nam mkha' rin cen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/kun dga' legs pa gsum las 'bring po rab tu byung / chung ba lho byang yongs la mnga' sgyur/ dpa' gtum gyi grags che/ mched gsum gyi rigs las nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan kun dga' rin chen/ bkra shis stobs rgyas dbang ngo/'i sde sogs zhabrungs pa las/ 'di nyid slob dpon chen po'i zab chos kyi bdag por bka' babs so/ /smras pa/ 'od gsal 'chi med lam las babs pa'i 'khon gyi brgyud pa rin po che/ shar phyogs gong ma'i rgyal mtshan rtser mdzod chen po'i las ka 'dod rgu'i char/ /'dzam gling khyon kun mngon par snyil ba'i mu thi la yi lha ka /rin cen nyams 'gyur phra tshoms kyis mdzes ya rabs mdun sa'i rgyan du spel/ g.yung po'i lugs min rigs rus cho 'brang ldan/ /gong ma'i lung 'dzin srid kyis ma' mtho'i mkhar/ /rnam dkar zla shel dri med zil mngar can/ /bde skyid kuṇ+ḍa dag 'a ba'i grogs su 'dzag /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /—92

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (polha gzigs rlangs kyi gdung rabs brjod pa dang /phag gru'i rgyal rabs kyi skor/kha bas bskor ba'i ljongs chen po 'di nyid du dpal dwags po'i bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa nags klung sdug po'i dbus su dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa lta bu ni dpal phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po zhes dbang po tha mal pa rtsod dus kyi gdul bya'i snang ngor rim gyis sbyangs pa'i sar gnas kyi sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin cing / dbang po yang rab la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas yin par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i snyan grags lha yi rdza lnga sgrub brgyud rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang (68na)gi rtse mor brdungs pas me tog mda' can lha min gyi tshogs mtha' dag brnag nus las 'das te phun sum tshogs pa'i legs byas kyi bdud rtsir spyod pa la nyer 'tshe'i bsam pa ring du gtong ba'i byed po theg pa chen po'i glang chen sa la rab brtan gyi steng du rnam par 'gying zhing / ye shes 'dren byed stong gis ji lta ji snyed kyi chos mtha' dag chen por 'char ba kun stong chen phyag rgya gcig gi rgyas thebs pa'i rdo rje rtse brgya pas bdag 'dzin ri bo'i bgrod pa ming gi lhag mar btang ba'i skyes mchog mchod sbyin brgya pa 'di nyid kyi bka' brgyud yin la/ de yang chos srid kyi 'byor pa bla na med pa'i sgo nas yar ldan du spel ba ni rje spyan snga rin po che dang / gong ma ta'i si tu sogs dpal ldan rlangs kyi gdung las rim par byon pa rnams yin pas/ rlangs kyi po ti bse ru las/ lar skyes pa'i mis rang gi skye brgyud ma shes na nags khung gi spre'u dang 'dra/ mi rang gi cho 'brang ma shes na g.yu 'brug zol ma dang 'dra/yab mes kyi che ge'i yig tshang ma shes na/ mon phrug yal bor dang 'dra zhes dang / skyes pa'i mi la grags pa'i gtam dgos/ byas pa'i chos la grub pa'i mtha' dgos/ che ba'i mi la mtho ba'i rtags dgos zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bod gsil bur ma song ba'i snga rabs kyi dus rje 'bangs mtha' dag —93—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyerigs rus 'chol bar mi spyod pas khungs dang yig tshangs la nan tan du byed pa'i srol 'dug cing /deng sang ni 'di rigs kyi rgyu mtshan mang du smra ba/ sprel rgan rnams kyis mi bzung nas/ /mjug ma med ces bzhad gad byed/ /ces pa'i tshul lta bur 'gro bar gda' na'ang (68ba)gong gi 'phros las 'di nyid cung zad brjod na/ po ti bse ru las/ 'bangs kyi mi rabs la/ 'byung ba sna lnga'i snying po la/sgo nga chen po gcig yongs pa/ phyi'i sgong shun la lha brag dkar po chags/ nang gi sgong chu la dung mtsho dkar mer 'khyil/ bar gyi sgo nga'i dar cha la/ rigs drug sems can kun tu grol/ /sgo nga 'phrul gyi bco brgyad chags/ /sgo nga bco brgyad 'bring po de/ /dung sgong gcig tu yar nas byung / /zhes bshad pa ltar/ dung gi sgo nga de la dbang po lnga dang yan lag rnams so sor dod de mtshar sdug gyi khye'u yid la smon pa lta bu zhig byung bas ming ye smon rgyal por btags/ de'i jo mo chu lcag rgyal mo la/ 'phrul sras dbang ldan 'khrungs/ des dung bza' dngul mo blangs pa la/ ko sras skyes gcig 'khrungs/ de'i sras mi rabs mched gsum las/ chung ba stag tshal 'al 'ol gyi jo mo 'tshams bza' khyad khyud la sras mgur lha mched bzhi byung / chung ba'i sras yab lha sde drug gi chung ba 'o de gung rgyal gyi jo mo lha mo la/lha tsha mched dgu byung / jo mo gnyan mo la gnyan tsha mched dgu/ jo mo rmus mo la/ rmu tsha mched dgu/ jo mo klu bza' la klu tsha mched brgyad byung / kun bsgril bas sras sum cu rtsa lnga byung / de rnams kyi chung ba sne khrom lag khra'i jo mo lha lcam la/ la kha rgyal po 'khrungs/ de'i jo mo lung kha hril mo la sras gsum gyi che ba mthing gi /de'i jo mo lha lcam dkar mo la sras bod 'jongs la brang gi rmu bza' mthing bsgril khab tu ba ches par rgya khri la 'ad 'khrungs/ de la sras rgyal po che chung gsum/ brgyud brgyad yod pa las/chung ba'i jo mo mthing mo la sras gsum (69na bang ba'i khri rje gnyan thang gi sras dpal lha/ de'i sras a mi mu zi khri do'i jo mo gnyan bza' sha mig la sras gsum dang / rmu bza' la sras gcig /sren bza' la sras gnyis te drug byung la/ 'di dag las mched pa rus chen bco brgyad/ 'bras la dkar nag /khra gsum sogs dang / bod mi'i gdung drug /byung tshul shin tu mang zhing / stod kyi 'bras dkar 0(34

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pemached dgu la/ /bal po dang bal yo bal srid gsum/ /ma stong bal stong con stong drug /mar ba dang zhang chung pu rangs dgu /zhes sogs dbye ba shin tu mang zhing / bse khyung 'bras kyi jo mo btsan bza' dge ldan ma'i sras/ 'bras khrab/ de'i jo mo srun bza' khra mo la sras bzhi byung ba'i sa ches hor bza' 'bum mo khab tu bzhes pa la khyung ru dkar po/ de'i sras 'bum re shal mig /de'i sras ar rje gtsug gsum/ de la gnam lha mched brgyad kyi lnga pas sras su sprul pa'i ming mang ldom stag btsan/ de'i jo mo rong bza' khye lcam la sras ma byung bas thugs ma bde bar lha yul du byon te rang gi gcen rnams la dris par/ rang re lha sras mched brgyad kyi/ khyed ni mi yi sras su sprul/ /bu dang sras med thugs chad na/ /zla ba bcu gsum sgrub pa mdzod/ /yi dam bsgoms la gsang sngags bgrongs/ /lo gsar zla ba bcu gsum la/ /lha ri gnyan po can du byon/ /bsangs dang mchod pa gsol ba thob/ /lha tshangs sras mo 'grub ste 'ong/ /lha tshangs sras mo 'grub pa na/ /lha yi sras la mi yi brgyud/ /rigs brgyud khyad du 'phagasapa 'ong / /mi rabs bdun cu rtsa gsum par/ /bla ma mi dpon rgyun mi chad/ /(69ba)sems can kun gyi 'dren pa dang / /dpa' bos rgyal khams 'dul ba dang / /grags pa sa steng khebs pa 'ong / /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par mi yul du byon te sgrub pa mdzad/ lo gsar gyi zla ba la lha ri'i rtser byon te mchod pa mdzad pas nam mkha' las 'ja' tshon sna lnga pa byung zhing bar snang la rol mo'i sgra sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung bas/ tshangs sras lha mo 'khor brgyad dang bcas pa byon par gzigs te/ chung ma mdzad par gsol ba bzhin 'khor rnams 'od du yal/ lha mos zhal gyis bzhes/rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi khrus chus jo mo'i sku lus bkrus nas yul du byon/ yun ring du song kyang sras ma byung / skabs shig nam mkha' nas sgra zhig la/ mang sdom stag btsan dmag la byon/ /rgya dmag bod du lhags dogs yod/ /rgya dmag bod du lhags pa na/ /khyod min gang gis thub mi 'gyur/ /zhes byung bas/ mang sdom gyis chibs ngang dkar g.yug shog la chibs/ dngul dkar gyi dung khrab dang shel dkar gyi rmog de gyon/ 'od 'bar gyi mtshon btags nas/ nam mkha' la lha dmag dang chu rgyud la klu —95

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedamag rnams 'grim du bcug ste byon pas/ rgya rnams bros te g.yul las rgyal/ skabs der sman btsun gyis lha yul nas khrid pa'i dung gi mdzo mo bros pa mang sdom gyis bkag /sman btsun gyis mdzo mo 'tshol du 'ongs pa gzigs nas/ mdzo mo mi 'gro ba'i phyag rgyas bcings te pha bong gur 'dra'i nang du byon/ sgo bsdams te zur gcig nas gzigs pas/ sman btsun gyis mdzo mo la 'o ma bzhes pa'i phud kyis dkon cog dang / mang ldom gyi skyabs lha la mchod (70na)pa phul/ lhag ma chu la blug nas/rigs brgyud khyad 'phags 'byung ba'i smon lam btab pas mang ldom mnyes/ dus der nam mkha' nas sprul pa'i lha brgyud spal ran pas/ sang phod dus kyi de tsam na/ /rigs kyi sras bu 'khrungs par 'gyur/ /zer ba'i sgra byung ba dang / mang ldom kyis sman btsun gyi rtsar byon nas gzims/ tho rangs mi dkar rta dkar du sprul nas/ mched bdun la gsung ba bzhin byas yod/ sras ji ltar 'brungs zhus pa'i lan du/ mi brgyud lha rabs gsum du yod/ /gcig gis bla ma'i brgyud pa 'dzin/ /sems can kun gyi 'dren pa byed/ /gcig gis bod khams dpon du 'gyur/ /bod khams kun gyi rje byed cing / /gcig gis dpa' bo'i rigs su yong / /zhes gsung / de nas zla ba bdun rdzogs dus nyams sad pa'i phyir du bdag gi sras ma lags zhes lha mo la gsungs pas/ sras 'khrungs khar sman btsun gyis sngar gzims sar byon/ mnal lam du gser gyi mchod rten rin po ches spras pa la/ bang rim grangs med cing thog mtha' bar gsum la rim bzhin bla ma/ lha'i bu bu mo bsgrigs pa zhig pang du byung ba rmis/sang sras 'khrungs pa lta ri'i rtser khyer te/ g.yam sgrom gyi nang du sras bzhag nas/ mang ldom gyi sras yin na mi brgyud lha las sra ba dang / min na bya dang gcan gzan gyis za ba'i smon lam btab/ mi'i dri ma phog pa'i stabs kyis lha gnas su ma thon par yul du log /der mang ldom la rgyu mtshan rnams bshad pas/ de ma thag yab yum (70ba gnyis kyis lha ri'i rtser phyin pa na/ khye'u g.yu'i zur phud can spyi gtsug na rlangs pa dkar po yod pa gcig la g.yu 'brug gis ngar chu blud/ seng shes nu zho bsnun/rgod kyi gshog pas bkab/ gcan gzan ri dwags kyis skor ba byed/ 'ja' tshon gyi gur phub 'dug —96

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ ('apa gzigs pas/ yab dgyes te/ rlangs so rlangs so lan gsum rlangs/ gsungs pas rlangs kyi gdung brgyud ces ming de nas chags/ 'ga' zhig tu ga gla btags su snang ba ni yig mkhan gyis ma dag pa'i rgyun 'byams par nges so/ /de'i jo mo ldong bza' khri sgron la sras dpa' bo/ /de'i jo mo lcog ro bza' lha gnam gyi sras stong tho/ de'i sras che che/ de'i sras rgod lding / gcen po'i steng du rgod ldir ba ltar 'phur bas ming de ltar chags/ de'i sras stong dge /de'i sras stong khri/ de'i sras phag tshang / de'i sras ldang ra/ de'i sras gtsug gnyen rdzong khong / de'i sras btsan pa 'dab shong / de'i sras snang gnyan khong sleb/ de'i sras mang po che sgro kha/ de'i sras stag po che dar dpal/ 'dis ma pham g.yu mtsho'i 'gram du gser kyi shākya mu ni bzhengs/ g.yu snang ba 'od ldan yon du phul/ byu ru bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi mchod rdzas byas/ grub thob seng ge rab gnas su gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ sgang bza' lha mo la sras gag zhakhrungs pa/ grub thob kyis mtsho ni bzang nyid sras 'di lha'i spyan gyis gzigs pa zhig byung bas/ mtsho bzang lha gzigs su thogs gsung / 'di nas bzung ste rlangs lha gzigs su grags la/ 'di'i sras a mi byang chub 'dra 'khol te/ dgung lo brgyad la o rgyan du byon pa dang / (71na)srin po btul nas phyir byon pa'i tshe yi dam gyi lha zhal gzigs pa dang / ge sar gyis gling yul du lan gnyis gdan drangs pa'i phyi ma'i tshe/ pha bong gra ba rta 'dra ba la chibs nas phyogs bzhir gdon chen po bzhi btul ba sogs rdzu 'phrul ni mtha' yas shing / sngar byang chub rdo rje zer yang / phyis lha srin bran du 'khol bas 'dre 'khol du mtshan chags/slob dpon chen po pad+mas kyang / byang dang chub ces bya ba yi/ /mi bu khyad du 'phags pa 'ong / /de ni nga yi thugs kyi sras/ /zhes gsungs shing / byang chub 'dre 'khol nyid kyi gsung du yang / da nas mi rabs bcu gsum na/ /bod khams yongs kyi bdag po 'ong / /zhes lung bstan pa/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i pho brang tshun gyi mchog dman gyi skye bo mtha' dag gi mig dang rna ba'i spyod yul du gyur pa de ltar yin la/ 'di'i jo mo skal ldan ma la sras dpal gyi seng ge /gnyan thog a khrom/ stag tshab gsum —97

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shelas/ 'bring po gnyan zog a khrom gyi sras gnyan po nya mog khri/ de'i sras rlangs ston bya zhu nag po/de'i sras a seng / de'i sras a ser/ de'i sras skyabs bdun dpal dang brgyad/ btsan dang dgu zhes pa'i che ba yon chen rgyal ba skyabs yin la/ de yang rlangs stod tho yi spyi dpon mdzad/ mgo rum seng ge rgya bcom/ rtse 'thon gyis drag po spun bzhi btul/ ldong sras kyi 'don yul dbang du bsdus pa sogs 'jig rten mi chos nas mngon par mtho ba shin tu mang zhing / dam pa'i lha chos kyi sgo nas/ byang chub 'dre 'khol ni gong du smos zin pa dang / de'i sras gsum gyis dpag (71ba)par dka' ba sprul sgyur mdzad pa dang / rlangs khams pa go chas rab tu byung ba'i sad mi mi bdun gyi bar mar grags/ rlangs dpal gyi seng gis slob dpon chen po'i thugs sras mdzad de grub pa brnyes/ ye shes rdo rjes nyi ma lhong la mnan/ye shes seng ges dpal thang du jag pa btul/ dpal gyi 'byung gnas kyis lha 'dre dam la btags/dar ma seng gis dur khrod bsil ba tshal du byon/ dpal gyi rdo rjes nyi zer la chos gos bkal ba sogs grub pa brnyes pa'i mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul dpag par dka' ba sha stag tu byon pa yin no/ /smras pa/ /'chi ba med pa'i lam las legs 'ongs lha rigs rlangs kyi pad dkar tshal/ /mkhas grub ra yig gnyis pa'i tshogs 'du ngo mtshar 'phur lding rol gar can/ /gsang chen theg pa'i ze'u 'bru rab ldem dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i za ma tog /lo rgyus myangs na zhim pa'i ro bcud skabs gsum bdag po'i bdud rtsi bzhin/ /mdo khams yul gyi zla ba'i ma ma las/ /lha gzigs gdung gi mngon mtho'i bsil zer can/ /gangs can legs bris lam du 'phags pa'i tshe/ /skal bzang skye rgu'i sa smos 'dod pa 'jo/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de yang yon chen rgyal ba skyabs la jo mo 'bro ldog bza' dang / de gu ma/ 'byo bza' ye shes mtsho dang gsum las/ dang po'i sras rje spyan snga rin po che dpon sangs rgyas bskyabs/ dpon shes rab rgyal/ gnyis pa'i sras dbon mgon po rgyal mtshan gsum pa'i sras rgyal ba rin po che/ bcu gnyis pa gter rgyab pa rin cen rdo rje rnams las (72na)rje spyan snga rin po che ni yab mes dang bka' —98

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pobargyud kyi chos kyis gtso mdzad/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu la thos bsam lhur blangs pas/sgrub ris yongs kyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ shar rgyal po'i lung gis mthong tshad bsad na thos tshad skrag pa'i las rngam po che gsog pa'i byed po dor rta nag po yang rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dul bar mdzang pas/ kha ba ri ba rnams la gcig tu bka' drin che/ de rjes rgyal ba rin po che rab tu byung ba'i mtshan grags pa brtson 'grus te/ dbus su phebs nas rje spyan snga rin po ches byin gyis brlabs pas chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi rtogs pa zhabrungs/ mkhas grub kyi yon tan phul du byon zhing / nam mkha' las thog babs pa sku chos su gtums pas rgyal sras thog rdugs pa zhes nus mthu'i snyan pa che/gdan sar phebs nas sing gha gling ti ra hu ti ya rtse rgyal po rnams kyis rnam thos kyi bu la 'gran par nus pa'i mkho dgu'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul zhing / khyad par sog po rbad 'gyel du grags pa'i nor bu sogs nor sna'i rigs kyi mchod rdzas bod yul du gdan sa thel bzang bar grags pa yang 'di'i dus byung / spyan snga rin po che yan chad du gong ma'i 'ja' sa sogs med 'dug na'ang / 'di nyid kyi dus hu la hung gtogs pa rnams gong ma'i lung gi 'ja' sa dang bcas ldan ma sgom brtson gyis spyi dpon byas na'ang lugs dang 'brel bar ma byung bas/ dpon rdo rje dpal rkang bzhi'i dpon byed kyi yod pa rgyal ba rin po ches tshur bkug ste khri dpon du bskos/ gong sar lan gsum byon/ pho (72ba)brang sgang / tshong 'dus brag kha/ sne'u gdong / sna mo/ ha la sgang / thang po che gling smad/ 'phyos gzhis ka /mon mkhar bkra shis gdong / rgyal thang / lcags rtse gri khu/ mchod rten gling / chad dkar te gzhis ka bcu gnyis brtsigs/ mnga' thang shin tu mtho zhing / dpon rang yang mgo la sgom zhwa dang /lus la chos gos rnam gsum gyon/ btsun tshugs ma dor bas lugs gnyis thad nas kun gyis mtho bzos che/ 'khor rnams kyang mtshun che ba'i stabs kyis gzhan mtha' dag gis dpon gyis gzigs sar bag yangs kyi spyod pa byed mi nus skad/ chos rje bsod grags pas/ bcu gnyis rin po che'i dus gong ma'i 'ja' sa byung ba dang / tshes bzhi pa'i dus dpon rdo rje rin cen gyis khri dpon byas par smra ba —99

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyesogs ni yig tshang khungs thub rnams ma gzigs par tshod 'jog tu bris pa'i skyon kho na ste/ lo rgyus rnams ma nges bzhin du 'dri dgos pa mo rtsis pa bzhin gyis lung bstan byung ba yin na thugs bden par mchis so /'gro mgon rin po che'i sprul pa bcu gnyis rin po che rdo rje ni lung rtogs kyi yon tan mtha' yas shing / gdan sar phebs nas pu rangs ma/ chung gi thugs dam dgra nag la gsol ba btab pas lho brgyud kyi 'khrug pa zhi ba dang mngon par mkhyen pa thogs pa med pa sogs rnam thar ya mtshan can mang zhing / 'di'i dus khri dpon rdo rje dpal grongs nas khong gi gcung gzhan nu rgyal mtshan khri dpon gyi go sar bskos kyang / mgo la smyug zhwa/ lus la hor gos/ rkang pa la hor lham gyon/ mtshan phyed kyi rin glu len zhing bro brdung / nyin phyed kyi bar nyal ba sogs bag med kyi spyod pa kho nas (73na)dus 'da' bas phag mo gru pa'i sde tshugs la shin tu gnod pa byung / khong 'das rjes lho brag gshong sde mkhan po rin rgyal gong sar btang ste 'ja' sa zhus/ de rjes yar 'brog pa byang gzhen khri dpon du bskos na'ang sngon ma'i mig ltos kyis bag med kyi spyod pa kho na'i dbang du song / dpon mgon po rgyal ba sras rin cen shes rab/ grags pa ye shes/ grags pa rin chen/ rin cen skyabs dang bzhi las/grags pa ye shes ni sa skyar 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i drung du 'byon dus mdo sdud pa'i tshod tsam gyi phyag dpe zhogs re la bzung bas mkhyen rab kyis grags pa che/ gdan sar bzhugs rin 'gro phan gyi sgo mchog tu yangs/ khri dpon byang gzhen gyi rjes su gzhon nu yon tan gyis khri dpon lo drug byas na'ang / chang nag kho na don du gnyer bas sde'i 'dzin tshugs ma byung / gcung grags pa rin cen thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin zhing gdan sar bzhugs thog ti shri grags 'od dang / rgyal po the mur bog gnyis kyi 'ja' sa stag mgo phul/ khri dpon zur du ma bskos bar bla dpon sbrags nas mdzad/ do sngon/ rgyal thang / smon mkhar/ sa 'thon/ byi chung / za ra zo thang / lding gsum/ g.yu sring / mon mkhar sogs gzhon rgyal 'od du dben sha /dpon chen legs pa dpal/ slob dpon a tsa ra/ dpon — //)(/—

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pechen a blon/ sa skya ba sogs la 3(ra ba rnams phyag rdzas kyis bslu bar mdzad pas/ phag gru khri bskor la bka' drin shin tu che zhing / de'i don gyis si tu rin po che'i bka' chems su/ sne'u gdong gi thab mgo 'dzin pa'i gzhis ka ming can 'di rnams zhi (73ba)bar gshegs pas/ phyag rdzas kyis bslus pa'i gzhis kyang yin cing / sku drin che ba'i don gyis da lta nyi shu gnyis mchod 'di rang re nang so dang bza' pa mi sde dang bcas pas bdag rkyen byed pa'i don de yin zhes gsung /dpon rin cen skyabs la dzem zhang lcam ma dang khri smon 'bum skyid gnyis las/ dang po'i sras rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / grags pa rgyal mtshan/ grags pa bzang po dang gsum/ 'bum skyid kyi sras gong ma ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan/ grags pa shes rab/ bsod nams bzang po ste yum mi gcig pa'i sku mched drug las/ grags pa rgyal mtshan thos bsam sgom pa mang du mdzad cing / khyad par mgon po'i bka' babs byung zhing gdan sa yun ring du mdzad/ 'di'i dus slob dpon rgyal mtshan bzang pos gong ma'i drung du phyin te lung dang lag rtags sbrel nas khri dpon byas na'ang / bag yangs kyi dbang du song nas lugs gnyis kyi 'dzin bkod tshar ma byung zhing / de'i rjes su rgyal mtshan skyabs kyas khri dpon gyi go sar bsdad kyang 'khos ka chung bas kun gyis brnyas pa byas te/ phag mo gru pa'i sde srid kyi 'dzin tshugs nyag phra ba byung / de rjes ta'i si tu khri dpon gyi go sar phebs pa yin la/ 'di nyid ni thang yig las/ yar klungs mthil nas rnam smin bskyed rgyal 'byung / /bag gis sa rlog dbus khams sa hong za/ /btsan rdzong brgya dang rtsa brgyad phyogs su 'byung / /zhes pa'i lung bstan thog tu babs pa ste/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi byed po gser mngal can gyis gnam ka ba med pa'i sgo phye nas/ rin po che sna bdun sngon du 'gro ba can gyi gdong lnga'i dbang po'i gad (74na)rgyangs zad mi shes par sgrogs pa'i khri chen por snying stobs dpa' rtags kyi lus stobs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sa srung dbang po'i snar rigs pa dang mi rigs pa'i sde bzhi'i spyod tshul la rmongs pa'i dra ba mtha' dag gcod pa'i shes rab kyi spu gri rnon po rang byan du 'khor yang ngo tsha dang khrel gzhung sogs ya rabs dam pa'i spyod tshul gyi 'dzam bu chu —10/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyebo'i gser gyi rgyan bzang pos mdzes par spud pas skye rgu mtha' dag gi ral pa'i cod pan gyi rtse mor 'gying ba la skye bas thob pa'i skal ba mchog gi legs byas kyi zhags pa ring po stong spyi phud kyi rgyal khams su khrims kyi thig drang por 'debs pa'i sa la spyod pa'i mtho ris kyi rgyal po ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan dge byed ces pa chu pho stag gi lo la sku bltams/ dgung lo gsum la 'bri klog mkhyen pa dang / drug la chos skyong bya rog gdong can gyi rjes gnang gsan pas shin tu 'go ba byung / dgung lo bdun pa la spyan snga chos bzhi pa'i drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos/ mtshan byang chub rgyal mtshan du btags/dgu pa la mkhan chen tshul dar ba dang / slob dpon pu rangs pa la rab tu byung / bde mgon gyi bsnyen pa mdzad pas dngos grub kyi mtshan ma khyad par can brnyes/ dgung lo bcu bzhi lon pa'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu bdun la sa skyar 'byon pa'i grabs mdzad/ zla ba bzhi pa'i zla stod la sne'u gdong nas thon te glur bzhugs pa'i gongs 'khor rnams kyis chang mang du blangs te bag med kyi spyod pa byed par brtsams pas/ bdag chen rin po cher 'bul rgyu'i rta la chibs te ma bzhugs par byon pas g.yin rnams kyang (74ba)phyi la yong dgos pa byung nyid / skabs 'gar gung gi dro phyis bas ma gsol ba sogs rab tu byung ba'i bla mar khas 'che ba 'ga' zhis las 'di nyid bslab pa la gus shing / gong dkar bas mi khal la gnod pa byas par ngos kyis byon te bcu hu bstan nas nga'i 'go khag khyed rnams la yod do zhes sogs kyi na phra mo nas gsung sgam po byon pas 'jigs te gtong len dang bzod gsol byas/gan pa phur lcang gong gi rgyal pos bar chad brtsam pa sgom bzlas mdzad pas ma tshugs/ de nas rim gyis sa skyar phebs te/ dpon chen 'od zer seng shes ban rtsa byas nas bdag chen rin po cher phag gru'i dpon po 'di slob gnyer byung na rab/ ma byung na bzhi thog pa'i drung 'khor las tshan zhig zhus 'dug pa ltar dam gnyer la bskos nas/ bdag chen pa thugs gtum pas gsol gzims dam gnyer sogs la bka' bkyon 'phral 'phral yong ba zhig 'dug pas/ dgongs bzhus te rang bzhin las tshan mang bar bzhugs/ sprul pa'i dpyid chos la chu mig tu phebs skabs zhabs phyir mtshan nyid kyi bla ma — 1(32

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dbyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ ('a'ajam dpal dang / sngags kyi bla ma kun dbang sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rim pa dang / dpon chen dbang phyug dpal/ sang ye dpon po/ ba de lung ba'i dpon po/ stag lung dbon po rnams kyi snga bas khar/ si tu la phag gru dpon por 'bod cing / dpon po rnams kyi nang nas mthong bzos che bar mdzad/chag chag la khar/ bdag chen rin po che chibs bshol skabs si tu'i chibs 'dzin pa sngon la song nas med pas/ chibs 'drogs te rgyang ring por khyer bas/ rgyal tsha rin dbang gis rta nas babs te rogs byas 'dug pa (75na sgor 'i klungs pa' chen yin 'dug cing / bka' chems su/ nga rta thog nasam lhungs pa kho'i drin yin gsung / sa skyar phebs skabs drung 'khor rnams chang gi dga' ston byed par/ brang khang shar na si tu bang yod par bdag chen pa'i sku gzhogs nas 'bod mkhan bsdud mar gnang byung ba la byon pas/ gsol ras gser gyi theb rtsa'i nang du gnang ches med par phyag rjen pas bzung chog pa'i dgyes pa'i bka' stsal zhabs gom 'khyor ba tsam yod na'ang thugs rus mdzad de gsol/ bdag chen po rin po che mngon mkhyen thogs med mnga' bas/ si tu la/ khyed la khri dpon yong g.yul rgyal slobs gsung ba sogs ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i gsung mang du mdzad/de'i rgyu mtshan gyis bka' chems su/ bla ma bdag chen pa'i drung du thugs la dpe med btags pa de nga'i bsod nams chen po yod pa 'di mkhyen par 'dug bsam pa'i dag snang dang mos gus bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod gsung / ston chos thog bla ma mnyam med pa'i drung du brtag gnyis kyi gsan sbyong mdzad skabs/ slob dpon nam blo dang ma 'cham pa'i tshig rtsod kyi gtam bla mas gsan pas/ khyed tshe rlung gis 'das pa'i bye ri yin/ phag gru dpon po srid pas bskos pa'i gangs ri yin gsungs skad/de nas rta lo'i lo gsar la rin cen sgang du dpon chen rin cen seng ge'i rtsar byon pas 'brum pas bsnyung de grag pa dang / 'jad du zla ba gsum bzhi skor bzhugs/ de nas dbus su 'byon khar bdag chen rin po che'i drung du phyag 'bul la byon pas/ bla ma mkhas btsun pa dang / si tu gnyis phyag sbrel nas mkhas btsun pas si tu pa'i mgo gnyer (75ba bong / si tus mkhas btsun pa'i 'khas tog tu —/03—
