rgyal dbang snga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kye'agyur ba byed dgos pa'i gsung nan che ba byon/ de nas dbus su byon te mi ring bar gong ma rgyal pos stag mgon nor bu gsum pa dang bcas khri dpon gyi las ka gnang / khyi lo zla ba brgyad pa'i nang chun du rgyal mtshan skyabs kyis khri dpon byas na'ang / lugs gnyis kyi byed pa mthu dman zhing khyad par /bong rang gis las ka len par gong ma'i gser zhal lan gsum mthong ba'i rgyal dpal sgrol ma skyid 'phrog 'dod pa'i ched du bsad cing / si tu la tshig ngan bskur ba sogs kyis/ si tus bla chen kun blo gong ma'i gam nas sa skyar bsnyen rdzogs la byon pa'i sdebs skar si tu rin cen grags/ dpal ldan ju dben hur dpen gye dam kha khrims ra dang bcas 'byor 'dug pa'i dus su gtug gsher byas/ rgyal mtshan skyabs las ka las phab/ khyi lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes dgu'i nyin bka' shog bcu hu rnams bsgrags/bcu bzhi la sne'u gdong rtsis blangs/ gzhen nu 'od gnyer par bskos kyang phyi nang gi zhib tshags tshul dang mthun pa ma byung yang gnyer rtsis len pa las gzhan pa'i ca ra ma mdzad/ 'brug lo la a tu la yar klungs su byon/ yun ring bzhugs/ nyin gcig a tu las/ si tu rta rar khrid nas rta bres kyi kha shing gog la khad cig 'dug pa de bstan nas/ khri dpon blo zhib dgos pa yin/ 'di la sa phag gsum bzhag na 'grig pas/ rta la snad yar mi yong ba yin/ rta rab la dngul bre re/ dngul bre de gser srang brgyad yin gsung ba sogs 'jig rten mi chos la dgos pa'i bslab bya che phra du ma mdzad/ de nas sprul lo si tu' rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po tshul dar ba'i dpon (76na)po 'phyong rgyas pa hor gzhon nu bzang po gnyer du bskos/ de rjes gnyis ka rnams kyi gso phran dang / yul gru so sor skye shing 'dzugs pa/ gsham chu la zam mo che 'dzugs pa/ sne'u gdong rtse'i pho brang rgya bskyed de rnam par rgyal bar khang bzang sa la 'phos pa lta bu mdzad/ de nas mi ring bar g.ya' bzang pa dang kha mchu mang du byung zhing /g.ya' bzang pa 'di chos phyogs nas phag gru'i slob brgyud dang / 'jig rten nas hu la hur gtogs pa'i phag gru'i 'og tu dgos rgyu yin na'ang las kyi shugs kyis bdas pa na/ blo chen log pa'i lam la 'gro/ /mu stegs byed kyi ston pa mchog /dbang phyug smyon pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /zhes pa'i dpe ltar — /()4

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (dzadagaya' bzang pas phag mo gru pa'i steng du dmag gis tshur 'gebs lan 'ga' byas shing tshal pa rgyab phugs su yod pa dang / dpon chen rnams kyang yo bas kha mchu yang g.ya' bzang pa rgyal ba 'ga' re byung na'ang / kha mchu'i rtsa ba ma chod pas g.ya' phag bar thang du g.yul 'khrugs pas phag gru pham ste/ston pa gzhen 'od kyis 'go byas mi gces bcu gsum tsam bsad/ si tu dang mnyam du gzhen nu bzang pos 'go byas mi bco lnga tsam ma gtogs phal cher bros/ de nas dpon chen dbang phyug dpal ba'i drung du g.ya' phag gtug gsher byas pas phag gru bden pa che ba tsam byung kyang / dpon kun rdor gyis gyog byas par brten g.ya' bzang pa rgyal/ de nas mi ring bar dpon chen dbang brtson gyis dogs lum par si tu ston mo la bos thog /lab bslus kyi rnam par stag mgo gtong dgos pa'i tsha 'jun ci yang byas shing / zhag bcu dgu tsam gyi ring gung thang du (76ba)btson la 'jug pa sogs byas kyang / shes rab ldan pa mgo bskor yang / /bya ba'i cha la rmongs mi 'gyur/ /srog chags grog ma mig med kyang / /mig ldan g.yin las lhag par mgyogs/ /zhes pa ltar mkhyen rab dang snying stobs phul du byung bas/ dpon chen gyis glags ma rnyed par phyir phebs/ de nas si tu dar ma rgyal mtshan/ mnga' ris phyin gyi 'jags byed pa dang / bod chol kha gsum gyi phye gsal byed par byon dus/ 'dam dang tshong 'dus 'gur mo gnyis su gtug gsher byed ma thub kyang / mnga' ris 'khor nas yar klungs su se chen rgyal po'i 'ja' sa li ji bcu hu sogs yig ris rnams bstan pas si tu dar rgyal ba ha las/g.ya' phag gi kha mchu'i bcad mtshams legs par byas na'ang / g.ya' bzang tshul 'bum 'od kyis/e gnyal gyi dmag rnams bskul te rdog po rgyud du zhakhrugs pas phag gru rgyal te/ ma dga' dgra dgas 'go byas mi nyi shu tsam bsad kyang / g.ya' bzang pas 'bras mo'i nang du gzhon nu bzang po dpon g.yog gi steng du bkab par/ si tu dpon g.yog gis 'gab sangs 'byor te g.ya' bzang pa'i dmag rnams phyir bros/ g.ya' bzang dgon pa dang gzhis ka rnams rtsis blangs/ de nas sa skyar bla ma kun spangs pa dang / dpon chen rgyal bzang pa gnyis kyis si tu gsod/ sne'u gdong rtsis len pa'i gros —1()5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)ngan bshams pa rim gyis mched na'ang / sngar nas sa phag gnyis 'brel zab cing / khyad par si tu rang bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal pa'i drung 'khor yin pa'i stabs kyis/ dpon chen la dgra dbang mchongs byed pa'i rtsis yod skabs/ dpon chen rgyal bzang ba dbus phyogs su byon te (77na)rim gyis yang klungs su phebs/ sang g.ya' phag gnyis ga khug gsher byed rgyu'i nyin/ si tu pas ga rā zhe nu bzang pos 'gos byas blon po rnams/ sang nged dang g.ya' bzang pa gnyis khri dpon gyi mdun du gtug gsher byed rgyu yin pas/ ma nges pa'i dpon chen gyi nged bzung ba bzhin byung na nged kyi lpags pa dmar bshus byed kyi 'dug zer 'byung kyang / sne'u gdong ma gtod sogs kyi bslab ston rnams mdzad/ sang dpon chen gyis si tu bzung kyang thel rtse me la bsregs pas yi ge len rgyu ma byung / de nas dpon chen gyis sne'u gdong du bskor g.yang byas par blon po rnams kyis zhal ngo las sde srid gal che zer nas ma gtad/ de nas dpon chen gyis si tu la ko sha brgya dang sum cu rtsa lnga tsam brgyab/ zhwa rnga ma can gcig dbu la bskon pa sogs btson chas kyi rnam pas yar khrid skyi nag bar du tshal pa'i dmag gis bskyal pas kha ngan gtong ba dang 'ded drag byas/ chen po re zhig gud gyur kyang / /de la gdung ba skye mi dgos/ /zla ba re zhig gzas zin kyang / /de ma thag tu grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ nyug chos rdzong du zla ba phyed gnyis dang / ko sprel du zla gcig bzhugs de nas bo dong du dpang lag gi thog dpon chen dbang brtson 'ja' sa dang bcas mthong smon du slebs pa dang / dpon chen rgyal bzang gis si tu la dam sbrags ma byas par si tu dbus su byon/ sne'u gdong du gzhen nu bzang pos 'go byas blon po rnams la kha mchu 'di'i dbye gsal ma byung bar chos byed pa skad mi zer ba'i khas len bskor/ de nas dpon chen dbang brtson gyis khri dmag rnams bsdus te dog lung par (77ba khyung ba dang / si tus kyang rdzong rnams kyi 'dzin cha dang dpung gi bsdu sogs mdzad byang gi la khar khrom po lha btsun dpon g.yog brgya skor dang / dpon chen gyi dmag rnams thug pa lha btsun pa can lag dpangs mtho bar byung ba'i gtam snyan pa slab/ sang gzhon nu bzang pos dmag dpon byas te/ phag gru khri bskor gyi dmag rnams bteg /— 106

deb zer rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (polhum steng du dro la sleb/ der rta rnams sgugs bslangs/ bab col du spyod pa ma yin par dpa' bo dmag la chas pa stag ltar mchong pa la med mi rung gi mi bzhi'i nang gi thug dkar bas lha gsol/ g.yul rgyal bas lto bsgyur/ dus tshod rtsis dang bstun nas dpung rnams 'grims/ dpon chen gyis khri dmag mon mkhar mda' na ru bsgrigs pa'i steng du bkab nas 'khrugs pas sa skya pa'i dbus gtsang gi khri dmag mtha' dag spub/ phag gru pa'i jus rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon srid rtse'i bar du bsgreng nas/dgra mgo ru dar dang bcas pho brang chen po sne'u gdong cher lag rtags su bskur bas kun gsal sgeg mo rlung gi rgyal mtshan gyi gos gyon pa ltar rnam par bkra ba'i dar gyi lhab lhub dang grags snyan rdza rnga'i sgra chen pos nam mkha'i nor bu yang skrag nas gling bzhi bskor ba'i zol gyis rgyu bar byas so/ /sngar dpon chen rgyal bzang gis si tu bzung skabs pho brang chen por 'khra phur tshugs shing / nye lam dbang brtson gyis khri skor bcu gsum gyi dpung bshams pa btul ba sogs g.yin sde rnam par 'joms pa'i dgra thabs kyis sde srid phag mo gru pa'i bstan jus tshugs pa'i rtsa ba lta bu hor gzhon nu bzang po yin pas/ bka' chems su/ sne'u gdong dgra lag (78na chu ma shor ba byung bas nga'i srog thon/ de la brten nas sde 'di zug chags byung bas kho drin che ba yod pa'i don de yin zhing / da dung tshun bcad du nga la sngas gtod pa 'di yin pas shi gson gang byung yang nang nas bsdur dgos/ da lta'ang gzhen nu rgyal mtshan gyis 'go byas spun skya ser kun la blo thub dang / nang mi 'chel ba'i don de yin gsung la/de nas si tu rang yang dpung thog tu phebs/ gra phyi 'phyong rgyas sogs lho rgyud kyi sa cha rdzong gzhis phal cher blangs/ 'thab brtsod snga phyir byung yang gzhan dag rnams rmeg med par bcom/ de nas dpon chen dbang brtson gyis dmag bsags par bla ma dam pas bka' phebs dang / de rjes kha mchu bsdum mkhan mang du byung yang / dpon chen gzhan gyis bskyod stabs su song bas ma 'grig pa'i zir bun gyi ngang la si tus gong dkar blangs te/ de la dpon chen gyi dpung bcug par bsad bzung tshul lcebs pa sogs mang du byung nas si tu ba rgyal te/ kha rag phyin gtsang la yar gtogs lha 'brug rnams rta rmig 'og nas —1()7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheblangs/ de nas ta dben pa dang mjal te gong ma'i drung du khyed rang 'gro'am mi gtong ba gang ris 'thad gsung ba bzhin dbang phyug dang shes rab rdo rje gnyis btang ba nyes med du 'khor te khri bskor la dgos pa'i dngul gyi dam kha dang cwa hu sogs 'grub/ de nas 'bri gung sgom pa kun rdor gyis snga phyir byed spyod ma mkhas pa la brten/ phag gru dang 'bri gung pa 'gal te sde 'khrug lan mang du byung ching / khyad par 'bri gung pa/ nam grags pa/ g.ya' bzang pa gsum gyis gros bshams nas/ phag gru'i steng (78ba)du bkab par gzhen nu bzang pos 'go byas yar stod kyi dmag rogs 'bras mo bsrung ba la bzhag /si tu rang gis gtsos dbyar chen byang khar btan nas 'bri gung par jus nyes btang bas/g.ya' bzang pa yang phyir bros/ tshal pa dang / nam grags pa gnyis kyi khron pa ri dang g.yu rtsi brag la rjong rtsig pa sogs kyi byed par rten/ phag gru'i dmag rnams gsang mdar phongs thog /g.ya' bzang ba 'bum phrag 'od kyis gnyal dmag rnams khrid nas lhun po rtser sleb pa'i 'phrod byung ba dang phyir log ste 'brugs pas 'bum phrag 'od kyis 'go byas dgu brgya tsam lhun po rtse'i nang la bcur/ de rjes gnyal dmag yongs pa rnams kyang mang du bsad cing go mtshon rnams thob/ 'bum grags 'od dpon g.yog rnams kyis 'babs kha blangs/ gnyal shel mkhar sogs gzhis ka rnams su rjong dpon btang zhing zug pa btsugs/ de nas skabs shig chos rje bla ma dam pas bar mdzad nas/ si tu dang dpon chen rgyal bzang pa gong dkar du mjal 'phrad mdzad/ dpon chen gyis si tu la bzod gsol byas te mthun skabs/ nam grags kyis shangs mthong smon la brgyab pas/ dpon chen gyi rogs su phag gru'i dmag rnams chen pos 'go byas phyin par shab chu'i lho khar 'khrugs te/ nang pa'i dpung rnams bcom/ de nas phag gru'i dmag rnams sa skyar 'gro bar thag bcad kyang / dpon chen gzhan gyis mgo bskor gyi dbang du song ste dmag rnams phyir slog /de nas dpon chen sa skyar byon pas bla ma ti gri'i sras po gnyis kyis btson du bcug pas/ si tus dpung (79na)chen gtsang du bteg /zhi drag gi thabs du ma'i sgo nas dpon chen btson nas bton/ gtsang gi sa cha phal cher chab 'og tu bcug ste/ phyir 'byon — /08

deb zer rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (popa'i lam zhor du gzhis ka rin spungs rtsig pa'i zhal bkod mdzad/ de yang dus skabs 'di dag tu sa skya pa zhal ngo mang bas bla brang go bzhir gyes nas nang mi mthun pa sogs kyis bstan jus mtha' dag phag gru pa'i 'og tu shor ba ni/ sa nang grums nas phag gis sa rlog 'jig /yar klungs nang nas phyag rdor sprul pa 'byung / /zhes pa'i lung bstan gyi don dang mthun par/ gong ma ta'i si tu 'di nyid ni gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i bka'i bsdu ba po rje btsun phyag na rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum gyi med du byung ba'i zlos gar las/ chos kyi rgyal po mes dbon gsum gyis mdzad pa'i snang brnyan dri mas cung zad sbags pa bsal ba'i slad du dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i rgyal khams la stobs kyis mnga' sgyur bar gnam gyi lung gis spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar gor ma chag /de nas gong ma rgyal pos/ dar kha che sogs gser yig pa mngags te ta'i si tu'i ming dang dam kha gnang /de nas 'bri gung pas phag gru'i steng du dmag tshan cher bsags par brten/ si tus gong dkar gyi dmag rnams btang ste brag dkar phab/ de skabs sa skyar bla ma kun spangs pa bkrongs pa sogs nang 'khrug byung bas/ kha mchu lab par si tu gtsang du byon/ dpon chen rgyal bzang 'bod par btang ba khong lha rtse bka' gros la byon thog dpon chen dbang brtson dang mkhan po nam mkha' ye shes kyis dug btang yang zer/ a rag mang bas lan kyang zer/ gang ltar dpon chen grongs/(79ba)de nas si tus sa skyas gtsos pa'i che gnyan rnams kyi bcwa tshe blangs/ mjug bsdoms su sa skyar byon/ bcwa tshe'i nang dang 'gal ba byung na rtsa ra gtong ba'i khrims bsgrags/ lha khang chen mor rin cen 'od kyis 'go byas brgya skor zhig zug par bzhag /sa skya'i lo rgyus na 'di skabs rdzong chung pa gzungs kyi dpal bas si tu la mngon spyod kyi las mdzad pas mtshan ma/ khyad par can byung skad/ de nas si tu dbus su byon rjes lha rtse pa dang byang pa 'khrugs/ de la bcwa tshe dar mthun pa'i rtsa ra gtong bar chen pos gtsos pa'i dmag brdzangs pa snyi tshar sleb dus lha rtse nas dpon chen dbang brtson gyi dpung gis sa skya lha khang chen mor bskor ba thos pas dpung rnams snyi tshar nas sa skyar phyin te 'brugs pas mang du bsad/ dpon —/09

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyechen bzung / bzhi brgya skor la khrims lugs byas/ de nas ti shri kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams blo gros/ g.ya' bzang khri dpon/ tshal pa khri dpon sogs kyis gong sar/ si tus sa skya dmag gis bcom/ khri dpon gzhan rnams la mthar 'ded byas sogs kyi zhu log rim par phul bar brten/ gong ma thugs tshom pa sel ba'i ched du/ drung chen shes rab bkra shis kyis seng ge dkar mo'i pags pa sder bzhi ma nyams pas gtsos pa'i 'bul ba dang bcas gong ma'i sku gzhogs su btang bas/ gdung rabs nas gdung rabs su phan pa'i 'ja' sa dang lung bzang po grub/ de ltar 'bri tshal g.ya' bzang sa skya'i dpon chen sogs stobs sbyor dregs pas myos pa'i rgol ba'i klan ka can rnams la/ ce spyang dus men du nga ro'i skad 'byin par/ gdeng lnga'i dbang (80na)po dgra zlar mi sems pa'i ngang tshul bzhin mjad kyang / tshur 'gebs kyi byed pa dug sbrul sgong 'khyer gyi snang tshul la brten nas gzhan sde'i mnga' thang thams cad dpung shed kyis bcad nas nub phyogs chu lha'i mthar thug gi bar du bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya btsan pos gser gyi gnya' shing lta bur lci ba'i rgyal khrims kyi 'og tu bcug ste/ nyi 'og gi rgyal phran mtha' dag gis yul srol dang mthun pa'i nor gyi dbye 'bul ba sogs mdor na bsil ldan gangs kyi ri bo dar dkar kyi yol bas bres pa'i khongs su 'khod pa'i skye rgu mtha' dag gis bde ba'i rtsa rkyen gyi byed po kun nga rgyal ba'i gdong pa dmad nas gting sel gtsang bar tshang bcad/ gong dkar/ brag dkar/ sne lu 'ol kha/ stag rtse/ bsam 'grub rtse/ lhun grub rtse/rin spungs sogs dbus gtsang 'dzin ma'i lte ba'i sa mdud rnams la rdzong chen bcu gsum brtsigs/pho brang chen po sne gdong rtser rgyal sgo phyi nang gsum du byas pa'i nang mal nag chang gi khrims bsdams shing / si tu nyid chang dang phyi dro'i kha zas spong ba sogs rab byung gi tshul la gnas pas lha sde dang mi sde kun gyi spyi bo'i cod pan du nor bu dbang gi rgyal po ltar bsten/ de yang sngar dpal ldan sa skya pas bod tsam du ma zad bod chen po'i rgyal khams la mnga' sgyur na'ang / gdung brgyud zhal ngo rnams thugs 'dod kyi 'then phyogs so sor song zhig /dpon chen rnams kyang tig mi chags par spo len mang ba — //(/—

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pogong ma'i khrims kyang hor gyi shan shor ba'i hang zom sogs la brten/ thang lhod dang mtho dma' ci rigasadang / khyad par hor khrims la mi bsad na srog tshab tu srog (80ba gto me bas mtshon pa'i khrims rnams sdig pa'i las shas che bar brten/ bod chos rgyal gong ma'i lugs srol bzang po dge ba bcus gzhi bzung ba 'di nyid/ ta'i si tus gtso bor mdzad par bzhed de/ tshul de nyid sgrub par byed pa la khas zhan rnams yal bar dor zhing / dregs po rengs su bcug pa ma yin pa'i bden rdzun thang mar brdal nas/ dkar nag shan phyed pa'i khrims kyis rgyal khams rgan mo gser khur lta bur bde ba'i ched du/dpa' bo stag gi zhal lce/ sdar ma wa'i zhal lce/ sne mo las 'dzin kyi zhal lce/ zhu bzhes bden rdzun gyi 'kha lce/ bzung bkyigs khrims ra'i zhal lce/ nag can khrag bcod kyi zhal lce/ dran 'dzin chad las kyi zhal lce/ hor 'dra za rkang gi zhal lce/ bsad pa stong gi zhal lce/ mes pa khrag gi zhal lce/ smyon ham mna' dag gi zhal lte/ brkus pa 'jal gyi yis lce/ nye 'brel 'bral bzlums kyi zhal lce/ byi byabs byi rin gyi zhal lce/ nam bar tshur gyi zhal lce ste bco lnga'i sgo nas gtan la phab/ de yang mi bsrun log par 'khru ba'i dgra sde tshar bcad nas/ jus don bzhed thog tu 'byol ba'i thabs su drag po dpung gi sbyor ba bshams tshul/ tshur 'gebs la btsan po'i rdzong la 'khra 'phur byed tshul/ sne mor mngags sleb rnams kyis rnam dkar gyi las la spyod cing nye 'gyang spangs pa'i gzhung don gtso bor byed tshul/mi bsad la lan 'jal gyi gnyis phung sdig las byed du mi 'jug par stong sprod len sogs phra zhib mdzangs pa'i blos khrims kyi 'jam dar yug gcig tu brkyangs pa'i 'dzum gyis rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i mgron ring nas 'gugs par mdzad do/ /smras pa/ /'jigs bral sra brtan g.yul (81na)ngor dpa' ba'i ru mtshon rtse la dgra sde'i srog dbugs blangs pa na/ gser ldan rum dkar khyab pa'i mdangs kyis zla gzhen skrag ste byang gling ngos kyi mkha' la bros/ khrag gi rba rlabs phur ba'i 'od dmar: yis rgod ma kha ngo rgya mtsho'i 'gram du yibs/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i rdza rnga ldir bas sum rtsen bdag po 'dud par gros pa'i ca co gleng / /e ma rtsod pa'i —11/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyedus 'dir su wa rje'/ /'khor lo nam mkhar 'phags pa'i rgyal thabs kyis/ /grags snyan du kū la yi ba dan dkar/ /srid pa'i rtse mor khyab ces lha rnams sgrog /gong ma'i lung gis gtsug na zla ba'i mchog /thob pas stobs ldan 'gro skyabs gser can 'ga'/ /dpa' mdzangs seng ge'i ster mos bsad pa na/ /pad dkar mig cig gnyis pa sa 'dir snang / /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas dwags po bka' brgyud kyi phyogs su mdo phyogs kyi bshad gra'i srol med pa gsar du btod pa'i ched du chos grwa chen po rtses thang btab/ phar tshad sogs bka' po ti du ma la rig lam nas drangs pa'i bshad nyan btsugs/ de dang thel gyi sgom grwa gnyis ka la phun sum tshogs pa'i mthun rkyen sbyor ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku brnyan du ma dang / gser gyi bka' 'gyur ro cog bzheng pa/ ra sa 'phrul snang dang bsam yas kyis mtshon pa'i gnas chen khyad 'phags rnams la mchod 'bul sogs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bla na med pa bsgrubs pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi chu gter chen po dbyar mtsho ltar gyur pa'i mthus dkar nag gi las kyi 'bras bu chos thams cad rjen par 'char ba'i tshad ma'i srang la gzhal bas/ nag po'i 'bras bu cha tsam du yang ma gyur pas/ (81ba)dge legs chu zla'i 'od dkar grangs med pa spros pas mngon par mtho bas nges par legs pa'i gang bu yongs su smin pas nor 'dzin gyi bu mo mngal khyud kyis lci bar mdzad/'di nyid gshegs rjes 'jam dbyangs gu shri chen po ni dpon bsod nams bzang po'i jo mo nyi ru ma dang mang nyam gnyis las snga ma la nyid dang bdag po shāka rin pa gnyis/ phyi ma la dpon rin rdor 'khrungs pa las/ 'jam dbyangs kla bla ma klu lung grags pa la klog yig bslabs/ chos bzhi grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos slob dpon gzhon brtson la rab tu byung ba'i mtshan shākya rgyal mtshan du gsol/ gdan sar brtag gnyis dang / rtses thang du bka' po ti bzhis bshad pa mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa thob/ bu ston rin po che'i drung du rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud bshad dbang lung mang du gsan pas/ mgon po gdong gi ri man gyi yar klungs kyi zhing re'i khar dkyil 'khor — //2

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhan nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (po rigs mi 'dra ba re bzhengs kyang kheb par yod ces bu ston chos rjes zhal pho gsung / chos rje bla ma dam pa'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs te lha sar chos 'khor dang / rtses thang gi tshogs pa lo bcu gsum gyi bar du skyong bar mdzad/ mi ring bar pho brang sne'u gdong rtse'i khri thog tu phabs te hor gong ma rgyal pos/ ta'i gi tu dang chang gu'i lung / kwa din gu shri las ka dang dam kha gnang / bod chol kha gsum brgyud pa dang bcas pa shes su 'jug pa'i 'ja' sa sa spur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams na mngon par mtho/ gtsang phyogs su log par 'khu ba'i kun dkris kyis brnag pa'i sems ldan 'ga' zhig gi steng du dpung gi sbyor ba bshams dus/ chos skyong bya rog gdong can gyi nus pas dmag rnams gtsang po la thogs med du phyin/ phyir (82na)phebs nas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gtso bor bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun khri phrag mang po zhag bcu sbrel du gya nom pa'i bkur sdi mdzad nas chos 'khor btsugs/ mnga' 'bangs thams cad bde skyid kyi dpal la 'god par mdzad/dpon rin cen rdo rjes zin bkra shis skyid dang / do brag ma rin cen 'tsho gnyis khab tu bzhes pa'i snga ma la rgyal sras grags pa rin cen dang chos rje chos bzhi ba gnyis las/ chos bzhi ba chung ngu'i dus su mkhan chen seng ge rgyal mtshan gdan drangs pas/ sman bla'i pho brang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer los pa sku lus la thim pa gzigs pa'i lung bstan mdzad/ rgyal sras grags rin pa la brtag gnyis kyi lung zhus te thugs skyong dang / spyan snga grags she ba la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos pa'i mtshan grags pa byang chub tu gsol/ 'jam dbyangs gu shri chen pos gdung brgyud spel ba'i bka' gnang kyang ma bzhed par/ chos rje dpal ldan bla ma'i drung du bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ de nas gdan sa chen po'i go sar bzhugs nas zab rgyas chos kyis skal bzang gi gdul bya smin par mdzad cing / gu shri chen po'i rjes su pho brang sne'u gdong rtse'i khri thog tu byon nas bla dpon sbrags te rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa chen po yang 'di nyid kyi 'khas la gtugs nas mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa tshad med pa zhabrungs te/ mkhas dbang daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung lugs nas drangs pa'i rtogs —1/3—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)brjod dpag bsam lhun por grags pa'i legs par bshad pa'i rtsom pa gnang / spyan snga rin po che yang rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i rmad du byung ba'i mkhyen rab kyis gsung rab rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol du byon pa gzigs nas bsngags (82ba)pa rgya cher mdzad/ 'di nyid kyi gcung chos rje bsod nams grags pa do brag dpon mo la 'grungs/ mkhan chen gzhon dbang pa'i drung du rab tu byung / rtsed thang gi gdan sar phebs nas 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i skyes bzang pos mkhas pa rnams kyi yid yongs su phrogs/lha sar dge 'dun dpag tu med pa la chos 'khor bskor/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa bzhes/ pho brang chen po'i khri thog tu phebs nas phan bde'i bsil zer mnga' 'bangs kun+da'i snying la dran par mdzad/ sa skyong shākya rin cen gyis zin rin cen 'dzom zhes pa grongs tshe las dag rnams kyi snang ngor seng ge la chibs nas mkha' 'gros spyan drangs pa mthong zhing / chams la dung g.yas 'khyil byon pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par sprul pa de nyid khab tu bzhes pa'i sras mo'i dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan/ drung byang chub rdo rje/ spyan snga bsod nams bzang po/spyan snga dpal ldan bzang po/ spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ drung sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams sku bltams pa las/ mi'i dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan ni/ 'jam dbyangs chen po'i sku'i skye ba gsal bar dran zhing / mkhyen rab mchog tu yangs pas klog yig sogs ched gnyer du bslab sbyangs ma dgos par 'bad med du mkhyen/ mkhan po gzhon dbang ba'i drung du rab tu byung / spyan snga grags pa byang chub la chos khrid rnams rdzogs par gsan/ mtshan grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol/ chos grwa chen po rtses thang gi gdan sar phebs nas rig pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi grags pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel gsungs pas shin tu phra ba rtog ge'i rig pa la mngon par nga rgyal ba'i mkhas rloms srung rnams (83na)kyi spobs pa phrogs/de nas pho brang chen po'i seng ge'i khri'i dga' tshal du zhabs zung swā la chen po'i ljon pa rnam par 'god pa'i rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dri bsung ma la ya'i rlung bzhon gyis bod chen por 'khod pa'i — //4

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (peskye rgu kun gyi duḥkha'i tsha gdung gi 'jigs pa ming gi lhag mar mdzad nas/ phan pa dang bde ba'i char chen po tha gru kun tu phab/ bkra shis sgo mang gsum gyis thog drangs pa'i thugs dang sku'i rten/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dri ma med pa bod du 'gyur ba'i glegs bam mtha' dag sa le sbram gyi snying po las grub tshar gnyis/ gser dngul la 'dres ma gcig /chab lha thog dkar po la bris pa tshar gsum gyis thog drangs gsung rten mtha' yas shing / de dag kyang rgyal mkhar rtse'i sde dgon du bka' 'gyur shin tu mang ba char rtsis nas bris pa snang ba lta bu ma yin par rgyu phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du/ bod kyi yi ge mtha' dag gangs khrod pa rnams la bka' drin 'gran zla ma mchis pa thon mi saṃ bho ṭas mdzad pa'i sum rtags dang / de dag la brten nas bod kyi mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyi yi ge'i brda dag gis bstan bcos mang du snang ba rnams la brten nas sdeb kyi sbyor lugs mtha' dag la zhib mor dpyad/ rgyud 'bum sogs su legs par sbyar ba lha'i skad kyi sngags mtha' dag bya ka ra ṇa'i don khong du chud pa'i skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyis rang bzhin/ rkyen/ rnam 'gyur gsum la brten nas gtan la phab pas/ bka' 'gyur de rnams gcig tu bstan pa'i rtsa lag lta bur gyur/ gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs gser gyis bzhengs pa'i snying po can gyi 'bum ther grangs mang ba dang / 'bum ther gdung lo'i grangs lo re bzhin (83ba)bzhengs pa/ spyan snga rin po che bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis chos 'byung mig 'byed 'od stong mdzad pa'i lo sa khyi yan la lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis star chags su byung bar gsungs 'dug pas de nas kyang sa phag nas lcags phag gi bar lo bcu gsum gyi ring rgyun ma chad par mngon/ g.yin yang ris su ma chad pa'i grub pa'i mtha' tha dag la bsnyen bkur dang / yongs 'dzin rnams chos kyi gsan pa mdzad pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i rgyun 'dzin tshogs sde 'ga' zhig la bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho'i thugs dam bde gshegs bdun gyi smon lam 'bum phrag mang du bskul ba/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos srid 'di'i legs byas rnam par dkar ba'i nam mkha'i glang po yongs su 'khrigs pa las byung ba'i 'phral yun kun tu dge legs —115

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyekyi 'jug rgyun mi chad pa'i gru char gyis/ ye shes mchog gi myu gu zad mi shes pa'i zong du bskrun pa'i thabs mkhas kyi sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye ba'i kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras pos cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus khyad par can chu shel dbang po rta chen dga' ma'i khyim du rtse dgar spyod pa'i zla bar/ bod yul kyi rdo rje gdan lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du smon lam gyi dus ston khyad par can 'dzugs pa mjad pa'i mthun rkyen yang dag par bsgrubs/ ring mo nyid nas bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs po che bsags pa'i rten 'brel gyis khri thog tu phabs pa nas bzung ste/ 'jig rten kun tu mu ge yams nad sogs med cing mkho dgu'i yo byad la longs spyod pa'i 'dod rgu rmugs 'dzin gyi bang mdzod la rang dbang du spyod pa lta bur gyur/de yang 'di'i yab sa skyong chen po shākya rin cen la tho gan thi mur gyis lung gnang nas pho brang (84na)chen por khri dpon du phebs shing / tho gan thi mur gyi dus gru tha la gru rgya nag gi yul gru chen po 'ga' zhig tu khral len par btang bas/ de dang rgya'i mi dpon 'ga' zhig gros mthun te shing rta 'khor lo mang du byas pa'i 'og tu dmag dang / steng du rin po che dang gos dar gyi tshogs bzhag ste khral skyel ba ltar byas nas pho brang gi nye logs su yongs te dmag gis bskor bas/ rgyal po gsang sgo zhig la bros/ gru tha la grus mnga' 'bangs thams cad chab 'og tu bcug pa'i sras kyen 'un/ de'i sras yung lo ta ming rgyal po'i dus gser gyi dam kha dang / slar yang shel gyi dam kha/ dbang gi 'ja' sa gnang bas mtshan dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan zhes snyan pa'i rdza rnga skabs gsum pa'i lam du brdungs pas 'jig rten gyi mes po tshangs pas gnam rim pa bcu gsum gyi mthong nas rin po che'i bum pa dri bzang gi chus gang bas spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rdzong chen rnams kyi rdzong sdod so so la mi brgyud dang bcas par 'ja' sa'i shel dam gnang / mchog dman gyi skye rgu mtha' dag gong ma chos rgyal chen po zhes gleng zhing / nyang stod shar kha ba rgyal rtse rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pas gong ma 'di gnyis kyi gzims dpon gyis las ka bzung zhing / sde srid 'di nyid kyi bka' drin las mnga' thang che bar yod kyang /— //6

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhan nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (secung zad byed ma mkhas pas gong ma'i thugs la phog ste/ nyang stod du dpung gi 'jug sgo lan gnyis tsam mdzad pas/ yar klungs pa rnams dgra nyang stod shar kha ba zer ba'i skabs byung zhid / 'on kyang dran 'dzin tsam las rgyal mkhar rtse rtsis len pa sogs ma mdzad/ de tsam ma gtogs dbus gtsang mtha' dag bde 'jags las/ dpung gi 'jug sgo sogs sdig pa'i las kyi sbyor ba la mi re bar chos ldan (84ba)rgyal po'i khrims nyin byed dbang po shar ba na/ mi bsrun pa'i skye bo zhe sdang gi 'dab ma rnam par rgyas pa'i ku mu ta'i tshal mtha' dag rang shugs kyis zum par gyur to/ /gong ma 'di'i dus dpa' mdzangs rtu pa phod pa'i rgyal po'i bya ba la mkhas pa'i blon po rin spungs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan rin spungs kya rdzong dpon dang / sa skya'i lha khang chen ma'i dpon chen gyi khrir bskos/'phyeng rgyas pa hor dpal 'byor bzang por bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon dang dmag dpon gyi las ka gnang / gzhan yang sne'u pa nam mkha' bzang po/ brag dkar pa rin cen dpal rnams grags che/rigs rus yon tan mnga' thang sogs lugs gnyis kyi go rim dang mthun pa'i drung 'khor shin tu mang zhing / de dag kyang chen po'i las tshan gyi sgo dang bstun pa'i rgyan gos kyi rim pa dang / khyad par gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i dga' ston dus rin cen rgyan char grags pa'i bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyan sprod dang / rgyun mar yang rin po che'i phra tshoms kyis rnam par mdzes pa'i muk+ta rta ka rna ba'i rgyan du spud pa sogs mdzad la/ mdor na lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pa bzang po g.yin dag lta ci smos/ gnas skabs kyi spyod lam yang ya rabs bzang po che btsun gyi ngang tshul las/ lung ma bstan gyi zhwa gos gyon pa/ sgrigs kun spyod kyi srang la bcur ba med pa'i yid la shar tshad lag tu mi len pa'i mig stos mchog tu bzang / chos rje bsod grags pas/ chas rgyal chen po 'di nyid kyi blon po'i khrod du brag dkar pa shes rab bkra shis 'dren pa ni/ sher bkras pas gong ma ta'i si tu'i skabs hor rgyal po'i drung du 'ja' sa zhu bar byon pa'i dus dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa bdun gyi khar sleb cing / si tu rin po che nas gong ma 'di'i ring la gdan rabs kyang 'ga' zhig song bas/ rlung chen (85na thar bkras pa —117

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)'ong ba'i don med cing / rin spungs nam mkha' rgyal po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi sras yin kyang /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi sngon la 'dren pa sogs dmus long gcig pur rgyu ba lta bur kun dang mi mthun pa'i gtam mang ngo / /smras pa/ phul byung bsod nams shing rtas legs drangs pas/ /dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan 'bar ba'i gzis/ /sde gsum cig car gsal ba'i grags pa'i gzugs/ /rlung gi rgyal mtshan lta bur tshar du dngar/ /tha gu'i lto can 'jug pa bcu pa'i sgyus/ /kun las rnam par rgyal la mtshar du ci/ /g.yo med drang po'i tshul gyis lhar bcas 'gro'i/ /gtsug na zhabs sen u dum wā ra 'dzum/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gcung sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis rin spungs nas bdag mo zhig khab tu bzhes par grags pa 'byung gnas dang / kun dga' legs gnyis 'khrungs/ grags pa 'byung gnas sku na phra mo nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas la mkhas par sbyangs/ khyad par rdo rje theg pa la thugs rab kyi rtsal shin tu che bas/ mkhas pa'i dbang po 'gos lo ye bzang rtse pa'i zhal nas/ de rjes mi'i dbang po grags pa 'byung gnas pa thugs rab shin tu che zhing gsang sngags kyi mkhyen pa shin tu rgyas par gyur kyang / gdan sa'i bzhugs khri rin po che shin tu gnyan par dgongs nas gdan sar ma bzhugs kyang / gnas chen du 'gro ba'i ri pa rnams la mgyogs khrid gsungs zhes deb sngon du gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de yang chos rgyal chen po gshegs rjes/ 'di nyid sku na phra bas pho brang chen po'i khrir yab sras gnyis su bsko la bka' blon rnams gros ma mthun par spyan snga rin po che bsod nams rgyal mtshan (85bskor zhus pas/ sras bsko bar bka' gnang ba bzhin mdzad kyang spyan snga gshegs rjes/ yab kyis khri thog yong ba'i ched du gnang sgo ma legs par brten/ yar klungs su sde gzang langs te yab che sa dpon blon yar rgyab tu 'byon dgos byung / de nas gong ma dbus kyi gzhis bskor la phebs skabs sne'u rdzong du mkhas grub chos rje dge legs dpal bzang dang gsang ne'u thog — 118

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (7gi chos rje rnam gnyis/ drung chen slob dpon sogs mjal bar phebs/ gong ma'i sku gzhogs su bzhugs gral gyi thog /gsung rab kyi 'brel gtam mdzad khar mkhas grub chos rje dang gsang phu'i chen po rnams sgo so nas bshad pa mdzad rgyu 'ong du re yang / gong ma'i zhabs phyir 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal ba yong bas khong gi rtses thang pa'i brtul zhugs kyi thog mar gzhung len pa mdzad skad/ de nas 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po kyen tha'i yis dbang gi 'ja' sa gnang ba nas bzung / dbang grags pa 'byung gnas su grags/ thel dang rtses thang gnyis su gdan sa zur du med na'ang / gsung chos 'gangs che ba rnams rtse nas gnang zhing / zur 'chad slob dpon rnams la bka'i 'khor los khyab pa dang / gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzheng ba sogs lugs zung gi mdzad pa mtha' dag gong man rim gyi srol bzang po ma nyams par bzung / yar rgyab nas che sa rtses thang du gdan drangs/ zhal ngo nang mtshams kyi 'khon zhi nas thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ byang phyogs kyi bso kha bsrung bar 'u yug gling dkar gyi rdzong brtsigs/ rin spungs nor bu bzang po/ 'phyong rgyas pa hor dkon cog rin cen ni chos rgyal chen po'i zhabs la gtugs kyang gong ma 'di'i dus su khrims kyi kha lo sgyur ba'i blon po mdzad/ gcung kun dga' legs pas gsung rab la sbyangs pa ma smad pa mdzad de/ (86na)rtses thang gi gdan sar phebs/ rin spungs nas bdag mo khab tu bzhes par sras rin cen rdo rje dbang gi rgyal po 'byungs/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen hang rgyal pos dbang gi 'ja' sa gnang / 'di nyid rtogs pa'i yon tan phul du byung ba'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po zhig yin par 'dug na'ang gnas skabs su skye bo rnams kyi snang ngor mdzad sgo legs rgyu med tsam yang 'dug par dpags/ gtsang gi gzhis bskor la phebs dus rin spungs nor bzang pas gus 'dud bla na med pa mdzad kyang gnang sgo'i khog la ma mgu skad/ de nas gong ma ka bzhi ba sku mched kyis gang zhus la gsan pas/ yab yum nang mtshams su sel chen po zhugs te/ yar gong bya bsam sdo pa sogs bdag mo phyogs dang / sne'u 'ol dga' rnams gong ma'i phyogs su chad nas dus mi bde ba mang du byung / 'on kyang 'phyong rgyas pa rdo rje tshe brtan —119

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyephan tshun gnyis ma'i phyogs su ma lhungs pas sde gzar bzlums shing / zhal ngo nang mtshams kyi legs spel mdzad pas sde srid kyi zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba byung / de nas yum gshegs rjes rin spungs pa mtsho skyes rdo rjes mkhar thog bzung / de yang deb ther sngon po las/ de rjes bdag po kun dga' legs pa dang / che sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan bka' bgros mdzad de/ shing pho khyi'i lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu la chos kyi rje rin po che dpal ngag gi dbang po dgung lo bcu drug bzhes pa zhig rin po che'i gdan seng ge'i khri la bzhugs su gsol che'i gagasungs pa ltar/ bar skabs su brel gyi gdan sa stongs na'ang / slar spyan snga ngag gi dbang po 'di nyid bzhugs pa yin la/ 'di'i yab/ la la dag tshes lnga rin po che grags pa 'byung gnas yin par 'chad/ 'ga' zhig tshes lnga rin po che sku (86ba'u'i stod smad mtha' dag tu rab tu byung ba yin pas/ ma yin par smra ba yang yod la/ 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i phur pa'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mdzad byang du/ jo sras kun bzang rol pa'i rdo rje zhes gsung ba la dpags na yab yin nam snyam/ gang ltar shes ldan rnams kyis dpyad par bya'o/ /de yang spyan snga ngag gi dbang po gzhon nu nas dpal ye bzang rtse pa sogs yongs 'dzin du ma bsten nas gsung rab la thos bsam bsgom pa mang du mdzad/ bstan pa la zhugs te yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa mnos te gdan sa chen po'i spyan sngar phebs/ bar skabs su gong ma'i gnang bkod la brten nang mtshams su mi mthun pa byung yang / slar rim pas 'jags skabs/ rin spungs don yod rdo rjes gtsang dpung rnams dbus su bcug ste gzhis ka sne'u ba'i lag nas rdzong gzhis 'ga' zheg blangs/ de nas spyan snga rin po che/ rin spungs mtsho skyes pa dang don yod rdo rje gnyis/ 'phyong rgyas pa hor tshe dbang rnam rgyal dang / hor rin cen rgyal mchog sku mched kyis gtsos pa'i sne'u ba dpal 'byor rgyal po/ lar rgyab pa rin cen rgyal po/ byang pa bkra shis dar rgyas sogs blon po rnams kyis gros thog nas pho brang chen por spyir spyan drangs/ mi ring bar zhal ngo gong ma rnams gshegs pas lha rigs rlangs kyi gdung 'dzin pa spyan snga nyid ma gtogs med par brten/ ji ltar grong khyer ser skya'i mi gtsang lud/ /— 12(/

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (0de ni bu ram shing pa'i zhing la phan/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud/ /de ni sangs rgyas chos rnams bskyed la phan/ /zhes pa'i don ltar/ bod kha ba can 'dir kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che dang / skye rgu rnams kyi phan bde ni gnam bskos kyi rgyal po phag mo gru pa'i sde srid la rag lus pas/ gong du smos pa'i blon po (87na skoms kyis gong ma spyan snga rin po cher nan gyis zhus te/ rdzong kha pa'i sras mo zhig bdag mor phul/ yab mes kyi lu sa/sa srol bzang po rnams dkar phyogs kyi zla tshes lta bur ches cher gsal bar mdzad/sras ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa sku bltams nas ring por ma lon par spyan snga zhi bar gshegs khar sras sku na ha cang phra bas de la thugs chags pa'i tshul gyis sku ngal ba chen por gyur skabs/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pas gdung brgyud rin po che nar ma son pa'i ring khong rang gis thel gyi spyan snga'i khur bzhes dang / thel rtses thang gi chen po gros dbang po blon po rnams dang bcas par gnang bkod bka' nan sogs kyis khyab pa'i sde srid kyi lar rgya mi 'phyug pa'i zhal len mdzad/ de yang dpon tshab thel gtong byed par rin spungs mtsho skyes rdo rjes/ blon po gzhan rnams la gros med par 'ga' zhig 'dod pa ltar mdzad pas/ sde dpon gzhan rnams ma 'dod pa'i dbang gis sde gzar langs/ 'on kyang 'phyong rgyas nas sde srid kyi lar rgya la dgongs te thugs khog che bar mdzad pas yo 'khyoms cher ma byung / de nas 'jam dbyangs gong mas spyan snga rin po cher dbang gi 'ja' sa gnang yang spyan snga zhing brjes pas gnang sbyin rnams phyag mdzod du bzhag nas gser yig pa phyir log /de rjes rin spungs pa dang 'phyong rgyas pa gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i blon po rnams bka' bgros thog nas gdung brgyud rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa pho brang chen po'i khri thog tu spyan drangs/ gzhen nu'i dus nyid nas rol rtsed sogs skye bo phal pa dag gi spyod yul las rnam par 'das pas 'jig rten mes po rnams kyis kyang blos 'byud par dga' zhing / chos dang srid kyi yon tan ma lus cig car du shong (87ba)pa'i za ma tog lto ba rab tu yangs pa/ chen po'i rnam par thar pa'i kha rgyan gyis mdzes —12/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po nyin mor byed pa la skyengs pa ster bas rigs stobs su ma zad/ blo stobs kyis kyang bod chen po'i rgyal khams su 'khod pa'i gong ma'i mdun na 'don blo can shel gyi me long lta bu rnams kyang zil gyis gnon pa'i bka' khrims bzang pos bod 'bangs thams cad bde ba nas bde bar spyod pa'i bde skyid kyi glu dbyangs snyan pos dri za'i rgyal po gan dha lha kha ba rir gnas sam snyam du skabs gsum pa rnams la 'phyang mo ster bar byed do/ /'on kyang 'di nyid kyi dus/ grags khrung ming can sne yi gdong po 'dzin/ /bdud sprul mi dgus phag tshang yos ltar rjod/ /ces pa'i lung bstan ltar/ rin spungs ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis e gnyal gyi phyogs su dmag gi dpung khyer byed pa sogs gong ma'i dgongs par phog pa mdzad par brten/ zhwa dmar ba bzhi pas/ phag mo gru pa'i sde srid 'di/spyir rgyal khams yongs/ sgos sdod pon rnams/ yang sgos khyed ni rin spungs pa la gce pas dgongasabasams mdzad dgos tshul gsungs kyang bzhed pa zhig ma byung / de yang lung bstan du grags 'byung zhes pa ni gong ma grags 'byung ba'i skabs dus mi bde ba 'ga' zhig byung bas 'go zin pa la dgongs kyi/ dngos gzhi gong ma 'di'i dus so/ /de skabs 'jam dbyangs gong mas dbang gi mtshan dang 'ja' sa gnang / zhabs drung gong ma chen po dpal ngag gi dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa mtshan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba kwa ldan gu shri ho wang gi mtshan gyi zlos gar srid pa gsum gyi me long gi ngos su gsal bar shar ro/ /mi ring bar rin spungs pas me tog mda' can gyi las dang tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i sdig sems kyis (88na)sde gzar bslangs pas/ lha ma yin lha'i mnga' thang la phrag dog gi bsam pas g.yul bkye ba na legs bris pa rnams kyi bsod nams kyi mthus lha min mtha' dag ming gi lhag mar 'gyur ba de bzhin du sde srid mtshan jus rgyal/ 'on kyang zhwa dmar chos grags pas bar mdzad nas lo gsum gyi chings bsdams na'ang / rin spungs pas slar sde gzar bslangs te rgyal mkhar rtser bteg skabs/ 'phyong rgyas pa rin cen rgyal mchog gis gtsos gong ma'i dpung chen rnams nyang stod bar du — 122

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (7byon/ dga' ldan pa dmag dpon bsod nams rgyal pos skyid 'phan gyi dpung rnams khrid de shangs kyi bar du bteg pas ri la spyi bos brdung ba'i rnam thar 'dzin pa cher rlom gyi dregs ldan gzhis ka rin spungs pa 'bangs gyen 'o1ga gi rgyu mi zad pa bsags pa'i 'bras bu dus gcig tu smin pas ci bya gtol med du gyur na'ang / rgyal rtse dang pa snam pa'i sa cha bshor ba rnams phyir sprod pa dang / gong sar dgongs bsangs/ rdzong dpon gyi las ka zhu ba/ phyin chad ma rungs pa'i sems 'dor ba sogs kyi dan kha las mtha' med du gtong ba ma mdzad/ de lta na'ang dus kyi bskal pas 'gro ba'i bsod nams mthu dman zhing / nag po'i phyogs kyis yid bsgyur ba bdud kyi las 'grub pa'i 'bras bu'i shugs gang gis kyang dgag dka' bar brten/ rin spungs pa dpon blon gyis sde gzar tshan che bar bslangs kyang / sde srid kyi mtshan jus la skyon ma byung / gong ma 'di nyid kyis bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi snying po gser zhun ma'i khu bas bris pa'i bka' 'gyur dang / stong 'khrun mdzangs ma'i sor mo'i 'du byed las bskrun pa'i gan gos kha dog sna tshogs las grub pa'i sku brnyan bzheng ba phyogs lhung gi bsam pas ris su mi gcod par/ (88bsko ston pa bu ram shing pa'i rjes su zhugs pa'i grub pa'i mtha' thams cad la bsnyen bkur dang mgo 'dren/ jo shākya rnam gnyis dang byang chub chen pos thog drangs pa'i gangs khrod kyi sku gsung thugs rten khyad 'phags rnams kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin mngon par spro ba dang / rje btsun phyag na pad+ma bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / dpal 'brug pa'i ring lugs pad+ma dkar po rnams ti shir bsten/ mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang phyug mtha' dag 'bad med du 'grub pa'i rgyu dge ba bcu la rdzogs par longs spyod pa dang ldan pa'i me tog gzhon nu gsar du dgod pa'i 'khri shing nam mkha'i mtha' klas par 'khyud pa'i khor yug dang po bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po mchog gi go 'phang srid pa'i rtse mor bsnyeg pa'i them skas su 'dzugs par mdzad/ 'di nyid kyi dus rin spungs pa dang dpon blon nang mtshams su sel che bar byung yang /phyi rgya'i blon chen gyi gral du rin spungs ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ sras don grub tshe brtan rdo rje rnam gnyis/—123

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)'phyong rgyas pa hor rin cen rgyal mchog sku mched/ sras hor bsod nams mgon po mched gsum/de'i sras hor bsod nams dar rgyas rnams rim pa bzhin dang / brag dkar 'jam dpal tshe ring rgyal po/ yar rgyab rin cen bkra shis/ dga' ldan pa bsod nams rgyal po/ bya nor bu bkra shis sogs blon po dang / drung 'khor 'gangs che ba shin tu mang / gong ma 'di nyid la rin spungs kyi sras mo zhig khab tu bzhes par sras gong ma 'gro ba'i mgon po dang / spyan snga grags 'byung ba gnyis las/ gong ma 'gro ba'i mgon po gong dkar du phebs/ dpon sa 'phyong rtse'i drung khab (89na chu bzhes pa'i sras zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa sku bltams/ 'gro ba'i mgon po gshegs pa'i gdung rten rin po che'i phra tshoms kyis spras pa pho brang gong ri dkar por bzhengs/ spyan snga grags 'byung ba thel gyi gdan sar phebs/ 'bras mi bde ba'i dbang gis zab bzhes thugs dam gyi rim pa gtso bor mdzad/ khyad par gshed skor dang ma mgon bya rog gdong can la rtsal du thon pas sde pa 'os kha ba phun tshogs rab brtan pas thel gye mchod gzhis sogs la log bsgrub mang du mdzad par mngon spyod kyi las sbyor gnang bas/ dus de skabs der thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho 'ol kha rtser bzhugs yod pa mtshan ltas 'gyur te rgyal du phebs/ mi ring bar sde pa sku rbab la shor ba'i rkyen gyis grongs/ thel pa rnams lhungs pa'i tshe bar snang khams nas bya rog zhig gis phyag bcad nas khyer song ba yin zer ba'i thel gyi mgon khang na da lta lag pa zhig ston rgyu yod skad/ zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa gong dkar na bzhugs skabs/ rtser yum mi gcig pa'i sku mched yod par brten/ dpon sa 'phyong rtse mas gnang bkod ma legs pa'i zer bun bslangs te/ rin spungs pa dang dga' ldan pa sogs zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa'i zhabs tog tu rtser dpung gi sbyor ba bshams/ hor bsod nams dar rgyas sogs blon po gzhan rnams dpung khyer gyi phyogs lhung mngon tshan can med na'ang / gong ma chen pos bkra shis rtse bar nang blon bcol bar ma rangs pa'i bar zhugs khog nas rtser dpung gis bskor ma dgos pa'i ngos/ gong ma 'on rgyal bzang du phebs bcug nas/ zhabs (89ba)drung ngag dbang grags pa rtse'i — 124

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pekhri thog tu gdan drangs/ 'on kyang 'brug pa sprul sku pad+ma dkar pos sdod pon rnams la rgyu mtshan gnang yang zer/ gang ltar 'gyangs med du gong ma phyir rtser phebs/ zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa gong dkar du bzhugs pa la yang bskor rgyag cha grul che ba 'byung skabs gong dkar 'di dbus gtsang gnyis kyis mdud 'dzom pa'i lte ba lta bur 'dug pas rang re'i mi ngo zhig gis ma bzung na bod kyi bde skyid la gnod pas rdzong gtod mi dgos tshul gyi gong ma'i bka' shog gong dkar du gnang ba bskor mi rnams kyi lag tu brgyab pas dmag rnams gyes te bde 'jags che ba byung / zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa 'di nyid kyis lugs zung gi mdzad pa mtha' yas shing / lhag par dge 'brug gnyis la thugs mos che bas dam pa'i chos kyi gsan pa mang du mdzad/ sger du thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dang mchod yon nyi zla zung gcig lta bur thugs snang dag pa byung bas gong dkar 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i pho brang nas rten 'bul gyi rgyun 'dzugs pa gnang / gong ma chen po'i sras zur pa sogs kyis sne'u gdong rtse'i khrir bzhugs shing / bdud mi spun dgus dbus gtsang lan mang du dkrugs pa'i sri ngan langs te/ byi glang sde gzar gyi skabs 'pho 'gyur shin tu che ba byung /'khas drung ngag dbang grags pa la sras bka' brgyud rnam par rgyal ba dang / rnam rgyal grags pa gnyis 'khrungs par gcung yar rgyab nas bdag mo byon skabs rigs 'dzin chen po'i rgyal sras pad+ma chos rgyal dang / lha rtse ba gnyis kyis srung 'khor mdzad dus/ rgyal sras pas thun brab sogs tsham rngam ha cang che (90na thas bdag mo 'dzangs te 'byon ma nus par bgegs skrod kyi mtshams cung zad bzhag pas rten 'brel 'phyugs nas ma 'gyangs par zhabs drung rnam rgyal grags pa sku blta shegs/ gcen bka' brgyud rnam par rgyal ba lugs zung gi mkhyen sgo yangs shing khyad par phyag rgya chen po sogs nges don gyi skor la thags gzhol/ 'di nyid kyis sras mi pham bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rnam rgyal dpal bzang da lta pho brang sne'u gdong rtser bzhugs skabs so/ /smras pa/ med byung rlangs kyi gser skyogs kyis bcus lha rigs bdud rtsi'i zil dngar can/ /—125

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyematho ris yon tan bdun gyi mnga' 'byor yul dbus sman ljongs yol go'i nang / /'phyur bur gtam pa'i rin cen gdung brgyud chos srid bla na dngar ba'i ro/ /gangs can ljongs 'di'i skye rgu me zhal yongs kyi dga' ston e ma mtshang/ /skye bas thob pa'i rigs gzugs chu nang zla'i/ /sdogasum gcig tu dkar ba'i bsil zer gyis/ /nam mkha'i ri bong can de pham mo zhes/ /chu 'dzin lang long 'khrigs pas sgrib snyam byed/ /gnam bskos rgyal srid swa la'i sdong po la/ /las gas mngon mtho'i stobs ldan yal ga'i tshogs/ /srid 'byor lo ma'i phang phung g.yo bzhin du/ /legs byas 'bras bu'i 'dod 'jo dpyid du dar/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /rin spungs pa'i skor/de ltar gong ma sde srid kyi bka' khrims kyi shing rta chen po'i kha lo ba rnams las/ rin spungs pa ni/ sngon bod rje sha khri btsan po'i dus ma sangs la khar khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig byung bar sger dpal legs 'od nas bzung / phyi sger/ na〉 sger/ grub thob kyi sger (90ba)dang gsum las/ rim bzhin mi rabs nyer lnga pa na nang sger ral pa 'dzin gyis gru gu'i yul nas gzings bdun gyis rin po che g.yu'i zong drangs/ khrag gi lus la mgo lnga pa 'brug gi skad 'byin pa zhig rig sngags kyis btul pas nus mthu che bar grags shing phyag na pad+ma mi rje'i tshul bzung ba srong btsan sgam po'i nang blon mdzad/ de nyid kyi brgyud las blo gros kyi rtsal ldan zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi chos blon du gyur pa nas bzung mi rabs nyi shu'i mthar/ sger shākya 'bum gyi sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis gong ma sde srid dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'khas la gtugs gzhis ka rin spungs kyi rdzong dpon/ chu mig gi khri dpon dpal ldan sa sku'i lha khang chen mo'i dpon chen du bskos/de'i sras nam mkha' rgyal po na chod phra mo nas lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen pa'i spyan mchog tu yangs/ de'i — /26

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhan nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (posras nor bu bzang bos gong ma'i zhabs la gtugs shing / yab mes dus kyi rdzong sdod khri dpon rnams kyi 'ja' sa gnang / dpung gi sbyor bas rta g.yag gi rdzong dang / lcags thag mgo sbrel du grags pa'i rgyal phran mang po'i mnga' 'bangs rnams blangs/ nyang smad bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon mdzad/gter ston kun skyong gling pas/ bstan ma gsol zhing rje yi mgur lha mchod/ /mi rabs bcu gsum bar du mi rabs brtan/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan bzang po mdzad/ de nas rong byams chen gyi chos sde btab/dge 'dun rnams la dbyar dgun dpyid chos kyi phogs sogs mthun rkyen gyi noms pa sbyar/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang du bzhengs par paṇa chen nags kyi rin cen gyis me tog (91na gtor/ brag dmar chos sde rnying pa'i 'dabs su spyil po brgya lhag tsam brtsigs te thos bsam sgom pa tshul bzhin du byed pa'i 'dus gra btsugs/ mdor na ris med pa'i grub pa'i mtha' thams cad la bsnyen bkur bla na med pa mdzad pas mngon par mtho/ chos rje bsod grags pas/ chos rje ngor chen pas rin spungs nor bzang pa la/ rje dge 'dun grub kyis dgon pa 'debs pa 'gog dgos tshul gsungs pa ni ngag rgyun ma dag pa'i 'chal gtam zhig bris par snang ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyis bkra shis lhun po 'debs skabs/ bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon 'phyong rgyas pa hor dpal 'byor bzang po yin zhing / 'di nyid kyis rje dge 'dun grub kyi sbyin bdag gi mthil mdzad par ming tsam gyi mkhas pa ma yin pa'i grags pa don dang mthun pa'i paṇa chen byams pa gling pa bsod nams rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa'i yar rgyab kyi gdung rabs na gsal bar gsungs so/ /rin spungs nor bzang pa'i sras u pa si ka /kun bzang pa/ don grub rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ shākya rgyal mtshan dang lnga las/ dpon chung ngu nas grongs /kun bzang pas dbang grags pa 'byung gnas sku mched kyi thebs la gtugs/ yab mes kyi 'ja' sa las ka gnang ste rin spungs kyi rdzong dpon mdzad/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rang lugs pa kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel dang go rams bsod nams seng ge dang mchod yon du 'brel te 'bras yul skyed mos tshal gyi bshad grwa btsugs shing / rta nag thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi dgon pa 'debs —127

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyepa'i mthun rkyen mdzad/ don grub rdo rjes gzhis ka (91ba)bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon gyi las ka bzung / ma sangs mtsho skyes rdo rjes yar klungs mkhar thog gi rdzong bzung zhing spyan snga dpal ngag gi dbang phyug gshegs rjes gdung brgyud sku na ches phra bas/ pho brang sne'u gdong rtser dpon tshab kyi thel gtong mdzad/ shākya rgyal mtshan gyis nyang khog gi rdzong gzhis su bzhugs nas bdag po rgyal mkhar rtse pa gtser ba sogs dgra thabs kyi bya ba la mkhas par grags/ kun bzang pa la sras rdo rje tshe brtan dang / don yod rdo rje gnyis las/ don yod rdo rjes rdzong chen gnyis kyi las kas mtho ba dang bcas dbus phyogs nor 'dzin gyi char dpung gi 'jug sgos gzhis ka brag dkar dang chu shul lhun po rtse sogs snel pa'i lag nas blangs/ mi ring bar 'phyong rgyas pa sogs blon po gzhan rnams dang gros khog bstun pa'i spyan snga ngag gi dbang phyug pho brang sne'u gdong rtse'i khrir mnga' gsol ba'i byed po mdzad/ la stod dang lho rgyud phyogs su dmag lan kha yar mdzad pa rnams rgyal zhing / de rjes spyan snga gong ma sku gshegs/gdung brgyud rin po che nar ma son pa'i bar du bag yangs pa dang / khyad par lta grub kyi kun slong drag po snying la gzer ba'i 'gro ba'i 'dren par rlom pa me tog mda' can gyi zhags pas bcings pa 'ga' zhig gis yid rnam par bskyod pa la brten nas skyid shod phyogs su dpung 'jug byas par gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug kun mkhyen smon lam dpal bas mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor chen gyi las sbyor mdzad par brten/ dmag lan gnyis rkyen gzhan gyi dbang gis phyir bzlog dgos pa byung / slar kun (92na/mkhyen smon lam dpal ba sku gshegs pa'i gtam byung rjes dmag gi 'jug sgo byas pa dang / dga' ldan pa nam mkha' rgyal po ngo bltas pa sogs kyis sde gzar chabs su brgyugs te gzhis ka sne'u rtsis len pa sogs mdzad 'on kyang gong ma chen po sne'u gdong rtse'i khri thog tu gdan 'dren par blon po gzhan rnams kyi grogs su 'gyur ba'i mdzad pas ngo tsha khrel yod kyi gos dang ldan/ zhwa dmar chos kyi grags pa dang mchod yon bka' bgros nas yangs pa can gyi gtsug lag khang sde dang bcas pa 'dzugs pa'i mthun rkyen mdzad/— /28

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhan nu'i dga' ston nga phying kyi rgya'i/ mo'i glu dbyangs/ (porje drung chos grags rgya mtsho'i ba ched pa ltar lha ldan nye 'dabs su dgon pa btab na'ang / las 'bras kyi shugs 'di gang gis kyang dgag par ma nus pas yun du ma gnas/ mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sras ngag dbang rnam rgyal gong ma spyan snga'i zhabs la gtugs nas rdzong dpon gyi las ka blangs/ rig gnas chung ba lnga dang / sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs la blo gros kyi 'jug pa gsal bar shar/ e gnyal gyi phyogs su dmag gi mdzad sgo sogs la brten/ gong ma chen po'i thugs la phog par rje 'bangs go rim ma log pa'i dgongs bsangs khengs dregs kyi dbang gis ma mdzad par brten/ dbus phyogs kyi sne'u sogs rdzong gzhis rnams shor te mnga' thang cung zad nyams/ 'on kyang gtsang phyogs su seng ge rtse pa dang / la stod lho sogs 'og tu bcug /byams chen gyis gtsos pa'i gtsang rong gi chos sde rnams la 'tsho rkyen sogs dge rgyun bzang po sbyar/ rin spungs nyid du pho brang chen po'i mig ltos kyis gsang ba sngags kyi dus rim gyi srol btsugs/ de nyid la sras gsum (92ba tshe pas/ che ba chung ngu nas grongs/de 'og don grub tshe brtan rdo rjes sngar yab mes kyi dus ma lon pa'i pa snams lhun grub rtse'i rdzong mnga' 'bangs dang bcas pa rang dbang du byas/ rje drung mi bskyod rdo rje'i gsung bzhin gsung rab gling gi dgon pa btab/ bkra shis dpal bzang bla mar bsten nas theg pa'i rtse mo nyams su blangs/ gcung ngag dbang 'jigs grags mkhyen rab kyi klong rnam par yangs pas rig pa'i gnas che ba lnga dang chung ba lnga ste bcu phrag gcig la slob dpon mkhas pa bsten nas/ rgyal po paṇ+ḍita'i rnam thar bzung / hor gos bzang po'i rgyu las grub pa'i rigs ldan yol bar grags pa'i bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa de nyid bzhengs/ rje kun dga' grol mchog pa rab gnas su spyan drangs/ daṇ+ḍi'i dgongs rgyan 'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ros thog drangs pa'i tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i bstan bcos kyi rtsom pa mang du mdzad/ lugs gnyis la rnam dpyod kyi sgo 'phar mchog tu yangs/ 'on kyang phag tshang yos ltar dkrug pa'i lung bstan thog tu bab pa'i mtshan rtags kyis zhing gshag pas 'bangs gyen log byas skabs sras pad+ma dkar po bkrongs pa'i gtam byung ba/ rin cen spungs par dmag 'brug dar ba 'byung /—/29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyezhes pa'i dus su mngon/ sku tshe'i mjug tu mnga' thang phal cher shor/ sras zla ba bzang po'i brgyud deng sang yang snang ngo / /gong ma'i blon po hor gzhan nu bzang po ni/ za hor gyi rgyal rigs te grong khyer shing thabs can na rgyal po shing rta bcu pa zhes bya ba byung ba'i sras chos rgyal mya ngan med ces bya ba bden tshig gi mthus mchod rten bye ba bzhings pa/ de'i sras (93na)rgyal po dza zhes pa smon lam gyi mthus rdo rje sems dpa'i glegs bam gyi char pho brang gi steng du bab pas mdo sde za ma tog rlung gis khyer te pho brang yum bu bla sgang gi steng du babs pa lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi gnyan po gsang bar btags la/ de'i sras za hor rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti sngags la mos pas/ po ti gnyis phyag na rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyis rnyed kyang brda ma 'phrod pas grub thob ku ku rā dza spyan drangs te smin par mdzad/de la sras mo go ma da wa dang / sras sha kra gnyis kyis rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa grub cing / de'i sras rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin bya ba slob dpon chen po'i zab mo'i chos dang lung gis dbugs dbyung ba/de la sras dharma rā dza/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ lha lcam man dha ra ba gsum las/ bar pa gnas lnga rig pa'i pha rol du byon zhing / gangs can bstan pa'i rtsa lag mdzad/ phyi ma ye shes mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso bo gyur/ dang pos rgyal srid bskyangs pa'i dharmā pā la/ shākya de wa/ ma hā de wa gsum byung la/ de yang gangs can gyi ljongs su mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyis dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang bzheng ba'i srung mar/ slob dpon chen pos klu zur phud lnga pa la bka' bsgos pas/ nged kyis mi 'ongs/za hor gyi yul na dmu'i rigs la klu'i tsha bo rgyal po hu zhes bya ba nor rgya khab tsam gyi rjes la bya rgod po'i nyin lam bco brgyad 'gro ba zhig yod pas de bsko bar zhus pas/ rnam sras seng sngon can rta bdag brgyad dang bcas pa bkug nas gzugs brnyan bris pa'i ru dar la bstims nas/ khams kyi g.yer ma thang du dmag sgar btab/ slob dpon (93ba)chen pos ting nge 'dzin gyis pe dkar bkug nas lan cig bod du yongs kyang ha cang gdug rtsub che bar byung zhing / slar mkhan slob chos gsum gyis — 130

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (poza hor du pho nya mngags nas/ rgyal po dharma pā la/ g.yu'i thub pa rang byon/ zhal brnyan bse 'bag /chibs shel gyi seng ge dang bcas te sna drangs pe dkar yang rin po ches spras pa'i shing bya la zhon nas lha mi rnams bod du byon/slob dpon chen pos spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste dam tshig bsgrags/ deng sang yang rgyal po nges par brlams na spyi gtsug tu rdo rje'i rjes yong / rnam sras sprin gseb ma'i lo rgyus dang pe dkar ar gtad kyi lo rgyus gnyis 'di dang gung 'grig par mngon/ dharma pā las mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyi bla ma mdzad/ dpal chu bo rir theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor zab mo'i grub pa'i rtags khyad can brnyes/ des pho yong bza' bya ba mkha' 'gro'i rigs can zhig khab tu bzhes pa'i sras dpal gyi rdo rje dang rin cen rdo rje gnyis las/ gas rgya gar du byon/ thos bsam sgom pa mang du mdzad/ si ta) grong khyer du sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs/ dpal gyi rdo rjes pa tshab kyi rigs kyi jo mo zhig blangs par sras rdo rje grags pa/ rin cen grags pa/ chos kyi grags pa gsum las/ gcung ni rab tu byung / gcen gyis sgrub pa mdzad pas yi dam gyi lha mang po zhal gzigs/ zhing skyes kyi ḍā gī zhig phyag rgyar bsten pas sras zla ba grags/ de'i sras rig pa seng ge /de la sras shākya blo gros/ yon tan blo gros/ grags pa ye shes gsum gyis g.yon ru sa'i lte ba yar klungs su phebs/ gcen gyi g.yon ru khra 'brug dang khad nye ba'i g.yu srid smon mkhar du bzhugs (94na'i bring gnam lde 'od srungs kyi bla ma mdzad nas mkhar thog btab/ chung bas lha sman jo mos sa skyong ba'i phyogs su lha khang btab nas bzhugs/ 'ga' zhig byes lha khang yin zer/ yon tan blo gros kyi sras rdo rje gsal ba dang rdo rje rin cen gnyis/ 'di'i dus rgya dang shar ga bya dang jog dang khu dang dbus dkar sogs rus chen gyi 'bangs mang du byung / gcen gyi sras ye shes rdo rje/ des g.yu ru nam mkha' ri khu mo skyid khab tu bzhes pa la sras mo zhig las ma 'khrungs par mkhar thag dang bcag gnas rgya la byin pas pho brang rgya'i mkhar thog tu ming chags/ rin cen rdo rje mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyis gdan drangs/—131—

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)phu lung 'di ngan lam rgya mtsho dang gtsang pa mi bdun du grags pa'i rigs sngags pas kyang ma thul tshul zhus nas/ gser gyi phyags shing khru do pa zhig phul/ bla mchod du bkur bas phu lung gi lha 'dre rnams btul/ der dgon pa sdegs kha mo btab/ jo mo mchil mo zhig khab tu bzhes par sras rdo rje grags pa dang rdo rje 'bar ba gnyis 'brungs/ yab sras gsum gyis hor pa sar byon/ sgang kha spel zhes bya ba'i pho brang zhig btab/ rgya gar gyi srol bzhin sras che ba khang pa phyi mar phog pas sras khang phyi par grags/ rdo rje 'bar glu sdings su phog pas lcang sdur bar grags/ mched gnyis kyis g.yu srid kun dga' bar sa dpyad legs par mkhyen nas phyag phab/ yab bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mtshan rdo rje rgyal por gsol/ rdo rje 'bar pa la sras hor da dar pa zhes bya ba sbas pa'i rnal 'byor nus mthu'i mnga' bdag chen po zhig byung bas/ hor se chen rgyal pos gsan nas gser yig pa mngags te spyan (94ba)drangs kyang / thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pas btul te ma phebs/ de'i sras hor bkra shis 'bum dang mkhan chen chul dar ba gnyis las/ mkhan chen pa dpal ldan rlangs kyi gdung las/ spyan snga bcu gnyis rin po cher so sor thar pa'i sdom pa mnos/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i zab chos mang du gsan zhing / spyan snga grags pa shes rab dang / ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi dbu skra'i phud bzhes te bla ma mdzad/ hor bkra shis 'bum la sras gzhen nu bzang po dang bkra shis bsam grub/ gnyis gas gong ma si tu'i zhabs la gtugs/ khyad par gcen gyi gsol ja ba nas bzung bka' blon gyi bar las tshan rim par mdzad/ dpon chen rgyal bzang pas si tu btson du bzung pa'i skabs/ dmag gis bsdigs pa'i bskor g.yang mang du byas kyang sne gdong rtser 'khra phur bzung zhing / dpon chen dbang brtson gyis khri bskor bcu gsum gyi dmag yar klungs su bteg pa dus kyi me lce'i 'phreng ba la phye ma leb mchongs pa'i ngang tshul bzhin bcom pas/ stobs 'byor gyi dregs pas myos pa'i sa skya'i dpon chen kyang spa dkong par mdzad pa sogs kyis sde srid phag mo gru pa'i bstan jus tshugs pa'i rtsa ba lta bur byung bas/ si tus/ gzhon nus snying bgyis/ gzhan rnams yan lag gi tshul bgyis zhes dang /— /32

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pegayin yang ya gi gtsang sa skya nas/ smad 'jang zhabs lho mon dang bcas pa mnga' 'og tu 'du ba gzhen nu bzang po'i drin yin gsungs/ gcung bkras bsam pa'i sras gzhen nu rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' dpal bzang / nam mkha' rin chen/ dbang phyug rin cen dang bzhi byung ba rnams kyis spyan snga rin po che dang gong ma si (95na)tu'i zhabs la gtugs/ rgyal srid skyong ba'i blon po'i bya ba tshams gong sa'i dgongs pa dang bstun par mdzad/ kun dga' dpal bzang gi sras dpal 'byor bzang po/ bsod nams dpal ldan/ sangs rgyas skyabs/ dkon cog rin cen bzhi 'khrungs/ dpal 'byor bzang pos tshes bzhi gsar ma ba'i zhabs la gtugs/ nyang smad bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon dang / phyis su dmag dpon la bskos pas dgra sha drod ma yal bar blangs pas srin po yang byin sha 'dar zhes dpa' rtags byung / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub dang mchod yon du 'brel bas/ rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa'i ring lugs la mos pa thob/ bsam rtse na kun mkhyen bu'i phyag bris dang phyag rtags 'byor pa'i bka' 'gyur bzhugs pa phying bar stag rtser gdan drangs/ gcung gsum gyis sa skyong grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs la gtugs/ khyad par nang so dkon chog rin cen gong ma'i lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag spel ba'i nang blon mdzad/ bod kyi blon po rig pa can rgyun mar 'byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi ri bo'i 'dabs rol du phying bar stag rtse'i btsan rdzong lha'i grong khyer mi yul du 'phos pa lta bur yid du 'ong ba brtsigs/ de'i skabs sras nyag phra bar byung bas/ gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas chos rje zha lu pa legs pa rgyal mtshan gdan drangs/ gshed dmar gyi sgo nas rigs bskrun pa'i cho ga mdzad pas hor rdo rje tshe brtan 'brungs/ skabs shig lha mo 'od zer can ma'i las tshogs la brten nas/ rgya khab rtser brgyus dgra phyogs su bstan pas dmag dpung chen por mthong ba dang / rdzong la (95bcu med par dbyangs 'char gyi sgo nas lum bton pa sogs bka' drin che bas dga' ldan dos skyel du grags pa zhal ngo rim par mdzad/ hor rdo rje tshe brtan dbang grags pa 'byung gnas sku mched kyi zhabs la gtugs nas bka' khrims sgyur ba'i blon po mdzad/ phying bar —133

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shestag rtse'i glang po che lta bu'i ngos su ri bo bde chen gyi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs/ thon mi sa sto ṭa'i gdung las gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po byams pa gling pa bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba mi pham dga' ba'i bshes gnyen spyan drangs nas rab tu gnas pa mdzad/'phags pa'i yul gyi mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gyur ba'i glegs bam rnams kyi steng du/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i gsung 'bum po ti bcu drug bsnan pa'i pu sta ka mkha' mda' mig gi grangs ldan bzhugs shing / bstan 'gyur snga ma rnams la med pa'i skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po zha lu lo chen gyis bsgyur ba'i mngon pa'i 'grel pa gnam lcags thog gzer yang yod do/ /mched rnams kyi sras/ tshe dbang rnam rgyal dang rin cen rgyal mchog gnyis las gcen ni rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad dang sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi la mkhas par byung zhing / hor rin cen rgyal mchog ni srid zhi'i yon tan nor bu'i 'phreng ba mgrin pa'i do shal du spud cing / dpa' mdzangs rtul phod sogs lugs gnyis kyi bla na mtho ba'i gong ma chen pos thugs shin tu 'jog pa'i blon po rnams kyi gtso bo lta bur gyur/ gong ma'i bka' shog hung rgya ma'i nang du/ dbus gtsang gi chings kyi skor la gnas tshul dri bar btang 'dug pa/ 'di tshor che chung ji 'dra zhig byed kyang khyod rang la 'dri ba las 'os med pas (96nasgo gang zab kyi thag de kha nas chod gsung ba sogs rgyal po las blon po gtso bo'i gtam phyag len du mdzad/ srong btsan gzhis gar zhwa dmar chos kyi grags pa spyan drangs/ yangs pa can gyi chos sder mchod gzhis sogs kyi mthun rkyen gong sar zhu ba gnang / bde skyid gling du spyan snga bka' brgyud bris 'bur dang / bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs gser gyis 'dri ba gnang / jo mo la bsam yas rgyal po'i gnod pa byung bar/ gsol kha bshol nas ar la gtad pas chos skyong gis tshur btud de/ dngos grub ster bar gsungs pa bzhin nyi ma gcig la rdzong bcu gsum blangs/ dbus gtsang gi chings bdag mdzad pas/ gram pa shar/ stod lung rmad sogs smyu gu mchu rin la bzhes/ de'i sras bsod nams mgon po/ tshe dbang bkra shis rin cen tshe brtan rnams las/ gcen gong ma'i thugs la — 134

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pobatags pas dmag dpon gyi las ka bzung / skyid shod dpal 'byor lhun po thab skyong la gnang /'bring po 'jigs pa med pa dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ste/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa ltar dgra thabs la mkhas pas yan lag rnam bzhi'i khyu mchog yin la/ chung ba yang rnam dpyod zla ba gsar pa'i ngos su gtsug lag ri dwags kyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba zhig go /mched rnams la bya bkra shis dar rgyas kyi sras mo don yod sgrol ma jo mor bzhes par sras hor bsod nams dar rgyas dang / don grub rdo rje gnyis las/gcen lugs gnyis kyi gtsug lag mtha' dag la mkhyen pa'i spyan dang ldan zhing / khyad par bka' brgyud ga rma ka tshang gi ring lugs pa don dang mthun pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po dpal khang lo tsā ba'i drung du thun mong pa'i rig pa'i gnas mtha' (96bdag la phul du byung ba'i sbyangs pa mdzad/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho gdan drangs te dam pa'i chos kyi bgo skal stsal/ gcung 'khor ba'i phun tshogs mtha' dag chu shing gi snying po ltar gzigs te/ sdom gsum rim gyis mnos pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/ hor bsod pa'i jo mor dga' ldan pa sa skyong bkra shis rab brtan gyi lcam sring tshe dbang rgyal mo blangs par sras bsod nams stobs kyi rgyal po/ tshe dbang bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ ga rma ngag dbang grags pa gsum gyi che ba phun sum tshogs pa'i gzi brjid kyis nam mkha'i nor bu la skyengs pa ster bar nus la/ g.yul ngor chas pa'i drag shul gyis thob rgyal lha rtse'i rdzong mnga' zhabs dang bcas pa chab 'og tu btsud/ dus gsum mkhyen pa mtsho skyes rdo rje'i ring lugs pa slob dpon be+e ro tsa na'i thugs sprul gter ston shes rab 'od zer ti shri ra bsten nas/ sa 'dzin dpal gyi ri la theg mchog sgrub pa'i 'dus sde btab/ sher phyin sum brgya pa/ shel brag gi thang yig /sems nyid ngal gso rnams par du bzhengs/ 'brug nas sprul pa'i sku kun mkhyen ngag dbang nor bu sogs dam pa du ma la phu dud mdzad/ dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dga' ston spros bcas dang spros med kyi zlos gar le'u brgyad pa'i chog bsgrigs ba'i na btsugs/ gdan sa chen po ri bo dga' ldan gyi shar pa chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes rig pa'i gnas lnga la ma —135

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyermongs pa'i ma/bas pa de spyan drangs nas ri bo bde chen ser khyim pa lta bur song ba slar gtsang dgon mdzad/ 'bring pos rgyal ba'i bstan pa (97na ྅ dang / khyad par chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa la rmad du byung ba'i bkur sti dang phu dud mdzad/ chung ba gtsug lag rtsis kyi gzhud lugs la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs so/ /mched rnams la jo mo 'od gsal lha'i gdung brgyud mi dbang byams pa rab brtan gyi sras mo don grub blangs par sras ngag gi dbang po bsod nams grags pa 'jig rten dga' ba'i rgyan dang /lha'i dbang phyug mched gnyis dang lcam gsum 'khrungs/ dang po ni/ lhums su zhugs pa'i skabs mtshan ma khyad par can mang du byung zhing / lugs gnyis la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs/ 'chi med grub pa'i ring lugs pa chos rgyal khri srong lde'u bcan gyi yon tan gyi sprul pa byang pa bdag chen ti shur bsten/ khyad par gsang chen rdo rje theg pa la rtsal du thon pas rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zab mo la thugs dam gyi mthil du mjad/ yi dam dang chos srung gi gnang ba thob pas lha srin dran du 'khol nus pa'i mthu stobs dbang phyug gi snyan pa che zhing / stag rtse la zhugs kyi gnod pa byung skabs/ sngags chas kyi na bza' skor rnams ma tshig cing / zhal dkar ma chag pa sogs byin rlabs dang thugs rje'i ngo mtshar bla lhag tu che/ me'i gnod pa 'di yang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug 'di nyid za hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi skye ba'i mtha' ma yin pas las kyi rnam par smin pa'i mtha' brtul/ pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su thegs khar/ drung 'khor 'ga' zhig la slob dpon chen po'i rnam thar zhal thang gra tshar khrod nas gang zin pa zhig khyer sgo ga gsung ba ltar phyag tu phul bas/ slob dpon rgyal srid spangs nas brtul zhugs (97ba)kyi spyod pa mdzad pa'i thad de 'byung na nas/ da bu chung gis kyang sde srid 'di zin pa zhig mi 'ong bar 'dug gsung ba sogs ma 'ongs pa mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i bka' stsal to/gcung ni thun mong ba'i gtsug lag rnams la blo gros pad dkar rnam par spro zhing / mchod sbyin brgya pa'i dpung tshogs rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal du sleb pa lta bur shugs drag dmag gi sbyor ba la snying stobs — 136

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhan nu'i dag smu ston dpyi da kyi rgya lha/ cho/'i glu dbyangs/ (dzadakyi go cha btsan po gyon pa zhig ste/ mched gnyis sras dang bcas pa rim par byon no/ /ta'i si hu'e blon po drung chen grags pa bzang po ni/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus mkhan slob rnam gnyis kyi slob ma grub pa'i dbang phyug nyang ting 'dzin bzang po'i gdung las rim par brgyud de/ btsan thang shar phyogs su nyang grags pa bzang po 'khrungs/ gong ma ta'i si tu'i zhabs la gtugs te 'ol kha stag rtse'i rdzong dpon mdzad/ de'i sras btsan thang sgom gra po/sa dang sgom she gnyis kyis yar klungs mgon nag gi sras mo bkra shis skyid mo jo mor blangs pa la sras drung chen shes rab ba po shis/ kun grags pa/ kun dbang ba gsum las/ 'bring pos 'ol kha rtse'i rdzong dpon dang / chung bas rtses thang du slob gnyer mdzad/shes rab bkra shis gong ma'i zhabs la gtugs/ sa skya pa bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / tshal pa/g.ya' bzang pa sogs kyis hor rgyal po la zhu log phul bas/ dgongs pa dag byed kyi rgyu mtshan 'bul bar sher bkras pas lus srog la bltos pa med par hor rgyal po tho gan thi mur gyi drung du byon/ rgyu mtshan 'bul mkhas pas 'phral yun du phan pa'i 'ja' sa 'grub/ sde srid kyi zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba byung bar dpags/ gzhis (98na 〉 / brag dkar khyod shes rab bkra shis mi brgyud dang bcas pas shes su chug gi bka' shog gnang / de'i sras drung rin cen dpal dang / dge slong gnyis las che ba la gong ma chos rgyal chen pos rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnang / rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i sbyin bdag gi mthil len mdzad nas/ ri bo dga' ldan gyi dgon pa 'debs pa'i mthun rkyen snga phyir bsgrubs/ de la 'phyong rgyas nas jo mo sangs rgyas ma blangs par sras rin cen lhun po/ lhun grub pa/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dngos grub/ kun dga' 'dzom pa rnams las/ che ba gong ma chen pos rdzong dpon du bsko bzhag gnang / ri bo dga' ldan gyi rtsa ba'i sbyin bdag mdzad/ de 'og gong ma'i gsol dpon gyi las ka bzung / de 'og rab tu byung ste gsung rab la sbyangs nas se ra theg chen gling gi gdan sa mdzad/ de 'og che sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi gsol dpon dang / de 'og gong ma kun dga' legs pas rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnang / mched rnams la gzhis ka rin spungs nas sras mo lha mo chos skyong jo mor —137—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyeblangs pa la/ nang so dkon cog pa dang sri chod rgyal po gnyis las/ che bas rab tu byung / chung ba la tshes gnyis rin po ches rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnang / gnas rnying kun dga' bde legs dang / chos rje smon lam dpal ba sogs mkhas pa rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi gsan pa mang du mdzad/ de la rgya ma ba'i sras mo bu khrid khab tu bzhes pa la/ nang so 'jam dpal tshe ring / bdud 'du wa rgyal po/ ma zhig pa/bsod nams rgyal po/ lcam gnyis dang drug las/ 'jam dpal ba'i jo mor yar rgyab nas tshe ring dpala'adzom blangs par/ (98bsras tshe brtan rdo rjes rdzong dpon gyi las ka bzung / chab srid bskyangs so/ /gzhis ka snel pa dang / rgyal mkhar rtse pa/ 'ol kha ba sogs kyi skor/gzhis ka snel pa ni/ chen po rin cen bzang pos gong ma si hu'i zhabs la gtugs/ sa skyar dmag la 'byon skabs/ si tus phag gru'i khri dmag rnams kyis chen po la phyag 'tshal dgos pa sogs gsungs nas dpon tshab du bskos/ dus der dpon chen bzung ba sogs jus kyi 'gro khyab che ba byung /sa skya pa dang hor rgyal po mchod yon du 'brel ba'i dus kyi nor sna khyad 'phags rnams dbus su drangs/ dpon chen rnams kyis gtsos pas gzhan sde rnams la khrims ra nyi ma bcu gsum bsgyur cing bya khra ma'i steng du mi lnga brgya tsam khrims la sbyar ba'i drag shul gyis 'bod grogs kyang 'dar/ skam po grong du sger gzhis kyi mkhar las mdzad/ bya sar sger gru btsugs/ yon bdag blo bde'i sras mo bde skyid/ khams mo/ dpon mo dpal ldan 'bum gsum jo mor blangs pa las/ dang po la rgyal ba rin chen/drung nam mkha' bzang po/ gnyis pa la dpon shag pa/ gsum pa la dpal ldan chos skyong dang / bsod nams bzang po 'khrungs/ dpal ldan chos skyong gi nyang smad bsam grub rtse'i rdzong dpon thog cig mdzad/drung chen dpon grags pas gong ma'i zhabs la gtugs/ spyan snga grags pa byang chub dang / rdzong phyi rgyal mtshan bzang po dpon blon bka' bgros thog sne'u'i rdzong dpon du bskos/ gong dkar nas sgom — /38

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (7log chos rgyal gcung po rtses thang dge bsnyen dang / pa sde mkhan pos gtsos pa'i dmag gi sbyor ba bshams pa mtsho sna gdong du slebs skabs/ dpon grags pa rang gis dmag dpon mdzad nas zhabrugasapas rgyal te/ pa sde mkhan (99na)pos gtsos pa'i mi drug cu tsam lnga pa'i lam du btang / de rjes stod pa 'jam dpal gyi thog tu dpung bteg /gnya' gnon du gzhis ka smon mkhar brtsigs/ lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi gyo thog rdo gcal gsar rjes khyams ra dang / bar bskor gyi thog 'bubs/ldeb bris/ gong ma si tu'i dgongs rdzogs su/ chos rdzong / bkra shis sgang / brag nag /dbus gling sogs skyid shong stod smad kyi sngags grwa rnams su dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod btsugs/ byams pa chos 'khor gyi drung du dge 'dun bzhi sdes byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs smon lam dang bcas pa'i rgyun/ dung mtshor sngar dung mtsho ras pas ngan slong la skyo tshul btsugs pa bar skabs su chad pa gser bre'i nas khal lnga bcu lnga bcus lo ltar du gsos/ chen po rin bzang pa yab yum/ rgyal ba rin cen sku mched kyi sgrib sbyong la/ jo bo rnam gnyis drung du sman bla 'don pa'i rgyun/ gsang ne'u thogs sogs dge 'dun gyi sde rnams su mthun rkyen sbyor ba sogs rnam dkar gyi las gcig tu de che/ drung chen nam mkha' bzang po gong ma'i lung gis sne'u'i rdzong dpon du byon/rgyal ba tsong kha pa yab sras la rtsa ba'i bla mar mdzad/ khyad par dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi chos sde chen po 'debs pa'i mthun rkyen phul du byung ba dang / rta chen gyi zla ba'i cho 'phrul gyi dus khyad par can la 'gro ba'i bsod nams dmod par bskrun pa'i thabs dam pa lha sa smon lam chen mo 'dzugs pa'i mthil len mdzad/ 'di nyid kyis lcam rin cen sgrol ma jo mor blangs par/ drung chen nam mkha' dpal 'byor 'khrungs/ gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis rdzong dpon gyi las (99bka gnang / gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzheng ba dang / 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa'i zhabs tog /dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi chos sde chen po'i mjug chags rnams mdzad/ dpon grags pas tshal pa dpon mo jo mor blangs pa'i sras/ drung chen grags pa dpal bzang gis gong ma grags 'byung —139

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)ba'i zhabs la ga khugs/ stag sna'i dmag res byes gnyer dang / khrims las/ gsol dpon sogs las tshan rim par mdzad/rgyal mkhar rtse'i sras mo skal bzang ma jo mor blangs kyang / bar skabs su bde dog ci rigs la brten rab tu byung / slar hor chas su bsgyur nas gong sa sa du dben shi'i las ka gnang / byang sbra thag 'then tshad kyi dpon du bskos/ rin spungs pa la mdzo rir jus nyes chen po btang bas dpa' grags che/de'i sras drung chen dpal 'byor rgyal po/ dbang grags 'byung ba sku mched kyis rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnang / bstan pa spyi dang khyad par rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i bstan pa la phul du byung ba'i bsti stang mdzad/mnga' thang yang shin tu mtho bas/ 'bri gung rdo tham man/ kha rag rdo bug pa can yan/ yar klungs khra 'brug tshun zhes lam yig mdzad skad/ 'di nyid kyi sras/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal po/ ngag dbang bsod nams lhun po/ ngag dbang bsod nams rnam rgyal gsum las/ dang po chung ngu la grongs/ phyi ma gnyis kyi dus rin spungs don yod rdo rjes dpung gi sbyor bas mnga' thang rnams shor ro/ /rgyal mkhar rtse pa ni/ sngon 'dod khams stod du dbra rgod ldong btsan bya ba/ stag lpags brgya'i thul ba gyon pa/ dred la sbar 'dzin byed pa/ khrom ge sar rgyal po'i mag pa byas pa'i bu tsha brgyud/ yon bdag (100na phrin bum nyeg bya ba'i sras slob dpon nam mkha' byang chub bya ba gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa zhig gi sras slob dpon nam mkha' lhun grub/ de'i sras slob dpon nam mkha' bzang po/ de la sras brtson 'grus rdo rje/ grags pa brtson 'grus/ gzhen nu 'phags gsum las/ che bas snar thang du rab tu byung / chung bas ti ri grags 'od pa'i yig dpon mdzad/ bar pa la sras rgyal mtshan yig ris mang du mkhyen/ 'di nyid kyis brtsams pa'i bka' po ta yang snang / 'di chos rje ma rma pa dang thugs 'brel che bas/ mtshur phu'i byang chub chen po bzheng bar byon skabs/ bzo rgyus ldangs na kho bos mdun gyi nags ri 'di tsam blor shong zhus pas/ sprul sku nags ri par grags/'dis ma gcig lha sman jo mor blangs par sras dpal ldan bzang po/ dpal ldan rin chen/ ma zangs — /40
