deb ther rdzogs ldan gi smo nu'i dga' ston dbyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (podar po gsum 'khrungs/ nyang stod 'dul chung chu nub kyi nang tshan/ lhan yul sngon mo lung rings su byon pa'i lam khar lcags pa'i gdung brgyud 'phags pa rgyal la dang mjal te ming zhus pas/ gcen gnyis la 'phags pa dpal bzang dang / 'phags pa rin cen du btags/'phags pa dpal bzang gis dpal ldan sa skya pa'i las tshan bzung gtam yig rtsis gsum/mda' kha dpal rtsal dang ldan pa'i shar dung lho dung 'dul ba'i rgan por sa skya nas bskon cha dang bcwa tshe gnang / de nas bzhi thog nye gnas kyi go sa bzung / pa shi da ra kha che shar phyogs gong ma'i drung du brdzangs pas/ 'bri mtshams gangs dkar po tshur shes su bcug pa'i 'ja' sa gnang / gong ma si tu'i drung du byon par/ slob dpon rnam rgyal/ sher bzang / pa shi dkon (100bcug rnams kyis rin spungs su bskor nas/ grwa tshong 'dus su bskyal te dam gcur byas pa las grol te yar byon skabs/ hor rgyal pos nang chen gyi 'ja' sa gnang / rtse chen dang phag ri rnam rgyal gyi rdzong brtsigs/ rgyal rtse/ sna bo rdzong gnyis nyi ma gcig la 'gram btings/ khyung rtse sogs rdzong mang du brtsigs/ rtse chen gtsug lag khang btab/bdag chen 'phags pa dpal la sras mang du yod kyang / jo mo ma gcig dpal ma la nang chen kun dga' 'phags 'khrungs/ de la sras dpon mo mgon po sogs sras lcam sring mang du 'khrungs pa las/ bdag chen rab brtan kun bzang 'phags 'di nyid pho brang sne'u gdong rtser gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du byon/gong mas sne'u gdong dga' ldan rtse'i rten gsum rnams kyi nang nas dpon rab brtan dang ji ltar 'dod pa zhig khyer gsungs pas/ thub dbang rdo rje gdan chung ma zhig zhus pas/ thugs nyams che ba'i grags pa byung / deng sang yang rgyal rtse'i li ma lha khang du bzhugs yod 'dug cing / gtsang du byon nas grogs po brgya rtsar rin spungs nam mkha' rgyal po'i dpung rnams spub ste mtshan jus legs pa byung / mkhas grub rin po che dang mchod yon du 'brel nas/ dpal 'khor bde chen gyi gtsug lag khang —14/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)sde dang bcas pa btab/ sngags grwa pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor mang po'i zhal 'byed dang / mdo grwa pa rnams kyis dbyar chos thog bka' po ta rnams la rab 'byams grwa bskor gyi rgyun srol btsugs/ sku 'bum bkra shis sgo mang dang gos sku chen mo/ bka' 'gyur rgyun 'jags su bzheng ba sogs dbus gtsang gi sge dpon zhig la rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa 'di nyid che bar mngon/ 'di'i sras rab brtan bkra (101na)shis 'phags/ de'i sras don grub 'phags nas bzung ste bdag po phun sum pa yan chad du mnga' thang rgyun gnas shing / bar skabs su dus mi bde ba 'ga' zhig byung yang / gong ma sde srid nas rgyab gnyer mdzad pas skyon du ma gyur to/ /snge pa 'ol kha ba ni/ drung chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan la sde srid gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnang / chos rje bzang skyong pas nyi ma gling gi dgon pa 'debs pa'i sbyin bdag gi mthil mdzad/ rin po che'i khu bas bras pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i bka'i glegs bu kha bas bskor ba'i ljongs su 'gyur ro cog bzheng ba sogs sku tshe'i stod la rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs shing / rjes su rigs kyi sras nar son pa dang / chos rje rgyal tshab pa'i drung du bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa'i sdom pa mnos/ 'ol kha dge sbyong chen por skye bo rnams gleng / de rjes nor bzang pa dang / rgya mtsho ba mched kyis srid bskyangs shing sge pa rgya mtsho pa la gong ma chen pos dmag dpon gyi las ka gnang bas/ gzhan sde 'joms pa la snying stobs kyi rtsal dang ldan skad/de nas mkhan chen pas mchod khang dang / rje btsun mi pham mgon po'i sku'i snang brnyan bzheng ba sogs gong ma'i rgyun bzang po bzung / de rjes don yod rnam rgyal rdo rjes/ mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun nor bzang rgya mtsho zhes dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhung lugs sngon chad gangs can pa rnams kyis ma rtogs pa dang log par rtogs pa'i the tshom gyi dra ba mtha' dag drungs nas 'byin pa'i shing rta chen po dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho rnams la gus mchod lhur len zhing / (101ba)byad par gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i sbas pa'i bsti gnas chos — /42

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ ('a'akhor rgyal gyi 'dus sde rten dang brten par bcas pa la 'tsho ba'i yo byad bzang po gong 'phel du sbyar ba sogs dge ba'i las kyi shugs zad pa med pa'i ral gris mu mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba nags klung stug po'i mtha' dbral te/ sras phun tshogs rab brtan gshegs par brten/ zhal ngo'i brgyud ring bar ma byung yang / phyis su 'od gsal lha las babs pa'i sa skyong pa dang khyon gcig par gyur to/yar rgyab pa ni/ chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i blon po thon mi saṃ bho ṭa zhes bya ba 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa/ sngar bod du yi ge'i srol med pa la/ rgya yig lnga bcu tham pa bod yig sum cur gtan la 'bebs pa'i shing rta chen po de nyid kyi gdung brgyud yin la/ kha cig bho ṭa zhes smra ba ni mi rigs par saṃ bho drar 'dod pa mchis na'ang saṃ bho ṭa zhes gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir legs par sbyar ba lha'i skad smra ba la 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba chen po zha lu ba chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos za ma tog tu/ gangs can khrod pa'i bla ma mchog /saṃ bho ṭa zhes rab grags pa'i/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /chos blon chen po 'di nyid kyi sras ma hā sa twa/ de'i sras ye nag /de'i sras nyi ma klong gsal/de'i sras ber nag can/ de'i sras mon mo/ de'i sras gtso bo lha sras/ 'di rnams dgung lo brgya lhag tsam bzhugs pa sha stag byung / de'i sras bsod nams rgyal po/ de'i sras rgyal po dga'/ de'i sras rta mgrin rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras rdo rje ba po shis/ 'dis dpal ldan sa skyar ti shri kun blo'i zha khas la gtugs/de nyid kyi hor rgyal po'i (102na)drung du brdzangs pas/ du dben sha'i bya las chen po gnang /de'i sras dpon bzhi 'dzom/ gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis gzhis ka gong dkar gyi rdzong dpon la bskos/ de'i sras rgyal ba shes rab/ de'i sras dpon chen gral lnga/ 'di nyid sa sku tshe'i stod la gong ma grags pa 'byung gnas kyis yar rgyab dpon chen dang gong dkar rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnang /'on kyang sprul pa'i gang zag khyad par du 'phags sa pa yin pas/ sku tshe'i smad la rab tu byung ba ste gsang ba sngags kyi chos sde gong dkar rdo rje gdan du grags pa'i ngo mtshar can de btab/ 'di nyid kyis —143

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyedapon sras nas bzung ste/ sde pa rnam rgyal ba sku mched kyi bar du mnga' thang yar rgyas su gnas so/ /bya pa khri dpon ni/ yul yar klungs kyi smad/ ma yul ljongs kyi 'dabs su bya'i rgyal po gshog bzang dang 'dab bzang gi rigs las mched pa mang du byung bas bya ba zhes grags la/ yar klungs mthil du rnam smin bskyed pa yin/ /slo bur rgyal po bya mig mas kyis 'gebs/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan du gleng / yul der bya chos kyi ka ba dang / gcung thod pa g.yu'i smin ma can mched gnyis las/chung ba'i sras mkhan po yon tan mchog dang / bya shaka gnyis 'khrungs pas gcen gyi 'bring sde la rab tu byung / e nas klogs/ byar nas shar mda'/ dwags po nas grom mda'/ gnyal nas srin mo mig rnams bzung / bya sha ka la sras rdo rje legs pa dang rdo rje dbang phyug gnyis byung ba gnyal phyogs su byon/ rgya mtsho grong mkhar btab/ gcung gi sras bla ma bya nag chen po rin cen 'od 'khrungs/ kha che paṇa chen dang mjal nas spyod rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis zhus/ (102ba)g.yin yang rgyal ba thog rdugs pa/ skye 'od 'byung / 'jad rta mig pa so gos bla ma mang du bsten nas thos bsam sgom pa lhur mdzad/khyad par spu gri skor gsum sogs yi dam chos skyong la rtsal du thon pas yang rtse'i gtsug lag khang kyang gnyan pa'i grags che/'di nyid kyis gtsug lag khang brtsigs dus stag /spreg sho mong gsum bong tshod shin tu che ba'i cho 'phrul byung bas/ stag dang sho mong gnyis bsad pa'i sob kyang rtse'i mgon khang spyan gzigs khrod du yod skad/ spre'u de gsod thub na dbus gtsang spyi dang khyad par lho rgyud kyi mi bde ba'i rtsa ba zhi ba gcig 'ong rgyu yin kyang / 'gro ba'i las kyi mthus spre'u shor bas phyis su sku rab pa byung / bla ma 'di la byar smad du tshal sgom chos la dga'/ lo rong rab dga' ba chen po/ dwags por ba tsho ras pa/ gtsang du 'u yug pa chen po ste chos kyi bu bzhi/ gnyal du chos grwa grong mkhar/ er se po/ dwags su nags mo shod/ byar na rgya mtsho blug gang ste sde bzhi byung la/ rigs kyi sras bya jo sras/ de'i sras mnga' bdag /de la sras dge slong ba/ bya rin chen/ chos rgyal dpal bzang gsum las/ dang po'i sras rin cen dpal/— /44

deb zer rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dbyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (gedabang phyug rin cen bzang po/ dwags po ba bzhi byung / dwags gnyal lo ro rnams su gzhis ka mang du brtsigs/ bya rin cen gyis e gnyal byar dwags lo ro rnams kyi sgo sdud mdzad nas hor dmag bzlog pas kun gyis dpon du bkur/ 'di'i sras kun dga' rin cen gyis sa skya'i dpon chen kun dga' bzang po la gtugs/ bya chos rgyal dpal bzang pas 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i drung du byon/ shar pa kun bsod la slob dpon bcol nas rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa (103na〉sbyangs pa mdzad/a mi bya nag gi dus la yang rtser mgon khang sogs yod pa'i steng du/ slar gtsug lag khang du grags pa'i mkhar las rgya bskyed/ rgya hor gyi nor sna mang po bsdus nas mdzod nag tu rgyas btab/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gser las grub pa bzhengs/ chos srid kyis mtho ba'i 'go tshugs/ 'di'i sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen spyil bu ba/ mnga' bdag chos seng 'od/ bya thub pa dpal rnams las/dang pos dpon chen 'od zer seng ge la 'dam du rdzongs zhu bar byon/ rte'u ra'i gya gnyer kyang 'di'i ring la byung / mnga' bdag chos seng 'od 'bri gung gi sku tsha yin par brten/ 'bri gung nas byar dwags kyi dpon du bskos/ de'i sras mkhan chen tshul khrims bzang pos zangs mo che'i mkhan po mdzad/ slar yang rtser khri dpon gyi go sar byon/de'i sras dkon cog bzang po/ de'i sras bkra shis dpal bzang gis rtses thang du slob gnyer mdzad/ bshad ston bzang po btang / gong ma sdo srid grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bya pa'i khri dpon la bskos/ de'i sras rgyal ba bkra shis/ shākya dpal mgon/ thub pa rgyal mtshan rnams las/ dang posasne'u gdong rtser byon/ gong ma sde srid kyi drung 'khor mdzad/ bya pa khri dpon gyi go sar bskos/ sras bya bkra shis dar rgyas/ pad+ma rta mchog rgyal po/ bya tshe dbang rgyal po/ skal bzang chos kyi rgya mtsho/ bya nor bu rgya mtsho rnams 'byungs/ gcung shākya dpal mgon mkhan chen yon tan dbang phyug la rab tu byung ste thos bsam sgom la lhur blangs nas/ zangs mo cher mkhan thog tu bzhugs/ skal bzang chos kyi rgya mtsho ni mdzad pa 'khrul med sogs bstan bcos mang (103ba)du mdzad cing gsung rab la mkhas —145

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyepar grags/ bya bkra shis dar rgyas rtses thang nas dpon sa rdo rje rin cen dbang gi rgyal pos lho rgyud lung gi khri dpon du bskos slar yang sne'u gdong rtse nas gong ma ngag gi dbang phyug gis bsko ja bzang po gya nom pa gnang / bya pa khri dpon gyi zhal ngo gcig la 'di nyid grags che zhing / chos rje dme pa rje drung chos grags rgya mtsho la mchog tu gus/ gser gyi bka' 'gyur gyis thog drangs sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzheng ba sogs rnam dkar gyi dge las mang du mdzad/ 'di nyid kyis rdo rje gos dkar ma jo mor blangs pa'i sras/ bya nor bu bkra shis dang / grags pa rgyal mtshan mched gnyis zhabrungs shing /de yang rdo rje gling pa'i lung bstan du/ gnyal lung pa rgyal po gcig gis 'bangs su sdud/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa'i sku zhig rgyal por 'byon zhes pa'i lung bstan du 'ga' zhig gleng bar mched gnyis kyi nang nas 'brug pa sprul pa'i sku 'jam dbyangs chos grags pas sku tshe'i stod la yab yum gyi bka' nan bzhin rgyal srid bskyangs pa'i sras bstan 'dzin nor bu dang mtsho skyes rdo rje/ de'i sras gong ma chen po mi pham tshe'i dbang po dang / dmag dpon stag rdo rje de gnyis kyi sras ga rma tshe dbang grags pa dang /gangs dkar rnam rgyal byung ngo / /dga' ldan pa dmag dpon bsod nams rgyal po ni/ skyid shod yar phyogs gling zhes par/ mi chung don rgyal du grags pa des chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i blon po mgar gyi rigs las/ tre hos dga' bde bzang po zhes pa tshal pa khri dpon gyi go sar yod par de la gtugs/ dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis sde srid phag mo gru pa'i rdzong dpon gzhis ka snel pa'i phyag g.yog mdzad/ nyang bran dga' ldan gyi me dpon du bskos pas dga' (104na yin pa'i ming thogs/ de la sras bsod nams rgyal po/dbang dar/ rnam sras gsum gyi che ba snel pa dpal 'byor rgyal po'i thugs la btags pas/ dbyi nag bsod rgyal du grags shing / byang phyi chos lung dang yang dgon nang sor gtogs pa phud rjes/ klan ka gnyis das gtsos/ lo sprel sna gdong phyin gyi 'ja' sa gnang / 'bring po snams bon grong gi bdag po mdzad/ chung ba 'brong ri sngon rdzong du yod thog /rin spungs pa'i dpung gis bskor ba'i rgyogs nad — /46

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (dzadal brten rdzong gtad nas/ tshal du mkhar las mdzad nas bzhugs/ dbyi nag bsod rgyal ma mched kyi sras nang so nam mkha' rgyal pos bar skabs chu shol lhun po rtse bzung / 'on kyang snel pa nang zlos dus rin spungs pa'i dpung snye thang du 'byor thog chu shol gtad/ nam mkha' rgyal po'i sras tshe brtan rgyal po dang / bsod nams gnyis las/ che ba rab tu byung / chung ba la snel pa sku mched kyi dgongs par mi bde ba mang du byung bar brten/ rin spungs don yod rdo rjes dpung skyid shod du bcug skabs/rin spungs par ngo gtad pa'i dmag gi sne bsu mdzad pas sne'u dang po ta la sogs rin spungs pa'i phyag tu 'byor pa'i lag rtags su rnying khung gi steng snye mda' chu so kha yan gyi 'ja' sa gnang / de nas mi ring bar sde srid gong ma chen po'i dpung gzhung po rar phebs skabs/ yar rgyab rin cen bkra shis kyis 'tshams sbyar nas/ dga' shag gnyis kyis gong ma'i zhabs phyir 'brangs/ shag pa la skyor mo klung dang skyid shod g.yas ru'i ru dpon/ dga' ldan par bde chen du gtogos pa'i chu lho byang rnams dang /yar rgyab par sne'u rdzong dpon gyi las ka gnang / gong ma'i (104ba po khas tog tu 'gyur bas bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan 'phrul snang gis gtsobs skyid shod lung pa'i khrims bdag tu lung bud/ gtan khra shel tham gyis chod/ 'di nyid kyi sras ra nu lha bsrung gis gong ma chen po chu shol du bzhugs skabs/rin spungs pa'i dmag gis sna khang bcar bar ra nu lha bsrung gis gtsos pas kha sbub che bar btang bas/gong sa nas dmag dpon bsod nams rgyal po'i ming nang / byi ri stag rtse'i mi brgyud rdzogs rjes dga' ldan pa dang khyon sgril bar sras lcam sring drug 'khrungs pas gnyis chung ngu la grongs/ lcam tshe dbang rgyal mo 'phyong rgyas har bsod pa'i jo mo dang / lcam du dkar ga srid kyi bdag por bzhes/ de 'og nang so don grub rgyal pos gangs nas rdzong dpon gyi las ka zhus/ mi ring bar sde srid zhal ngo nang du sel zhugs skabs dga' ldan pa'i dpung gis skyor mo klung rdzong dmar 'bebs su btang / stod lung dang 'phan yul gyi rdzong mnga' zhabs phal cher blangs/ gangs nas chu shol mkhan chen par bka' bgyon gnang ba'i dpung gi rkangs mdzad nas chu shol 'bebs pa dang / gong dkar nas zhabs drung ngag dbang —/47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)grags pa rtse'i khrir phebs pa'i 6khas 'degs mdzad/ gcung sde pa bkra shis rab brtan pas/ gong mar lar rgyab nas zhabs 'dren zhus skabs skyid shod kyi dpung rnams lho khar bton pa sogs sde srid kyi zhabs tog tu 'gyur bar brten/ gzhis ka brag dkar gyi rdzong dpon gnang / skyid smad rnam rgyal sgang gi sgrub mchod gling mkhar du/ sne gdong yar rgyab sogs lho rgyud kyi dpung rnams 'byor pa'i steng du/ sde pa bkra shis pa nyid kyis 'go mdzad nas (105nasgo chongs pa dang / stod lung mtsho sna gdong du yang gong chu snyug gnyal byar lor gsum/ lho brag dwags kong du rgyal bzang gi dpung zhib sgril byung ba bzlog thub pa sogs dgra thob tu mngon par lci ba'i dpa' grags kyis srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu la skyengs pa ster nus/ dga' ldan dngul gdung rin po cher sgo rgyan/ 'phrul snang gtsug lag gi gser thog bzo ba/ rin cen sgang du rig pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi grags pa'i ring lugs kyi bshad grwa 'dzugs pa sogs rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa'i zla snang gis legs byas puṇ+ḍa ri rka'i tshal ches cher rgyas par mdzad cing / rigs rus yon tan du mas mngon par mtho ba'i lha'i btsun pa bsod nams dpal bzang dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po shar pa chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs ti 'a shrar bsten nas bkur sdi bla lhag tu mdzad/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la rnam dpyod kyi rtsal med du byung ba'i yon tan du:'i sti'i sgra dbyangs skabs gsum bdag po'i gnas su bsgrags so/ /'di nyid kyi sras sde pa g.yul rgyal nor bu lugs gnyis mngon par mtho zhing sras bsod nams rnam rgyal/ yid bzhin nor bu chos rje gsum las/ gcen gnyis kyis/ rtse nas gong ma'i lcam jo mor bsus pa'i sras mgon po rab brtan/ rdo rje rnam rgyal chos rje mtsho skyes rdo rje rnams byung ngo / /smras pa/ sdo bzhi'i dpal 'byor yongs 'du rlangs kyi ljon/ /gnam bskos rgyal srid yal 'dab sdug po las/ /bsod nams dpung gis spyod pa'i mi bdag 'bras/ /mnga' 'bangs dga' ba'i 'dod rgu char du phab/ /(105ba)rigs rus bzang po'i nor 'dzin dbus/ /stobs 'byor gser gyi 'dzin /48

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (poms bskor/ /ya rabs rnam thar lhun po'i rtser/ /rgyal phran nye dbang tshogs kyi 'dus/ /chos srid blang dor gnas kun la/ /ma 'dres gzigs pa'i spyan stong ldan/ /sde srid mchod sbyin brgya pa gang / /srid 'dir mtho ba'i khri la 'gying / /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de ltar gong ma ta'i si tu nas bzung ste/ bod gnyan zhan gyi go rim sil bur ma gyur gyi bar/srid kyis mngon par mtho ba phal cher ni sde srid gong ma'i thugs la btags shing / lung dang las ka gnang ba shas che na'ang / sa skyong lha rgya ri ba ni/ gong nas lung dang 'ja' sa ched du ma blangs par/ nyi 'og gi rgyal por gyur pa zhig ste/ de yang bod chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud dri ma med pa gnam lde 'od srungs kyi sras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi brgyud tsha ba khri bkra shis brtsegs pa'i sras gsum gyi 'od lde las rim par byung ba/ 'od skyid 'bar gyi sras gtsang tsha spun drug las brgyud de/ gdan sa thel gyi mdar btsad po tsha ba rong pa zhes mi dpon zhig dpal phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po'i dus byung zhing / de nas rim par brgyud nang so mda' smad pas/ e stod chu tshan kha zhabs su ri la rtsa rgya bo skyes pa zhig na gzhis ka brtsigs pas rgya ri zhes ming du chags/ de nas lha chos kyi bshes gnyen sogs zhal ngo rim par byung ba las/ lha dgra las rnam rgyal gyis rgya ri rdzong du bzhugs/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang mchod yon du 'brel/ rgya ri lcog mkhar du lo gsar gtor chen gyis phyag srol btsugs/ lha dgra las pas se chen ri sgo phyogs su phebs pas/ yul du bkra (106na spro shis pa'i dge mtshan mang du byung bas/ yul mi rnams kyis nas phud khal re phul/ bla'i dpon du gyur te/ ri sgo bkra shis chos rdzong du pho brang gi lte ba mdzad/ de nas lha 'jig rten dbang phyug khri thog tu phebs rjes/lha byams pa rab brtan dang lha yul 'khor dbang phyug sku mched gnyis byung / 'di'i dus su sprul sku bde chen gling pas/ e yi nang du khrag mtsho lan gsum khol/ /rgyal po byams pa'i ming can bya ba 'byung / /rgyal po de yin bstan pa rgyas pa la/ /zhes sogs kyi don dang mthun par mnga' thang gong du 'phel/ khyad par lha yul 'khor bas lang ga'i grong khyer sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i btsan rdzong 'ol kha —149

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)stag rtse mnga' 'bangs dang bcas pa rang dbang du mdzad/ de nas lha bsod nams rab brtan sku mched gsum las/ bsod nams rab brtan khri thog tu phebs/ chad dkar rdzong gi nye 'dabs su dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa sogs rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs/ de rjes/ lha dga' ldan dpal 'bar gyis khrir phebs nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa la sri zhu bla lhag tu mdzad/rog pa rtsar mi bsrun pa'i skye bo rang nyams kyi blo'i spyod yul can rnams ming gi lhag mar bcom pas mgo lag khrag gi ral pas sbags pa blangs pa sogs 'jigs pa med pa'i snying stobs kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i dbu rmog btsan po gyon/ de rjes khri thog tu blo bzang mthu stobs chos rgyal byon nas snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang gis sde 'brug snyol ba gtso bor mdzad/ 'on kyang las ngan gyi rba klong drag pos bdas pa'i skye bo 'phar 'gro'i rigs can na kra'i mgrin par la jug 'dod kyis tshur rgol gyi sde gzar 'ga' zhig byung (106ba)ba rnams bka' khrims sgyur ba'i byed po bsod nams rab brtan sogs kyis zhi drag gi sbyor ba du mas bzlog par byas/ khri chen 'di nyid ni rnam dkar dge ba'i snyelas la mchog tu brtson zhing / khyad par gas nga sngags zab mo'i rnal 'byor lhur mdzad de/ de rjes lha ngag gi dbang phyug dga' ldan rab tu brtan pa mi 'gyur rnam par rgyal ba khri thog tu byon te/ phun sum tshogs pa'i mnga' thang 'gog pa med pa'i snang ba rab tu rgyas so/ /smras pa/ mchod sbyin brgya yis 'chi med dbang po'i sar/ /skabs gsum rigs kyi bdag por dbang sgyur na/ /nor 'dzin tshes ba'i na skyong ba'i legs byas kyis/ /stong gsum kun kyang rang gir byas kyis dogs/ /e ma khyod kyis sde bzhi'i nor/ /bsod nams gser gyi 'khor lo yis/ /drangs pa'i mdzad med gan mdzod 'di/ /re ba skong ba'i dpag bsam dbang / /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de yang gnam bskos kyi rgyal po 'jam dbyangs gong ma se chen gan gyi lung gis/ kha ba'i rdul — 150

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pemang yongs su brtsegs pa'i bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams mtha' dag dpal ldan sa skya pa la phul te/gnam la nyi zla zung gcig sa la mchod yon rnam gnyis zhes grags shing /de nas zla ba'i 'phreng ba bcu phrag bdun gyi phyogs su nye ba na/ gang gis kyang gzhes gzhig nus pa'i go skabs phra mo tsam yang ring du spangs pa'i bsod nams kyi dpung pa can/ sa'i tshangs pa ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i dpa' mdzangs rtul phod pa'i rnam dpyod kyis bod yangs pa'i sa kun la dbang sgyur ba nas bzung / dus yun ring po'i bar du dpal phag mo gru pa'i sde srid kyi bka' khrims gdugs dkar po (107na po khog gis 'og tu khyab tshul sngon du brjod ma thag pa de lta na'ang / zhabs drung gong ma chen po zhing khams gzhan du 'pho ba'i tshul bstan pa'i mjug tu/phag gru'i mtshan don mi rgyug pa dang / glo bur gyi rgyal ba zhig 'byung ba sogs dus 'grig pas/ 'phreng mgo gter ston shes rab 'od zer gyi thugs rje chen po pad+ma'i dbang phyug gi lung bstan du/ sgra snyan 'dra ba'i gnas sgo sa 'jig rten dbang phyug sprul pa nyidaḥ ar tha'i ming 'dzin byung gyur na: lho byang slo bur rgyal po byed: sgrub pa snying po'i bstan pa 'dzugs mi lo lnga bcur bde la 'god skye ba'i rten 'brel ma 'grig na yul de rang 'pho gud pa dang : mtha' ma rlung gis 'khyer du nye zhes sde pa 'phreng mgo ba'i mi ngo zhig gis glo bur gyi rgyal po byed pa'i lung bstan dang / gnang rtse nas kyi gsang ba'i lung bstan du/ gtsang phyogs rgyal po pad+ma'i ming can 'byung : sku tshe mthar phyin bdud dbang ma gyur na: zhes pa lhad bcug pa min na rin spungs pa'i sras pad+ma dkar pos bod spyi'i rgyal po byed par bshad pa sogs ni rten 'brel 'phyugs pas thog tu ma phebs/ pad+ma'i rgyal tshab mnga' ris paṇa chen dang rigs 'dzin legs ldan pa'i/ bla ma bka' brgyad yongs 'dus kyi lung bstan du/ 'dzam gling shar lto'i phyogs mtshams su bdud mo rno myur nag mo la bu dgu skyes nas 'dzam gling 'joms khyad par bod yul gangs can 'dir ma 'ongs bzhi bcur nye dus su: bdud sprul dgu dang de blon dgu btsun mo phyi nang las byed dgu bang 'phrin dbu gtso dmag dpon dgu /dgu dgu brgyad cu rtsa gcig gis: 'gro —151

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)kun kha lo thur du (107ba mo'u da: ces pa'i dus rtags thog tu khel te/ rin spungs pa'i blon po nyid gis bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong dpon gyi thog /snar thang ba/ nor byung ba/ brgya tsho ba sogs lho byang gi dpon rigs mang po dang 'brel btags byas pa'i/ sde pa rong par 'bangs gyen log gis/ sdogazar lan snga phyi kha yar du byung ba'i mthar je 'phel du song ste/ gtsang stod rgyal po lung gis dbus gtsang mtha' dag rim gyis chab 'og tu bcug pa'i mnga' thang gi dpal phun sum tshogs pa dag /ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor seng ge mo'i bu'i mgrin par chud pa ltar/ mnga' 'bangs mtha' dag cig car du rang gir 'dzin pa'i byed po ni/ rtsod dus kyi 'khor los sgyur ba bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po ste/ 'di nyid ni/ gter ston dri med lhun po'i lung bstan las/ spyir yang mtha' dmag lan bdun mtha' ma la badz+ra pā ṇi'i sprul pa'i rgyal po zhig: bod khams dar cig bde la sbyor ba 'byung : zhes gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje mi'i srid pa'i zlos gar can yin par lung gis zin pas/ byang sems 'phags pa snying rje dang / smon lam gyi dbang gis 'gro ba'i don du bsams bzhin chos ldan rgyal por skye ba bzung nas phan bde'i 'od brgya phyogs bcur bkyed pa ste/ gang zhig tha mal gyi skye bo rang nyams kyis spyod pa'i snang tshul mun pa mtha' dag rgyang du bsrings pa ni gor ma chag la/ de yang byang phyogs hor sog gi rgyal khams na sde chen po grangs med pa yod pa'i ya rgyal/ o rod tsho pa bzhin grags pa'i nang tshan/ ho shod kyi dpon po ha na'i la jo mo a ha'i ha thun blangs par sras lnga byung ba'i gsum pa rgyal po 'di nyid chu pho rta'i lo la (108na gyi khrungs/ mtshan tho rol ba'i hur btags so/ /dgung lo bcu gsum lon pa'i tshe/ mgo dkar gyi dmag khri phrag tsam gyi steng du/ dmag rnams kyis sna drangs te mchongs pas pha rol gyi dpung tshogs mtha' dag 'jig rten phyi ma'i ltad mo dus gcig tu myong bar byas pa'i grags pas/ srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu mi'i yul du rgyu ba'i 'gran zla gnyis pa byas rbe se/ /de skabs yul phyogs de dag mtha' 'khob las kyang ches mtha' 'khob tu gyur pa kla kle'i rgyal — 152

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ ('khams lta bur gnas pa las/ sog po'i yul gru g.yin dag tu/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / gser gyi rgyal po mchod yon zung gcig la brten nas dam pa'i chos dar zhes pa'i chos kyi ming tsam thos 'dzin gyi rgyan du gyur pas yid dga' spro dang bcas te phyogs der phyag btsal bas dpral ba skrangs pa tsam du gyur cing / bstan pa'i dbu brnyes pa ni/ lha tho tho ri gnyan shal la gnyan po gsang ba 'byung ba bzhin no/ /me rta dgung lo nyer lngar slebs pa'i tshe/ yum grongs pa'i rkyen gyis mkho dgu'i 'byor pa mtha' dag mchog dman gyi skye bo rnams la sbyin par btang zhing / de yang tshe 'di'i snyan grags dang / rnam smin lan la re ba tsam ma yin par/ slob dpon zla grags kyis/ sbyin pa sbyin bya len po gtong pos gto me / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor gsum/ bden stong gi rtsis zin pa'i 'phags chen dam pa'i rnam thar ro/ /byang 'phags rnams ni gzhan don du 'gyur tshe dmyal ba'i me 'obs kyang mtho ris kyi dga' ba'i tshal bzhin du 'jug par mdzad pa ni chos nyid de/ de skabs khar kha dang o rod phan tshun du g.yul (108ba)rlabs po che bshams pa'i 'byug long gis/ srog gcod pa'i sdig pa'i las rngam po ches/ngan song mu mtha' med pa'i nags klung sdug por bsgyur ba'i sbyor ba la brtson pa dag la dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur te/ khar kha o rod phan tshun du 'grul tsam yang byed mi nus pa'i skabs/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i snying stobs kyis go cha btsan po gyon te/ khar kha'i khrod du tsham tshom med par byon nas/ gzhung dka' tshegs chung ngus bzlums par mdzad pa dag legs pa'i pha rol du phyin pa lta bu'i rnam thar ro/ /stong 'khor chos rje dang khar kha'i rgyal blon rnams yi rangs te/ da'i gu shri zhes cho lo byin/ slar rang yul du byon/ rje bsod nams rgya mtsho la o rod cig gis mdo sde gser 'od dam pa la phyag nas zhus pa'i tshe/ gsung rab gyi ming dri ba gnang bar/ al tan ge ril zer zhus pas/ da nas mi lo nyi shu na khyod kyi yul du chos 'di dar bar 'gyur ro/ /—153—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ gser 'od dam pa sogs chos mang du sgyur ba'i sbyin bdag mdzad pa sogs bstan pa'i srol btod pa ni/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po gnyis pa sa 'dir 'ongs so zhes lha rnams gleng ngo / /sngar sog ngo tsho chen drug la gzhung dang chings yod pa rnams/ cha dkar rgyal pos bshig pa'i dus zhabrug la brten/ bros po 'ga' zhig khar kha'i khrod du 'ongs par/ dpon po nang phan tshun rtsod pa'i rkyen gyis/ khar kha chog thu rang yul nas spyugs te mtsho khar 'ongs pa/ sdig can gyi yul du rin po che'i char bab pa'i gtam rgyud ltar/ re zhig mnga' thang che bar byung bas/ nag po'i gdon gyis yid rnam par brlams pas/ bstan pa spyi dang khyad par rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i bstan (109na)pal log par 'khu ba'i bsam sbyor ngan pa nyams su bstar pa la bsten/ rgyal po 'di nyid kyis bstan pa 'ba' zhig thugs su bcug pa'i/ rang yul nas dmag gi dpung tshogs dang chabs gcig par bteg pa/ me glang zla ba dang por mtsho khar 'byor te/ stobs ldan gyi rgyal po rā ma ṇa sa lang rka'i bdag po lnga pa'i lam du btang ba bzhin chog thu'i dmag khri phrag bzhi dang bcas pa ming gi lhag mar btang / shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha' tshun mnga' 'og tu bsdus te chos srid gnyis ldan gyi sgo nas mnga' 'bangs rnams bde bar bskyangs/ rim gyis nyi ma dbus kyi rgyal khams su byon/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya cher spel ba'i dga' ston bsgrubs/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du/rgyal phran kun gyi cod pan du bgrod byed zung nye bar 'god pa'i ngal sor mdzad pa'i chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i mtshan dang las ka sogs mngon par blangs te/ phyir lam gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du phebs/ de dgongs nyer bdun yin na'ang / srod kyi dus rde'u phra mo tsam yang mthong ba'i mun pa shin tu dkar ba byung bas/ bstan srid mtha' dag dkar 'jam du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel 'grig /de skabs bod dang bod chen po mtha' dag mnga' 'og tu chug pa'i mtshan ltas legs pa'ang 'ga' zhig byung 'dug /glang lo'i dgun thog mtsho khar phyir byon/ de yang bar khams su be ri don yod kyis/ kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i rjes su zhugs pa mtha' dag nye bar 'tshe zhing / bon kho na spel ba — 154

deb ther rdzogs ldan gas nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pol brten/ sa yos hor zla lnga pa'i nang du be ri'i thog tu dpung tshogs rnams bteg /mnga' 'bangs phal cher blangs/ (109bsko:gas 'brug zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer lnga la/ be ri dpon po sogs mtha' btsan por gros pa rnams kyang / gang gis bsod nams kyi lcags kyu rnon pos/ khab len rdo ba dang lcags phye'i snang tshul ltar khrims kyi do ra chen por yongs su bcug /mi bde ba'i rtsa rkyen mtha' dag gnas nas dbyung / sa dge /gar 'brug /stag lung pa sogs kyi bla dpon khrims dong du tshud pa rnamasabartan te rang gnas su bskyal/ 'jang rgyal po tshun chad kyi skye rgu rnams kyis nor gyi dpya khral phul zhing gus 'dud lhur blangs/ de nas dbus gtsang gi phyogs dpung gi tshogs bshams par mngon du phyogs pa ni/ mnga' ris sku mched kyi gter lung du/ khyad par gdug pa sprul gyi lo shar dus: gnam rtagasa'od dkar skya rengs yang yang shar gza' skar 'khrug cing byang du hor sog gso: 'ol kha'i phyogs su rkyen byas 'khrug: dbus gtsang sde zhabrug 'gro rnams nyam thag 'gyur: sa g.yos nad rims lo gsum lo nyes 'byung : lo dgu'i bar du dbus gtsang dbu rur 'tshogs: khrag gi char pa lo bdun bar du 'bab: ces dang / yol mo sprul sku'i gter gsar du/ yos kyi lo la ngal so byed: 'brug gi lo la 'brug ltar 'dir: sbrul la sbrul shun bzhin du 'thor: de phyir yos bu'i lo la long : zhes pa'i dus rtags dang mtshungs par dpung tsho gis bye ba phrag brgya'i g.yul bshams te/ lho phyogs gshin rje'i mthar thug pa tshun dbang du bsdus/ chu rta zla ba gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la/ bod shing sgo can yongs kyi rgyal blon rnams kyang nga rgyal gyi gdong pa smad de gus 'dud lhur len gyi sbyor ba la nye bar zhugs/ chu shel gyi (110na)dbang po nag pas nya ba/ dus 'khor ba'i lo'i thog ma'i dus tshes nas bod chol kha gsum gyi rgyal por gyur te/ bka' khrims kyi gdugs dkar po srid rtse'i bar du 'khor/ ris bral gyi grub pa'i mtha' rnams la gus 'dud lhur len gyi lhag pa'i bsam pa mnga' na'ang / gar srid rnams kyis byed spyod ma mkhas par brten/ shar phyogs kong po'i yul tshun dpung shed sa spyad/ gter ston 'ja' tshon pas rang gter du slob dpon chen po'i sprul par bstan yod ces ngos bzung / rgya gar gyi rgyal por —153

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyekho shing / bal yul yam bu'i rgyal po/ mnga' ris rgyal po sogs mtha'i rgyal po mang pos kyang yul lugs kyi skyes mang du phul/de yang rat+na'i bstan pa spyi lung du/ 'bri yi rā co phag gi mjug ma can: gung gi tshang 'cha' sa yis zas za zhing : zhes pa'i 'og tu dbus gtsang thams cad sku yi mnga' 'og 'du: de lta'i bstan pa mi lo drug cu 'byung : zhes pa 'bri gung pa dang phag gru'i bstan pa g.yag tsam las rwa co dang mjug ma lus pa'i tshod tsam gyi dus rtags dang gnas tshad bstan no/ /de yang rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i thugs rje'i bdud rtsi gang gis gsang ba gsum gyi za ma tog tu bltams pas chos srid mtha' dag gser gyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i dpal la 'gran pa 'di bzhin no/ /mdzad byang /smras pa/ dbyangs gsal sdeb kyi sra bar bcings pa'i lcags rje'i khor yug dbus na mngon mtho glegs bu'i rin cen rdul mang brtsegs pa'i ba gam na/ /'gal ba'i khur mang gya gyu'i tshul spangs legs bshad khams kyis dwangs ma kun bsdus tshar du dngar ba'i deb ther ri dwags mig can ma/ /nyams 'gyur 'jo sgeg gar gyi rnam rol bcad (110ba tshe lhug spel ma'i dbyangs bdun lhur len tshig don ma 'dres zur mig dbang gzhu ltar 'khyug cing / /mngon brjod u dum wā ra'i 'phreng mdzes gtam rgyud mgo skyes g.yon 'khyar ma 'di blo ldan brgya byin dag las g.yin gyi spyod yul min/ /ka raṇ+ḍa ltar ya rabs mchog gi spyod tshul snod du ca co'i ngag spangs khungs ldan lo rgyus dbus 'gyur ta la'i glegs bam ji bzhin rab gsal ba ti dzā yi pu sta ka /kha dog tshig don ma 'dres lang tsho rnam par bkra ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs snyan tshig bsil zer mdangs kyi tha gru kun khyab sgra 'dzin bdud rtsis pha rol shes ldan dga' ston che/ /ga dza lta bu'i dregs pa'i blun po legs bshad — /56

deb ther rdzogs ldan ga sto nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (poskyes las ja chang btung ba 'ba' zhig don du gnyer phyir da lta'i dus kyi snang tshul 'di la ba glang spyod las gzhan mi brin/ /nga zhes stobs nor snyems pas 'gying yang shes ldan rig pa'i nya gar gzhal tshe lci dang yang ba'i mtha' bral na ra'i dbus na g.yung por mthong bsam dmad 'gro ba shin tu dkon/ /tsa ko ra yi lus 'deg blo yis shes bya'i mkha' la 'grod tshe zha bo ji bzhin mthu dang bral yang ra nag gser gyi zol can 'ga' zhig gis/ /tsha zer la sogs grang dro'i 'jigs pa khyad bsad bsgrubs rnams gtan bde za bar byed pa gor ma chag mod la lar 'di snang rnam dpyod tshul dang bral/ /dza ṭa'i cod pan chos rgyal mes dbon 'khon rigs rlangs sogs grags snyan 'a 'ud srid pa'i rtse mo kun tu sha shi'i 'od 'dzin blo gsal tshogs rnams kyis/ /wa ler sgrog 'dod sems kyis bskul bas bsngagasabarjod rgyud mang glu blangs ya mtshan dpal gyis skabs gsum pa rnams sa la blta phyir rgyu skar zol gyisalhags/ /ha cang sa chen (111na skyong ba'i chos ldan rgyal ba a shwa tho yi ljon pa'i dbang po dar ba'i mchog /ha ri tsan dan dpung pa skyes kyi dbus mtho a ga ru yi rgyal phran kun gyis zla bral ba/ /ha ri ka yi mgrin da byangs khrims gnyisang ros a mra'i yongs 'du mnga' 'bangs yongs kyi 'dab ma 'dzum/ /ha har bzhad pa'i phul byung dga' ston bzang pos a mri ta yi snying po'i zil dngar bla na med/ /srid zhi'i khams kyi lha lam yangs pa'i ngos/ /rgyal dbang ye ༷ ma'i 'od dkar can/ /bsil ldan chu snod so sor shar ba las/ /bka' khrims dge ba'i bcu drug cha shas rdzogs/ /gangs can kun gsal mdzes ma'i bzhin ras la/ /thub bstan nam mkha'i sgron me'i spyan gyi dkyus/ /lung rtogs khrol pa'i snang mdzod lcags kyu yis/ /phan bde'i 'od dkar gzhen nu ring nas 'gugs/ /srong btsan dge bcu'i legs lam zla tshes can/ /log spyod ra ri'i dri ma byung ba'i 'od/ /grags snyan ral par spud tshe mgrin sngon can/ /sa bla'i ljongs su song zhes lha rnams gleng / /yid srubs kyis brlams sdig lta'i sems 'chang rigs/ /legs byas snang ba 'gog tshe khri srong lhas/ /thabs mkhas 'phrul gyis spel bas dge legs 'od/ /spur rgyal yangs pa'i sa la kun tu 'bar/ /ral pa'i zur —157

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyephud bla brer bres pa'i mkhar/ /thun mtshams lang tsho'i sde yis legs 'khyud pas/ /bdud sde'i rgyal mtshan nags kyi me khyer dag /gangs ldan ra ba'i ngos las phyi rol brgal/ /ma rig stug por 'phyan byed dgra sde'i ltar/ /mngan par 'khon pa'i bdud rtsi bod yul zong / /'thungs pas chos srid bdag po sa skya ba/ /stobs ldan sgra gcan gnyis pa sa 'dir snang / /rin cen bdun gyi 'dod (111ba)rgur mnga' sgyur ba'i/ /sa dbang rgyal po'i go sar gnam gyi mthongs/ /sgo 'phar yangs pa'i spo nas bum bzang gis/ /spyi bor dbang bskur sde srid phag mo gru/ /e ma sngon byon sa spyod lha rnams kyis/ /bod 'bangs 'dab brgya ba 'ad pa'i phan bde'i 'od/ /spros tshe nyin byed bdag gis ci bya zhes/ /gnod sbyin phyogs kyi 'khrig pa'i khyim du bros/ khrims gnyis srab kyis ma gtsug rengs pa'i gnyar/ /drang thig 'dzam bu gser gyi 'khor lo yis/ /mnan tshe ngan spyod skye bo'i bag yangs kun/ /bkres skom gdung bas mnar lus ji bzhin snyam/ /brnag nus las 'das pha rol rgol pa'i g.yul/ /rnam par bcom pa'i mgo 'phreng khrag gis brlan/ /lan cig min par gsher ba'i dmar 'od kyis/ /rgod ma kha de rgya mtsho'i mtha' ru yibs/ /gser mngal stobs la rmugs 'dzin 'byor pa'i mdzod/ /gcig tu bsdus 'dra'i srid kun dge phyogs su/ /bsgyur bas rnam smin dkar po'i thigs pa 'bum/ /'dzag byed dam pa'i spyod tshul med du byung / /mthon po'i mnga' thang phun tshogs dpal 'byor kun/ /bkod pas khyad 'phags rnam dpyod dbyar rnga'i sgras/ /che ba'i rnam thar bzang po'i gtsug phud can/ /ya rabs dga' ston rnam bkra'i gshog rlabs ngom/ /kye ma thos bsam bdud rtsi yal bor nas/ /ngan g.yo zang zing rnyogs pa'i bza' btung gis/ /lto ba khengs pa'i dregs ldan mthon po'i khrir/ /'dzegs kyang tha ga pa dang khyad par ci/ /ya rabs tshal du rigs rus cho 'brang gi /yongs 'du'i ljon pa rgyas pa rmad byung yang / /tshe ldan bya ba'i sbyong tshul mi shes na/ /gser skyogs snod du ngan skyugs blug dang mtshungs/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i skye bar khas 'che (112nabs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i blo gros mthu dman na/ /gnod sbyin nor la spyod pa tshe 'phos nas/ /dbul po'i khyim du skyes dang khyad — 158—

deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhon nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ (pepar ci/ /mi mdzad stobs 'byor gter la mnga' sgyur yang / /'di phyi'i phun tshogs bsgrub pa'i rnam dpyod mig /longs tshe sa 'og gnas pa'i klu tshogs dang / /srang la bteg tshe lci yang gang gis 'byed/khungs ldan lo rgyus mthong bar rig lam nas/ /'dren pa'i rnam 'byed shes rab mthu phra yang / /dmus long gcig pur rgyu ba'i gom stabs bzhin/ /'gal 'du'i khur gyis lci ba'i glegs bam mang lo rgyus gzhu la drang po'i rgyud drangs nas/ /legs bshad 'dab ldan g.yo ba'i nyag phran can/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i snying la phog srid kyang / /gzur gnas mkhas pas mthong tshe spro ba 'phel/ /mi mdzad zhing gi gangs ri'i spo la sdebazhi'i rtsal gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i mtho sa rgyal po gdong lnga'i dbang / /rim par byon la bsngags tshig su sti'i sgra yi gdub sil 'khrol bas ya rabs mdun sa'i kha rgyan spel legs 'di/ khres bya'i rba klong yid mtshor rol pa'i ban+de tshangs dbang sras mos bzhad pa'i 'dzum ldan legs bshad gter mdzod kyis/ /mi bdag gsung gi ri bo man dha ra yis bskul ltar dpyad gsum dag pa'i 'chi med lus phra'i pad+mo bskrun/ /gangs can 'dzin ma'i dpyid kyi mngal khur las/ /blo gros yal 'dab dar ba'i shes ldan rnams/ /ngo mtshar gtam gyi legs bshad skyes 'dod na/ /deb ther dpyid kyi rgyas mo'i dbyangs 'di bsten/ /thub bstan kun gsal mdzes ma'i khor yug tu/ /rung mthun gos kyi thun mtshams zol bsten nas/ /nges gsang theg pa'i yang rtse sngo skyes 'bras/ /yongs smin gang (112ba)bu rgyas pa'i g.yur za ldem/ /de lta na yang nges pa lnga ldan gzugs/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i ā dar+sha yi ngos/ /zlos gar bsgyur ba'i drin las rig pa'i gnas/ /sma tshe dbyangs can dgyes pa'i 'dzum gyis bsu/ /lhag bsam rab dkar dri bral yid kyi mkhar/ /bstan bcos chu lha'i bu yi pu sta gas/ /skye rgu'i nyon mongs 'du ba zhabrugs pa 'a nad/ /legs bshad chu klung dwangs pos drungs tshwan cing / /'dzam bu'i lang tsho dar babs 'khri shing gis/ /nyer mtshon yangs pa'i nor 'dzin skyong ba kun/ /rtsub 'gyur dpal gyi rno ngar rab zhi nas/ /dge gas khrims kyis rdzogasaldan 'bod par shog /phan bde'i gdugs dkar srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar/ khor yug gcig tu khyab —159

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)pa'i legs pa'i lam/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal 'chang ring lugs snying po'i brgyud/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing du 'bar gyur cig /ces gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs su mchog gsum dam par gtan gyi skyabs su 'dzin cing / rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras po'i bstan pa rin po che la phud dud sogs bla na med par bkur ba'i sa la spyod pa'i mtho ris kyi rgyal blon rnams gtso bor bkod pa'i deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di yang / stobs kyi dbang phyug bstan 'dzin cho so kyi rgyal po'i bkas bskul bar brten/ bka' chems bka' khol ma/ thugs rje chen po'i skor/ mkhas pa'i dbang po 'gos lo gzhen nu dpal dang / tshal pa'i deb ther sogs khungs thub kyi yig tshang rnams la zhib mor dpyad/ mkhas rlom dregs ldan gyi khungs med blun tshig gi glegs bam rnams la dgag gzhag cung zad bgyis te/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal (113na tha gnyis pa rje btsong kha pa'i bstan la zhugs pas rgyu mtshan shes nas mi ldog pa'i dad pa thob kyang / 'thad ldan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rnams la chos spong gi sgrib pas ma sbags shing / bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la blo gros kyi 'jug pa cung zad shar ba'i za hor gyis rigs las lo rgyus smra ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ ming gzhan tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho gsar pa'i sdes/ 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ge drag po zhes pa lcags sprel lor bltams nas lo nyis stong drug brgya dang nyag ma gsum 'das pa/ 'phags pa'i yul du su rla zhes pa gangs can kyi ljongs 'dir nyi mar grags shing / ma hā tsi na'i rgyal khams su dbang thang dang bstun pa'i skad gu'i wu'i/ phyogs 'dir chu mo lug tu brjod pa'i glu dbyangs kyi zla ba'i phyogs snga ma'i rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la/ sman ljongs sa'i lte ba dga' ldan pho brang me tog mngon par bkra ba'i lding khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so// //maṅga lo// //

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long (dzadalha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long bzhugs/(1na)kā — ru tsi r+ya da sha ba lu yu ba rgya dzod 5 2 khya ba rnga ma thi lwa ma na sare dha ri: sa skru jo tswa yu ba na bā ྅ka 8 ku sha :shi 3 ya sa ba tsa ma hā shu ma yi praya smo /stobs (sdeb sbyor dpyid kyi thig le/)bcu'i lang tsho dar ba'i mdzes sdug gis/ /bgrang yas cho me kun ri dwags mig can yid/ /'gugs par byed pa'i rnam 'dren sgyu rtsal spyod/ /zas gtsang sras kyis legs pa'i dpal kun stsol/ /lus can kun la ris su ma chad brtse chen lho phyogs lam las 'ongs pa'i dri bzhen gyis/ /mtha' klas brjod bral gsang ba gsum gyi ma la ya yi ljon pa bskyod las gangs can 'dir/ /sa dbang dam pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol (2na skor dri bsung tshar du dngar bas yongs gang ba/ khrims gnyis drang por srong la btsan zhing sgom pa'i dbang phyug 'khor lo sgyur ba rgyal gyur cig /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'chi med tshogs gyi lam yangs por sna tshogs sku yi bkod pa'i zlos gar rlung gi rgyal mtshan rab bkra ba'i/ /mkhan slob chos rgyal mtshan gyi dbyangs snyan phyogs kyi lus phra'i mgrin pa las/ /nam yang zad pa med par len de skye dgu'i bsod nams zong gi dpyid/ /zur phud lnga pa'i mtshan dpe'i rang snang mtho ris bdag po'i lding khang nas/ /thub pa'i bstan la rjes su chags pa'i rin cen sbrel bas them skas las/ /bde bar legs babs mi yi snang brnyan 'gro la ston pa'i gar mkhan mchog /mi zad blo gros bzang po'i grags 'bur tsong kha pa la spyi bos 'dud/ /bka' khrims char gyis phan bde'i 'khri shing kun/ /g.yur du za bas rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i mgron/ /'gugs mkhas phag mo gru pa'i sde srid ces/ gnam bskos rgyal po'i lugs sras de med byung / /phyag na pad+mas 'dul shing kha ba'i ljongs/ /mchog dman kun gyi —/61—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyebasod nams bskrun pa'i yul/ /lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang bzang gi /dkar chag (2ba)deb ther bsgrig la su mi spro/ /ngo mtshar chos 'byung dpyid kyi dpal mo las/ lo rgyus legs bshad dbyar skyes gzhon nu'i mgron/ khungs ldan gtam gyi ljon shing ldem pa'i rtser/ /nyams 'gyur snyan tshig me tog rab bkra 'di/ /zang zing 'byor pa'i bya rgod 'dab gshog la/ /nyer bstan mkhas mang gnyis skyes gral bsnyeg pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin pha wang tshogs kyi yul min kyang / /dpyod ldan khu byug snying la lhag par 'jebs/ /chu 'dzin sdug po'i dbus na 'brug gi sgra/ /dal bur sgrogs tshe rma bya gar byed na/ /lo rgyus chul la gdung ba'i skye bo'i tshogs/ /nor 'dzin gser gyis bka' las cis mi dga'/ /mi dman dge ba'i tshogs kyi dkar phyogs la/ /bsod nams cha shas yongs su ches gang ba'i/ /chos ldan rgyal po'i chu shel dbang po yi/ /mdzad bzang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'di na spro/ /nor rdzas 'od chung cam gyis cher dregs pa'i/ /blun rmongs srin bu'i me yi ngang tshul dag /ring sgangs ya rabs ngang chu la cin byed la/ /rab dga'i pad+ma skra 'dzin 'dab brgya phye/ /dri za'i 'phang 'gros char yang bsgrun min zhing / /shes ldan mkhas mang dga' byed rna ba'i rgyan/ /dkar chag gdong lnga'i brgyud kyi nga ro'i dbyangs/ /'dzad med mgrin pa'i lam nas deng 'dir len/ /zhes shis pa brjod pa'i glu dbyangs kyis sngun bsus te/ mtha' klas pa'i lus can kun la ris su chad pa med par phan pa dang bde ba'i lam bzang po la dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas bkri ba'i brtse chen thugs brje'i dbang phyug rgyal ba (3na)zas gtsang sras po'i bstan pa rin po che ni ltar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi legs byas rgya mtsho'i sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i rang bzhin du lhun gyis grub la/ de nyid 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa sa chen po byams pas skyong ba'i chos ldan gyi rgyal po zhig la rag las pa'i phyir/ rang cag rnams kyi ston pa'i bstan pa bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di nyid du 'byung ba'i thabs su 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po bod rgyal po'i rnam par bstan pa'i rje rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung / lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi bar du byung ba'i gnam gyi khri — /62

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long / (dza)bdun/ stod kyi stengs gnyis/ bar du le drug /sal lde brgyad/ 'og gi btsan gsum du grags pa'i rgyal po rnams kyang / dngos su chos kyi khrims bca' ba ma byung yang / mtha' 'khob gdul dka'i skye bo rnams thabs du ma'i sgo nas btul te/ brgyud nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel ba'i bdag rkyen sha stag mdzad la/ khyad par lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dam pa cho me kyi dbu brnyes/ de nas gdung rabs lnga song ba'i tshe/ phyag na pad+ma'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar mkhan chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po 'jigs pa med pa'i khri chen po la zhabs zung gi pad+mo rnam par dkod de/ rgyal ba'i sras po 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i snying stobs dang / dpa' zhing brtul phod pa/ gzhan gyis tshad gzung dang bral ba'i sprul pa sna tshogs ston pa'i snyan grags kyi rnga bo che 'dzam gling yangs pa'i sa'i khyon thams cad du khyab pas/ rgya dkar nag /stag gzig /ge sar sogs (3ba)rgyal po chen po rnams kyis gus pas btud cing nor gyi dpya phul/ chos blon mthon mi sam bho ṭa rgya gar du brdzangs te/ rgya gar gyi yi ge las btus nas bod la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge sum cu rtsa bzhir gtan la phab/chos dge ba bcu las brtsams pa'i bka' khrims btsan pos mchog dman yongs kyi gnya' bar gser gyi gnya' shing lta bur lci/ smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu las sprul pa'i dge slong blo gros 'byung gnas tshul khrims pho nyar mngags te yi dam gyi lha rang byon rnam pa gnyis spyan drangs/ rgya bal gyi rgyal po dregs pa can rnams kyang phyi nang gsang ba gsum la brten pa'i thabs mkhas kyi 'phrul dang /blon po mgar rig pa can sogs kyi byed pos nga rgyal gyi gdong pa bsnyil/ 'phags ma sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa'i btsun mo gnyis dang / de dag gi rten skal du kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i sku'i snang brnyan mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis kyang mngon par mtho ba dang / nges par legs pa zad mi shes bskrun par byed pa zung sogs rten ngo mtshar can du ma dang / klu'i dbang po'i bang mdzod kyi khengs pa 'joms par nus pa'i bdog pa'i skyes mtha' yas pa drangs te/ bod chen po'i rgyal khams thams cad chos dang srid kyi 'byor pa ma smad pa dbyar gyi chu bo bzhin du 'gyur bar gyur/—163

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)de yang gangs kyi ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i lte ba/ gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang / byang nyang bran bal po che'i ri la dbu la gdugs/ mal grong gi ri la spyan la nya/khol mar dog lte ra ga brag zer/ mdong khar gyi brag la ljags la pad+ma/ nyang bran phan dkar gyi ri la gsung la dung / la la grib kyi 'khyags pa dkar chung la zer/ rdzong btsan gyi ri la mgul la bum pa/ yug ma'i ri la thugs la dpal be lu bka' 'khol mar gdugs kyi byang shar ngos na yod par bshad pas/ (4na)da lta rmog lcog tu grags pa'i brag ri la sku lus rgyal mtshan/ stod lung brang bu'i ri la phyag zhabs 'khor lo ste/ logs bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs sa dpyad ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan gyis khor yug kun nas dkrigs pa'i dbus su/ shākya'i rgyal po'i pho brang ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang bskrun pa'i lus can mtha' dag gi bsod nams kyi zhing dam par ji ltar nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'gro ba'i mun pa sel ba de srid du spel bar mdzad pa yin no/bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs kyi rdzing bu la/ /mtho ris bdun gyi yon tan ngang mo dkar/ /bde skyid glu dbyangs rkang gdub 'brol bzhin du/ ngo mtshar 'phur lding zlos gar ci yang bsgyur/ /'khor los mtshan pa'i kun gsal lus phra ma/ /pad 'dab nor 'dzin gzhon nur chags pa'i bzhin/ /bkra shas rtags brgyad zur mig g.yo ba yis/ /chos srid dge mtshan mtha' dag ngang gis 'gugs/ /gdul dka'i 'gro la byams brtses rjes chags pa'i/ /rgyal sras rtsod dus 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal/ /'dzin mkhas srong btsan sgam po'i sgyu dra'i gar/ /sgyur tshe dregs ldan kun kyang 'phyang mo nyug /mtha' 'khob ba glang ltar blun skye bo'i tshogs/ /blang dor 'byed pa'i blo gros gsal ba yis/ /lcags zong gser 'gyur rtsi yi sprul bsgyur la/ /mtshar du 'dzin pa'i snang ba da gdod bskyungs/ /bod 'bangs skye dgu'i grangs med legs byas kun/ /sa 'dzin dbang por co 'dri'i phung po'i ljid/ /ma bzod dbyig 'dzin ngal ba'i rdul gyi rgyun/ /babs la dza hu'i bu mor btags sam snyam/ /legs byin ma dang khro gnyer can ma zung / /rgya bal la dbang sras mor sku sprul nas/ /srong btsan btsun mo'i zol — /64

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long / (the)gyis phan bde yi/ /gzhir gyur gtsug lag khang bzang brtsigs pa la/ /nag po'i yid kyi mngon brlams lha srin dpung / /nyer 'tshe'i (4ba'i gas blta mtho 'tsham sbyor ba kun/ /gzhom pa'i rnam mang thabs kyi mdzad pa yis/ /bgegs med 'gro ba'i gnyen du 'grub de mtshar/ /zhes pa ste/ bal bza' khri btsun gyis rgya mo bza' la gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i sa yul dang sa dpyad gang bzang 'dri bar bran mo zhig gtang bas/ rgya nag po'i spor thang brgyad cu skor gyi steng nas legs gnyis kyi tshul gsal bar gtan la phab kyang / bran mos 'phrin thams cad ma 'byor bar brten/ mtsho bsub pa'i sbyor ba byas na'ang cha tsam du yang ma subs pas/ rgya mo bzas phrag dog gi rnam pas tshul bzhin ma byas par mngon nas/ rgyal po la yang ma zhus par/ la gdong ne'u thang la rmang bting ba mtshan mo mi ma yin gyis shul tsam yang med par bshig pas/ rgyu mtshan rnams rgyal po'i snyan du gsol ba na/ chos rgyal gyis mkhyen bzhin du ma mkhyen pa ltar mdzad nas khri btsun dang bcas 'o thang gi mtsho 'gram du phebs te/ sor gdub mkha' la bskyur bcug pas mtsho nang du babs pa dang / mtsho'i dbus na 'od zer sna tshogs las grub pa'i mchod rten 'dug pa rje blon kun gyis gzigs te/ chos rgyal gyis bden tshig dang / blon 'bangs kyi rdo bskyur ba lhan cig tu 'dzom pa'i mthus/ rdo'i mchod rten sra zhing brtan pa cig tu song ba la gdung ma rnams kyi sne gtad de dka' tshegs med par mtsho bsubs/ 'on kyang rgya bza'i rtsis khog nas byung ba'i bcos ka rnams ma 'grub pa'i stabs kyis gtsug lag khang brtsigs kyang lha 'dres bshig pa na/ kong cos rtsis khongs nas legs nyes kyi blang dor bstan tshul rgyal po'i snyan du byung bas/ shin tu dgyes te/ chos rgyal yab yum gsum gyis skyid shod nyang phran pha bong khar/ bsra ba'i mkhar dbu thog brtsigs pa'i nang du zhag bdun gyi ring sgrub pa mdzad pas/ (5na)rigs gsum mgon po zhal gzigs byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi/ yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi/ /ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi rnams bzhengs/ g.yin yang sa dpyad ngan pa mtha' dag bcos rjes/ ra sa 'phrul —165

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)snang gtsug lag khang / rgyal po nyid kyis sku lus kyi bkod pa mi 'dra ba sna tshogs dang / bod 'bangs las la bskul ba sogs mthun mong dang mthun mong ma yin pa'i mdzad pa bstan te bgegs med par grub pa dang chabs cig par ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang kyang lhun gyis grub bo/ /de ltar ngo mchar rgya che'i dge mchan kun/ /gcig tu 'khyil ba'i gtsug lag khang gi rten/ /bris 'bur byung chul srid zhur bgyis pa rnams/ /'brul pa med par gleng ba brjod bya dngos/ /seng ldeng sgo mo nas brgyud chos skor du/ /sku gsung thugs rten lo chen rin bzang sogs/ /dam pa'i sku brnyan bris 'bur spel ba'i phreng / /mkha' la dbang po'i gzhu ltar rnam par bkra /zhes pa ste/ sku'i rten du ldebs bris la rgyal ba rigs lnga chos rgyal nyid kyi phyag nas ma/ gsung gi rten du thugs rje chen po'i gzungs yi ge drug ma chos rgyal gyis dus/ thugs kyi rten du sa paṇa gyis bzhengs pa'i brtag pa mchod rten chos rgyal gyi phyag tshwa bzhugs pa/ gzhis ka snel pas bzhengs pa'i lo chen rin chen bzang po/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / dpal phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po/ mnga' ris pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ g.ya' phug pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang / rje btsun mi la ras pa/ zhad 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa rnams dang / da lta ma hā kā lar grags pa zhig po bdud rtsi/ de'i steng thub pa'i sku/ mdo la chu bskor dpon/ gtsang khang byang ma'i sgo stengs su skyid shod sde pa bkra shis/ (5ba)rab brtan gyis bzhengs pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sku 'dra dang / rigs gsum mgon po rnams bzhugs so/ /nag phyogs bdud sde'i dpung tshogs brag gi ri/ /'joms la rang byung sku brnyan gnam lcags thog /'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor skal ldan gyi/ /mig gi bdud rtsir gtsang khang byang 'dir bsdo/po/tra// /zhes pa ste/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal 'di ni/ gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba'i thabs yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba btab pas/ rgyal po rang gi sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i — 166

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long (dze/thugs rje chen po'i sku gzugs shig bzhengs na 'dod pa'i don 'grub pa zhes pa'i sgra zhig byung ba la brten nas/ sngar sprul pa'i dge slong gis spyan drangs pa'i byang chub shing gi yal ga /rgya mtsho'i gling gi 'jag ma/ chu bo ni rañja'i bye ma/ tsan dan sprul snying dang / gor shi sha'i dum bu/ gnas chen brgyad kyi sa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i rdzas mang po gcig tu brdar nas ba dmar dang ra dkar gyi 'o mas sprus pa'i phung po rgyal po'i dbu sngas su bzhag cing / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la gsol ba btab pas/ bde gshegs zhi khre'i lha tshogs nam mkha'i khyon gang ba lta bu 'jim pa'i phung po de la thim pa gzigs/ nangs par sngar gyi rgyu rnams la thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal du grub 'dug pas/ rgyal pos bal po'i bzo bo la/ rten 'di ya mtshan zhing shin tu mgyogs pa zhig byung 'dug na'ang / rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'i tsan dan gyi sku rang byung dang / sangs rgyas rab bdun gyi ring srel rnams nang bzhugs kyi tshul du gzhug rgyu yin pa la gsungs par/ bzo bos/ sku 'di bdag gis bzhedas pa ma lags/ rang byon du gda'o/ /zhus ma thag tu/ 'khas g.yon pa'i sham thabs pus mo'i gong du brdzes/ zhabs mthil las 'od zer byung (6na)bas rten de rnams drangs te thugs gar thim zhing / de yang nub phyogs zla ba tshal gyi dug shing sdong po rkang gcig gi rtsa na lha srin rnams gas te/ chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i 'dun ma shoms pa la/ thugs rje chen po bzhad pa'i zhal las 'od zer gnyis byung bas/ gcig gi sna la khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa byung nas ma mo'i nyal sa phyogs te rdo rje'i ra bas bskor bar byin gyis brlabs/ gcig gi sna la rta mgrin byung ba'i zhal nas me dpung thog ltar song bas lha 'dre rnams rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol tu bskrad par mdzad pa'i sku brnyan 'di nyid la nang bzhugs 'phags pa'i sku rang byon dang / chos rgyal yab yum gsum thim pas rang byon lnga ldan zhes grags pa yin/ 'khor du chos rgyal nyid kyi dus su bzhengs pa g.yas phyogs su 'jig rten dbang phyug /khro gnyer can/ dbyangs can ma/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ g.yon phyogs su kha sa chu ni/sgrol ma/ 'od zer can/ rta mgrin rnams bzhedas shing / khang par bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang rta mgrin —167

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)gnyis kyis gtsug lag khang bzheng ba la bar du gcod pa'i nag po'i 'dre srin mtha' dag btul bas byin rlabs shin tu che/ rta mgrin gyi zhabs g.yas pa'i 'og nas grub thob dngos grub dang /mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi thugs rje chen po'i chos skor bton pas cung zad yo ba la blun po rnams mdzo mo 'dzam gling rgyan gyi lo rgyus blos byas zer ro/ /g.yas g.yon gyi 'jam dbyangs dang phyag rdor gnyis tshal pa khri dpon gyis bzhengs/ de yang gtso 'khor dgu po po ta la nas skyes bu'i rtsol ba la ma ltos par gtsang khang byang ma 'dir rang byon du phebs pa yin no/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /mtsho skyes rdo rjes (6ba)rjes bzung thang stong pas/rab bzhengs mkhas dang grub pa'i gzugs kyi sku/ /ya mtshan bkod pa'i rim pa 'di ltar ro/ /zhes pa ste/ de nas phyir 'ongs pa na/ gtsang khang gi phyi'i khyams na rim pa bzhin/ gter ston thang stong rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i nyid kyi sku dang / dam pa sangs rgyas/ grub thob birnyi pa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ sgo khang steng / dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams bzhugs so/ /rnam mang thos pa'i sras 'grub sgra bsgyur rjes/ /chos rgyal sku khrus gsol ba'i nyal 'gro yis/ /gsher ba'i rdul mang phung po las bskrun pa'i/ /mi pham mgon po mchog de'i sku'i snang brnyan/ /zhes pa ste/ chos rgyal yab yum rnams sku khrus mdzad pa'i chu rgyun gyis yongs su brlan pa'i sa la sku rgyu'i gtso bor mdzad nas zangs mkhar lo tsā ba zhes 'phags pa'i yul nas gangs can ljongs 'dir dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba'i skad gnyis smra ba des/ rje btsun byams mgon gyi sku bzhengs par byams pa khrus mdzad du grags shing / sku pang na mgo yod lha khang nas spyan drangs pa'i tsan dan las grub pa'i 'jam dbyangs/ mnyam med jo bo chen po'i bla ma gser gling pa'i thugs dam rten li dkar gyi tshe dpag med/ gzhan yang 'jam dbyangs/ phyag rdor/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa/ dkon gnyer dpon rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long rtsom pa po legs pa'i shes rab kyi gdung rten/ rje btsun ma sgron ma'i sku/ bshan pa rme ru rtse'i sdigs bshags la bzhengs pa'i 'bum/— /68

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long (dzadamanga' ris pa brtson 'grus snying po'i gdung rten/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i dus kyi rdo gong bkra shis 'od 'bar rnams bzhugs so/ /bod yul bstan pa'i gsal byed mkhan slob zung / /lta ngan 'joms byed ka ma la shrī la'i/ /sku gzugs rig 'dzin pad+ma'i gdung 'dzin pa'i/ /theg mchog rgya mtsho'i gleng (7na)pa de yis so/ /zhes pa ste/ phyi'i khyams na rim pa bzhin du chos rgyal yab yum sku khrus gsol ba'i khrus rdo pad+ma spungs pa/ gter ston pad+ma gling pas bzhengs pa'i mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho/dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma saṃ bha wa/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po ka ma la shī la gsum dang / ne chung ri pas bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba sman pa'i rgyal po rnams bzhugs so/ /rgyal ba'i yab gcig zur phud lnga pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum phung po dang / / rgyal sras yon tan ma lus gcig bsdus nas/ /rgyal dbang blo bzang grags pa'i skur bstan tshe/ /dge legs be+e ḍūr+ya mthing kha zhu ba'i khams/ /dge mtshan yul gru'i snod du 'khyil ba yis/ /dge ba'i dngos po mtha' dag dar ro zhes/ /dge zhing shis pa'i dbyangs 'di srid rtser bsgrags/ /'jam dpal snying po'i blo yi pha mtha'i tshad/ /tshad mas gzhal nus min na gser gyi mngal/ /mngal bzang sngon med sbrum la 'jigs pa'i tshul/ /tshul bzhin phyogs bral skye bo'i ngag las thos/ /rnam 'dren ma lus lus pa med pa'i tog /rgyal ba'i sras kun kun nas 'dud pa'i yul/ /blo bzang grags snyan snyan pa'i gdugs dkar can/ /'dren pa mchog de de phyir skye dgu'i gnyen/ /zhes pa ste/ lcags khra'i nang du dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i sku 'dra rin po che rgyal ba nyid kyi phyag nas ma 'dren byed kyi yul du gyur pa tsam gyis kyang byang grol gyi sa bon mtha' yas pa 'jog nus pa de'i g.yon du sa skya'i gdung rgyud ta ming gan gyi ti shrī theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis bzhugs/'jig rten dbang phyug las brgyud tsan+d+ra pa/ /'jig rten mes po'i sras kyi cha bsags mdo/ /—169

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kye'ajig rten kun la mngon (7ba)par rten mdzad pa'i/ /'jig rten mig gcig sgra bsgyur lo tsā bas/ /rmongs pa mkhas pa'i go sar 'gying min pa'i/ /grags pa don dang mthun pa'i paṇ+ḍita/ /bu ston chos rje sogs kyi sku brnyan rnams/ /'dren byed yul gyi bdud rtsi'i mtshar du dngar/ /zhes pa ste/ lo chen byang chub rtse mos bzhengs pa'i kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ sa skya'i gdung brgyud gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i gsang chen slob bshad kyi bdag po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ gzhan yang / mu sras pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan rje drung ga rma rang byung rdo rje rnams bzhugs/nag po'i yid kyis nyer bskyed glang dar mas/ /phan bde'i rtsa lag bstan la rma 'byin tshe/ /rten gsum 'jig pa'i byed po'i tshogs rnams la/ /'jigs rung cho 'phrul ston pa'i gsang ba'i bdag /ces pa ste chos rgyal gyi phyag nas 'thor zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyag na rdo rje'i sku 'di nyid/ glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs te/ gtsug lag khang 'jig pa'i thog ma lha sa la byas nas/phyi nang gi rten gsum rnams med par gtong rtsis kyis thog mar phyag rdor gyi mgul la thag pa btags pas/ 'dogs mkhan kha nas khrag skyugs pa dang / spyo 'bog sogs kyis shi ba'i mthus/ gtsug lag khang gi 'jig 'phro bcas pas khyad par du 'phags so/ /phyag na pad+mas gangs can rgyal po'i tshul/ /rang 'dzin gang des shākya'i pho brang mchog /bzhengs la byin rlabs phung po 'di'o zhes/ /ston phyir 'ja' tshon dra bas rnam par sbrel/ /mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /mtha' dag 'od phung gyur la ro gcig kyang / /'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad ces grags pa'i/ /nang tshan snang ba mtha' yas gtso 'khor mdzes/ /zhes pa ste/ gtsang khang nang gi gtso bo 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha (8na sgongs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas/ 'khor spyan ras gzigs/ sa'i snying po/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ nam mkha'i snying po/ kun tu bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs/ phyag na rdo rje/ byams pa rnams chos rgyal dus so/ /170

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long / (dza)rgya nag dmag tsho gos bzlog nus dpung chen po/ /gang gi lto bar gnas pa'i khyon yangs 'di/ /shong ba'i snod du pha mtha' yas pa'i sa/ /'jig rten mes pos ched du bskrun par nges/ /'jam mgon mi yi rang gzugs khri srong rjes/ /zan yang mi 'gyur lhun 'grub gtsug lag khang / /bzhengs pa'i phud las rgyal chen rnam bzhi'i sku/ /dpa' gtum khro chags nyams 'gyur ci yang ston/ /zhes pa ste/ gtsang khang nas phyir 'ongs pa'i khyams na/ 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha khro bo rme ba brtsegs pa/ blon po mgar gyis rgya yul du g.yo sgyu khram gsum byas par brten/ chos rgyal mya ngan las 'das pa'i gtam rgya yul du thos ma thag /rgya dmag 'bum phrag bcu bod du lhags pa'i 'jigs skrag gis sus kyang ma thub pa'i tshe/ khro bo 'di'i lto ba kha phye ba'i tshul gyis dmag grangs med pa bkye nas/ rgya dmag rnams phyir bzlog pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa'i byin brlabs shin tu che/de nas rim pa bzhin tshal pa khri dpon gyis bzhengs pa'i rgya lugs kyi chos rgyal yab yum/sangs rgyas mthong ba don yod/ jo bo'i spang lcog steng na/ dpal zan yangs zhes rgya skad de/ lugs zung mi 'gyur lhun rgyas grub pa'i sa phud la phul ba'i rgyal chen bzhi/ shing phud la phul ba'i ka ba gnyis/sgo steng du/ rje mi las thang dpal mo'i dpal thang la rdzu 'phrul bstan pa'i g.yag rwa rnams yod do/ /lha mi'i rin cen rdul brtsegs phung po la/ /mtshan dpe'i mdzes sdug lus phra sa rab 'byud na/ /rgyal dbang sku yi snang brnyan 'gran (8ba)zla zhes/ /'chi med dbang po'i tshogs kyang gtam du gleng / /mthong na mi mthun med pa'i rnam gyur gyis/ /kun gyi mig la bdud rtsi dpal ster na/ /rgyal rnams mngon sum mjal ba'i skal bas kyang / /gzugs sku de mthong dag las ci zhig lhag /mig stong can gyi nor bu'i man+ta ra/ /las bzang g.yon mig sor mo'i rna ba'i rtser/ /spud tshe ltar bcas skye bo'i bstan pa kun/ /cig car phyogs pas sngon med mdzes pa'i dpal/ /bsod nams zhing gyur rgyal sku'i nyin byed dbang / /srong btsan mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rta bdun gyis/ /bsil ldan lha lam ngos su drangs pa na/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshe'i pad dkar 'dzum/ /yang yang mig dang rna bar mthong —171

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyethos shing / /dung dung snying nas ldang ba'i dad pa yis/ /gus gus lus rmad phyag 'tshal bskor ba dang / /lhang lhang gsol 'debs yul gyi yang rtse yin/ /long long thugs rje'i sprin dkar gsar pa las /sim sim phan bde'i char gyi rgyun 'bab cing / /ldir ldir ston pa'i rnam thar 'brug sgra yis/ /brel brel yid kyi rma bya zlos gar bsgyur/ /zhes pa ste/ kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras po nyid kyi sku'i snang brnyan/ sangs rgyas nyid dang khyad par ma mchis pa'i jo bo rin po che 'di ni/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis lha dang mi'i rin po che rnam pa bcu sku'i rgyur spungs pa na/ bzo bo bi sha ga rmas de rnams bzhu btul lugs su blug /de yang sku rgyu ni sde pa rdzong pa lha sa paṇ+ḍa tas/ lha klu mi yi nor bu sna tshogs pa/ /gcig tu byas pa'i rin cen phung po dang / /zhes gsungs pa'i don dang mthun par sems/ shākya'i rgyal po dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad lta bas chog mi shes shing / mthong thos dran reg tsam gyi mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa bon khyad par can 'jog nus pa 'di nyid/ lus can kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing dam par bskrun pa la/ (9na)rgyal ba nyid kyis rab tu gnas par mdzad de/ rim gyis lha dang / o ḍi ya na zhes pa bod skad du 'phur 'gro /deng sang zur chag pas/ o rgyan yul gyi 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ de yang chos 'byung mang po na lo lnga brgya re zer yang / rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das nas/ chos rgyal bar gyi lo grangs dang mi 'grig pas khungs che bar ma mthong zhing / yul de dag gi rjes su dbus 'gyur ma ga dhar bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgya nag gi rgyal po'i bsod nams kyi mthus/ rgya gar nas rgya nag tu rdzings la spyan drangs te/ma hā tsi na pa'i mchod pa'i zhing du bzhugs pa las/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos/ rgya rje'i sras mo 'o shing kong co/ bod skad du mtsho nang gi pad+ma zhes pa btsun mor spyan 'dren pa'i pho nyar/ gnam gyi mthongs nas mi yul du babs pa'i mgar gyi rigs las/ blon po rig pa can sogs mngags pas/rgya yis bod la btsun mo ster ma 'dod pa'i snyad du/ 'grub par dka' ba'i rtsal mang po ston btsug par/ mgar rgyas dka' ba med par bsgrubs/ kong co bod kyis thob ste/ gdul bya thun mong ba'i snang — 172

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long 'dangor/ kong cos mi 'dod pa ltar mdzad pa la/ blon po mgar gyi ram thon mi dang / 'bre brtse ru gung ston gnyis kyis bteg nas/e ma ngo mtshar che/ lha gcig kong co khyed/ /bdag gi tshig la gson/ /bkra shis nyams su dga'/ /bod kyi rgyal khams ni/ /rin cen sna las grub/ /rgyal po'i rdzo brang na/ /mi rje lha yis mdzad/ /srong btsan sgam po de/ /rigs gzugs dpal gyis brjid/ /mthong na sems yid 'phrog /thugs rje chen po lags/ /rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs/ /'bangs rnams bka' la nyan/ /rgyal blon 'khor 'bangs rnams/ /dga' skyid glu ru len/ /chos kyi nyi ma shar/ /(9ba bo pa la gyi sgron me bteg /ri la shing sna tshang / /sa gzhi yangs pa la/ 'bru sna lnga yi tshogs/ /go mtshams med par skyes/ /gser dngul zangs lcags sogs/ /rin cen du ma yod/ /gnag rta lug gsum rgyas/ /dga' skyid de ltar yod/ /e ma ngo mtshar che/ /lha gcig kong co gson/ /zhes spro ba bskyed pa'i glu blangs/ de nas kong cos yab rgyal po la/ /yab kyi mchod gnas yi dam lha/ thu kya mu ni bdag la zhu/ /zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ /de ltar phan bde'i 'byung gnas jo bo 'di/ /bdag gi snying dang 'dra bar phangs na yang / /mdzangs ma'i bu mo khyod la bdag gis brdzangs/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa te/ rgyal ba'i sku gzugs 'di nyid rten skal du gnang ba bod du spyan drangs/thog mar rgya btab ra mo che'i lha khang du bzhugs na'ang / dpon sras mang srong mang btsan gyi dus/ rgya dmag byung bar brten/ lho sgo me long du bcug nas sgo la zhal ba byas 'jam dbyangs kyi sku dris/ de nas rgyal rabs gnyis kyi tshe/ 'jong tsha lha dbon gyi btsun mor bsus pa'i rgya mo bzas nga'i a si'i lha khang bltar 'gro zhes ra mo cher phebs pa na/ shākya mu ni ma bzhugs pas/ lho sgo me long can du yod pa rtsis khog nas shes te spyan drangs nas gtsang khang dbus ma 'dir bzhugs su bcug /lha zhal mthong gi mchod pa rgya chen po btsugs pa yin no/ /sku'i g.yas g.yon na li las grub pa'i byams 'jam dbyangs/ sku rgyab tu sangs rgyas mar me mdzad/ deng sang mi 'gro gsung byon du grags pa 'od —173

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)zer 'phros pa'i lha/ de'i sku rgyab na zangs mkhar lo tsā bas bzhengs pa'i thub pa gangs chen 'tsho rgyal/ g.yas g.yon du sems dpa' sems ma bcu gnyis/ khro bo rkang zhing rnams/ gling phyag drug dpon pos bzhengs pa'i byams 'jam dbyangs/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i sku/ gzhan yang skor dpon byang chub (10na)sems dpa'i gdung khang / rgyal ba tsong kha pas rag nas bton pa'i rdo chen a mo long /dril gdang la mo'u gal gyis yum la ma ṇi 'dren 'jug pa'i dril bu rnams bzhugs so/ /'od dpag med kyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /paṇa chen tshul gyis bka' gdams bstan pa'i srol/ /'dzin mkhas di paṃ ka ra yab sras kyi/ /sku dang gang de'i lha mchog rje btsun ma/ /zhes pa ste/ gtsang khang gi phyi'i khyams na rim bzhin/ thub pa'i dbang po/ jo bo chen po lha gcig di paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na/ 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po/ nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba rnams lo tsā ba nyid kyi dus/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku/ sngon 'phags pa rin po ches rten phal mo che la snyan dar phul/ dar gcig phyag tu bsnams nas su la 'bul dgos dgongs the tshom yod pa'i tshe/ sgrol mas/'phags pa nga la yang dar thong gsungs pas sgrol ma dar len mar grags pa/ skor dpon byang chub sems dpa'i sku rnams so/ /rigs med kun la byams brtses rab bskul bas/ /rigs can mtha' dag kun mkhyen sar 'god phyir/ /rigs gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad sku/ /rigs ldan sa spyod kri kris bzhengs pa la/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal mnga' thugs rje'i 'od dpung gis/ /'gro ba'i mi shes mun pa bsrungs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ges rab tu gnas pa yi/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer 'phro ba'i mi pham pa /zhes pa ste/ gtsang khang nang du/ 'dzam bu gling pa tshe lo nyi khri ba'i dus su/ chos rgyal kri kris sbyin bdag byas nas li dmar las grub pa'i rje btsun mi pham mgon po'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa la/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyis rab tu gnas par ma zad 'di bal rje'i mchod pa'i rten du bzhugs pa las/ khri btsun/ chos rgyal gyi btsun mor 'byon pa'i (10bsgobs/ rten skal du thob/ lam du — /74

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long (dza)brag dang chu 'thabs zhabs thang la dngos su byon pa dang / phyis 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha ste ngo mtshar ba'i rten no/ /de'i 'khor du chos rgyal dus kyi sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob dang / spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gso rnams bzhugs/ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi gtsug lag 'od 'chang rdo'i/ /phud du bzhengs pa'i tshangs dang brgya byin gyis/ /'chi med gtso de rang min gnyis pa zhig /sa 'dir yod snyam blta phyir mkha' la lhags/ /zhes pa ste/ sgo 'gram gnyis na phyag na rdo rje sprul pa mnga' bdag khri ral gyis 'od 'chang rdo dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang brtsigs pa'i phud du bzhengs pa'i tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyi sku/ phyi'i khyams na rgyal ba tshe dpag med/ jo nang dol po pa/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ g.yung drung sbug tu gtsang dus mtha' dmag bzlog thabs su bzhengs pa'i dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi sku gnyis bzhugs so/ /mi mthun nad kyi tsha gdung kun bcil bas/ /ma smad thugs rje'i ga bur thigs pa 'bum/ /ches dkar 'gro la stsol ba'i sman pa'i rgyal/ /mchog dman yongs kyi spyod yul 'di na'o/ /zhes pa ste/ ldebs ris la sangs rgyas 'gran pa'i rgyal po 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha/ rim pa bzhin dus gsum sangs rgyas/ bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ tshal pa khri dpon gyis bzhengs pa'i chos rgyal yab yum gsum/ mon bza' khri lcam/ sras gung ri gung btsan/ blon po thon mi/ mgar/ zhang blon sna chen po rnams bzhugs so/ /rab dkar rin cen gnyis pa'i rdul brtsegs la/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i gtso gyur byams mgon gyis/ /rab mdzes mtshan dpe'i dpal 'dzin gzugs kyi sku/ /rab mang 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing (11na)du sdi/ba/ /ces pa ste/ gtsang khang nang du rgyal po glang dar gyis dus/ paṇ+ḍita tshul khrims nor gyis 'dzam la bsgrubs shing / rme ru'i 'dzam la'i thugs ga nas dngul bton par/ nye gnas kha che ut+pa —175

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)las/ dngul gar thugs kyi byams pa mched bzhi bzhengs pa'i ya rgyal/ rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i thugs dam rten gyi 'jam dbyangs/ klu mes kyis bzhengs pa'i kha san ni grab mda' lha khang spyan drangs pa/ bcu gcig zhal sangs rgyas 'od srungs kya phyag nas ma/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ stong chen rab 'byams/ so sor 'brang ma/ gshin rje mthar byed/ pad+ma mthar byed/ bgegs mthar byed/ 'dzam ser nag bdun po chos rgyal gyis dus/ ra ma rgya mo/ lha rje dge ba 'bum khong rang gi phyag nas ma rnams bzhugs so/ /'jam zhing ches dul ngag gi dpal thob pas/ /'jam dkar gzhen nu'i mkhyen par 'gran bzod pa/ /'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi gdung brgyud rim pa phreng / /'jam mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan gang des bskrun/ /gtsang khang gi phyi khyams na rim pa bzhin/ 'phags pa rin po che'i phyag tsha bzhugs pa'i mchod rten pad+ma spungs pa/ grub chen birlu ba/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'di thad kyi ldebs ris la/ rgya bza' phyi mas/ jo bo shākya mu ni lho sgo me long can nas gdan 'dren rtsis kyis sgo la zhal ba byas pa rnams bshig pas/ kho bo cung zad gzung bas chog ces gsung byon pas/ 'jam dbyangs kho yon mar grags pa/ sngar gyi 'gro la rje btsun sa paṇa/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan te/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud rnams bzhugs so/ /dge bcu'i khrims kyis (11ba)bod 'bangs ma lus pa/ /dga' ba'i pad+mo kun nas rgod pa'i tshul/ /ri mo 'phreng bar spel ba'i dzi na ka /blo ldan thod du 'ching ba'i rgyan gyi mchog /bla na med pa'i snying stobs btsan po can/ /'jig rten dbang phyug mi rje'i tshul 'dzin la/ /'jig rten dregs pa'i lha klu srin po yis/ /gtsug lag khang bzang bsrung bar g.yar dam bcas/ /ches pa ste/ de nas ldebs ris la srin po lang ka mgrin bcu'i grong khyer dang mtshungs pa'i pho brang dmar po ri dang /— 176

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long (lja)lcags po ri'i bkod pa/ bod 'bangs rnams dga' ston byas tshul gyi bkod pa dang / klu khang lho byang na klu'i rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ dga' bo/ nye dga'/ gnod sbyin nā ga 〈be+e ra/ dri za zur phud lnga pa/ ma hā kā la/ srin po'i rgyal po lang snamagrin bas rnams dang / seng ldeng sgo phyi ma'i nang gi lho byang na ge re lha pas bzhings pa'i trag shad dang phyag rdor byang / drel zhen dang rta mgrin lhan bzhugs nā ga ku be+e ra'i dar sham 'og nas sprul sku shākya 'od kyis mdo skor rnams brtan no/ /rnam mang 'gro la rab gzigs lus can gyi/ /gtsug tor ltar mtho 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa'i tshogs/ /thams cad la skyob 'dzam bu'i gser mdangs can/ /thub mchog 'od srungs nyi ma'i gnyen gyi sku/ /rgyal ba'i pho brang bar gyi lding khang na/ /rab bzhugs skye dgu'i mchod sdong bla med la/ /chosaldan rgyal po'i phyag gi man+ta ra/ /'thor zhing byin gyis brlabs pa 'di na bzhugs/ /zhes pa ste/ bar khang nub phyogs kyi gtsang khang dbus ma na/ sangs rgyas rab bdun chos rgyal gyi phyag nas ma/ bla ma dung dkar 'brug grags kyis bzhengs pa'i chos rgyal yab yum gsum/sras gung ri gung btsan/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa yab sras gsum/ dkar me bskul byang dus mchode pa'i chos rgyal yab yum gsum tshal dus ma/ g.yin yang khyams dang sgo (12na khong thams cad du sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku gzugs/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas shing / khyad par 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha/ lho na sgrol dkar dang / nub na rta mgrin gnyis bzhugs/dpal ldan rgyal ba kun gyi bstan srung che/ /dpal mo'i snyems pa 'phrog pa'i mdzes sdug can/ /dpal 'byor 'dod dgu mtha' dag stsol mdzad pa'i/ /dpal gyi lha mo'i sku gzugs dbang po'i gzhu /rab dkar 'jam pa'i rtsig ngos lha lam la/ /rab tu rnam par bkra ba shar ba'i tshe/ / rab brjid sa yi brgya byin mchog de yis/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung bar bskos/ /zhes pa ste/ be dbar sbug na chos rgyal gyi dus bzhengs pa'i dpal lha mo'i bris sku byin rlabs can/ byang phyogs na bla ma zhang gi sgrub khang / lho na slob dpon chen po'i bzhags pa khang rnams so/ /—177—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shelhun po'i mdzes pa 'phrog pa'i pho brang gi /yang rtser mchog gsum dam pa'i sku gzugs kyi/ /spel legs phreng bar byas tshe skabs gsum pa'i/ /chos bzang mdun sa sa 'dir 'ongs sam snyam/ /zhes pa ste/ thugs rje chen po'i gser thog 'og tu tshal pa'i nang gnyer bkra shis kyis bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba shākya thub pa sman bla bde gshegs mched bdun rnams la sems dpa' dang gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon rnam thos kyi sras kyis bskor ba/ jo bo rin po che'i dbu thog tu dpon wo dbang brtson gyis bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / chos rgyal gyis dus mi 'gro gsung byon gyi 'khor na yod pa'i sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo gnyis dang bcas pa rnams bzhugs/ dpal lha lcog tu/ chos rgyal nyid kyi shangs mtshal gyi bris pa'i dpal lha mo'i thod sku nang gi ye shes/ (12ba)sems dpa'i tshul du byas nas da lta'i 'bur sku khro chags brjid pa'i rnam 'gyur can 'di nyid tshal pa khri dpon gyi dus sprul sku mgo gru bzhis bzhengs/ seng ldeng sgo khang gi rtser ming dngos bkra shis khri sgo/ da lta gnas bcu khang du grags pa 'di ni/ sa skya las bod khri skor bcu gsum la bdag byed pa'i dus kyi dpon chen gong lo ta'i hu si tu ston ching dben shrī dbang phyug brtson 'grus kyis bzhengs pa yin la/ nang gi rten yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba/g.yang rtse rgyal po'i pho brang na bzhugs pa la dpe blangs/ dge bsnyen dharma ta la rgya nag cung do mkhar gyi hong then sing rgya'i rgyal po ta'i gim gyi dus su gnas brtan spyan drangs te dbyar gnas mdzad tshe bris pa'i thang sku dang / klu mes 'brom chung gis leb par spyan drangs pa rnams la dpe byas/ dbang hā shang dang 'bacas pa 'a lder sku brag ri rnam par bkra ba'i phug pa rnams su bzhugs pa/ gdung mtshams su 'jam dpal dbyangs dang byams mgon sogs bla ma rnams 'phags pa nor bzang gis ji ltar bsten tshul/ phal po che'i mdo las byung ba'i brgyud ris rgya'i lha bzos bris/ gzhan yang dpal sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dang / jing gir hor gyi rgyal brgyud rnams kyi sku dang / phyi khyams su rnam sras sprin gseb ma/ rgyal chen bzhi sogs ngo mtshar bar bzhugs pa'i rab gnas chos rje bla ma dam pa dang /— /78—

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long / (dzadamathun rkyen sde srid phag mo gru pas mdzad/ gzhan yang gtsug lag khang dngos gzhi'i phyi nang gi gad spang / ka gzhu thams cad la skye bo gso thigs dang / sgrung gi lo rgyus gsal bar bkod do/ /longs spyod 'dod dgu'i 'o mtshor rab 'byud zhing / /dga' zhing skyid pa'i skad snyan ches(13na)cher sgrog /mi mthun mun tsho gos ring nas skrod byed cing / /legs byas pad dkar gzhen nu 'dzum zhing g.yo/ /chos nor gter gyi rin cen sgrom bu la/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i phyag rgyas legs spras pas/ /grangs med yon tan phung po byung ngo zhes/ /srong btsan gsung las mi 'gyur zhal gyis bzhes/ /zhes pa ste/ ka ba shing lo can dang nye ba'i sar chos dang gser dngul zangs lcags kyi gter yod pas mtha' bzhi'i 'dod dgu mtha' dag 'byung / ka ba sprul mgo can dang nye ba'i sar drag sngags mthu'i gter yod pas mtha' dmag dang log 'dren gyi gnod pa zhi/ ka ba seng mgo can dang nye ba'i sar phyugs kyi g.yang yig sbas pas dkar thog bcud dang ldan/ rin po che rat+na : wa sprul lpags kyis bstums nas klu khang du yod pas lo phyugs legs/ rin po che stag sha : wa gzi'i sgom bur bcug nas rdza la'i 'og tu yod pas rgyan gosahrū nor 'phel/ be+e ḍūr+ya lhung bzed klu khang du yod pas longs spyod 'phel/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor chen mo'i 'og dang / gnod sbyin na ga ku be+e ra'i brla g.yas su rin po che du ma sbas te/ ma 'ongs pa na gtsug lag khang gso ba'i thebs su phan pa'i smon lam mdzad/ bstod pa sum cu par/ gang du rgyal po'i bka' chems gter du sbas/ /mkha' 'gros gter kha phye nas khyod la gtad/ khres pa ltar/ jo bo chen pos gtsug lag khang gi lo rgyus dris par/ rgyal po srong btsan gyis bzhengs zer ba las ma byung ba'i tshe/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor mas lung bstan/ ka ba shing lo can nas bka' chems bka' khol ma gter nas bzhes pas/ da
