lta'i bar du skye bo kun la 'phrul snang gi rten dang brten pa'i byung tshul gsal bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin mtha' yas so/ /(13ba)bar skor gyi phyi na nyag re rin cen grags kyis bzhengs pa'i sgrol ma lha khang / ār+ya lha —179

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyekhang na spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong gi sku li las grub pa sogs bzhugs/ chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis bzhengs pa'i byams pa khrom gzigs/ de yang blon gong rgyal pos der sku chen po zhig byung nas dpyad nyams 'gro ba shes nas byams pa'i sku 'di bzhengs pa'i ched du/ khrom la gnod pa chen po byas par de bzlog thabs su bzhedas pa/ 'phral phan pa ltar byung yang / don nyang dogs bar gyi ri glang po che g.yul du zhugs pa 'dra ba'i sna nas kyang stobs po ches 'then pa lta bu yod pa sa dpyad nyams te bod 'dir 'thab rtsod dang mtha' dmag gi gnod pa mang du byung ba de sprul sku rat+na gling pa/ mnga' ris pa paṇa chen/ rig 'dzin chen po legs ldan rdo rje/ 'phreng mgo gter bton shes rab 'od zer rnams kyi gter lung du gsal lo/ /bskor lam phyi ma'i shar zur na bzhugs pa'i lo ma gyon pa'i rdo sku ni/ sngon bskor 'bum pa rnams kyi bar chad bsrung phyir nub phyogs su bzhugs kyang / phyis chu'i gnod pa yang bsrung ba'i phyir shar lho 'dir bzhugs/ gzhan yang byang na bdud rtsi'i 'o ma'i chu rgyun/ nub na rdo ring gnam gyi ka ba/ dkyil 'khor sdings na rdo thung sa'i lte ba sogs phun sum tshogs pa mtha' yas so/ /de ltar phan bde'i gzhir gyur rten brten pa'i/ /'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid la/ /zla bral srid zhur bskrun pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /dri za'i phang 'gro'i sgra las cis mi snyan/ /dbang chen 'dzin ma'i rgyan gyur ra sa la/ /dbang bcu brnyes pa'i mkhas grub du ma dang / /ba bang phyug brgyad ldan rgyal dbang tsong kha pa/ dbang gis las bkas mngon mtho phag gru sogs/ /mdor na skye rgu'i dge ba'i sa bon dag /mchod (14na dzil dam pa'i zhing sar yongs btab pas/ /'phral yun legs tshogs 'bar ba'i 'bras bu la/ /'dzad med longs su spyod pa'i dga' ston rgyas/ /zhes pa ste/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang rten brten pa dang bcas pa 'di nyid bod dang bod chen po'i 'gro ba tsam du ma zad/ lhar bcas skye dgu kun gyi legs byas kyi sgo brgya phrag 'byed pa'i yul yin pas/ sngon jo bo chen po a ti sha phebs skabs/ lha sa'i — /80

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long lja)thang du lha'i bu bu mo mang pos nam mkha' nas mchod pa 'bul ba gzigs pa'i lo rgyus ltar/ 'di dang 'di zhes tshad du bzung ste brjod pa'i yul las 'gong yang / dngos bstan mkhas grub kyi dam pa rnams dang / rgya bod/ hor/ mnga' ris/ ya rtse sogs kyi rgyal blon 'bangs kyis bkur sti srid zhu mdzad pa'i tshul rigs pa tsam brjod pa'i tshon/ spyir chos rgyal nyid kyis dpon sras rnams la/gtsug lag khang 'di 'ding ba'i sa phud rdo phud 'phrul snang 'di nyid du 'bul dgos pa gsungs pa'i don gong du rags rim smos pa ltar dang / gzhan yang mnga' bdag khri ral gyi mchod gnas nyang sha'i spyan dang blon po 'gas/ shar du ka ru dang rme sa lhor dga' ba dang dga' ba'i 'od/ byang du brang khang dang brang khang tha ma'i lha khang bzhengs/ rab tu byung ba'i sdebatsugs/ bod cho ge rgyal gyi gdung brgyud dri ma med pa/ ya rtse rgyal po ril po mal gyis/ jo bo rin po che'i dbu thog tu gser thog phub/ ya rtse rgyal po sras pra ti ma la dang / blon po dpal ldan grags gnyis kyis thugs rje chen po'i dbu thog tu gser thog phub/ mnga' bdag myang dang gter ston chos kyi dbang phyug gis mar me'i mchod pa'i rgyun mang du spel/ lha rje dge ba'i 'bum gyis gtsug lag khang gi rtsig pa phyi ma'i gsar (14ba)bcos dang / rags kyi zhabs tog /rgya phibs 'khor ma bsgrubs/ zangs mkhar lo tsā bas shar gyi glo 'bur bskyed cing nang gi sku gzugs mang du bzhengs/ sgam po zla 'od gzhen nu khu dbon gyis/ rgyab yol zhig gsos sogs kyi zhabs tog dang / khyad par dwags po sgom tshul gtsug lag khang 'di nyid kyi bsnyen bkur zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa la sgrub dgos tshul ched gnyer du mdzad pas/ des lha sa'i zhabs tog la dmigs pa'i tshal gung pa sdebatsugs/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas mu tig dang byu ru spel ba'i rnam sbyar phul/ sa dpon chen gyi thog ma shākya bzang pos bal po a ni ka gu'i gung la bzo bar zhus nas/ jo bo rin po che'i gdan khri rgyab yol khyad 'phags phul/ hor rgyal po'i sras stod du sprugs pa hu la dus dngul kong phul/ tshal pa khri dpon hos dga' bde bzang pos lcags khra'i thog chen bcu gnyis thog 'thud dang bcas pas ka ba —181—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyebacu drug gi zhabs tog mdzad/ slob dpon ār+ya de was khyams stod kyi glo 'bur lto bzhengs/ dpon chen dbang brtson gyis khri sgo bkra shis sgo mangs bzhengs/ sde srid phag mo gru pa ta'i sī tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi mchod pa dang zhabs tog mtha' yas pa mdzad/ rgya nag gong ma ta ming rgyal pos mu tig gi snam sbyar gnyis dang / gser kong phul/chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po ni/ bka' chems bka' khol ma las/ de nas khyad par bsnyen bkur cher mdzad pa/ dge slong byang sems shar phyogs sku 'khrungs pa'i/ /gsang sngags 'chang ba'i rnal 'byor chen po ni/ /snying po'i mtha' can skyes chen dam pa 'byung / /zhal yang bsgyur zhing bsnyen bkur dam pa mdzad/ /ces lung bstan la/ bstan tshul ni/ shar phyogs tsong kha'i yul du 'khrungs pa dang / 'jam dpal snying po'i (15nasgo tshan dang ldan pas snying po'i mtha' can/ dbu rgyan phul te/ shākya mu ni sprul sku las longs skur zhal bsgyur zhing / cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa rgya chen po/ ji srid thub bstan rin po che gnas pa de srid du rgyun bzang po 'dzugs pa gnang ba yin no/ /gzhan yang rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa/ rdo rje gling pa sogs khungs ma mang po'i gter lung du rje bla ma la bsngags brjod shin tu che ba yod/ sde pa snang rtse bas lung bstan ngan pa byed pa ni rang nyid gter rdzus pa yin par gsal bar byed pa'o/ /de yang sngar lugs gnyis nas mngon par mtho ba'i skyes bu du mas gtsug lag khang 'di nyid la bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa mdzad na'ang / bar skabs su cung zad nyams te yod pa'i skabs/ sne gdong gong ma chen po dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan 'di nyid la srid zhu bla lhag tu bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen mdzad dgos pa'i bka' gnang / sde srid rin po ches kyang sne'u pa nam mkha' bzang po dang / brag dkar ba sogs skyid 'phan gyi rdzong gnyer rnams la/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i bka' bzhin du bsgrub bcug ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus chen khyad par can/ dge 'dun khri rwa can la bsnyen bkur/ rtsam — /82

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long (dza)khal stong las bzhengs pa'i lha bsgos/ kong rgya mtsho chen pos thog drangs pa'i mar me kong lnga brgya tsam/ sku rnams rang rang dang mthun pa'i na bza'/ jo bo'i sku la gser chab/ gzhan yang kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin la 'gran par nus pa'i lha mchod mi mchod rgya chen po gnang / snga dro 'gro ba rnams dad pa bskyed pa'i slad du/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa las brtsams pa'i (15bgyi srungasarabs so bzhi pa'i bka' chos dang / phyi dro smon lam gyi rim pa sogs phyag len du bstar/ jo bo rin po che la gser gyi dbu rgyan/ thugs rje wo po la dngul gyi dbu rgyan/ jo bo la dngul gyi lhung bzed dang / dngul dam rta mgo ma gter nas bzhes te phul/ nyang ser sman ri nas rdo gter bton nas/ rdo mo ches thog drangs/ khyams dang bar skor gyi rdo gcal brjes/ gnam g.yengs rdo rje'i rwa ba ka ba bstoganyis/ thog 'thud ka ba bcu/ khyams ka ba bcu rnams sne'u rdzong pa la bka' gnang ste bsgrubs/ bar skabs su skor ba'i rgyun 'gribs pa slar dar rgyas su mdzad pa sogs chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sa'i zhabs tog pa/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa nyid 'gran zla ma mchis pa yin no/ /gzhan yang gzhis ka sne'u pas kyang spang gdan phan tshun bzo ba dang / drung chen rin po che ta'i sī tu sogs phag gru'i sde srid gong ma rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs la dmigs pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po bsgrubs/ spyan snga chos kyi grags pas jo bo'i bzhugs bstod/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos/ jo bo'i dbu thog tu gser gyi bla bre phul/ al tan chos kyi rgyal pos dngul srang stong rwa can las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang de'i sras bu dha shrīs gser kyi maṇ+ḍal phul/ 'brug pa sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang nor bus/ thugs rje chen por rang byon lnga ldan gyi sku yo bsrong bar mdzad/ 'ga' zhig rang shugs kyis 'brongs 'gro rgyu la/ bcos pas chag grums byung bar gleng / stag lung chos rje dang /skyid shod sde pa bkra shis rab brtan pa thun mong nas/ jo bo'i gser thog gi zhig gsos mdzad/thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtshos/ jo bo rin po che'i khri rgyab gsar brjes/ rgyab yol la mdzad bcu 'bur dod/ 'od skor bar ma la dngul gal blugs kyi (16na gi nas bcu/ 'od skor nang —183

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)ma la gser gar brdungs kyis dpal ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa sogs dang /rin po che'i 'phra tshoms kyis bkod pa bzhengs/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po bsod nams rab brtan gyis dngul las grub pa'i bzhugs khang rgya phibs nyis brtsegs bkod pa khyad du thon pa/ yi ge drug pa'i 'phrin las pa ma ṇi ba dung dkar 'brug grags kyis bar skor gyi ldebs ris zhig gsos bsgrubs/sde pa gtsang pa phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis mchod 'bul gyi rim pa rgyun mi chod par btsugs/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po ches/ thugs rje chen po'i gser thog gi zhig gsos gnang / dga' ldan pho brang gzhung nas mda' yab gsar brjes/ dbu rgyan gyi zhig gsos/ phyi nang gi 'phan bla bre maṇ+ḍal sogs mchod pa'i rim pa gsar du bsgrigs pa'i bkod pa khyad thon/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal/ da las kun ji rgyal mos/ jo bo'i dbu rgyan zhig gsos med du byung ba gsar du bzhengs pa lta bu dang / mu tig gi snam sbyar/ dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal phul/ ju nang rgyal po/ dbon po hung tha'i ji/ khar kha thu shal thu rgyal ba sogs sog po tsho chen drug o rod dang bcas pa'i rgyal po dang dpon che chung gis dngul srang stong tsam las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang / dbon sa g.yang sogs mdo stod mdo smad kyi 'byor ldan du mas gser kong phul ba ni mtha' yas/ dga' ldan pho brang nas jo bo rin po che'i gser thog gsar brjes/ byams pa mchod bzhi'i steng du gser thog gsar 'bigs/klu rgyal steng dang mda' g.yabs kyi gong gab rnams gser zangs kyis gsar brjes/ khyams khra chen mor da las kun ji rgyal mos mthun rkyen phul ba dang bcas/ cho 'phrul mchod (16ba)pa'i dus sogs dge 'dun gyi kun dga' rwa ba phul du byung ba/ mdor na yul dbus ma ga dha rdo rje gdan nas bzung / rgya mtsho chen po'i mtha' klas pa tshun gyi yangs pa'i sa chen por 'khod pa'i mchog dman mtha' dag gis rang rang gi 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i mchod pa'i phung po ji snyed cig phul bas/mtha' dag ni brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa lta bu'o/ /e ma mchod sbyin brgya yi bsod nams kyis/ /'chi med dbang po'i go 'phang nyer thob na/ /— 184

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long (dzada'adzam gling 'gran zla bral ba'i zhing mchog la/ /mchod pa'i bsod nams pha mtha' sus gzhal nus/ /gang 'di cung zad mthong thos dran pas kyang / /grangs med yon tan phung po 'byung ngo zhes/ /srong btsan rang gis zhal gyis 'tshes pa la/ /yid brtan mi byed bdud kyis brlams sam ci/ /bod 'bangs 'gro la phyag na pad+ma'i zhabs/ /srong btsan rgyal por sprul la nges brnyed na/ /phyag skor mchod sogs bsod nams tshogs bsags par/ yang dag 'bras bu byung bar the tshom med/ /ces pa ste/ de yang gtsug lag khang rten brten par bcas pa mthong ba'i yon tan ni/ chos rgyal nyid kyi gsung las/ gcig mthong na ngan song gi sgo chod/ gnyis mthong na lha mi'i lus thob nas thar pa 'thob/ gsum mthong na dug gsum rang sar zhi nas sku gsum la sbyor nus/ zhes dang /thos pa'i yon tan ni/ dud 'gro'i rna lam du thos kyang dud 'gro'i lus las grol nas thar lam gyi sne zin no/ /lha mis thos nas thar pa 'thob/ dran pa'i yon tan ni/ yi dam de rnams kyi yon tan rjes su dran na bskal pa lnga stong gi sgrib pa 'dag cing mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa 'thob bo/ /zhes pa dang / gzhan yang lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas skor ba byas pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i sa bcu dang / kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes sogs 'thob (17na)pa'i sa bon 'jog pa dang / 'phagasayul rdo rje gdan/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod sogs kyang 'di nyid las lhag pa med pas/gtsug lag khang 'di la mjal zhing mchod pa thams cad kyang / gnas de dag mjal zhing mchod pa yin no/ /de yang mdo las/ khyim bdag dpal skyes kyi mngon mtho'i sa bon shin tu phra ba sangs rgyas nyag gcig ma gtogs/ dgra bcom pa g.yin rnams kyis ma gzigs par gsungs pa ltar/ dge ba shin tu phra bas kyang mngon mtho nges legs rgya chen po bskrun nus pas/ gtsug lag khang 'di dag gi phyi'i rags dang / nang gi zhig gsos/ gser chab/ mar me/ lha bshos/ na bza'/ snyan dar/'phan gdugs sogs mchod pa'i rim pa dang / phyag dang bskor ba byas pa'i dge ba'i phan yon ni/lce brgya phrag du mas bskal par brjod kyang rdzogs pa'i yul las 'gong la/ dge ba'i 'bras bu lha —185

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)dang mi'i dbang phyug dam pa tsam la spyod pa'am/ gnas skabs su de lta bur spyod cing / mthar thug bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba dag ni/ rgya mtsho'i chu la ba tshwas ro bsgyur ba ltar/smon lam dang sems bskyed rgya che chung gi rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa yin no/ /rgya gar dbus kyi lha mchog mu ni rgyu/ /rgya nag yul las brgyud de gangs can 'dir/ /rgya chen dpag yas legs byas kyis drangs tshe/ /rgya btab ra mo che yi gnas 'dir bzhugs/ /lag na pad+mas dregs ldan bod kyi mi/ /'dul ba'i grogs su snying stobs go cha yis/ /smon lam lhan cig btab pa'i legs byin ma/ /lha gcig kong co'i tshul gyis rdzu la brten/ /rgya bod dbon sras gzugs pa'i g.yul bkye ba'i/ /byed pos gtsug lag zung gi sku brnyan rten/ /phan tshun ched du gnyer nas brjes pa 'di/ /gser (17bsgong la can gyis min pa gzhan su zhig /ces pa ste/ rgya btab ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid du/ thog mar rgya nag po'i mchod gnas/ gser gyi lha shākya mu ni bzhugs pa yin na'ang / dbon zhang zhakhrug long byung ba'i tshe/ lho sgo me long can du bzhugs su bcug pa las/ slar shākya mu ni ra sa'i gtsang khang dbus ma dang / mi bskyod rdo rje ra mo cher bzhugs pa yin zhing / de yang bod chos rgyal gyis blon po mgar la sogs pa'i pho nya mang po bal yul du mngags te/ jo mo khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa lha gcig khri btsun/ btsun mor bsus pa'i dus su khri btsun gyis/ rang gi yab bal rje la/ de 'dra'i mtha' 'khob gnas su bdag mchi na/ /bdag gi bsod nams gsog pa'i mchod gnas su/ /yab kyi mchod gnas shākya mu ni zhu/ /zhes gsol ba'i lan du/ bdag gi mchod gnas shākya mu ni ni/ /yon bdag lha yi dbang pos byas pa yin/ /rgyu ni rin cen sna tshogs las grub pa/ /bzo bo lha yi bi shwa kus sa byas/ /de yang sangs rgyas nyid kyis byin rlabs yin/ /rgyal ba nyid kyis rab tu gnas par mdzad/ /gang zhig da lta mchod pa byas pa dang / /'das nas sku gzugs mchod pa khyad med gsungs/ /zhes sogs bslab bya mang po dang bcas nas brdzangs pa'i tshe/ brag dang chu 'thab pa'i 'phrang la zhabs thang la 'phebs pa dang / /86

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long (pe'od zer 'phros pa'i lha yin no/ /spyir yang brgya byin gyis sbyin bdag byas nas/ rgyal ba nyid dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad du bzhengs par/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi rab gnas mdzad/ jo bo shākya mu ni dang 'di nyid sku rgyu gcig par chos 'byung 'ga' zhig tu snang ba ni/ rin cen sna tshogs 'dus par bshad pa dang gungs 'grig pa tsam yin zhing / thub pa lha yul ma jo bo'i bzo phud du bzhed pa (1zhaskor na dpyad dgos so/ /'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i tsan dan gyi sgrol ma'i sku/ thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal gso 'di da lta ma bzhugs kyang zer/ mchog zung gnyis kyi gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten gnyis/ 'khor nye ba'i sras brgyad po chos rgyal gyi dus/ sgo 'gram g.yas g.yon na phyag rdor dang khro bo dbyug sngon can/rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i sku 'dra nyid kyi phyag gnas ma/ mdo khyams na sangs rgyas stong / mdzad bcu/gnas bcu'i ldebs ris rnams she pa dkon mchog phan bdes do dam byas nas bsgrubs pa/ khyams kyi phyi na se ba'i sdong po zhig la srog shing byas nas bzhengs pas mgon po se sdong mar grags shing /'ga' zhig mgon po beng dmar yin par 'dod la/ lho brag grub chen gyi rnam thar du/ ra mo'i che'i khyams su nub gcig bzhugs pas/ mi nag po zhig 'ongs nas lung bstan mdzad pa dang / de mgon po gri gug yin par ngos 'dzin gnang 'dug pas/ don la gnas pa yin no/ /gtsug lag khang 'di nyid la/ lha rje dge ba 'bum/ mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer sogs kyis mchod pa'i srol rgya chen po mdzad cing / sa skya'i dpon chen po shākya bzang pos khri rgyab gsar du bcos/ tshal pa khri dpon gyisaphyi nang gi zhig gsos do dam mdzad/ chos kyi rgyal po myong kha pa chen pos dngul gyi dbu rgyan dang / cho 'phrul gyi dus su mchod pa mtha' klas pa phul/ dpon sa lho ngos mas chos rje dpal ldan pa la skye brtag zhus pas/ chu srin skye zhing / de bzlog thabs la dge 'dun stong rwa can gyis sman bla'i mdo chog ston na bzlog zer 'byung bas/ cho 'phrul gyi dus su zhag drug gi ring / jo bo mi skyod rdo rje 'di nyid kyi sku gas su/ tsha gung gi tsho gos la sman bla dang / dgong (1sha ba thirgo smon lam chen po ji lta ba'i —187

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shergyun btsugs/ 'di la brten dpon sa lho ngos ma'i chu srin gyi skye brtag de sne'u gdong gong ma'i yin par go ste/ snang rtse pas smon lam che chung gi sbyin bdag nor nas lung bstan ngan pa byas snang /gter gton pa'i rat+na gling pa'i gter gnas la dpags nas zhig po gling pa dang 'gro 'dul gling pa/ zhes don gcig ming gi rnam grangs khyad tshang brag zer ba ni khyung chen zer rgyu la yi ge nor ba yin/dgongs 'dus kyi lung bstan chings lnga par/ las kyi dbang gis dgongs 'dus dar ba'i tshe/ dpe dkar snying zhugs 'dra min gtor chos rtsom/ zhes pa'i lung bstan yul snang rtse nas yin 'di pas bdud du byas pa'i tshe'i bdud kyi las de mkhas btsun grub pa'i rnam thar/ snang rtse pa rang sangs rgyas su khas blangs pa'i mdzad pa de ci 'dug brtags tshe lus rten rab byung dang dkar po ba gang du yang mi gtogs pa'i mi nag dar dom can/ spyod pa sde pa skyid shod pa'i dmag dpon/ rnam dpyod ki rkang gis bsgrig rtsom tha snyad gang yang med pa de dang sprang sgrub rnams yin pas dpyod ldan gyis bltas na ha ha dang hi lha'i yul yin la 'on kyang 'brug pa lung pa sog zlog pa gong ra ba sogs bdud kyi rjes 'brang shin tu mang ngo / /da las gun ji rgyal mos gser 'jang brdungs kyi dbu rgyan rin po che'i 'phra tshoms kyis brgyan pa phul/gnam lcags lta bur bsra mkhregs btsan po'i rir/ /rgyal dbang pad+mas rjes gzung thang stong pas/ /bzhengs pa'i sku dang nang rten byin rlabs kyi/ /sprin phung mkha' la snyeg pa'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes pa ste/ lcags kha ri 'di phyag na rdo rje'i bla ri/ seng ge gnam du mchong pa lta bu'i dbyibs su yod cing / gtsug lag khang gi nang rten du gter btan thang stong rgyal po'i sku 'dra nyid kyi phyag nas ma/khams mo mi nyag mas dung gi ngos gcig phul ba de/ thang stong pas chad lhag med par bzhedas (19na)pa'i thugs rje chen po g.yu las grub pa'i don yod grub pa/ g.yu'i sgrol ma gsung byon/ byu ru'i tshe dpag med/ mu men gyi phyag rdor/ gaṅgā sgo bzhi na thang stong pa bzhugs skabs/ mkha' 'gros sku rgyu rnams phul ba la/ dung las grub pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro /spos shel las grub pa'i rin cen mkha' — 188

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long (dzada'agro /mu men las grub pa'i sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro /byu ru las grub pa'i pad+ma mkha' 'gro /g.yu lasagrub pa'i las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyi sku dang / tsan dan dkar po las grub pa'i slob dpon chen po/ thang stong pa'i slob ma bstan 'dzin nyi bzang gi pur bzhugs pa'i gser gdung / seng ge ral pa'i gser 'bum/ gter btan nyid kyi dbu lo/ zhabs rjes/ ral gri dang / gter rdzas 'ga' zhig yod par grags/ bong ba ri ni/ stag mo bye khung 'dzul 'dra/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bla ri yin no/ /sa 'dzin bu mo'i mngal khur lto ba na/ /mngon par 'phags pa'i gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i ri/ /rtsod pa'i dus kyi 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi/ /pho brang dmar po ri zhes phyogs kun grags/ /ye shes rdul mang brtsegs pa'i phung po la/ /zhi dang khro bo'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /grangs med skye dgu'i nyer 'tshe yin no zhes/ /'chi med bu mo'i rgyud mang sgra las thos/ /seng ge'i rgyud las 'ongs pa'i dbyangs snyan pos/ /ma rungs gcan gzan khengs pa 'phrog pa ltar/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang na/ /tshar du dngar ba'i rten gsum bzhugs so kye/ /zhes pa ste/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi bla ri glang po che bres la nyal ba lta bu/ ming dngos dmar po ri'am po ta lar grags pa 'di nyid du/ sngar bal bza' khri btsun gyis srin po lang ka mgrin bcu'i grong khyer la 'gran par nus pa'i pho brang / ri'i rtsa ba na mkhar dgu brgya dang dgu bcu (19ba)so dgu rtse mo na gcig dang stong yod par grags pa ltar/ bod rgyal po'i pho brang gi lhe ba yin zhing / da lta'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid kyi nang du/ rgyal po rang nyid kyi sku phyag nas ma/ des 'phags pa lo gī shwa ra gar bzhugs su zhal ston par mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi phung po ngo mtshar ba/ 'khor du rgya bza'/ bal bza'/ sras gung ri gung btsan/ blon po mgar/ thon mi/ ka gdong du 'jam dpal gshin rje gdong drug gi sku sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyis rab gnas mdzad pa'i byin rlabs can/ sngar 'od 'chang rdo na bzhugs pa/ de la me'i gnod pa byung dus nam mkha' la 'phur te brag lha klu sbug nas brgyud de phebs pa/ khyung po rnal 'byor gyi thugs dam rten tsan dan las grub pa'i phyag drug pa/—189

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyebacu gcig 'kha/ rta mgrin/ rgyal po yab yum gsum gyi thang rnying me thub ma/ spyan ras gzigs kyi thang sku rwa sgreng gi me thub ma sogs dang / chos rgyal gyis sprul pa'i dge slong a ka ra ma ti bal yul du btang nas/ rgya bal gyi sa mtshams kyi nags khrod chen po zhig na tsan dan gyi sdong po 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba zhig 'dug pa de dum bu bzhin bcad pa las/ 'phags pa dza ti/ 'phags pa dbu khang / 'phags pa 'ja' ma li/ 'phags pa lo ka shwa ra mchod bzhi byung bas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'di nyid bod rgyal po'i gnas su spyan drangs te/ dmar po ri 'dir bzhugs pa las/ dus phyis skyid shod sde pa g.yul rgyal nor bus gzhis ka brag dkar du spyan drangs/ mi ring bar thu med kyi se chen tha'i ji la byung bas mtha' 'khob kyi yul gru du mar 'khyar te yod pa'i skabs/ gnam gyis bsgos pa'i bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i bsod nams chen po'i dpung gis/ bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams thams cad rang dbang du byas te/ dga' ldan pho brang dang / bstan 'dzin (20na)chos kyi rgyal po mchod yon nyi zla zung 'brel gyi khrims btsan pos yangs pa'i sa thams cad rgyal khams rgan mo gser khur lta bur spyod pa'i dus su/ o ḍi yā na'i rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i lung bstan gyis yongs su zin pa'i snyan pa'i rnga bo che dpyod ldan yongs kyi rna lung du mdzes pa'i dus la bab pa nas/ sa skyong zhes pa shing mo bya'i lo/ dus 'khor ba'i lo'i thog ma/ nag pa zla ba'i 'grub sbyor shis pa'i nyin/ sngon dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang 'ding ba'i tshe/ dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i sgo nas sa gzhi btul ba ltar/ 'dir yang 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor chen po de la brten nas sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs te/ sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes kyi dga' ba dang po la pho brang chen po'i rmang bting ba dang dus mtshungs par ched du gnyer nas bsgrigs pa min pa la rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i rten 'brel ni/ snying stobs dang /brtson 'grus rnam dpyod mtshungs pa med pa'i sa dbang rgyal mo da las gun jis 'bad rtsol chen pos yul gzhan nas blangs te/ mtsho khri shor rgyal mo nas sku 'dra rin po che 'di nyid gnyer gyis 'bul — /90

lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkar chag shel dkar me long / (dza)bar mañju shri tshong rje dang / sba bal chi shi pa gan jas gtsos pa'i gser yig pa mngags pa dus mtshungs su 'grig ste/ sku 'dra rin po che lha sa nas po ta lar gdan drangs skabs/ rab tu byung ba dang / skye bo'i tshogs mtha' klas pas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i mchod pa skabs gsum pa'i longs spyod la 'gran par bzod pa dag gis mdun bdar/ nam mkha' las lha rnams kyis kyang mchod pa'i ltas su mchog dman kun gyi mig lam du chug pa'i me tog gi char dang / 'ja' tshon gyis phyogs rnams bkrigs (20ba spro shing / dge mtshan rgya mtsho'i dpal kun tu 'bar ba dang bcas te phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po 'di nyid kyi rten gyi gtso bor phebs pa yin no/ /phul byung sku gsum chu gter ma lus ma smad tshogs gnyis gser ldan rnams/ /rab bsrubs las thon phyag na pad dkar pad ma'i gnyen gyi dkyil 'khor gyis/ /srong btsan rol gar 'od kyi sa 'gangs sa la'i ljongs kyi sti ma ra/ /dga' ba'i zlos gar kun nas legs bsgyur legs pa'i yon tan phreng ba spel/ /mang thos mig dkyus dkyus ring mchog tu mdzes/ /mdzes ldan shes rab rab tu gsal zhing yangs/ /yangs pa'i rnam dpyod dpyod ldan tshar du dngar/ /dngar ba'i legs bshad bshad tshe mkhas rnam mgu/ /skal bzang ka shi mdzes dga'i zur phud la/ /gtam rgyud man dha ra yi thod bcings tshe/ /rab mdzes mig stong can gyi dga' ma yang / /skyabs te sum rtsen gnas su bros kyi dogs/ /dkar 'jam shing gi ma ma'i ngos yangs por/ /deb ther ri dwags gzugs can 'jo sgeg gi /mdzes sdug lang tsho ma bzod bsil zer can/ /chu gter chen po'i klong du song ba bzhin/ /mkhas rnams dga' ba'i snyan ngag rgyan ldan la/ /mchog dman gang gis bltas kyang go bde ba'i/ /mkhas blun kun la nyer mkho'i dkar chag 'di/ /byed po tshangs pa yin yang ci zhig 'grub/ zhan tu 'jam zhing mkhregs pa'i zhal ba'i ngos/ /bkod legs mar me'i phreng ba'i snang snyan dang / /mkhas pas lan brgyar bskrun yang mun pa'i dpung / /sel zhing snang ba'i don byed ga la nus/ /rdul bral ston gyi nam mkha' dngas pa'i ngos/ /phra mo'i skar phran rang 'od 'byin pa yis/ /kun+da'i tshal rnams rgyas par —191

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)nus min yang / /zla ba'i gral du snyeg pa gad mo'i rgyu/ /rigs rus skye bo tsam gyi sdong po la/ /nog dang grag (21na sgom 'khyog po'i yal ga can/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'bras bu dang bral yang / /rab rmongs tshang tshing dbus na ches cher lding / /gangs can sa yi lhe ba rdo rje gdan/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /dkar chag shel dkar me long dwangs pa'i ngos/ /zhabrul med lo rgyus gzugs brnyan ci yang 'char/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi yon tan la/ /cung zad bstod pa'i dge tshogs mtha' klas na/ /zhid khams rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun gcig bsdus pa'i/ /lha ldan gtsug lag bsngags la su mi dad/ /tshul 'dir mos ldan skye bo'i nyin byed kyis/ /sgra 'dzin 'dab brgya rnam par phye ba las/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyi za ma tog /blo ldan rkang drug dga' ba'i dpal du gyur/ /rnam 'dren bstan pa'i 'chi med dga' tshal du/ blo bzang grags snyan 'bar ba'i yongs 'du'i ljon/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i gang bu bla med kyis/ /lhar bcas skye bo'i gnyen du dar gyur cig /gnam gyi mthongs nas yangs pa'i sa chen por/ /mes po tshangs pas bskos pa'i mi yi rje/ /chos ldan rgyal ba'i khrims kyis 'jig rten kun/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig /ces gangs ri'i rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i ljongs kyi rdo rje gdan lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang ma bu'i dkar chag shel dkar me long zhes bya ba 'di yang / gtsug lag khang rten brten pa la rim gro dang sri zhur bgyid pa'i dkon gnyer rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ gnam bskos kyi rgyal po phag mo gru pa'i blon po/ rgya gar gyi rgyal rigs swā la pa chen po/ za hor gyi rigs las son pa'i lo rgyus smra ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes/sa skyong gi lo rgya nag gi rgyal khab chen por lo 'go gsar du tshes pa/ nyin byed dbang po gzhu khyim du nye bar spyod pa'i phyogs snga ma'i bzang po dang po/ dbyangs i 'char ba'i tshes la dga' ldan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni wa gan+da shrī ya'o/ /

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (pemachog dman bar pa rnams la lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya gsal bar ston pa'i rim pa zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /(1na)(ldeb sbyor me' phreng can/)di ཿ lha wa dī ga nu ta lun+ta rtu 'o li spro mi tri su redo sha ma lu ca ba sa su rla ji ni sa ཿ pu rje twa : e ti bha sdi ka ruḥ su ya hi ta/ring nas goms pas tshogs gnyis lus phra mas/ /mi phyed mdza' bas 'khyud pa'i stobasabacu'i rtsal/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam 'dren nyi ma'i gnyen/ khyod kyis srid 'dir thugs rje'i sman yon stsol/ /mkhas pa'i rba rlabs 'dzin ma'i mthar 'khrug cing / /btsun pa'i dri bsung phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs/ /bzang po'i 'od dkar rmongs pa'i mun pa sel/ /tsong kha pa zhes dus gsum rgyal ba'i (2na gtso/ shes byar mkhyen pa'i mtha' bral 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /'jig rten kun gyi byed po gser mngal can/ /mi zad tshig gi gter mdzod dbyangs can lha/ /chos kun lta ba'i blo mig stsol cig kye/ /lugs zung blang dang dor bya'i bgyi ba'i las/ /ji bzhin yi ge'i phreng bar spel ba'i tshig /dregs ldan rgyal po'i cod pan gyis bskul tshe/ /snyoms las can gyis g.yar khral 'di ltar lo/ /chos srid kun la mtha' yas rig pa'i 'phrul/ /brgya phrag 'byed pa'i rab yangs shes rab kyis/ /zhib mor yun du dpyad de ri bong cal sgrog gis ri dwags ca bslus pa ltar/ legs brtags nas/ /lag tu bstar ba dpyod ldan spyi yi lugs/ /stobs nor 'byor pas rgyags pa'i khengs can la/ /yid dang ngang tshul rjes mthun smra ba'i gtam/ /bag phebs gleng mor bgyis te thabs sangs rgyas kyis kyang moskyes dgra la pha gsad byar gsungs pa'i 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdo dang / gdul bya 'ga' zhig la gang zag gi bdag yod par bstan pa ltag mkhas kyis/ /gang yin don gyi thog tu lobs pa gnad/ /(2bskog pas gnam gyi mthongs—193—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheyangs pa'i sar/ /btsan po'i las kyis bskos pa'i rgyal po'i rigs/ /legs nyes bya ba'i spyod zhes5 ji ltar yang / /'phal snang gus sa paṇa gyis/ yul gyi bdag po zhes sdang na'ang / de la gus pa kho na byed/ ces pa gsungs ltar / pa lhur len rang gi don/ /mtho dma' dang bral phan tshun mnyam pa la/ /'phral snang mdzes pa'i 'dzum gyis legs bsus nas/ /nye ring bya gzhag bzang ngan cig shos kyi/ /thabs dang bstun nas nyams su len pa gces/ /bran 'khor rnams la bslab byar nan tan bskyed/ /cung zad nongs la blo khog yangs bya zhing / /shes bzhin khyad du gsod pa'i dngos po dag /dran 'dzin sngon gyi rgya bod kyi rgyal po rnams kyi khrims btsan po mdzad cing / mi rje srong btsan sgam pos sprul pa'i mi'i mgo lag gcod pa sogs kyang dgongs gzhi che/ legs nyes spang blang 'byed par rigs/ /sngon dang 'phral gyi rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i/ /mi mdza'i dgrang yang tshig gi mtshon 'debs pa/ /blo chung byis pa'i tshul las ma mchis pas/ khyab 'jug mi yi seng ge'i rnam 'gro skyabs gser can la gang gis mi thub pas mchog dbang phyug gi byin par/ khyab 'jug gis tsho 4 ger sprul nas bas pa lta bu/ thar brjid/ /yid ngor bde sdug bzang ngan 'char ba dag /dgag par mi nus de yi rgyu mtshan rnams/ /tshig tu brjod na rang gi snang tshul kun/ /rjen par ston pas gre bar bskyil ba gnad/ /ring nas las kyis 'phangs pa'i rje bo yis/ /byams brtses skyod las lhod pas g.yel gyur kham rnga'i yul gyi bram ze dpal dang dpal grub kyi (3na skotam rgyu ltar/ kyang / /'gyur med bsam pa thag pas las byas na/ /mi bslu'i rgyu las gos bu 'byung bar nges/ /mchog dman skye bos gcam bu'i tshig min par/ /snying nas blo de 7lo gshegs pa spre'ur gyur tshe g.yang rong la lhung ba'i mi ba 'a pa'i lo rgyus ltar/gtad byas pa slu ba dang / /dug sbyor mna' dang tshad la mi brtsi ba'i/ /las 'di sgrub las srog 'dor ces mi dga'/ /don med rdzun dang phra ma'i byed po yis/ /mdza' gcugs 'byed sogs phung bram ze ma gzugs kyi nyi ma'i gnya rgyu ltar/ krol chen po'i las/ /'di phyi mnar ba'i mi dge'i 'bras bu dag /sgrub pa blo dang ldan pa su yis byed/ /g.yo khram ngo bstod blo brid sbyor ba yis/ /bcos ma'i ltar snang grogs su rlom pa rnams/ /sbrang skru gri rnon po 'i kha la sbrang byugs nas bsngags na lte gcod pa ltar/ rtsi byugs pa'i spu gri dang — 194

lug zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag lor ba'i rdzing bu/ (pematshungs pas/kha mdzes khong grims btsan po'i go cha yin/g.yin gyis ched du gnyer ba ma yin pa'i bar ma'i las la bcol rtog med bzhin du//gros dang tshe po pa khri dpon cad ga' rdo rjes/su bar/drung r+sā si po che waṃ sī tu ldog gzhoms kyi nya' gros lang ston dang /dpon 'a rgyal bzang yar klung su 'ongs skabs/slo pa khyi skor gyis dam nas byas pas mthar rang gi mtsho yong shor blta bu/'char ston lus semasang la byed pa'i//klad chung de 'dra gzhan gyi gad mo'i yul//drang po'i gtam gyis yin min mtha' dag kun//thang mar brdal la shes ldan su mi mgu//dgra la snying nas gnag kyang dga' ba'i sprang tshogs brjod mkhasapas rgyal po khyab 2ga dul blta bu/tshul//3ba tha stan nas na nam phugs shags su che ba yin//nges par mdza' na ngo bstod ma yin pa'i//blang dor sha mo'i mdo las/tso dga' pho tsha bo la mo gal gyi bu dmyal ba bska pa lta ga gtam gyis gsong por smra//phan btags pa la drin gyis sgral shal gtam//ha cang mngasan dga' ba'i dung sems yal//byams pa ches na bur yang phyis srol tshud//rngan chen grogs la mang yang 'khon pa'i rgyu//ngan pa'i dpe khrims ga' na la gtod pa sa skya'i dpon wo yo bzang gi bla mas posapo das mus/phyis khorang skyar tshal du ā+o kha lta gan//de yi g.yang rtsa rang la byung nyen che//legs nyes sngon gyi bsod nams la rag kyang //dpa' dpon 'a dbang brtson gyis khri skor stsogasum gyi dmag ṣ+ka kyang phag gru ma thub pa lta bu/ mdzangs rtul phod pho tshod zab pa gnad/ /phan gnod bya ba gang yang 'grub pa'i gdengs//ma rnyed bar du gsal por gtam mi smra//gang la gsar 'grogs che ba'i rje dpon dang //snying gtam phyi ru 'chad pa'i grogs po dang //bzang ngan sems la mi 'jog mgo steng dag/zol 'grogs mdzes par byed pa grung po yin//lhag par dga' yang 'dzum chen mi bya zhing //ma mgu gyur kyang bzhin gyi 'gyur ldog spang //gdengs khyab 'jug gis la sdug pa ges rnam grangs mang du bstan pa kun la rnam par sto/tshod yid la bzung nas nges med gtam//brjod pas gzhan dag 'phyang mo'i dra bar 'jug/rang nyid stobs ldor dpal gyis cher dregs shing //kun gyis bkur yang ya rabs khungs ldan la//brnyas par byed pa 4na / lus kyi phyi nang rgyal po nga la /sa brgya byin dang stan cig gi steng du bsdad par/de la ga sems

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)byas pa sa phyir lhung ba lta bu/ kun/ /gsal por ston pas go 'dul ba lung du glang po che dang bya dang ri bong rnams kyis bsnyen bkur go rims byas par bkra shas par shad/ rim 'brel mtshungs gnad/ /gong ma'i dpon gyis nye bar bskyangs pa yis/ /lugs zung kun la btsan po'i dbang ldan yang / /'phral du mi brnyas 'jug pa bde ba de/ /cang shes 'phrul gyi me long cis ma yin/ /sngon sa paṇa gyis/ mkhas pa rang gis dpyod shes kyi/ blun po grags pa'i rjes su 'phrad/ khyi rgan ku co 'don pa na/ ā mtshan med par gzhan dag rgyug ces gsungs pa ltar/ nas cha rgyus zhib tu ma 'tshal bar/ /yun du ma brtags legs nyes phyogs tsam gyis/ kha tshon bcad de grogs dang dgrar lta ba/ /rang nyid 'gyod pa'i mtsho ru ltung ba'i rgyu/ /gang zhig g.yul ngo zlog pa'i dpa' bo'i rtsal/ /mi ldan na yang grogs kyi khrod nang du/ /rtsing pa'i gtam dang spyod pas mig ltos kun/ /shes g.ya' bzang khri dpon dang rgyal mtshan skyabs dang ma dga' dgra dga' lta bu/ byed skyes bu de las tha chad su/ /chung ngu'i rkyen la dga' khre'i kun rtog rnams/ /ston cing rtag thub dka' ba'i skye bo la/ /grogs rjes skyabs su 'tshol ba sdig kha ya/ khang hrul nang du sdod dang khyad par ci/ /dga' sdug bar ma'i sems kyi gar mkhan ma/ /gting bral rgya mtsho'i nang gi nor bu ltar/ /mi mngon g.yin gyis dpag par dka' ba de/khrims ldan mdun sar dgung blon pher ba'i bka' gdams chos 'byung du/ rgyal ba 'brom la/ dus der rgyal khrims yod na dgung blo chen po blo gros dang dkyil che bas nges par bshad pa ltar/ 'os/ /(4bzhin tan bslabs kyang legs pa'i yon tan bral/ /ga pa'i spyod pa khab len rdo bzhin shes/ /drung du 'khod rnams de la sbyor byed pa'i/ /spre'u'i mdzod 'grel rgyal sras ma las/ rgyal po kri sku'i rmi snye pa ma bcu'i lo rgyus ltar rnam thar 'dzin de rgyang du bskrad/ /yun du bsten nas dge la ngang gis sbyor/ shes bya mtha' dag 'chad la spobs pa can/ /don gyi snying po thar lam ston mkhas pa/ /gtan gyi skyabs yul yongs 82dzin bla ma'i mkhas grub rin po ches na bza' phu thung ma gsol zhing thugs nga rgyal ba'i rnam pa can de rgyal ba btsong kha pa dang mjal ba tsam gyi thugs rgyal chag cing zhi dul du gyur pa dang / rje sa pa ṇa gyis dpon chen shākya bzang po lta bu'i sdig can mtho ris su drangs pa lta bu/ 'os/ kha drag gtam dang 'byor pas legs skyong zhing / /gcam bur mi lta byas byung so sor 'byed/ khrims la spyi — 196

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (pesnyoms drung chen waṃ sī tu gtsang du byon skabs khrom chen po tshogs nas sku tshe ring ba'i smon lam btab pa lta bu/ ltos bcas shugs kyis skyong / /phra zhib khog yangs blo gtad dpon gyi 'os/ /nyes pa'i skyon sel phan pa'i yon tan sgrub/ /skyid sdug kun brag dkar ba shes rang bkra shis kyis nyes dmigs la ma 'dzems par rgya nag du phyin pa lta bu/la mi 'byol phyi thag can/ /mtho dma' phra mor re 'khang mi byed pa/ /yid kyi 'jog sa mdza' gcugasagrogs kyi 'os/ /ci bcol la nyan sha tsha mi 'dor la/ /dka' ba'i las la kha lhang mi 'don zhing / /gzengs su bstod blon po thon mi dang mgar gyi rnam thar ltar/ kyang gnya' ba mi rengs (5na)pa'i/ /blo rtse gcig tu sgril de 'khor gyi 'os/ /de lta na yang srid pa'i phun tsho gis las/ /'phral gyi bde ba sgrub pa'i mi chos tsam/ /bla lhag 'bras bu tshangs dang 'khor ༷ / /'gyur pa'i sdug bsngal yin phyir snying pos dben/ /thabs dang shes rab rtsi yis zin pa las/ /'khrul pa'i 'gro 'di'i lcags khams sangasargyas kyi/ /'dzam bu'i gser du sgyur ba'i byed pa po/ /bshes gnyen jo pos khyed bod bla ma la tha mal phe 5 shes las med/ ga nas skye zhes pa'i khungs ltar/ la rag de phyir bsten pa gces/ /yongs 'dzin de yang bslab gsum de nyid rtogs/ /snying brtse la sogs yon slong dpon spyo gzha dngags ston gyi lo rgyus po sto bas gsung pa ltar/ tan nyer ldan zhing / /slob bu dge ba'i jo bo la skad 'a pos gdams po zhus par/ pha ngag bya bdad 0yin/ /dad pa dad pa gsung pa ltar/ zhing sa dad pa la/ /brten na don gnyis myu gu cis mi 'grub/ /mthun rkyen tshogs gsog yan lag bdun pa dang / /mtshan mo'i rig pa'i bdag nyid sto bar mtha' dag dang / mas mo'ang kun gyi stod smad 'das nas ni/ zhes bshes spring las gsungs pa ltar/thog mthar dge sbyor la brtson zhing / /dbang po'i sgo sdom zlas kyi tshod rig pa/ khun gyi spyod lam tshul la gzab pa gces/ /mi khom skyon bral 'byor pa'i rten bzang po/ /yang yang rnyed par 'a3 yulasa'i rgyas tsor gyi lo rgyus ltar/ dka' ba thob dus 'dir/thos bsam sgom pa'i rdzings kyis 'khor ba'i mtsho/ /sgrol bar 'jug 'dod su zhig blo dang ldan/ /skas kyi gdang bur 'dzeg pa'i go rims (5bskor/ /theg kun gzhi ma skyes bu chung ngu dang / /thun mong lam gyi chos skor nyams len pa/ /di chos zab zab mo mang pos bod rnams bslus pas/ lha gzha gyi bzhed pa ltar —197

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shejo bos lam sgron mdzad/ paṃ ka ra'i lugs srol bla na med/ /nges par 'chi zhing dus kyi cha med par/ /pha rol 'gro tshe dkar nag las 'bras tsam/ /ma gtogs lus kyang rjes su mi 'brang ba'i/ /tshul la bsam pas dge bar ngang gis 'jug /da lta'i sdug bsngal phra mo brnag dka' na/ /ngan song byu yun ring su yis bzod/ /de phyir dmyal gos spring slob spring spyod 'dug sogs las spyod pa ltar/ ba yi dwags dud 'gro las/ /bzlog par mi brtson sems ldan min nam ci/ /zug rngu'i nad las skyob phyir sman bsten ltar/ /'jigs kun bsrung phyir bslu med mchog gsum la/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan shes byas nas/ /tsham tshom med po to bas/'o skol44rgyas las mo mar rtsis che tshul gsung / par gtan gyi skyabs su 'gro /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun so so yi/ /skyabs shed bu ser skya chu srin du skyes pa dang / mtha pa bzang ldan dang / dpe cha la so dreg bkus par jo bos ma bzod pa dang 'byom gyis lhan pa ser po tsam yang dbu thog tu 'jog pa'i gtam rgyus ltar/'gro'i bslab bya phra rags thams cad las/ /bde sdug 'bras bu 'byung ba'i tshul bsams nas/ /shes bzhin brtan pos bslab la nan tan bya/ /srang mda'i mtho dma' lta bur bde 'gro dang / /ngan 'gror 'phen pa'i dge dang sdig pa'i lus kyi gsum/ ngag gi bzhi/ yid kyi gsum/ las/ /rnam yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po/ smin rgyu mthun bdag 'bras 'byin pa la/ /nges rnyed srung sdom nan du bya bar rigs/ /char sprin stug pos(6na g.yogs pa'i lha lam dag /'thor byed dri yi bzhen pas mthar skyod bzhin/ /gnyen po stobs bzhi'i bshags par nan tan du/ /bskyed chos pha tshan pa'i mdo dang dpung bzang gis zhus pa las ga/ na sngon byas sdig pa drungs nas 'byin/ /de ltar dge dang sdig pa'i blang dor gyis/ /mngon par mtho ba'i lus bzang rnyed gyur kyang / /zo sa khyud mo bzhin du ga song du/ /ldog phyir gto gyi bde bar ci zhig rung / /bden bzhi'i phan gnod 'jug ldog legs bsams nas/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs mtha' dag me 'obs ltar/ /'khor ba bcings las grol bar 'dod pa yi/ /skyes bu 'bring dang thun mong 'di rmad byung / /skye dme pas/ rga pa kha kyis kha kyis 'ong bas drag /dus gcig la 'ong na bgran thabs med gsung / rga na 'chi 'dod pa btsal mi rnyed/ /mi 'dod phrad sogs rigs drug nyam nga kun/ /nyes brgya'i — /98

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (se'abyung gnas 'khor ba'i rang mtshang ste//sdug bsngal bsams te de rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa dug gsum sogs/kun 'byung spong //rten 'brel lugs phu chung bas rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs bzlog las brtsams pa'i lam gyi sil mdzad/bzlog sgrub rten tshangs spyod khrims//nges 'byung rkyen gyis blangs pa'i dge sbyong gis//lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum po nyams bstar pas//thar pa'i khang bzang mchog der dgyes rgur spyod//de ltar rang nyid 'khor ba'i btson ra la/ /mi 'jigs gdengs tshad brnyes kyang skye rgu rnams/ /srid mtshor mnar las 'don pa'i khur 'byer ba//skyes bu chen po'i chos lugs 6bsnying po'i lam//gang der rgyu dang 'i 'bras bu theg pa las//ches zab gsang ba sngags zhes rab grags kyang //thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs ma song bar//ma dul glang po zhon na rang nyid phung //ma jo bos lo ma la/ṣ+pezang mo'i grags pa sngags la lus/lar 'khor ba'i gting rdo byas kyi dogs//zhes dang /'brog gyi po to bar/khyod tshe 'dir sngags lam na gsung gsogs/zab kyang dmo tshig yis na rdo rje'i dmyal bar skye bas/de'i kun du pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshog rdzogs pa la dgongs/rig nyen mongs 'thug pos cher sbags pas//dgra gnyen bar ma du ltas mnar ba la//dga' sdug btang snyoms min par lus can kun//mar shes de yi drin dran ga rdzob gces//de ltar kun la byams pa'i sems kyis bsgos//snying rje chen po nan tur bsgoms pa yis//lus can srid mtsho sgrol ba'i khur 'byer ba'i//mi dman lhag bsam yun du bsring ba gnad//rang slob 'a mu go mis/tig waṃ tso po la bur sa gyi thigs po re sa kyis mngar mi nus po ltar/nyid sdug bsngal gsum gyi dbang gyur phyir//gzhan dag de las thar pa'i mthu dman pas//thog mar kun mkhyen ye shes 'thob pa'i ched//rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rnams la bslab//gces skol gyi ston pa /shi'i rgyal por gyur tshe phug 'a la sha dang /thams cad la lta bu/ pa'i srog dang rta glang mchis brang bu/ /'o rin cen mdzod sogs zang zhing 'byor pa'i zong //rigs med 'dod can kun la gtong byed pa'i//sbyin tsā nga zing gis sbyin pas tshig dag dga' zhig sa la/sa par bas tshul de ston cing mos/don da pas gas dag de lasbyor/don mthun pas rang nyid kho su len pa bsdu ba'i dngos po 'phor phyin lhag ma rnams la yang sbyar ro/99/pa'i pha rol phyin pa pha mtha' yas//7na bzhan

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyeganod bzhi bcas spong ba las brtsams pa'i/ /so thar byang sems tshul khrims ji snyed pa/ khas blangs ji bzhin 'byom gyis sgo sor thar pa sgo sgo skye bos srung nus 4de bor nas/ zhes theg chen par khas len pa 'ga' la bka' bgyon pa dang / jo pos so thar dang 'gal ma myong / byang sems dang sngags sdom las 'gal pa byung ba rnams zhag tu ma 'grogs zhesagasungs/ srung dang legs sdome pa/ /mtha' yas yon tan brten pa'i 'dzin ma 'dra/ /mi bsrun gdug pa 'tshe ba'i gnod pa dang / /dka' spyad g.yin don sgrub pa'i ngal ba la/ /dang len bzod zhi ba lhas/sems can mi bsrun nam mkha' bzhin/ /de dag gzhom gyis bongs mi lang / khro ba'i sems 'di gcig bcom na/ /dgra de thamasacad choms dang 'dra/ zhes pa ltar dang / khong khros dge rtsa thams cad 'joms pas shin tu nyes pa che/ sha ra pas kham lung pa sne'u zur pa gra ba pa gsum snyan khung 'thug pas bde/ gzhan rnams snyan sras pas mi bde ba byung bar gsungs pa dang / 'byom la 'disa'adi skad zer byas na lkog kha kho por yang ga sto gsung / pa'i go cha btsan po 'di/ dge ba'i dngos po mtha' dag srung bar shis/ /sems med nyi ma zla ba'i ba gam dag /dal po to bas go mo grub pa 'i ra mda' dang byang pa'i ra mda'i dpe gsungs pa ltar/ med rlung gis lha lam skor byed na/ /yun du brtsams pa'i brtson 'grus byed po yis/ /mi gnas myang 'das sa der cis mi 'khrid/ /bying rgod dang bral g.yo med gsal ba'i mdangs/ /(7ba)ting 'dzin rnam bkra lus sems shin sbyangs kyi/ /bde ster de kho na nyid dam/ nga sngags kya rim gnyis sogs gang la yang 'di nyid dgos te/ nam pa la shi las mar me dang rma gi dpe gsungs so/ /stong nyid bde ba chen po'i lam/ /kun gyi gzhi ma bsam gtan pha rol phyin/ /rnam chos kun la shes rang kyis dbyed dgos pas/ sha ra bas sangs ma rgyasabar du slob gnyer tshar pa med gsung ba dang / rnal 'byor pas sangs rgya ba la po ti mdzo khal tsam la slob gnyer bya dgos par gsung skad/ spyir don dam rtogs pa/ kun rdzong gan lnga rig pa rtogs pa/ sems can don byed rtogs pa'i shes rab sogs mang ngo / /par dpyod pa'i shes rab rnon po yis/ /mtha' yas chos rnams rang bzhin gyis stong yang / /tha snyad rten 'byung bslu ba med pa yi/ /rgyu 'bras tshul la nges pa'i ngo mtshar rnyed/ /rang nyid bskal chen grangs med gsum gyi bar/ /dpal ldan stobs bcu'i go 'phang sgrub pa'i ring / /mar gyur lus can mnar ba ma bzod nas/ /nye lam 'jug 'dod dbang po yang rab dag /thun mong rgyu yi theg pas blo sbyangs —2()(/—

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ rtogenas//'bras bu rdo rje'i theg par bgrang yas kyang //'phags yul shing rta chen po klu sgrub dang /gangs can mkhas dbang blo bzang grags pa yi//bzhed srol rgyud kyi rgyal rje bla mas/gang zhig rtog po mtha' dag gsung rang la//mi log sgoms po mchog ster 'dus pa'i lam//zhes gsungs/po 'dus pa lam//'di nyid gsang sngags yongs kyi phyi mo ste//ye shes lnga yi sku bsto sa go lo ltos dam gni srog ltar bsrung /sabon thebs pa'i ho//brda don 'phrod nges dbang bzhi nod par bya//phra rags8na tha skyed skye shi bar do gsum sku gsum du mkhyen zhing byang sems yungs hrūslo du dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sgom pa sogs//rim mi g.yo nges rnyed pa//ro rkyang dri bzhen sgru ltar thim pa yi//dga' yas babs mas brtan gyi dga' ga brdzis drang pa'i/bas lus dben ting 'dzin nyer drangs shing //gang shar rdo dam pa rigs brgya/de wo rigs lnga/ga4 0rig btso/ga4 r+pā rigs r+sālto'i/rje 'chang gi sku ru 'char/ /de nas srog rtsol gsum gyis snying kha yis/ /rtsa 'dud grol bsang ga dben ting 'dzin skye//sems phyinang gi o gnyis kyi gong yis/dben thugs kyi rdo rje'i rlung sems las//rim pa gsum pa'i 4zhadapes bas cing na mo ma mdzod lamang 'a wor tha/sgyu lusamangon du byed//lhan skyes bde ba chen po drangs pa yis//rim pa bzhi pa ba4 gto gnyis kyis 'od gsal du dag par byas pas/don gyi 'od gsal dag/bskyed ma' dpes spras pa'i dag pa sgyu ma'i sku dang thugs don gyi 'od gas kha nyidangos bi rdzi kha'i /de slob 'i pa zung 'jug rab 'thob nas//mi slob rigs brgya'i khyab bdag myur du 'grub/khyad par gsang bde 'jigs gsum zung 'brel du//nyams su len pa rgyal blo slong grags pa/ba'i dgongs pa ste/ma 'grub gyur na rdo rje 'jigs byed nyid/khyad par 'phags pas 'di nyid gces par 'dzin//gzhan khro pho dus su yang 'jam dpal gyi zhal yod pas zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi rga chod/gas mo dang sgyu lus sogs pha rgyud ma rgyud gcig la gsal yang gcig la mi gsal ba sogs 'dir mtha' dag gsal bas/yang 8bamatha' 'khob yangs pa'i nor 'dzin der/ /tshegs chung don che yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims/ /skyabs gsum dge bsnyen yig drug bzlas skyabs gsum dge bsnyen na bstan par 'jug pa'i sgo yin pas lags la/da lta yongs rdzogs dgob blangs par khas 'a ba'i rtags su gas yo pa de yod bog pa/srog gcod log mal mi 'dzem pa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheshas che bar gda' bas sdig pa'i rgyu'o/ /lung dang / /las 'bras dge bod du yang paṇ+ḍi ta sham thabs sngon po can gyis sngagasabashad pas phal cher bslab pa 'chol te 'dul ba'i bstan pa nyams pas/ jo bo chen pos kyang skyabs 'gro las sa sogs gsungs nas pha na pa dpag tu med pa btags/ do ha zhes pa'i sngags gsungs par brtsams pas 'brom ston rin po ches bkag pa dang / mnga' ris su lha btsun gyis kyang sngags mi gsung bar zhusapa rnams dgongs gzhi che ste/ dper na gsang sngags kyi dbang da lta ci thob byed par 'dug ste/ de thob nas sngags sdom srung dgos rab byung gi sdom pa blangs nas ma srungs pa 'dra ba'i steng na nyesadamigs de las kyang che'o/ /sdig la sogs gtso bor ston/ /'on kyang sngags la mos pa'i las sad pa'i/ /snod ldan dag la gnas skabs mthar thug gi /dngos grub thob pa'i thabs mchog dus 'bor/ gsang 'dus/ bde dgyes/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ tshe dpag med/ rta mgrin/ rig gsum mgon po/ mgon chen sde bzhi/ slob po chen po bhā ya rkara'i thugs dmo sgrub thabs rgya mtsho sogs yul der bde legs 'byung bdag spel/ yi dam lha/ /gsang sngags skabs dang sbyar te spel bar bya/ /mdor na dang du blang bar dka' ba'i las/ /mi bzod thog tu babs pa ci byung yang / /mchog gsum dam pa snying nas blo bkal te/ /(9na gsol ba btab pas don kun 'grub par 'gyur/ /e ma lugs gnyis bya ba'i mgrin bcu'i gzugs/ /blo gros be+e ḍūr gsar pa'i rtsig ngos la/ shar tshe lta ba'i ha nu man tha de/ /gnyis pa swā la'i ljongs 'dir 'phos snyam byed/ /gnyis skyes rgyal po gcig gi dkyil 'khor gzugs/ /'bum phrag chu snod so sor 'char ba ltar/ /mi zad shes bya'i tshul 'di grangs mang yang / /dpyod ldan tshad mas gzhal nus min pa su/ /sde bzhi'i gnas tshul tshul bzhin ston pa'i tshig /tshig sbyor ches nyung nyung ngu'i gtam gyi 'phreng / /'phreng bar spel legs legs lam rgyan gyi mchog /mchog dman mdzes byed byed po 'di na bkod/ /tshangs pa'i gsung las 'ongs pa'i gtam rgyus ltar/ /shing rta che gnyis zhal lung lam gyis 'gros/ /lugs zung bya ba'i shel dkar me long la/ /'char ba'i byed po dge sbyor skad gnyis pa/ /chos srid sgros su gleng 'os drang po'i gtam/ /snying por sgril ba'i don gyi zla snang gis/ /ut+pal dkar po'i 'dab ma 'dzum byed na/ /sems ldan su zhig rgol ba'i go skabs ci/ /lhag bsam ri dgas mig can ba'i na ras —202

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (7ngos/ shes rab smin ma'i 'khri shing gar sgyur ba'i/ /legs bshad mig gi ri mo 'dzum pa'i dkyus/ /'dod can skye bo'i snying la 'jug gyur cig /ces lugs gnyis kyi blang dor gsal bar ston pa shel dkar me long zhes tshig sbyor go bde bar byas pa 'di yang / stobs kyi 'khor lo sal spyod pa'i tshangs pa mi'i gzugs can gang gi (9ba)ral pa'i cod pan/ legs sbyar skad du dha rma swā mi dza yā 'o dme zhes pa bod yul du chos rje rgyal ba'i 'phrin las par grags pa dag gis nan gyis bskul ba la brten nas/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir gnam gyis bskos pa'i chos ldan rgyal po gong ma sde srid phag mo gru pa tā'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan dpon bcas kyi mdun na 'don/ 'phags yul pa'i rgyal rigs su la pa chen po za hor gyi rigs las son zhing / dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo thams cad mkhyen pa myong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs la rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa thob cing / bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas phyogs tsam mthong ba'i ban : sgom las pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes/ sa skyong zhes pa shing mo bya'i lo chu shel gyi dbang po nag pa'i dga' ma dang rtse ba'i dbyangs i 'char ba'i tshes la/ kha ba'i rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lte ba/ sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar cig car du phye ba'i rdo rje gdan lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /oṃ su sti bra dzā 6 grangs med 'gro la nyer 'tsho'i dpyid kyi sprin/ /phul byung phan bde'i char rgyun snyan pa'i rnga/ /cig car grub pa'i rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i mgron/ /'bod mkhas rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras po rgyal/ /dbyig gi blo gros ma 'dir stobs bcu'i rtsal/ /las bzang sor rtses bskrun min dpe bral gar/ /mkhas rlom grags pa'i mu khyud skyengs byed pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i tog gyur btsong kha pa la 'dud/ /ring nas bsod nams(10na the ḍūr tshong zong gis/ /rnam par gzhal ba'i rje btsun dbang gi rgyal/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan rtse mor mchod pa'i 'od/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu 'bar la 'dud/ /legs pa'i lam gyi skyed tshal do ra sa /dal brgyad 'byor bcu grub pa'i sa —203—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyemos tshal/ /mthon po'i rigs kyi yal 'dab spud pa la/ /blang dor bsil zer tshul 'dis ba 'ad do kye/ /rang bsrung pha rol gzhom sogs rgyal thabs kyi/ /sna tsho gos bya ba sgrub pa'i chos nyid du/ /snang yang lcags la gser 'gyur rtsi bzhin du/ /rgyal khrims cho me su sgyur ba gnad du gces/ /gnas skabs mthar thug nyer 'tshe'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol byed gru gzings dkon cog rin cen la/ /bcos min snying nas dad pa'i gdung shugs kyis/ /nyin mtshan kun tu skyabs 'gror brtson par rigs/ /rgyal bas khyim par bsngags pa'i so sor thar/ /nges 'byung rlan gyis bskrun pa'i tshul khrims gos/ /skabs 'tsham dus dang sbyar te legs srung ba/ /mngon mtho'i go 'phang 'thob pa'i rgyu ru shis/ /lus srog 'tshe bas nyen la mi 'jigs pa'i/ /sbyin dang 'phongs par mkho dgu'i 'byor pa yis/ /tshim par byed pa stobs dang ldan rnams kyi/ /rlabs chen bsod nams sgrub la mngon par mtho/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod sogs dge ba'i las/ /ji snyed bsags pa stobs bcu'i go 'phang mchog /thob byed rgyu yi gtso bo byang chub sems/ /theg chen lam gyi srog yin brtson pa skyed/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster byed sngags kyi tshul/ /rje (10ba)btsun 'jam dpal snying po'i gdams pa'i mthil/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed rim gnyis lam/ /dal 'gro'i rgyun ltar chad med nyams len mdzod/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas bsgrubs na dge ba'i tshogs/ /chung ngur gyur kyang 'bras bu mtha' klas shing / /nye bar 'khod rnams de yi rang bzhin du/ /rnam par sbyor ba'i dge ba bla na med/ /mchog dman bar ma'i 'bangs la byams brtse'i 'dzum/ /lhug par bsus pa'i ga bur gsar pa'i thigs/ /kun gyi snying la dran pa'i bsil ngad can/ /dga' bdes lan cig min par brlan par mdzod/ /mi bsrun skye bo'i bag med skyin thang gis/ /skye 'gro'i phan bde'i lo tog 'joms byed na/ /rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing 'od stong gis/ /mnga' 'bangs yid kyi kun+da lci bar mdzod/ /chen po'i srid kyi bya ba sgrub pa la/ /dpa' mdzangs rtul phod ldan pa'i mdun na 'don/ /cang shes du ma gcig tu bgros pa'i ngag /legs pa'i cha kun bsags te 'bad par rigs/ /rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras —204

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ ('apo'i bstan pa'i dpyid/ /mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs dri med de 'dzin 'dus pa'i sder/ /mi lhod gus pa'i bsam pa brtan par mdzod/ khres rab kun gsal yangs pa'i ā dar+sha/ /blang dor gar du rtse ba'i nyin mor byed/ /'gog med gsal bar shar ba'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /lha ldan gtsug lag bya 'dabs ngos nas dge /zhes pa 'di yang gnam bying gir rgyal po'i rigs las dad stobs ldan pa er (11na)ti na khung tha'i jis bskul ba la brten nas/ shākya'i ring lugs pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang gi nye 'dabs su sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /dal 'byar rten gyi me long dngas pa'i ngos/ /gto mdun yid 'ong snang bas la'i ba'i thabs/ zhom dkar nyal 'gro thod du mes po bzhin/ /bsten na mi dge'i dri ma ngang gis luspu da/ /'di snang tsam gyi bde gos smin pa yang / /skyabs mchog dpyid kyi ma mar rag lus na/ /grangs med skye bar bsgrubs pa'i legs byas kun/ /mchog gsum dam pa'i mthu las gzhan du ci/ /de phyir chos srid bsgrub bya'i zhing sa la/ khyu 'bras blang dor tshul bzhin nyams bstar pa'i/ /sa bon bskrun tshe 'di phyi'i phan bde'i 'bras/ /lhun gyis 'grub pa nan tan snying por rigs/ /thun gyi thog mar 'khor ba'i chu gter las/ /bsgral phyir snying nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang / /g.yin phyir sems skyed sdig lhung dag byed pa'i/ /tsho gos ri sog gzungs sngags phyag mchod gsol 'debs bya/ /tshe dpal skyed cing byang chub stsol ba'i lha/ /bzlas brjod lhur len bar chad sel byed pa'i/ /sna chas srung gsol mchod dge rtsa bsngo ba rnams/ /nyin zhag phrugs gcig dge sbyor rim pa khrigs/ /chos srid pad dkar kun+da 'byed 'dzum gnyis/ /cig car 'gal yang 'jig rten zla zer gyis/ /dam chos pad 'dab snyigs par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /gtam gyi bdud rtsi yid la sim par byos/ /zhes (11ba)pa 'di yang khyams stod pa don gnyis lhun grub kyi ngor za hor gyi brnyes bris/'chi med dpal ster yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhabs/ /legs bshad 'dod par 'jo ba'i —205

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyedabyangs can ma/ /nges legs la sbyor phyag na pad+ma'i zhabs/ /lhag pa'i lha kye khyod la dge legs stsol/ /bsod nams gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong gis/ /stobs kyi dpung pas sa la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /'jam dbyangs gong ma'i rigs su nyer son pa/ /e ma ngo mtshar las kyang ngo mtshar med/ /deng sang rtsod ldan lnga brgya'i snyigs dus 'dir/ /mtho dman bar pa'i nye ring 'gro ba la/ /mdzes shing bag phebs khong grims rang don rnams/ /'phyug med gnad dang ldan pa'i 'grogs lugs gsas/ /gsung 'jam zhi dul snyan par smra ba yis/ /dgra gnyen bar ma'i blo sems 'khrid mkhas pa'i/ /mjangs pa'i 'phrul gyis rgyal thabs legs sgrub pa/ /rnam dpyod gos ser can la 'gran par mdzod/ /zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'bad kyang mi thul ba'i/ /mi bsrun log par 'khu ba'i dgra sde'i dpung / /snying stobs rtsal gyis 'joms la ches dpa' ba/ /lha chen gtsug na zla ba'i ngang tshul zungs/ /blo gros zhib mos yang yang brtags pa yis/ /zhi dang drag por brtsams pa'i bya ba gang / /ma grub bar du dka' ba khyad gsod pa'i/ /tshangs pa rgan po'i blo ltar rtul phod mdzod/ /lugs gnyis yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten mchog /'phags bod rgya hor yul sogs grangs med kyi/ /skad dang (12na)yig rigs brda la byang chub pa/ /mtho rigs sarba dz+nyā yi rgyud 'dzin mdzod/ /'phong sogs sgyu rtsal drug sto rtsa bzhi yis/ /stobs ldan gyad kyi rigs can ma lus pa'i/ khengs pa cig car 'phrog nus srid sgrub dang / /rā ma ṇa yi ngang tshul ji bzhin mdzod/ /kun la spyi snyoms khrims kyi 'od gsal yang / /sger bltos pa da dkar gzhen nu 'dzum nus shing / /log sgrub 'byung po'i bya rnams long byed par/ /rtsol med lhun grub nyi ma lta bur mdzod/ /gtam gyis yid gso zang zing nor mang ster/ khas zhan dbugs phyung thabs mkhas mjad pa yis/ /mtsho la ngang pa ji bzhin skye rgu kun/ /'bad med ngang gis 'du ba'i thabs 'bad mdzod/ /nges pa'i gtan tshigs ldan pa snying gi grogs/ /'gyur med gus ldan 'khor g.yog ma gtogs pa/ /gang la bya byed bza' btung gsang ba'i gtam/ /zhib mor dpyad pa'i ngag dang ldan pa gnad/ /tshe sgrub bar chad sel ba'i dge sbyor dang / /swā tsha sbyin gtong mdo sgrog bskang bshags —2(/tshu

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (dzadasogs/ /rim gro sman dang zas kyi spyod lam gyis/ /dal 'byor yun ring 'tsho ba'i thabs tshul mdzod/ /lan gcig bsrungs kyang lha mi'i lus 'thob cing / /thar pa thob byed nya stong brgyad gsum gyis/ /bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i cho ga la/ /'bad pas sgrub pa gtan gyi mdun ma'i gzhi/ /dka' tshegs chud ngus mchogo gi dngos grub gang / /rtsol mdzad yi dam 'phags mchogo spyan ras gzigs/ /snying po yi ge drug pa'i bzlas rjod la/ /ma yengs chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bad par (12ba'i tshal bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems gsol 'debs dang / /smon lam sdig bshags phyag dang skor ba sogs/ /bgyid 'os rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba dag /rang gzhan brel ba'i dus dang bstun pa gces/ /sku gzugs mchod rten bka' dang bstan bcos kyi/ /glegs bam bzheng dang dge 'dun bsnyen bkur zhing / /phongs la sbyin gtong srog slu tshe thar sogs/ /dge ba rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar yol med mdzod/ /de ltar tshul bzhin lhag bsam dag pa yis/ /bsgrubs na mchog gsum dam pa'i thugs rje dang / /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa yis/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogos 'grub par 'don mi za/ /gang gi tshe dpal stobs 'byor ma lus pa/ /'phel zhing phyi ma dag pa'i zhing mchog tu/ /skye ba'i bden tshig smon lam dge sbyor gyi/ /skyabs 'jug yid la yun du 'grogs par byed/ /de ltar lugs zung 'grub byar 'os pa'i gtam/ /snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'byin pa'i ku ke la/ /sa spyod rigs ldan khe shing ching wang gi khrung du tshig gi gshog rlabs bskyod de song / /zhes chos srid zung ldan gyi bslab bya mes po'i zhal lung zhes pa 'di ni 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i rigs las dpyod ldan kha shing ching wang gi gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brnyes pho brang chen po pe cing dang le bar bdun brgya tsam gyis chod pa'i sa byang phyogs tal sgar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /lta bas mi ngoms mtshan dang dpe byad sku/ /srid zhi'i gdung sel yan lag drug (13na cu'i gsung / /ma lus chos kun dri med mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /rnam 'dren gtsor gyur zas gtsang sras la 'dud/ /rnyed dka' 'jig sla don che dang ldan pa'i/ /dal 'byor rin cen lan gcig thob dus 'dir/ /—207—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)'jigs rung 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las/ /bsgral phyir gtan gyi mdun ma bsgrub par rigs/ /legs byas dpung pas stobs ldan rgyal po yi/ /rigs su skyes rnams tshe 'di'i bya gzhag kun/ /dor nas dam cho༅/'ba' zhig lhur len pa/ /tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i skal pa ches phra yang / /bde gshegs sku gsung thugs rten bzheng ba dang / /dge 'dun mchod cing 'phongs par sbyin par gtong / /mi dang dud 'gro'i srog skyob tshe thar dang / /rang gis dus khrims srung zhing yig drug sogs/ /lus ngag yid gsum dge la spyod pa dang / /'bangs rnams bder skyong dge ba'i srol gtod sogs/ /rgya che rnam smin dkar por 'dzag nus pa'i/ /thabs mkhas 'phrul gyi byed po gcig gis kyang / /phan bde'i gdugs dkar srid rtser 'khor nus zhes/ /ma 'dris kun la brtse ba'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /lan cig min par gsung rab mang po sa /bstan pa 'di ko bslu med nges pa'i gsung / /'di ni rgya mtsho'i mthas gtugs nor 'dzin la/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rigs son pa/ /gang de'i rnam par dkar ba'i gaṅgā 'a rgyun/ /zhi ba'i chu gter chen por 'bab phyir bris/ /zhes pa 'di ni ma ga dha bzang mo dang tshul mtshungs pa'i nor 'dzin dbang mo gu ru na kong jos bskul (13ba)ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes byang phyogs tal sgar sbyar/phun tshogs 'dod pa'i re skong dbang gi rgyal/ /dran pas tshe yi dpal ster rgyal ba'i yum/ /yid bzhen 'khor lo rnam par rgyal ma sogs/ /lhag pa'i lha yis khyod la rtag tu srungs/ /mngon mtho'i dal 'byor rgyu skar 'phreng ba'i dbus/ /rmad byung za hor rigs kyi zla snang gzugs/ /mkhyen dpyod rnam par yangs pa'i 'od dkar gyis/ /'phral yun bde bar kun+da bzhad 'di mtshar/ /rkang 'thung khrod na dpag bsam yong 'du ltar/ zhan tu rnyed dka'i rten bzang thob pa 'di/ /don med ngang du stong zad ma song bar/ /yang dag snying po sgrub pa'i tshul 'di gson/ /dkon cog skyabs 'gro byang chub sems bskyed pa/ /sngon du btang ba'i sgo nas tshogs gsog dang / /sdig lhung mi dge zungs nas dbyung ba'i phyir/ /gnyen po stobs bzhi'i bshags par nan tan mdzod/ /lha mi'i lus rten —208

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (pe'athob pa tshul khrims la/ /rag las phyir na bya sla tshegs chung zhing / /don chen sgrub pa yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims/ /nya stong brgyad gsum kun tu srung bar mdzod/ /dngos su bshams pa'i sku gsung thugs rten la/ /me tog bdug spos mar me byug pa'i dri/ /lha bshos rol mo sogs kyis legs mchod pa'i/ /grangs med bsod na mas tshogos chen spel bar mdzod/ khyad par 'phrul snang bsam yas khra 'brug sogs/ /bod 'bangs yongs kyi bsod nams zhing mchog la/ /gser chab snyan shal mar me'i phreng ba yis/ /(14na)dge tshogs rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar yol med mdzod/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i dge 'dun la/ /bsnyen bkur ston cing byin rlabs ches lhag pa'i/ /sman bla'i mdo chog mkhan chen zhi 'tsho'i gsung / /lhad med rgyas pa 'don du 'jug par mdzod/ /mnga' 'bangs tshogs rnams byams pas legs skyong zhing / /ri rgya klung rgya mi phyugs srog skyob dang / /dbul 'phongs nad pa nyam thag 'gro ba la/ /bza' btung sman sogs sbyin gtong phan gdags mdzod/ /mchod rten man khang la sogs zhig gsos dang / /rdo lha spyan 'byed lam 'phrang zam pa 'chos/ /tshes bcu'i mchod pa yig drug 'dren pa sogs/ /'gro mang thabs kyis dge la skul bar mdzod/ /yun ring 'tsho gzhes ched du tshe sgrub dang / /bar chad sel phyir lhag pa'i lha bsnyen cing / /sāts+tsha 'debs shing gtor ma rgya rtsa gtor/ /bod kyi chos skal yig drug 'dren pa mdzod/ khrag mkhris rlung dang bad gan la sogs pa/ /gang che de yi gnyen po bsten pa dang / /sku la 'jug pa'i zas dang spyod lam sogs/ /sman pa mkhas pa'i ngag bzhin spang blang mdzod/ /gdugs dkar sher snying sgrol ma tshe gzungs dang / /bka' 'gyur chos skyong gtor bsngo bskang ba mdos/ khro 'char zlog pa sri gnon lto bcos sogs/ /zab rgyas sku rim rnams la g.yel med mdzod/ /de ltar rang gis byed dang gzhan byed du/ /'jug kyang dge ba tha dag rdzogs byang du/ /bsngo zhing smon lam dag pas mas sbyar te/ /mi zad 'bras bzang rgya cher spel (14ba) bar mdzod/ /nyams bzhes gsal 'debs tshig nyung don gsal 'di/ /za hor rigs ldan dbang mo a ba drung / /pad dkar chos nyid bzang mo'i thugs dam du/ /za hor brje tshangs sras bzhad pas bris/ /—209

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyen mo mañja badz+ra : swa ra swa ste/ /bgrang yas shes byar srid pa'i nam mkha'i mtha'/ /kun gzigs mkhyen pa'i dgu tshigs zhags pa yis/ /legs 'ching 'jam dpal rdo rje ngag gi lha/ /dbyangs can dga' mar bcas pas 'gro 'di skyongs/ /thos bsam sgoms pa'i gzings kyis srid pa'i mtsho/ /rab bsgral dam pa'i skyes rab nor bu'i dpya/ /legs rnyed theg chen rigs ldan rgyal ba'i sras/ /'gro kun 'dren slad brtson pa'i go cha gyon/ /bdag dang gzhan du brje ba'i sman gyi mchog /sgrib gnyis nad brgya 'joms pa'i bdud rtsi'i gter/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub pa'i srog /'tsho byed rlabs chen spyod pa rtag tu bsten/ /bskal mang bya dka'i tshegs la bltos min pa'i/ /smin grol chos kyi nyin byed 'od po che/ /zung la jug sku bzhi'i pad dkar rab bzhad tshe/ /'chi med rdo rje'i glu dbyangs rna bar 'jibs/ khyad par dpang ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i rigs/ /dbyangs can dga' ba'i 'jigs med kun mkhyen de'i/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa kun bzod ma/ /rnam dpyod rus sbal khur gyis 'degs par mdzod/ /sgra tshad rig pa brgol ngan spobs pa 'phrog /bzo dang gso bas gdul bya rjes su 'dzin/ /stobs bcu'i go 'phang mngon byed nang don te/ /paṇa chen grags pa'i (15na)gdan sa khyod kyis drungs/ /gangs kyi ri bo dkar ba'i rang bzhin la/ /bsil sbyin mkhan po'i 'od kyis gsal byed ltar/ /mkhas grub dbang por skul ba'i tshig gi 'phreng / /dpyod lnga ba ched pa'i re ba bskang phyir spel/ /zhes pa 'di ni yongs rdzogs gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'jigs med grags pa'i bstan 'dzin sbyor ra sprul pa'i sku rdo rje snying po'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/oṃ su sti sid+dhi/ bskal bzang sangs rgyas rab gsal lnga brgya'i dus/ /ngur smrig gar mdzad kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs/ /slar sprul bstan pa'i srog shing mtshar pa rje/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas pa rtag tu rgyal/ /rang nyid chos brgyad 'khol po'i gzhan dbang gi /dal 'byor don med stong par 'dzad bzhin du/ /blang dang dor bya smreng gsol spyon pa yis/ zhes ldan gzhan gyi nyes pa sel ba —210

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (sebazhin/ /'on te gtsang stod zha lu'i chos grwa nas/ /smin grol dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid mchog /mkhasang grub brnyes gsung gi nyi zer gyis/ /smra ba'i bang mdzod 'dab brgya ci yang 'dzum/ /mgon khyod 'jig rten tshul lugs smos ci dgos/ /na tshod phra nas dam pa'i yongs 'dzin gyi/ /rjes bzung thos bsam sgom pa'i rtser son pas/ /rgya mtshor chu yi thig pas ci zhig bya/ /de lta na yang ches cher snyigs pa yi/ /blo dman rjes 'jug (15ba)'ga' la phan pa'i ched/ /'di 'dra bskul zhing brtsoms pa sngon dus kyang / /byung phyir 'gal ba med snyam cung zad 'god/ /tshe 'di blo yis btang ba'i lha chos dang / /'di snang srid la zhen pa'i mi chos gnyis/ /phal cher tsha grang lta bur 'gal bas na/ /lhan cig sgrub pa bye ma'i changs bu bzhin/ /'on kyang bka' gdams gong ma mi la sogs/ /tshe 'di'i 'khri ba rbad kyis chod rnams dang / /mtshungs min deng dus ris med grub pa'i mtha'i/ /rjes zhugs phal cher chos srid lhan cig spyod/ /dusang na skye bo'i slu 'drid g.yo sgyu dang / /snying nas dad cing gus pa'i ngang tshul gnyis/ /bya byed gtam dang spyod tshul rags pa yis/ /rtogs min brtag cig zhib mor dpyod pa gnad/ sha tshar rlom pa'i drang po'i gtam gyi mdas/ /bcol chung snying ga mes te dang ma'i dgrar/ /'dzin pa mang phyir dus ༅ skye bo yi/ /blo dang bstun pa'i mol mchid 'grogs lugs gces/ /bdag gir bzung ba'i grwa slob 'khor 'bangs la/ /zol 'grogs ngo bzung 'phral du mthun grub kyang / /phugs mar bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu chud 'dza' bas/ /drang po'i gtam gleng bzang ga dbye ba 'byed/ /zang zing nor dang sa gzhis 'dzin skyong rnams/ /snyigs dus dgon sdo skyong la nyer mkho bas/ /rang nyid gcig pu'i ched min dge 'dun gyi/ /'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen bsgrub la nyes med snyam/ /'phags pa'i yul ltar bsod snyoms kho na'i zas/ /nyin bzhin slong ster bod (16na 'dir ches dka' bas/ kun spangs dben sa bsten kyang zas gos kyi/ /mthun rkyen tsam zhig sgrub la klan ka su/ /dgra gnyen nges med bsams na chags sdang gis/ /phyogs ris 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i gzhi yin kyang / /btang snyoms chos rjes kho nar 'brang ba des/ /dus ngan tshe 'di 'byid pa dka' mor snang / /—211—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)gnas mal bza' btung sman gyi bcud len dang / /bsrung bzlog rim gro 'khor grogs spyod lam gyis/ /dal ba'i rten bzang ring por 'tsho ba'i thabs/ /'di phyi'i don gang sgrub kyang gal po che/ /blo grims snying stobs rtsal lag 'jam rtsub sogs/ /pha rol bya spyod dang bstun sgyu thabs 'phrul/ /srid skyong gzhan sde 'dul la nyer mkho yang / /ha cang thal na dam pa'i chos dang 'gal/ /kye ma srid pa'i bde ba phun tshogs kyang / /brgya byin slar yang ngan song lhung ba bzhin/ /sbrang ma'i sbyang rtsi lta bu'i ya ma brlar/ /blo ldan su zhig 'bad pas ci ste sgrub/ /mtshan dpe'i mdzes sku tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs can/ tags bya ji lta ji snyed kun mkhyen pa/ /thub dbang dpal gyi mgur las bstsal pa'i bka'/ /bslu med gtan 'dun sgrub pa rab kyi phul/ /sgra tshad bzo gso mdo rgyud bstan bcos mtsho/ /rnam dpyod gzings kyis dpogs nus de srid du/ /legs bshad nor bu 'tsho ba'i snying stobs kyis/ /bgrod pa de yang dam pa'i ngang tshul yin/ /bstan la gces shing 'gro la nyer brtse bas/ /thos don bsams pa'i smin grol (16bsgong man ngag /snod dang ldan la lhug par ston pa yi/ /'chad nyan 'di ko phan bde'i rtsa bar nges/ khyad par rdor dbyings dpal rtse dus 'khor sogs/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor bla na med rgyud kyi/ /gar thig dbyangs dang sgrub mchod rab tu gnas/ /sbyin sreg phra rags phyag len mi nub spel/ /bu ston yab sras mtshar chen mkhyen brtse sogs/ /mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa'i srol/ /thun mong min pa'i zab chos phyag bzhes rnams/ /srid mthar mi nyams dar rgyas brtson pa gces/ /'bad pas btsal min zang zing sbyin gtong dang / /tshul khrims gtsang zhing gzhan yang de la 'god/ /dge tshogs rtsa ba drungs 'byen khong khro'i mtshon/ /bzod pa'i go 'di gtan bde'i 'dun mar 'khums/ /chos srid che chung bya ba gang sgrub kyang / /le lo'i dbang gyur yid kyi 'dun par lus/ /brtson 'grus rlung gi rta la nyer zhan na/ /tsha zer can rgyas nyan bzhin gling bzhi 'khor/ /'di phyi'i phan bde'i rtsa ba bshes gnyen du/ /gsung rab dgongs 'grel bcas las legs gsungs na/ /dpal ldan chos skyong bzhed srol lam zab kyi/ /rnal 'byor mchog la spyod 'di skal ba bzang / /ma rgyud gsang —212

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (dze)mtha' dgyes mdzad he ru ga: 'dus pa rnam gnyis dus dgra'i dbang po sogs/ /snga phyir 'gyur ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor lha'i/ /bsnyen cing sgyub mchod bdag 'jug len par bya/ /tshe spel 'byor pa'i re skong lhag pa'i lha/ /bzlas pas rgyud bskul dngos grub (17na)zhu ba dang / /lhag par phur thogs drag po'i sgrub pa yis/ /nag phyogs bdud sde'i dmag dpung 'joms la shis/ /spyi sgos bstan dar rnal 'byor chos sgrub par/ /glags lta'i dgra dpung 'joms la rdo rje'i thog /gur zhal bka' sdod las gshin rab brtan ma/ /bstan srungs bsnyen sgrub mchod bshags skang bar 'bad/ /yang sgos mu stegs nyi ma grub pa sogs/ /thal bar brlag mdzad rnam mang thos pa'i sras/ /rtag tu lus dang grib ma ltar 'brangs na/ /mchod bsnyen skang ba 'phrin bcol nan tar mdzod/ /ngan song gnas la snying nas ma 'jigs par/ /lha mi'i bde bar chen log ga la 'byung / srid pa 'khor bar gnas na sdug bsngal gyi/ /zo chun 'byud mo 'di las su zhig thar/ /tshul de 'jug ldog byed nus dal ba'i rten/ /rnyed dka' don dang ldan par legs rtogs nas/ /sdig spong dge sgrub 'gro rnams mar shes te/ /kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems mchog sgoms/ /lnga gsum bco lnga'i nyams sogs 'jam rtsub kun/ /yang dag lam du grol bas sangs rgyas kyi/ /gsang gsum dag pa 'khor lor 'byam klas pa'i/ snang gsum lam 'di skal bzang ro brgya'i bcud/ /gdod nas blo 'das byar med gzhi dus lhar/ /ma shes 'khrul snang spyod byed lam bsgoms pas/ /bcu gsum rdo rje'i 'bras bu g.yur za ba/ /thun mong lam las khyad 'phags 'di med byung / /bum pa'i dbang gis sbyang gzhi lus kyi rtsa/ /(17ba spyod byed lam bzang snang stong lha'i dkyil 'khor/ /rab gsal rang bzhin lhan skyes ngo 'phrod nas/ /phra rags skyed rim gnad la sgro 'dogs bcad/ /gsang ba'i dbang gis sbyang gzhi yi ge'i gzugs/ /sbyong byed lam bzang gsal stong bdag byin rlobs/ /nyams myong rang rig lhan skyes ngo 'phrod pas/ /rtsa rlung gtum mo'i gnad 'gag nyams 'og chud/ /gsum pa'i dbang gis sbyang gzhi dang ma'i khams/ /sbyong byed lam bzang bde stong 'khor lo yis/ /'bar 'jag zhu bde lhan skyes mngon gyur ba'i/ /bcu drug dga' —213

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebazhi dbab ldog pho nya'i lam/ /mchog dbang bzhi pas sbyang gzhi snying po rlung / /sbyong byed lam bzang rba rlabs rnam gsum don/ /mthar phyin rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa'i sa/ /sngags lam la rnyed phyag chen mtshan nyid ldan/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi lam bzang nyams bstar tshe/ khams 'dus gsum gyi gzhi yi 'phrang gegs la/ /spyod pa rnam gsum lam gyis bogs bton pas/ /ltas ngan g.yang du len pa'i gnad 'di zab/ /tshe 'dir 'ja' lus 'od skur ma grol na/ /'da' dka'i lam gyis dag pa'i zhing bgrod cing / /gal srid pa bar do'i 'phrang 'grim tshe/ khrin pa rnam gsum lam gyi ngo yod bakhres/ /gang de nyams 'og tshud pa'i tshod 'dzin la/ /sgyu ma rmi lam nyin mtshan khor yug can/ /tshogs bshad spang spos ngad tsam ldang min pa'i/ /slob bshad li shi'i dri bsung spro ba'i lugs/ /phyogs re tsam min thub pa'i (18na)bstan pa kun/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshad ma bzhi ldan chos/ /nyams su blangs pas tshe 'dir rdo rje 'chang / /mngon du gyur pa'i dga' ston e ma mtshar/ /dge 'dis rang lus snang stong lha skur shar/ /ngag gi grags stong sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog /sems nyid gsal stong rdor sems rang ngo shes/ /dus kun bde skyid dpal la spyod par shog /ces bshad sgrub thos bsam sgom gsum 'di phyi'i dge legs su 'gyur ba'i 'khor lo gsum gyi byed lugs slob dpon sngas kha ma de nang bzhin bsgrub chog pa zhig dgos zhes 'gro ba'i ma rig sel ba'i rten 'brel du gser gyi mig thur gyi rten dang bcas te bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos kyi gdan sa pa rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bang ga mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub kyi gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi bzhes po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa kun/ /gcig bsdus rigs gsum sgyu dra'i gar mkhan can/ /chos kyi 'khor los sgyur rgyal btsong kha pa/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla mas rtag tu skyongs/ /srid bde'i bde spel sdug bsngal spong ba'i thabs/ /blun rmongs byol song rnams kyang sgrub mkhas na/ /blang dang dor byar blta ba'i mig yangs pa'i/ /mngon mtho'i rten ldan su zhig don du gnyer/ /dal —2/4

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (pe'abyor rnyed dka' 'jig sla las 'bras zab/ /ngan song sdug bsngal (1shabs 'obs ltar mthong nas/ /bslu med dkon cog gsum la skyabs 'gro zhing / /snying po stobs bzhi'i bshags pa nan tar 'bad/ /mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang nyer thob kyang / /'chi med gtso yang gnasang na len srid na/ /'khor ba'i phun tsho gos kun la yid phyung ste/ /lam bzang bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len gces/ /rang nyid gtan bde'i go 'phang tsam thob kyang / /skye bar drin gyis bskyangs pa'i mar gyur 'gro /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor byings la snying rje ches/ /nyer drangs smon 'jug byang chub sems mchog skyed/ /sbyin sogs phar phyin drug gis rang gi rgyud/ /legs par smin nas bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis/ /gzhan rgyud rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen po/ /rgyal sras dam pa'i rnam thar legs par skyongs/ /thun mong lam gyi rgyud sbyangs snod rung nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang nyams len gyi/ /gzhan du gya tshom gsang sngags la 'jug pa/ /mnog chung nyen che zhib mor dpyod pa gnad/ /mdor na 'di phyi'i legs tshogos gang sgrub kyang / /rgyu 'bras la 'dzem snying rjes rgyud brlan zhing / /snang stong dbyer med lta bas rgyas thebs pa'i/ /bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar skyong bar mdzod/ /ces pa 'di'ang skyid shod chos rje'i sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyi gsung gi bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar pa 'jam dbyangs so/ /shes byar srid kun yongs mkhyen 'jam zhing dul/ /(19na po shegs bshad dbyangs bdun mgrin 'brol ngag gi lha/ /ngur smrig gar gyis rol ba'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /dpal 'byor lhun grub snying dbus ze'u 'brur bzhugs/ /tshe rabs mang por chos dkar bsags pa'i mthus/ /blo bzang grags snyan ches 'bar btsong kha pa'i/ /med byung bstan pa rin cen sgor zhugs khyod/ /ma yengs rna ba'i dbang po blogs te nyon/ /mi khom gnas brgyad smag rum stug po'i dbus/ /dal 'byor glog 'od skad cig 'gyu ba yis/ /rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i ngang tshul yong bsams pa'i/ /mi rtag lcag gis sems kyi cang shes snun/ /gro nas la sogs sa bon gang btab pa'i/ /'bras bu so sor smin pa ji bzhin du/ /dge —215

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyedang sdig pas bskyed pa'i bde sdug gi /dkar nag las 'bras mi bslu yang yang sgoms/ /bzod dka'i 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i/ /bslu med dpung gnyen dkon cog rin cen yin/ /de phyir bsam pa thag pas skyabs 'gro la/ /nyin mtshan dus drug kun tu 'bad pa gces/ /phyi ma bde 'gror skyes kyang btson ra las/ /thon pa slar yang mi chud deng med na/ /srid bde gyur pa'i du:kha yongs shes te/ /thar pa'i lam bzang sgrubs shig gtan 'dun yin/ /rang rgyud 'dul ba tshul khrims bslab pa dang / /nyon mongs bag la zha byed ting nge 'dzin/ khres rab bslab pas bdag 'dzin drung phyung nas/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi grong la phyi phyag tshol/ /rang nyid gcig pu zhi bder ma chags par/ /mtha' klas skye bar phan btags mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /ngang tshul bsams te byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /pha rol phyin drug spyod pa che la slobs/ /grangs med (19ba)bskal gsum tshegs kyis bsgrub bya'i lam/ /snyigs dus tshe thung yun la thabs mkhas kyis/ /gom pa gcig gis rab bgrod rdo rje'i theg zhan tu rnyed dka'i bstan la legs par 'jug /lta bar sgro btags phyag rgya'i lam sogs dang / /mi 'dra dbang gi rgyud smin rim gnyis kyi/ /rnal 'byor don gyi phyag rgya chen po yis/ /zung 'jug sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon du byos/ /de lta ra thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /go rim 'brul med snying por legs bsdus pa/ /mtsho la bzhin ras lta bur gsal ba 'di/ /blo bzang rin cen nyams len ched du gdams/ /chul 'di za hor brnyes mgrin pa'i rnga/ /myos ldan dbyug gus bskul ba'i mod nyid la/ /bkod tshe sor mo'i 'du byed sgyur pa po/ /gnas btsun 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /su sta/ sngon nas rnam dkar rlabs chen char rgyun gyis/ /tshe 'dir mngon mtho'i gos bzang rab smin pa/ /legs par 'ong pa'i snang tshul dran med 'dis/ /phyi ma'i bde sdug sgrub pa'i dpe ru bstan/ /dal ba'i rten 'di rnyed dka' yid bzhin nor/ /'jig par sla ba glog gi gar mkhan bzhin/ /ngan song 'jigs skrag me 'obs lta bu la/ /nan tar bsams tshe dge la ngang gis 'jug /mi rtag 'chi bas snying nas yid 'byung ste/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs rnams la zhe log pa'i/ /bcos min blo zhig rgyud —2/6

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (pol legs skyes na/ /chos kun rtsa bar de las lhag pa med/ /'phrom ston chos kyi dbang phyug mi la rje/ /sngon byon mkhas dang grub pa'i rnam par thar/ /rlabs chen g.yin gyis dpag par dka' ba yang / /nyer len rnam dag nges 'byung sems su khums/ /de phyir thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs pa'i/ /(20na sgon lag snod kyi zhing sa gshin pa las/ /gsang chen nye lam sa bon yongs btab pas/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu ma lus yongs su smin/ /lhag par khyod kyi sngon nas las 'brel ba'i/ /lha mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang yin pa'i phyir/ /dpal ldan ye shes mgon po phyag drug par/ /yid dam chos skyong dbyer med gcig tu sgrubs/ /'di la chos min glo shugs bshal ba na/ /tshe 'dir bar gcod kun skyob 'dod pa 'grub/ /'chi dus don gyi 'od gsal nag po ches/ /bde chen gnas su 'dren par gdon mi za/ /de ltar brjod bya'i snying po'i nor/ /nam mkha' lha dbang snying dbus su/ /gtams par gyis la nyams su long / /legs pa'i yon tan rab tu
