'phel/ /phyag rdzogs dbu gsum lta ba bod 'dir grags/ /dbu ma glu sgrub ba ched srol lta ba'i rtse/ /gzhung lugs sbyangs pa'i mkhas min rtogs par dka'/ /deng dus phyag chen zer ba sems gnas kyi/ /lta ba yin gyi phyag chen dngos gnas min/ /dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ye shes la/ /phyag rgya chen por tshad ldan mkhas rnams bzhed/ /pad 'byung bī ma la dang be+e ro sogs/ /bka' gter las 'ongs nges don rdzogs pa che/ /mkhas rmongs bar ma gang gis nyams blangs kyang / /tshegs chud don che 'phrul gyi gnad gsang zab/ /dper na mi pham mgon po ches rgan pa/ /be+e ros tshe der byang chub lam du khrid/ /rgya bod gnyis gar rtogs gral dus gcig tu/ /byung ba'i ngo mtshar lo rgyus pha mtha' yas/ /de phyir las 'di'i nyams len snying po ni/ /chos kun ka nas dag pas ma rnyed stongs/ /stongs kyang sgyu ma lta bur (20bsgog sum snang / /snang ba'i ngo bor bltas na ngos bzung med/ /med kyang bde sdug thams cad nyams myong nus/ /yid 'ong chu zla ltar 'char rang gi sems/ /sems kyi gshis lugs nam mkha' lta bur dag /dge sdig bde sdug sprin 'brug 'ja' glog bzhin/ /'char yang 'byung gnas 'gro gsum dmigs su —217

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyemed/ /med kyang don byed nus pa rmi lam 'dra/ /da ltar rtogs par byed pa'i mkhan po de/ /gtan med yin na rtogs bya rtogs byed bral/ /yod na de yi ngo bo btsal bas stongs/ /sems 'di ma rtogs ma rig 'khor bar 'khyams/ /rtogs na rig pa'i ngo bo kun tu bzang / /rkang 'khyam rgyal po'i bu bzhin rang nyid la/ /gnas phyir sangs rgyas phyi rol nas 'tshol ba/ /rkun bu nang bzhag gzhan du rtsad gcod 'dra/ /de phyir skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ /gsal stong brjod du med pa'i gnas lugs 'di/ /rang rig dag pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sems/ /me long gzugs brnyan ji bzhin spyi gtsug tu/ /gtso rkyang yum bcas gang 'dod gsal btab pa'i/ /thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng dag las bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /babs te bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus pa/ /dud khu rnag khrag gzugs su bshang chu'i lam/ /rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon pa'i ting 'dzin bcas/ /yig brgya mang bzlas nad gdon sdig sgrib kun/ /dag par 'gyur bas nyams len gnad du che/ /res 'ga' rdor sems gnas 'gyur tshe dpag med/ /sgrol dkar la sogs gang 'dod lhar gyur nas/ /so so'i sngags bzla tshe dang bsod nams sogs/ /bskyed pa'i ting 'dzin spro bsdu de 'bras 'byung / /skabs 'gar drag (21na)po phyag rdor rta mgrin sogs/ /bskyed bzlas dmigs pas steng 'og bar gsum gyi/ /gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa/ /me lce'i dpal rgya tha/phye ma leb ltar bsreg /phyis yar mkhas rnams de 'dra mi ba ched kyang / /gcig pu nyid las du ma'i gar bzhin du/ /rang rig bde gshegs gcig las yongs rdzogs su/ /bsgyur 'di 'od gsal theg pa mchog gi gnad/ /spros bcas dmigs pas skyo na rig pa'i gdangs/ /brjod bral ka dag ngang du lhod kyis glod/ /rnam rtog gang shar ngo bo la bltas pas/ /sbrul mdud ltar grol ngang du lhan gyis slod/ /la la lta ba'i rbad kham chen po yis/ /chad mthar lhung nas 'dus byas dge ba spong / /de 'dra log pa'i lam ste lta ba la/ /rtsal thon tsam gyi las 'bras nges rnyed dgos/ /de phyir sdig sbyong ched du sems can gyi/ /brgya phrag srog blu su ts+tsha 'bum ther gdab/ /sman bla ltung bshags bzang spyod na rag skongs/ /kun rig la sogs dge ba ci nus sgrubs/ /de ltar —2/8

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (dze/mtshan bcas mtshan med legs byas kyis/ /thogs med dus nas da lta'i bar bsags sdig /rab byang yang srid kun tu mngon mtho'i rten/ /thob cing ring min byang chub mchog brnyes shog /snying por dril ba'i nyams len tshigs bcad 'di/ /rnam gling phun tshogs dbang pos bskul ba'i ched/ /za hor bzhes 'phral du nyer bkod pa'i/ /yi ge'i byed po ngag dbang nam mkha'o/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /mi bzod sdug bsngal 'jigs (21bsgos skyob pa'i mgon/ /dkon mchag gsum las gas du ma mas pas/ kha tsam tshig tsam min pa'i skyabs 'gro ces/ /yid can ma lus pha mar yongs shes nas/ /rang gi bde ba de dag kun la gtong / /skye rgu'i sdug bsngal ma lus rang nyid kyis/ /len pa'i byang chub sems la sbyong ba gnad/ /gtong len bya ba'i yul dang byed po kun/ /chu nang zla ba bzhin du snang tsam las/ /dpyad tshe gdod nas cung zad ma grub pa'i/ /gnas lugs stong nyid lta bas rgyas 'debs bya/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi sems/ khri spyan chad med par nyams su len pa dang / /'di snang 'gags tshe bde ba can 'id du/ /skye mched bzang spyod smon lam mtshams sbyor byed/ /nya stong brgyad gsum bsnyen sdom gnas ma pa bsrung / /ji ltar nus pa'i sems can srog skyob blu/ /swa ts+tsha gdab cing rgyal ba'i gsung rab klog /gzungs sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod ci nus byed/ /phongs pa rnams la zas gos sbyin pa gtong / /dkon mchog gsum gyi sku gsung thugs rten la/ /mchod pa 'bul zhing phyag dang skor ba byed/ /rtag tu khong khro'i gnyen por bzod pa bsgom/ /dge ba gang byas sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur/ /bsngos na 'di phyi'i don kun lhun grub par/ /bslu med thub pa'i gsung rab las byung phyir/ /som nyi spangs te brtson 'grus rtsom par rigs/ /zhes me kha no yon kho tu nang so tha'i shis 'di phyi'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i 'chang rgyu sgom rgyu nang don gyi rtsom pa zhig gyis zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /(22na/rugs zung gi bslab bya mu thi la'i 'phreng ba bzhugs/ smra ba ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /—219

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyedabyangs can lha mo gtsug lag 'dod 'jo'i dpal/ /dpal ldan tshangs pa sdebazhi'i bang mdzod 'dzin/ /'dzin ma'i mnga' bdag rnams kyis shis pa stsol/ /chos dang srid kyi tshig don zab brling sgra/ /snyan ngag pi waṃ rgyud kyis glur blangs na/ /rnam dpyod lang tsho rgyas pa'i shes ldan rnar/ /'dzabs kyang phal cher thos 'dzin tsher mal nyal/ /de phyir mchog dman kun gyis legs rtogs pa'i/ /'bol rtsom tshigs su bcad pa'i mu thi la/ /ching gis gnam gyi rigs las mi bdag mgul/ /mdzes byed do shal 'phreng bas rgyan du spud/ /deng dus rgya gar rgya nag hor bod sogs/ /sngon byung ya rabs ngang tshul lugs gnyis khrims/ /cher nub ngan spyod ngo sor 'khyer dus 'dir/ /legs par bshad kyang tsū ta'i rkang gnyis bzhin/ /byang bstan phug par rta ljang can gyi zer/ /mi 'jug dngos po'i gshis la bcos med kyang / /phyogs gzhan bug par shar ba'i snang ba yis/ /'thibs bu'i smag rum sel ba 'ga' 'byung snyam/ /lha chos lta zhog mi chos bya gzhag kyang / /lam du rgyug pa bsod nams la rag pas/ /dkon cog mchod dang ngan song sbyin gtong sogs/ /legs byas spel ba'i tshogs chen gsog pa gnad/ /mngon shes med phyir gros dang mdun ma kun/ /thog tu khel dka' yul dus gnas skabs dang / /dgra gnyen bar ma brtags nas 'phral tshod 'phral/ /blangs te 'jug pa pho chod yang rtse yin/ /sems kyi 'char sgo 'byung la mtha' med kyang / /gre bar bskyil nas(22bas sngab de mkhas/ /snying na'i dgra la 'phral du mi khro bar/ /bcos ma 'dzum gyis bsu ba grung po yin/ /rang blo mi 'bab gtam tshig ci byung yang / /brdzu bzang khog nas mi mngon len pa zab/ /zas nor 'dod kyang ngag mdzangs g.yo thabs kyis/ /mi mngon shugs kyis len pa spyang po yin/ /ngan la mi 'khang slad nas 'gyur ba srid/ /bzang la ma bstod cir 'gyur shes pa dka'/ /gang gi thog tu 'bab pa'i gnad med par/ /gzhan zer 'brangs pa'i zhal bce bcad mi rung / /bya ba gang yang 'grub pa'i gdeng med par/ kha 'don mi skyen khong du sbed par gnad/ /bu sogs gnyen la byams drag ngan srol yong /dgra la ha cang sdang na rang la mtshungs/ /gnyen la ral spyod ches na nam phugs 'khon/ /zan la —220

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla bo 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ ('a'abar sha ches na 'khor mkhan dkon/ /'khor la ches cher rtsub na snying skran 'jug /grogs la rngan chen mangs na zhe bzhag yong / /dper na gzhan la gtod na rang la 'khor/ kha dgra mi bsag gnag pa sems la ga 'ag /gnyen la mi bstod byams pa yid la 'dzin/ /ngan blo yod kyang phyi ru 'jam skad snyan/ /gdong thug drag pos drag po thul dka' bas/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis mdun ma rlabs kyis chod/ /gtam mgo 'dzum bsu mjug ma dal gyis long / /dgos don phigs smra 'tsham zhing mdzes par brjod/ /ser sna tsam gyis zas nor gsog dka' bas/ /brgya bshig stong 'gugs spyi byams blo rgya bskyed/ /bu la nyes skyon bshad na rjes su phan/ /rang la che bstod spangs na nam phugs brin/ /rang 'dod zhe bzhag spyi gtsigs phyir byas btsun/ /bud med gros dbang ma gtong rang thag (23na yone/ /rmongs par grol dang ngan la dbang / /gros la mi dbang mi la gros ma 'chad/ /dkrug shing byed mkhan gros kyi khyur ma 'jug /mkhas dang rgan rabs nyams chen sha tshar dris/ /gros mthil re zhig ma bshad bsgyur du btub/ /gros la bsam gzhigs mang btang hang bug chung / /mi dpe rang la bkab nas zhib mor dpyad/ /phran bu'i khe la bltas nas nyen sdo dang / /gtam ngan mi bsam 'dod la sred pas 'phung / /ya rabs dus bstun dma' sar 'babs mi rung / /ma rabs che sar btan na gnya' ba rengs/ /mkhas pa ras por yon tan ldan pa dkon/ /mi mangs dgra ru mi len gnyen du 'gugs/ /mi 'grub khas len ma che der mi 'jug /gces nor 'dod can mi la mi ston gsang / /tshod med la gros ngan sems can la blo/ /mi btad snying gtam kha mang can la gsang / /sna thung ku re mi thub la sdo spong / /mi bden pa la lus kyis gshags ma gdab/ /mi nyan gros 'debs med la khyer shog dang / /mi yong las la cho pa mi shes ko long dor/ /drin 'dren mangs na dga' ba'i gdung sems 'chor /gyong chen mangs na gnyen yang chen pa ldog /gzhan sdug snying tshim ma byed rang la 'khor/ /rang skyid ma ngom gzhan gyis de lan 'jal/ /gros nyes 'gyod 'thal mi bya phyin chad gzabs/ /dgos ming 'phog thug gtam gyis dgra bo 'gugs/ /pha rol bsam pa rtogs phyir yun du soms/ /rang mgo —221—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)thon pa'i 'phrul can grung po len/ /chen por slebs tshe khengs dang nga rgyal dmad/ /kun gyis khur dus 'og 'dzul 'jug par byed/ /'grub tshad mi byed (23bcu'i 'dzin khe nyen bsam/ /dpon du gyur tshe 'dod chung spyi gtsigs ngos/ /sger du bltos rnams mi mngon shugs kyis skyong / zhar tshad lag tu mi len blangs phyin chad/ /zhi drag thabs kyis bya ba mtha' ru thon/ /zer tshad bden par mi 'dzin dpyad dar gyis/ /zas zhim mir byin nor bzang rang gis chongs/ /mi snying gcod pa'i gtam de lce nas bzung / /sdang dgra'i nor la ma blta brjed ma gzhug /ma zhim sna nyer zhim la hab sha dang / /ma mgur 'phral du mchu mug mig ldog spong / /don med las la brtson 'grus rang ngal yin/ /gsod brdungs nges par dgos la snying ma chung / /ma babs khral dang lag 'don yangs mi 'jug /dgos med 'bangs rnams mnar ba'i las mi byed/ /phrad ma thag pa'i mi la ngo shes dang / /'dris ma thag pa'i mi la blo gtod dang / /sems la babs 'phral dga' ba'i 'dzum ston dang / /ma babs 'phral bzhin sdud rnams klad chung yin/ /drag po drag khyer ma mkhas nam phugs 'phung / /mdza' ba mdza' khyer ma mkhas nam phugs 'khon/ /mkhas pa mkhas khyer ma mkhas nam phugs blun/ /btsun pa btsun khyer ma mkhas nam phugs 'chal/ /che ba che khyer ma mkhas nam phugs dma'/ /gtam la rgyu mtshan yod pas g.yin kha myul/ /bag phebs ngag 'jam snyan pos blo brid nas/ /gzhan mtshang thabs kyis brus nas cham la 'bebs/ /ma bshad pas kyang mi go lhon par smra/ /ma 'bar bus kyang mi nyan ran par rgol/ /ma bslabs sus kyang mi go legs par bslabs/ /ma sbyin gnyen yang mi 'khor bag re ster/ /yang yang byin sar rtag 'gro byams pa (24na)zad/ /drin can mi de sun du ma 'jug mdzangs/ /gnya' bar 'chor ba'i dgra bor rangs ma 'jug /sus phan mi shes snyem chung ras ma bor/ /gang bcol go chod gyur na bran gyi rab/ /rdzun dang g.yo rgyu mi shes nam phugs brin/ kha nyung lag pa gtsang ba yon tan mchog /byas sdus ches na las la ngo so chung / kha gdangs sbar bsdams mi dang 'bral byed phung / /mthon po nga rgyal can gyi mtshang ma 'dru/ /bsam ngan phyi thag thung dang grogs ma byed/ /zhe sdang —222

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (dzadakha 'jam can la rang zon chug /don med gtam la yang yang skyor zlos spong / /phyug po nor la spyod shes ( slad nas 'phel/ /mi ldog bas bsring/chib byabs na rang sdug chung / /dbul yang sdug theg byabs nas pho bzo byed/ /nor yod med por ma brdzu kun gyis shes/ /ngan pa che skad ma 'don khrel bdas yong / /gdong par khrag med gnyen la re ba las/ /ngo tsha khrel yod shes pa'i dgra bo dga'/ /blo gtad mi thub spun dang bza' tshang las/ /gsang thub blo ldan grogs dang grong pa bzang / /yon tan med pa'i tshogs kyi slob dpon las/ ta shes rab ldan pa'i gra slob byas na 'tshengs/ /mi nyan kha 'dus mang pa'i dpon po las/ /ya rabs bzang spyod ldan pa'i g.yog po skyid/ /lang shor rkun po mi yi khyur mi tshud/ /blo gros zab dang mgo 'thoms nor sa yod/ /klad chung mi dang pho grung nor sa yod/ /ma nus jo bzang brdzu che nor sa yod/ /blo shed can dang do thung nor sa yod/ /rang bzhin bzang dang mdo med nor sa yod/ /drang pa'i mi dang glen pa nor g.yod/ /tshul 'chos can dang btsun pa nor sa yod/ /tshe blos thongs dang thog po nor sa yod/ /brdzu (24ba thag can dang mkhas pa nor sa yod/ /de ltar tshe 'di'i mdun ma bsgrub pa la/ /blang dang dor bya'i skyon yon shes byas nas/ /dpa' mdzangs rtul phod sna tshogs g.yo 'phrul gyis/ /rang nyid rgyal ba'i sgyu thabs lhur len gces/ /'on te tshangs pa brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor kun la longs spyod mthar/ /slar yang lcags bsregs sa gzhir dmyal ba'i me/ /'bar ba'i bud shing byed srid yid brtan ci/ /'jig rten gsal bar byed pa'i nyi zla yang / /sngon bsags bzang po'i 'phen pa rdzogs pa'i mthar/ /rang gis lag pa brkyang bskum mi mthong ba'i/ /mun pa'i mal du nyal 'byung mchi ma dku/ /pad+ma'i 'dab 'dra'i gos kyi reg byas kyang / /lus la rtsub nyams byed pa'i smin legs ma/ /bdag po'i ro dang lhan cig sreg khang du/ /rab 'bar me yis bsreg pa su yis bzod/ /nor bu'i gling du bgrod pa'i tshong zog gis/ /rnam thos bu la 'gran pa'i ded dpon yang / /'jur bgegs gnas su skye nas zas skom gyis/ /bkres shing skoms pa'i ngang tshul kye ma hud/ /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong mnga' thang longs spyod sogs/ /bla —223

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shenas blar 'phel pho rgod grung po yi/ /grangs su chud kyang tshe ni nam mkha'i glog /rmi lam tsam gyi bde bas ci zhig bya/ /bsams kyin nam yang rdzun jog mi gsung ba/ /'o skol rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras po des/ /'khor bar gnas phyin sdug bsngal rang bzhin du/ /bstan tshul bsams na snying yang dum bur gas/ /bzod dka'i sdug bsngal 'di las slan chad du/ /mi ldog thar pa'i khang par mjug pa'i thabs /(25na)dkar nag las 'bras bsams nas blang dor ngos/ /bslab pa rnam gsum nyams len grung po yin/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas mngon sum mthong dka' yang / /de dag zhal skyin gsung dang thugs rten la/ /me tone gdug spos mar me lha bshos sgra/ /'phan 'dugs phye phur la sogs mchode sbyin dbul/ /bslab gsum ldan pa'i dge 'dun bsnyen bkur nas/ /thub gsung sgrog sogs chos spyod rnam bcu'i las/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i bya ba cher spel ba'i/ /bsod na mas tshogos chen gsog pa gnad du che/ /dbul phongs skye rgu kun la sbyin pa gtong / /nyam thag nad par gos zas sman gyis bskyangs/ /'chi nges dud 'gro gsod 'os nag chen mi/ /srog blu mi 'jigs skyabs kyi sbyin pa bya/ /lha mi'i rten bzang thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo/ /bya sla tshegs chung yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims/ /nya stong brgyad gsum rnams la legs blangs nas/ /dam bca' sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung bar mdzod/ /tshig rtsub mtshon la ji mi snyam pas go /btsan por gyon na rang rgyud mi 'khrugs pas/ /rnam pa dge ba'i srog rtsa mi gcod cing / /sngar bsags 'phel ba'i thabs tshul 'di la brtson/ /sgyid lug le lo btang snyoms dbang song na/ /legs pa'i yon tan gang yang 'grub dka' bas/ /dal med brtson pa chen pos 'bad byas na/ /ches cher dka' ba'i las kyang lhun gyis grub/ /de bzhin gshegs sku la sogs dmigs rten la/ /ma yengs gzhol ba'i ting 'dzin brtan po'i rgyun/ /chad med bstan na nyon mongs mngon gyur mgo /zil mnan lus sems las rung bsam gtan rnyed/ /chos rnams (25ba)so so'i bdag gzhi'i steng tsam na/ /rtogs pas btags pa las gzhan don dam du/ /ma rnyed rten cing 'brel 'byung dbu ma'i lam/ zhes rab mtshon gyis 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod/ /dran pas 'chi bdag dpung 'joms tshe dpag —224

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (dza)med/ /yid srubs sde bcas mthar byed gsang ba'i bdag /bla mgon dbyer med myur mdzad phyag drug pa/ /'di phyi bar do'i skyabs yin rtag tu bsten/ /de yang gnam dang sa yi dkyil 'khor la/ /dbang phyug mi yi rgyal po chen po rnams/ /rang nyid gcig pur dge sbyor la gzhol las/ /bstan 'gro'i bde thabs bsgrub pa mchog tu bsngags/ /nyi 'og mi yi bdag po che rnams dang / /phan tshun mnyes gshin byams pa' sems bzang pos/ /rang rang mnga' ris rnams kyi chog shes shing / /'bangs kun bde phyir bzang po'i gzhung bzang spel/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje phyogs bral 'gro ba la/ /'jug phyir yang dag chos la ris med kyang / /gna' bo'i dus nas dar ba'i yab mes kyi/ /chos lugs grub pa'i mtha' de shin tu shes/ /byang phyogs chen po hor gyi rgyal khams su/ /al than chos kyi rgyal po ti shi rir/ /bsod nams mtshan ldan tā la'i bla ma gang / /byon nas deng bar zhwa ser can 'gyas khyab/ khyu mtshan des na 'jam mgon btsong kha pa'i/ /bstan pa rin cen bkur na phyag drug mgon/ /las gshin 'dod khams ma sogs chos srung gis/ /rtag tu bsrung zhing mnga' thang bde skyid 'phel/ /lugs gnyis zung 'brel yab mes rgyal po'i khri/ /mnan nas sa chen 'jam dar yug gcig dang / /pha rol phyin drug spyod pa nyer spyad pas/ /'di phyi gtan gyi mdun ma (26na spun gyas khrub/ /de ltar chos srid blang dor rang nyid la/ /mi ldan byu sdu'i brjod pa lta bu'i tshig /smra la mkhas rnams khrel yang ston zla ltar/ /ches dkar sems bzang ba la nyes pa med/ /'dis mtshon dge bas gnas bskos mi yi bdag /btsun mo sras bcas blon 'bangs rab brtan cing / /mnga' thang dpal 'byor rnam mang thos sras dang / /mtshungs pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /de ltar lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya'i rim pa mu thi la'i bgrod pa 'di ni tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gis stobs kyi dbang phyug ching gis kyi rigs las mkhas kha thu she yi thu rdo rje rgyal pos ri kha ba can gyi ljongs su dkon cog gsum la bla mar bzung ste mchod par byon pa'i tshe rtsoms shig par gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi rigs las sdosnod gsum pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs —225

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /su sti sid+dhi/ rigs gsum thugs rje'i cha gang zla 'od kyis/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i kun+da rab rgyas pa/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon dpa' bo rim byon gyi/ /zhabs sen dmar 'od srid zhi'i gtsug na mdzes/ /mdo rgyud tha snyad lnga rig bā ku la/ /mkhas rlom phal gyi nyi zlas ma phye ba/ /'khon rigs blo gros lus bral 'gram chang gis/ /ba 'ad de skal bzang bung ba'i dga' ston dpyid/ /rgyal bka' zab dang rgya che nam mkha'i mthas/ /gzhal bar dka' yang thub (26bsgo stan yongs rdzogs pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bzhed srol gsung ngag las/ /gzhan du mchog gi nyams len dmigs su med/ /thun mong gdul bya'i shalbi ka yi nags/ /tshogs bshad gom 'gros lhod po'i gnyis 'thung dbang / /mang yang gsang chen slob bshad 'jigs med sgra/ /dbyangs su len pa'i gdong lnga pa de brjid/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i snying po'i yang snying mchog /nā ro ta pa'i snyan brgyud gdams pa yis/ /mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo'i zhing khams su/ /'dren pa'i gnad zab 'di ko yid bzhin nor/ /byin rlabs nus rtsal dmar 'od glog gi zhags/ /'phangs pa'i mod la srid zhi'i yon tan rnams/ /'ching bar byed pa dmar po skor gsum zhes/ /'dod pa'i re ba skong ba dpag bsam ljon/ /chos dbyings bde chen zhi la rtag zhol yang / /mi'u thung rdo rje srin po'i stang stabs kyis/ /dgra bgegs 'dam ltar brdzi ba gur gyi mgon/ /stobs 'phrog gdong bzhis khams gsum za ba snyam/ /de ltar mchog thun dngos grub bsgrub pa'i chos/ /snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi yi rten 'brel kun/ /'phyugs med bsgrigs nas gtan mdun lhun grub pa/ /snying dbus dpal gyi be'ur 'khyil bar mdzod/ /mnyan yod bya rgod gshongs kyi mkhan chen mang thos grags pa rdo rjes gdams pa tshigs bcad ma zhig dgos zhes bskul ma mdzad pa ltar za hor bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /'a su sta/ kun rdzob spros pa'i snang ba bkrag po che/ /mkha' (27na)la sprin dang chu la chu rlabs —226

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (dze)bzhin/ /gsal stong sems kyi 'char sgor mtha' klas kyang / /dpyad na don dam dbyings su rnyed pa med/ /sems la gnyis snang bag chags gos pa'i mthus/ /dngos nyams rmi lam 'jigs skrag ci byung yang / /phyi don tsam du bden par ma grub cing / /sems las logs su cung zad tsam yang med/ /sems de gsal rig tsam yin legs brtags na/ /thog mar skye ba'i rgyu med de yis stong / kha dog dbyibs med bar du ngo bo yis/ /stong phyir gnas med skye gnas dang bral bas/ /'gags pa med pas 'bras bu nyer stong phyir/ /stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin tshul la brtag /gsal ba ma rnyed de la stong par 'dzin/ /stong pa 'tshol mkhan de nyid gsal ba ste/ /gsal dus stong zhing stong dus gsal bas na/ /gsal stong zung 'jug rang bzhin ma grub pas/ /thog mtha' skye 'jig 'gro 'ong rtag chad sogs/ /kun las 'das pa spros bral ngang nyid du/ /mnyam par bzhag pas gegs dang bar chad kun/ /mkha' la 'ja' bzhin rang tshugs mi thub pas/ /mdor na rnam rtog mtha' dag 'khor ba de/ /de sbyangs rnam shes phung po gnas bsgyur bas/ /me long ye shes mya ngan 'das gyur nas/ /'khor 'das gnyis su med pa lam gyi gnad/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug thugs bcud zab mo'i lam/ /bar chad dngos grub skyon kun yon tan du/ shes na ltas ngan g.yang du nges par khugs/ /tshul 'di rdo rje 'chang dbang bka' 'gyur ba'i/ /rigs dbon nam (27ba7kha'i mtshan can thugs dam gyi/ /bogs 'don tsam du za hor bzhes bkod/ /oṃ su ste sirnyi/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i thugs bskyed ring po nas/ /goms pa'i sa bon tshogs gnyis drod gsher gyis/ /legs smin chos gzugs yongs 'du nyi ma'i gnyen/ /phan bde'i 'bras bus ris med 'gro tshim mdzod/ khyud lnga'i lam du zo chun 'byud mo bzhin/ /ring bar 'khor yang dal rten da res tsam/ /rnyed 'dir rdog sna 'dred tshe mi khom pa/ /gnas ngan chu gter klong du 'phyan las ci/ /de phyir rang rgyud 'dul ba'i khrims dang ldan/ /gzhan phan rlabs chen spyod pa'i sems mchog bskyed/ /dbang khrid nges gsang gos bus nyar phyug pa/ /dus brgya'i za ma lan gcig yid bzhin nor/—227—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyekhyad par bdag med mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi rlangs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chos skyong bzhed pa'i srol/ /thub bstan yongs rdzogs gsung ngag smin grol gyis/ /'dus gsum 'phrang brgal zung 'jug bde chen bgrod/ /'di ko rang ched dor nas mkha' mnyam 'gro /'dren phyir theg pa'i rgyal po bla med kyi/ /spyod mchog pha mthar phyin pas don gnyis kun/ /lhun grub gtan gyi mdun ma'i yang rtser son/ /chos brgyad 'khrul ba'i snang ba bkrag po che/ /sgyu mas nyer sprul rta glang ltar rig gnas/ /bas mthar gzhig tu byang chen bsgrub gzhol na/ /dus gsum rgyal ba dgyes bskyed mchod pa'i gtso/ /'on te thub bstan lnga phrag lnga 'das pa/ /sgrub 'jug lung du nye bar bsgom pa las/ /'chad nyan (28na gzhan rgyud la 'jug 'phrin las gya/ zhang rta lung rtogs rin cen ci yang 'dren/ /mdo khams nor 'dzin bu mo'i mngal gyi bur/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gling gis lci ba der/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i tshogs rnams 'khor ba las /yid 'byung myang 'das bsgrub phyir khrims la sbyor/ /snang gsum thun mong gdams pas blo sbyangs nas/ /rgyud gsum rdo rje rba rlabs bar gyi lam/ /rno brtul dbang por 'tsham par tshogs slob kyis/ /rnam par grol ba'i dga' ston sa la 'god/ /bla med gsang mtha'i rgyud kyi snying po'i bcud/ /nā ro ta pa'i zab don rnal 'byor ma/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i skal ba dang 'tsham par/ /mkha' spyod dag zhing 'khrid pa'i nye lam ston/ /rigs byed lha mo tshogs bdag 'dod rgyal gyis/ /thogs med dbang gi 'phrin las 'phrul po ches/ /dregs ldan log par 'khru rnams rab bsdus nas/ /thub pa'i rjes su la jug la nye bar 'god/ /gtum chen rdo rje srin po gur gyi ma gon/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po dmar nag las mkhan bcas/ /mthu stobs dus kyi byin za 'bar ba'i rtser/ /dgra bgegs rtsa sbur mi rtag lam du 'god/ /mdor na klog pa thos bsam spong ba dang / /bya ba las 'khor las kyi shākya'i bstan/ /spyi dang khyad par 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i/ /ring lugs bla nas blar mthor spel bar rigs/ /ches cher snyigs ma'i dus kyi skad ngan pas/ /dam pa'i chos la gcig tu gzhol kho nas/ /sna tshogs skye bo'i yid kyis bsos sman du/ /'gyur ba'i lugs (28ba)zungs mdun ma dka' mor snang / /de phyir bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam pa bzhi/ /mchog —228

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (pedaman bar pa'i 'gro ba 'dul ched du/ /rgyal bas lan cig min par bsngags pas na/ /thabs mkhas spyod pas don gnyis sgrubs shig gu/ /rang nyid blang dor gdengs tshod dang bral nas/ /ne tso ltar smra shes ldan khrel ba'i gnas/ /yin kyang ri khud bla mas nan tan du/ /bskul ngo ma ldog tshig gi 'phreng bar spel/ /pad rtsa ltar dkar bzang po'i bsam pa yis/ /brjod pa'i maṇ+ḍalasangs rgyas sras༄cas la/ /'bul na ma smad thugs rje nyi 'od kyis/ / bdag sogs 'gro ba'i blo mun sel bar shog /ces blang dor gyi rim pa bslab bya'i tshul du bsdebs pa zhig dgos zhes mdo rgyud kyi rgya mtshor blo gros mchog tu yangs pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen ri khud bla ma shākya kun dgas bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /su sti/ bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya'i tog /thags snyom tshems dkar 'dzum pa'i zhal sgo las/ /mtha' klas chos kyi phung po gsungs so cog /grangs med skye rgu'i nyer 'tsho rtsi sman ljon/ /'gro rgyud nyon mongs gaṅgā'i klung rdul bzhin/ /phra mor 'byed nus sangs rgyas kho na'i yul/ /yin phyir snying po'i gsung rab pha mtha'i tshad/ /tshur mthong byis blos gzhal bar ga la ci/ /de ltar mchog dman theg pa'i rnam grangs kun/ /ma 'dres nyams su len la mthu zhan yang / /bstan pa thams cad dgongs don 'gal med du/ /gdams par shar nas rgyud (29na)thog 'gol ba gnad/ /'phags bod mkhas grub nam mkha'i skar tsho gis kyi/ /rnam dag so so'i zhi lugs ban yongs bstar bas/ /dus gsum rgyal rnams gshegs bshul nyer bgrod pa/ /rmad byung nyams su blang 'os kho na'i lus/ /'on te rkang 'thung khrod na yongs 'du ltar/ 'ang rta che gnyis bzhed gzhung skyes bu gsum/ /lam gyi rim pa di paṃ ka ra nas/ /yongs brgyud bka' gdams snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar/ /tshul 'di ches phra bstan pa'i me ro tsam/ /slar bsos gangs can ljongs 'dir rgyas mdzad pa/ /'jam mgon blo bzang grags pas rab bkral ba'i/ /legs bshad 'di ko sngon med yid bzhin nor/ /lam gyi rim pa gnyis kyi tshig don kun/ /zhib mor brjod na yi ge'i tshogs kyis 'jigs/ /snying por dril tshe nges 'byung byang chub lam/ /stong nyid —229

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shertogs pa'i shes rab gsum du 'dus/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i/ /ngang tshul tshig gi rjes tsam ma 'brangs par/ /de don bcos min yid la mi bzod pa/ /lhang lhang ma skyes bar du bsgom pa gnad/ /dge bas phyi ma lta mi'i rten thob kyang / /sdug bsngal gsum gyi rgya las ma grol zhing / /'khor ba'i la jug rim bsams te srid pa las/ /thar 'dod snying dbus dam bca'i 'dzin bur thog /rang nyid gtan bde thob kyang mkha' mnyam 'gro /mar shes la sogs rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun/ /legs bsams sman dang 'jug pa rgyal sras kya/ /rlabs chen spyod pa bstar ba gnad du che/ /de yang dang por btang snyoms (29bsngon song bas/ /tshe 'di'i mas mtshon dgra gnyen bar ma la/ /bdag bde gzhan gtong gzhan sdug tshur len pa/ shan+ta de wa'i lugs tshul gtso bor bslab/ /snying rje'i yul du gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /snang yang rang bzhin med pa chu zla ltar/ /chos kun gdod nas stong pa dbu ma'i lam/ /nges don lta la dpyad 'jog zung 'brel sgoms/ /rjes thob snang ba mtha' dag sgyu ma yis/ /sprul pa'i rta glang dang mtshungs nges brnyed cing / /nam mkha' bzhin du g.yo med mnyam bzhag gis/ /srid pa'i gzhi rtsa thams cad drungs nas 'byin/ /rgyal pos legs gsungs mkhas pa mang pos bshad/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i tshogs kyis nyams su bstar/ /lo paṇa gyis bsgyur dpyad gsum dag pa'i chos/ /blo gsal yid dbang 'phrog byed lcags kyu yin/ /chad mthar lhungs pa stong 'byams tad po can/ /phyag rgya par grags ra gan lhad med pa/ /gser zhun lta bu'i mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub ba ched pa'i srol/ /phyag chen snyan pa'i gtam gyis yid 'phrog na/ /smin byed dbang dang grol byed bskyed rdzogs las/ /byung ba'i rang byung ye shes 'brul med du/ /nyams blangs tshe 'dir rdo rje la4 dbang 'thob/ /nges 'byung gis drangs so thar khrims kyis btsun/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po byang sems sgoms/ /phra rags bskyed rim dben gsum sgyu lus dang / /'od gsal zung 'jug lam gyis gtan mdun sgrubs/ /zhes pa 'di'ang bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa'i khrims dang ldan cing theg pa chen po'i chos —230

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ ('akyis (30na bo la 'byor don ldan du byed pa'i 'phan yul drug brgya dge slong blo bzang dkon mchog gis nyams len byed tshul zhig ring nas bskul ba ltar za hong gyi ban+de 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /'gro rnams thog ma med nas mi dge ba/ /bsags pa nag por 'dzag pa'i 'bras bu rnams/ /smin pa ji bzhin snyigs ma lnga bdo 'dir/ /nad mtshon mu shes nyam thag skye rgu'i las/ /tshul 'dir rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa kun/ /ma la bu gcig bzhin du rjes brtse yang / /'gro ba'i dkar nag sngon bsags deng smin pa/ /re zhig bcos su med la mthu dpung ci/ /'on kyang du khas mnar ba'i skye rgu rnams/ /chu nang zla gzugs sgyu ma'i rta glang bzhin/ /snang yang bden par ma grub don dam bden/ /brjod bral stong chen dag pa'i dbyings su zhog /rmi lam yul gyi 'char sgo ji bzhin du/ /bde sdug sna tsho gos snang ba 'khor ba'i rgya/ /dbral nas thar pa'i lam du lus can kun/ /sgrol nus smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed gces/ /rgya bod hor sogs thos so cog gi 'gro /sdug bsngal 'dam las grol bar mchog gsum la/ /gsol gdab 'debs bya 'debs byed 'debs yul dang / /bral ba gdod ma'i gshis la lhug par zhog /ces pa'ang ma hā tsi na'i yul nas un dur bla ma'i shi res thus dmag 'di la brten nas skye 'gro grangs med pa shi bas/ nges 'byung skyes shing mya ngan gyis non par phan pa'i gdams pa sog skad du bsgyur ba zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar (30ba)ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /na ma pad+mā kā rā ya/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus e nyi ya na yi/ /slob dpon rigs rnams kun gyi khyab bdag che'i/ /snying rtag bdud rtsi'i nying khu mang tsam du/ /nyams su bstar ba mdun ma'i yang rtse yin/ /de phyir rdo rje slob dpon tshad ldan drung / /dkyil 'khor chen por dbang gis legs smin nas/ /grol byed khrid kyi rim par thun mong dang / /thun mong ma yin sngon 'gro ma 'phyugs gnad/ /dal 'byor rnyed —231—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyedaka' mi rtag 'chi ba dran/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsod nams ku su lu'i/ /tshogs gsog rdor sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /thun mong sngon 'gror nang byan chud par bya/ /lus ngag yid gsum ru shan so sor dbye/ /rigs drug sa bon ye shes me yis bsregs/ khang rul zhig 'dra khol bur na ba dang / /drod skye mi rtog 'char ba lus sngon 'gro /rlung sems lha gsum gcig bsres snang glu blangs/ /phyi nang kun la rgyas gdab rang bzhin bral/ /hūm̐ gis phyi nang zad thal la phug pas/ /rdos bcas dngos por 'dzin pa rang gis zhig /hūm̐ gi ba thag 'ching dang grol ba yi/ /dmigs pa gang la bstad kyang bsgyur du btub/ /srin 'gros tshul gyi nam mkha'i mthar gzhal bas/ /dga' skyo 'char ba dag gi sngon 'gro yin/ /'khor bar 'khyams mkhan sgo gsum gang yin brtag /sems su ngo 'phrod rkun ma ngos zin 'dra/ /sgo gsum gcig na sems kyang mthong thos bsam/ /yang na lus ngag gzugs dang sgra yis dben/ /dpyad pas lus ngag rten dang (31na)gcig bral bas/ /'khrul rtog kun zhi chos nyid rang zhal mthong / /sems 'di'i 'byung gnas 'gro gsum btsal ba na/ /phyi nang snod bcud cha shas phur gsil kyang / /ma rnyed skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba yi/ /mnyam yangs blo bde sems kyi sngon 'gro yin/ /lus ni 'gul bskyod ngag ni smra brjod dang / /sems ni dran rtog bral bar lhod kyis glod/ /rtsa rlung khod snyoms ting 'dzin ngang gis 'phel/ /gnad du bab ste sngon 'gro bzhi yi lam/ /de ltar thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /sngon 'gro'i nyams len nyams 'og tshud nges la/ /rdo rus thug par nyams su blangs pa'i rjes/ /dngos gzhir brtson 'grus rab kyis tshe 'di dang / /'bring gis bar do tha mas rang bzhin gyi/ /sprul skur 'tshang rgya'i dang por khregs chod dang / /thod rgal lam gyi rim pa rnam gnyis las/ /dang por snang ba sems su ngo sprod pa/ /phyag chen pa ltar sa rdo ri brag sogs/ /snang tsam sems su 'dod pa blun po'i lugs/ /snang tsam bzung ba'i yul la cher brtags pas/ /'khrul pa tsam las gzhi med rtsa ba bral/ /'di zhes 'dzin pa'i blo yang de dang 'dra/ /de gnyis skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba yi/ /dbyer med snang ba sems nyid las ga then med/ /sems las byed mkhan gak+ṣ-i na —232

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ ( dza)du med pas na/ /chu las chu lhar ba rdo la las ga' na du med/ /snang ba sems su ngo sprod zab gnad yin/ /sems de stong nyid chos sku ma 'gags pa'i/ /rtsal las 'khor 'das chos kun snang na yang / /ngo bo stong pa spros dang bral ba'i phyir/ /chu bo brlan gsher dag las gzhan med pas/ /sems (31ba)nyid stong par ngo sprod man ngag yin/ /snang dang snang yul dbyer med dug lnga sogs/ shar yang ngo bo stong pa gang shar kun/ /sgyu mar 'char ba snang stong gnyis med de/ /bu ram de yi ro bzhin dbyer ma nus/ /'di ko snang stong zung du 'jug pa'i gnad/ /snying dbus gzhon nu bum skur gdod ma nas/ /'dus ma byas pa ka dag rig pa'i gshis/ /gnyis med rang grol nyi ma'i snying po ltar/ /skyon bral 'di las sangs rgyas logs su med/ /skyon bral 'di dngos bzung nas cer gyis blta/ /gnyis med rang grol gdengs tshad btsal ba yin/ /gnyis pa thod rgal lam gyi rim pa ni/ /sprul sku drang srong cog bu'i bzhugs stangs kyis/ /snying dbus ye shes sum ldan gdod ma'i mgon/ /rig gdangs rtsa sgron lam brgyud chu sgron mas/ /thon pa ye shes sgron ma chos nyid de/ /dag pa dbyings kyi mkha' la shar ba'i tshe/ /'od dang 'od khrim thig dang thig phran dang / /sbra phug re lde mthing phyar me long sogs/ /gang shar de la rtse gcig bltas pa na/ /ka dag lhun grub gnyis su med pa yi/ ta shes rab rang byung sgron ma'i gzhi'i snang lugs/ /da lta'i snang sems 'bras bu ye grol ba'i/ /smin byed don la goms pas mngon sum gyi/ /rang snang dbyings rig dbyer med du 'char bas/ /'di mthong tsam gyis 'khor bar phyir mi ldog /de ltar sbyangs pas phyi yi dbyings nang du/ /lug rgyud dbyer med gnas pa ji lta bar/ /nang du ka dag stong pa'i dbyings kyi ngang / /rang mdangs rig pa'i dbyings kyi rtsal rnams kun/ /dbyer med gnas pas 'od gsal ma bu 'dres/ /chos nyid mngon sum nyams su blangs pa'i rjes/ /longs sku glang chen nyal (32na)ba'i 'dug stangs kyis/ /gong bzhin bltas pas kha dog rnam pa lnga'i/ /'od 'phreng thig le sran ma tsam gyi nang / /lug rgyud skar mda' ji bzhin 'tsher zhing mgyogs/ /gyen sgreng rtsibs shar gru phyed re lde dang / /yul gru la sogs ma nges cir yang 'char/ /thig le me long tsam gyi nang du ni/ /rig pa 'dab chags —233—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'aphur rkyen bzhin du 'char/ /de nub ye shes lnga dbyings snang ba ni/ /mig tshags mig mar dra ba dra phyed dang / /me tog tshom bu rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan tshogs/ /mkhar thabs za 'og gur khyim thig le'i khyon/kham bor tsam la ri dwags spang rgyug 'dra/ /de rjes thig le bse phug tsam gyi nang / /rig pa bung ba rtsi bcud myang ba 'dra/ /lug rgyud gcig 'dus gnyis dang lngar 'bel sogs/ /snang ba dang po'i thig le las che zhing / /bar do las grol nyams ni gong 'phel tshad/ /'di la rdor sems sku rkyang 'char ba sogs/ /snying tig gzhan du byung bas gang zag gi/ /'char sgo'i snang tshul gcig tu mtha' ma bkag /de rjes chos sku seng ge'i bzhugs stangs kyis/ /sngon bzhin gcun nas dbyings rig bltas pa yi/ /thig le re re'i nang du phyed sku dang / /sku rkyang sprul sku'i snang ba yab yum lngar/ shar ba longs sku'i ye shes tshad du phyin/ /steng dang phyogs bzhir rigs lnga yab dang yum/ /gtso byas yab yum zung 'jug tshom bu yi/ /dkyil 'khor bgrang yas chos sku'i sbyang ba dag /dbyings rig nyin mtshan med pa chad phebs yin/ /de ltar goms pas tshe 'dir zhing khams chod/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru grol ba yin/ /slar yang chos sku'i bzhugs stangs ngang nyid las/ /snying dbus rig pa a dkar las 'phros pa'i/ /sngon po'i 'od kyis stod smad lus kun khyab/ /mdun nas brtsams (32ba)te dkar ser dmar ljang gis/ /lus ni 'od kyi phung po chen por gyur/ /lnga ldan thig le a phyi'i yi ge sogs/ /grangs med ba spu'i bu ga nas thon te/ /snang srid thams cad 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ /rags pa'i lus zad mnyam bzhag phyag rgya can/ /'od lus sgyu ma tsam du 'char ba yin/ /gzhen nu 'bum sku 'grub nas skra sen so/ /cung zad bzhag ste sngon med rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de'i phyir chos nyid zad sar 'byol zhes brjod/ khregs chod thod rgal nyams len rab 'bring mtha'/ /nyams 'og chud na brtson 'grus 'bring po rnams/ /bar do tha ma rang bzhin sprul sku yi/ /zhing du 'tshang rgya'i gdams par ma bltos shing / /spro na snying tig zang thal klong gsal dang / /gser zhun la sogs mang por rgyas bshad cing / /de don chos 'di ston pa'i mkhas grub kyi/ /zhal lung rnams la 'bad pas blang bya sa /yong bas yi ge'i tshogs kyis ma bkod —234

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ ('akyang / /blo gsal rnams kyis thos bsam sgom pas 'grub/ /snying tig las brtsams gdams pa nyung ngu zhig /rdzogs chen bla ma pad+ma rigs 'dzan gyis/ /bskul tshe gang shar rang grol gyis bkod pa'i/ /yi ge'i 'du byed dpal grong sngags rams so/ /na mo mañju badz+ra ya/ 'di phyi'i legs tshogs kun gyi rtsa ba ni/ /dkar nag las 'bras blang dor kho nar rag /de don tshul bzhin ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /srid zhi'i yon tan spel byed ma ma yin/ /de phyir rang la dam chos 'chad mdzad pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin rnams la skyon rtog blo skyes na/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i sa bon mes tshig par/ /sngon po'i myu gu ji bzhin 'bras bus stong / /(33na lo la 'chal thos nyung 'jungs sems la sogs pa/ /skyon gyi cha nas nam yang mi bsam par/ /yon tan gtso bor bzung nas shugs drag gi /dad pa legs bskyed 'di phyi'i mdun ma mchog /rtsod dus bla ma skyon yon 'dres pa'ang / /rang sems log par rtog pa'i 'char sgo las/ /nges pa'i don du sangs rgyas dngosayin par/ /blo thag chod na nyes pa'i dri dang bral/ /skyon rnams rang gi mthong snang kho na dang / /yon to tshogs la yid ches gdengs rnyed pa'i/ /mdun ma'i rtse mor gdung shugs gang che ba'i/ /blo de ngang gis 'byung ba chos nyid yin/ /ched bu bsgoms pa'i rtsol bar bltos min par/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong thos dran pa'i mod/ /skyon bral yon tan ma lus tshang ba sa /'bad med 'char na rnam dag dad pa yin/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu ldan pa mi yi lus/ /rang thog tshang ngam ma tshang legs brtags nas/ /tshang na de rgyu bsgrub pa dge sdig gi /blang dang dor bya'i dka' gnad tshul la bsam/ /tshe 'dir phal cher sdig pa'i las bsags tshe/ /sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' ni gong dang mtshungs/ /de phyir rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung dgos pas/ /dal rten thob pa nyin skar bzhin du dkon/ /btsas ma thag dang dar babs rgan po rnams/ /nges med 'chi bdag drung du chu klung bzhin/ /dbang med rgyu ba'i ngang tshul 'di mthong na/ /tshe 'di'i mdun bsgrub byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra/ /bsags pa'i dkar nag las kyi 'bras(33ba)bu de/ cung zad tsam yang mi 'chol nges par myong / /rgyud lnga'i 'gro kun sdug bsngal rnam gsum gyis/ /—235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyemanang ba'i tshul la bsams na snying rtsa 'dar/ /'chi med bdag po 'khor los sgyur rgyal kyang / /ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar 'phyan pa ches mang na/ /skyugs nad can la zan bzhin blo log ste/ /bcos min thar 'dod nges 'byung rnam dag yin/ /de ltar 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho cher/ /rtogs te bslab gsum lam gyi gru gzings la/ /brten nas zhi bde'i rin chen gling phyin kyang / /don gnyis ma rdzogs dman pa'i sa ru gol/ /bde ba 'dod kyang ches cher rmongs pa'i blos/ /mi bzad nyes brgya'i zug rngu'i rgyu bsgrubs te/ /sdug bsngal dngos dang de rgyur longs spyod pa'i/ /'gro kun drin can pha ma sha stag yin/ /rang la mthu bral rnam pa thams cad mkhyen/ /thob na g.yin don rgya cher 'grub pa'i phyir/ /bdag gzhan mnyam par brje ba'i byang chub kyi/ /sems bskyed phyin drug lam la bslab pa gces/ /de ltar dang por nges 'byung byang chub sems/ /snying por dril ba'i tshigs bcad nyung ngu zhig /dgos zhes sgra tshad smra ba'i rab 'byams pa/ /bshes gnyen rnam par rgyal des bskul ba'i ngor/ /rang la bsam pa'i bag chags phra mo'ang / /mi ldan ni tso'i smra ba ji bzhin du/ /tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes bkod pa yi/ /yi ge'i 'du byed blo bzang dbang po'i/ /(34na/sangs rgyas kun 'dus rnga yab gling pa dang / /dri med bshes gnyen mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gar/ /mngon sum ston mdzad yongs 'dzin rnam pa bzhi/ /byang chub thob kyang rigs kyi bdag por zhugs/ /nam mkha'i pha mthas gzhal dka'i sems can gyi/ /dbang po dang 'tsham sgrib gnyis gnyen po na/ /rgyal bas legs gsungs bgrang yas chos phung tshogs/ /bsdu na rgyu 'bras theg pa gnyis su 'du/ /mtha' dag 'gro la sman pa sha stag las/ /don med don log ston pa mi srid kyang / /myur du sangs rgyas sgrub thabs gsang sngags kyi/ /nye lam 'di ko ga 'a na las khyad par 'phags/ /de yi nang nas theg pa kun gyi rtse/ /a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag gis/ /phung po 'od skur tshe 'dir grol nus pa'i/ /lam 'di bde gshegs rnams kyis byon pa'i bshul/ /'on te rtsa ba bral ba'i stong po dang / /rmad med rtsig pa'i kha bad la rangs ltar/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ /'khor ba'i sdug —236

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ ḍa'abasngal snying nas bsam pa gnad/ /sdug bsngal de las skyob phyir skyabs 'gro dang / /ma rgan 'gro la brtse ba'i sems mchog bskyed/ /bsag sbyangs byin brlabs myur 'jug bla ma yi/ /rnal 'byor rang gi rgyud la 'dres nges gces/ /tshul 'di lam 'bras gsang bde sbyor drug dang / /byu gu zhi gcod dbu phyag blo sbyong sogs/ /nyams khrid bal dang phyogs tsam mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /thun mong sngon 'gro zhes su ming 'dogs mdzad/ /thun mong ma yin lus ngag yid (34ba gsum pa/ /'khor 'das ru shan dbye bas sdig pa 'dag /bar chad sel zhing dngos zhen ldog pa dang / /rdo rje gsum du 'tshang rgya'i dgos pa yod/ /srid par zo chun ltar 'khor rigs drug gi /sa bon gdod nas rang lus la gnas pa/ /ye shes mes bsregs sgo gsum sgrib pa dag /rigs drug zhen ldog phyin chad 'khor rgyun gcod/ khol bu na dang khang rul zhig pa dang / /drod skye ma rtog ngang du sems gnas pa/ /ma byung bar du rdo rje'i 'dug stangs sogs/ /lus kyi sngon 'gro'i gnad la nan tan bya/ /phyi nang thams cad hūṃ gi rang bzhin dang / /snod bcud hūṃ gi zang thal phug pa yis/ /rang bzhin med par rdos bcas tshugs zhig nas/ /stongs sang 'ja' tshon lta bur 'char ba yin/ /hūṃ gi ba thag grol 'ching 'byog 'gros kyi/ /sna tshogs dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor la bcur bas/ /ther zug med par gang 'dod la bsgyur cing / /lus ngag lam du bsgyur btub dgos pa yod/ /lus ngag rigs drug gnas 'khyams ltar snang yang / /bde sdug sems kyi myong ba'i rnam 'phrul te/ ji ba'i 'og tu lus ni bems po dang / /smra brjod pi wang rgyud thag chad pa bzhin/ /chu nang zla ltar chos kun rang sems la/ /snang ba tsam las ga' na dang mi gcig par/ /rtogs tshig gzung 'dzin rtsa chad gnyis 'dzin gyi/ /mkhar 'gyel chos nyid mkha' ltar khyab pa'i gnad/ /gsal gsal jig cig sems 'di gang nas ta grang / /gang gnas gang 'gro btsal bas skye 'gag gnas/ /yongs bral gdod ma'i (35na)gshis lugs mthong ba'i mod/ /mnyam yangs chen por gcig tu blo bde'o/ /lus bskyod ngag smra yid rton dang bral bar/ /nyal bas rtsa rlung 'khor snyoms ting nge 'dzin/ /shugs 'byung sgo gsum 'dzin pa rang sar grol/ /thun mong ma yin sngon 'gro rnam bzhir grags/ /deng —237

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedus sems kyi gnas cha tsam rnyed par/ /rtogs pa mthon por rlom pa'i sgom chen po/ /mang yang lam 'di'i dngos gzhi'i phyogs tsam du/ /ma slebs rmang gzhi yin pas nan tan dgos/ /sngon nas bka' gter rdzogs chen gang rung gi /smin byed dbang chu ma thob gsar bu rnams/ /nges gsang snod rung bya phyir smin byed dbang / /tshad ldan cho ga'i sgo nas legs par zhu/ /ka dag dngos gzhir chu las chu lhar bzhin/ /ye nas btsal du med pas chos rnams kun/ /sems kyi snang cha yin phyir snang ba kun/ /sems su thag bcad myong ba thon par bya/ /phra zhib gnas la phyi rol gzung ba'i yul/ /me long gzugs ltar rang gi sems la shar/ /de bzhin bzang ngan rtog byed 'dzin pa yang rang sems la shar gzung dang 'dzin pa'i chos/ /sgyu ma'i rta glang lta bur med bzhin du/ /gzhi med rtsa bral ye nas dag na yang / /stong zhing ma 'gags snang ba sems tsam du/ khas len snga 'gyur rigs 'dzin rnams kyi lugs/ /gnad 'gag 'di don ma rtogs snod bcud sogs/ /mthong tshad sems su smra ba'i phyag chen po/ /sems kyang bems por thal ba'i 'gal dum phreng / /lugs srol 'di yi bgrang byar 'dren mi rung / /sems snang ma 'gags (35ba〉nyam gyi rang rtsal la/ /snang yang dpyad na ye stong chos sku sa /nges pas 'brul ba'i gzhi rtsa dngos 'dzin zhig /chu bo gsher las logs su med dang mtshungs/ /bzang ngan gang shar ngo bor bltas pas stong / /stong pa'i ngang nas sgyu ma ltar 'char ba/ /dbyer med nyon mongs ye shes lngar grol bas/ /bu ram de'i ro bzhin du dbyer mi nus/ /snying dbus gzhen nu bum skur sems nyid dam/ /rig pa gdod nas grol ba'i kun tu bzang / /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum 'dus pa/ /chos nyid ngang nas chos nyid yul la spyod/ /'dus byas kun gzhi'i sems tsam glo ba sa /las rlung gis drangs 'bras bu 'khor bar 'khyams/ /de nyid rtar zhen dri med rig pa yang / /zhal phyag rdzogs pa'i sku ru ngang gis 'char/ /da lta'i rig pa 'di la cer bltas pas/ /gsal la 'dzin pa dngas la phyi nang med/ /yangs la 'chal ba rang dngos ngos gzung med/ /gsal bas gar khyab rig pas yongs la khyab/ /zang thal cham brdal stong gsal rig gsum po/ /dbyer med mkhyen cha nang gsal rtog pa 238

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (dza/yis/ /ma bslad ye shes gsum dang ldan pa'i gshis/ /rang babs cog bzhag rgya yan chen po'i ngang / /bzhag tshe mkha' la snod bcud kun gyis kyang / /tshur la dgos pa med pa ji bzhin du/ /nyi ma'i snying po nam yang mun pa dang / /gtan bral lta bur nges nas mnyam par bzhag /nyams su blangs rjes 'gyur ba med pa yi/ /gdengs tshad 'tshol phyir nges shes drang ba dang / /rtsal sbyang bogs dbyung rim bzhin nyams bstar bas/ /gang (36na skor chos sku'i yo lang chen por 'gro /chos kun ye nas ka dag khreg chod lam/ /nyams bog chud nas yon tan ma lus pa/ /ye nas lhun rdzogs thod rgod sngon 'gro la/ /lus ngag yid gsum bya ba dgu phrugs gtong / /'byung bzhi dag nas rig pa ye shes dang / /dkar 'jam rtsa dar rgyang zhags dag par dbyings/ /thig le stong pa shes rab rang byung gi /sgron ma drug po las rlung yongs dag nas/ /ye shes rlung gi cha las nyer byung ba/ /nyams su len tshe sgom gsum gcun pa'i thabs/ /sprul sku drang srong longs sku glang chen dang / /chos sku seng ge'i bzhugs stangs legs bcasate/ /ye dag rang rig mgon po 'od mi 'gyur/ /'od phung dbus na ye shes gsum ldan gyi/ /snying po rma bya'i sgo nga lta bu sa /nang gsal gdangs las sku dang thig le zhing / /mtha' klas rang la rang chas lhun grub pa/ /skal can rnams kyis mngon sum ngo 'phrod tshe/ /rang snang 'og min zhing du 'tshang rgya'i lam/ /'od gsal snang ba bzhi ru yongs 'char ba/ /rten dang brten par 'brel phyir snying dbus nas/ /nang dbyings rig pa ye shes sgrol ma de/ /dkar 'jam rtsa yi sgron ma'i lam brgyud de/ /rgyang zhags chu yi sgron ma'i sgor thon pa/ /rnam dag dbyings sgron thig le stong sgron nang / /rig pa rang byung lug rgyud 'char ched du/ /zim bu'i mig gis zer la khrid pa yi/ /gzer bas gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i/ /ka dag lhun grub gnyis su dbyer med pa/ /lug rgyud gser (36ba〉skud phreng dang thig le dang / /thig phran shar mthar shes rab rang byung gi /sgron ma'i sngon 'gror ko mog rdo bskyur nas/ /rma bya'i mdongs bkra'i bar du shar pa la/ /chos nyid mngon sum snang ba zhes bshad cing / /nyi ma ma g.yos 'od zer 'phro ba ltar/ /gzhen nu bum sku rig pa ye shes de/ /rang gi gzhi dbyings ye shes stong sgron yin/ /—239

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shede'i gdangs rtsa mig mkha' ru shar ba la/ /thig le stong sgron rig pa'i ye shes zer/ /phyi nang phra mo'i gnad 'gag ma nor gces/ /nyams kyi snang ba gong du spel ba'i ched/ /sngar bzhin ma yengs gcig tu gzir ba yis/ /chos nyid mngon sum dus las thig le rnams/ /je cher 'phel ba rtags tshad gcig tu 'dod/ /bi ma'i snying tig klong gsal la sogs par/ /rdor sems sku rkyang yan chad 'char ba'i tshul/ /gang zag so so'i dbang po'i khyad par las/ /mtha' bkag gcig gi ngos gzung byar mi nus/ /rig pa tshar du phebs pa'i nyams len skabs/ /dbyings kyi snang bas kun la khyab pas na/ /'byung ba bzhi yi snang ba dang bral bas/ /thig le'i dbus su phyed sku nas bzung ste/ /stong gsum gang du bltas kyang dbyings rig gi /snang ba nyin mtshan rgyun chad med par 'char/ /gong du sku rkyang shar tshe 'di nyid kyi/ /thog mar yab yum zung re 'char bar bshad/ /nyams su blangs mthar chos nyid zad pa ni/ /phyi rol nyams kyi snang ba'i 'phel kha zad/ /nang du sgyu lus rdos bcas phung po zad/ /gsang ba (37na)rtog tshogs sems kyi 'phro 'du zad/ /tshig dang 'khrul pa thams cad rang dag nas/ /gzugs phung 'ja' lus 'od kyi gong bur yal/ /rnam dag chos sku'i slong du thim pa yi/ /'ja' sprin nam mkhar thim pa ji bzhin no/ /mtha' rten mi 'gul gsum gyi gzhir bca' ba/ /sdod pa gsum gyi chad bzub rtags gsum po/ /sgo gsum la 'char tshad gsum rmi lam gyi/ /thob pa gsum gyi gzer gdab gdengs bzhi yi/ /drod tshad legs bstan tshe gcig grol nus pa/ /dbang po rab kyi nyams su blang bya de/ /gal te tshe 'dir grol bar ma nus na/ /'bring gis bar do'i lam gyis grol ba'i thabs/ /rab kyi ded dpon gser gling bgrod pa ltar/ /skye gnas bar do'i don rtogs rnam shes mkhar/ /thim tshe 'od gsal ma bu gcig 'dres pa/ /ngo 'phrod shar grol dus mnyam rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /'bring gis skad cig gnyis par ngo 'phrod nas/ /stong par rtogs pas mtsho la kha ba bzhin/ /nyon mongs chos nyid ro gcig grol ba'i mthar/ /yon tan rdzogs nas mngon par 'tshang rgya 'gyur/ /tha mas 'khrul ba rang thog tu grol bas/ /chos nyid bar dor ma sleb tsam gyi dus/ /'khyags rngam chu bzhin 'od gsal cher mched nas/ /—24()

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (dze)rim grol thog ma'i bzhi ru sangs rgyas thob/ /rgyal po'i bka' chems bskur ltar 'chi kha yi/ /bar dor rang gi stobs sam grogs gzhan gyis/ /zhi khro'i sku dang sgra 'od zer gsum sogs/ /ngo sprad chos nyid bar do shar tshe grol/ /'chi ba'i 'od gsal ma pang bu rgyug la/ /(37bdakar lam dmar lam kha bye brgyal sangs dus/ /slo bur dri bral zhi ba chos kyi sku/ /ston gnam g.ya' dag lta bu'i 'od gsal de/ /ngo 'phrod ka dag gzhi la rang grol ba/ /chos nyid bar do'i khongs su 'chad na yang / /'di dus bem rig bral bar ma gyur phyir/ /don gyi 'chi kha bar do'i khongs su gtogs/ /lhun grub bar do'i rab ni 'od gsal la/ /nam mkha' thim tshe mdun du ye shes lnga'i/ /mthong khung 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i ba thag can/ /mig g.yon zug pa thugs rje tshad med kyi/ /thag pa rdor sems khong gseng lam la bstad/ /rig pa stong gsal 'dus ma byas pa la/ /ma yengs ngang nas yar gyi zang thal du/ /skar mda' 'phangs pa lta bur thogs med 'gro /ngos ma zin tshe de las mched pa yi/ /'od gsal zhing khams rgya che mu med pa/ /yom yom shig shig shar kun rang snang du/ /rtogs pa'i mod la skad cig nyid la grol/ /'bring gi klad pa dur khar nang bzhugs pa'i/ khrag 'thung stang stabs sgra 'od mtshon cha sogs/ /sngar 'dres mi bzhin ma bu 'phrod pa yi/ /rang shar rang snang ngang du grol ba yi/ /tha ma snying ga'i zhi ba'i lha tsho gos rnams/ /rim bzhin 'char ba dben na rnam snang sku/ khar tshe gdams par dran nas ngo 'phrod pa'i/ /snang mdzad ngo bor 'tshang rgya gzhan rnams shes/ /srid pa bar do'i rab kyi bar do der/ /rmi lam tsam du skyes kyang tshe sngon dus/ /bla mas ngo sprad chos nyid mngon sum la/ cung zad nyams blangs mthu yis skad cig mar/ /rmi lam (38na)sad ltar shar phyogs mngon dga' sogs/ /sangs rgyas zhing mang bgrod nas chos nyan cing / /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang / /'khor ba de srid 'gro ba 'dren par 'gyur/ /'bring gis srid pa bar dor 'khyams pa'i tshe/ /sngon thab dbang dang gdams pa dran byas nas/ /rigs drug skye sgo bgags nas sprul sku'i zhing / /dran pa'i mod la gnas der skye ba len/ /tha mas bskyed rim gsal gdam bla ma bsgom/ /rtse gcig 'dun pas pha ma lha sku n+da/ /gsal ba'i mkha' gsang pad+ma —241—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyenyi zla'i steng / /rnam shes yi dam sa bon la bcug pas/ /dal 'byor rten thob nyams len 'phro 'thud pa/ /yun chags sa 'dzugs lta bur grol lam rnyed/ /yang mtha' skyabs 'gro sems bskyed shugs drag pos/ /gnas ga las ldog chos ldan lus rten thob/ /brtson 'grus ches cher zhan dang sdig can rnams/ /ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'pho ba'i man ngag gis/ /dag zhing bgrod thabs rigs 'dzin brgyud pa yi/ /zhal drod mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can las long / /de ltar dbang po rab 'bring tha ma yi/ /'jug ngogs theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse'i chos/ /pad+ma kā ra bi mā la mi tra'i/ /thugs bcud snying tig mang po'i dgongs don yin/ /rnam mang grub mthas rgyud bslad log rtog mkhan/ /ma yin snying nas mos pa'i snod ldan las/ /kun la bstan nas e ka dza ṭā sogs/ /chos srung gnyan pas gsang rgyas 'debs pa gnad/ /sngon gyi bag chags phra mos chos 'di la/ /mos shing mang du thos (38ba)kyang sgrub la g.yel/ /ba sdu'i smra ba lta bu bum stong nas/ /snod gzhan la 'byo mo gsham bu dang mtshungs/ /'on te tshe 'di'i bya ba rgyab tu bsgyur/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mang po'i zhabs pad bsten/ /rtse gcig sgrub la nyer gzhol rigs 'dzin gyis/ /'bad pas bskul tshe cung zad g.yar khral bgyis/ /dge 'dis deng nas bzung ste rang rig sems/ /gdod nas dag pa rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal/ /ma mthong de srid chos 'di ston mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon 'bral med bsten pa dang / /chos brgyad bun long byis blo 'drid thabs la/ /ma chen skyon kun ka dag chos sku'i gdangs/ /yon tan lhun grub yongs sku'i zhing myul te/ /sprul skus mtha' klas sems can 'dren par shog /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa brtse chen grub chen 'od gsal klong yangs rang grol gyis zhal gdams su ming btags pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba la brten nas rdo rje 'ams chen po dpal 'byor lhun grub/ rab mas shes bya kun gzigs zur chen chos dbyingasarang grol/ bka' gter chos kyi bang mdzod khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje/ rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gdung tshab chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa bzhi'i bka' drin las a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i dbang khrid lung man ngag du ma nos pa'i za hor gyi sngags smyon gang shar rang grol gyis lcags mo bya lo sprel zla'i yar 242

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (setshes la pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon ngag dbang dkon mchog gis bgyis pa sirnyi ra sdu/(39na btsang byed pad+ma ra co 'dri'i snyems min yang / /snang srid dregs pa'i gnyen por rdzus skyes su/ /gar dbang sprul pa'i zlos gar thod phreng rtsal/ /zhabs sen zla tshes gtsug na rtag 'char gsol/ /srid pa'i bya gzhag 'jig rten mi chos dang / /gtan gyi bde ba bsgrub pa'i lha chos gnyis/ /'gal med zung du 'brel ba'i byed chos ni/ /tsha grang lta bur gcig tu 'gal chos yin/ /'on te lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug dang / /rje btsun mi la me long rdo rje sogs/ /chos brgyad gtan spangs sngon byon rnam thar la/ /snying nas thar 'dod su zhig cis mi mos/ /de tshul blo dang brtson pas bsgrub pa la/ /yar gyi dpon dang dma' ba'i 'khor g.yog 'bangs/ /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong re dogs kun spangs nas/ /lho gos gyong khur dben pa rtse gcig bsten/ /deng dus cho se par rlom pa'i gzugs brnyan phal/ /dka' gnas 'di 'dra mngon sum lta ga 'ag gi /rmi lam tsam du 'byung ba'i skal phra na/ /lugs gnyis zung 'brel spyod las 'os gzhan ci/ /de phyir mchog dman dgra gnyen bar ma la/ /brag shul rtsing spyod snang ba gdong 'deng blo/ /ma yin sna tshogs thabs kyis ngo bsrung ba/ /snyigs dus skye rgu'i 'grogs khugs bzang por go /'on kyang dkon mchog las sa rgyab bskyur nas/ /g.yo sgyu mna' za dug gtong ngan las kyis/ /rang don re zhig 'grub kyang brnag dka' ba'i/ /rnam smin mthong chos tshe 'dir myong bsaspong / /lugs gnyis dpal 'byor dar la phrag dog pa/ kha mkhas gting rtsub skya btsun (39ba)grong pa'i rigs/ /sngon las 'phral rkyen dbang gis 'byung srid pas/ /zhib brtag khong bsgrigs kha mdzes zon skyor gces/ /slob bu dgon gnas gra rigs 'khor 'bangs la/ /ha cang byams na phyis su srol ngan 'dzugs/ /drag 'jun chas tshe snying skran 'jug pas na/ /gang 'tsham thabs kyis 'dul ba'i cho ga zab/ /rnyed pas rnyed pa bsdu sogs 'du 'dzi'i las/ /lhur len dam pa'i chos dang rgyab 'gal yang / /deng dus bstan 'dzin yongs kyi rnam par thar/ /'khor skyong 'ur sgrog byed la nges par mkho/ /gcig ngo —243

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyezin kyang cig shos mi dga' ba/ /srang mda'i mtho dman lta bu ches dka' yang / /tshe 'di rgyab tu ma 'khyud sbyin bdag sogs/ /gzhan ngo bsrung zhing 'drid pa gnad du che/ /phan btags drin can blo gtad mkhan po sogs/ /bltos bcas rnams la snyan snyan mdzes tshig gi /me tog mi 'thor gsong por smra ba dang / /phan thabs ci nus sgo gsum bsgrims te 'bad/ /ma rungs log par 'khu la ngan spyod mtshon/ /mi brdeg khong sbed dngos brgyud sgrub thabs kyi/ /cham la 'bebs pa dpa' mdzangs brtul phod pa'i/ /rnam thar rang don bsgrib la lhag par bsngags/ /myang 'das bsam pas ma zin rten bzheng dang / /tshogs gsog 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor na yang / /blun po ngo mtshar 'dzin phyir mi chos la/ /lha chos ming btags 'phrin las spel la phan/ /des mtshon nad gdon bgegs rigs sel ba dang / /ring 'tsho 'byor rgyas phal cher bder 'gro (40na zhang / /nyams myong 'chol med 'byung bar nim nur bral/ /ngan song skyes kyang las dkar 'bras bu la/ /'khor ba'i bde ba sgrub la yangs pa'i blo/ /ldan kyang tshe 'di mi rtag nam mkha'i glog /phyi ma gcig pur 'gro ba re dogs kyi/ /spang blang mang po gleng ba ngag gi las/ /snod kyi 'jig rten dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog dang / /bcud kyi sems can sdug bsngal spyod tshul la/ /bsams na dal rten 'di la sangs rgyas zhes/ /grags snyan sgra bo che de don gnyer rigs/ /sems can bsam pa'i khyad par mtha' klas pas/ /rgyal bas chos tshul grangs med gsungs na yang / /snying po theg pa rim pa dgur 'dus pa'i/ /rnam gsum yo ga las lhag gzhan na gang / /smin grol lung dang rgyud bshad man ngag rnams/ khong du chud nas zhi khro bka' brgyad kyi/ /lha sngags ye shes rol pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /brten nas mchog thun dngos grub bsgrub par rigs/ /ma ning dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu sogs/ /dam can las la bskul te dgra bgegs tshogs/ /nyer bsgral rnam shes rang rig kun bzang zhing / /'dren pa sngags rgan rnams kyi go mtshon yin/ /mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor tsam la ma zhen par/ /rang byung lus kyi rdo rje pho brang du/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs ma lus yongs 'char ba'i/ /zab gsang gnad 'di a ti yo ga'i lam/ /'od gsal chos sku rang la gdod —244

lugs zung dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya zla ba 'bum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ (dzadam nas/ /gcer mthong ngo sprod a ti rdzogs pa che/ /theg pa'i yang rtse 'dzin la goms 'dris na/ /sangs rgyas gzhan nas 'tshol ba'i re ba skyungs/ khyad par pad 'byung thugs bcud (40bslob khar chen bzar/ /gnang ba mkha' 'gro'i snying tig bka' gnad mdud/ /'grol mdzad kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po yi/ /yang tig 'di ko yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /bla rdzogs thugs gsum nyams su blang ba'i phyir/ /mtsho skyes brag tu chig re 'grim pa la/ /thag bcad spang la be phur yongs btab pas/ /dam pa'i rnam par thar der gcig tu rangs/ /'on te snyom chung chen po'i ming mi ldan/ /gzhan gyi phrag dog rlang spyod yul bral ba'i/ /bya btang min phyir tshom rkun jag pa yi/ /'tshe ba sel ba'i thabs la 'bad par rigs/ /ci'i phyir sgrub chen rnams su dgra bzlog pa'i/ /go mtshon nad gso'i sman sogs bshad pa dang / /lus gnas ched du 'tsho ba'i zas bsten pa/ /bshes pa'i springs yig sogs las gsungs dang mtshungs/ /cung zad brjod 'di rig pa 'dzin khyod kyi/ /thugs gsang klong du nye bar sim pa dang /rtse gcig sgrub pa mdzad bzhed lhun grub par/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs rje'i mthu dpung bskyed/ /ces blang dor gyi tshul gdams pa'i lugs su byas pa 'di ni dbang chen sprul par lung gis zin pa thugs sras zla ba'i sprul sku bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten rang gi bya spyod mtha' dag smyon pa'i zlos gar lta bus brjod par mi 'os kyang ne tso'i 'don pa ltar snag shog gi gron la ma 'dzems par za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa blo bzang dbang pho// //—245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyergya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang zhes bya bzhugs/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing bya lor bris pa'i chab 3|ga 'phrin yig khag /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos kya gdan khri la bzhugs pa zhabs drung bdag chen ngag dbang bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i chab shog gi lan mtho ris lding ba'i gsang pa'i them skas/ ā dzi ti ga shā sa mu dro sha ra su sgru sakhyu pa tshu re la 'i smi (la su 'i ya pa dha rnya sa su tho /rgyal (kha sgo phrin pa 'i sdeb sbyor/) ba kun gyi gsang gsum chu gter las/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang phyug nyin mor byed/ /legs byas 'od zer 'bum gyis lus can rnams/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i drung / /(2na)ring min mchog tu dge ba'i dus kyi char/ /nyes brgya ra ri'i dri ma drungs phyung zhing / /mtshan dpe'i cha shas bcu drug yongs gang bas/ /sngon med zla ba gsar pa'i gzugs kyi sku/ /legs byas 'bum sde'i lus phra'i 'dzum mdangs kyis/ /phan bde'i snang ba rgya mtsho'i ngo mtshar mgron/ /mtho ris lding khang gsar pa'i them skas las/ /bsus 'di skal bzang 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /dri med gdung gis mngon mtho 'chi med rgyud/ /'khon rigs ma la ya yi skyed tshal las/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'dri bsung phyogs brgyar 'gyed pa'i dpal/ /grangs med skye bo'i bsod nams zong gis bsgrubs/ /'jam dbyangs thugs rje'i gur kum gsar pa'i tshon/ /ri mo yongs su smin pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i gdugs dkar srid rtse —246

rgya bod tor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (peyi/ khongs las brgal bar 'khor ba'i sa skya pa/ /bka' tham tshig phreng gnyis skyes lus dkar can/ /ngo mtshar gtam gyi mgrin rnga sgrog bzhin du/ /thun 'tshams phyag rgyar 'grogs pa'i bdog pa zung /snyim par thogs te sman ljongs tshal du son/ /rgyal ba kun dngos 'jam mgon btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs gser gyi shing (2bka'i kha lo pa/ /za hor rigs las shākya'i btsun pa yang / /lnga rig rgya mtshor bgrod pa'i 'dun par mchis/ /snyigs mas cher sbags mi bsrun tsher dong na/ /'gro la rjes chagasa'aphags chen dam pa rnams/ /snying stobs go cha btsan pos gzhan gyi don/ /sgrub la ngal ba med pa chos nyid lags/ /de phyir mkhyen brtse'i 'od dkar gar mkhan mas/ /rtsod pa'i mun pa ring du sgrod pa dang / /rdzogs ldan snang ba 'bum sde'i dga' ston gyis/ /kun khyab rnam par thar pa de med byung / /gsang chen slob bshad dbyar skyes snyan pa'i dbyangs/ /phyogs brgyar bsgrigs kyang skal bzang mdongs mtha' can/ /ma gtogs 'dab chags kun gyi mngal 'dzin pa/ /srid min dman pa'i skal ba can des nongs/ /blo gros rin cen sbrel ba'i them skas can/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan sgreng ba'i seng ge khrir/ /snyan rgyud yid bzhin nor bus sa skya pa'i/ /ring lugs rnam par rgyas pa'i mdzad bzang ngos/ /mngon par yangs pa'i mkhyen pa mes po'i thod/ /dri ma med pa'i bka' mchid gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /skal ldan shing rtar 'gran pa'i bya ma rtas/ /sug par thogs te dga' ba'i gar yang byos/ /ri mo rab dkar pad+ma'i tshal/ /rten gyi 'dab rgya g.yo ba la/ /rtags kyi ze'u 'bru g.yur za ba/ /gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i rtse nas phul/ /pho brang chen po sne'u bdong rtse nas zhabs zung rin po che gong ma dpal ldan lha gzigs mi pham bsod nams dbang phyug gragasapa rnam rgyal dpal bzang pos shing bya gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ston dang bcas pa'i chab shog gi phebs lan dge mtshan rgya mtsho'i bdud rtsi/ (3na)da sha ba la shrī 'a tā r+sha snya si : : ku la ra smi sa ha sra 8 la hā/ sho : kaku ra hā ba sbra pu zhi PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB/ /stobs(dzā ti'i steng sbyor 'phags ma/)bcu'i dpal gyi mi zhal lam yangs las/ /mtha' klas grub rigs 'od zer stong 'bar ba/ /mi 'jigs bzhi ldan rdo rje rgyal po yis/ /nor 'dzin skyong gang dus kun dag par mdzod/ /byang phyogs ra ba dkar po'i khor yug —247

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)'dir/ /chos dang srid kyi gtsug tor mthon po'i rtser/ /mang pos bkur ba lha bcas skye rgu'i mgon/ /dpal ldan lha gzigs mi dbang dam pa'i drung / /brgya phrag legs pa'i lam gyi skyed tshal du/ /phul byung nye bar len pa'i yongs 'du'i ljon/ /lugs zung lo 'dab 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i ngo mtshar gtam gyis thos 'dzin skyes su byas/ /dge mtshan rgya mtsho'i mngar ba'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /gsar tshes gnam lo'i yol gor rtag 'khyil ba'i/ /bgrang bya'i (3ba)dpal mo ba 'ad pa'i snyan tshig 'phreng / /bdog pa phyag rgya'i lang tshor spras pa son/ /'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs 'dzin rlom yang / /nyer 'tshe'i shugs drag dri bzhen gyis dben ngos/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i gru gzings thabs tshul gyis/ /gtsug lag nor bu'i dpya la spyod snyam grang / /mi dman dge bcu'i cha shas kun rdzogs shing / /bde legs ga bur thigs pa 'bum 'dzag pa/ /zla 'phreng lang tsho'i bzhin ras ngom pa'i dus/ /sa spyod dam pa'i sde bzhi rgyas gyur cig /yun du snyan pa'i dbyar skyes sgra/ /sgrog pa'i char ldan dus kyi mgron/ /'bod mkhas gsung bris legs ldan dbyid/ /rgyu ba'i tshul 'dir mi bskyud 'tshal/ /rab dkar bkra shis thags kyi dar/ /'chams sprin rgya yis 'khrud bzhin du/ /zla snang rta chen gyis nya ba'i/ /sī yig 'char ba'i tshes la phul/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i gdan sa chen po ri bo dga' ldan dang gangs ri'i khrod kyi rigs pa smra ba kun gyi 'byung gnas gsang ne'u thog gi rngeg lo tsā ba gnyis kyi chos kyi khri la mngon par 'dzegs pa yongs 'dzin bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel la brtan bzhugs dang bcas te zhu 'phrin du gsol ba mi 'gyur rdo rje'i snying po/ (4na) bi pa smo da khye ka do na pa ram cu da r+sha ji ma le/ /bi dzi dha rma : pra ti ma ma ma na sa kya bu dha co/ /〉 du shi : smyule na ra bha ba sa dha rma ga pa khu yo/ /khya rā tsa to wa ti sbi li ta la dza ta ñcakra lha ma rwa/ /bla (sdeb sbyor gtsug phud can/)na med pa'i ye shes me long rnyog pa'i dri ma dang bral ngos/ /chos kun ma lus cig car mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs zlos gar rnam 'gying yang / /zur phud lnga pa mi yi srid bzung thun 'tshams bla gos rab bkra ba/ /gangs can mkhas grub gser gyi 'khor lor thogs med mnga' sgyur —248

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('gang gi drung / /dri bral kun gsal 'bras ldan dus kyi mkhar/ /gsang gsum mdzad pa'i nyin byed 'od rnon las/ /dad pa'i pad+ma dgod pa'i ze'u 'bru'i dbyangs/ /nyams 'gyur stong gi bcud len 'di ltar gsol/ /deng dus mi zad mtshan bzang 'khor lo'i rgyan/ /phul byung gzugs skur sdud pa'i zla bral kyis/ /zhabs sen mthon ga'i 'od stong lhar bcas 'gro'i/ /zur phud bla na mdzes 'di chos nyid lags/ /snyan 'gyur gar du rtse ba dri za'i rgyud/ /zag med skad kyi nga ro nā de'i sgra/ /zab rgyas chos kyi 'jigs med glur sgrog pa/ /srid 'di'i mkhas rlom ri dwags dbus (4bka brjid/ /mi 'gyur stong gzugs mkha' la bde ba'i mdangs/ /gnyis med thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i mtha'/ /rnam 'dren mkhyen pa'i srang la gzhal dka' na/ /tshad du rjod pa rang nyams byis pa'i blo/ grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i bzhed gzhung tshang tshing khrod/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i dgongs don ā shā dā/ /legs bshad 'bras bu'i g.yur za ldem mkhas pa/ /gangs khrod thub bstan yongs kyi shing rta che/ zhan tu sra ba rtog ge'i tshig don gzhu/ /yang dag rigs pa'i rgyud kyis nyer bkug pa'i/ /dgag sgrub nyag phran rnon pos log smra'i snying / /'bigs 'dis chos kyi grags pa'i snyems pa phrogs/ /'phags yul mkhas mang gtsug rgyan paṇ+ḍi ta/ /mtsho byung snying gar rol ba'i dpa' bo'i zhabs/ /rtsom tshe gang gi rnal 'byor shes rab kyis/ /yun du dpyad kyang dbye ba'i go skabs bral/ /'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs dri ma med/ /gyen du 'degs par shin tu lci ba'i khur/ /mngon par 'byed la bzod ldan dpag dka'i thugs/ /yangs pa'i sa 'dir shong ba e ma mtshar/ /'di na thos pa'i gru gzings la zhugs nas/ /legs bshad nor bu 'tshol 'dod snyom las pa/ /rnam g.yeng chu yi 'khri shing 'khrug gyur kyang / /mthun byed brtson pa'i dri bzhen med dman tsam/ /slad mar bstan 'gro'i dpal du 'tsho gzhes sku/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gzhi la rtag 'chel yang / /gzhan ngor gzhom pa med pa'i thabs tshul gyis/ /grangs med bskal par chos 'khor skor du gsol/ /brnag nas las 'das mi bsrun tsher ma'i dong / /ma dag nyes brgya'i dri mas sbags dus 'dir/ /gzhan don snying stobs lhag par mi skyed na/ /rgyal sras chen po'i mtshan —249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)gyis dgos pa ci/ /lugs zung (5na)mkhyen pa'i lag 'gro'i snying po las/ /blang dor 'byed pa'i bslab bya dri bsung can/ /'phrin yig ma la ya klung dang 'grogs te/ /mong rtul tsha gdung sel ba'i bka' drin zhu/ /snyan tshig rgyud du chags pa'i ri bong can/ /rnyog bral thugs mtshor 'char ba'i zhu mchid gzugs/ /bdag gnyen gzhu khyim spyod pa mgo zla ba'i/ /dmar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i bye rdo bsdo 95 sdo 95/ /gtsang stod bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen bco lnga pa yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gang gi gsang ba'i rnam thar gyi sa bon dgos tshul gyi zhu 'phrin du gsol ba gsang mdzod phyag rgya 'grol ba'i lde mig /ru'i rka yu na n+ti bha ra tsa me sag su ri sa spru 'a/ /dzi ba 2 bri kho da yu yasta sgyu ྅ yu ba rgya spo /tshogs (kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor/)gnyis chu 'dzin ri mo kun/ /gzugs sku'i lha yi lam yang ba'i par/ tan ra bas dbyar skyes lang tsho rnams/ /'phel mdzad rgyal ba mchog gang der/ /(5ba spro shes bya'i rang bzhin kun gsal smin legs mar/ /mkhyen dpyod lang tshos 'khyud pa'i stobs bcu'i rtsal/ /lhun grub 'gro la mtshan dpe'i gar mkhan ma/ /skal bzang snang ba'i dpyid du gsal ba'i gtam/ /rab snyan lho phyogs bser bus bskul ba'i dri/ /phan bde'i cho ga bstar pa'i dga' ston can/ /sngon med rna ba'i gsos kyi bdud rtsi 'dis/ /'chi med btung ba'i khengs pa phyogs kyi dogs/ /mi 'gyur bde chen bcud kyis myos pa'i gdangs/ /sgrib phyir tha mal zug rngu'i tshul bstan kyang / /bdud bzhi'i mes po'i 'khor los gzhes min pa/ /mgrin pa'i stong gzugs ri mo bkra 'di ci/ /brjod bral mdzad pa mchog gi yid bzhin nor/ /gsang ba'i mdzod du rgya yis nyer 'ching na/ /nyi ma'i gnyen des dpag dka'i rdzu 'phrul 'ga'/ /thun mong gdul byar bstan de nongs min nam/ /ngan rtog khung bur log smra'i phud sgrog 'gar/ /rtogs brjod dri yis gdung skyed la dgongs nas/ /med byung dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi gang / /me tog mda' can snying la mtshon cha bzhin/ /brtse chen spyan dkyus snyigs ma'i lang tsho la/ /rjes chags ring por rkyong na rnam 'dren gyi/ /mdzad pa'i mdzes —250

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pesdug sgam pa'i ra ri'i dris/ /gab pas rmongs pa'i srid ldan re skong ngam/ /rtse brgya'i lag nyal 'dren byed stong phrag gis/ khyad 'phags grub pa'i ngo mtshar mi gsal na/ /grags pa'i mu khyud snang/bzang mdun sa yi/ /legs bris tshogis las lhag pa'i mtshan nyid ci/ /srid pa'i mtsho 'dir dman cha blangasapa'i gzings/ /nan tur dri za'i rgyud kyi dang po de/ /brdungs pas zhig tshe gsang spyod gdengs can grong / /rang shugs 'jig pas ngo mtshar nor bu rnyed/ /chos dbyings dpyid kyi lus phra'i phang pa las mtshan bzang dar bab ma la yar skyes ljon/ / zhin7khas btsun bzang po'i dri bsung spro ba khyod/ /thub bstan rkang 'thung dpal du brtan gyur cig /ri mo gnyis skyes gtsug phud can/ /rten gyi sgro mdongs rab bkra ba/ /chu lha'i phyogs kyi bshul lam du/ /gshog rlabs bskyod de bde bar 'phur /stag lung nas zhabs drung ma chen ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub nges don chos kyi nyi ma rnam grol mchog gi sde'i chab shog lan grub rigs rgya mtsho'i shing rta/ /bi tswa su ga rgyu dza ta da sha ba lwa : kyi ni rgyu 'i re khri /bha 〉 ta ñcatha ra bha ra ra ga nut+ta roṣa dha shā snya/ /ye shes mchoge gi chu gter las 'khrungs stobs bcu'i bdud rtsi mi zad gter/ /srid 'di nyam nga'i nad tshogs zhi ba bla na med pa'i sman gyi ro/ /(6ba) ka r+yako ga snem ṇi ba ri sa dhi ma phya ra 〉 su 'i yu/ /ya sta ( lo rā shi ra mu ku ṭa tsa khyu sapa rnyi kyi lha mya/ /ci yang stsol mdzad phan bde'i nor bu skye rgu'i gtsug gi cod pan du/ /'god mkhas gangs can grub rgyud yongs kyi shing rta chen po gang de'i drung / /char dus mkha' glang glog 'od 'thul ba'i lce/ /rnam bkra ri mor rdzogs tshe dbyar rnga bzhin/ /thos 'dzin sngon med bro ba'i bsil zer gyis/ /mgrin pa'i kun+da dgod pa'i 'dzum gyis gsol/ /deng dus bral sku yi bcu drug cha/ /phul byung mtshan dpe'i ri dwags snang brtan gyis/ /mngon par sbud 'dis thub bstan 'chi med lam/ /mdzes byed rgyan du byed pos bgod par nges/ /'jigs med nā da'i nga ro tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /snyan 'gyur yan lag drug cu'i gsung gi sgras/ khengs ldan gan+dhar ba yi rgyud (7na kā pang glu/ /spobs pa'i mthu bral rgya mtsho'i 'gram du bros/ /gnyis med zung du 'jug pa'i ā dar+shar/ /chos kun ma bsgribs 'char ba'i —251—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyethugs kyi gting / /zab mor dpyod pas rin cen 'byung ba'i gnas/ /tshad du 'jal la ngal ba'i go skabs bral/ /mes pos sprul pa'i snod kyi mi mjed khams/ khri khye mtshan 'phyang mor byed la ngal ba su/ /gang gi rlabs chen mdzad pa'i phung po'i gzugs/ /yol sgo sgrub la dpyod ldan gor ma chag /'bum phrag zla snang phyugs 'dra'i 'phrin las kyi/ /gcig tu dkar ba'i 'od kyis dbyig 'dzin khyon/ khyab tshe 'phags yul mkhas pa'i bram ze rnams/ /lag pad zum ches skad gnyis smra rnams glang / /chos srid 'khor los sgyur ba'i 'od stong gis/ /bsil ldan sde bzhi'i 'dab stong rgyas byed pa'i/ /dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i lugs bzang mchog /'dzin la ljongs 'dir khyod la do zla ci/ /blo ldan phur bu'i khengs pa sa 'dzin rkang / /'joms byed snyan tshig bka' tham rtse brgya pa/ /gan dar rkang 'thung phur ma'i sa srung bcas/ /'gog med sug par son pas spro ba 'phel/ /blo gros kun gsal mdzes ma'i 'gram pa la/ /mdzad bzang nor bu'i rna rgyan grags pa'i 'od/ /gzi 'bar zur phud lnga pa thun 'tshams gos/ /rab klubs bstan la rjes zhugs zhi 'tsho'i dbon/ /gyi nar spyod pa sems kyi sgyu rtsal spyod/ /nges 'byung mdza' mo'i lcags kyus dam zin kyang / /bag med g.yeng la 'phyan 'dir bsti ba yis/ /theg mchog rgya mtshor la jug la mos blo tsam/ /ring mo nyid nas snying stobs go gyon pa'i/ /(7bsgo gon khyod brnag nus bsgrub par dka' ba'i dus/ /grangs med 'gro dbugs mi dbyung zhi bde'i ched/ /dben par bzhugs pa sems dpa'i mdzad pa min/ /slob lam gnas skabs rnam 'dren nyi ma'i gnyen/ / lus srog longs spyod lha lam mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can don du gtong ba'i mdzad pa'i dper/ khyod las gzhan du kun mkhyen gzigs pas dben/ /mtha' med skye rgu'i mi dman dkyus ring spyan/ /ma 'dris kun la brtse ba'i rgyal rnams kyis/ /srid pa'i dug gsum tsha bcil ga bur thigs/ /bran pa'i byed por 'os so gzhan du min/ /mdza' gcugs kyis bcings mkhyen pa'i gser mngal can/ /mgo skyes las 'ongs bka' mchod na gaṅgā 'a rgyun/ /drang srong dza hur co 'dri'i bya ma rta/ /nam yang chad pa med pa'i bka' drin stsol/ /dri med snang byed 'khor lo'i yan lag can/ /tshig 'phreng 'dzin mar rgyu ba'i 'bab stegs —252

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pemachog /ston 'khrun sgeg mos thags su grub pa'i dar/ /sprin lam zhu 'dra'i rdzing bur rgyas btab ste/ /bdud sde'i brag ri dpal sdug sprin zer gyis/ /phye mda' btags pa rta chen lus phra mas/ /bsil sbyin mkhan dang rtse dgar 'grogs pa'i zlar/ /lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang nas phul/ /zur phug bya lung pa'i gdung las rig sngags 'chang ba'i rdo rje'i slob dpon dpal 'byor 'phrin las rab rgyas chos dbyings rang grol la snyan tshig gi lam nas gsol ba bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi do shal/ (8na〉ka ā shrī mā ba ཿ bra si ta ka yalo ke shwa ra ma hā sa mu dra 3 tsa 〉 ru tsi ra yu wa na — kra tsa 'a rā/ /bi tswa re de lo t+palu ga sa ka ra mo k+ṣa bi dzi ma ti pra ma / sto ba khru su ra tsa sa ra si : sha tsa tsa kwa ka /dpal (mnyam pa'i mit+ta gtsug phud can gyi sdeb sbyor/) ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug rab dkar tshems kyi chu gter chen po las/ /mdzes sdug lang tsho'i dpal gyi gzugs sku chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor mchog /rnam dpyod blo gros ut+pal bzhad byed rmongs pa'i tshogs las rnam rgyal lha/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma kye ngag gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /phul byung legs par spyod pa'i sgyu rtsal spyod/ /rnam dkar 'tshams sbyor ri dwags mig can dang / /dga' bder gnas las rten bzang gzhen nu can/ /mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i tshogs rnams ring spangs ngos/ /rig gnas gtsug lag skyed tshal do ra sa /da lha'i tshig rgyan dpag bsam ljon shing gi /phra rags rgyan med rnam 'gyur dri bsung la/ /mngon par spyod pa'i tshul las gzhan du ci/ /'dir yang zin bral g.yeng ba'i dri bzhen rtas/ /sna tshogs las kyi me zhal lam yangs par/ /'gog med rgyu yang shes bya'i pad dkar tshal/ /rnam par ba 'ad pa'i tshul 'di mi dman tsam/ /zla shel (8ba gsar pa'i ga bur thigs pa yis/ /tsha gdung nad kun cig car 'joms pa ltar/ /rgol ngan ri dwags tshar gcod sgra tshad kyi/ /gdong lnga pa 'di rig gnas kun gyi phul/ /sgeg mo'i lus kyi sgyu rtsal drug cu dang / /'dren byed yon por lta ba'i mdzes sdug ltar/ khres bya'i gzugs kun gsal byed tshig gi rgyan/ /daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung 'di gtsug lag kun gyi mig /bi shwa'i sor rtses sna tshogs dngos po rnams/ /rab mnyam gcig tu ston ltar legs sbyar skad/ /lci yang yi —253—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyege'i 'phreng bar spel ba yi/ /sdeb sbyor gzhung 'di gtsug lag kun gyi rgyud/ /ka shi mdzes dga'i lus la rin cen rgyan/ /'bras ldan dus kyi mkha' la dbang gzhu ltar/ /ming tshig ma lus mdzes byed mngon rjod gzhung / /mkhas dbang na chung kun gyi mgul pa'i rgyan/ /mgrin pa'i yid bzhin mtsho yis lan brgya'i bar/ /bos nyams ston pa'i dbyangs bdun ngang mo dkar/ /sna tshogs sgra yi bye brag zlos gar yang / /blo ldan 'chi med thos 'dzin dga' skyed dbyangs/ /nges gsang sgo glegs phyi nang g.yin gsum rnams/ /thabs mkhas 'phrul gyis dbye thabs skar rtsis gzhung / /mgrin sngon gsang tsheg srang gsum rnam rgyal mchog /dbyangs 'char gzhung 'di gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog /phul byung tshe yi rig byed chu skyes mngal/ /gang gis mngon par dran pa'i yang snying las/ /yon tan mgon po'i ring lugs bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /gzhan phan dgos 'dod rab stsol dbang gi rgyal/ /sna tshogs yul gyi ā da ra yi ngos/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyi 'gying bag sked med bzhin/ /'gog med 'char ba'i gzhan phan bzo rig rnams/ /'dren byed yul gyi zil dngar bla na med/ /mdog lnga'i bzhon pas drangs te pad+mo'i gnyen/ /phyogs bral lha lam myul yang gang gi tshad/ /rtogs min skyid skyur (9na stir byed nang rig pa'i/ /nor mchog skal bzang klu dbang gtsug gi rgyan/ /de lta'i phyogs kyi rig gnas yid bzhin nor/ /dri med tshig gi srad bur brgyus pa'i 'phreng / /rig byed 'dzin khyod mgrin pa'i mdzes rgyan du/ /legs par spud kyang ngoms pa med pa'i sa/ /slad mar dpyad gsum dag pa'i lam yangs par mi dman bzang po'i blo gros shing rta che/ /thogs med bgrod 'di dkar phyogs bsil zer ltar/ /yar ldan 'gyur ba'i yur chen rtag tu sten/ /'phrin yig 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin 'jo sgeg can/ /snyan tshig rnam bkra 'dab gshog legs bskyod de/ /dbang phyogs dar gyi gtsug phud ngom bzhin du/ /dga' ba gnyis pa'i 'chi med lam la 'phur/ /'phyong rgyas zhang mkhar ba rig byed smra ba 'jam dpa la rdo rje tshang pa'i nad kyis 'du ba cung zad 'khrugs pa'i skabs springs pa'i yid gsos ga bur thigs pa / sdebs sbyor rgyun chags kyi nang tshan rgya mtsho zhes pa/ ru tsa ra tsa ka ya rā pa po skru rla 254

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (per sne skyu dha pa ya bā li dha rmā ni lha la ma ཿ ma ṇi ba tsa me ru su ri/ /bra sa mu dar sa bi dhi ka — rba u de sha ni rta bya hā ba spro tswa lha ga mā / tsa ba ga ru ti ṣa ṣ+ṭhatsā/ /rin cen be+eḍūr lhun po dbang gzhus 'byung ba ji bzhin mdzes pa'i phun tshogs gzugs sku yid bzhin nor ltar don kun rab tu bsgrubs/ /phul byung yan lag drug cu'i sgra dbyangs rig byed 'dzin pa kun gyi rna ba'i bcud du ston tshe gsung la cha tsam 'gran pa'i dpe/ (9ba) ru ci ra ga ga cha kārnya sto na hre ga li ka me ya u lha sa tsi stu sko ta 3 8 8 6 bu ཿ tri shā ka /dza yatsa la ra sa ga ra lo ke shwa re tse dha ma spyo khyu pa dha si rna lha ka si dhi kra ya : tsa mā/ tsa sa:/ /mdzes sdug gzhal dka'i pha mthar snyems ldan kun gsal zur mig can la skyid sgyur ster byed thugs ni kun mkhyen des kyang rtogs min pa'i/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi yum mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug sras de snying dbus pad mtshor bzhugs la ngag gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bsod nams mchog gi dbyig 'dzin bu mo'i ltor/ /legs spyod rgyu tshogs kun+da'i byed po yis/ /dal ba'i rten bzang yongs 'du'i lang tsho can/ /tshad
