nad grang reg ma las rnam rgyal ngos/ /sngon dus rab brten mchod cing bstod pa'i 'bras/ /dbyangs can ma dang ma gnyis yul 'khor bsrung / /gang gi ri mo gsum pa'i yid bzhin mtshor/ /gtsug lag tshig sgrog rnam dpyod gar sgyur 'di/ /bzang po'i grogs ltar yid kyi zhags pa yis/ /blo gros dpal dang gcig tu bsdoms 'dra'i tshul/ /zur mig ma dang bgrang bya stong gi bar/ /lhan cig gnas pa'i bde las lhag gam (10na)snyam/ /rab dkar las kyi cho rus legs bris dbus/ /mkhan chen lha dbang dpon rigs rgyal byed du/ /gyur kyang rab rmongs sbyin skyes gzhes pa'i slad/ /gtsug lag dpung gi ngal ba rten skababa'i kyang / /klu gzugs grangs ldan zag phung pad+ma dkar/ /mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i sngo bsangs las rgyal phyir/ /bgrang yas rig byed nor 'dzin rab yangs par/ /sna tshogs byed po'i gsang tshig chu gter cher/ /rje btsun g.yu thog stobs ldan 'chi med gtsos/ /blo gros ri dbang thabs kyis bsrubs pa las/ /yang snying yan lag brgyad —255

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyepa'i rta ljang dbang / /ma nor brtag thabs bsir bus legs drangs te/ /'chugs med ro nus bsdebs pa'i 'od rnon gyis/ /lang tsho'i 'dab stong rnam par bzhad pa yi/ /mtha' yas mkhas pa'i thabs 'phrul ston pa la/ /gzhar yang 'gog med brtson pa lhur len ngos/ /sna tshogs lugs zung tshig gi mi na ka /skyes thob rig pa'i 'od kyis legs bzhu ba'i/ /bgying 'os gtam gyi 'jug pa gang ga'i rgyun/ /'phrin yig lam gsum dag tu 'bab kyang 'tshal/ /de skad ri mo'i dga' tshal rabs yangs par/ /'dren byed ra yig gnyis pa 'phur lding slad/ /dbang phyogs dar gyi sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mchan la/ /ma nyams rtags kyi ze'u 'brus legs sbyar nas/ /nyi gzhen 'khrig khyim la gnas mchu zla yi/ /snga ma'i phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa la/ /bcu phrag rigs nas brtsegs pa'i ba gam gyi/ /ri'u mig kun tu bzang po'i 'khor lor bris/ /zur rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal ldan bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi snyan tshig byung ba'i lan 'dren byed bdud rtsi/ sna tshogs byed po'i gtam gyi 'byung gnas las/ /'dren (10ba)byed zil dngar ri dwags mig can gzugs/ /blo gter ngag dbang lha mo bsil zer can/ /mgo bsten kun gsal las 'ongs 'di skad lo/ /mchog tu rnam dkar legs sbyar dpyid kyi mas/ /rab bskul smon lam chu 'dzin myu gu'i 'bras/ /zag phung sa mos nyi bu'i bsil ldan ma/ /kun mkhyen gzigs pa'i lam las gsal ba'i ngos/ /brda sprod dbang po rdo rje sdeb sbyor gyis/ /legs brgyan daṇ+ḍi'i khengs pa 'phrog byed pa'i/ /lho phyogs gtsug lag las 'ongs snyan tshig phreng / /rkang 'thung ga bur bcas pa sug par son/ /gtan du bde ba'i ma la yar skyes dri/ /'di snang g.yeng ba'i rdul gyi rgyal mtshan mthus/ /tshad gdungs lag ldan 'gro la phan sems pa'i/ /gyi na ba yang gtsug lag 'dzin tshul tsam/ /mig gis bsgyur ba mda' yi grangs ldan pa'i/ /rig gnas khung bur blo gros dri ba'on can/ /dpyad gsum dag pas 'jug pa mi dman ngos/ /don mthun gtam gyi gzhol 'gro rgyas kyang 'tshal/ /tshig gi dbyibs legs sgeg mo'i mngon rjod kyi/ /sna tshogs rin cen byang phrul lags sbud cing / /dbang phyogs las 'ongs lhab lhub gan dar bcas/ /thun —256

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (po'atshams mdangs kyi rgya dang lhan cig par/ /bcu gnyis bdag bor srang gi ba gam du/ /dga' bder spyod pa'i ltad mo'i zla ba yi/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa la/ /me tog ma pha 'gra'i lding khang gnas nas bris/(11na skongs ri'i ljongs 'dir gnas lnga rig pa smra ba la zla med pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍita smon 'gro lo tsā ba rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa tshe dbang don grung la bsrings pa'i 'phrin yig chos kun gzigs pa'i me yod/ sdeb sbyor ma mo'i dbyangs/ na ṭag tu pra pra ni yu ba rna 9 3 1 sdu dhi ka ju kwa dha ru tsi ra spru li ni pra ga re har tswa du ra : ka dza ge 4gu gla PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBtsa tu rmu kha sa hu 〉 tā/ /dkar (ldeb sbyor zab mo'i dbyangs/)'jam gzugs can gyi shis brjod/ mdzes sdug lang tshor rab rgyas dbang po'i gzhu yi lding khang na/ /mtho ris sgeg mo'i snyims pa rab 'phrog 'gro la rjes chags zlos gar can/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i zil dngar bla med yid kyi za ma tog 'gengs pa'i/ /(11ba7 su ra rā dza ni tu a : to nyi u t+ta ra shu : gro sa ཿ dza ha ka la :ma ti ba dzo ( gre/ so : ta me gha ga dzo ba ri : lha : bi sdi ni 2 sna sa pi khu girdu the tha ka ṇ+ḍi ka ya:/ /ngag (2 ti'i sdeb sbyor 'phags ma/)gi dbang phyug tshangs sras ma kye dus rnamasakun du dge bar mdzod/ /phun mtha' dag gzugs༅/ tshogs blo gros sa 'dzin dbang po'i rtser/ /legasasbyar sprin gyi glang po'i steng 'gying ba/ /rig pa'i gnas rnams gzigs pa mig stong can/ /grags pa don ldan mkhas gang rna rgyan du/ /ma cha shas gzugs༅/ bsad snyan tshig mngal gyis lci ba'i khur/ /yongs su 'dzin pa'i 'phrin yig lus phra ma/ /nyams 'gyur snga na med pa'i rgyud mang glu/ /'os phyir gnas lnga rig khyod tshul 'di gson/ /lan ldan pa'i gzugs༅/ gcig min par legs byas mdog lnga pa/ /srid 'di'i lha lam ngos su rgyu ba las/ /mngon par mtho ba'i nyer len bcu gnyis bdag /bde bar spyod pa'i 'od rnon spor mchis sam/ /rigs go ḍa ma la grags pa'i don ga4 gyi rgyan/ stobs nor gyi 'od rgyas phyed min pa'i/ /legs bshad chu skyes 'dab ma 'dzum mi 'dzum/ /gang gi rnam dpyod mdzes ma'i (12na'i gram —257

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyechang rlan/ /'phos tshe ba ku la der rang dbang ci/ /dman gzugs༅ gyi 'gog pa/ blo'i khams kyi sa bon las grub pa'i/ /phra mo'i yon tan lcug phran phon po 'ga'/ /grags skam bsir bus bskyod pa'i stong pa'i sgrar/ /snyems pa'i ldem ldem g.yo la su zhig mtshar/ /phul mtha' dag gzugs can/byung sbyangs pa'i dbyig 'dzin lto ba sa /skyes thob shes rab ljon pa g.yur za ba/ /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin nad rig dri bsung can/ /spro ba'i dpag bsam yongs 'du khyod du khums/ /skye le'u dang po nas bstan pa'i lho phyogs pa la grags pa'i mdzas pa'i yon to gtso dang sbyar ba/ rgu'i me tog mkhas pa'i ngang tshul gyis/ khrims ldan lus phur 'dud la phyir g.yel ba/ /gangs can srid sgrub brtson gyis blang dor mthu/ /phra ba'i yid kyi shing rtar sus ma rig /blun smos po ra pog /sgom rgan po'i tshul bral shes bya kun/ /zhib mor dpyod pa'i brda sprod rig pa'i gzhu/ ta shes rab rgyud kyis bkug tshe ga rti ka /skyengs te 'chi med gnas su yib bam snyam/ /dngos gzugs can dang rgyu rgyan dam pa'i nyams dang rab rtog rnams 'dres pa'i rab spel gyi rgyan/ stobs rigs pa'i ngar ldan 'khor lo yis/ /rgol ngan srid sgrub mgo bo bregs pa'i dri/ /srid rtse'i bar du 'thul bas pad dkar mig /sems kyi ri dwags gya gyu'i dra bar tshud/ /lus ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ ngag yid kyi sgyu rtsal chu gter che/ /nam yang zad mi shes pa'i pha mtha'i tshad/ /'jal byed sbyangs pa'i rtags gsum gyis thob pa/ /bzo rig nor bu'i dpyad de mchog tu gshin/ /tshar smos ldan ra pog /du dngar ba'i 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /kun la ster ba tshe yi rig byed sgo /brgya phrag mngon phyir yangs pa'i spyod yul 'dis/ /yon tan mgon po'i tshul la 'gran pa (12ba)bzhin/ /mchog le'u dang po nas bstan pa'i rgya che ba'i yon to lho phyogs pa la grags pa/ dman shel gyi rtsig nga/ dngas pa'i ngos/ /grangs med gzugs kyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /ma 'dres so sor 'byed pa'i shing rta che/ /ha nu byu gnyis pa gzhan yod min/ /rgyal gsugs༅sol byung /gsung yan lag bcu gnyis tam+bu ra'i/ /rgyud du nyer khugs dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor kun/ /yongs surdzogs par spyod pa dan+ti'i glu/ /len mkhas gangs can 'di na khyod min su/ /legs the tshel khyung / sbyar lha yi skad kyi 'a muk+ta ka /smon+da'i srad bur brgyus pa'i rtse phran 'di/ shes ldan sgeg mo'i rgyan du byed pa por/—258

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / rtogekhyod dang tshangs pa gang yin phyang mo nyug /legs rab dwangs gyi gzugs can/ bshad dpyid kyi dpal mos yongs bsus pa'i/ /mngon rjod dbyar gyi margad zhun ma'i gos/ /don bzang 'dzin mar klubs pa'i gzigs mo la/ /spyod pa'i mig ldog bod blun yul 'dir dkon/ /skad ra byung gi sags༅/ gyi rang bzhin brda yi tshon ris kyis/ /ma 'dres lus 'degs bkra ba'i zlos gar can/ /blo ldan rtsed 'jo'i rnam thar mngal 'dzin pa'i/ /dbyar skyes sgra 'di sngon med ngo mtshar dpal/ /lkog gzugs༅ rab rtog /gyur shes bya'i ri mo'i snang brnyan kun/ /rig pa'i me long ngos su 'char byed pa/ /gtsug lag rtsis kyi yang snying dbyangs 'char gyis/ /kun mkhyen ye shes zla ru bcas min nam/ /e sems ldan rab rtog /ma chos kyi rang bzhin mtha' klas mdud/ /cig car 'grol ba'i rig byed rgya mtsho'i gzhung / /swa la'i ljongs 'di'i 'gron du 'bod mkhas pa'i/ /byed por lha yi bla ma 'ongs pa 'dra/ /dbyang mtha' dgag khugs༅/ can tshe ring gnam gyi she mong las/ shes bya'i sal spyod pa'i dpung pa skyes/ /'chad rtsod rtsom (13na)pa'i 'khor lo sgyur ba yi/ /snyan grags gdugs dkar srid rtse'i bar du 'phyur/ /ru 'gal ba'i gzugs༅/ bzhi'i gser ldan zhags pa'i khor yug gis/ /ring du bcad kyang tshar du dngar ba'i dri/ /yid kyi yol gor skyug la nyer gnas pa/ /de 'dra sngon med ma la yar skyes mchog /dpyad mi ldan pa'i gzugs can/gsum gtam gyi sgra kun dbyangs bdun gyi/ /rol mor 'brol ba'i 'phrin yig khur 'khyer ba/ /seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa'i bya ma rta/ /rtsal gsum rdzogs par rgyu de mi bskyud gces/ /'bum gzugs༅ gyi ༅ la le'u dang po'i ra bdangs 'dres pa/ phrag zla ba kun nas 'khyil ba'i khams/ /thags kyi bcu drug cha shas yongs gang ba'i/ /ngo mtshar ri mo'i 'od kyi mdzes sdug la/ /pad rag gzhen nu'i rgya yis dam du 'byud/ /dbus bya ma rang 4sto rjod pa/ 'gyur skad las phyogs 'di na/ /bsgyur ba nyi sgrol byed kyi lo/ /ca ṇa'i rgyal khang gya shin gyi/ /'od rnon 'phrog byed khyim zhugs tshe/ /mtho kho nge 'dzin dang bdes pa'i wor pa rgya che pho sa/ris bdun gyi yon tan kun/ /nor ldan khur du rab lci ba'i/ /sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar legs phye ba/ /dga' ldan pho brang nas bris dge /—259

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)'phyong rgyas ri bo bde chen gyi bla ma blo bzang bstan 'phel gyi tshigs bcad kyi yi ge dang bcas rnam sbyar ram de'i rgyud byin gyis brlab tu rung ba zhig dgos tshul byung ba'i lan 'dod pa'i re skong / (13ba)a ཿ tā tsā sa kṛ ta wa ra ā dz+nya nasi / pa ti: nywa/ /tsu ru bya lha ma dhu sa hi ta tswa gu rba u tsa kra tsa khyu/ /ma tha byu lha subha ga si ta shā u t+ta za ཿ ta na sa/ /u spyi rda spro ṭa ka mra ta bi bu / ba byu PROB PROB PROByas/ /rmad (sdeb sbyor dal gyis gnon/)byung legs byas ye shes mchog gi sngon med sin+ta'i bdag po las/ /bla na dngar ba'i mtshan dpe'i 'khor lo rnam par rgyas pa'i bsil sbyin mkhan/ /phan bde'i bdud rtsi'i zegs ma rab 'dzag skal bzang ut+pal dkar po'i snying / /ci yang reg pas dga' ba skyed mdzad nyi ma'i gnyen khyod rgyal gyur cig /ring min sor ma'i gar mkhan gzhan nu ma'i/ /sgyu rtsal yi ge'i gzugs su shar ba dang / /snyan tshig rgyud mang skyengs byed 'dir son pas/ /'dren byed thos 'dzin lam kun dog por bgyis/ /tshig don rnam bkra phul byung rjod pa'i dpyid/ /gang gi mgrin par 'ongs pas dbang po'i gzhu/ /'chi med grong du bros tshe me bzhi skyes/ /sa 'dzin lhun por skor ba'i zol gyis song / /mngon mtho'i rten ldan nags klung sdug po'i khrod/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'bras bu g.yur za zhing / /dri bral tshangs spyod yal 'dab ldem mkhas pa/ /shes ldan u dum wā ra khyod las (14na)su/ /kun gsal zhags pas tshad du 'ching ba'i stobs/ /phra ba'i bla med ye shes bdud rtsi'i ro/ /mi dman myang ba'i lnga rig bcud kyi ma/ /gzhan yang g.yel med bsten la brtson par rig /tshig don log smra spobs pa'i gzhu las skyes/ /rnam par zhus pa'i dbyig 'dzin 'og bcings tshe/ /nye dbang rang nyid zla bral min snyam pa'i/ /phyang mor byed pa sgra tshad rjod pa'i gtso/ /gser mngal gso rig gtsug lag 'chi ba med/ /bcud du len pa yon tan mgon po'i gzhung / /snang byed ngo mtshar skyed pa'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /sprul sgyur rig pa'i bzo 'di gzhan phan mchog shar lha'i lam bzang nying khu'i dan+ḍi'i gzhung / /nyams 'gyur stong gis chos kun 'dzum gyis bsu/ /rgya chen don gyi lang tsho rgyas pa'i lus/ /rin cen rgyan gyis spud pa'i 'chi med mdzod/ /legs sbyar rgyud du spel ba'i sdeb sbyor 'phreng / /grangs —260

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pemed skad kyi zlos gar rna ba'i bcud/ /ma 'ongs ma rnga zhe sum ston pa gsang ba'i tshig /dbyangs 'char rtsis kyi gtsug lag rig pa'i 'phrul/ /rnam par yangs pa snying rje'i 'dab stong tshal/ /'khor dang myang 'das rgyar 'debs stong pa'i 'od/ /'bral med zung 'jug lam mchog ze'u 'bru'i /dpal stug gsung gi bcud phyung sde bzhi'i lung / /tshul bzhin (14ba)bstan pa rnam bzhi'i 'khor gyi tog /dge sbyong dpal gyi thun mong min pa'i gos/ /'grub byed dbang phyogs dar la rgyas btab ste/ /sprin bcud khams 'dzin rlung gi shing rta ma/ /gnam lor shar ba nyin byed chu srin khyim/ /dga' bder spyod pa rgyal gyi zla ba yi/ /dkar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes la bris/ /zur chen rdo rje tsu na nini ka tso rnga ya : mā nā spu re/ /badzā : kha si swā dzi no t+ta ra ka la rgya nā dhi hā shārbi ko la k+ṣe PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB/ /mi (sdeb sbyor stag rnam rtsen/)'gyur mchog la dgyes rgur spyod pa'i mtha' bral dbyings su g.yo med las/ /grangs med 'gro blo'i rlabs phreng can ngos sna tshogs sprul pa'i snang ba'i bdag /thugs rje'i zil dngar 'bum du 'dzag pas phan bde'i sa mos ci yang 'dzum/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bla na mngon mtho mtsho skyes rdo rje 'od dkar can/ /(15na chu rgya ba ra ya na ga : rgyu da re ma ti dha ra ya : khyi rwa hā/ /wa du lekha mu ཿ the/ su ni rtu ga wa rnyi swā ṇi spu ti/ /gang (dza ti'i sdeb sbyor nye ༅ dbyangs/) gi theg mchog gsang ba'i rgyun gsum pa/ /blo gros lto bar 'dzin pa'i drang srong gis/ /don bzang phrin yig phyag —261—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)rgya'i g.yon mig gar/ /snyim pa'i rgya mtsho'i gos can steng na sgyur/ /legs byas 'chi ba med pa'i dga' tshal du/ /rmad byung nye bar len pa'i yongs 'du'i ljon/ /lang tsho'i yal 'dab rab rgyas rnam dkar gyis/ /gang bu'i khur du lci la spro dga' rtas/ /cha shas yongs rdzogs nam mkha'i bsil sbyin mkhan/ /phul byung lhag bsam 'od dkar ma bzod par/ /ti mi'i grong mthar bris la gnyis skyes tshogs/ /rgya mtsho'i zla bar 'bod pa'i rdzu la brten/ /rmongs pa'i tshang tshing stug por bod blun rnams/ /'gog pa'i gnyid la yur byed gnas lnga'i khur/ /rnam dpyod khyogs la blangs(15ba)tshe swā la'i ljongs/ /blo ldan phur bu gnyis pa khyod min su/ /gdod gnas mi 'gyur rtag brtan kun du bzang / /sgrib byed stobs ldan 'khul ba'i mchod sbyin mkhan/ /'od gsal zla snyed bgrod pas bcom pa yis/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i ye shes mchog 'di mtshar/ /'di na za hor gdung 'dzin rig byed pa/ /la ba'i grong khyer sa la 'phos 'dra'i rdzong / /rab mtho'i ba gam gnas su nyer son nas/ /thos bsam sgrub pa'i 'dun pa mi dman tsam/ /g.yung drung 'gyur ba med pa'i rdo rje'i ngos/ /'chi ba'i dngos po 'joms pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/ lga mchog dri zhim lus phur myong ba'i ro/ /bro byed lha mchog bsten la mi bsgyur ngos/ /snyan tshig rnam par bkra ba'i lus 'od gsal/ /don bzang 'jo sgeg gzigs mor mtshar ba'i dpyid/ /'phrin yig 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin legs bris kyi/ /bshul du 'gag pa med par rgyu yang 'chal/ /rtsa gsum tshig gi bden sra'i rtsi brgya bas/ /mthar byed 'dzin ma bcom pa'i gtan bde'i lus/ /mtshun lha'i me long dal ster rtag pa'i gzhin/ /rig pa'i dpa' bo khyod nyid 'grub gyur cig /'dzam bu'i chu bo dar babs gaṅgā skyes/ /zla 'phel 'og pag 'khrol ba'i gar mkhan ma/ /gan dar lan bu g.yo ba'i rnam 'gyur can/ /rtags kyi 'dod pa'i myos bum gyis spras te/ /pā lwa sha mdog mdangs 'dzin nags kyi bdag /gos su klubs pa'i yal ga'i ri dwags kyi/ /bgrang bya'i mdzes sdug bzhin ras ngom pa'i rnar/ /bzhi ldan 'byung ba'i rgyan gyis spud tshe bris/ /smon gro paṇ+ḍi ta tshe dbang don grub gyis nyams gyur stong gi rgyud mang 'phrol ba'i lan rmongs pa'i tsha gdung 'joms pa'i tsan+dan —262

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ḍa'angos 'dzin/ (16na)zhwa gu rkyu da ta ka r+sha :la : sha snya pya bha ཿ tsa/ /dzi ne nā pa ra mi du yasta ba ṇ+ḍi ta ( pā la ca/ /phun (kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor/spros gas srid dang zhi ba yi/ /yon tan thams cad ster byed pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po tshe dpag med/ /gang gis mkhas khyod skyong bar mdzod/ /legasabyas dpyid kyi bu mo'i mngal khur las/ /mngon mtho'i rten gyi dbyar skyes gsar pa'i mgron/ /mang thos yongs 'du'i 'khri shing g.yur za ba/ /grang reg nyes brgya'i dgra las rnam rgyal ngos/ /ngo mtshar legs bshad nyams 'gyur stong gi dbyangs/ /snyan tshig dri za'i rgyud du khugs pa'i glu/ /'phrin yig lus phra'i mgrin las rab len cing / /snyim pa'i nor 'dzin ngos su zlos gar sgyur/ /phra zhib dka' gnad gtsug lag mdud pa'i rgya/ /cig car dgrol ba'i dri lan sor mo'i 'phrul/ /rnam par dpyod la blo ldan phur bu (16bsgong / /lta ba'i zol gyis mkha' la rgyu'am snyam/ /pha mtha' rtogs dka' shes bya'i gser ldan ma/ /blo gros gom pa gcig gis gzhal ba'i tshe/ /pad dkar mig de rang min gnyis pa zhig /yod snyam gya gyu'i dra bar tshud kyi dogs/ /mdzes so stobs bcu'i dbus na nyi ma'i gnyen/ /kun gsal 'gram par chu shel dbang po ste/ /dbang phyug mgrin par in+d+ra ni la'i mdangs/ /dpyod ldan khrod na bod yul paṇa chen khyod/ /tsha ba'i gdung ba mtha' dag ring 'phrog cing / /yid la kun dga' skyed pa'i bde ba ster/ /rkang 'thung g.yin gyis 'gran pa'i zla bral ba/ /nags klung 'thug kyang tsan dan ljon pa dkon/ /e ma mdo rgyud 'jigs med snying stobs can/ /tha snyad rig pa'i nga ro cher sgrog pa'i/ shesabya kun gyi rtsal gsum rdzogs pa la/ /bsams kyin gnas lnga rig par nges pa rnyed/ /sngon byon mkhas mang mdzad pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /yid kyi spro dga'i pad+ma rab bzhad pa'i/ /ngos kyang legs bshad sbrang rtsi gtong len la/ /ngal med ldem ldem sgyur ba'i gar gyis brel/ /ris bral brtan g.yo'i chos kyi gnasalugs gzugs/ /gang gi rnam dpyod me long ngos shar ba'i/ /sna tshogs gzigs mor mtshar ba'i ngang tshul la/ /chu skyes tshogs kyang dga' bas 'dzum pa 'dra/ /rnam gsum mkhas pa'i mdzad bzang 'od dkar gyis/ /thub bstan kun+da bzhad tshe ri bong can/ /chu gter chen po'i klong du bros pa la/ /rig byed —263—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)smra rnams zla ba'i ma mar 'bod/ /smra mkhas ngag gi 'dod 'jo dbang gi rgyal/ /legs bshad 'dod rgu 'bad med stsol ba'i dpyid/ /mkhyen dpyod bde legs kun gyi za ma tog /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i spo 'a 'ches gyur cig /lho phyogabs ma la ya las mngar ba'i dri/ /(17na〉bsir bus phyogs rnams 'gengs pa'i dga' ston ltar/ /thos 'dzan bdud rtsir spyod pa'i 'phrin yig rgyun/ /dzaḥ yi bu mo'i 'gros ltar 'tshal/ /tshe dpag 'dod rgu nges legs gru char gyis/ /dngos grub dbyar skyes dga' ston spel ba'i dpyid/ /mthong thos dran reg don ldan yid bzhin nor/ /zas gtsang sras kyi 'phel gdung chu 'dzin dang / /dbang phyogs ka shi mdzes dga'i sor mo yis/ /lan brgyar bskrun pa'i thags kyi lang tsho can/ /thun 'tshams phyag rgya'i mdzes mas dam 'khyud de/ /bzang po'i tshes la gru 'dzin rtse nas bris/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa smra ba'i dbang phyug dkon mchog chos 'phel gyi bka' gnang thod du bcings te slob dpon mkhas pa chen po smon 'gro pa ṇa chen 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rjes kho bo'i rtogs brjod kyi glegs bam gsar bskrun dang 4 sa snyan ngag ngo mtshar ba'i 'phrin yeg spel ba'i lan mya pha med pa'i ljon shing / sa dzo dzi rgya tswa du PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBPROB PROB 85 /brji tā la rti khyu hā rdo tsa shi ya sa smi na go ya smo /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i gzugs/ /lus phra mchog gi zlos gar can/ /༷ mkhas tshangs pa'i bu mo yis/ /gang der ngag gi dpal stsol cig /(17ba)bsod nams dpung gi mkhar lding rgyal mtshan can/ /smon lam thabs mkhas 'phrul gyis legs thob pa'i/ /rten bzang nor bu sa man+ta ka mchog /'di phyir phan bde'i re 'dod 'jo ba la/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo'i mgrin las ma 'ongs shing / /dbyangs bdun rgyud du khugs pa'i sgra min par/ /nyams dang 'gyur ba stong gi snyan 'gyur 'phrin/ /'di 'dra sngon med rna ba'i bdud rtsir nges/ /snyigs dus srid pa'i tshang tshing sdug po'i khrod/ /stobs ldan rmongs pa'i tsher can ches mang yang / /legs bshad lo 'bras g.yur du rab za ba'i/ /mang thos a shad+ma de khyod du nges/ /'khrul ba'i rang mtshang 'di snang bya ba'i mkhar/ /gzhan dbang rlung gis rgyu ba'i snyem las pa/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'od stong dga' ston la/ /mngon par spyod pa'i tshul la lhod min tsam/ /ches phra pad+ma'i skud pas lhun po yang bcings —264

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('azhes 'ud kyi phul byung gtam gyi phreng / /rtogs brjod dbyangs su 'char ba'i rtsa ko ra/ /mkha' lding dbang po'i bshul rjes snyegs kyi dogs/ /bdag 'drar rab btags bsngags pa'i zol sbyor gyis/ /bstan bcos byed por sde snod gsar rnying sngags/ /sgra tshad bzo gso tha snyad rig gnas lnga/ /yod ces bsil ldan ljongs su ngom pa bzhin/ /ris med chos kyi phra zhib dbang po'i gzhu/ /zhabrul bral ston la mdzad pa med pa yi/ /dbang phyug yon tan grub pa'i grags snyan gyis/ /'phags yul mkhas rnams khengs pa btang gi dogs/ /log par rtog pa'i sha ba ri yi rgya/ /blo gros mtshon gyis bcad tshe deng dus kyi/ /rtog ge tsam gyis dregs pa'i bshes gnyen kun/ /nga rgyal brag rtser bros nas mu cor sgrog/theg chen gtam gyi 'dren byed dmar zlum las/ /zab rgyas lam gyi rnam bzhag me (18na༄ra tshe/ /yid kyi mda' lnga 'dod pa'i grong myul ba'i/ /sgom chen 'dod lha'i tshul 'chos gzugs brnyan zhig /srid pa'i khongs las brgal ba'i yon tan tshogs/ /blo gros gser mngal ma 'di'i ltor sbrum tshe/ /brtan g.yo'i lcid kyis rgya mtshor bying dogs nas/ khyab 'jug rus sbal zol gyis bteg pa 'dra/ /rgya chen gsung rab lar tshe dbyig gi gnyen/ /rtsod tshe chos grags rna ba'i do shal bzung / /rtsom la dpa' bo lcang lo'i phreng 'dzin pa'i/ /do zlar 'os pa shes ldan khyed du khums/ /mkhyen yangs lang tsho dar ba'i thigs kyi gos/ /gtsug lag gur kum gyis bcos grangs med du/ /ji tsam spyad pas mi 'dzad legs bshad gter/ /byed pos gang gi bgo skal nyid du bskrun/ /e ma mthong na mi mthun pa'i/ /dri ma dang bral rgyal ba'i sku/ /don gnyis stsole ba'i ris bral gnyen/ /bsten pa don che rnyed dka' ltar/ /gangasakhrod bza' shing ra ba na/ /yon rtan kun rdzogs dpag bsam ljon/ /bod yul paṇa chen smon 'gro ba/ /tshe dbang don kun grub pa der/ /mkhas rlom kun la grags dka' ba'i/ /sngon med lta bu'i legs bshad la/ /ngoms pa med pa'i thos pa dag /'bad pa chen pos grub par mdzod/ /don bzang nor bu'i phra tshom can/ /tshig gis sor mos legs bskrun pa'i/ /rna ba'i rgyan ldan bya ma rta/ /bskyud pa med par gnyen gshin 'tshal/ /'phrin yig gnyis skyes gtsug phud can/ /za 'og gos kyi spu sdug bkra/ /—265

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)snyan pa'i zlos gar sgyu ba de/ /mkhas mchog sor mo'i rtser der 'phur// //(18ba〉spro lo ngos shar phyogs 'ol kha stag rtser yod skabs 'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel lha ldan du mnyan yod mgon du phebs par phul ba'i zhu 'phrin thar pa'i sgo brgya 'byed pa'i skal bzang / bha wa sha snya t+ta ti rta sna khu /pacu : sa dha ba lwa ga ga:/ /gi rte rte/ swā rwa ba /ska /ma nyushrī mā la sa sku nas/ /srid (sdeb sbyor kha sgo phan pa/) zhi' cha shas gzugs can/ khams kyi lha lam du/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i chu 'dzin phreng / /grags pa'i dbyar gyi rnga bsang can/ /'jam dpal bla ma dam pa'i drung / /brtan dog pa phul byung / g.yo'i chos gyi gzugs brnyan 'gog med blor/ khar ba'i zur phud lnga pa 'phreng ba 'dir/ /thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen du/ /nges pas dad pa'i yid kyis mchid 'di zhu/ /ngo sngon medagazugs can/ mtshar rgya mtsho'i mtshan dpe'i chu shel (19na bo bang / /ma rig phyogs kyi zhabrul blor 'phel 'grib can/ /'gyur med rtag pa'i ngo bo ston pa 'di/ /bsil ldan skye rgu'i bsod nams zong gis bsgrubs/ /grangs ltar ba 'gog pa/ med blo gsal 'du ba'i bzang po'i las/ /grags snyan phyogs bral rnar 'god mdzad pa'i dpyid/ /rnam 'dren bdud dpung gzhes pa'i dge ba'i dus/ /gang gis thar par ma drangs sems ldan su/ /rab ldan pa 'i gzugs can/ dmar mchu yi 'dab brgya 'dzum pa la/ ta shes bya'i rang bzhin yangs pa'i sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /skal bzang ra yig gnyis pa'i sgra 'dzin snod/ /nam yang zad mi shes par 'bab 'di mtshar/ /chos le'u dang po'i rab dngas kyi sa/ kun stong pa'i ri mo gsar pa la/ /bde chen tshon gyi mdangs gsal rnam bkra ba'i/ /gnyis med nyams 'gyur 'jo sgeg zlos gar 'di/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan gyi gzigs mor 'bab/ /bcu gzugs can gyi 'byung 'gyur 'gog pa/ gsum rdo rje'i sa gzhi nyams dga' bar/ /thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i shing rtas ris bral gyi/ /'gro rnams drangs tshe bskal pa bzang po 'di'i/ /'byung 'gyur sangs rgyas gdul bya mchis sam ci mtho rang ba tsā sa gzugs yo/ ris yon tan dud pa'i 'phrul snang du/ tshem smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i dge ba'i rnga/ /brdungs pas rtsod pa'i 'dus kya lus phra ma/ /skrag ste rdzogs ldan gos kyi rdzu la brten/ /phul gzugs can shis brjod/ byung mngar ba'i bde legs —266

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pesteng gi ro/ /dpyod ldan skabs gsum ri dwags mig can lces/ /myong ba'i ma ma rje btsun yongs 'du'i ljon/ /thub bstan mtho ris dpal du dar gyur cig /snyan ldan ༅gzugs༅/ tshig dbyangs kyi nga ro'i rgyud mang po/ /snyim par thogs pa'i zhu mchid (19bskos/ /stong 'khun mdzangs ma'i sor rtse lasabaskrun pa'i/ /bkra shis dar gyi pañca li ka can/ /'chi shis brjod kyi rgyan/ ba med pa'i tshe yi reg byed kyi/ /ngo mtshar gtsug lag gzhung gi dgongs pa dang / /dbang phyogs gong ma'i gnam lo gsar tshes kyi/ /dga' ston dus su shrī dza yan+tu/ /shing pho spre'u'i lo jur jir bog to rgyal pos se chen chos rje sogs gser yig pa skya ser tshan cher bsngags nas rgya nag po'i khyad nor mang po'i skyes dang bcas te bskur ba'i yig lan legs lam nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ su ra ma nya gi rti ka ṇi ka b.re ṣaṭa : sgo mu ni tha la bi sa ga pra bhā ba sha ba tsa bha wa ṅgātu sha mā/ /su ra : du hā ramā ya na ra i ba la ya :hi ni rti sa ga ta ga rnyi dhi su ma ga sha ཿ tsa sa ṅgā tu dwa/ /srid (sdeb sbyor bum pa can/)dang zhi ba'i khams na stobs bcu'i 'od zer stong phrag rab 'bar ba'i/ /grags chen dbyangs kyi rna ba'i rgyan mchog mngon shes drug ldan zas gtsang sras/ /'jam dbyangs sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar mkhan kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa yis/ /(20na)bra h+ma ṇa bi ṣ+ṭha khri ha ta muhi sha ra dza ma ma ka ra ka PROB PROB PROB/ /lo ke ta su bha snob la shrī bha li ka sa : pa lwa/ hā/ /gnam bskos mi yi dbang po khyod la dus rnams kun du dge legs stsol/ /gser (dza ti'i sdos sbyor 'phags ma/)mngal dpal gyi mgrin dang 'khor lo'i lag /blo ldan me skyes chu srin rgyal mtshan can/ /'jig rten 'di na stobs ldan tsho gos rnams kyis/ /sa spyod dam par shis pa skyong par mdzod/ (20bsgo : rugo kho sba ra gi ti 'i khu :shu kra li 'a phya ba rā/ mā le/ be khyu na lha ga stu ma tsa kra wa rtirgyu ka kla o dzi sgra la sko re hā/ /ngo khung sbyor dbang po rdo rje/)mtshar ba po shis gan mdzod dbyangasakyi glu /'phrin yig be+e ḍūr dkar po'i 'phreng ba mchog /tshangs pa mi yi lus can rtsod dus 'dir/ /'khor los sgyur ba gang gi rgyan du 'god/ /ces dbyangs bdun rgyud las nye bar drangs pa'i shis pa ba—267

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherjod pa'i tshig gis sngun bsus te/ mchog tu bde legs rgya mtsho'i snang ba gsar du ston pa'i dus kyi char/ byang phyogs nor 'dzin gyi khyon la mnga' sgyur ba'i rje bor 'jig rten thams cad kyi byed po tshangs pas gnam gyi mthongs nas rin po che'i bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba/ rtsod ldan gyi dus gyi stobs gyi 'khor los sgyur ba chen po gang gis phyogs kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon srid rtse'i bar du sgreng ba'i khrims kyi gdugs dkar po gcig gi grib bsil la skye rgu (21na)thams cad bde bar 'tsho zhing / mchog gsum dam par slu ba med pa'i gtan gyi skyabs su nges pa ches cher rnyed pas bzang po'i bskal pa 'di'i bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes pa stong gi dbus na mngon par 'phags pa rgyal ba bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che la sri zhu bla lhag tu nyams su bstar ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i gtam dang lhan cig par yi ge rten der gsal gyi bdog pa'i skyes dang bcas sug par son pas yid kyi sman yon du 'brongs/ 'di na'ang lus can kun gyi phan pa'i rtsa lag lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che spel bar 'dun pa'i lhag bsam yar ldan du mchis/ nye char/ byang chub sems dpa' snying stobs can dag bsam bzhin stobs ldan rgyal por srid 'dzin pa rnams 'phral dang yun gyi legs byas rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas dge ba bcu'i rgyal khrims kyis mnga' 'bangs kun yang dag pa'i lam la 'god pa'i med du byung ba'i mdzad pa la dgongs nas/ gnam bskos kyi rje bo nyid slad mar yang rgyal ba'i bka' sde snod rin po che gsum la dbang por bgyis te tshogs gnyis kyi sgo 'phar mtha' klas pa 'byed pa'i rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston la yun du spyod pa'i dpung phrag par 'dzin pa dang / /chos rje yā nā ku me zhes rgyal ba'i 'phrin las par 'bod pa'i 'di nyid snga sor de phyogs su thub bstan lang tsho'i rang zhal thog mar ngom pa'i byed por legs tshogs su gyur pa ltar/ nye lam yang rgyal blon kun la mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam bcad ston phyir rgyal khab chen por rdzong sta bgyis yod pa yid ngor rtag tu 'char par 'tshal/ zhes rten rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi 'phel gdung / 'phags yul gyi bzo bos bskrun pa'i ston pa'i sku li ma/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi don snying por bsgril ba/—268

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pechos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba (21ba)btsong kha pas legs par gsungs pa'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i glegs bam/ mchod sdong pad spungs lcags lte can jo bo chen po a ti sha'i phyag nas ma/ srung ba rdo rje'i mdud pa/ byu ru'i brgya 'phreng / spos shel dang bcas pas rtags kyi lang tsho bkra bar rgya gar ba bhu pā lar 'bod pa bod kyi yul du sa skyong zhes grags la/ rgya nag po'i rgyal khams su mi yi 'ur rjod pa/ phyogs 'dir dbang thang dang bstun pa shing mo bya'i lo/ 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ges chos rgyal zla bzang la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo gsungs pa'i zla ba nyin mor byed pa lug khyim du spyod pa'i phyogs snga ma'i rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang nas bris pa dzā yan+tu/shing bya slob dpon smon 'gro paṇa chen 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje kho bos snyan ngag me long sdeb sbyor rin cen 'byung gnas dbyangs 'char sogs legs bshad mang po gsar du slob par sngon sbyangs zin pa rnams la'ang skyon nan tan byed pa'i slob dpon du 'degs pa'i bzhul gyi mthun rkyen sogs sta gon gyi 'phrin lan spro dga' skyed pa'i gtam/ go i sa zwa ṣ+ṭha ma kha hi she maṇi ka ra ṇa 'a tsa sto ra gri baḥ shrī ka ra pu sto ba nya tsa ༈ ra ༷ lhu lhu ni ba 3 thi gsuha/ /ngag (sdeb sbyor mar dbyangs/ji bang gzugs༅ phul byung / tshangs sras blo yi nor/ /mgrin pa'i za ma tog 'chang ba'i/ /dpyod ldan phur bu'i dpal 'phrog pa/ /bsil ldan ljongs kyi lnga rig pa/ /(22na)gang gis skyes thob blo grob(zla ga then las/ /snyan gzugs can dang nyams ldan rab rtog gsum 'dres pa'i rab spel gyi rgyan/ tshig bsil zer 'bum phrag 'dzag pa can/ /nyams 'gyur ri dwags gsags kyi 'jo sgeg la/ /blta phyir lha dbang mig stong sprul lam snyam/ /brda gzugs ro gyi rab rtog /sprod 'dzam bu'i gser gyi rna rgyan la/ /sdeb sbyor bla tshogs rin cen 'phras mdzes pa/ /dbyangs can 'phang 'gro'i rgyud las drangs pa 'dis/ /mkhas dbang dpa' bo'i snyems pa phrogs kyi dogs/ /thun grangs kyi kha tshig dang bcas pa'i nges pa phul byung /'tshams lus phrar chags pa'i phang ba na/ /dus gzugs bgrang byas lci ba'i zur phud can/ /mi zad ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo ba la/ /dmar ser mdangs kyis khyod la khyad par phye/ /shes bya'i gnad don 'byed pa'i mig gi dkyus/ /ma 'dres zur gyis lta ba'i sir bu yis/ /gtsug —269

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shelag dri bsung tshar du dngar mi dngar/ /yongs 'du nyid la rang dbang ji ltar mchis/ /ring sngon med gzugs can/ po'i yul gyis bskal yang snyan pa'i rnga/ /phyogs bral gtam gyi dbyu gus bskul ba'i sgra/ /thos 'dzin yul du 'jebs la ches nye ba/ /'di 'dra snga na med pa'i ngo mtshar gnas/ /legs slu byed kyi gab tshig /bshad dga' ston spyod phyir bshul gyi grogs/ /mthun rkyen mig sman la 'khru'i mdangs kyi rgya/ /'jigs bral rtags kyi ri mo bkra ba de/ /rab dkar shing gi ma mar gsal bar shar/ /'phrin ldan pa'i gzugs༅/ yig rdza rnga rdung ba'i ngang mo dkar/ /bkra shis dar gyi 'dab gshog legs bskyod nas/ /kun phan sa gas nya ba phyi ma yis/ /dkar phyogs i yig 'char ba'i tshes la bris/ /(22ba 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i 'phrin lan nor bu'i rna cha/ la k+ta bi ste dze do myu sa bha ma khe khya bu khyo ཿtri ga hraḥ /ya dz+nyā ga ruṇa 〉 mi ga tsa sa/ ya la bha wa gā la: gsang (dzā lha'i sdeb sbyor 'phags ma/)gsum nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid kyis/ /rmongs pa'i mun tshogs 'dul ba'i zas gtsang sras/ /gang gi mkhyen brtses nor 'dzin skyong khyod la/ /legs pa'i dngos po stsol ba'i shis pa skyongs/ /dbyig 'dzin lus phra'i mngal du lci ba'i khur/ /ster byed legs byas rgya mtsho'i dpung pa can/ /kun mkhyen shākya'i bstan la nyer gus pa'i/ /blo can mi bdag rna ba'i kun+da der/ /snyan tshig bsil zer 'bum 'dzag nyams 'gyur gyi/ /cha shas yongs gang sngon med ri bong can/ /mgrin pa'i 'chi med lam las shar ba na/ /sgra 'dzin sa mos dga' ston ngang gi 'phel/ tshes pa brjod pas mdun bsus te/ deng yang mchog tu dge ba'i dus kyi char/ legs byas na kra'i grong khyer las 'ongs pa'i nyer len gyi bsil sbyin mkhan (23na)po lnga pa'i chu 'dzin gyi 'tshe ba las ring du gyur cing / mnga' 'bangs dga' ston gyi 'od brgya phyogs bcur 'gyed pa nas/ ri mo legs skyes kyi rten/ 'dus pa'i tshogs la zang zing gi sri zhu phu dud du 'byor pas yid kyi sman yon du 'grongs/ shākya'i ring lugs pa'ang 'tsho ba rtas shing / ris bral gyi 'gro la lhag pa'i bsam pa dkar bar gnas/ nye char sngon gyi rgya hor bod kyi chos rgyal rnams kyang 'gro ba mtha' dag gi bsod nams kyi zhing ma dmad pa/ mnyam med rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po cher —27(/

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dzadagus 'dud lhur len pa'i rjes su zhugs te/ 'jang sa tham gyi rgyal khams kun legs byas kyi sgo 'phar ma smad par skyong ba'i gtam thos pas yid kyi spro ba 'phel zhing / slad nas kyang snga mkho ltar gyi srol bzang po spel ba dang / khyad par rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i bstan pa de phyogs su yod pa rnams 'phel rgyas kyi bkod 'doms mi dman pa dang / 'phros tshogs kyang rim par 'tshal zhing / gnas skabs mthar thug gi bzhed don 'grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'jug pa yang bgyis yod/ces rten bkras btags kyi mdud pa/ snam phrug lnga dang bcas dus 'khor gyi lo mgo nag zla'i dbyangs 'char ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa la chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi pho brang gru 'dzin khang brtsegs nas bris/ /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me khyi sogs la bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag /smon 'gro paṇa chen rigs gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pas kho bo la tha snyad rig pa lnga slob par rigs kyi bu 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje legs bshad gyi glegs bam mang po dang bcas te btang ba'i skabs su tshig gi 'phrin yig stag tshang lo chen dang lo chen 'gyur med bde chen gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs dang tshe gzungs byings sgrub kyi yig (23ba 〉 'i rten dang bcas bsrings pa'i lan legs bshad rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng yol ba med pa'i gtam/ a to ྅ : rte nā mā ra tswa yu:sto bu 〉 ka ra/ /dzi ma tā ཿ khyu tsa kre ta tu yi pa ṭi 〉 a ཿ kṛ /med (sdeb sbyor kha sgo phan pa/)byung 'chi med bdud rtsi yis/ /tshe dang dpal kun rgyas mdzad pa/ /rgyal yum yid bzhin 'khor lo yis/ /mkhas dbang khyod la shes par mdzod/ /phun tshogs rig gnas yongs kyi mdun sa cher/ /legs bshad rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng cher g.yo ba'i/ /snyan grags khur gyis nor 'dzin ngal byed pa/ /srid zhi'i yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin/ /don bzang gzigs mor mtshar ba'i 'jo sgeg can/ /—271—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyeshing gi ma ma'i rin cen rtsig ngos la/ /grangs med shar ba'i tshul 'dir blta ba'i blo/ /ha nu mar+shar gyur kyang phyang mo nyug shes rab rdzings kyis chos phung rin cen mchog /rgyal mtshan rtse mor bkod pa'i dpal 'byor char/ /skal bzang 'gro la bsnyel ba'i lo tsā (24na)dang / /'gyur med bde chen la rol skad gnyis pas/ /'chi bdag g.yul las rnam par rab rgyal ma/ /tshe dpag med mgon gzungs sngags legs sbyar skad/ /byings las rkyen gyis sgrub pa'i pu sta ka /ri skyes 'khor lo byung bcas sug par 'byor/ /gang gi yon tan mes po'i thod yangs las/ /legs bshad nyal 'gro'i rgyun bzang 'dren mkhas pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs mgrin par dbang du rab bgyis pas/ /ngag gi rgyal po grub pa'i lo tsā ba/ /phra zhib rigs pa'i rdo rje rtse brgya pas/ /log rtog sa 'dzin rkang pa mthar byed des/ /ka tsaṇa daṇ+ḍa 'a gtsug lag sdeb sbyor gzhung / /dbyangs 'char sum rtags skyes bzang ci yang son/ /chos mngon dgongs 'grel rgyal po'i sras po las/ /kṛ sku'i rmi ltas bshad pa dus bab 'dir/ /legs bshad rin cen spangs nas mching bu'i rdor/ /ngal ba bsten pa blun po'i rang mtshang yin/ /'ga' zhig mkhas par 'dod pa'i gsung rab la/ /phyogs rer sbyangs te dregs pa'i 0 la kha/ /mtha' bral gnas lnga kun rig nyin byed kyi/ /'od brgya spros tshe zum pa chos nyid yin/ /de lta na yang rigs chos 'dzin pa'i sras/ /blo ldan phur bu'i dpal la 'gran bzod der/ /rnam dpyod mig stong mnga' ba'i rig byed kun/ /stsal tshe shong dpang brgyud pa'i bstan pa 'dzin/ /'jam dbyangs gzhen nu mi yi srid pa'i gar/ /'gro la nye bar ston pa'i btsong kha pa/ /rnam 'dren gang de'i ring lugs 'dzin byed pa'i/ /zhi 'tsho'i dpon rigs sdom brtson klog pa mkhan/ /yongs 'dzin du ma'i drin las mdo rgyud kyi/ /tshig don rtogs dang mkhas khyod las 'ongs pa'i/ /gnas lnga'i ring lugs shing rta 'dren pa yi/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i kha lo sgyur skabs grang / /yid kyi ri dwags 'khrul pa'i dra ba sa /(24bsnya bar chud las 'don pa'i dris lan tshig /drug skyes glu dbyangs thos pas 'phags yul gyi/ /paṇa chen rnams la mos pa lhod par byas/ /'phros 'os gtam gyi 'od dkar dkyil 'khor can/ /'phrin yig dri bzhon rta —272

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pedang lhan cig tu/ /bshul lam kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram pa la/ /'gog med rgyu ba'i dga' ston ci yang mdzod/ /rmugs 'dzin dpal 'byor ma lus 'char byed pa'i/ /dbang phyogs rgyal po'i mi zad gan mdzod las/ /legs dngos thags su grub pa'i man+ta ra/ /'tshams sprin rtags kyi ze'u 'bru spud bzhin du/ /rgya nag skad du bing zu'i zhes/ /rjod pa phyogs 'dir me pho khyi'i/ /bsil sbyin mkhan po gro bzhin dang / /rtse dgar spyod pa'i zla bar bris/ /slob dpon smon 'gro paṇa chen 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje'i 'phrin lan legs bshad joms med 'thung bar sprul tshig gi pi wang / sa ba dzi na su ྅ba tswa 5 tsa stu : yub rgya na sa byu rwa/ / su ra su stu ta : rgya tsam ti shu t+ta ma tsa ya tsā 5 pa ñca::/ /rgyal (dza ti'i sdeb sbyor 'phags ma'i dbyangs/)ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i gzugs/ /lus phra'i lang tsho'i zlos gar can/ /tshangs pa'i bu mos gnas lnga kun/ /rig der blo gros mchog stsol cig /(25na)grangs med yon tan chu klung ma lus lus pa med par 'bab byed stegs/ /gting mtha' bral ba'i shes bya'i gnas lugs lugs srol rlabs phreng cher g.yo ba/ /snyan tshig rin cen bye ba'i 'byung gnas gnas lnga rig pa'i chu gter che/ /blo ldan nyal 'gro'i gtsug na rab mdzes mdzes sdug tshangs sras mgron 'chang ba/ /gangs kyi rdul brtsegs yol bas rab bskor rab tu bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs/ /ljongs 'dir sngon byon lo paṇa mdzad bzang mdzad pa ma lus spel mkhas mchoge /mchog tu snyan pa'i grags pas mngon khyab mngon rjes tshad mas 'jal byed gang / /gang gis zad med lung rigs legs bshad legs par 'ongs las spring yig 'phreng / shar lto'i lugs bzang dgod pa'i man+ta ra/ /nyams 'gyur stong gi ge sar g.yo ba can/ /snyim pa'i thod du bcings tshe mtho ris kyi/ /sgeg mo'i cod pan sa 'dir 'phos pa bzhin/ /rmad byung rig pa'i gnas kyi rgya mtsho che/ /rnam dpyod srad bur brgyus pa'i phreng ba dag /'dzin mkhas gangs ri'i ljongs kyi paṇ+ḍita/ /tshe dbang don kun grub pa'i legs bshad rgyun/ /'jam snyan shes bya'i dbyangs bdun la dbang ba/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje sdes/ /gcig car 'thungs tshe drang srong dzaḥ/ /mngon par skyengs te —273—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyeskyugs pa'i zol la brten/ /legs byas 'o mtsho'i rdzing bu 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /ma smad nyer len chu skyes gzhon nu'i tshal/ /mi mthun ba mo'i dgra las rgyal ba'i gtam/ /ngang mo'i mgrin par 'khrol de rna bar 'jebs/ /rnam gsum mkhas pa'i bya ba lang tsho'i dpyid/ /dar la bab pa'i tha snyad mig gi dkyus/ /'phangs tshe blo ldan phur bu mkha' dbyings la/ /rgyu ba'i zol gyis lta bar 'ongs pa bzhin/ /phun tshogs nor 'dzin dga' ma'i (25ba)phang ba na/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i khur gyis rab lci ba'i/ /gang gi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar la/ /chu skyes phal cher 'dzum zhing dgod pa 'dra/ / blo gros be+e ḍūr zhun ma 'khyil ba'i ngos/ /ji snyed chos kyi gzugs brnyan stong 'char ba/ /sngon med tshar du dngar ba'i gzigs mo 'di/ /byed po gser mngal can las gzhan su zhig /dpyid kyi kun dgas ring nas bskyed pa yi/ /spang ljongs rne'u gsing rgyas pa'i dga' tshal na/ /rkang 'thung g.yung du za ba mang na yang / /dpag bsam yongs la du ljon pa shin du dkon/ /phun tsho gis yon tan ma lus ches 'jo bas/ /'gro ba'i re ba skong la mkhas khyod dang / /yid bzhin nor mtshungs gang de sems med de/ khyod ni mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug ngag gi dpal/ /za hor gdung las rig gnas bcu phrag la/ /phyogs tsam mos blor gzhol ba'i skad gnyis pa/ /mtha' bral shes bya khengs ldan gnas lugs gzhu/ /blo gros rgyud kyis 'gugs pa'i 'dun par gnas/ 9/nga pang lo chen chos skyong bzang po'i bar/ /rim byon rnam thar glu dbyangs mi ldan pa'i/ /zang zing brag rir gnas bcas gnyis skyes 'ga'/ /chos min 'dab gshog skyod pa mang bar gda'/ /dri bsung mngar por 'thul ba'i ma la ya'i/ /tsan dan gzhen nu'i ljon pa gsar pa dag /bor te tsher can shing la lo 'dab kyi/ /lhab lhub g.yo zhes 'dud pa'i blun po mang / /yid 'ong rin cen rtsig pas yongs bskor ba/ /phun tshogs lha yi khang bzang dam pa bas/ /ri brag gcong rong khung bur yid gtod pa'i/ /lce gnyis spyod pa'i brang 'gros khengs 'di ci/ /slob dpon bsten dang brtson pa ma dgos par/ /chos kun ma lus mkhyen par khas 'che ba'i skye rgu'i 'dren par rlom pa'i (26na lo la bden na/ /mdo las rgyu 'bras gsungs pa gtam du zad/ /— 274—

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (peblang dang dor byar dpyod pa'i rna ba la/ /phyi nang gtsug lag nor bu'i phra tshom can/ /rnam dpyod gzi 'od 'bar ba'i dga' ston de/ /deng dus khyod kyi skal ba tsam du khums/ /mang thos 'dzam bu'i gser phye phyir dor nas/ /blun rmongs dregs ldan ra gan gtsor 'dzin pa'i/ /bsil ldan skye bo'i snang tshul 'di mthong tshe/ /mkhas khyod mdzad par rjes su cis mi rang / /rkang mgyogs grub pa'i 'phrul gyis 'phagasapa'i yul/ /lan brgyar bskor kyang deng dus rnyed min pa'i/ /grags pa don mthun bod yul paṇ+ḍi smon 'gro lo 〈tshe dbang don grub/ ta/ sa/ dum wā ra lta bur phrad dka' na/ /sgra tshad bzo gso nang rig snyan ngag dang / /mngon rjod sdeb sbyor zlos gar skar rtsis sogs/ /bslab byar 'os min 'ga' yang ma mchis pas/ /ngoms med thos pa'i sgro 'dogs chod par mdzod/ /snyan tshig spel legs nor bu'i be+e ḍūr+ya/bru t+ta dzā ti'i gru gzings la brten nas/ /'phrin yig mthun pa'i rlung dang rang 'grogs te/ /nam yang bskyud pa med pa'i khur 'khyer 'tshal/ /stong 'khun smin legs sor mo'i 'du byed kyis/ /ngo mtshar thags su grub pa'i lus phra ma/ /thun 'tshams rtags kyi ga 'on nur mdza' gcugs kyi/ /mi phyed dga' ston rgya yis dam du bcings/ /dmar 'od gos bzang klubs pa'i bgrang bya yi/ /rta ljang seng ge'i khyim du nyer spyod pa/ /gtsug na zla ba'i lugs srol dbyangs 'char ba'i/ /dmar phyogs o yig 'char ba'i tshes la 'bris/ /mi rgan dka' bcu shes rab rgya mtsho bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i bod sog gi lo stor gtsang pa rnam rdzong du yod thog springs(26ba)pa nad brgya 'joms pa li sman mchog /tri ga phya gas su ti shu 'i yu/ su ka ྅ dza ga kṛ ta tsa 'ing skra/ /ཿ bṛ k+ṣa ba ཿ k+ṣa da ra shu ba lha/ /ba rā kra mu sa du ku ru:shu :/ /phul (sdeb sbyor nye dbang rdo rje/byung gsang gsum tshar du dngar ba'i dris/ /skal bzang 'gro la phan bde'i bdud rtsi'i dpyid/ /mi zad stobs bcu'i rtsal gyi ro bro ba/ /rnam 'dren rkang 'thung dbang pos dge bar mdzod/ /ring nas goms pa'i legs lam snang ba'i gter/ /mi dman skrun pa'i cho ga'i khrims kyi 'od/ /mngon mtho'i rten bzang 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal can/ /nyer 'tshe'i skyin thang dgra las rnam rgyal ngos/ /—275

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)phun tshogs dge bcur grub pa nyi 'og yul/ /mtho ris yon tan kun mkhyen g.yas ru'i cha/ /sum rtsen 'dzin mar 'phos sam gser mngal can/ /byed pos gsar du bris 'dra'i sman ljongs su/ /gzhan phan 'khri shing gsar pa'i lcug phran can/ /ma 'dris 'khyud pa'i dpyad thag thon po mchog /yid kyi ga bur ster tshe chu shel dbang / /(27na)gnyis pa sa der 'phos snyam kun+da 'dzum/ /mi bdag rjes 'jug mdun na 'don rnams la/ /gang gis legs par brjod pa'i tshig sbyor gyis/ /bsil ldan yangs pa'i sa chen 'dir 'khod pa'i/ /grangs med skye rgur byams brtses legs skyong cing / /kun gsal lus phra'i ngos shar bsil sbyin mkhan/ /'bum phrag 'das pa'i rdzing bur 'char ba ltar/ /rgyal ba'i rjes zhugs gangs khrod grub pa'i mtha'/ /ris med yongs la phan bde ster ba'i thabs/ /kun yid dga' ba'i ngal gso'i stegs byin ces/ /brjed ngas dri ma 'khrud tshig dbus 'gyur nas/ /sems kyi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gzhol ba/ /a wa ( ti'i btsun pa de skad smra/ /slad mar bgyid 'os gtam gyi si spyi'i klung / /rab dkar shog bu'i lam gsum ngos yangs par/ /lan gcig min par rgyu ba'i dbyangs bdun glu/ /rnam par sgrog pa'i mgrin pa gdeg par gyis/ /de lta'i 'phrin yig 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin can/ /snyan tshig sgro thul 'geng ba'i ga9|ga rlabs kyis/ /gsang ba sngags kyi mdud rgya'i gtsug phud bcas/ /gru 'dzin ri bo'i khang brtsegs spo nas 'phur/ /zur chen rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po khyab bdag pad+ma dbang gis snyan tshig 'phreng bar spel ba'i lan bde gshegs zhi khro'i gsang tshig /phun tshogs dge bcu'i dpal gyis legs spud pa/ /bsil ldan bstan 'gro'i gnyen gyur mtsho skyes rje/ /blo bzang snyan grags ba dan mngon mtho ba/ /mtshungs med skyabs kyis rtag tu shis par mdzod/ /rab 'byams zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /nye bar bsnyen pas grub pa'i mtshan ma mchog /mngon gyur gsang bdag sgro phug rje la sogs/ /phul byung dam pa'i rigs las (27ba)nyer son pas/ /mtshungs med rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs che/ /da lha'i ring lugs snyan tshig lam drangs pa/ /sug pa'i gar dang gtam gyi rgyud mang glu/ /'dren byed sgra 'dzin zung gi dga' ston gyur/ /—276

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pongos kyang dus kyi bskal pa'i snang tshul 'dis/ /theg mchog zab mo'i tshul la blo gzhol yang / /mi phan phan rlom 'gro don gzugs brnyan gyis/ /sngon chad gzhan dbang bsir bus cung zad bskyod/ /slad mar mig stong ldan pa'i lag nyal bzhin/ /mi mthun sa 'dzin bgrod pa kun bcom nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i gnyis 'thung dbang po'i steng / /zab don rin cen rgyan gyis bkra bar byed/ /de ltar tshig gi 'phrong ba'i gtsug phud can/ /brjod don rgyan gyi mdongs mtha' legs ngom zhing / /lha rdzas dar gyi shog rlabs rab bskyod nas/ /dbang po'i phyogs kyi lha lam ngos su 'phur/ /chu mo lug gi lor ngos sog po'i yul la 'degs mi 'degs kyi 'gro ldeng bar brten rang bzo'i gtam sna tsho gos sgrog pa na zur chen dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal ldan bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyis dbus 'gyur 'chang 'dir stan chags dgos pa'i snyan tshig gi phreng ba spel shā tso nges pa don gyi gto/ rab dang klung chen bcud kyi snying po'i dpyid/ /dri med mdangasaldan mtshor shar au ḍi ya'i/ /'dab stong ze'u 'bru dbus na sprul pa'i gar/ /rnam rol 'chi med grub pas 'gro 'di skyongs/ /legs bris bdud rtsi'i yang zhun ma bsdus shing / /dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i glu min 'dren byed dang / /rna ba'i dpal du spyod pa'i zab mo'i gter/ /mi zad chos kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa yi/ /'phrin yig dbyangs can 'phang 'gro'i rgyud mang las/ /nye bar drangs pa'i tshig 'phreng dan+ḍi'i lugs/ /'gyur med gzhom du med pa'i (28na rdo rje'i glu/ /rten gyi lang tsho rtags kyis bkra ba 'byor/ /snang bzhi'i lam bzang rang sems gdod ma'i zhal/ /lhug par ston pa'i a tir mi g.yo zhing / khrag 'thung dpal chen khro bo'i dbang po yi/ /rdo rje'i zegs ma 'phro ba'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /glags lta'i bsam sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud sde'i sprin/ /gsang ba zab mo'i rig sngags 'thor rlung gis/ /rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bskrad gyur snyan pa'i sgra /thos 'dzin gsos su gyur pas spro ba 'phel/ /'dir yang nyi 'og dbus 'gyur lte ba sa /nam yang mi 'gyur brtan pa'i thabs kyi sgo /bod skyong rdo rje 'bar rtsal gang de la/ /lan cig min par gnyer du gtod snyam grang / /dge mtshan rgya mtsho'i yul ljongs bsil ba'i bzhi/ /mtho ris yon tan ma lus 'byor pa'i gnas/ /tshul 'dir mi 'gyur zhing skyes bcu gnyis —277

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)la/ /'phrin las gnyer gtad dam pos bcing bar 'tshal/ /gangs ri'i 'od la 'gran pa'i thags kyi dar/ /〈 ṇa'i sgeg mo'i sor rtse las grub pa/ /pad rag lang tsho'i mdangs kyi rgyas btab ste/ khru 'dzin ri bo'i gzhal med khang nas bris/ /sa yos stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub gyis sgra ṭika nag po 'gro shes glegs bam g.yar po dang bcas tshigs yod kyi chab shog gi lan gzhon nu 'gru/ dpal ldan phul byung rigs kyi thig le nor 'dzin mchog tu rab yangs par/ /rnam dpyod mkhyen pa'i chu gter gyis bskrun sde snod gzhung gi sdong bu la/ /sgra tshad rjes 'dzin 'dab mas legs spud mngon par rtogs pa'i 'bras ldan pa/ /mkhas grub rkang 'thung gtsug rgyan rje btsun dpag bsam ljon pa gang de'i drung / /deng dus rnam dkar legs spyod sa 'dzin (28ba)dbang / /rlabs chen smon lam legs bris stobs kyi sgo'i/ /'tshams sbyor sgyu rtsal 'phrul gyis bsrubs pa las/ khyim zla'i grangs ldan rgyan gyi gzi 'od can/ /gzugs sku bcu gnyis bdag po'i dkyil 'khor gang / /gzhan phan dgongs bzang mdog lngas rab drangs te/ /gangs can grub dbang rdo rje rgyal po zhes/ /zab lam nges don yid bzhin nor bu mchog /dpal stug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser 'god pa/ /gang de bka' rgyud skabs gsum rdzing ring ngos/ /lus can bsod nams dbang phyogs gyen 'phyur spor/ /mi mthun chu 'dzin dang bral mngon shar bas/ /rnam dag gsang gsum mi zad tsha zer gyis/ /skal ldan ra yig gnyis pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /legs bshad puṇ+ḍa ri ga'i bdud rtsi'i ros/ /mngon par myos pa'i dga' ston rgyas pa nas/ /ri mo gsum pa'i bi shwa ri yi/ /bcud kyi ma ma'i snyim pa'i 'du byed la/ /ston med lugs zung bslab bya rin cen phreng / /snyan ngag tshig gi srad bu la brgyus pa'i/ /bka' shog shar phyogs rgyal khab gan mdzod dar/ /rgya bod mkhas rnams 'jug pa'i sgo gcig pu/ /legs sbyar gzhud gi 'grel pa'i glegs bam zung / /phyag rtags lang tsho gsar ldan mngon phebs tshe/ /kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi rjes bzhugs pa'i/ /gnas lngar mos blo 'dzin pa'i snyom las pa rab dga'i sa la 'gran pa'i dga' bde'i dpal/ /'chi med skyed tshal gnas su sleb ltar gyur/ /slad —278

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (penas zab yangs blo gros gangs ri las/ /'dor med thugs brtse'i skal ldan shing rta yi/ /bka' gnang phebs tshogs ri sti'i thos 'dzin rgyan/ /'gog med rgyun mi 'chad pa'i bka' drin zhu/ /'di lta'i tshig 'phreng snang byed ba ma ras/ /(29nasgo ngo zhe par btsa' phyir sa 'dzin dkar po'i mdangs/ /'phrog byed lha rdzas āt+pal ze'u 'bru la/ /rtags kyi 'dab ma'i rgya yis legs btab ste/ /'phags pa'i yul du pra ma ting rjod cing / /phyogs 'dir myos ldan zhes pa sa yos lo'i/ /thos ldan zla ba grags pa'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la phul ba dge /bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i mchod gnas dang mdun na don zung du 'jug pa gu shi bla ma shes rab rgya mtsho la springs pa rgya mtsho'i zla ba / gu rnya mi dha : la : bra si ta ku ba na ma khru rmo tu ye na la k+ṣe/ /be+e ci tsho kā lig shrī te ma na ga ra ma ti tu rta 〈 li ku se wa/ rta (phreng ba 4na pa'i sdeb sbyor/skong dbang po 'bum gyi ri dwags mig can mas 'byud rab dkar be+e ḍūr rdul brtsegs sgyu rtsal spyod/ /gang gi lang tsho'i dpal gyis ti mi'i grong mthar btang yang stobs ldan gros su bsten la rings byed pa/ /(29ba)shrī ༷ gi ṭa ཿ na lha gi sa khi ta wa da ya lha ka spro kā ya : tsa skyu//〉 rgya ga hi ta stu sudzi ku ru si ta sto ma tu u PROB PROB PROBPROB/ /phun tshogs ngag gi 'dod 'jo ma lus ngag la rab stsol rna ba brgyad pa'i sras mo mtsho byung ma/ khyod kyi thugs rje'i bsil sbyin mkhan pos rmongs mun choms la blo gros ut+pal dkar po rgyas par mdzod/ /bkra shis zla ba'i zhags pas rab bcings pa'i/ /phun tshogs ma ho mtho'i lus rten yongs 'du ri shing / /rnam dkar bya ba'i gang bur mngon par rgyas/ /mang thos gtam gyi nyal 'gror legs spyod cing / /phul byung bsod nams me zhal 'khrul 'khor las/ /grangs med rgyal phran na kra'i grong khyer dbus/ /gnam bskos stobs kyi dbang phyug bcu gnyis bdag /yangs pa'i dbyig 'dzin kun gsal las 'ongs pa'i/ /'jigs med bzang po'i lung gi 'od rnon gyis/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'dab stong ma lus pa/ /(30na jig car ba 'ad pa'i sa 'di'i mig stong can/ /bgrod byed zung gis phyi bzhin snyeg pa'i ngang / /snyim pa'i gar mkhan shing gi ma ma'i ngos/ /zlos gar —279

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)sgyur ba'i rnam bkra ri mo'i gzugs/ /snang byed las gyur tshig gi bya ma rta/ /sgra 'dzin lam du zhugs pas spro ba 'phel/ /ngos kyang bde snang yan lag brgyad ldan 'gram/ /zin bral rnam g.yeng ca co'i sgrar sun te/ /theg mchog snying po'i dal 'bab lto ba sa /mngon par 'dren la mos pa mi dman tsam/ /gnyisaskyes rgyal po'i 'od kyis kun+da'i tshal/ /'dzum la gzhan yang 'gog pa mi mnga' ltar/ / bgyid 'osagatam gyi 'jug pa man shel phreng / /'phrin yig tshig gi srad bur rgyu bar gyis/ /dmar phyogs me yis bcings pa'i rdzogs pa la/ /zla gzhen snang gter sgrib smra rdzun pa'i gtam/ /sra brtan srung ba'i 'khor lo'i 'od kyi gzi/ /'bar ba bzod min lhun po'i phag tu song / /de skad ngag gi 'dren byed bh+ra ma ra/ /dkar 'jam shog bu'i skyed tshal mngon yangs par/ /'phur lding rol slad bdog pa'i pad+ma dkar/ /rtags kyi lang tshor rgyas btab li khi tam/ /blang dor la lta ba'i mkhas rlom gyi gur can cal sgrog tsam gyi rjes su mi 'brang bar khal kha e te na hong tha'i ji'i 'phrin lan gser gyi meg thur (30ba) 1 8 8 ta ha rma sa mu dra tsa bi nā ya / 'a bha : wa re/ /dha : ta byadzi ka : pa tra ka ta 1 me lha su ti bya : ā/ /gu bya / su ma to ra swā rgya bha ya u surlo ma dhu r+ya ma tā/ a dz+nyā dz+nyā dzi sta tsa bha mi ku ru pā ༷ rti shu bhū ta bla lha/ /rnam (sdeb sbyor stag rnam rtsen/)'dren gsang gsum zla 'phel las 'khrungs ye shes mchog gi snang ba yis/ /'gro 'di'i mong rtul sngo bsangs las rgyal phan bde'i 'dab rgya ci yang 'dzum/ /phul byung blo gros bzang po'i bcud za'i 'jigs med chos kyi snyan pa'i sgra/ /grags pa srid 'dir mngon mtho'i rgyal pos nor 'dzin skyong khyod dge bar mdzod/ /legs pa'i lam du ring bskrun dpung pa skyes/ /mi dman rgyal thabs 'khor lo'i su war+ṇa/ /'od srung byin 'dir 'gog med rgyu ba'i stobs/ /mdog lnga'i bgrod pa'i shugs la skyengs pa ster/ /dbyig gi blo gros me zhal rdzing ring gos/ /gyon par 'phyang ma ster ba'i klung chen 'gram/ /dge bcur grub pa'i gnas chen yul gyi ljongs/ /'dren byeng dga' ston sbyor ba bdud rtsir 'chel/ /stobs bcu mnga' rnams lus can bsod nams zhig /bla med tshar du dngar phyir bshes —280

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('ganyen gzugs/ /dam pa'i bgrod byed gtsug bsten bde ba dang / /zab rgyas gsung (31na po cud rgyud mang glu la 'khru/ /'khrul med blang dor lta ba'i mig stong dang / /rlabs chen dge tshogs grub pa'i rtse brgya pas/ /sdig lta'i dbyig 'dzin phur bu'i rkang bcag tshe/ /legs lam sa srung bu yi steng na 'gying / /gang gi spring yig ri dwags mig can ma/ /sna tshogs tshig gi 'phyang 'phrul rab spud de/ /dbyangs bdun rgyud la co 'drir rdzu ba nas/ /rgya yis smras te bshul lam bde bar 'byor/ /za hor rigs kyi shākya'i dge sbyor yang / /nyer len ma la yar skyes g.yur za zhing / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i yal 'dab g.yo ba nas/ /theg mchog nges don dri bsung mi dman tsam/ /tshe ring gnam gyi rgyud 'dzin dpyod ldan dpyod/ /ji snyed shes bya'i kun gsal pha mtha'i tshad/ /blo gros lus 'degs kyis 'jal bsam pa'i khur/ /gser ldan ltor shong yangs pa'i yol go mtshar/ khres bya rig pa'i gnas kun lta ba'i mig /ming tshig rjod pa smra ba'i lce yi mdzod/ /legs bshad sha mchog be+e ḍūr brda sprod gzhung / /tshul 'dir mos la rgol ba'i klan ka su/ /tha snyad gtsug lag mngon bkra'i khang bzang dbus/ /legasasbyar gser gyi khri la rnam 'gying ba/ /skad gnyis smra ba phur bu'i blo ldan der/ /mi dman brtson pa'i sbyangs pa'i thabs su che/ /snang byed rab dkar 'khor lo'i yan lag can/ /tshig don 'dam skyes 'phreng spel shang shong chur/ /rab spyod byed por sa brtan rdo rje'i gzugs/ /rnyog bral dang du shar la rgyas btab ste/ /ral gri'i so can khyim du snang ba'i gter/ /legs gnas ma hā rtswa ṇa'i yul gru sa /shi dbri yol 'bod tshim byed zla ba yi/ /dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la bris/ /(31ba)bcog min gyi nges par 'byung ba'i blos chos brgyad kyi mgo snyoms pa'i grags pa don ldan gyi grub chen bka' bcu bag dro ngag dbang lhun grub la springs pa drang srong kun du dga' ba'i zlos gar/su sti pra dza:: legs byas dbyar skyes lang tsho'i mngal gyi khur/ /lci ba'i don gnyis 'dab brgya ge sar las/ /bde legs sbrang rtsi 'bum du 'dzag pa yi/ /grub rigs glu dbyangs rab sgrog rkang drug pa'i/ /'phrin yig srad bur brgyus pa'i gtam gyi 'phreng / /legs skye bang rten gyi gser sbyangs 'phra bkod pa/ /rtags kyi 'od gzis 'khyud pa'i gtsug —281

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)phud can/ /snyim pa nor 'dzin ngos su zlos gar sgyur/ /mi khom skyon gyis sbags pa'i ra ri'i dri/ /legs byas nyal 'gro'i rgyun gyis rab bkrus pa'i/ /dal ba'i rten bzang nyer 'tshe dang bral zhing / /don ldan snying po len la spro dga' rtas/ /snyan dang mi snyan bde sdug bstod smad sogs/ /chos brgyad bya ba'i ngang chul ring dor te/ /mngon par mtho dang nges par legs pa'i lam/ /phyi ma'i don chen sgrub pa lhag par gces/ /srid pa'i bde bar 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /dgra gnyen go ldog nam 'chi nges pa med/ /ngan song sdug bsngal bzod dka'i snang tshul la/ /bsams tshe shes ldan su zhig tshe 'di gnyer/ /srid 'dir mngon mtho tshangs dbang 'bar los sgyur/ /'jig rten snang ba'i gter byed nyi zla yang / /bran gyur mun pa'i rum du gnas byed na/ /tshe 'di'i bde ba glog gi gar mkhan bzhin/ /sdug bsngal g.yang las ches grol zhi bde'i gdugs/ /rmad byung thar pa'i rin cen yu ba can/ /bsil ba'i ngal gso ster ba'i grib bsil la/ /gnas kyang dman pa'i lam du gol gyi dogs/ /brgya phrag dka' ba spyad de phan pa'i thabs/ /lan grangs mang por bsgrubs pa'i mar gyur 'gro /mtha' med 'khor ba'i (32nasgo tsho las yongs sgrol ba'i/ /snying stobs khur chen 'khyer ba med byung lam/ /thabs shes 'dab gshog zung du rab 'brel zhing / /zab don chos kyi dbyangs snyan legs sgrog pa/ /blo ldan 'khor lo'i lag de'i snyan pa'i gtam/ /thos pas me tog phal cher 'dzum pa 'dra/ /'brom ston mar me sku mched gsum la sogs/ /sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar ri dwags gzugs/ khyod blo'i zla gzhen ngos su rtag bkod nas/ /de don sgrub pa'i 'od dkar 'gyed par rigs/ /gnyen 'dun mdza' bshes rnam g.yeng rgyang du bsrings/ /dben zhing nyams dga' dam pas byin brlabs gnas/ /nyal 'gro'i lhung lhung sgra 'byin spang ljongs jogs/ /bsam gtan sgrub pa'i lo ma'i khang bu'i nang / /dal ba'i rten la snying po len pa'i tshe/ /zhi lhag zung 'brel ting 'dzin la sgoms pa'i/ /rgyas sras spyod pa'i khur 'khyer spong ba pa/ /drang srong khyod kyi snang tshul 'di rmad byung / /snying nas tshe zhabs sgrub pas 'dal ba la/ /'gyur med dam bca'i bsam pa brtan po gang / /'bad med lag rtser gyur pa'i dge legs kun/ /—282

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dzadamachog gsum dam pa'i mthu yis 'grub gyur cig /dbyangs bdun rgyud las 'ongs min yang / /blo gsal dga' ba skyed pa'i gtam/ /srung mdud rkang 'thung phur mar bcas/ /gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i rtse nas bris/ /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me phag lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag /khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma btsong kha pa chen po mi'i srid pa 'dzin pa'i tshul bstan pa'i sa sku 'bum byams pa gling gi mchod sdong la khar kha ye ra te (32ba)tong tha'i jis dngul srang khri phrag tu nye ba tsam gyis sri zhu byed skabs rgyu mtshan 'phrin yig tu bsrings pa'i lan bsod nams gser gyi 'ban lo'i gzi 'od/ rwa go ྅ra nu ni 〈 tu a 2 khya 5 gi ge lha gha sdi go hā: du nā/ hā sha khri/ /pa rte na re hā ru tsi re ta bha li ka shrī/ su gi rti rta ga sa ཿ u t+tar/ /grangs (sdeb sbyor dbang po'i rgyud/) med skye rgur rjes chags gar mkhan ma/ /'jam mgon gnyis skyes zol can blo yi dpyid/ /srid 'di skal pa bzang por sgyur byed pa/ /grags pa'i dpal khyod kun gyi bla na mdzes/ /(33na) tsa tu sa na nyi ko ṣaḥshu ra/ ti sha ṭa 6 tu/ /dza skru thu ba lha 'i ka sposu rje ka r+ṇa ṇa nā ya tsa/ /phul (sdeb sbyor kha sgo phan pa/)du byung ba'i sdebazhi zhi mdzod/ /legs lam dri bzhen shing rta yis/ /'dzam gling kun gsal la 'dren pa'i/ /byed po sa spyod rna ba glogs/ /kun gsal zhags pas bcings pa srid pa'i snod/ /yid bzhin nor gyis phyur bur gtams pa'i zong / /grangs med tshogs kyis cha tsam bskrun min pa'i/ /mngon mtho'i rten gyi yongs 'du sa brtol dbang / /grang reg tshun rol phrag la ring brgyal zhing / /mnga' thang 'byor pa'i skyed tshal yangs pa na/ /rgyal bstan gyen du 'degs pa'i mngar ba'i dris/ /gang tshe yangs pa'i sa yang dog snyam byed/ /brgyud pa'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun las sgrol byed pa'i/ /rjod tshig ri mor shar ba'i rtags gsum pa/ /bdog pa'i skyes —283

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)kyi (33ba)ba dan shugs 'gror bcas/ /snyim pa'i yul grur son tshe spro ba 'phel/ /rnam 'dren gsang 'bum dmar ser dhī yi gzugs/ /thabs shes 'od kyi shing rtas bzhu ba'i bcud/ kha sbyor bdun gyi grub pa'i 'chi med lam/ /klubs byed rgyal ba'i tog gyur btsong kha pa/ /nor 'dzin bu mo 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyis/ /lci ba'i khur gyis dud par dman blo'i ngor/ /mdzad pa'i rtags kyis bkra ba'i mchod sdong che/ /bla lhag sri zhur bskrun pa'i legs byas kyi/ /phung po mkha' la 'phags pa su waṇa'i/ /'khor lo rnam par sgyur ba'i gzi 'od kyis/ /rtsod pa'i dus kyi rgol ba cher skrag nas/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i yol ba ring du brkyang / /de phyir rna ba brgyad pa'i mgrin sngon can/ /'khor ba'i dgra bo grags pa'i mu khyud rnams/ /srid 'byor khyod kyis rang gi byed snyam pa'i/ /'phyang mo'i dra bar tshud 'di e ma mtshar/ /thugs rje'i mtha' bral dngos grub rin cen gter/ /'byung gnas 'jam dpal snying po'i bstan pa'i mtshor/ /thabs mkhas tshul gyis dge ba'i be+e ḍūr+ya/ /yid kyi rgyal mtshan rtse mor rtag mchod cig /'phrin yig dar gyi srad bu la/ /brgyus pa rten gyi mo snyi ka /rtags kyi 'od dkar spro bzhin du/ /gnod sbyin phyogs gyi lam yangs por/ /yal ga'i ri dwags mar gad kyi/ /stod g.yogs gyon pa'i dag byed zla'i/ /dkar phyogs rgyal ba dang po la/ /mtho ris grong khyer stag rtser bris/ /slob dpon smon 'gro paṇa chen 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje'i 'phrin las dbyangs can mgrin par zhugs la bsngags pa'i gtam/ (34na) u t+ta ma su ma tā ka ཿ sgra bha ṣaḥ su rnye 9 hu/ /pa ñca:ra pa 〉 shu kla yu〉sha ti sha pa 1 1 ya sta/ /blo (kha sgo bzlog pa'i phan pa/) gros ldan pa'i gsags can/ mchog gi kun gsal las/ /legs bshad nam mkha'i nor bu yis/ /gnas lnga'i pad dkar rgya bang byed pa'i/ /phul byung mkhas dbang gang de yi/ /mgrin mtha' dgag khugs can/ pa'i rgyud las 'ongs pa snyan tshig gi /nyams 'gyur stong gi dbyangs ldan 'phrin yig ma/ /ston 'khun dar gyi gos rgyan g.yo bzhin du/ /sug pa'i nor 'dzin ngos su zlos gar sgyur/ /gang mthu phun tshogs kyi zol bstod/ gis 'phags yul mkhas mang skyongs byed pa'i/ /phul byung tshig sbyor spel la mtshar du ci/ /mi zad dbyangs can gang gi dngos grub de/ khyod 284

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('akyi mgrin pa'i skal bar thob min nam//lhug phran phul byung/gzhen nu'i phon po ltar mnyen pa//lcang lo'i 34ba po phreng ba rab 'dzin gnas lnga'i gzhu//'gugs byed snga na med pa'i rnam dpyod 'dis//cho me rgyal dge dbang snyems pa'i ngal ba btang //blang pha spu3brdzita'i lnga mi tshos pa/dor ltar sdongasangan las bya gzhag gis//brel ba'i bod blun rang gi ngang tshul rnams//ston kyang rgya bal yul gyi blo ldan kun/khyod kyi snyan pa'i grags pa sgrog la brel//legs mtha' dgag stegs can/byas zla ba'i ma ma las 'ongs pa//med byung nye bar len pa'i chu shel dbang //nyer 'tshe nam mkha'i glang po las rgyal ba'i//gtam 'di dpyod ldan yongs kyi rna bar 'jibs//'chi shis rjod/ba'i dngos kun 'joms pa'i ye shes kyi//bdud rtsi'i lang tsho rgyas pa'i mgon po yis//gangs khrad gnas lnga rig khyod ji srid bar//'gyur med g.yung drung la gnas shis pa stsol/ /slad ldan pa'i gzugs can la dngos dpe 'dres pa/ mar 'os pa'i gtam gyi nor bu'i 'phreng //'phrin yig srad bur brgyus pa snyim pa yis//thogs te ngal med rgyu ba'i bya ma rta/ /kun phan bgrod pa'i rgyun ltar mi bskyud 'tshal/ /thags ldan pa'i gzugs༅/kyi lang tsho bdo ba'i gzhen nu ma/ /rgya yi lus phras mi phyed dam 'khyud de/ /legs ldan mgrin sngon gtsug lag dgongs don gyi//dmar phyogs e yig 'char ba'i tshes la bris//gong ma ta ming gi rgyal sa 'dzin pa'i tha ma khrung gying gi rgyal sa le'u tsis phyogs te snyigs ma las kyang ches cher snyigs pa'i mun pa'i smag wo ca zad bdo ba na jur jid bog do'i sras gnam gyi lha sto di rgyal po'i bsod nams nyi ma'i gzhi byin 'od du 'bar te 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khrir phebs nas lo bzhi lon pa me mo phag gi lo khā bla ma sogs gser yig pa skya ser mang po mngags te dar zab rin po che rngams ches du ma'i 35na skonang sbyin dang bcas bka' shog byung ba'i lan rdzogs ldan thog mar ngom pas rang zhal/bu rdo su gang ma gyur〉de n+ta na yadi/wa sde kā/bru69sto mi kama3:dugar+bhar rgya ya ha rgyu bi//legs dz+wa snya sdeb sbyor 'phags ma/byas rgya mtsho'i shing rta chen po yis//rdzogs ldan kun dga' ring nas 'dren byed par//nor 'dzin dbang por spyod pa'i tshangs pa che//'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po gang de'i drung //med byung mdzad ༷ 8 5 gi nyin byed 'od//snang ba'i sgo 'phar brgya

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)phrag phye ba'i gzis/ /yid kyi pad dkar 'dab stong cher bzhad pas/ /nyams 'gyur rkang drug dbyangs ldan 'di skad lo/ /'chi med lding khang nor bu'i them skas las/ /zur phud lnga pa 'gro ba'i dpung (35ba)gnyen du/ /bsams bzhin 'khor los sgyur ba srid bzung ba'i/ /phul byung gzugs sku mtshan dpe'i 'bras kun smin/ /rgyud mang glu las lugs zung 'byed pa'i sgra /dbyangs bdun mgrin par khugs pa tshangs pa'i gsung/ /skye rgu'i sgra 'dzin bde bar ngal gso ba'i/ /skal bzang 'di yis rtsod dus pha mthar bskrad/ /brtan g.yo'i chos kyi ngang tshul phra rab rdul/ /mkhyen pas cig car gzhal ba'i rnam dpyod can/ /zab gsal ches brling gang thugs ā dar+shar/ /mi 'char shes bya'i snang brnyan su zhig mchis/ /snying rje smon lam rlung shugs kyis drangs pa'i/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin gzugs sku bsil sbyin mkhan/ /nyes brgya'i chu 'dzin las brgal sde bzhi yi/ /'od dkar 'gyed pa'i gtam gyi dbyar rnga dang / /lhan cig bka' tham 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin can/ /mkho rgu'i 'byor pa'i sgro gshog rnam bkra ba/ /gser yig dbyar gyi rgyal mo'i lag pad kyis/ /thogs te sug par son pas spro ba 'phel/ /kun la sman mdzad zas gtsang sras po yi/ /dri med ring lugs 'dzin par khas 'che ba/ /sdom brtson klog pa mkhan yang ris bral gyi/ /'gro la lhag pa'i bsam pa dkar bar mchis/ /e ma 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khor yug nang / /bsod nams gser gyi 'khor los dbang sgyur bas/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal mnga' ba/ /'jig rten byed po'i 'gran zlar da gdod khums/ /mi bsrun dregs ldan skye bo mda' lnga pa/ /gang gi dpa' mdzangs me yi bsregs pa na/ /kun las mngon par mtho ba'i mgrin sngon can/ /byed pos gling 'dir mi yi gzugs su byas/ /brtse ldan byams pa mchog gi gan mdzod las/ /phan dang bde ba'i yid bzhin nor bu'i (36na)gter/ /ris med lus can kun la stsal ba yis/ /phyag na pad+ma'i ngang tshul 'dzin nam snyam/ /blang dang dor bya'i ka shi gsar pa'i ras/ /mkhyen dpyod pir gyis ri mor bris pa'i gzugs/ /ma 'dres rnam par bkra ba'i ngo mtshar gyis/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dang so sor gang gis dbye/ /nag por spyod pa'i cas lag mun pa'i dpung / /pha mthar skyod la 'bad med —286

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (polhun grub pa/ /phun tshogs nus pa'i dbang phyug 'od brgya pas/ /gsang ba'i bdag po rang gi dpe slar byas/ /nye ring dang bral mchog dman mtha' dag la/ /snyoms par bstar ba'i bka' khrims 'dzam bu'i gser/ /gnya' shing 'dzin ri lta bur ches lci bas/ /mang pos bkur ba'i rnamathar 'dzin pa bzhin/ /'dzam gling skye rgu bde ba'i grib bsil gnas/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i dbang po khyod nyid du/ /nges phyir chos srid mdzad pa ma lus pa/ /sngar bzhin yar ldan 'phel bar bskul phyir gsol/ /'dzam gling bsod nams zong gis cher bskrun pa'i/ /dpal ldan mi yi dbang po yid bzhin nor/ /phan bde legs tshogs kun gyi 'byung gnas khyod/ /bskal brgyar mi 'gyur zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /gang gi spyan ras bh+ra ma ra/ /gzigs rten sngags mdud pad dkar tshal/ /rten 'dam kun 'dus ze'u 'bru/ /rgyal ba'i sku brnyan sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /sbur len me tog g.yur za ba/ /srab 'jam lo ma phang phung can/ /thun 'tshams lang tsho dar ba'i rtags/ /rnam par bkra ba'i rgyas btab ste/ /'phagasayul skad du ā dzi tar/ /rjod pa thams cad 'dul zhes pa'i/ /kun phan dbyug pas nya ba'i tshe/ /gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i rtse nas phul/ /(36ba〉kong ma chen po'i dgung blon a ma dbang la springs pa legs tshogs 'dzad mi shes pa'i bang mdzod/ su sti pra dza sa:sku gsum 'chi ba med pa'i yongs 'du las/ /tshe dang ye shes dngos po 'dod rgu'i 'char/ /stsol mkhas gang des sa dbang rgyal po yi/ /chos srid kha lo sgyur der shis pa stsol/ /zhes bkra shis pa'i tshig gis sngun bsus te 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i mdun na 'don gang de la gdams pa/ deng gi dus bsod nams chu gter chen po las nye bar bskrun pa'i lus 'tsho'i bsil sbyin mkhan po mngon par rtas shing /rgyal khrims gser gyi shing rta nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon kun la mnga' sgyur ba'i byed po'i mchog tu gnas pa'i tshul thos pas spro ba 'phel/ ngos kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel ba dang / lus can mtha' dag la lhag pa'i bsam pa dkar ba re mchis/ slad mar yang gong ma chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' khrims gdugs dkar po gcig gi grib bsil du mnga' 'bangs mtha' dag la phan pa dang bde ba chen po —287

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kye'abyung ba'i tshul nyams su bstar bas 'phral yun kun du legs tshogs kyi dngos po zad mi shes par 'byung ba yid ngor rtag tu 'char bar 'tshal zhing / rgyal blon mtha' dag sku tshe chab srid 'phel ba'i smon gnas kyang yun du bgyid pa yin zhes rten sngags mdud/ byin rlabs rten grangs med pa 'dus pa'i ril bu/ spos shel/ snam bu le tshan dang bcas/ chu shel gyi dbang po dbyu gus nya ba'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la dpal ri bo gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal yas khang nas bris/(37na)bsam yas su sde brgyad kun gyi yab rje gnod sbyin rtse'u dmar po'i rdo rje'i gsung gi lan spyan gzigs kyi rta pho dang bcas myur mgyogs su skyel tshul/ 'dod don du gsol ba mi phyed dam tshig ni mdud rgya/ grangs med dus ga sdo/ma rgyal ba'i 'khor lo'i gsang ba gsum gyi chu gter las/ /cir yang sprul pa'i gar gyis rnam rol pad+ma las 'khrungs rta ljang can/ /bsil ldan mkha' slong yangs pa'i khyon 'dir thugs rje'i 'od zer rab 'bar ba/ /mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje gang des lus can kun la bka' drin stsol/ /gang des mchod bstod dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /legs bcug gtsug lag skyong ba'i srung ma mchog /'jig rten dregs pa kun gyi dbang phyug che'i/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i tshig gi 'phreng ba son/ /dbus 'gyur nye 'dabs nas bzung mi phyed pa'i/ /dam tshig nye ldan rigs son bdag cag la/ /blang dor gtam dang mthun rkyen 'phrin las kun/ /thogs med sgrub pa'i tshul 'dir spro ba 'phel/ /log 'dren dgra sde 'joms la thogs med pa'i/ /spyan gzigs dri bzhon shugs la 'gran pa'i rta/ /sprul pa'i gnas der skyel ba'i bya ma rta/ /'gyangs med brtson pas sgrub par byed pa lags/ /ca ṇa'i gan mdzod las 'ongs thags kyi dar/ /sa 'dzin dkar po bzhu 'drar legs smon pa'i/ /'dod don bsams pa'i 'dod rgu yid bzhin nor/ /yid kyi za ma tog kun 'gengs par mdzod/ /bsam yas su srog bdag chen po gnod sbyin rtse'u dmar po la spyan gzigs dang bcas 'dod don du gsol ba las bzhi lhun grub/ phun tshogs yid bzhin rab tu 'khyil ba'i au ḍi ya na'i rgya mtsho las/ /dri med chu skyes 'dab stong rnam par ba 'ad pa'i ke sa (37ba)ra yi rtser/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mi zad gsang mdzod gcig bsdus pad+ma —288

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dza)saṃ bha was/ /srid 'dir dge ba'i dngos po bla na med pa stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ /grub pa'i slob dpon chen po mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rjes 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi dkyil 'khor du bcug cing dbang bskur/ dam tshig nye bar bsgrags/ mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gis thog drangs pa'i bod yul rten gnas yongs kyi srung mar mnga' gsol ba'i gnod sbyin rgyal po chen po gang gi spyan sngar dgyes rgur spyod pa'i spyan gzigs kyi bdog pa khra gsal ltar phul bas sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan po nye bar dgongs la bcol ba'i las rnams sgrub par mdzod/ 'jig rten lha srin dregs pa kun gyi gtso/ /zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mthu rtsal can/ /dpal ldan gnod sbyin chen po 'khor bcas kyis/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srungs bod khams phan bde spel/ /deng 'dir yid la smon pa'i 'dod pa'i don/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i sbyor ba kun/ /thogs pa med par sgrub pa'i las mdzod cig /dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas mi bsrun pa/ /bsam sbyor log par 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs kyi/ 'i zhus pa mthu cho mes sbyor ba'i stabs kun shig /tshe srog sdus la sha khrag zhal du gsol/ /pad+ma ka ra'i dam tshig gnyan po dang / /rigs dang tshe rabasadu mar bsnyen mchod pa/ /nye bar dgongs la mthun rkyen dngos grub kun/ /'bad rtsol med par rang gis grub par mdzod/ /chu shel dbang po chu stod kyi/ /dga' mar chags pa'i rtse dga'i dus/ /dkar phyogs dpa' bo'i 'du ba'i tshe/ /gru 'dzin gzhal med khang nas dge /(38na〉ye rgan dka' bcu shes rab rgya mtsho 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i skabs springs pa'i 'phrin yig gi lan thengs gsos bdud rtsi'i za ma tog /tsa sa dra ku ma re ṇa na ka da ba re shrī 'i yu ba sla ra k+ṣa 〉 si ta tā rā/ man (sdeb sbyor dbus phra/)shel rdul brtsegs sgyu rtsal spyod/ /chu shel dbang po gzhen nu mas/ /'khyud pa'i lang tsho'i dpal ster ba'i/ /yid bzhin 'khor los khyod la srungs/ /blo gros chu gter chen po las/ /tshig rgyan brang 'gro'i chun po can/ /'phrin yig phur sgra sgrog bzhin du/ /gan dar nor bu'i gtsug phud kyi/ /'od gzi 'bar ba'i zlos gar de/ /snyim pa'i ba gam gzhal med na/ /'dren byed rin cen ngos —289

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyeshar tshe/ /yid kyi ha nu (38ba tshe pas 'jam/ /e ma legs byas bi shwa /'a yi/ /sor mo'i 'phrul lasathon pa'i mngon mtho'i rten/ khres rab rtsal gyis bi dza ra yi 'phra/ /byang grol 'gram par sbud la spro ba 'phel/ /srid 'di'i skye ba spel ba'i nags klung dbus/ /dal 'byor yal 'dab g.yur za'i yongs 'du'i ljon/ /phan bde'i dri bsung 'bum du 'dzag pa yi/ /dge ba'i rlung shugs ring du skyod pa dang / /'du ba'i 'phel zad 'khrugs pa'i lus kyi dgrar/ /bdud rtsi'i yang snying phyung ba'i zla shel thigs/ /drang srong mkhas dbang rig byed za ma tog /gzhan yang lhod bral sten cig dpyod ldan kye/ /byu ru'i nor 'dzin lho phyogs rgod ma khas/ /lan brgyar bzhu ba'i mdangs la 'khu ba yi/ /stong 'khrun dar gyi mdud pa rdo rje'i gzugs/ /rtags kyi lang tsho bkra bar li khi ti/ /bod yul gyi paṇ+ḍita smon 'gro nas tshe dbang don grub gyi 'phrin lan rig gnas mi mjed zhing gi mtha' 'jal/ sa ba mṛ āti shā da : ba ṇ+ḍi ta sto da lha ba ra de wa44 shu ru ba tu ya t+ta smi de si dhi :ya :kṛ tho/ /phul (dzā rta'i sdeb sbyor 'pha gsam/bang tshe yi zil dngar kun/ /ster mkhas lhag pa'i lha mchog gis/ /mang du thos pa'i dpal gang der/ /'chi med dngos grub stsol cig kye/ /(39na sgom bkra bdud rtsir byed pa'i ri mo gang / /dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i snyan 'gyur 'bum 'khyil bar/ /tshig don rgyud mang stong gi glur 'brol ba'i/ /grangs med rig pa'i zlos gar ci yang rtsen/ /mkhas mang bye ba'i yon tan 'bum kyi cha/ /gang ba'i gzugs phung nyer 'tshe'i chu 'dzin las/ /rab rgyal legs bshad 'od dkar 'gyed pa yi/ /snyan grags phyogs bral kun+da sa 'dzum zhing gleng / /gnam lo'i bzhin ras ngom pa kun dga'i dpyid/ /ba po shis dbyangs su 'tsher ba'i pu sta gas/ /lcang lo'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'i dpa' bo'i zhabs/ /mchis zhes nyi zla blta phyir mkha' la rgyu/ /sde bzhi'i gtsug lag 'byed pa'i zhal gyi sgo/ /'jig rten mes por co 'dri'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /rig gnas mi mdzes zhing gi pha mtha' yang / /'jal ba'i dka' ba med 'di su yis bskrun/ shes bya kun du rig pa nor bu'i gdugs/ /rnam dpyod rin cen yu bas bteg pa'i dpya/ /srid pa'i rtse mor 'khor tshe lhun po yis/ /nyi zla'i sgron me bteg nas lta ba bzhin/ /—290

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pos mos 'joms shing pad+ma'i gnyen min pa'i/ /rmongs mun pha mthar sgrod pa snang ba'i gter/ /brtan g.yo'i chos kyi rang bzhin kun 'dzum pa/ /sngon med rta ljang dbang po'i byed po su/ /rig gnas rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i legs bshad nor/ /tshig don phreng bar brgyus te 'dzin pa la/ /dpe zlar dbyangs can lha mo 'os so zhes/ /phyogs kyi sgeg mos gleng ba'i mkhas khyod kyi/ /dpyad gsum dag pa'i legs bshad yid bzhin nor/ kho bo'i rnam dpyod rgyal mtshan rtser bkod pa'i/ /nyams 'gyur 'dod rgu'i gter gyur glegs bam 'di/ /'khrul pa'i dri bral 'dren byed gzigs mor dngar/ /lho phyogs bsir bus drangs pa'i dri bsung ltar/ /ngoms med (39bcungs su spyod pa'i bde chen dpal/ /'phrin yig dbyangs snyan 'khrol ba'i lus dkar can/ /rig byed rdzing bur ngal med rgyu bar 'tshal/ /gtsug lag bye ba'i 'od zer stong 'phro zhing / /rgyal bstan chu skyes ba 'ad pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ /gangs can nyin mor byed pa'i paṇa chen khyod/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung lta bur brtan gyur cig /snyan 'gyur lus kyi lang tsho rab dar ba'i/ /'dog pa'i sgro gshog rnam par bkra ba can/ /'phrin yig mdongs mtha' rig gnas 'brug gi sgra /sgrog pa'i dbyar gyi dga' ston che der 'phur/ /smon 'gro paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje 'khor ba spyi bye brag gi ngang tshul la nges par 'byung ba'i skyo shas dang 'brel ba'i snyan tshig gi lan yid kyi ngal gso/ ma ji sgo ṣa ka mā ra ༈ ya ti shwa ra ra nā sa dha/ /bha ṣi khyi ba dzu yin su ka ba la kha :bu sta ka /'jam (kha sgo phan pa/kho byangs ga'o zhe nu'i mkhyen pa gang / /dbang phyug rgyal por grub pa yi/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i rdo rje'i sde'i/ /snyan ngag 'phrin yig pu sta ka /(40na)snying por spyad na mngar ba'i bdud rtsi 'bum/ /ci yang 'dzag pa'i rnam bkra'i gshog rlabs can/ /nyams dang 'gyur ba'i gtsug phud ldem bzhin du/ /snyim pa'i dbyig 'dzin do rar gar gyis rtsen/ /legs byas 'bum phrag rgyun 'bab chu gter las/ /'ongs pa'i nye bar len pa 'od dkar can/ /nyes brgya'i sgra gcan rgyu lam rgyang bsrings te/ /sde bzhi'i bsil zer spro ba thos 'dzin bcud/ /rig gnas rgya mtsho las 'ongs legs bshad kyi/ /mi 'dzad yid bzhin nor la spyod pa'i tshul/ /ngo mtshar gtam —29/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyegyi dbyar rnga bsgrags pa na/ /yid kyi mdongs mtha' dga' ba'i gar gyis brel/ /e raṇ+ḍa ra mtshungs mtha' med 'khor ba'i mkhar/ /las 'bras glog gi bu mo gar mkhan ma/ /bde sdug snang dang mun par 'char ba'i sgo /'brul ba'i dbyar gyi dpal mo'i rang mtshang ngom/ /grang reg ba mos bcil ba'i dgun dus kyi/ /mi brtan rnam par 'gyur ba'i sgyu ma'i dper/ /sos kyi lang tsho thom na bzang ngan kun/ /gcig tu rtag par 'dzin pa 'khrul pa'i blo/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i 'phrul gyis legs pa'i lam/ /bdud rtsi'i dngos po lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal/ /blo ldan gser mngal can khyod lugs zung gi /snang ba gser gyi rtsibs stong 'od du 'bar/ /sri zhur bskrun pa'i yul mchog sems kyi sna/ /bde bar 'khrid la blo chen tshangs pa ltar/ /gang yang mngon mi yangs pa'i dkyil chen pos/ /'jal byed tshad mas ngal ba'i gnas su mdzod/ /rab yangs shing gi ma ma'i nor 'dzin ngos/ /a 'dus ka phreng ldan pa'i nags klung nas/ /tshig don dri bsung g.yo ba'i tsan dan ljon/ /bsil ldan bde ba'i rang bzhin spel bar rigs/ /'dren byed ra yig gnyis pa'i spyod yul can/ /(40ba)bdog pa'i pad dkar gzhen nu g.yur za ba/ /mi 'gyur rtags kyi ze'u 'bru ldem pa gang / /dpyod ldan 'chi med rna ba'i rgyan du mdzes/ /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa byi sogs la bris pa'i chab 3|ga 'phrin yig khag /sa byi gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dus pho brang chen po sne'u gdong rtse nas zhabs drung rin po che lha gzigs mi pham bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rnam rgyal dpal bzang pos legs skyes dang bcas pa'i chab shog gi lan dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i pi wang / / srid zhi'i 'khor lo'i ri mo bkra ba'i zhabs/ /grangs med 'jig rten gsum gyi ral pa'i rtser/ /'god mdzad dpal ldan phag mo gru pa zhes/ /nor 'dzin khyon kun rnam par skyong de'i drung / /'jigs med 292
