rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pogasang ba gsum gyi cha shas kun/ /yongs su gang ba'i mtshan dpe'i 'od dkar 'bum/ /chos srid kun+da khong nas ba 'ad pa'i gnyen/ /ngo mtshar bye ba'i 'dzum rlabs g.yo ba nas/ /legs byas rdzogs ldan rang zhal cher ngom pa'i/ /kun 'dzin gnam lor grub pa'i rin cen snod/ /phan dang bde ba'i bdud rtsi rab 'khyil ba/ /phun tshogs thog mar dge ba'i rten 'byung du/ /bka' tham lang tsho dar ba'i smin legs ma/ /snyan 'gyur 'bum gyi gdub bsil 'brol ba can/ /bdog pa'i skyes kyi gos bzang g.yo bzhin du/ /snyim pa'i do ra dga' ba'i gar gyis rtsen/ /'di na gsung rab mang por brgal brtag kyi/ /rigs pas dpyad bzod sdom rtson klog pa mkhan/ /rnam g.yeng rlung gi shing rtas mkhar drangs kyang / /thos bsam sgom pa'i pad dkar ba 'ad 'dun tsam/ /byang chub mchog brnyes dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag /mi yi srid pa'i gar gyis rnam rol ba'i/ /sde bzhi'i rgyal mtshan mthon por sgreng ba'i tog /'od stong sum rtsen gnas las brgal te 'bar/ /nor 'dzin bu mo 'dod 'khro'i mngal khur gyis/ /(41na snya bar dud pa'i sa skyong thams cad mkhyen/ /gser pa lo tsā ra grags pa'i lugs zung gi /rnam dpyod 'di kos phur bu'i brtan pa phrogs/ /sgrub brgyud 'chi ba med pa'i lam yangs por/ /bshad pa'i chu 'dzin lang long g.yo ba'i dbus/ /gsang chen theg mchog dbyar rnga dgod pa yi/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i pi wang gcig tu snyan/ /e ma med byung nor bu'i yu ba yis/ /nye bar bteg pa'i chos nor 'dod pa'i gdugs/ /srid pa'i rtse mor 'khor ba'i byed po mā /lha khyod 'jig rten mes pos bskos par nges/ /sbom zhing ches ring tsher can rkang 'thung 'phreng / /nags klung 'dzin ma'i khyod kun khengs na yang / /ma smad mngar ba'i dri bsung 'thul ba de/ /tsan dan ljon pa min pa gzhan gyis ci/ /mtshudas pa med pa mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong gis/ /skye rgu kun la dga' bde'i snang ba'i gter/ /mchod sbyin sgo brgya 'byed pa'i sa dbang khyod/ /'gyur med seng ge'i khri la brtan gyur cig /brjod don man+ta ra yi 'phreng ba mchog /spel legs chab shog srad bur legs brgyus te/ /drang srong dza sna'i bu mor 'khu bzhin du/ /nam yang bsgyur ba med par mnyes gshin zhu/ /spyan ras 'khor lo'i yan lag rgyu ba'i rten/ /'o mtsho thags su 'khyil ba'i —293

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)rdzing bu la/ /ut+pal dmar po'i rgya yis legs spras te/ /dmar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la phul/ /dga' ldan khri rin po che chos rje byams pa rgya mtsho'i sprul pa'i sku'i yang sprul khar kha ta'i ching ka than bā dur gyi rigs su byung ba'i 'phrin lan dmar cha'i sngo bsangs drang thig /(41ba)ma ñjanā/ ma ya mā ni ti pra dzā rwa ya tsa ki la sha /su〉 ki rti la sti ka ra sa rla sta ཿ lha ka r+ya tsa/ /'jam (kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor/)mgon sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /bsil ldan skye rgu'i don gyi ched/ /sgyur mdzad blo bzang grags pa yis/ /dam pa gang der dge bar mdzod/ /legs byas bya ba'i chu gter las 'ongs pa'i/ /gsang gsum snang ba'i dpal ster chu shel dbang / /rnam dkar 'phrin las yangs pa'i 'od dkar gyis/ /phan bde'i kun+da ches cher ba yid pa'i gtam/ /'phrin yig rten gyi 'khor lo'i yan lag can/ /snyim pa'i rab dkar 'o mtsho'i rdzing bu na/ /zlos gar sgyur ba'i brjod don snyan pa'i glus/ /rgyud mang stong gi sgra de ngal bar byas/ /rgyal kun rang bzhin gcig tu grub pa'i khams/ /thun 'tshams lang tsho lhan cig 'dres pa'i gzugs/ /bshes gnyen dam par snang bar btsong (42na kho pa'i/ /dri med ring lugs nor bur spungs pa'i dpya/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las mchog gi shing rta yis/ /gnam bskos hor gyi nor 'dzin yangs pa'i sar/ /'dren mkhas 'jig rten dbang phyug bsod nams kyi/ /zhid mchog rgya mtsho'i gos can kun khyab pa'i/ /rnam par sprul pas sde bzhi'i yon tan kun/ /phung po rgya mtsho'i tshad kyis gzhal dka' bas/ /gangs can phan bde'i mgron kun 'gugs byed pa'i/ /ngo mtshar 'phrin las thog ma'i sgo 'phar du/ /chu lha'i bu mos bteg pa'i phang ba na/ /mchog dman bar pa'i gdul bya grangs med kyi/ /'dren par dbang bskur mi pham mgon gnyis pa'i/ /snang ba dam pa'i ngo mtshar lhun grub dpal/ /lung rtogs yon tan 'od dkar nyer rgyas kyang / /na chod zla ba tshes pa sprul pa'i gar/ /rgya hor bstan 'gro'i kun gsal 'gram pa la/ /rlabs chen smon lam shing rtas drangs par nges/ /blo bzang grags snyan 'bar ba'i ring lugs mchog /mkhyen brtse byams pa'i snying stobs kyis 'degs pa/ /dbang phyug brgyad mnga' phyag na pad+ma yi/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i pha mthar spel ba'i sde/ /grangs med lung rtogs rnam bkra'i ri mo gang / /mngal —294

rgya bod tor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pegyi ra ri cung zad grags pa dag /thos bsam byi dor tshul gyis legs zungs pas/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i 'dren byed dga' ston rigs/ /mang thos mkhas pa'i gru gzings la brten nas/ /rgyal sras spyod pa'i chu gter rab brgal te/ /don gnyis yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po che/ /dam pa'i cod pan rgyan du 'ching bar mdzod/ /mtho btsun 'chi med dga' tshal las 'ongs shing / /rje btsun yongs 'du'i 'khri shing g.yur za ba/ /rnam (42bdakar spyod yul dri bsung spro ba khyod/ /'jigs med rdo rje'i spo la brtan gyur cig /kun dga'i rang bzhin 'dzum pa'i mchu sgros las/ /snyan gyur gleng bar 'os pa'i gtam gyi phreng / /skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun la 'gran bzod pa/ /rta ljang bgrod pa'i rjes su 'jug par 'tshal/ /ri mo pad dkar chun po rgyas pa'i rtser/ /rten gyi ze'u 'bru ri dwags mig can la/ /thun 'tshams rgya yi lang tsho'i stod g.yogs kyi/ /lhab lhub rnam par mdzes pas rab spras te/ /rgyal ba'i bkod pa rgya mtsho'i ngo mtshar gyi/ /rta chen zla bar grags pa'i phyogs snga ma'i/ /dga' ba'i tshes la bod yul rdo rje gdan/ /lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang nas bris/ /phug pa dpal seng ba'i skye ba bzang yul grong gsar du byung ba ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos grwa sdings po che nas snyan ngag gi 'phrin yig phul lugs ri'u mig rgya mtsho'i glegs bam gyi le tshan 'ga' zhig dang bcas bsrings pa'i lan skyon bon ma 'dres 'char ba'i me long /di lha rā ti shā na sa bhā wa :sha snya tsa kra ba sa ma bha sa ཿ dzi nub twa nā ra bsu lnga shrī mā dhi ri no shu bha sku/ /(43na)srid (dza ti'i sdeb sbyor 'phags ma/)dang gzugs can shis brjod/ zhi ba'i 'chi med lam yangs par/ /phul byung tshogs gnyis 'khor lo rab rdzogs pa/ /rgyal kun rang gzugs mi yi srid pa can/ /dpal ldan phag mo gru pas dge ba mdzod/ /mtha' mtha' dag gzugs can/klas legs byas zla ba'i ma ma las/ /nye bar len pa'i chu shel dbang po'i gzugs/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'od dkar legs spro bzhin/ grub rigs lha lam ngos su rgyu ba nas/ /'phrin ldan pa'i gzugs༅ la te nga nge 'dzin gyis bas pa/ yig ut+pal dkar po'i 'dab ma stong / /snyan tshig nyams dang 'gyur ba'i 'dzum phreng dbus/ /rtsis ris glegs bu'i ze'u 'bru gzhen nu la/ /rtags kyi bung bas lkod pa sug —295

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)par son/ /sgrub gzugs can dang ting nge 'dzin chos can 'gog pa gsum 'dres pa'i rab spel/ brgyud nor 'dzin bu mo'i mngal khur las/ /grangs med rgyal ba'i 'khri shing g.yur za na/ /kun mkhyen ye shes 'thob gnas 'og min zhes/ /gzhud lugs mang por grags pa gtam du zad/ /thos lho phyogs be+e da lha lugs kyi rab dngas kyi rgyan/ nyung sgom par khas 'che rgan po'i tshul/ /ring spangs ngag gi dbang po nyer grub pa/ /mang thos nor bu'i con pan 'chang ba de'i/ /ring lugs 'dzin pa'i grags snyan rna bar 'jebs/ khyud mtha' dag gzugs can/ don ma la yar skyes ljon pa las/ /'khrul med phra 'i kha rigs pa mngar ba'i dri/ /legs bshad bsil bur ring nas 'gugs byed pa'i/ /lhun grub rgya mtsho'i lugs 'dzin 'di med byung / /nges ra pa rtog gi gas tshig /par legs pa'i mig mi 'dzum pa'i snying / /tshul chos mchu yis thal mar 'bigs byed pa/ /chu skyar rgan po'i ting 'dzin g.yo med can/ /dpyod (43badzin khyod kyi 'dren byed kyis mthong ngam/ /brgal ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ brtag dpyad kyis nyes brgya'i tshad nad kun/ /zhi byed lung dang rigs pa'i ga bur thigs/ /phyogs der sngon med len pa'i shing rta ba/ /mkhas kun mkhyen ngag dbang snor bu/ dbang gang de'i lugs 'dzin khyod du nges/ /legs gzugs can phung byung / sbyar dzasbu'i gser sbyangs kāṇ+ḍa gar/ /phyi nang rig gnas rin cen phra tshom can/ /gang gi rna bar spud tshe lha'i bla ma/ /skabs gsum slob dpon thol rgyas mkha' la bros/ /lkog phul byung rab rtog khu/ra gzugs kun gtsug lag me long du/ /rjen par 'char byed gsang tshig khyod kyis blos/ /rang gir byas tshig gtsug na zla ba yang / /ting 'dzin zol gyis gangs ri'i phag tu yib/ /gang mdzes pa'i rgyan shar phyogs go ḍa pa la grags pa/ gi thos bsam sgom pa'i grags snyan nor/ /'phyur bu spungs pa ma lus shong ba'i snod/ /bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'di ches yangs par/ /byed po tshangs pa yin par da gdod khums/ /'di cha shas gzugs can/ na za hor gdung 'dzin rig byed pa/ /chos srid rin cen brtsegs pa'i ba gam dbus/ /blo gros rgyud kyis gnas lnga rig pa'i gzhu/ /'gugs par brtson pa'i bsam pa mi dman tsam/ /rigs mthun sprin gzugs can gyi don gzhan bkod pa/ la rmongs pa'i gdongs mtha' can/ /dga' yang thub bstan nyi 'od mi gsal bas/ /—296

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pongag dbang nor bu'i rnam thar 'dab brgya'i kha/ /zum pa slar yang khyod kyis 'byed par rigs/ /dbang phyogs smin ldan pa'i gzugs can/ legs sor rtse'i kun gsal ngos/ /thags kyi dra bar grub pa'i dbang po'i gzhu/ /sngon med ri mo bkra ba'i chu 'dzin bcas/ /thun 'tshams rgya yi lus phras dam du 'khyud/ /mgrin rang bsto brjod pa/ sngon gtsug lag dmar phyogs kyi/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal mo i 'char tshe/ gtsug lag sgo 'phar legs phye ba/ /(44na〉dga' ldan pho brang rtse nas bris/ /'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan pa'i skye bar grags pa jo nang sprul sku kun dga' snying po'i yang srid khar kha thu she ye thu rgyal po'i bur byung ba la springs pa rdo rje rna bar 'thul ba'i ma la ya'i dri/ /bu skyu sa su lha lha kyo swā ga ri kā sdu gurla ti/ /kā dha ra smi tsa she ba rla bu ṣ+ṭi la spu gro/ /stobs (sde pa sbyor kha sgo phan pa/)bcu mnga' ba'i chu gter las/ /blo bzang bcu gnyis bdag po'i dpal/ /grags pa'i 'od zer 'bum phrag gis/ khyod blo'i pad+ma rgyas par mdzod/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i lang tsho dar ba'i dpyid/ /zur phud lnga pa mi yi srid pa tsam/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon du gnyis skyes kyi/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs 'degs pa'i khur ldan shes rab kyis/ /'jam da byangs ga' na nus 'gran bzod chos(44ba)rnams kyi/ /rje bo'i them skas 'dzeg pa'i thos bsam sgom/ /bkra shis dpal gyi g.yung drung rgyan ldan 'khyil/ /da lta'i ngang tshul phra mo'i na tshod kyi/ /skye bo'i zlos gar gsar pa'i chu shel dbang / /tshe ring gnam bskos rigs kyi lha lam ngos/ shar ba'i ngang tshul 'di las gzhan du ci/ /rab 'byams chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' yas mdud/ /cig car 'grol bar rgyal ba'i gsung rab mchog /'jug pa'i rim pa ji bzhin zhabrul bral gyi/ /tshul 'dir ring du ngal ba'i khur sten gces/ /ring nas sbyangs pa'i thos pa'i lcags khyo yis/ /mdo rgyud ri dwags mig can rab 'gugs pa'i/ /slob bu yongs su 'dzin mkhas bsod nams kyi/ /grags pa'i dpal 'bar de yang ring du sten/ /slar yang gtam gyi mes po'i thod yangs las/ /brjod par 'os pa dza hu'i bu mo'i rgyun/ /byed po skal ldan shing rta'i bya ma rta/ /bshul du 'dod la bskyud pa med par gyis/ /de skad 'phrin yig gan+dhar bha/ /snyan tshig rgyud mang snyim pa yis/ /—297

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyethogs te mi phyed rdo rje'i rgyan/ /rnam bkra'i rgya yis mdzes bzhin du/ /rin cen mar gad las bskrun pa'i/ /yal ga'i ri dwags dbang sgyur tshe/ /gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i ga 'kha med che/ /dga' ldan pho brang nas bris dge /bla ma lha rtse ba ngag dbang bzang po skye ba grong mo che ba'i bur byung ba ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub kyi ba so'i kha ṭaṃ ga chung ngu'i rten dang ma cas pa'i 'phrin las med dbang por co dri/ /(45na〉nye mā sgro dha sma la : shā kya gya sa ya ratho ma hā/ sa rta dzi ya dza le ni rte sni 'i na ma tshu ra dza ba dz+ra shu PROB PROB /dpal (dza ti'i sdeb sbyor 'phags ma/) ldan sgrub rgyud shing rta chen po gang / /zas gtsang sras po'i bstan pa'i nor 'dzin la/ /'dren mdzad rgyal kun sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /rdo rje rgyal pos dus rnams dge bar mdzod/ /mtha' bral legs byas zla ba'i ma ma las/ /rab thon nye bar len pa'i chu shel dbang / /nyes brgya nam mkha'i glang po las brgal te/ /nges don kun+da ba 'ad la 'gog med nas/ /dkar 'jam ljon shing ma ma'i gser ldan lhor/ /sor mo'i zlos gar sgyur ba'i snyan tshig glu/ /dbyangs can 'phang 'gro'i rgyud las drangs min na/ /sngon chad dpyod ldan rna bar 'jibs la mtshar/ /'chi med bzo bo'i 'phrul gyis ma bsgrubs shing / /'dren byed sgyu ma'i rtsal gyis bslad min pa'i/ /ngo mtshar snang brnyan lang tsho dar bab pa/ /stong 'khun dar bcas rgya yis (45ba yis pa 'byor/ /rgan po'i blo 'chang gzhen nu'i byed po yis/ /rmongs chen tshogs bdag mche ba phyung ba'i tshe/ /gzhud brgya'i tshig don bkra ba'i mdongs mtha' la/ /brten nas mkhas mang legs bris gral na mdzes/ /thos don zhib mor dpyod la lta ba'i mig /mkha' stong phyogs ldan bsam pa'i sa srung ste/ /rnam par 'gying khyod grags pa'i mu khyud pa/ /'gran ched co 'drir bgyid snyam 'phyang mo nyug /rtag chad khung bur 'brul sgom 'khyil ba'i nyams/ /bde bar rlom pa'i log pa'i 'bras bu lci/ rkyong min phag gru'i dgongs don lta ba'i gzugs/ /yid kyi bzhin snod 'char 'di med du byung / /mu mtha' yongs bral bgyid pos gtam gyi rgyun/ /dpyad gsum rnam par dag pa'i rnyog bral klung / /'phrin yig yangs pa'i lam du 'gog med par/ /rgyu ba'i tshul la bskyud pa med par 'tshal /—298

rgya bod tor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pedabang phyogs yul gru'i lus phra'i snyim pa yis/ /thags kyi dra bar bskrun pa'i 'od dkar can/ /ri mo'i snang brnyan mdzes pa'i sgyu rtsal spyod/ /thun 'tshams brgya yi sgeg mos legs 'khyud de/ /yal ga'i ri dwags mar gad gsar pa'i gos/ /rab klubs nyin byed sdig pa'i khyim spyod pa'i/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi i yig 'char ba'i tshes/ /gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang nas bris/ /pho brang gong ri dkar po nas bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos shing bya lo gsar phul ba'i lan srid zhi'i phun tshogs char 'theb pa/mchog tu dge ba'i dus (46na)kyi char yang bzhi ldan 'byung ba'i gnam lo gsar pa'i dga' ston gyi dpal mo rnam par bzhad pa'i gus ston gyi rtse dga' khong nas dgod pa'i skabs 'dir/ sa chen po la mnga' bsgyur ba'i bka' khrims kyi dbu rmog btsan po 'jigs pa med pa'i 'od kyis phyogs kyi snang ba ches cher rgyas shing legs byas rgya mtsho'i ma ma las 'ongs pa'i nye bar len pa rab tu brtan cing /'phrog byed kyi khrir 'gyur med g.yung drung gi rang bzhin du g.yo ba med pa'i gtam rna bar son pas/dza yas zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis sngun bsus te/ sgrib gnyis mun pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal zhing / /ye shes mchog gi 'od rnon 'bar ba can/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal ldan yongs kyis gser ldan ma/ /skyong khyod rtag tu dge ba'i dngos po stsol/ /gser mngal can dang mgrin sngon pad dkar mig /mig stong can sogs kun gyis khyod nyid la/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi'i ma smad 'byor ba'i dpyid/ /'dod rgu'i char du bsnyil ba'i dpal gyur cig /gang gi bsod nams las grub su waṇi'i/ /yol gor phyur bur spungs pa'i chos srid nor/ /skye rgu'i re ba stong ba'i dbang gi rgyal/ /phan bde'i sman yon ched du 'bar gyur cig /bsam blo rab stims pa shes ra po nyi ma'i 'phrin lan mun pa'i mda' 'phen/(46ba) sa dzo dza 'i dz+nyā ཿpā nirti su ma ti ༈ da r+sha tsa/ /bha 'u ta ki rti 4 rte mi : ru du sa ra k+ṣa rta/ rgyal (dza ti'i sdeb sbyor 'phags ma/sko/na mkhyen pa'i gzugs brnyan gar/ /blo gros bzang po'i ā dar+shar/ /sgyur ba'i grags pa srid 'di'i rnar/ /mdzes par byed des khyod la srungs/ /legs byas sa bon gling nas smin pa'i 'bras/ /—299

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shemangon mtho'i rten gyi ma la yar skyes shing / /tshul khrims dri bsung spro ba'i gnyis skyes kyi/ /'phrin yig rten gyi bdog pa bsug par san/ /zla ga cho zhe kun+da smin legs bzhin mdangs kyis/ /cha tsam 'gran pa'i mthu bral lhag pa'i sems/ /ris bral 'gro la dkar ba'i bsil zer gyis/ /yid srubs mun pa'i sde dpung cis mi 'joms/ /nges 'byung khrims kyi brtse dzi wa ka /cod pan rgyan gyur rnam 'dren 'chi med gtso'i/ /rjes zhugs blo ldan nye dbang bstan pa gang / /bzung tshe (47na tshe legs byas dga' ston tshogs rnams 'phel/ /dung dung 'gro la brtse ba'i snying rje dang / /lci lci gzhan phan khur 'khyer byang chub sems/ /dka' dka'i stobs bcu'i go 'phang 'thob po'i ched/ /yang yang bsten pa 'di phyi'i don gyi dpyid/ /'dren pa mchog gyur mchog dman kun gyi lha/ /lha mi'i gtsug na gtsug gi rgyan ltar mdzes/ /mdzes brjid rgyal sras rgyal ba rnams kyi dpal/ /dpal ldan 'jam dbyangs 'jam ching dul ba'i gzugs/ /ma 'dris 'gro ba'i yid kyi lha lam du/ /rlung gi rgyan mtshan lta bur ston mkhas pa/ /kun mkhyen btsong kha pa yi ring lugs mchog /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i tshul gyis rgyas par gyis/ /du ba'i tog gi lhab lhub gos/ /gyon pa'i zad pa med pa yi/ /gsar tshes bgrang bya'i rta zla ba'i/ /i yig 'char ba'i tshes la bris/ /pho brang sne'u gdong rtse nas dpal ldan lha gzigs mi pham bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i chab shog gi lan skal bzang zlos gar rjod pa'i dbyangs/ rab 'byams rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i dga' tshal las lha rigs rlangs kyi yongs 'du gsar pa can/ /legs byas ro brgya'i dpal kun 'dzin mkhas pa/ /chos srid rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug rin po cher/ /snyan 'jibs bka' tham ri dwags mig can gzugs/ /don bzang drug skyes glu dbyangs cher 'khrol zhing / /bdog pa'i skyes kyi rna rgyan 'od gzir bcas/ /sug pa'i nor 'dzin ngos su zlos gar sgyur/ /gangs can skye rgu'i bsod nams shing rta yis/ /nyer drangs rlangs kyi yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /byang chub rgyal mtshan zhes grags phan bde'i dpyid/ /rigs chos srid kyi ma smad brgyud pa kun/ /(47ba)byams ldan mi pham bsod nams phung po las/ /dbang phyug yon —30()

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (potan brgyad kyis nyer mdzes pa'i/ /rab snyan grags pa rnam par rgyal ba'i rngas/ /dpal ldan phag gru'i lugs srol bzang por byas/ /sa chen byams pas nyer skyong grags pa kun/ /'byung gnas phyag bzhes nges gsang theg pa'i srol/ /gar thig dbyangs sogs bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i tshul/ /rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i ngo mtshar de med byung / /'phrin las lha tshogs dkyil 'khor rab bkra ba/ /'dren byed dga' bder spyod pa'i lang tsho'i mchog /'jigs rung khro bo'i gar gyi bdud sde'i dpung / /bcos pas pad dkar mig kyang 'dar snyam byed/ /chos srung rgya mtsho 'bod pa'i nga ro'i dbyangs/ /dbyar skyes sgra yi khengs pa ches cher 'phrog /sna tshogs rol mo'i skad kyis tam+bu ra'i/ /rgyud mang stong gi cha kun gcig tu bsdus/ /e ma sde bzhi ma lus spungs pa yi/ /dpal ldan mi dbang mchog gi rgyal khab cher/ /nor ldan skyong ba'i rlangs ston mi yi rje'i/ /mdzad bzang gtam gyis thos 'dzin dga' ston byas/ /za hor rigs las kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs 'dzin rlom sdom brtson klog pa mkhan/ /thos bsam sgom par cung zad gzhol ba dang / /mi dman lhag pa'i bsam pa dkar bar gnas/ /mtho btsun gdung dang dam pa'i ngang tshul kun/ /mdzad bzang sngar ltar nyams pa med pa nas/ /phebs tshogs skyes kyi yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /bka' tham lam gsum ngos su chad med 'tshal/ /rab dkar thags kyi zla gzhen can/ /ri dwags rgya yis mdzes bzhin du/ /dmar phyogs dga' ba dang po la/ /gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i rtse nas phul/gzhung lugs mang por thos pa'i dpyod ldan sku 'bum chos rje don grub rgya mtsho'i 'phrin lan blo gsal dbyar rnga/ (48na jibadu k+ṣa ya :me gha su bha ga ka ṇi ma dhu r+ya sa/ /ā ( ki ti dzi su/ rta ta dz+nyā ba ra shu :kṛ/ /blo (sdeb sbyor kha sgo phan pa/) gros mi zad dbyar kyi rnga/ /skal bzang rna bar legs snyan pa/ /grags pa kun mkhyen thub bstan dpyid/ /rgyal mchog de yis dge bar mdzod/ /don gnyis yid bzhin rin cen dbang gi rgyal/ /blo gros gzings las grub pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /gsung rab rgya mtshor bgrod pa'i blo ldan de'i/ /'phrin yig rten gyi bdog pa snyim par son/ /legs byas char gyis ring nas bskrun —301—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)pa yi/ /zag phung lang tsho rgyas pa'i pad+ma dkar/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsi g.yo ba'i dga' ston la/ /blo gsal bung ba lang long g.yo ba'i gtam/ /thos 'dzin rgyan gyi 'phreng bar dngar ba'i tshe/ /e ma rgyal ba'i tog gyur btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs phyogs der gsal phyir mkhas rnams kyi/ /rnam gsum bya ba'i tshul du da gdod (48bsko gums/ /kye ma deng dus rab smin 'bras bu'i khur/ /mi ldan lo 'dab phang phung tsam g.yo bar/ /dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing dang chabs gcig tu/ /bsgrigs pa'i tsher ma can gyi rkang 'thung mang / /dka' gnad rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdud pa kun/ /ji bzhin 'grol bar nus pa'i blo gros kyis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas blo bzang rgyal bstan la/ /bya ba byas par dngos cag lhag par rangs/ /'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs shing rta che/ /mang du thos pas 'dren pa'i spobs pa can/ /sdom brtson klog pa mkhan yang gzhud lugs rnams/ /brgal brtag rigs pa'i dpyad bzod skabs na mchis/ /rgyal po'i chos tshul mtha' klas nam mkha'i khyon/ /mkhyen pa'i tshad kyis 'jal la zla bral ba'i/ /kun mkhyen btsong kha pa de'i ring lugs la/ /sngar bzhin mkhas pa'i bya ba byed par rigs/ /snyan tshig yi ger grub pa'i chu shel dbang / /brjod don ri dwags mtshan ma rab bkra ba/ /rten gyi cha shas rdzogs pa'i mdzes sdug la/ /thun 'tshams rgya yis mi phyed dam du 'khyud/ /legs sbyar skad du ak+ṣa yar/ /'bod pa phyogs 'dir mi zad pa'i/ /gro zhun zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi/ /rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la bris/ /zung chu rong tshang 'dul ba slob da pon pa gong du 'gro ba'i tshe phul ba'i zhu yig phyogs las rnam par rgyal pa'i gtam/ med byung bsod nams chu gter chen po las/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'od zer stong ldan pa/ /stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i nyin byed dbang / /tshangs pa mi yi gzugs can mchog gi drung / /chos srid mdzad pa'i zla gzhen gsar pa yis/ /rdzogs ldan kun+da rab ba 'ad snyan pa'i rnga/ /yang yang thos 'dzin lam du son pa yis/ /mi phyed dang ba'i yid kyis mchod (49na 'di zhu/ /deng dus bsod nams rin cen bye ba yis/ /phung por spungs pa'i zong gis cher bsgrubs pas/ /'chi med bdag po'i lang tsho rgyas pa'i —3(/the

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pedapyid/ /'dren byed bdud rtsi'i dpal gyi mdzes brjid sku/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa'i ngo mtshar gyis/ /mnga' 'bangs skye bo'i dga' ba skyed pa dang / /nyi 'og rgyal phran grangs med khengs pa kun/ /cig car 'phrog pa'i skal bzang 'di med byung / /tshangs dbyangs mgrin par len pa'i gsung gi gdangs/ /rna ba'i yol gor za'ajo ba'i bdud rtsi'i dpyid/ /yid kyi kun dga' gsar du skyed pa 'dis/ /mtha' klas lus can tshogs kyi dbugs phyung snyam/ /bstan 'gro dge legs gser ldan dga' ma'i lcid/ /gyen du 'degs pa'i snying sto bos rus sbal khur/ /mtha' bral zab cing rtogs dka' mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /tshangs pa'i blo yi dpe zlar byas pa bzhin/ /'gro la rjes chags 'phags chen dam pa rnams/ /chos ldan rgyal por bsams bzhin srid bzung ba'i/ /gsang gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin phyogs kun las/ /rnam par rgyal 'dis yid kyi spro dga' 'phel/ /rgyal ba'i ring lugs shing rta rtsod dus kyi/ /'dam lasa'adren 'dod lhag pa'i bsam pa can/ /dngos cag gang gi bka' khrims gdugs dkar gyi/ /grib bsil dag la bde bar 'tsho nyid mchis/ /e ma kun la brtse ldan byams pa yis/ /'dzam gling rnams la bde ba'i ngal gso'i nor/ /'dod rgu'i char du bsnyel ba'i dga' ston la/ /me tog phal cher 'dzum zhing dgod pa 'dra/ /mi bsrun skye bo 'dul la rdo rje'i thog /'gro ba'i re 'dod skong la dpag bsam ljon/ /legs nyes rnam par dpyod la 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /'dzam gling skye bo'i gnyen du (49brdar 'dir grub/ /lha gcig gang gi sdebazhi'i yon tan kun/ /'phyur bur spungs pa shong ba'i yol go sa /'jig rten byed pos brgya phrag thabs mkhas kyis/ /yangs pa'i snod kyi khams 'di bskrun par nges 'jam mgon sa spyod sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /mngon par sgyur ba mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag /blang dor ma 'dres 'byed pa'i snyan dbang du/ /gtam gyi phreng ba'i dka' thub ngal ba'i rgyu/ /'on kyang dbyar dusasprin dkar lang long dbus/ /'brug sgra dal gyis sgrog pa'i sgra dbyangs la/ /rma bya dga' ba'i rtsed 'jor rol ba'i gar/ /lan brgyar sgyur la su zhig klan ka 'jug /lcags khams rtse yi 'dzam bu'i gser sbyangs su/ /bsgyur te mi zad longs spyod spel ba ltar/ /rgyal khrims dge bcur sgyur ba'i bka' —303

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyesrol gyis/ /rang g.yin phan bde'i rtsa ba bla na med/ /grangs med sems can legs pa'i lam dag la/ /sbyor phyir mtha' yas rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /stobs ldan rgyal por skye ba'i srid 'dzin pa'i/ /tshul 'di thugs kyi mdzod du gtams par rigs/ /bde legasa'abum phrag bsil zer 'byung ba'i mdzod/ /chos srid cha shas yongs su gang ba'i dpal/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gcig sa dbang 'od dkar can/ /bskal brgyar mi 'gyur zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /bsam yas gnod sbyin chen po'i rdo rje'i gsung gi lan sbub chol che legs sogs spyan gzigs dang bcas gsol ba sgra 'dzin dgyes rgur skyod pa'i skal bsang / mi 'gyur bde chen lha lam yangs pa las/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i chu 'dzin zlos gar can/ /phan dang bde ba'i gru char 'gro kun la/ /stsol mdzad pad+ma ka ras dngos grub stsol/ /gang des khrag 'thung pad+ma dbang (50na ye rna dang / /'jig rten dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug nas/ /gangs can rgyal bstan yongs kyi srung ma sa /legs bsgos sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po yi/ /dpal gyi ri mo gsum pa las 'ongs pa'i/ /rdo rje'i tshig gi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /sna tshogs ri mo'i 'phreng bar yongs 'char ba'i/ /bka' rtags lang tsho'i phyag rgya ma nyams 'byor/ /ca ṇa'i yul gru las 'ongs brjid pa'i sgra /mi zad 'dod 'jo thos 'dzan dgyes skyed dang / /ro brgya'i dpal ldan rkang 'thung phud ma gang / /stong 'khrun yul gyi bzo dbyibs nyams pa med/ /rab dkar chu shel dbang po zhun ma dag /thags su grub lta'i gan dar snyan shal la/ /thun 'tshams rnam par bdo ba'i gzhen nu mas/ /mi phyed rgya yis dam du legs bcings nas/ /bsil sbyin mkhan po dbyug pa'i dga' ma dang / /rtse dgar spyod pa'i dpa' bo'i dga' ston che/ /dpal ldan gnod sbyin spyan sngar 'bul bgyid na/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /pho brang chen po sne'u gdong rtse nas zhabs drung rin po che lha gzigs blo bzang mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nor 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po ri ga gi lha'i bka' tham lan mang thos bzung ba'i cod pan/ blo gros bzang po'i chu gter las 'ongs pa'i/ /mkhyen brtse'i nyin byed dbang phyug yon tan 'od/ /nor 'dzin kun la 'gyed pa'i chos kyi rgyal/ /ngag gi dpal gyur —3(/4

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('alha rigs dam pa'i drung / /ring min mchog tu dge ba'i dus kyi char/ /legs byas lang tsho dar ba'i yongs 'du'i sku/ /phul byung rnam dpyod yal 'dab g.yur za'i rtser/ /ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i 'bras bu rgyas pa nas/ /bka' tham chu 'dzin gsar pa'i (50bsgong la khur las/ /snyan tshig ri mor 'phos pa'i dbyar skyes rnga/ /bdog pa'i skyes kyi gru char g.yo bzhin du/ /thun mtshams phyag rgya'i mdangs dang lhan cig son/ /sngon rabs mdzad pa'i rnam thar dkar po'i gdugs/ /phul byung sdebazhi'i nor bu'i yu ba can/ /kun la phan bde'i grib bsil ster byed de/ /'dzin mkhas lha rigs rlangs ston khyod du nges/ /gsang bdag mi yi srid bzung byang rgyal dang / /sa skyong thams cad mkhyen pa grags 'byung gi /lugs grung mdzad pa'i rin cen mu ku ṭa/ /lha gcig cod pan rgyan du 'ching bar mdzod/ /dam pa'i yon tan cha shas yongs gang zhing / /legs byas 'od dkar grangs med spro mkhas pa/ /'chi med rigs kyi chu shel dbang po gang / /rin cen brtsegs pa'i khri la brtan gyur cig /ngag dbang lha mo'i mgrin pa las 'ongs pa'i/ /nyams dang 'gyur ba stong gi snyan tshig ltar/ /phebs tshogs gtam gyi sbyor ba ji snyed pa/ /dzaḥ yi bu mor co 'drir zhu/ /bsil sbyin mkhan po thags su grub pa la/ /'tshams sprin rtags kyis nye bar 'byud bzhin du/ /smin drug can gyi dmar phyogs gang ba la/ /gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang nas phul/ /btsun mo tshal du tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can spyan gzigs tshogs 'khor dang bcas te 'phrin du gsol ba lkog gyur nog ma drungs byed nor bu/ nyi gzhen dang 'dres shel dkar lhag phran can/ /sngon med mtshan dpes 'byud pa'i ri dwags mig /'jam dbyangs dgyes rgur spyod la sgeg mo'i gzugs/ /gser mngal sras kyi dus kun shis par mdzod/ /phul byung pad+ma'i rigs kyi mkha' dbyings las/ /grangs med sprul sku'i rnam rol (51na ljang can/ /dbyig 'dzin bsil ris bskor ba'i dga' tshal 'dir/ /theg mchog nges gsang pad dkar mngon rgyas tshe/ /mthu ldan stobs kyis dbang sgyur dge bsnyen che/ /mchod bstod 'jig rten dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /legs bcug phan bde'i rtsa lag rgyal ba'i bstan/ /srung zhing skyong bar gnyer gtad rnam bzhi'i las/ /bsil sbyin mkhan po mkha' la rtag rgyu zhing / /kun+da ba 'ad la 'gog pa —305

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyemed pa ltar/ /mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam tshig gnyen po yis/ /dus kun g.yel med sgrub las gzhan du ci/ /gang gis 'byung 'gyur mtha' dag rjen pa sa /ston pa'i tshul 'dir nges pa'i dad pa yin/ /cung zad pho nya'i ngag nas gsol ba la/ /'gyur med rdo rje'i gsang tshig lhug par stsol/ /sna tshogs phyi yi mchod pa mtshon pa'i slad/ /dbang phyogs khab las legs 'ongs rab dkar dar/ /ljon pa'i shing gi lo ma'i phur ma dang / /sra zhing brtan pa'i go cha dang bcas te/ /nyin mor byed pa'i dbang po smin legs ma'i/khyim du legs spyod khrums kyis nya ba'i zlar/ /'phrul snang gtsug lag khang bzang 'od zer gyis/ /legs bskyangs dga' ldan khang gsar nas bris dge /mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs la blo gros dang brtson 'grus gnyis ldan gi sgo nas 'chad rtsod mkhas pa'i bya bar rnam dpyod yangs pa'i bshes gnyen 'od kha bsam gling slob dpon bstan pa rgya mtsho la springs pa mkhas rnams spro ba skyed byed snying gi gdung sel/(51ba)su bya ti dzi sa rbo ma khyi la tsa khyu sa spyi ki ti pra sa ma bha kra ཿ rba dz+nyā pra ta su ratsa twa bī: ka ra spro ṭa khya sku /rgyal (dza ti'i sdeb sbyor 'phags ma/)ba rnams kyi gsang gsum dkyil 'khor kun/ /rab rdzogs blo bzang grags pa 'od dkar can/ khres bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/ khyod blo'i za ma tog du rgyas par mdzod/ /rnam 'dren bla na med pa'i bstan pa yi/ /gsung rab rgya mtshor bgrod par rnam dpyod gru/ /skyes thob shes rab ljon pa las grub pa/ /brgal brtag rdzas ldan mang thos sgra 'dzin der/ /'jigs med sra ba'i rdo rje'i rjes 'gro ba'i/ /legs byas dpyid kyis bskyangs pa'i lag len gyi/ /'khri shing myu gu lang tsho dar ba'i rtser/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'bras bus dud las ci/ /ring nas sa bon nyal 'gro phan pa'i grogs/ /du mas yun du bsrings las yal 'dab dang / /dri bsung mngar ba'i lag 'gro'i snying po rnams/ /tsher ma'i shing dang lhan cig bsgrigs pas nongs/ /(52na sgom dpyod pad+ma'i skud pa ltar phra zhing / /rgyal gsung log par smra ba'i sto 'gro'i lce/ /rab rkyong rmongs tshig phud sgra cher sgrog pas/ /bsil ldan gang ba'i 'dren byed kyis mthong ngam/ /sprin bral kun gsal ngos su skar phran gzugs/ /phra mo'i 'od snang mchis la sa mos dag /'dab brgya mngon —306

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pepar rgyas pa'i phang phung gis/ /re ba skong 'dod mig yul gyur tam ci/ /sbom zhing ring sogs ljon shing stong po'i rtsal/ /mngon par rdzogs pa'i rkang 'thung 'phreng ba rnams/ /bor te tsher ma can gyi lcug phran dag /khang bzang gdung 'degs byed ces smra thos sam/ /na tshod gsar pa'i dbyar skyes ga tho ne nu'i 'bras/ /rlan gsher thos pa'i dka' spyad kyis smin pa'i/ /mkhas mang mgo skyes 'dab ma ser po rnams/ /zang zing med ces blun pos rtsa ltar 'dor/ /tshe rabs snga phyi med pa'i 'gro ba dag /med phyir skye ba tsam la su zhig mtshar/ /mong rtul rigs mthun dbus na chen po'i gar/ /'gying ba yis kyang thub bstan ches cher nyams/ khyod kyi mang thos yon tan nor bu'i dpya/ /gzigs mor mtshar zhes skar tsho gos mkha' la rgyu/ /rnam dpyod 'od mdangs ma bzod nyin byed dbang / /rings par chu lha'i phyogs su bros sam snyam/ /na tshod yol kyang thos bsam la brtson pas/ /dpyod ldan mkhas rnams rjes su yi rang dang / blun po tshul 'chos yid kyi ā dar+shar/ /mi sdug gar de sgyur la brel gyi dogs/ /bu ram shing pa'i ring lugs dri med kyi/ /bla na mngon par mtho ba'i btsong kha pa/ /dam pa gang de'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /snying gi yol gor spungs shig blo ldan kye/ /dbang phyogs gnam bskos rgyal po'i gan mdzod las/ /'ongs pa'i rkang 'thung phur ma'i 'dab ma dag /blo ldan skyems su 'os phyir rtagasakyi rgya/ /'tshams sprin gsar pa'i lang tsho rnam par 'phros/ /dus 'khor ba'i dkar (52ba)phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa/ mun pa'i mun pa gsal ba chen po'i lang tsho/ yon tan gyi yi ge ar rnams 'char zhing / dbyangs 'char ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa/ dbyangs u/ gsal byed dzha/ 'dod yon dri 'char ba'i tshe dga' ldan pho brang nas bris/ /gong ma rgyal po hong de'i drung du o ba shi pā tha'i ji btang ba'i dus phul ba'i zhu yig 'khor los sbyar ba'i gtam snyan/ 〉 rāsto ga ti shu ga ṇa nā sa mu ཿ dzi ba tri ka: ādz+nyā shā kye 2 re ṇa she ya la tsā lha mi swā laha/ /phul (sdeb sbyor kha sgo phan pa/rdo grang yon tan chu gter las/ /don kun lhun grub bsil sbyin mkhan/ /kun mkhyen shākya'i dbang phyug gis/ /nor 'dzin skyong der dge legs stsol/ /(53na)blo gros —307

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)gdugs dkar gsar pa'i grib bsil la/ /bzang po'i legs byas ngal gsor bgyid pa'i gnas/ /grags snyan phyogs bral khyab pa'i rigs kyi bdag /rnam 'dren btsong kha pa yi ring lugs la/ /rnam dpyod gsar pas yongs bskrun dad pa'i dpyid/ /bsod nams dbyar gyi dpal mo ba 'ad pa'i mgron/ /'gugs mkhas rtsod pa'i dus kyi 'khor los sgyur/ /mi rje lha yi rgyal po dam pa'i drung / /stobs bcu'i rtsal ldan shākya'i ring lugs pa/ /'gro la mi dman lhag bsam ches dkar bas/ /bgyid 'os gtam gyi dri za'i pi wang rgyud/ /cung zad sgra 'dzin dbang po'i rgyan du zhu/ /'dzam gling lus phra'i phang bar bka' khrims kyi/ /'jigs med gser 'khor 'phags dang chabs gcig par/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i 'dod rgu char bsnyil zhes/ /thos pas dang ba'i yid kyi mngon par gsos/ /zhes bkra shis pa'i tshig gis sngun bsus te/ kun nas dge ba'i dus kyi tshe bsod nams 'bum phrag rnam par 'khyil ba'i 'o mtsho las rtsod pa'i dus su rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston ring nas 'gugs pa'i byed por gnam gyi mthongs nas dbang bskur ba'i chos ldan gyi rgyal po chen po nyid sku gsung thugs kyi nyin mor byed pa la nyes tshogs nam mkha'i glang po'i dris cha tsam du yang ma gos shing / dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan mtha' dag lhun gyis grub pa'i ngos/ gnam bskos kyi rgyal po 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khrir 'jigs bral rdo rje'i bgrod byed zung skyil mo krung bcas te yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi khyon thams cad bde ba nas bde bar skyong ngo zhes pa'i gtam rim par son pa rna ba'i bcud len du gyur/ kun mkhyen zas gtsang gi sras (53ba)po'i rjes su zhugs shing / gzhung lugs thos bsam gyi grwar gnas pa'i shākya'i btsun pa yang 'du ba snyoms shing / ris med pa'i lus can la lhag pa'i bsam pa dkar bar gnas/ 'tshams zhus/byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don du rjes chags kyi snying stobs can rnams sa chen po la dbang sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i srid pa bzung ste/ grangs med pa'i mnga' 'bangs dang bcas pa la dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas te mngon mtho nges legs su 'god par mdzad pas rgyal po chen po yang de dang ngang tshul mthun pa'i 'phags chen dam pa'i dbang phyug tu gor ma chag pas/ slu ba med pa'i mchog gsum dam —308

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (ṭ+wāṃpa la bla mar 'dzin cing / 'dren mchog nyi ma'i gnyen gyi lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po cher sri zhu/ mnga' 'bangs thams cad chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa dang rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing zung 'brel du lci ba'i mdzad pa bzang po la thugs kyi 'dun pa sngar ltar gtod pa dang / nye char o pa shi pā tha'i ji 'di pa drung du rdzong sta bgyis yod pas bde legs kyi dngos po rnam par spel ba'i phebs tshogs kyang chu klung skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun ltar zhu/ zhes rten le tshan dang bcas/ rgya nag pa'i dbyar chu shel gyi dbang po dbos nya ba'i mgrin sngon can gyi gtsug lag gi dkar phyogs/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo ba'i dmar phyogs kyi gang ba dang po drang srong zla skyes lha mtshams smin legs ma dang dgyes rgur spyod pa'i tshe/ legs byas kyi sgo 'phar mngon par phye ba bod yul dbus kyi rdo rje gdan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang nas phul ba dge /(54na tshe skong du shes rab bla ma 'gro skabs phul ba'i zhu yig mas ra'i 'phreng ba/ ma 〉(4 nu ta ri ra dzu sa r+bhasmi / mi :: su ka ra lu wa : su tsa kri ta wa rba rti 96 ma ṇi ja ge khu su 'i yu: praya ts+tshaḥ le/ /legs byas gser gyi 'khor los nor 'dzin kun la dbang sgyur ba 'gro ba rnams la phan bde stsol ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'jam pa'i dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i drung du/ rnam par dkar ba'i dang ba'i yid kyis zhu ba/ mchog tu gyur pa'i dus nyid na'ang bskal pa rgya mtshor lan gcig ma yin par goms pa'i dge legs kyi bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po cod pan du bcing pa las 'dod pa'i re ba mtha' dag char du bsnyel ba'i dbang phyug yon tan brgyad kyi cha shas yongs su gang ba'i tshangs pa mi'i gzugs can gang gi sku gsung thugs chu shel gyi dbang po'i dkyil 'khor nye bar 'tshe ba'i ra ra'i dri ma phra mo tsam gyis kyang gos pa mi mnga' zhing / 'dzam gling yangs pa'i rgyal khams ku mu da'i tshal chen por 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i mdzad bzang rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i bsil zer gyi dga' ston ci yang dgod pa'i snyan par grags pa'i rdza rnga chen po srid rtse'i bar du brdungs pas lha dang bden tshig grub pa'i drang srong rnams kyis/ rtsod pa'i dus su 'khor los sgyur —309

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)ba'i rgyal po chen (54ba)po 'byung ba ni ngo mtshar to zhes bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pas me tog man+ta ra'i 'phreng ba phyogs kun du khyab par byed par gor ma chag cing / dngos cag kyang yid kyi 'o mtshor rjes su yi rang ba'i 'dab chags lus dkar dbang po 'phur lding g.yo bar mchis/ ched du zhu mchid 'bul ba'i snying po/ thog mar nges shes skyes na yang / /phyi nas yang dang yang du soms/ /zhes sngon gyi mkhas grub rnams kyi gsung las byung ba ltar gong ma chen po nyid kyi snyan dbang be+e ḍūrla dkar po'i snod du rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phan bde mtha' dag gi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i bdud rtsis yongs su gang na'ang / yang skyor gyi tshul du gsol ba don dang ldan pa'i phyir na 'dzam bu gling pa rnams tshe lo brgyad khri pa'i dus su gser dngul zangs lcags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po byung ba mtha' dag rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras bsams bzhin du srid pa bzung bar gsung rab rnams las bshad cing /bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dir yang 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po bsams bzhin du chos rgyal mes dbon gyi rnam par bstan nas 'gro ba rnams dge bcu'i lam la bkri bar mdzad/ rgya nag gong ma'i khri la mngon par mtho ba mtha' dag 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis byin gyis brlabs pa nyag gcig tu grags pa don dang ldan pa'i phyir na gong ma chos kyi rgyal po chen po nyid kyis kyang mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims bcas pa'i sgo nas mnga' 'bangs mtha' dag dge ba la 'god pa dang /slu ba med pa'i gtan gyi skyabs gnas mchog gsum dam pa dbu'i cod pan du bcings te rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas su 'gyur ba'i mdzad pa bzang po gtso bor gyur pa 'phral yun kun gyi legs tshogs kyi gzhi yin zhing / rgyal ba'i bstan pa de yang / (55na)drang don nges don theg pa che chung sogs gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal gyi dbang gis ji snyed cig mchis na'ang /gtso bor gyur pa ni theg pa chen po'i sde snod ces rgya bod kun du yongs su grags pa'i tshul de nyid go rim ma 'khrul bar ston pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa zhes mdo sngags gnyis ga'i lam gyi srog tu gyur pa/ shing rta chen po dpal mar me mdzad kyi lam srol dri ma med pa de nyid rje btsun 'jam —310

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pedapal dbyangs mi'i srid pa'i gar mkhan mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen pos legs par rgyas par mdzad pas bstan pa'i snying po 'di nyid ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'gro ba'i snang ba ster pa de srid du spel ba'i thabs tshul nyams pa med pa zhu zhing / gong ma chen po nyid kyi sku tshe chab srid mnga' thang bzhed don mtha' dag 'bad med du 'grub pa'i bden pa'i tshig gis shis pa brjod pa dgongs pa rin po cher bzhugs pa phebs tshogs kyang chu klung skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun ltar zhu/ zhes gzigs brten stobs bcu mnga' ba'i 'phel gdung / sku srung rdo rje'i mdud pa/ rgyal ba'i sku brnyan 'phagasayul gyi li ma dang bcas me khyi smin drug can gyi yar tshes la gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang dga' ldan pho brang nas phul/stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub kyi chab shog lan mthong bas 'dzu pa shor/grub pa'i gtsug gi rgyan dam pa rin po cher/ bka' tham rten ldan phebs/ deng phun sum tshogs pa'i legs byas chu gter chen po'i 'jing na med byung mkhyen brtse'i 'dab ldan gyis lus can mig mi 'grum pa mtha' dag sim pa'i dbang po las nye bar drangs te thar pa mchog gi ba gam phyag (55bskyol byung ba'i lam du bcug pa'i 'phrin las kyi dbyar rngas dbang po'i 'dab ldan rma bya mtha' dag zlos gar sgyur ba'i gtam gyis 'dir yang rna ba'i gsos su gyur/ shākya'i rjes su zhugs pa'i sdom brtson klog pa mkhan yang bka' sde snod gsum la dbang por byed pa'i lugs su yin/ slad nas bka' gnang phebs tshogs kyang chu shel kyi dbang po'i bgrod pa'i tshul la dpe zlar 'os pa'i rgyun bzang po sngar ltar zhu/ rten bkras btags dang bcas dbyangs o 'char ba'i tshes la phul/don gong dam pa gu lha'i lan rgyu 'bras snyu 0med pa'i gtan tshigs/ legs byas mes po'i ral pa stug po las/ /dal 'byor dzaḥ yi bu mo'i rgyun/ /rnam dkar khyab 'jug bgrod byed zhabs bsil can/ /don kun bzang por grub pa der springs pa/ mang gi ma ma'i ngos su sug pa'i gar/ /rab bsgyur mgrin par bcingasapa'i thun mtshams kyi/ /zhabs 'od ring por brkyang pa'i dbang gzhu'i dar/ /gser yig snyim par lha —311

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyelam ngos nas 'byor/ /phun tshogs zong gi 'od brgyas phye min zhing / /dge bcu'i smin legs 'gram chang gis 'byed pa'i/ /mngon mtho'i rten gyi me tog ba ku la/ /nyer 'tshe'i ba mos bskyod pa med de shis/ /'di snang bde ba'i zag bcas gnyid kyi ro/ /longs su spyod pa'i chu bo'i lce ldan pa/ /gzhan phan bde la rjes su chags pa'i nyams/ /lhag bsam phyogs kyi 'dren byed legs pa'i lam/ /tshe 'di'i skabs gsum dbang po'i skyed tshal du/ /dge ba'i sa bon btab pa'i a mra'i 'bras/ /skye ba du ma'i sbyin skyes grong khyer du/ /lhung de za ba'i ro 'dzin ces mi bde/ /'phrin yig sa srung dbang po gang / /rten gyi gser sbyangs rgyan spras pa/ /bshul ring dal bu'i gom (56na)'gros kyis/ shar phyogs dbang po'i grong der song / /khar kha er ti na sto tha'i ji'i 'phrin lan rigs kyis ma' par mtho ba'i dbyangs/ da sha 'a phya gu 6 tsa 〉 phrokhya 2 bha ra rā pa rwa/ /su lha ) zhe twa ra k+ṣa nye sa tho ku smo su 'i ya tsa/ /stobs (sdeb sbyor kha sgo phan pa/tha cu'i yon tan chu shel dbang / /tshogs gnyis ri dwags gzugs brnyan can/ /phan bde'i kun+da bzhad byed pa'i/ /blo bzang grags pas khyod la srungs/ /dge legs ngo mtshar snang ba byed pa'i gter/ /gnam bskos sa la spyod pa'i tshangs pa che'i/ /snyan 'gyur drug skyes gru yi khengs 'phrog pa'i/ /ri mo rten gyi bdog pa sug par son/ /ring min rnam par dge ba'i dus kyi char/ /nyer len ༄ la sdong po g.yur za bar/ /mi mthun dgun gyi reg pas mi brdzi ba'i/ /ngo mtshar rkang drug glu dbyangs sgrog pa spro/ /shes bya'i rgyud las 'phos pa'i brgal brtag gi /lhag phran rnon pos log smra 'joms byed pa'i/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan/ /'dzin la dngos cag (56badz+ra khyun pa mi dman tsam/ /'jam mgon chu 'dzin lus phra'i phang ba nas/ /legs bshad zad mi shes pa'i char gyi rgyun/ /skal bzang myu gu rgyas pa'i dza na mo/ /blo bzang grags snyan 'bar pa'i lugs su khums/ /nges 'byung glog gi do ra yangs pa na/ /tshul 'tshos skad cig 'od kyi rtsa dga' can/ /'jig rten bya ba'i mun par mal 'cha' ba/ /dwags brgyud rgan po'i ngang tshul rmongs pa'i lugs/ /tshul khrims dri ldan snying rje'i grib —312

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('basil can/ /gsang sngags 'bras smin lung rtogs dpag bsam ljon/ /dge ldan bstan pa'i 'chi med skyed tshal du/ /'byung gi gzhan lugs gcong rong khrod du man/ /phan bde'i pad dkar bzhad byed rgyal bstan gyi/ /nyin byed chu lha'i mkha' la gsal mi gsal/ /dus 'khrugs sprin gyi lang long mthar skrod pa'i/ /mnyes gshin byams pa'i ser bu ldang la rag /ma phyis dri ma med pa'i gang gi blor/ /ma bris yon tan tshogs kyis rnam bkra ba/ /dal brgyad dka' thub bstan pa ma yin pa'i/ /blo ldan phur bu grub khyod gang las 'ongs/ /ut+pal dkar po'i tshal la phrag dog cing / /gnyis 'thung tsha bsardung byed rta ljang can/ /nyer gnas tshigs pa'i cho ga bstar ba yang / /ring po'i mkha' nas snang ba'i dga' ston ster/ /rigs kyis mngon mtho ya rabs spyod pas mdzes/ /dpa' mdzangs brtul phod jing gir gan gyi brgyud/ /bstan la nyer gus gzugs can snying po'i grogs/ /nor 'dzin skyong khyod rtag tu brtan gyur cig /bzhul ring lam gsum las 'ongs pa'i/ /'phrin yig dri bral gang ga'i rgyun/ /pho nya skal ldan shing rta yis/ /chad med 'bab pa'i sbyor ba 'tshal/ /rje 'bangs ma lus mi mthun pa'i/ /mun stug sel ba'i srung 'khor gyi/ /'od kyis phan bde'i snang ba dag /'phral dang yun du stsol ba yin/ /yi ge gnyis skyes 'khor lo'i lag /rten gyi rkang gdub bsil (57nas la sgra /sgrog bzhin mir gan du bon chas/ /bdag gir bzung ba'i yul der 'phur/ /gong ra lo tsā ngags phan rdo rje'i 'phrin lan ri thang mtshams kyi nad cu po sman dkar chig thub/sa : ta kha pa ri masnye dza ha chu da ya bi tsā ra su ri su tsitra tsa/ /dz+nyā rwa de sha k+ṣa bha dzi di ya sho le kho k+ta sur 〉 smi na/ /rnam (po'i ༷ 'phags ma/dpyod ri mo yongs su dar ba'i 'ja'/ /brda sprod kun gsal 'gram par legs bkra ba'i/ shes ldan 'dren byed yul gyi zil dngar can/ /skad gnyis smra bar grags pa de la springs/ /dge ba'i sa bon dar bab lang tsho'i dpyid/ /mngon mtho'i a mra'i 'khri shing sdong bu las/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i yal 'dab g.yur za ba/ /phan bde'i grib bsil ster ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /da lha'i ba ched don nyams 'gyur glur blangs pa'i/ /'phrin yig dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i pi —313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)wang can/ /me tog phreng ba'i sdeb sbyor stong gi rgyud/ /rab sgrog snyim pa'i do rar gar kyis 'gying / /rnam par sra ba gzhung lugs bye ba'i rgyud/ /brgyal brtag rigs pa'i nyag phran gyis 'gugs par/ /mngon par rlom pa'i (57bsdom brtson klog pa mkhan/ /gtsug lag bye ba'i ltad mor g.yeng skabs grang / /snying med 'khor ba'i bde ba chu shing 'bras/ /'byung 'jig cig car grub pa'i ngan pa'i mtshang / /ston phyir bzhin ras sdong bu sdug bsngal mdog /nag por brnags pa'i 'gro 'di ya ma brla/ sol des nges par 'byung ba'i skya rengs kyis/ /srid pa mun pa'i smag rum drungs phyung nas/ /bslab gsum snang bas gtan bde'i 'dab brgya pa/ /mngon par 'dzumi de khyod kyi rna ba'i brgyan/ /legs sbyar dri za'i rgyud mang brdungs pa'i sgra/ /dang pos bong rgan ngag sgros glegs bam gzings/ /mu cor gtam gyi rgya mtshor nyer zhig pa'i/ /rdzun mtshang rlabs phreng 'khrug pa 'ga' mthong ngam/ /nyams dang 'gyur ba'i 'od dkar lhab lhub can/ /snyan ngag chu shel dbang po shar ba'i tshe/ /grong tshig gcer bu'i kun gsal lus phra ma/ /skyengs pas stong pa'i dbyings su bros pa bzhin/ /a 'dus ka 'phreng skad kyi gdangs snyan por/ shar ba lci dang yang bar spel ba'i gzugs/ /brit+ta dzā ti'i sdeb sbyor phreng ba yis/ /rin cen 'byung gnas spun zlar byas dogs/ /rtog pa'i byed pos brda yi chen por gyis/ /yid kyi ka shi gsar pa'i ngos yangs por/ /sna tshogs ming gi ri mo rab bkra ba/ /mngon brjod gzigs mor byed la tshar du dngar/ /tha snyad rig pa'i sis wa ra'i tshal/ /bcad lhug spel ba'i lus phra'i kha chang gi /'dzum gyis legs bshad mgron kun bsu mkhas pa'i/ /zlos gar ke sa ra yi mgo lcogs ldem/ /phra zhib rtogs dka' shes bya'i snang brnyan kun/ /mngon sum 'char byed g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /dkar nag rtsis kyi sngon med me long gis/ /kun mkhyen ye shes khengs pa phyogs kyi dogs/ /rtog (58na)ge'i tshig don brgyad kyi rigs pa'i mdas/ /phas rgol dam bca'i laṅka'i bdag po dag /smra bcad tshun rol grong du nyer btang tshe/ /sngon med rā ma na zhes lha rnams gleng / /mi shis mtshan mo mun pa'i khang pa na/ /ngo mtshar ri mo glog gi gar mkhan ma/ /bsod nams gzugs can bzhin du snang ba'i dpal/ /byed po bzo yi —314

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la skrun yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (perig byed pha mtha' yas/ /sbyor sde'i 'khor lo tsha bsil snyoms pa'i rtsibs/ /stong phrag rig pa'i 'phrul gyi rno ba'i dbal/ /nad kyi dra ba gcod pa'i gso rig gzhung / /lus can kun gyi nyer 'tsho 'di rmad byung / /rnam par sra ba sgrib gnyis srid sgrub mgo /theg chen mtshon gyis bcad pa'i ye shes dri/ /nyam nga'i 'dod chags bzang po'i lam sgyur ba'i/ /gsang chen chos 'di gsar 'gyur rtsi yi grogs/ /rgyal kun ye wa 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /mtsho skyes ring lugs rlud thub gser ldan gzugs/ /rnam dpyod sto bar zhu bas grangs med pa'i/ /gtsug lag gaṅgā 'thung bar mkhas so lo/ /de phyir mgrin pa'i 'khor lo rnam grol ba'i/ /dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i legs bshad glu/ /skal bzang skye bo'i rna bar 'jibs so zhes/ /phyogs kyi sgeg mos gleng mod de lta na'ang / shes rab gru gzings blo gros ngan pa'i mtshor/ /rab zhig chu srin rgyal mtshan grogs po dag /nyes bshad rlabs kyi dug sbrul gling phran du/ /mi dge'i 'jigs pas mngone par gtses min pa'i/ /rgyal bstan zhabrul med yongs 'du'i rigs las 'ongs/ /dpyad gsum dag pa'i dri bsung chos cher mngar/ /zung 'jug 'bras bu smin pa'i dri med kyi/ /bstan par nges che shes ldan su mi rang / /lnga brgya'i dus 'dir shes bya kun mkhyen pa'i/ /grags pa don ldan bod yul paṇ+ḍita/ /chos skyong bzang po'i legs bshad (54gyi khrul med du/ /'dzin par nges na bstan la bya ba byas/ /phyis min rnam par dngas pa khyod kyi blor/ /bris min yon tan ri mo rnam mdzes pa/ /mthong min gzigs mor ched du ya mtshan pa/ /byas min 'bad med lhun gyis rnam par grub/ /ngan skyugs phung pos nye bar gang ba yi/ /'dzam bu'i gser sbyangs las grub za ma tog /sna tsho gos rin cen 'phra yis nyer bkod pa/ /swā la'i ljongs 'di gang ba bzhin du byed/ /thub pa'i gsung rab rab tu 'byams klas pa/ /ji bzhin rjod mkhas mkhas pa'i grags pa ldan/ /legs sbyar skad smra smra ba'i 'jig rten mig /rjes 'asdug lo chen chen po'i ming 'dzin gang / /gang zhig rnyed dka' dal ba'i rten bzang lus/ /lus med thul gyi gsung rab ji bzhin du/ /du mar dpyad dang bsgoms pa'i snying po'i tshogs/ /tshogs gnyis bsags te don ldan bya bar rigs/ /'phrin yig 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin can/ /snyan 'gyur sgro —315

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)gshog rab brkyangs te/ /rten gyi gtsug phud ldem bzhin du/ /chu lha'i phyogs su nye bar song / /'phags yul ba ā dha rar 'bod pa phyogs 'dir kun 'dzin du grags shing rgya nag pa wun car rjod pa/ ljongs 'dir sa pho byi ba'i lo/ hor gyi zla ba bdun pa/ dus 'khor ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa/ya ṇa'i dbyangs ha dang gsal byed dha 'char zhing / mun pa'i mun pa gsal ba chen po'i bu mo/ dbyangs 'char ba'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa/ dbyangs a gsal byed wa/ khams sa/ 'dod yon dri/ tat+pal gzhu'i dus spyod la chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs nas bris tho/ /stag lung ma thang ri bo che be ri smad pas bcom ste (59na)bon pos bdag gir bzung ba dge sog mchod yon gyi drin las stag lung pa rang thi phyag tu 'gyur skabs nyams gsos su zhabs drung khri thog pa phebs par phyi nang gsang ba'i bgegs rigs la brten stag lung btsun pos 'dzin pa'i snyems pa gtong bar mngon du phyogs tshe zhabs drung ma chen ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub nges don chos kyi nyi ma rnam grol mchog gi sde kun spangs nyan rang gi zhi bder gzhol ba las bzhengs te byang sems snying stobs can gyi rnam par thar bas khams phyogs su chibs kha skyod pa'i sta gon gyi skabs chab shog lan du sangs rgyas yar byon gyi chems sogs skyes dang bcas gsol ba lugs gnyis dbyangs su 'tsher ba'i pi wang / ma spro sa su ri : tri tsa kra : bha shā snya sa she yosnri ṣa ba da ñca ko ṭi/ rgyu sa sho bha :: khya ma shā ka ru rdo tsi stu ba lha shwa bya mu r+ya ma yasmo /srid (sde pa sbyor sna tshogs lha mo/) zhi'i dge legs bye ba'i gtsug tor la/ /bkra shis 'khor lo'i ri mo bkra ba'i zhabs/ /'god mdzad snying stobs dbang phyug zas gtsang sras/ /med byung thugs rje chen pos dge tshogs stsol/ /(59na) ma khyi la mu da : dri sa ma bha na ba kwa rla tsa mā la sa dha dha ( bha ba ku ma da 〉 so ya t+ta ( 5 ti sha ku la lha ma la glu/ /mtha' (dzā ti'i sdeb sbyor mchog dbyangs/)bral grub rgyud zla ba'i ma ma las/ /'phrin las dkyil 'khor rab tu rdzogs pa yi/ /phul byung rigs kyi bsil zer 'bum phrag gis/ /chos srid kun+da bzhad pa gang de'i drung / /(60na tshe tha zhe 3 me/sha sgo spu ya wa blo sti gi rti ga rkya gro/ shi PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB/ /mi (sdeb sbyor kha sgo phan pa/)zad gsang gsum dbyar gyi dpal mo glu/ /phun tshogs mdzad pa'i 'brug gi sgra —316

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('dabyangs kyis/ /yid kyi mdongs mtha' sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /bcas te snyan 'gyur tshig gis mchid 'di gsol/ /bka' tham dri bral 'khor lo'i yan lag can/ /tshig don bzang po'i rkang gdub sil sgra dang / /bdog pa'i skyes kyi 'phur lding g.yo bzhin du/ /snyim pa'i rdzing bur babs pas spro dga' rtas/ /ring min ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i dus kyi char/ /kun dga'i mdza' ba ster ba'i 'dzum zhal can/ /gsar tshes gnam lo'i ri dwags mig can ma'i/ /zla ba'i nor 'dzin gos kyi do ra du/ /tsho gos gnyis lang tsho dar la babs pa'i 'bras/ /mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyas pa'i gzugs kyi sku/ /'phrin ༷ 'phrul bye ba'i rnam rol gyis/ /mngon par sgyur 40ba'i di skal bzang 'gro ba'i gnyen/ /kun yid dga' bder myong byed drug skyes glu/ /rang rang spyod tshul rjes su 'jug pa'i rdzas/ /'dzum zhal las 'ongs gzung gis rgyal ba yi/ /tshangs dbyangs de la mos pa lhod por byed / /lnga brgya'i ngang tshul sna tshogs bkra ba'i tshon/ /phra zhib pir kyis ri mor bris pa yis/ /srid zhi'i chos kun mkhyen pa'i thugasakyi mkha'/ /pha mtha' 'jig rten mes pos rtogs nus min/ /'khrul ba'i dri bral 'jam mgon btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs dpag bsam ljon pa'i grib bsil la/ /ngal gsor bsti ba'i snyom las klog pa mkhan/ /gnas lnga'i ltad mor dag 'ba' ring po'i blo/ khrud pa'i phun tsho gos sgyu ma'i zlos gar mkhan/ /'khor ba nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas dug sbrul tshang / /dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'jig slas nges byung yang / /da dung dngos cag zin med bya bas brel/ /'on kyang bslab las mi g.yel 'gro la brtse/ /sems kyi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gzhol ba/ /thub bstan snying por rig pa'i go yul tsam/ /'chags 'ad 'jam dpal snying po'i rjes zhugs drin/ /kun la byams brtse'i phyag gi nyer bzung ba'i/ /nges don pad dkar srad bu'i mi phyed rgyas/ /dwags brgyud skal bzang lag ldan bgrod byed zung / /'ching ba'i sgyu thabs chen po 'di med byung / /bka' brgyud gdan khri'i kai la sha yi rtser/ /chos nor gdod pa'i rtsal gsum rab rdzogs pa'i/ /rje btsun grub mchog gdong lnga'i dbang po yis/ /gcig shes kun grol 'jigs med sgra bsgrags tshe/ /mngon rjes tshad ma brgal cing nyer brtags pas/ /kun shes gcig tu —317

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'abyams klas sa chen por/ /dge ba'i rtswa chus 'tsho ba'i ri dwags rnams/ /skrag ste srid pa'i snang ba 'gags pa bzhin/ /mi bsrun tsher dong 'jam gnyen 'dab (61na)brgya pa'i/ /skyed tshal ltar gzigs gdul dka'i lus can tshogs/ /'dren la ngal med snying stobs go cha yis/ /sems dpa' gzhan rnams zhi bder mnal gyi dogs/ /gangs can ri bos bres pa'i dbang phyogs kyi/ /rgya chen skye rgu'i 'du sar mdzad bzang gi /nor bu'i yu bas bteg pa'i lugs zung gdugs/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i pha mthar 'khor snyam byed/ /ma rig 'khor los thar pa'i mgrin chad pa'i/ /lus can lha min dbang po 'tsho ba'i srog /ster ba'i byed po sngon chad gangs can 'dir/ /mchi so min bdud rtsi'i dpal 'di su yis bskrun/ /'dzad pa med pa dam pa'i chos kyi dung / /dpyad gsum dag pa'i g.yas su 'khyil ba'i glu/ /grub rigs bstan pa bsu phyir len pa la/ /pad dkar gzhen nu khong nas 'dzum pa 'dra/ /mdzes sdug rnam par bkra ba'i sgro gshog tshogs/ /bkod legs gdugs ltar phub pa'i 'gying bag gis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin dbus su gar sgyur bar/ /mngon phyogs rma bya gzhon nu ci yang brel/ /mkha' lding dbang po'i gzhen pa ma mchis shing / /'khor lo'i ri mos lag pas mtshan min la/ /'gro skyabs gser can srog dang ma bral ba'i/ /sna tshogs gzugs can khyod ni su yis bskrun/ /chu shel dbang pos rab dkar snang ba'i dpal/ /lho phyogs dri yis bsil ba'i reg bya mchog /ka shi mdzes dga'i bzhin gyis 'dod pa'i bde/ khyod kyis 'gro kun byang chub mchog la sbyor/ /ches sra rnam dkar rgyud las nyer 'phos pa'i/ /dge legs mda' yis yid srubs snying bsnun khrag /mchu sgros lan brgyar bsgos pa'i 'dzum rlabs kyis/ /mtsho skyes 'dab ldan mgron kun (61bsno5kugs pa bzhin/ /yang dag 'bras dor sdug bsngal sra mkhregs can/ /'khor ba e raṇ+ḍa yi ljon pa la/ /bde ba'i snying por re ba'i 'khrul ba'i 'gro /'dren pa khyod nyid gser mngal can gyis bskos/ /rgyu rkyen glog gis bde gzugs gzigs mo'i dpyid/ /cung zad grub pa'i pha mtha' du:kha'i mun/ /slong du 'phyan rnams 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan la/ /nyi ma'i gnyen dang khyod gnyis tha mi dad/ /bzod dka' srid pa'i rang bzhin ya ma brla/ /gtan bder —318

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la tshon yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('baskrun tshe dkar nag las 'bras ro/ /gcig tu grub pas dge sdig shan 'byed pa'i/ /gsal byed me long de la co 'dri snyam/ /de phyir gdul ba'i zhing khams grangs med rdul/ khams dang dbang por 'tsham pa'i mdzad pa yis/ /thar pa'i bka' rgyud shing rta tshul de la/ /mos ldan rnams kyi blo yi rwa bar drongs/ /'phrin las yol ba med la rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ /'gro ba'i re 'dod skong la dpag bsam dbang / /gdung sel bdud rtsi ster la zla gzhen dang / /mtshungs khyod bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /mgrin pa'i 'khor lo rnam par grol ba yis/ /nam yang zad pa med pa'i bka' mchid rgyun/ /drang srong dza hu'i bu mo'i spun zla gang/ /bsgyur min 'dren byed yul du rgyu bar gsol/ /zhu mchid kun+da spyan zung bh+ra ma ra/ /'jug slad sangs rgyas yar ngo'i zla snang tshems/ /lha rdzas dbang phyogs sa 'dzin rtser byon par/ /rten 'byung thun 'tshams rgya yis nyer spras te/ /kun tshig lang tsho rgyas pa'i 1 skyi/ /nyams 'gyur stong gi rgyud mang 'brol bzhin du/ /lci yang phreng bar spel ba'i gar stabs kyis/ /gnod sbyin phyogs kyi sa 'dzin ngos der song / /'phags yul ba ā dha ra zhes 'bod pa phyogs 'dir kun 'dzin du grags shing / 42na)ma hā ca na'i yul grur wun ca zhes pa kha ba'i yul 'dir sa pho byi ba'i lo/ hor gyi zla ba bdun pa/ dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang po/ dus 'khor ba'i ya ṇa'i dbyangs2/ gsal byed rda 'char zhing / khamasanam mkha'/ snying stobs kyi mun pa 'jug pa chung ngu'i bu mo dang / /dbyangs 'char ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang po/ dbyangs ā/ gsal byed tsa/ khams sa/ 'dod yon dri/ tat+ta la bu mo'i dus sbyor la mkhas mang rgya mtsho'i bsti gnas chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs nas phul/bsam yas nas gnod sbyin 'a po'i rdo rje'i gsung lan 'phrin las dpag bsam snyem/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /sprul sku'i gzugs su shar ba mtsho skyes rje'i/ /bka' srung srog gi bshan pa chen po yi/ /'phrin yig rtags kyi mtshan mar bcas pa 'byor/ /bsil ldan phan bde'i rtsa lag spel ba la/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa zla gzhen lta bur dkar/ /dge tshogs sgrub la mthun rkyen ma lus pa/ /g.yel med stsol ba'i nus pa'i mthu dpung skyed/ /snyan shal gser skyems gos bzang rol mo dang / /rkang 'thung —319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)'bras bur bcas pas nyer mtshon pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang mchod dngos bshams yid sprul pa/ /rab bzhes bcol pa'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub/ /sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan bo nyer dgongs la/ /bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus pa/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams gang du gnas kyang rung / /snying khrag 'thung la myur du tshar chod cing / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dbang thang dang / /dam chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen legs tsho gos kun/ /bsams pa tsam gyis re ba kun skong ba'i/ /yid bzhin (62ba)dbang gi rgyal po lta bur mdzod/ /kun 'dzin bgrang bya'i khrums zla yi/ /dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshe/ /gsang chen chos kyi pho brang che/ /gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i rtse nas bris/ /'bri gung zhabs drung khri thog rig 'dzin chen po dkon chog phun tshogs chos kya grags pa dpal bzang pos 'dul ba'i rgya cher 'grel g.yar po dgos tshul byung ba 'bul ba dang grub chen dza ber gyi rlung khrid skor g.yar po dgos tshul 'phrin du gsol ba pad 'byung gnyis par sgrog pa'i glu dbyangs/ sa dzo jo rgyu pa ṇ+ḍi ta mi : tri ga phya na ṭa 〉 〉 tsa/ ( bhu ma khyi latsa tsho nā tho : gu rnye 1 ā ཿ le/ rgyal (dza ti'i sdeb sbyor 'phags ma/)ba kun gyi gsang ba gsum/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i zlos gar can/ khyab bdag dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ /gsang sngags 'chang ba'i dbang po'i drung / / (63na ji bral yid kyi kun gsal ngos yangs por/ /rnam dkar mdzad pa'i dbang po'i gzhu ris can/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtshos rab bskul nas/ /mgrin pa'i 'khor lo rnam par grol te gsol/ /mtha' bral bsod nams bye ba'i chu gter las/ /mtshan dpe'i cha shas yongs su nyer gang ba/ /rmad byung gzugs skur grub pa'i zla snang gis/ /lus can phan bde'i kun+da dar ba'i dpyid/ /'dzad mi shes pa dam pa'i chos kyi dung / /longs spyod 'khor lo g.yas su 'khyil ba'i sgra /'gag med tshangs pa'i dbyangs su nyer blangs pas/ /mes pos rgyal gsung dpe slar sprul lam snyam/ /shes bya'i rang bzhin dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'bras/ /mngon sum ro brgya'i dpal du smin pa'i bcud/ /mkhyen pa'i skabs gsum dbang pos longs spyad tshe/ /srid zhi'i chos kun khyod thugs klong du mnal/ /phul byung 'phrin las yan lag brgyad ldan rgyun/ /lnga brgya'i nyes tshogs 'khrud pa'i cho ga mkhan/ /byang —32(/—

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('grol bsil ba'i reg bya lhar bcas 'gro'i/ /gtan bde'i dpyid du spun las g.yin du ci/ /'di na 'jam mgon kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs 'dzin rlom sdom brtson klog pa mkhan/ /za hor rigs kyi ā wa sgru tī pa/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i tshul la mos blor mchis/ /e ma med byung mdzad bzang mchog gi dri/ /grags snyan lho phyogs bsir bus rab bskyod pa/ /skye rgu'i yid kyi tsha gdung 'phrog byed pa'i/ /sngon med ma la ya yi spun slar byas/ /chos skur ngo sprod dri za'i pi wang rgyud/ /dang bor brdungs tshe 'khrul pa'i rgya mtsho cher/ /rnam rtog gru gzings bshig tshe sa ra ha/ /skyengs pas mkha' spyod gnas su (63ba)bros kyi dogs/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa kun 'joms snang bzhi'i lam/ /tshe gcig kun bzang sar 'god rdzogs pa che/ /snga 'gyur chos kyi sgo 'phar brgya phye bas/ /mngal skyes pad+ma 'byung zhes lha rnams gleng / /dbugs bral ba ma chen steng du gar rtse ba'i/ /don snying khrag gis myos pa'i dam can tshogs/ /bran ltar skul ba'i rig sngags mthu grub pas/ /gnubs ston rgya zhad khengs pa phrogs pa bzhin/ /blun sgom rgan po'i rang bzhi ya ma brla/ /ring por dor ba'i mang thos rnam dpyod kyis/ /gnas lnga'i bstan pa spel ba'i shong dpang dang / /chos skyong bzang po'i rnam par thar 'di gson/ /blo gros ka shi mdzes dga'i 'dren byed der/ /byings dang rnam 'gyur rkyen gyi kha dog tshon/ /rnam bkra brda sprod 'byog por lta ba'i dkyus/ /bstan tshe lha yi bla ma'i khengs pa phrogs/ /nyams dang 'gyur ba'i rkang gdub sgra 'brol zhing / shar lho'i lam bzang 'dab gshog rab skyod pa'i/ /snyan ngag gnyis skyes lus dkar dbang po de/ /sngon byon mkhas rnams mgrin pa'i pad mtshor rol/ /brit+ta dzāti'i rnam ba po za 'og thags/ /lci dang mang ba'i sna tsho gos ri mo can/ /legs sbyar skad kyi bos su legs grub pa/ /gyon mkhas gangs ri'i ljongs su mang zhig rgyu/ /grong chog na kra'i tshogs kyis ma gtses shing / /snyan tshig dus las yol ba med pa'i brlabs/ /snga na mchis min mngon rjod rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /bgrod byed shes ldan rnams kyi gru gzings che/ /grangs med skad rigs be+e ḍūr 'khyil ba'i khams/ /bcad lhug spel ma'i ri mo'i snang brnyan can/ /kun gyi gzigs mor mtshar ba'i zlos gar gyi/ /nor bu'i rna rgyan mkhas (64na)—321—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)rnams 'gram par spa/ /lkog gyur shes bya'i ri dwags mig can bzhin/ /dkar nag rtsis kyi me long ngos shar ba'i/ /rnam dpyod tshogs kyis dpal sdug mkhyen pa la/ /mos pa'i blo dang lhod por gyur min nam/ /nad mun thun gsum smag rum sdug po'i mtha'/ /bde ba'i skya rengs dang por 'char byed sman/ /gso rig gtsug lag nyin byed dbang po de/ /g.yu thog ring lugs rta ljang bdun gyis drangs/ /snying med 'khor ba'i dngos kun gtan bde'i rgyur/ /sgrub byed bsod nams zhing gi dpal gyur pa/ /'phags chen dam pa'i snang brnyan grangs med dang / /skrun byed gso rig shes ldan gzigs mor mtshar /log par smra ba'i dam bca'i ri dwags snying / /phra zhib rigs pa'i gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /cig car 'gas byed rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad/ /smra mkhas chos kyi grags pa gnyis pa mang / /rnam gsum sde snod snyoms 'jug la gnas shing / /gsang chen theg pa'i snang byed me dpung gis/ /sgrib gnyis sngon gyi lha rnams sreg byed pa'i/ /rgya bod mkhas grub dpal mgrin can de mtshar/ /'gro 'dren snying stobs go gyon byang sems rnams/ /mtha' klas shes bya'i tshul la legs slob phyir/ /phyag rdzogs grub rigs bstan 'dzin dbang po khyod/ /bcu phrag rig gnas tshad mas gzhal lam ci/ /sos dus rab dkar chu 'dzin lang long dbus/ /dbyar rnga dal gyis snyan por sgrog pa'i skad/ /ring po'i mtha' nas bsgrags tshe gtsug phud can/ /dga' ba'i gar stabs sgyur la ca yang brel/ /yid 'ongs e raṇ+ḍa yi ljon pa las/ /'bras bu khur du dud pa'i (64ba)bcud kyi ro/ /mngar por yongs su spyod 'dod skye bo 'ga'/ /bde ba'i sems kyis ngal te gnyid la yur/ /lha lam ngos su rlung gi rgyal mtshan can/ khyab 'jug lag par 'khor lo'i ri mo mdzes/ /bgrang yas 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor nyi ma'i gnyen/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i dbus na rig 'dzin khyod/ /snyigs dus tsher rnon 'byog po'i nags klung khrod/ /skye sprul tsan dan ljon pa dar bab gang / shar phyogs dbang po'i phang par khyod nyid la/ /re ba'i gdul byar phan bde'i dri bsung stsol/ /snyan 'gyur mgrin pa'i dril chung sil khrol can/ /don bzang 'jam gnyen sgro gshog cher ngom pa'i/ /dkar mchid gzhan sos dpyid kyi pho nya dag /dbyar gyi dga' ston chad du chad med —322

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pozhu/ /nyams 'gyur stong gi lang tsho cher rgyas pa'i/ /ri mo sgyu rtsal spyod kyi gar mkhan ma/ /zla shel thags su grub pa'i gos gyon te/ /'tshams sprin rgya yi do rar gar gyis rol/ /dbang phyogs 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i rgyal khab na/ /lo 'go bcu gnyis bdag po gzhu khyim du/ /nyer spyod dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa yi/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal mo snga kyi yig char tshe phul/ /gong nas ngos pho brang du 'byor dgos tshul gyi bka' shog gnang sbyin bzang po dang bcas gser yig par/ shes rab bla ma/gtsang pa bka' bcu/ da las chos rje/ mi rgan po'o/ tshul khrims la sogs sa khyi'i 'jug 'byor ba'i dus mi sna rnams dang mnyam du dka' bcu shes rab rdzong ga byas skabs phul ba'i zhu yig 'jam dbyangs snyan gyi mdzes rgyan ut+pal 'dzum phreng / (65na)ā dz+nyā mañjanā tha ni dhi di pa dza skyi ྅ dza ༷ tsa/ bu t+ta si khu tsa ka pra h+ma ཿ le ྅ lha wa rto sto mi ka /stobs (kha sgo phan pa'i sdeb sbyor/)bcu mnga' ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i gter/ /'jam mgon zur phud lnga pa 'dzam gling 'dir/ /grangs med legs par byas pas 'khor lo yis/ /mnga' sgyur sa la spyod pa'i tshangs pa'i drung / /rdzogs ldan dga' ston bcu drug cha shas kun/ /yongs su gang ba'i ring min dus kyi char/ /rab dkar dang ba'i yid gyi ku mu da/ /rtse dga' khong nas dgod pas mchid 'di zhu/ /tshogs gnyis rin cen 'byung gnas las 'ongs pa'i/ /rmad byung bdud rtsir 'khyil ba'i gzugs kyi sku/ /(65ba)phan bde'i mchi med dpal ster grags snyan sgra/ /thos 'dzin gsos su tshangs dbyangs dpe slar byas/ /mngon par rab gsal mkhyen yangs rnam dpyod spyan/ /gtsug lag bye ba'i rdzas su nyer 'jug pa/ /srid zhi'i chos kun lta ba'i blo gros kyis/ /'jig rten mes po'i tshul la co 'dri snyam/ /legs byas gser sbyangs rtsibs stong 'khor lo'i rtsal/ /gser ldan lto bar thogs med sgyur ba'i shugs/ /mchod sbyin brgya pa'i gnas su 'gro bzod pas/ /skabs gsum pa rnams phyogs der 'dud pa bzhin/ /drang por 'debs pa'i khrims gnyis bser bu yis/ /bde skyid ma la yar skyes dri bsung tshogs/ /'bad med 'dren pa'i cho ga rab bstar bas/ /'phags chen dam pa'i spyod pa da gdod khums/ thu kya'i ring lugs chu shel dbang po la/ /dad pa'i sor mo'i 'dab ma rab zum pa'i/ /sdom brtson gnyis skyes klog pa mkhan —323—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shepo yang / /thos bsam sgom pa'i tshul la mos blor mchis/ /bde legs rab dkar 'bum du 'dzag pa'i rnga/ /phun tshogs mdzad bzang dbyu gus nyer bskul bas/ /dge bcu rdzogs par spyod ldan snyan pa'i sgra/ /phyogs bral rna ba'i rgyan du dngar ba dang / /'dod pa'i re skong sngon med yid bzhin nor/ /'dzam gling 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshe dpag bsam ljon/ /gnam bskos nor 'dzin skyong ba'i lha yi lha/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khri la zhabs brtan gsol/ /'chi med sgra 'dzin be+e ḍūr yol go'i nang / /'khyil pos gtam gyi bdud rtsi pho nya yi/ /ngag gi snyim pas bteg nas lha khyod kyi/ /'dun sar song la spyan ras kyis bca' zhing / /tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i rang bzhin gsung gi dpyid/ /kun dga'i 'dza' ba ster ba'i 'dzum zhal las/ /nyer 'ongs phebs tshogos gaṅgā'i chu klung che/ /nam yang chad pa med par rgyu bar zhu/ /'dren byed ngang mo rol brten rdo rje'i mdud/ /lha rdzas shal dkar nam mkha' dus kyi grangs/ kha dog lnga ldan (66na'i jam po brgya phrag gi /yid 'ong pad dkar sding por rgyas btab ste/ /gser sbyangs btso ma'i gos gyon glang gi lo'i/ /kun phan dbo yis nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /nyi ma me bzhi dang 'grogs 'grub sbyor dus/ /gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang nas phul/ /slar yang gong nas ngos pho brang du 'byor dgos tshul yang skyor gyi bka' gzhog gnang sbyin dang bcas dka' bcu shes rab pa dang mnyam du gser yig par nom phyi bla ma nor bu dpon go tho nos khā rnams lcags stag lo 'gor 'byor pa rnams dang chabs gcig par che chen dpo na po blo bzang chos 'phel rdzong sta byas skabs phul ba'i zhu yig sdo bsnya sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i lde mig /྅pa ā d+masu de lwa PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB/ sa ཿ kā se ma hā rā dza maspra lu la 〉 pra ma cha ga ga nu ྅bha smi 2 ra/ /'gyur (sde pa sbyor tshe ton phreng ba༅/)med rdo rje'i rang bzhin tshe yi khams/ /grub pa'i rang gzugs phul byung 'chi med ltar/ /gnam sa'i dbang phyug nor 'dzin skyong ba la/ /dus rnams kun du shis pa'i dpal stsol cig /(66ba)srid dang zhi ba'i yon tan snying po'i gter/ /gser ldan dga' ma'i mngal du dar ba'i dpyid/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i mi yi rje/ /'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po chen po'i drung / /gtsug lag bye ba'i dpal la mnga' 'byor —324

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (poba'i/ /rab snyan gtam gyi lus phra'i 'gram chang gis/ /rnam par phye bas yid kyi ba kul/ /rab dga'i 'dab phreng bsad pas mchid 'di zhu/ /mtha' klas bsod nams char gyi legs bskyangs pa'i/ /gsang gsum dpag bsam yongs 'du gsar pa'i 'bras/ /'dod pa'i re ba skong ba'i dbang gi rgyal/ /'di ko skye rgu'i bsod nams zong gis bsgrubs/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa'i ngo mtshar gyi/ /mtshan bzang bsil zer bye ba brgya phrag gis/ /kun yid ut+pal khong nas legs 'dzu pa pas/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i mgron de 'gugs pa bzhin/ /cha shas zegs ma res kyang rna ba dang / /yid la kun dga'i dga' ston ster byed pa/ /snyan 'gyur gsung gi sngon med zil mngar gyis/ /'jig rten mes pos khengasapar 'gran gyis dogs/ /zab gsal thugs kyi chu gter chen po'i klung / /srid 'di'i bde legs spel la yol med rlabs/ /phun tsho gos sde bzhi'i nor bu'i 'byung gnas kyi/ /snod du mes pos yangs pa'i sa'adi sprul/ /med byung mdzad pa'i nyin mo'i snang ba yis/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i 'dab stong bzhad pa dang / /rgud pa'i phun tsho gos 'joms pa'i byed po sa /gnam gyi mthongs nas 'ongs pa khyod min su/ /de phyir dad stobs nor bu'i yu ba yis/ /legs par bteg pa'i lugs zung khrims kyi gdugs/ /rnam smin dkar por g.yo ba'i sham bu can/ /srid pa'i rtse mor brgal te 'khor bar rigs/ /'dzam gling skye rgya'i bde ba'i ngal gso'i stegs/ /ma smad nor bu'i be+e ḍūr legs 'khyil ba'i/ /rtsod pa'i dus kyi 'khor / ba khyod/ /(67nas 'gyur rdo rje'i bstan la brtan gyur cig /dri med 'dren byed gnyis skyes lus dkar can/ /zhu mchid dga' ba'i tshal du 'bab pa'i rten/ /tshan grangs gnam sngon zhun ma'i rdzing bu la/ /rtags kyi ut+pal dmar pos rgyas btab ste/ /lcags kyi dbang thang ngom pa bya k+ta'i lo'i/ /kun phan chu stod dang 'grogs bral tshes la/ /gangs can 'dzin ma'i lte ba'i dbusa'agyur 'chang / /dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde nas phul/ /'bri gung zhabs drung khri thog pa chos kyi grags pa sngags 'chang gos dkar lcang lo'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa ngur smig gi chas su bsgyur te dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skabs 'dul ba'i rnam bshad gcig thugs rtsom mdzad pa'i tshe mdo rtsa'i dpe dag pa zhig dgos —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyetshul gyi chab shog lan sku gsum rim gyis sgyur ba'i gar mkhan/ gu shā dza ya rbe tu wa r+ya sa rgyu dha rnya la ma yusu wa rti rta/ /ba sdi ma n+t+ra dha tsho ba sa n+tu : cwa bha khya ra ka wa du mū la yu/ /rgyal (sdeb sbyor dag pa'i snang ba/)kun gsang ba gsum gyi gar/ /theg pa mchog gi 'dzin ma'i gzhir/ /legs sgyur rig sngags 'chang kun gyi/ /dpyid gyur rje btsun mchog gi rlung / /(67ba)deng dus mtshan dpe'i lang tsho dar bab pa'i/ /bkod pa rgya mtsho'i gzugs sku'i chu shel dbang / /phul byung 'phrin las bsil ba'i zegs ma res/ /bstan 'gro'i kun+da khong nas 'dzum pa bzhin/ /mi 'gyur bde chen ye shes dbang gi rgyal/ /cod pan la 'chang mkhas grub klu dbang khyod/ khron mong theg pa'i rtsol bar ltos min pa'i/ /dge tshogs 'dod rgu 'byung ba 'bad med gshis/ /'on kyang sgyu 'phrul sras des 'og min nas/ /spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs pa/ /thun mong gdul bya'i ched du ngur smrig gos/ /'dzin de'i rjes su la jug pa 'di rmad byung / /gting mtha' yongs bral nyon mongs rgya mtsho las/ /bral nas myang 'das rin cen gling mchog tu/ /sgrol byed tshul khrims bslab pa'i gru gzings mchog /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi gsung rab kun gyi bcud/ /phang phung tshig gi lo mas ma gtses shing / /gzhung don 'bras bu smin la yol min pa'i/ /mdo rtsa'i glegs bam yongs 'du'i ljon pa 'di/ /mkhas grub legs bris gang de'i dga' ston gnas/ /bcu drug cha shas mi ldan sngon med kyi/ /zla ba thags kyi ri mos rnam bkra ba/ /thun 'tshams rgya yi ri dwags gzugs brnyan dang / /'grogs te e yig 'char ba'i tshes la phul/ /dpal sa skya'i khri thog pa zhabs drung ngag dbang kun dgar bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rang gi rigs kyi sras gdan sa chen po 'i khri thog tu 'don par bzhed nas sngar srol bzhin 'brel can grwa rigs sbyin bdag kun la rten 'byung legs skyes kye rim pa dgos tshul skul srol yod 'dug pa ltar 'dir yang 'brel chags kyi dbang du btang ba'i chab shog gi lan drang thig nam mkha'i ska rags/ srid dang zhi ba'i gtsug tor 'thon pa'i rtser/ /bkra shis 'khor los mtshan (68na)pa'i zhabs sen gyi/ /ngo mtshang cod pan 'god pa'i 'khor la'i bdag /brtse chen snying po'i zhabs des ring nas skyongs/ /gang de'i rigs chos pad+ma dkar po'i tshal/ /ma smad mkhyen brtse'i 'od kyis rgyas mdzad —326

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dzadapa'i/ /mkhas grub nyin mor byed pa'i dbang phyug che/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon dam pa gang de'i drung / /deng dus gsang gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin mchog /phul byung mtshan dpe'i gzi byin mngon 'bar bas/ /bstan 'gro'i snang ba skyed pa'i cho ga kun/ grub pa'i ngo mtshar sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i ngos/ /chab shog lho yi phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i rlung / /tshig don 'jibs pa'i ma la ya yi dri/ /tshan grangs bsil ba'i reg bya dang bcas te/ /dbus 'gyur chos kyi mdun sar 'gog med phebs/ /mtha' klas rigs pas grangs med gsung rab la/ /brgal brtag dpyod bzod sdom brtson klog pa mkhan/ /lar rtsod rtsom pa'i bya bar rab gzhol yang / /sems kyi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mi dman tsam/ /thos dang bsam pa'i yongs 'du'i ljon pa las/ /tshul bzhin sgom pa'i 'bras bu g.yur za ba/ /sku bzhi mngar ba'i ro la longs spyod pa/ /rgya bod mkhas grub kun gyi rnam par thar/ khyad par rigs gsum mgon po'i sgyu dra'i gar/ /snying po'i zhabs nas blo gros rgyal mtshan bar/ /rim byon 'jigs med seng ge'i khrir 'khod pa'i/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i bstan pa gsal mdzad rigs/ /'phags yul rnal 'byor dbang phyug chos skyong zhabs/ /thun 'tshams bla gos gsar pas rab mdzes pa/ /blo gros mchog la 'os pa'i gsang chen gyi/ /zab don chos kyi rgyal mas rnam par sgrengs/ /stobs 'byor cig shos sgo nga'i sbubs nang nas/ /snyan 'gyur slob bshad ka la ping rka'i sgra/ /sgrog tshe (68ba〉dzogs par bshad pa'i ngur pa'i khyu/ /ro bral ca co'i sgra yis ngal min nam/ /nye lam dri med gdung gi nam mkha'i ngos/ /med byung rigs kyi thig le zla tshes can/ /lugs zung cha shas gang ba'i ba ched pa'i don/ /phan grags yar ngo'i zhag gi bgrod pa rtsom/ /slad mar bsgyur ba med pa'i phebs tshogs kun/ /snyan 'gyur tshig gi mtha' med chu gter che/ khreng gi ma ma'i gser ldan sto ba sa /gsung shog rlabs phreng yol ba med pa zhu/ /ra mo an+da rnyil 'dra'i rdzing bu la/ /spyan ras lus dkar dbang po g.yo ba'i rten/ /rtags kyi sna thal dmar po'i 'dzum bzhin du/ /kun phan dbyug pas nya ba'i zla bar phul/ /slob dpon smon 'gro paṇa chen 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje 'khor ba las nges par 'byung ste rab tu byung bar 'dod pa'i rgyu —327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shematshan gyi 'phrin lan pad dkar kun+da ra dri ba'i nyi zla'i 'dam kha/ /sku gsum dag pa rab 'byams 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /mtshan dpe'i ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i sgyu dra'i gar/ /skal bzang yid ngor 'char pa'i ngag gi lha/ /'jam dpal rdo rjes rtag tu dge legs stsol/ /stobs 'byor yal 'dab g.yo tsam lhur len pa/ /dman rigs ljon shing phal gyis 'gran min pa'i/ /ma smad yon tan 'dod rgu'i dpal ster dpyid/ /yongs 'du'i rigs ldan mkhas dbang gang de yis/ /dbyangs can 'phang 'gro'i rgyud las nyer drangs pa'i/ /snyan 'gyur 'bum du 'dzag pa rna ba'i bcud/ /'dren byed dga' ston spel ba'i 'phrin yig tu/ /bkod tshe 'jig rten mes po'i 'od zlar byas/ /legs byas bye ba'i rdul mang rab brtsegs pa'i/ /phun tshogs dal 'byor rten gyi sa 'dzin dbang / /mi mthun rgud pa'i rdul gyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ /nam yang brdzi bar mi nus rang gi gshis/ /gangs kyi ra bas yongs (69na)bskor sman ljongs 'dir/ /phyogs re'i yon tan 'od spro'i rgyu skar 'phreng / /mang yang gnas lnga rig pa'i cha shas kun/ /rdzogs pa'i zla ba gsar pa khyod min su/ /mang thos 'od zer 'bum phrag dus gcig tu/ /spro mkhas nyin byed rig gnas rgya mtsho'i phreng / /chu lha'i lto bar mnal yang shong dpang gi /bstan 'dzin zla khyod shar zhes mkhas rnams gleng / /'di na gnas lnga rig pa'i bdud rtsi la/ /gcig pur longs su spyod pa'i drang srong zhig /rdo rje'i sna ldan lang long g.yo ba'i dbus/ /gnas pa'i sngon med blo ldan phur bu bzhin/ /tshe 'di'i srid 'byor chu shing sngon po'i 'bras/ /'byung 'jig cig car ston pa ya ma brla'i/ /tshul 'dis sngon gyi blo ldan phal cher rnams/ /zhi bde'i nags su gtan gyi snying po len/ /don gnyis grub pa'i zas gtsang sras po des/ /rtsod dus 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyang / /gdug pa'i sprul gyi tshang ltar ring spangs te/ /ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsir gzhol tshul bstan/ /de phyir dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar gyi/ /sna tshogs rin cen du ma'i them skas ngos/ /'dzeg pa'i snying stobs ldan pa khyod nyid la/ /thams cad sgrol dang mtshungs snyam lhag par rangs/ /'on kyang nor 'dzin skyong ba'i dbang po dang / /gang gi gnyen dang ltos pa'i 'bangs rnams kyis/ /tshe dbang don kun grub pa'i rigs chos kyi/ /brgyud pa 'dzin par 'os zhes dar der 328

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('agleng / /rang don dben pa'i nags su gnas pa dang / /byang sa grangs med 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por srid 'dzin par/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab du mar bshad min nam/ khyad par kha gcig phyi ru paṇ+ḍi ta/ /nang du rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gzhol bas/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi in+d+ra bhū ti dang / /bod yul mar pa lo tsa'i dpe (69ba)zlar 'os/ /de lta na yang rgyu mtshan rnam gnyis por/ /yang dag don ldan dgos pa mthong ba'i phyir/ /gcig tu 'dam par ma nus kho bo'i sems the tshom 'khar ba'i khyogs la brten nas lus/ /dbus gtsang gser ldan dga' ma'i stor/ /'chad med rgyu ba'i bya ma rta/ /yi ge'i phreng ba thegs bzhin du/ /mkhas dbang gam du yang yang bsrings/ khyad par gnam lo gsang tshes kyi/ /skabs sbyar dus 'khor tsan+d+ra pa'i/ /legs bshad dga' ston spyod pa'i ched/ /'phros 'os gtam yang bskyud pa med/ /snyan 'gyur tshig gi rma bya zhig /rten gyi mdongs mtha' ngom bzhin du/ /g.yas ru gtsang gi yul ljongs der/ /'dab gshog sgro thul skyod de song / /khar khag yas ru'i stong skor sprul sku'i 'phrin lan lhun po phyogs la 'degs pa'i rnga sgra/ ā dz+nyā kā
