sha sto bha ཿ shrībra ṅgā bha ྅ so sgo ti ku/ khu ju ga ཿ koṣ+ṭhasi sa ཿ sta spri sko 〉 〈 ya smo /srid (sdeb sbyor slog 'a/dang zhi ba'i dngos po kun/ /tsho gos gnyis dpal rgyas rab sbyangs pa/ /dag pa'i yon tan rnams kyi mdzod/ /zas gtsang sras des dge legs stsol/ /(70na)deng dus legs byas dpyid kyi mngal yangs las/ /rab bskrun nye bar len pa'i yongs 'du'i ljon/ /mi mthun dgun gyi reg pa rgyang bsrings pa'i/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las lo 'dab phang phung can/ /snyan 'gyur gtam gyi mgrin rnga cher sgrog pa/ /ngo mtshar 'phrin yig 'khor lo'i yan lag can/ /rten gyi rkang gdub sil sgra khrol bzhin du/ /dbusa'agyur sman ljongs rdzing bur dal gyis son/ /'di na sdom brtson mang thos klog pa mkhan/ /zin med g.yeng ba'i sgrog tu nyer chud kyang / /thos bsam bsgom pa'i tshul la mos blo dang / /'gro la dkar ba'i lhag bsam 'gran pa bzhin/ /e waṃ zung 'jug khyab bdag sku bzhi'i dngos/ /gcig las du mar sprul pa chu zla'i gar/ /skal bzang 'gro ba'i yid ngor rab 'char ba/ /mtha' klas rgyal ba kun kyi chos —329

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)nyid gshis/ /mi bzad snyigs mas ches cher sbags pa yis/ /brnag par nus dka' lnga brgya'i 'gro ba la/ /phul byung snying rjes mdza' bas dam 'khyud pa/ /dpal ldan shākya'i gtso las ga then na su/ /gang des grangs med gdul bya'i dbang po dang / /'tsham par bstan pa'i mchog dman theg pa'i chos/ /ma 'dres rgyal ba'i bzhed gzhung 'khrul med du/ /ston mdzad 'jam mgon bla ma btsong kha pa/ /ma dag ra ri'i snang brnyan mi ldan zhing / /phyogs rer zhen pa'i 'phel 'grib bgrod pa dag /mi ston sngon med zla ba gsar pa gang / /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i ring lugs las gzhan ci/ /de phyir gnod sbyin phyogs kyi gser ldan ma'i/ /phang par bde ba'i ngal gso'i stegs 'cha' ba'i/ /'gro rnams 'khrul med grub pa'i mtha' 'di la/ /brten nas thar pa'i gling der khyod kyis drongs/ /slad mar gtam gyi dzaḥ'i bu mo/ /pho nya skal ldan shing rta'i byed po yis/ /'phrin yig lam gsum dag las nyer babs te/ /(70ba)brjed ngas dri ma 'brud pa'i cho gar mdzod/ /ri mo pad dkar chun po dag /tshan grangs rten gyi ze'u 'bru can/ /'chi med dbang po khyod nyid kyi/ /rna bar mdzes pa'i rgyan du spud/ /gos dkar g.yo ba bya sprel lo'i/ /tha skar zla ba sngon ma yi/ /gnyis pa'i phyogs kyi gang ba la/ /gru 'dzin ri bo'i rtse nas bris/ /lcags stag gi lo dpal sa skya ba zhabs drung ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rigs kyi sras gdan sa chen po'i khri thog tu mnga' gsol ba'i tshe legs skyes kyi rten 'byung sgrig par 'ol kha 'bri lung pa rdzong sta byas skabs zhu 'phrin du gsol ba drang gtam ga bur rgyal po'i sbyor ba/ /ā tsa ti shā ra byu ma rgyu ba la tsi t+ta ti ga phya ma ṇayu: sto/ /re sa 'i yu na ya pa ṭa / shā ka ye — / sa dzo: ku n+da/ /rgyal (dza ti'i sdeb sbyor 'phags ma/)kun gsang ba gsum gyi nor bu rnams/ /phul byung snying stobs shing rta chen po yis/ /lus can phan bde'i 'dzin mar 'dren mkhas pa/ khu kya'i dbang pos dus kun shis par mdzod/ /(71na 'jam mgon thugs rje'i chab kyas nyer bran pa'i/ /lha regs 'khon gyi ljon shing skyed tshal nas/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i khri shing g.yur za ba/ /mtshungs med bdag chen chos rje rin po che/ /deng dus thub bstan rin cen zhal ba'i ngos/ /tshogs gnyis pir gyis bris pa'i mtshan bzang sku/ /ngo mtshar ri mo bkra —330

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (peba'i cho ga yis/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i mig gi dga' ston bsgrubs/ /ri mo gsum pa'i lam nas dbyangs bdun gyi/ /snyan 'gyur rdzogs par blangs pa'i dam pa'i chos/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i lam bzang ston pa'i glus/ /mchog dman skye rgu'i sgra 'dzin zil dngar byas/ /zab gsal thugs kyi zla ba'i ma ma'i ltor/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i klung chen kun/ /dbyer med zung du 'jug pa'i gsal stong gi /rlabs phreng dus las yol ba med lags grang / /zad mi shes pa'i 'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i mdzod/ /snang ba 'bum du 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /thub bstan pad dkar khong nas 'dzum byed pa/ /blo bzang grags snyan 'bar ba'i nyin mor byas/ /dri med tshul khrims man shel khams las grub/ /rab dkar lhag bsam rta bdun shing rtas drangs/ /mdo rgyud bcu gnyis cha shas yongs gang ba/ /zasagatsang sras kyi bstan pa'i yang snying 'di'i/ /rjes zhugs drin las blang dang dor bya'i gnas/ /'khrul med nyams su bstar par mngon rlom pa'i/ /za hor rigs kyi a wa khyu twe pa/ /lar rtsod rtsom pa'i tshul la gshol bar mchis/ /sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rtse chen bsams bzhin du/ /ngur smrig rnam rol blo gros rgyal mtshan yan/ /bstan pa'i 'khor lo mi yi sha tshugs su/ /phyogs bral gzur gnas kun gyi cis mi shes/ /zab don dka' thub zhig kyang mtha' klas pa'i/ /gnas (71bsnga rig pa'i mig med mong rtul lha'i/ /lus sreg rnam dpyod mthu grub grags snyan can/ /sa skya lo tsā ston med dpal gyi mgrin/ /chos kyi snying po rgyal po'i srid bor te/ /blos byas blon po'i khyim du bag pheb nas/ /gang shar spyod pa'i bzhi mdor rgyu ba'i zong / /dus 'gar 'jig rten rgan pos spyad bya'i yul/ /mngar ba'i dri bsung gtam gyis yid drangs pa'i/ /mchog dman skye bo mang zhig ma la ya'i/ /rkang 'thung rtser 'dzeg cho ga la gzhol yang / /rtsa bar gdug pa'i brang 'gros dam du 'byud/ /bdud rtsis nyer gang brgya phrag ke la sha/ /'phrong bar bsgrigs dang lhan cig ba tshwa'i chus/ /gang ba'i bum pa 'ga' zhig rma bya'i mdongs/ /mdzes sdug sgro yis kha rgyan byas min nam/ /'od gsal lha rigs gdung gi su war+ṇa/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen pas legs drungs dag pa'i khams/ /rnam par 'khyil ba'i be+e ḍūr zhun ma gang / /bstan 'gro'i nye —331—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)'tshor grub las gzhan du ci/ /'tshams sprin gos dar lcang lo'i 'phreng 'dzin 'ga'/ /rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje'i sku 'grub pa'i/ /'jigs med seng khrir 'khod pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /phyogs de'i 'gro rnams skal pa bzang por byas/ /sngon byon 'khon rigs rje btsun gong ma rnams/ /la lar mkhas dang 'ga' zhig grub pa'i tshul/ /bstan nas lugs der mos ldan gdul bya'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis phan dang bde la bkod/ /gong ma'i mdzad bzang nor bu'i yu ba can/ /phrag par phyogs la blangs te sa skya pa'i/ /ring lugs gdugs dkar 'degs pa'i byed po mā /rigs dang slob tshogs mgrin (72na bcig gleng bas na/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab gru gzings mchog /med byung brtson pa'i rlung gis nyer bskul te/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i chu gter las brgal nas/ /mkhas grub rin cen gling du bgrod par rigs/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i dge mtshan gyi/ /dus ston gsar pa'i legs tshogs spel ba'i ched/ /tshan grangs bdog pa'i lus dkar dbang po zhig /snyan 'gyur rtags kyi skad gsang sgrog bzhin song / /slad ma nyams 'gyur shel gyi rtsig ngos la/ /don bzang mgrin bcu'i gzugs brnyan stong 'char ba/ /byed nus 'phrin yig ha nu mas yi/ /zlos gar chad pa med par sgyur bar zhu/ /ri mo gser ldan dga' ma'i lho ba sa /spyan ras mdongs mtha' dga' ba'i gar sgyur rten/ /dbang phyogs dang dkar dbyar gyi rnga gsang sgra/ /phyag rgya'i chu 'dzin dmar po'i dbus na ldir/ /rgya nag gtsug lag gnam lo gsar tshes pa/ /rta bdun gzhu khyim spyod pa mgo zla ba'i/ /snga ma'i phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa la/ /lugs zung mdun sa chen po'i sde nas phul/ /sa skya dpon rin po che khre 'dren gyi tshe yab dpal sa skya zhabs drung ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la zhu 'phrin du gsol ba nye lam zung 'jug grub pa'i shing rta/ /(72ba/dha ma bha bi tsu la ti ki rtanu dz+nyā ma ya pra bha: shrī nā/ sa dra 〉 smi sdu da ko da yi hi su khya ca/ /chos srid pi tsu la ta'i nor/ /mkhyen pa'i 'od zer sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /phan bde'i nyal 'gro dar mdzad pa/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon dam pa der/ /ma dag 'khor ba'i skye srid 'bigs byed ri/ /tshogs gnyis me zhal mtshon chas legs —332

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pebardar bas/ /mtshan bzang nyi ma 'khon rigs mkhar shar ba/ /'od stong sgrib med gsal byas skye rgu'i gnyen/ /gsung ngag dpal gyi be'u snying kha na/ /legs 'khyil myur lam gya gyu'i gom gsum gyis/ /grangs ring rgyal sras spyod pa'i sa chen po/ /dus gcig bcad pa'i ngang tshul mngon gyur tam/ /gang gi blo gros 'jam mgon mkhyen pa dang / /lci yang srang la bteg kyang ma rtogs par/ /gnyis skyes 'ga' zhig zla gzhon la 'dri (73na)zhes/ /dbang phyogs ri rtser lta ba'i ngal ba bsten/ /'jam dpal rdo rjes rjes bzung 'khon rigs zhes/ /snyan grags tsan dan rkang 'thung dri bsung tshogs/ /phyogs kyi rlung bzhon gyis drangs gangs can 'dir/ khyab phyir blo dang ldan khyod tshul 'di gsen/ /sgra dang sgo ma'i rno ngar sder mo yis/ /sgom chen rgan po'i 'gro skyabs gser can lto/ /phral bas nyi tshe'i dngosagrub gtan 'dun du/ /rlom pa'i blo de chu shing snying po bzhin/ /bzo gsol sogs thabs kyis gdul bya'i khams/ /ji bzhin rjes 'dzin pa khro'i gnyen shar tshe/ /sems gnas tsam la re 'cha'i 'byung po'i bya/ /blang dor lta ba'i 'dren byed rnam par zum/ /snyan dngags ma rjod sdeb sbyor zlos gar dang / /skar rtsis tha snyad lnga rig gtsug lag gis/ /mtho ris sa spru dz+nyā yi rgyud 'dzin pa'i/ /drang srong phur bu'i tshul la co 'drir 'os/ /grangs med nyon mongs gnyen por gsungs pa'i chos/ /kun gyi rtser son gsang chen theg pa mchog /tshe gcig kha sbyor bdun ldan 'grub pa'i thabs/ /bzang po'i skal ba can rnamasa'ajug pa'i sgo /sa chen rnam par dge ba'i ring lugs kyi/ /gaṅgā sa thub bstan khyab 'jug rkang pa'i dri/ /'khrud kyang lung rigs rnyog ma'i rdzing bu rnams/ /brgal brtag legs par bshad pa'i skal ba phra/ /de phyir gong ma'i bshad sgrub pad dkar 'phreng / /slob bshad ze'u 'bru g.yur du za ba can/ /'chad med rna gong sbud pa'i 'dab ma'i 'dzum/ /zung 'jug mgron du bsu las g.yo med dam/ /blo chen 'jam mgon tshangs pa'i lung las kyis/ /skal bzang 'dren pa bzhi pa'i rgyal srid du/ /dbang sgyur rigs kyi thig le'i grags pa'i sgra /'khor los sgyur rgyal ji bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /dri med rnam par dwangasapa'i kun gsal ngos/ /zla nyi'i snang ba 'bum sde'i gzi byin gyis/ /smag rum mun pa'i tshogs rnams—333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kye(73ba)sel ba las/ /phra mo'i rgyu skar la re 'khrul ba'i blo/ /brjed ngas glang po'i gdong gi mche ba dag /rnam par phyung ba'i 'phrin yig gti ka /pho nya 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin la gzhen nas/ /sum rtsen dbus 'gyur mdun sar chad med zhu/ /chu shel dbang po zhun mar 'khyil ba'i ngos/ /snyan 'gyur ri dwags gzugs kyi 'jo sgeg can/ /chu lha'i phang ba'i stegs nas nyer 'phags te/ /nges gsang chos kyi mdun sa chen por song / /gong mas ngos bsu bar cha dkar bla ma/ shes rab bla ma/ dka' bcu bla ma/ don bsang gu shi rdo rje dar khan no yon sogs myur du mngags rgyu yin pa sa de thog tu 'gyur ba med pa dgos tshul gyi sngon 'gror che chen dpon po dang mnyam du bo ro tshe ring gser yig tu 'byor pa phyir ldog pa dang mnyam du che chen dar rgyas btang dus phul ba bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung dkar/ bu khyu gu larla tsa kra ba su : ba wa sha wa rti tsa/ /bra mo rgya : ྅ ba : / se ma hā rā dza pu rba tsa/ /legs(kha stso phan pa'i sdeb sbyor/)byas gser gyi 'khor lo yis/ /nor 'dzin kun la dbang sgyur ba/ /tshangs pa mi yi gzugs 'dzin pa/ /dbang phyogs rgyal po chen po'i drung / /(74na)phul byung mkhyen dpyod rab yangs bsil zer gyis/ /mngon par phye bar yid kyi ku mud da/ /dad pa'i 'dab ma rnam par 'dzum bzhin du/ /snyan 'gyur tshig gi ze'u 'bru dgod pas zhu/ /dbang phyug dam pa'i ri mo gsum pa las /bka' shog bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / /bdog pa'i rten gyi lha rdzas dar dpyangs can/ /'dren byed sgra 'dzin bdud rtsi'i dpyid du phebs/ /deng dus 'dzam gling skye rgu'i bsod nams kyis/ /ring nas bskrun pa'i gsang gsum dbang gi nor/ /rgyal phran bye ba'i cod pan rtser bkod pa'i/ /snyan grags srid rtser sgreng las gzhan du ci/ /'di na zas gtsang sras kyi rjes bzhugs pa'i/ /gnas lngar mos blo 'dzin pa'i snyom las pa/ /sdom brtson klog pa mkhan yang rgyal ba'i bstan/ /thos bsam sgom pas 'dzin pa'i 'dun par mchis/ /gang gi bsod nams phung po 'bar ba'i gzi/ /rta ljang can gyis bzod par ma nus nas/ /bcu gnyis khyim gyi bgrod pa 'gog min zhes/ /'chi med lam du dal med rgyu ba bzhin/ /nor 'dzin skyong ba khyod dang yongs 'du'i ljon/ /'dod pa'i re ba skong la mtshungs gyur kyang / khyod ni —334

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pomakhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dpag bsam shing de sems med bem por nges/ /med byung mdzad bzang gis bskrun phan bde'i nor/ /gser ldan lto ba 'di na shong min zhes/ /sngon med nor 'dzin sprul pa'i cho ga la/ /'jig rten sa bon mngal ba'i khur gyil mnar/ /rtsod dus 'khor los sgyur rgyal mi 'byung zhes/ /gsung rab mang por bshad pa nges par rdzun/ /bden na legs byas rtsibs stong (74ba)srid rtsol na/ /'khor 'di kun gyis mngon sum mthong min nam/ /phan dang bde ba'i mchod sbyin brgya pa'i nor/ /rnam par 'byed mkhas nor 'dzin skyong ba'i lha/ /'jigs med gdong lngas bteg pa'i khri steng du/ /'gyur med rdo rje lta bur brtan par gsol/ /snyan dbang rin cen yol gor ci brtol gyi/ /tshig gi yul las 'gongs kyang dngos cag rnams/ /'degs pa'i yul dus pho nya'i ngag lam nas/ /'bul ba thugs kyi dpal ber gcags pa dang / ti shin tu snyan zhing rna bar 'jebs pa yi/ /phebs tshogs ka la ping ga'i gre 'gyur glu/ /chu klung skal ldan shing rta'i bgrod pa bzhin/ /'phrin yig las gsum dag tu 'bab pa zhu/ /spyan ras chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor dag /'char byed rten gyi gnam sngon zhu 'dra'i rdzing / /rgya yi āt+pal dmar pos legs spras te/ khrums stod zla ba'i yar tshes bzang por phul/ /sa glang pho brang chen po po ta lar don gnyer can mang po la 'dod chos bgyid skabs nyang stod gnas rnying zhabs drung khri pa blo bzang kun dga' bde legs rin cen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / bar khams nas ba so sprul pa'i sku gnyis kyis nged rang gi rnam thar zhig rtsom dgos tshul nan chas pas ngo ma bzlog par khas lan tsam byas pa/ slar lcags yos nang du ba so sprul sku ngag dbang chos kyi dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos tshigs su bcad pa'i 'phrin yig rtogs rjod yang skyor du bskul ba dang /dbang phyogs gong ma'i rgyal khab nas myur du ldog dgos pa'i lan skal bzang thog mar 'char ba'i skya rengs/ (75na〉pa ñjusar lha hā nya ku du mā la spyi yi rtsa li khri kyi be sto ra ka rta/ / 〉 bha lha ga mu tri tsa gu da yudha rma ga sa tsā sa ri pa la ṇ+ḍa zhu mo khye/ 'jam (sdeb sbyor dbang po rdo rje/ji byangs mkhyen pa'i gur kum gyis bran pa/ /phun tshogs rnam dpyod pir gyis bris pa las/ /chos phung rgya mtsho'i ri mo legs 'char ba'i/ /byed po rgyal ba kun dngos btsong kha pa/ /gang gi lugs bzang man+ta ra yi 'phreng / /thos bsam —335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)sgom pa'i cod pan la 'phyang ba/ /bshes gnyen 'tshe ba med pa'i me na gas/ /'phrin yig snyan pa'i glu dbyangs rna bar 'jibs/ /deng dus nyer len tsan dan nags kyi rlung / /lang tsho'i yal 'dab tshar du ches dngar zhing / /mkhas btsun bzang por grub pa'i dri bsung tshogs/ /snyan grags ma la ya myur dag gis drangs/ /bod chen mdo stod yangs pa'i nor 'dzin der/ /gzhan phan 'dren par rloms pa mang na yang / /'chad rtsod rtsom pas thub pa'i bstan pa mchog /'dzin mkhas shes ldan khyod du da gdod khums/ /(75ba tshe sho bor ba e raṇ+ḍa yi grib bsil la/ /gnas kyang 'gro la phan blo ma snyoms pa/ /rgya chen gnas lnga rig pa'i kun gsal mtha'/ /blo gros tshad kyis 'jal ba'i 'dun par mchis/ /gangs can dbus 'gyur lte ba po ta lar/ /blo gsal rgyu skar phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /bstan 'dzin nyin byed khyod gsung 'od rnon gyis/ /sgra 'dzin pad dkar tshal de ci yang 'dzum/ /rgyal kun gsang ba rab 'byams 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i snang ngor yongs 'dzin gzugs/ /ston mdzad sngon byon dam pa'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /rnam thar rjod pa yang dag don dang ldan/ /bdag 'dra'i snyigs dus bshes gnyen sha tshugs can/ /dug gsum bya ba'i ngan skyugs phung po la/ /ro brgya'i lha yi zas ltar sgro btags pas/ /rdzun gyi glegs bam skrun pa ngal ba'i gnas/ /'on kyang deng dus ha la'i za ma tog /'chi med bdud rtsi'i zol gyis su la pa'i/ /phan bde'i srog la rgol ba'i cho ga dag /rdzogs kyang legs pa'i lam du nyer sgrogs na/ /dal 'byor rten bzang zhing sa gshin po la/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i myu gu rab 'phel ba'i/ /bston med spyod tshul dbyar skyes gzhen nu yis/ shes ldan zhing pa'i gsos su cis mi 'jibs/ /de phyir snyan 'gyur shel gyi rtsig pa la/ /rtogs brjod gzugs brnyan 'bum phrag rab 'chang ba'i/ /sngon med glegs bam mgrin bcu'i pho brang zhig /myur du skrun pa'i 'dun pa mi dman yang / /don med g.yeng bas bskyod pa'i stong 'ur la/ /rnam dkar las su sgrog pa bla chen spyi'i/ /lugs srol g.yeng ba'i khol por bdag chud pas/ /sngon chad 'dri ba'i go skabs rnyed ma gyur/ /srid 'dir dkar nag las kyis 'phangs pa'i rten/ /thob pa'i snang tshul brjod na ha cang mangs/ /'di snang dge dang mi —336

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ḍa'adage bar ma'i tshul/ /kun rtog ri mor bris kyang pha mthas dben/ /drang po'i glang chen btang na tshul 'chos kyi/ /(7na sgodzes byed gtam gyis chu skyes 'dam ltar brdzi/ /'byog por brjod tshe g.yo sgyu'i zhags pa yis/ /bzang po'i rang bzhin ri dwags bcings kyi dogs/ shes ldan pad tshal rnam par bzhad dka' yang / khrel ba'i kun+da khong nas mi 'dzum pa'i/ /rtogs brjod sgeg mo'i 'gram pa'i char zil gyis/ /glegs bam ba ku la zhig myur du 'byed/ /'khon rigs 'jam dpal dpa' bo 'phagasapa dang / /pad dkar 'dzin dngos bsod nams rgya mtsho sogs/ /snying stobs mchogo gis 'gro ba 'dren pa dag /rgyal dang de sras rnams kyi rnam par thar/ /de lta na yang rnyed bkur grags 'dod phyir/ /stod smad rgyal khams myul nas gzhan don zhes/ /brjod tshe dngos kyang rtswa ṇa ra bgrod pa sogs/ /snang tshul 'di dang mthun snyam rnam par nongs/ /ci'i phyir ga song sdug bsngal me 'obs dong / /srid pa'i phun tshogs glog gi sgyu dra'i gar/ /mdo med dus kyi pho nya 'jigs bzhin du/ /blo dman bdag 'dra tshe 'di'i 'dun ma sgrub/ /rang nyid zhi bde tsam gyi gdengs med par/ /'gro rnams mngon mtho nges legs la sbyar zhes/ /don med mkha' la bris pa'i ri mo yis/ /rang gzhan gnyas ka slu ba'i byed por dogs/ /'on kyang rgyal ba'i bstan dang 'gro ba la/ /rab dkar lhag bsam zla ba gsar pa dag shar tshe rgud pa'i phun tshogs sel ba dang / /phan bde'i snang ba rgyas pa chos nyid yin/ /las rlung shing rta bdun pas nyer drangs te/ /mtha' 'khob thun 'tshams stegs la 'phags na yang / /ring min gangs can sa 'dir nyer spyod pa'i/ /skal ba bzang po'i skya rengs cis mi 'char/ /gleng 'os legs bshad gtam gyi gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /'phrin yig lam gsum dag las nyer drangs pas/ /ba rjesangs dri ma'i tshogs kun rab bkrus te/ /dge legs khyab 'jug zhabs bsil sgreng bar mdzod/ /(76ba'i mo rnyog bral rdzing bur 'char pa la/ /rung mthun rten gyi gnyis skyes lus dkar can/ /rtags kyi rkang gdub sil sgra 'brol bzhin du/ /bshul ring lam du bde bar dal kyis 'phur/ /gong du 'degs pa'i bshul du zhugs te stod lung phu'i na dkar ma zhes par sleb thog so zur gnubs gsum sngags pa'i rgyal —337

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)por grags pa'i nang tshan zur 'ug bya lung pas/ po brang chen po nas myur du ldog dgos pa'i tshigs bcad kyi 'phrin lan swā la'i pad tshal myur bzhad kyi bden gtam/ la sa / khri shā snya bha 'o nā ga tsa su sgru la : o dz+nyā nā kha tsa bad su sru gu bha/ /pra ( lwa PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBnā sto/ /phun (sdeb sbyor rma bya myos pa/)tshogs srid bzhi'i gtsug tor mthon po'i rtser/ /dge legs zhabasasen nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi/ /rab 'bar 'jig rten gsum gyi snang ba'i 'od/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso/ /(77na)gang de'i lugs 'dzin rig sngags 'chang ba'i khrod/ /bka' gter bshad sgrub rab snyan tshangs pa'i glu/ /mgrin par dbyangs su 'phrol ba'i byed pa po'i/ /'phrin yig rten gyi bdog pa sug par son/ /deng dus nyer len tsan dan nags kyi klung / /rgud pa'i grang reg dgra lasarnam rgyal zhing / /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i dri bsung rab spros pa'i/ /snyan grags ma la ya yi rlung gis drangs/ /thos bsam sgom la gzhol blo'i nyin byed bdag /sa dbang tshangs pa'i lung gi shing rta yis/ /drangs kyang swa la'i ljongs kyi pad+ma'i tshal/ /myur du phan bde'i 'dzum gyis bsu bar byed/ /'gro ba'i dbang por 'tsham pa'i theg pa'i chos/ /grangs med rdzing bu zla ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /'char yang snying po'i lam mchog nges gsang gi /rdo rje'i theg par grags las ga' na du ci/ /gsang chen cho me kyi bza' shing ra ba na/ /lhun grub snang bzhi'i lam gyi 'bras bu'i bcud/ /rab smin rdzogs pa che zhes dpag bsam gyi/ /yongs 'du'i ljon pa 'di ko bla na med/ /de phyir ka dag rig pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /lhun grub zhi khro rab 'byams 'od lnga'i klong / /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las 'ja' tshon rab 'byug pa/ /gang shar rig pa'i rtsal du rdzogs 'di mtshar/ /lam bzang 'di la brten nas grub brnyes khyod/ /snga 'gyur rdzings kyis grangs med lus can kun/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las rab bsgral te/ /kun bzang rin cen gling du 'khrid par rigs/ /'phros 'os gtam gyi dbyangs can 'phang 'gro'i sgra/ /dam pa'i chos dang 'brel ba'i rgyud mang por/ /nye bar drangs pa'i chad med bya ma rta/ /yan lag brgyad ldan rgyun la 'gran par 'tshal/ /ri mo dal gyis rgyu ba'i gnyas 'thung dbang / /rten gyi rin (77bcun dra ba'i gdong g.yogs —338

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pecan/ /snyan 'gyur tshig gi spu sdug bkra bzhin du/ /nub phyogs chu lha'i ngos kyang phang bar song / /sgar chen byang phyogs 'bri chu'i 'gram du 'byor thog mdo stod kyi bla dpon sogs mchog dman mang po dang lhan cig bar khams ri bo che nas stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub kyi phyag mdzod pa ngag dbang bzang sbyin byung skabs bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan du myur bar ldog dgos tshul gyi chab shog tshigs bcad kyi 'phreng bar spel ba'i lan brtan bde'i 'od snang gsal ba'i thun la mos/ ā :nye 〈 li spro du po 'i yu ba rgyu ka rdza bha — nā da tsa sto hā ru ta tswa lha ka/ be+es rwa dz+nyā ba r+ya tsa ཿ tā tsa stu ta tswa 〉 〉 le mi ཿ tsa ka ska la ju ba sa rnye/ /ngo (sdeb sbyor rma bya myos pa/sgo tshar mtshan dpe'i lang tsho dar ba'i sku/ /gzhom du med pa na da'i sgra dbyangs gsung / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa mchog gi thugs/ /grub rigs rgya mtsho'i dpyid du gyur de'i drung / /(78na)rgyal kun zad mi shes pa'i 'phrin las gzugs/ /gang gi rmad byung mdzad pa'i ā dar+shar/ /'gog med shar ba'i snyan 'gyur dbyangs kyi sgra /rna ba'i bcud len gyur chinas ma da 'di gsol/ /ring min rnam par dge ba'i dus kyi char/ /gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gar/ /grangs med gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa'i ngor/ /'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i skal bzang de med byung / /phun tshogs bkra shis ri mo g.yas 'khyil ba'i/ /ma smad dam pa'i mgrin pa gzengs mthon po'i/ /zab rgyas legs par bshad pa bka' mchid gtam/ /bdog pa'i skyes dang lhan cig sug par smin/ /thos bsam bsgom la mos pa'i blor ldan yang / /don med rnam g.yeng gzeb tu nyer chud pa'i/ /za hor rigs kyi sdom brtson klog pa mkhan/ khams gzugs tshogis pa ma gyes tsam du mchis/ /rab 'byams chos kun 'jal ba'i mkhyen dpyod can/ /ma 'dris 'gro la brtse ba'i byams pa'i dpung / /nag phyogs phye mar 'thag pa'i mthu stobs can/ /rigs gsum mgon yang khyod kyi mdzad par rdzogs/ /dpal ldan thang pa'i sgrub rgyud shing rta che/ /phyogs der dus kyis bskal pa'i 'dam rdzab las/ /'dren pa'i byed por dus gsum rgyal ba rnams/ /ngur smrig gar gyis rol las gzhan du ci/ /mdo smad bstan pa'i nags klung stug po'i dbus/ /tshul 'chos 'khyog po'i tsher rnon ches mang yang / /phan bde'i dri bsung spro ba'i tsan dan ljon/ /mkhas dbang —339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)khyod du nges zhes lha rnams gleng / /sngon byon 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa sogs/ /zhabs sen ma yi tshangs pa'i cod pan du/ /'god de nyi ma'i gnyen gyis 'chi med gtso'i/ /gtsug gi rgyan du gshegs de'i dpe zlar 'os/ /de lta na yang mang du ma thos shing / /de don bsam dang (78bsgom lam yol ba yi/ /bdag 'dras yar lta'i tshul du mig lta ba/ /pha bang mkha' lding dbang por 'gran par bzhin/ /zhi bder gnas pa'i gdeng tsam mi ldan par/ /rgya chen g.yin phan bsgrub ces stong 'ur gyis/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka slu ba'i chu dong la/ /snyan grags phub mas g.yogs 'di skal ba phra/ /bzod dka' ngan song sdug bsngal me 'obs dong / /srid 'byor glog gi bu mo'i gar mkhan ma/ /longs med tshe 'di chu bur ltar mthong yang / /skal dman bdag 'dra don med bya bas g.yengs/ /ltar snang g.yin phan smig rgyus ri dwags kyi/ /gtan bde'i sī tā 'phrog pa'i byed po la/ /chen po'i rnam par thar zhes rlom pa 'di/ /dal 'byor stong par yol ba'i blo brid mkhan/ /'on kyang chab shog pad dkar dga' tshal du/ /'phral yun dge bar 'gyur ba'i gtam snyan po'i/ /ze'u 'bru dgod 'di gzhan gyi dbugs dbyung ba'i/ /bden pa rnams kyi thabs mkhas gsung du nges/ /de lta na yang lhag bsam 'od dkar gyis/ /dbang phyogs tshangs pa'i mdun sa'i mun bsal nas/ /med byung kha ba'i ljongs kyi lha lam ngos/ /gtan bde'i snang ba 'gyed la rangs par mchis/ /slad mar bka' mchid me tog man+ta ra/ /snyim pa'i thod du bcings pa'i bya ma rta/ /mdo stod nor 'dzin sa yi bshul lam nas/ /nam yang chad pa med par rgyu bar zhu/ /snyan tshig dpyid kyi pho nyas legs bos pa'i/ /'phrin yig ljon shing lang tsho rgyas pa la/ /rten gyi lo 'dab phang phung g.yo bzhin du/ /byang phyogs lo hi rta yi 'gram nas phul/ /bod yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta smon 'gro lo tsā ba rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa gang rgya gar gyi paṇa chen pa la bha dra sogs la brten nas brda sprod kyi gzhung lugs la blo gros mchog tu yangs pa stag lung lo tsā ba dbu ma chos mdzad kyi 'phrin lan don gyi blo ldan phur bu/ (79na) o da yi su gu sta tsa shā ba bha ba dha to sa rbe rtsi sto wa ba ri na mā tsa swā tsā.ā mā rta da dzi ཿ sha ba la tsā ba rā kra mu tswa zwa dzi /shu bha 7 shā rka ba sa yas srid (sdeb —34(/

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (posbyor rang dga' ༅/〉zhi khams na dar ba'i dge legs kyi/ /dngos po kun gyis yongs su btung bya'i gnas/ /stobs bcu'i rtsal gyis bdud las rgyal ba'i mgon/ /rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyis dge legs stsol/ /deng dus rnam smin dkar por 'khyil ba yis/ /nyer len 'o mtshor rnyog ma'i dri bral zhing / /thos bsam sgom pa'i gnyen skyes 'khor lo'i lag /legs bshad rkang gdub sil sgra 'brol ba'i ngos/ /blo gros mgrin pa'i pi wang brdungs pa las/ /'phrin yig dbyangs kyi rgyal mo snyan pa'i tshig /nyams dang 'gyur ba stong gi ro mngar ba/ /'di na thos 'dzin dga' ba'i gsos su 'jebs/ /zin med g.yeng ba'i shing rtas nyer drangs kyang / /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa la/ /mi dman sngon med nyin mor byed pa bdag /rgud pa'i chu 'dzin las rgyal bde bar (79bsgo chis /nges don grub pa'i sti gnas sman ljongs der/ /legs sbyar skad kyi 'gyur khugs snyan sgrog pa/ /sgra sgyur 'jig rten mig gcig ko gi la/ khyod min gnyis pa gzhan zhig gang du mchis/ /rgya chen gsung rab kun gyi zhus chen la/ /zla med chos skyong bzang por grags de rdzun/ /bden na brda sprod gtsug lag mtha' klas par/ /smra ba'i dpyod ldan khyod nyid su yis bskrun/ /rig gnas rgya mtsho'i rin cen 'phreng ba yis/ /legs spud don gyi paṇa chen smon 'gro ba/ /tshe dbang don kun grub pa'i legs bshad rgyun/ /'dzin pa'i byed por tshangs pas khyod nyid bskos/ /don gyi gnad la ma rmongs sgra rig pa'i/ /chos kun 'khrul med sgro 'dogs legs bcad nas/ /gnyug ma la ga kha sems kyi gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /nges don rgya mtshor 'bab pa zlog nus su/ /deng dus thos bsam dri bsung mi ldan yang / /sgom chen rgan po'i rdzuba'i 'dzin stangs kyi/ /lce gnyis brang 'gros lkod pa'i tsher ma'i shing / /tshad ldan tsan dan gral du bsgrig pa mang / /sdom brtson thos pa'i dka' thub nyer zhig kyang / /stobs 'byor gya gyu'i 'dren byed legs sbar mes/ /gzhan sde'i 'dod lha sreg pa'i cho ga dag /rdzogs pa'i gtsug na zla ba ci yang snang / /'on kyang thos pa'i cha shas kun gang zhing / /bsam pa'i ri dwags mtshan mas rab mdzes pa/ /sgom pa'i 'od dkar spro ba'i zla ba khyod/ /mthong tshe snying gi mun pa cis mi sel/ /mi bsrun tshangs pa'i 'khor lo —341—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebazhi ldan gyis/ /thang pa'i bka' rgyud khyab 'jug mgrin bcad tshe/ /'chi gsos bdud rtsi ster ba'i byed po yi/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa yang dag don gyi mchog /yi ge gser gyi gdu bu can/ /snyan 'gyur pad kor rab mdzes pa/ /don bzang mdzas sdug 'chi med kyi/ /lus(80na)phra'i gar gyis phyogs kun rol/ /sang rag thags su btags pa yis/ /pañca li rka'i stod g.yogs can/ /don gyi blo ldan phur bu de/ /snyan tshig mdongs mtha' zhon nas song / /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu sbrul lor bris pa'i chab re/ga 'phrin yig khag /chu sprul gyi lo pho brang chen po nas bteg skabs gong nas khe shing gi ching dbang ta'i ga'i gzims khang gsar pa'i bar skyel mar btang ba phyir log pa dang mnyam du bsod nams dbang rgyal btang ba'i zhu yig mes po'i khengs pa 'gugs pa'i dbyar rnga/ pu / suwa : shu sa ra sa ha sra 5 la su la 〉 ba le no dwa ra su ma hā : ha 'u mo/ /tsa ཿ ṇa biwa rje rna rā 6 de tsho ma ji stokho t+ta ma hā rwa ( spru la bsod nams gser sbyangs rtsibs stong 'bar ba yi/ /phun tshogs stobs kyis yangs pa'i sa chen por/ /'khor los rnam par sgyur ba'i mi yi lha/ /'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po chen po drung / /(80bzhang dus legs byas bye ba'i chu gter las/ /mdzes sdug gzugs sku'i snang brnyan ri bong 'dzin/ /mi mthun chu 'dzin rnyog mas ma gos pa/ /ngo mtshang rna ba'i dga' ston 'gyed las ci/ /pho brang khang bzang mes po'i zhal gyi sgo/ /grangs med sde bzhi'i nor bu'i 'byung gnas can/ /gser mngal can gyis khengs pa'i rgyud 'gugs pa'i/ /byed por gnam nas 'ongs pa khyod min su/ /de phyir gser ldan dga' ma'i khor yug gi /phang par gnas pa'i mnga' 'bangs skye bo kun/ /phan dang bde ba'i rdzogs ldan dga' ston la/ /'god par rigs so nor 'dzin skyong ba'i lha/ /rgyu skar sa la bkram pa'i grong khyer dbus/ /phun tshogs gser gyi pho brang nyams —342

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pedaga' bar/ /mi rje lha yi rgyal po chen po khyod/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khri la brtan par gsol/ /ri mo gnam sngon bzhu 'dra'i rdzing bu la/ /spyan ras zla snang dbang pos btsa' ba'i rten/ /rtse mo grangs dang ldan pa'i bdog pa la/ /rtags kyi lang tsho gsal bar bkod nas phul/sgri lig cu nang sol springs pa sgo nga'i sbubs nas lha sgos ba'i skad snya/ a blu ma hā su kha ja ma ku yu ba rgyapu sna ni skyu nu bya lhan ni mi ta tsa nyu r+sha ri re/ /ta bla /ni spro sa khyu ra ma ka byi go ྅so / de khya tsi t+ta ma sha ra khyu tsa ra spu ta rta/ /(81na)zung (sdeb sbyor dpyid kyi thig le/〉〈cog sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bde ba che/ /mtshan dpe lang tsho sa rgyas pa' gar mkhan can/ /thub dbang de'i gsung chos dang slob mar bcas/ /skyabs mchog bslu ba med pas khyod la srungs/ /skye bar goms pa'i legs byas sa bon mchog /rab smin dal ba'i rten bzang tsan dan ljon/ /blang dang dor bya'i dri bsung spro bzhin du/ /bde ba'i lo 'dab g.yur du za la ci/ /dam pa'i chos kyi blo gros zla ba'i gzugs/ /dri med rnam dpyod rdzing bur legs shar bas/ /dal 'byor 'dab gzhog rgyas pa'i ngang pa khyod/ /dge sbyor mgrin pa'i rnga dbyangs sgrogs 'di mtshar/ khyim gzugs sgo nga'i sbugs rgya ma grol bar/ /yang dag skad snyan 'byin pa khyod mthong tshe/ /mu cor sgra yis rna ba gtser byed pa'i/ /'tshamasasprin gos can phal cher ngur pa'i khyu/ /cal sgrog ri dwags rjes su mi snyeg par/ /bla med theg pa mchog nas 'dul ba'i bar/ /'khrul med nyams len gnad kyi sī tā ma/ /rnam par skyongs shig blo ldan dga' byed lha/ /slad mar mi bskyud 'phros 'os gtam gyi chu/ /chad med gaṅgā'i rjes su 'gro bzhin du/ /rnyed dka' brtse ru lta bu'i dal ba'i rten/ /yun du 'tsho zhing skyong ba'i thabs 'bad gces/ /mi mthun rgud pa'i mun tsho gos 'joms byed pa/ /dam rdzas byin rlabs kun 'dus ril bu dang / /srung ba sra mkhregs rdo rje'i mdud pa la/ /'tshams sprin rtags kyi lang tsho 'khyud nas song / /gnas chung na chos rgyal chen po rdo rje'i gsung 'phrin snga phyir byung ba'i lan rma chu'i 'gram nas dar gan nang so rdzangs dusaphul spu yid bsto char 'bebs/ (81ba tsā ni khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ khams gsum 343

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyezil gnon srid gsum dbang du sdud/ /yid bzhin nor ltar grub kun kun stsol ba'i/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos pad+ma 'byung gnas rgyas/ /gang de'i bka' sdod sge brgyad dregs pa'i gtso/ /dpal ldan sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po yi/ /rdo rje'i tshig gi ri mo snga phyi dang / /nyams med sug par son pa'i spro ba 'phel/ /'gyangs med kha ba'i ljongs su 'byor pa sogs/ /sngar bcol 'phrin las ma lus grub pa yis/ /dam can bsten pa'i dgos pa don ldan zhes/ /nges rnyed dga' ba'i gar stabs ci yang sgyur/ /slar yang bdag cag bshul du zhugs pa yi/ /bar chad nyes pa'i tshogs kun sel ba dang / /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde legs spel zhing / khyab bdago bla ma zung 'jug zhabs brtan mdzod/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi srung ba'i rwa bar du/ /bcug rnams nyin mtshan g.yel med skyob pa dang / /ma rung bsam ngan 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /gang du 'dug kyang snying khrag gzhal du gsol/ /spyan gzigasasnyan shal sna lnga gser skyems dang / /go mtshon cang shes rta dang phyi nang du/ /bcas te hor zla drug pa'i gral tshes la/ /phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i sgar nas dge /bod nas mchod yon gyi mi snar sgo mang zur pa slob dpon ngag dbang dpal 'byor dang / dar gan nang so gnyis ta'i rgar 'byor skabs zur chen mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug khyab bdag bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi snyan tshig lan chos srid bdag por bkur ba'i gtso yā gnam gyi she mong / (82na tshe ska kṛ tho 'i rgyu dha ra 5 dza ya ho sa khyu tri ga ཿ su tsab sbra ni rti/ /tri ཿ la pa dha ka ra ā sa mā dzā sna tswa ni rwa bh+yo ga spo si rnyi la smo /rgyal sdepo sbyor nye dbang rdo rje/ba kun gyi gsang gsum rdo rje gar/ /'chi med rig 'dzin grub pa'i ngo mtshar can/ /rtsa gsum kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /dngos grub stsol la don rnams lhun grub mdzod/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mgon de'i lugs 'dzin pa/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpyid/ /zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gdung gsob de'i/ /ri mo dbyangs can mgrin par chags pa'i glu/ /zab don gter kyi sgo 'byed sangs gling pa'i/ /phyag sor las grub bla ma yab yum sku/ /kong chen 'jigs med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /'bral spangs srung bar mdzad pa'i rten bcas 'byor/ /deng dus gsang —344

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pegasum 'jigs med rdo rje'i khams/ /lhun grub bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing / /theg (82ba)mchog chos kyis 'gro kun smin grol la/ /legs bkod snyan pa'i gtam 'di rna bar 'jibs 'di na za hor rigs kyi sdom bu ba/ /sgyu lus dus kyi zhags pas ma bcings shing / shar phyogs rgyal po'i khab las phyir bteg nas/ /dbus 'gyur gangs can phyogs der 'ong skabs yin/ /gnam gyis bskos pa'i 'jam dbyangs gong ma zhes/ /sa la mngon sum rgyu ba'i tshangs pa des/ /dngos cag nub phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams kyi/ /chos srid bdag por lung dang las gas bskur/ /tshul 'di snying nas chos la nyer gzhol ba/ /sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar ma lags kyang / /deng dus go sa lhur len rang gzhan gyi/ /bla chen phal kyi 'thob min gnas shig yin/ /'on kyang srid pa'i phun tsho gos glog gi gar/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bzod dka' can/ /theg mchog chos kyi snying po rnyed dka'i don/ shes rnams tshulu 'dir a 'thas dga' ba ci/ /de ltar snga phyir 'gyur ba'i rdo rje'i theg /zab mo'i chos kyis rang gzhan don sgrub par/ /gcig tu mos pa'i ā wa dhū tī pa/ /'di snang chos brgyad bya bsa'aching nus min/ /bgrang bya'i glegs bam brag ri ltar brtsegs kyang / /tshe 'di'i bya gzhag gzhon nu'i ngang tshul can/ /zhabrul pa'i 'bod grogs ri dwags rjes snyeg rnams/ /mthong tshe kho bo gtan gyi gi tā gnyer/ /dbyar gyi srin bu'i grangs la co 'dri ba'i/ /skad dang lugs srol mi gcig skye rgu rnams/ /sdig spong dge ba bsgrub pa rdzogs ldan gyi/ /sngon med dga' ston mchog la ci yang sbyar/ /'on kyang deng dus rgya hor yul gru kun/ /mda' lnga snying la phog pa'i bshes gnyen dang / /blun po rdzun dang zog gi 'khrul 'khor can/ /mu stegs kla klo'i lugs srol sogs(83na sta)sa gang / /de phyir dri ma med pa'i thub pa'i bstan/ /tshul bzhin gnas pa kha ba'i sman ljongs las/ /rgyal khams ga' na du med par nges rnyed na/ /phyogs der bgrod par mi rings shes ldan su/ /'khyog 'gro blo yi lce gnyis rkyong nus pa/ /rang gzhan phung 'tshengs sgrub pa'i rnam thar 'ga'i/ /rjes su 'jug na srin bu'i byin sha gang / /'dar byed mtha' 'khob yul la dga' srid kyang / /dngos cag mkhan slob chos gsum bzhed pa ltar/ /—345

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)ru bzhi'i rgyal khams bde ba sgrub pa'i khur/ /'dzin la gzhan 'phrul dbang po 'ga' 'khu yang / /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus dgyes sam snyam/ /ut+pal ze'u 'bru dgod pa'i nags klung la/ /rkang drug bung ba ring nas 'du byed kyang / /dus kun lhan cig gnas pa'i sbal pa dag /ci yang mi sems rang gi ngang tshul yin/ /lho phyogs ma la ya yi dga' tshal du/ /skyes pa'i rkang 'thung 'phreng ba ches phra yang / /tshad pa'i gdung ba sel ba'i dri bsung dag /'bad med shugs las 'byung ba chos nyid yin/ /gang gi legs par bshad pa'i ri mo la/ /bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i mgrin pa las/ /nyams dang 'gyur ba'i ro ldan 'phrin yig tu/ /mngon rjes tshad mas sgrub nus don de bzhin/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa rgyal ba'i sku/ /jo shāka rang byon 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / /'phrul snang bsam yas la sogs stod smad kyi/ /phan bde'i rtsa lag chos 'khor gtsug lag khang / /u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling gi rjes 'gro ba'i/ /mtsho skyes rdo rjes byin brlabs gsang ba'i gnas/ /thub bstan spyi dang kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /lugs 'dzin 'dus pa sde yis sa gzhi khyab/ /ris med dam pa'i cho so kyi bdud rtsi yis/ /yid la kun nas dga' ba'i mchog sbyin mkhan/ khyab bdag 'khor (83ba〉('i dbang phyug zung du 'jug /mkhas grub bstan 'dzin rgyu skar lta bur 'khrigs/ /sa spyod mchod yon nyi zla zung gcig sogs/ /bstan la ri mor bgyid pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag /chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi dpe zla yis/ /gser ldan ma de'i lto ba dog por byas/ /de phyir lcag gis yang yang nyer bskul ba'i/ /cang shes rlung gi shugs la 'gran bzod par/ /brten nas dbus 'gyur chos kyi mdun sa cher/ /myur sleb bag phebs gleng mo zhib tu byed/ /rab dkar thags su byas pa'i ngos yangs steng / /phun tshogs rin cen mchog gi gar bu can/ /gsang ba sngags kyi grangs 'dzin brgya rtsar bcas/ /chu stod zla ba sngon ma'i tshes la bris/ /snar chen gong nas 'khor te mtsho khri shog rgyal mo'i byang phyogs rang byung khrus kyi rdzing bu'i 'gram du 'byor thog bod kyi che rgu'i bsu ba sleb pa'i stag lung zhabs drung ma chen gyi chab shog lan pa sti'i sgra dbyangs/lha yu da yi sto ni mi ta bha ཿ 5kri gaphya ṅgā tu sto yu ba rtse/ /su dha tsho la spru la sto ma hā ra 〉 tsa ni ka r+ya ba rti rwa lha/ /—346

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('a(84na)rgyal (sdeb sbyor rma bya'i 'gros/) kun gsang ba gsum gyi dbyings/ /mtshan bzang lang tsho dar ba'i dpal/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar mkhan can/ /sgrub rgyud shing rta chen po'i drung / /deng dus dag pa don dam mi zad pa'i/ /'khor lo'i mdzod du 'byor pa'i dbang phyug kyang / /kun rdzob sgyu mar snang ba'i gzugasakyi sku/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i dpal la spyod pa'i ngos/ /snga phyir gnang ba'i ra shog dri za'i rgyud/ /nyams ldan 'bum phrag 'dzag pa'i glu dbyangs can/ /pho nya bgrod pa'i byed pos 'gog med du/ /sug par son tshe yid dang rna ba'i gsos/ /rnam dpyod sgro gzhog phra yang brtson 'grus kyi/ /sgo nga'i sbubasanas lnga rig snyan 'gyur sgra /sgrog pa'i sdom brtson gnyis skyes klog pa mkhan/ /ngoms med thos bsam sgom la gzhol blor mchis/ /gangs can ngo bo'i cha shas shar gyi phyogs/ /phyag rgya'i grub rigs du ma'i sti gnas che/ /tshang tshing 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i sman ljongs der/ /'khor lo'i bya bas mdzes zhes gtam du gleng / /brnag dka' bdud rigs nyer 'tshe'i chu gter nang / /thang pa'i ring lugs nor 'dzin bying gyur tshe/ /snying stobs rus sbal khur gyis 'degs nus pa'i/ /sngon med tha gu'i lto can khyod min su/ /mkhyen yangs zur phud lnga pa'i rjes 'gro zhing / /brtse chen phyag na pad+ma'i ngang tshul 'dzin/ /mthu stobasalag na rdo rje rab 'khu ba/ /deng dus bshes gnyen tshul du rol min nam/ /rim brgyud chos kyi bgrod pa'i ltos min rnams/ /gcig shes kun grol rnam rtog cho me kyi skur/ /nges pa'i ring lugs mtha' klasa'agro ba la/ /spel pa'i byed po deng dus khyod min su/ /mnyam med dwags po'i lung rtogs bstan pa'i mkhar/ /bstan 'dzin nyin mor byed pa'i dbang phyug khyod/ /rta ljang (84bsko dong lngas bteg pa'i khri steng du/ /nam yang 'gyur ba med par brtan par gsol/ /ri mo gsum pa'i ṛ ṣi yi/ /ngo mtshar lasa'ongs phebs tshogis kyi/ /yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i klung / /bdud rtsi'i dpyid du grub par mdzod/ /rjod byed mdongs mtha' la bzhen ga rti ka /don bzang su sti'i sgra dbyangs sgrog pa can/ /bdog pa'i glegs bam sug par thogs bzhin du/ khar lho 'dzin ma'i bshul ring lam du bskyod/ /rtog lung zhabs drung ma chen gyi khams ri bo che nas ga lung lo tsā ba skar chen bod du 'byor pa'i legs skyes dang bcas byung ba'i —347

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheskabs kyi chab shog gi lan mya ga med pa'i spun zla/ sa ba dzi rwa PROBPROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBba sa /n+ta sa sku pa shā zwa da mu ku rdo gre pa ri sa : ku lu tsa sa la/ /rgyal sdeb sbyor gser ldan/ba kun gyi gsang ba gsum/ /'tshams sprin gos kyi zlos gar can/ /grub rigs yongs kyi cod pan rtser/ /zhabs kyi chu skyes 'god mdzad drung / /(85na)deng dus skye rgu'i bsod nams chu gter las/ /legs 'ongs mtshan dpe'i ri dwags snang brnyan can/ /rmad byung gzugs sku chu shel dbang po dag /rgyal bstan mkha' la 'gog med 'char ba'i ngos/ /bka' tham legs bshad ga bur gzigs ma 'bum/ /nyams 'gyur tshigs su bcad pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdag yid ut+pal khong nas 'dzum pa dang / /skyesabazang snang bas kun gsal lhan cig gyur/ /mang du thos kyang sgrub pa'i skal ba dag /ches phra zin bral rnam g.yeng gzeb chud pa'i/ /klog pa mkhan yang 'tsho ba bde ba'i ngos/ /dbus 'gyur chos kyi mdun sar slebs skabs yin/ /ring min dus su hor dang rgya nag po'i/ /grangs med yul gru'i bkod pa dge mtshan dang / /'jam dbyangs gong ma'i gtsug lag lugs brgya'i sgo /ltad mo skabs gsum grong la co 'dri byas/ /mchog dman bar ma'i skye rgu'i zhing sa la/ /mngon par mtho dang nges legs sa bon tshogs/ /bskrun pas rnam smin dkar po 'dzag pa yi/ /ngo mtshar 'bras bu'i snye ma g.yur za ldem/ /gang gi 'phrin las nyi ma 'bum gyi gzis/ /tshang ching stug pos bskor ba'i ri bo'i ngogs/ /rmongs chen mun gsal sgrub rgyud pad dkar tshal/ /rgyas zhes phyogs bral sgeg mo dbyangs su len/ /'dus sde'i kun dga' ra ba dri gtsang khang / /sku gsung thugs rten bzhed dang gso ba sogs/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor los mya pha med/ /swā la'i ljongs 'dir 'ongs las gzhan du ci/ /kun rdzob spros pa'i chos kyi rlabs 'phreng rnams/ /gnyug ma sems kyi rgya mtshor ro gcig pa'i/ /phyag chen bstan pa spel la mi la rje/ /bsams bzhin ga zi'i rgyud du byon par nges/ /ring min dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing (85ba khoms su/ /phebs tshul tam+bu ra yi dbyangs snyan po/ /rna ba bdud rtsir byas dang lhan cig tu/ /yid la kun dga' skyed pa'i gsos su 'thebs/ /pañca li ga'i gos bzang lhab lhab can/ /'gyur khug mgrin pa'i dril —348

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la wen yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('chung legs 'khrol ba//a 'dus ka 'phreng ldan pa'i gar mkhan zhig/nges don grub pa'i gnas su bde bar song //rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing rta lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag/shing rta bzhi mo tshal nas tshangs pa dung thod can gyis sku rim bskul ba'i lan byin za nyal 'gror sgyur ba'i zhakhrul 'khor/srid dang zhi ba'i dge legs kun gyi gter//rig 'dzin pad+ma'i bka' srung dung thod can//gang gi rdo rje'i gsang ba'i gsung gi tshig/lha dang rten dang bcas pa nyams med 'byor//bstan dang de 'dzin mchod yon mtha' dag gi/mi mthun g.yul las rgyal ba'i rim gro'i tshogs//ji bzhin tshad med snyan cing 'jebs pa'i glu//dngos kyi ngag nas nan tan skul ma byed//slad nas sngon gyi dam tshig ma g.yel bar//zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun sgrub pa'i rten//rab dkar bkra shis dar gyi snyan shal bcas//dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde nas dge/gong du 'gro skabs bsam yas gnod sbyin chen por 'phrin las bcol pa rnams lhun gyis grub pa'i gtang rag phul ba'i 'phrin du gsolas bas mas pa yid bsto grub pa'i gad brgyangs/e ma ngo mtshar phul byung rgyal ba'i bstan//bsrung bar zhal bzhes rdo rje dam tshig can//bstan bsrung sprul pa'i chos kyi rgyal po mchog/dpal ldan gnod sbyin chen po deng 'dir dgongs//sngar bcol don kun thogs med grub pa dang //da 'chol 'phrin las gnyer du gtad pa'i phyir//lha rdzas gos bzang go mtshon gser skyems sogs//86na rdo/na bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis dgyes par mdzod//'chi med ro brgya'i bcud ldan btung ba'i mchog/tshe ring don dang ldan pa rgya ja'i bcud//snang srid dregs pa'i gtso bor legs 'bul na//'dod pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod//bstan dang bstaX 'dzin 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel//ma rung bsam

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2cesbyor 'chang ba'i dgra dpung choms/ /nag po bdud kyi ru mtshon sa la stol/ /dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i rdza rnga cher sgrogs shig /khyad par bod 'bangs phan bde'i 'od gsal bar/ /gnod byed g.yin 'phrul dbang po'i mun pa kun/ /dregs pa'i ded dpon nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi/ /rab tu 'bar ba'i mthu yis pha mthar sprod/ /rgyal dbang pad+mas dam bsgrags nyer dgongs la/ /rigs dang rgyud nas mchod pa'i lha khyod kyis/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /lhun grub yid bzhin nor bu lta bur mdzod/ /bkra shis 'byung ba gsum dang ldan pa yi/ /ljon shing 'dab ma'i sos gyon rgyal ba'i lo/ /nyin byed bum par spyod pa'i zla ba la/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde nas dge /sgar chen gong du 'degs skabs thang po cher rigs kyi srung ma bshan pa lag dmar la 'phrin las bcol ba rnams grub pa'i gtang rag 'phrin du gsol ba mthu stobs 'phrul gyi re skong / mthu stobs 'phrul gyis g.yin sde dpa' bkong par/ /dbang phyug lta bur phyogs las rnam rgyal ba/ /pha mes brgyud pa'i srung ma mthu rtsal can/ /bstan srung bshan pa lag dmar deng 'dir dgongs/ /sngon nas gnyer du gtad pa'i las sgrub cing / /slar yang 'phrin las 'chol bar byed pa'i rten/ /gser skyems lha rdzas go mtshon rgya ja sogs/ /rmad byung mchod pa'i tshogs rnams dgyes par bzhes/ /yid 'ong rab dkar snod du legs gtams pa'i/ /(86ba)phun tshogs ro brgya'i dpal kun 'dzin pa'i ja/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor rab 'khyil ba/ /bstan srung dbang po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas/ /'gro ba rnams kyang dga' skyid longs su spyod/ /rig 'dzin bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las kun/ /bsam pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ngo mtshang kun nas dga' ba'i zhal gyi khyim/ /ngom pa'i 'byung ba gsum ldan shing rta yi/ /rta chen zla ba'i gral tshes dus dge bar/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde nas dge /gong nas ra chen bod du skyel ba dang / bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal por lung la gnang bar/ ji bla ma/ dar gan chos rje/ gtsang pa dka' bce/ nar nu dor gi e bha/ shu byi thar dor gi e bha/ mang khas rdzar go chi/ nor ras jo ra go chi/ rbi chi mā che/ rje red sogs phyir —350

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('a'adegs skabs/ rta 'bul nang sodang / lcang lo can dka' bcu ngag dbang nor bzang gnyis btang ba'i zhu yig 'khor / ba'i rang gzugs/ la ཿ bi dza bya su ma tā sa na : bu ṇ+ḍa pa smra gu shā ka ra ga : de wa : bra h+ma ṇalo ka sku rmi du hwa PROBPROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBPROB PROBPROB/ /(87na)phun (spyosbyor da4 po rdo rje/)tshogs rnam par rgyal ba'i khri chen por/ /legs byas pa da dkar mngal las mthon pa'i lha/ /'jig rten byed po tshangs pa mi gzugs can/ /'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i zhabs drung du/ /gangs can nor 'dzin dpal mo'i lto ba na/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dri med bstan pa la/ /thos bsam sgom par mos blo'i sdom bu pa/ /sdom brtson klog pa mkhan des mchid 'di zhu/ /dus kyi bdag por gnam gyi she mong gis/ /mngon par dbang bskur phyogs las rnam rgyal ba/ /'jigs med rdo rje'i rigs ldan 'khor lo'i dpung / /dbang phyug yon tan grub pa'i lha khyod gson/ /deng dus sku gsung thugs gyi 'od dkar can/ /nyer 'tshe nam mkha'i glang po rgyang bsring shing / /'dzam gling skye rgur sde bzhi'i mchog stsol ba'i/ /'bum phrag ga bur zegs ma spro las ci/ /yab mes tha'i sun rim byon nyi 'og gi /stobs kyi rgyal por rtsod pa med pa'i lha/ /'chi med dbang po'i bzhul du gshegs pa'i tshe/ /phun tsho gos srid zhi'i gdugs dkar khyod la gtad/ /lhag par tshangs dang khyab 'jug gtsug na zla/ /rnam gsum gcig tu bgros nas rtsod dus kyi/ /'khor los sgyur pa'i rgyal por mnga' gsol bas/ /sems med nor 'dzin ma yang rjes su 'breng / /gang gi gzi brjid 'bar ba'i mkha' lding gis/ /grags pa'i mu khyud mgrin sngon rgyan gyi sprul/ /'jigs te bshol med tshogs bdag gsang ba'i rnar/ /zhugs tshe lha rnams ba 'ad gad cis mi sgrog /ka ba med pa'i gnam gyi sgo phye nas/ /srab med seng ge 'phyo ba'i brtul zhugs can/ /dbang phyug 'khor wa rgyal zhabs kyi rdul/ /spyi bor mi 'dzin srid gsum 'di na su/ /'jig rten 'jig pa tsam gyi drag shul dpung / /yan lag bzhi ldan mtshon cha'i (87ba thabs kyi/ /phye mar btag snyam mtho ris them skas la/ /'dzegs zhes rig byed smra 'ga' dar dir gleng / /cung zad bsten kyang 'dod pa'i re ba kun/ /'bad med stsol la gnas pa'i dbang phyug dang / /—351

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyeyongs 'du'i ljon gnyis so sor dbye ba'i sgo /blo ldan phur bus dpyad kyang rtogs nus min/ /mi bsrun dgra dpung 'dul la rdo rje thog /mnga' 'bangs byams pas skyong la 'jig rten dbang / /srid zhi'i gtsug lag mkhyen la 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /skye rgu'i bsod nams dpal du deng 'dir grub/ /lha gcig lung gi mthun rkyen shing rta yis/ shar nus bshul ring kun gsal 'gram pa la/ /ngos rnams bde bar 'grod nas dbus 'gyur 'chang / /gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i spo la slebs skabs yin/ /gtan bde'i don bzang sgrub pa dam pa'i chos/ /'di snang phun tshogs spel ba rgyal po'i khrims/ /zung 'brel mdzad pa rgya mtshos mtha' klas pa'i/ /'gro rnams phan bder sbyor ba'i khur chen mdzod/ /slar yang gser zhal dza hus legs skyugs pa'i/ /bka' gnang yan lag brgyad ldan dal 'gro'i klung / shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i rgyal khab chen po nas/ /sman ljongs dag pa'i zhing du tshad med zhu/ /rten 'brel skyes su 'os pa'i ma:ra/ /rna gong phon por rgyan du dngar ba yi/ /legs bris lang tsho ldan pa'i bya ma rta/ /zung ldan chu gter chen po'i jogs su song / /gar dbang pad rag mdangs 'dzin 'chi med lha/ /rmad byung mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mthu dpung gis/ /dpal ldan nor 'dzin skyong ba'i dbang po khyod/ /sku tshe mnga' thang chab srid rgyas par smon/ mdo smad nas sku 'bum chos rje dpal ldan rgya mtshos/ dri ba lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dri lan gsar rtsom dgos tshul gyi lan ri byi rna rgyan/(88na)usti ཿsha na tsa bha wa su yi tsi tra la 〉 ba ñcakra sa a nu ra dzutsa su ri bā/ rgyu su ka rā ru kha pa la : dzi na kya sa rbu : la : me su shu bha ya :tsa malha sto ṣa /dpal (sdeb sbyor dpyid kyi thig le/dzin srid dang zhi ba'i gtsug tor rtser/ /'khor lo'i ri mo rnam bkra'i zhabs kyi rdul/ /'god mdzad rgyal ba kun dngos btsong kha pa/ /'jam dbyangs bla mas khyod la dge legs stsol/ /tshogs gnyis zla ba'i ma ma las 'thon pa/ /mtshan dpe'i gzugs sku'i rta bdun dbang po can/ /ngo mtshar 'god pa'i 'od zer 'bum 'phro ba/ /gnas de sa la brten pa'i 'og min zhing / /gang der rnam gsum 'khor lo'i shing rta che/ /snying stobs rgyad kyis 'dren pa'i byed po yi/ /'phrin yig snyan pa'i tshig ldan du rdzu bhi/ /rin cen do shal dbyu gus bsnun cing son/ /mang thos sa bon —352

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (peyongs su legs btab pa/ /'khrul med bsam pa'i nyal 'gros brlan pa las/ /tshul bzhin sgom pa'i las bzang g.yur za ba'i/ /gtan (88ba tha de'i ro brgya'i dpal la spyod pa mtshar/ /'di na kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa'i bstan/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas 'dzin rlom klog pa mkhan/ /za hor rigs kyi sdom brtson snyom las pa/ /'gro la mi dman lhag bsam ldan par mchis/ /e ma thub bstan ma la ya yi tshal/ /'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs tsan dan ljon/ /dpyad gsum dag pa'i dri bsung rab spros pas/ /mi shes tsha gdung sel ba'i byed po mtshar/ /kun gsal /shi mdzes dga'i bzhin ras la/ /rgyu skar 'phreng ba'i 'dren byed rnam bkra yang / /nyin dang mtshan mor ma 'dres 'byed pa la/ /bcu gnyisabadag po'i dkyil 'khor las gzhan su/ /rang g.yin mkhas grub grub mtha'i zhal gyi rgyun/ /dri dang brgyal brtag 'bral ba'i gaṅgā'i chab/ /ma dag rnyog mas sbags min dwangs pa'i klung / /'di go skal bzang btung ba'i dpyid du nges/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i gsung rab rgya mtsho ltar/ /ches zab bdag 'dras dpog par ga la nus/ /'on kyang rang blos ji tsam gzhal nus pa/ /rim gyis bsring pa'i 'dun pa yid la 'grogs/ /de skad snyan tshig mgrin par legs sgyur ba'i/ /rten gyi rgyud mang thogs pa'i bya ma rta/ /margad lwa ba'i gos can rgyal ba'i lo'i/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal mo e yig shar tshe bris/ /dwags po lcang ra ba mgon po tshe brtan gyi 'phrin lan 'jigs pa med pa'i dbyangs/(yon tha tho sgyu : ta tsa ra seṇa :rlu ma ru shrī da shrī kwa /2 2 dzi u tsi sta tsa gyu nu t+ta ra si rnyi la (tsa/ /med (dza snya sdeb sbyor 'phags ma/)du byung ba'i mchog gi bdud rtsi'i ros/ /ngo mtshar 'chi ba med pa'i dpal ster ba/ /rgyal ba kun dngos yid bzhin 'khor lo yis/ /bla na med pa'i dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /rnam dpyod dar bab mgrin pa'i rdzing bu nas/ /nyams 'gyur skad snyan 'phrin yig ngang mo dkar/ /rten gyi gshog rlabs skyod bzhin g.yas ru'i ljongs/ /bsams don lhun gyis grub pa'i rtse mor son/ /deng dus bsod nams nyi 'od kyis smin pa'i/ /phun tshogs nyer len pad+ma dkar po'i tshal/ /lugs zung ze'u 'bru g.yur du za ba nas/ /phan bde'i 'dab stong 'dzum pa spro ba 'phel/ /'di na za hor rigs kyi —353—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)skad gnyis pa/ /mi bzad dus kyi zhags pas ma bcings shing / /mkhan chen dam pa'i spyan sngar nyer lhags te/ /nyang (89ba)zhabs sa yi mdud du sleb skabs yin/ /dbus 'gyur sman ljongs sa yi thig le sa /myur du 'ong ba'i mdun pa mi dman yang / /mkhas grub dam pa'i bsti gnas mang po zhig /mig gi bdud rtsir spyod 'dod byed pos 'gyangs/ /'jam mgon thugs rje chen po sgyu 'phrul gar/ /blo bzang grags snyan 'bar ba'i bstan pa la/ /mi phyed dad par ldan pa'i mi yi bdag /tshe dbang rab tu brtan pa'i rnam dpyod can/ /srid dang zhi ba'i me long dwangs pa'i ngos/ /blang dor gzugs brnyan 'bum phrag shar ba rnams/ /ma 'dres so sor lta ba'i mig gi dkyus/ /ring po'i pha mtha' tshangs pas gzhal nus min/ /e raṇ+ḍa ltar 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la/ /ji tsam longs su spyad pa'i snying po'i 'bras/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i srang la ma bcal kyang / /'khrul ba'i 'gro rnams re ba ya ma brla/ /'khor ba nyes brgya'i zhags pa gcod pa'i mtshon/ /sna tshogs theg pa'i la jug sgo mang ba'i phyir/ /'dod yon lam du byed pa nges gsang chos/ /ltas ngan g.yang du len de ngo mtshar med/ /srid las nges par 'byung ba gtsang ma'i khrims/ /bdag gzhan brje nus rgyal sras rlabs chen spyod/ /tshe 'dir grol lam theg pa'i snying po mchog /chung 'bring chen pos nye bar spyod pa'i yul/ /chu 'dzin lang long g.yo ba'i phang pa nas/ /dbyar rnga dal gyis sgrog pa'i sgra snyan pos/ /rma bya'i sgro gshog zlum por sgyur byed kyang / /'dab chags kun gyi dga' ston spel nus min/ /pha mes rgyud kyis nyer bzung chos srid kyi/ /ma nyams cho ga bstar bas dus kun du/ /dge ba'i 'bras bu thob pas sngon rabs kyi/ /deb zer chos khrung rnams la nges rnyed mdzod/ /snyan tshig g.yas 'khyil 'phrin yig rab dkar dung / /bdog pa'i rten gyi dar dpyangs (90na)g.yo ba can/ /nam yang 'jig pa med pa'i dbyangs kyi sgra /gang gi rna ba'i bcud kyi dpal du bsgrags/ /mdo smad nas rgya yags 'ga' zhing rab 'byams pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'phrin lan zhi bde'i gnyid las slong pa'i rnga chen//sdeb sbyor dpyid kyi thig le/ dzu ga sa ha sra ga ra da : 5 spo kya rwa ste la dha shu na sa ra ha si 6 tsa—354

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (potu rmu khru sa /r+gha ya tā dhi ta na ya rgya sha ri tsa 'i 'o 8 sha ga dha sna sa ra gi ti tsa ma nu har+ya/ /bsod (sdos sbyor dpyid kyi thig le/)nams nyi ma stong 'bar skye rgu'i bdag /lte ba'i 'dab stong bzhad pa'i ge sar rtser/ /yid 'phrog dkyus ring mig gi zur mda' can/ /rgyud mang sgra las chos kyi glu dbyangs ma/ /e ma dpal gyi ri mo gsum pa'i lam/ /nyams 'gyur stong gi snyan tshig g.yas 'khyil bas/ /mi zad smra ba'i bang mdzod rjes 'gro mkhan/ /'phrin yig rten gyi bdog pa sug par smin/ /dkar min las rnams bdar ba'i bcu gnyis char/ /legs byas dkyil 'khor (90ba)rdzogs pa'i tsha zer can/ /mi rtag sgyu ma'i chu 'dzin rgyang bsrings te/ /bde skyid pad dkar 'dzum pa'i gtam de snyan/ /'di na sdom brtson gnas lngar mos blo can/ /gtsug lag rgya mtshor dpyod bzod klog pa mkhan/ /dge bcu'i yon tan kun tshang sman gyi ljongs/ /gangs can sa yi thig ler bde bar sleb/ /gzhan phan ming gi chus bkrus bzhin ras can/ /tshul 'chos mig zur g.yo ba'i blo brid ma/ /'dren par rlom pa kun gyi lugs srol 'dis/ /dal ba'i rten bzang g.yeng ba'i khol por mdzad/ /rab yangs rnam dpyod shes bya 'byams klas pa'i/ /don ldan snyan grags mgrin pa'i rta ljang can/ /legs bshad 'o mtshor 'jug pa'i ngang mo dkar/ /rgyal gsung thos bsam rkang gdub mtshon gyis spud/ /snying med 'khor ba'i ngang tshul e raṇ+ḍa/ /phun tshogs dpal gyi bdag po ya ma brlar/ /mthong ste dben gnas lo ma'i spyil bu sa /drang srong bsam gtan pa yi tshul de mtshar/ /ring goms dug gsum dar ba tsha ba'i nad/ /ting 'dzin ga spu ra yis drungs phyung tshe/ /bas mthar chu klung bu mo ngo mtshar nas/ /lhung lhung snyan pa'i glu dbyangs sgyur la brel/ shar ri'i rtse nas nyi ma 'bum shar yang / /mun sel snang ba'i cho ga sgrub mtshungs ltar/ /grangs med theg pa'i 'jug sgo mtha' klas pa/ /kun mkhyen ye shes 'thob pa'i thabs su nges/ /de phyir grangs ring gis bskal sangs rgyas lam/ /nges gsang gom pa gcig gis bgrod nus pa/ /bla med theg mchog yongs 'du sa brtol des/ /gtan bde'i 'bras bzang g.yur du za bar nges sos kyi chu 'dzin lang long g.yo ba'i dbus/ /dbyar rnga dal gyis dgod pa'i sgra snyan pos/ /rma bya sgro gshog —355

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)zlum por gar byed kyang / /rdo rje'i sna ldan yid la dga' ba ci/ /snyan tshig rgyan 'gyas spud pa'i me na ka /rten gyi rgyud mang snyem par thogs (91na)byas te/ 'ang gi ma ma'i do rar gar sgyur pa'i/ /'dren byed gzigs mor 'di na tshang du dngar/ /gsum ldan 'byung ba'i cang shes margad kyi/ /mdangs 'dzin gos kyis klubs pa'i bgrang bya zhes/ /kun dga' 'dzum zhal ngom pa rgyal ba yi/ /rta ljang lus phra'i khyim du spyod tshe bris/ /dwags la sgam po'i sprul pa'i sku blo bzang 'phrin las rnam rgyal nges don grub pa'i shing rta mchog gi sde brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad rten 'byung dang bcas pa'i chab shog lan mchog sprul zla snang gsal ba'i rdzing bu/ dz+nyā nā ma hā su kha tsa ni sti bi malu tsa rgyu 〉 be+e rgya mā ra ba ra ni smo a rdza ta ra sdi/ mā len dhe da yas mu ba tsa shā sa na sgyu sekhya nga ga su u ba rdzu wa ka sa sdu te smi na/ /zung (sdeb sbyor dpyid kyi thig le/)'jug bde ba chen po'i ye shes gar/ /mchog sprul dri med zla snang gzhen nu'i gzugs/ /sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i rgya mtshor legs shar ba/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho dam pa der/ /(91ba)chab shog be+e ḍūr zhun ma'i za ma tog /bden pa'i tshig gi bdud rtsi rab 'khyil ba/ /tshan grangs 'gyur ba med pa'i rdo rje'i stegs/ /nyams med sug par smin pas mchog tu dag /sku gsum mi zad 'khor lo'i bang mdzod nas/ /mtshan bzang lang tsho dar ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /rnyog bral chos kyi 'dod rgu'i char chen pos/ /srid zhi'i dbul ba sel ba'i gtam 'di snyan/ /blo chen tshangs sogs kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /skal bzang 'dren pa bzhi pa'i 'phrin las par/ /lung bstan zil dngar 'thul ba'i sgam po pa/ /zla 'od gzhen nu'i grags pa rna ba'i rgyan/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i 'chi med khang bzang du/ /gnas lugs nges pa'i don gyi mig stong can/ /chos kun phyag rgya gcig tu yongs grub pa'i/ /lag nyal bdag 'dzin bgrod pa'i gnyen por gdengs/ /rgya chen shes byar 'byams su klas pa kun/ /gcig tu grol ba'i rin cen phung po yi/khur ldan shing rta 'dren pa'i mchog gi sde/ /rgyal kun thugs rje'i sgyu drar nges min nam/ /bka' gdams ring lugs nyal 'gro 'khyil ba'i mtshor/ /dwags rgyud pad dkar ze'u 'brus nyer spud pa/ /—356

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (posnga 'gyur rdzogs chen chos kyi nyi 'od kyis/ /smin pas skal bzang bung ba'i mgrin dbyangs snyan/ /'di na za hor rigs kyi sdom bu pa/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i kun gsal 'jal byed pa'i/ /blo gros rta bdun dkyil 'khor rab gsal yang / /rnam g.yeng rlung gis bskyod pas dal med brel/ /las nyon thags su btags pa'i za 'og gos/ /bde sdug kha dog ri mo rnam bkra yang / /gang gis bden tshig mdzad pa'i brjod don ltar/ /bskal brgyar g.yo med 'dun pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig /med byung legs par bshad pa'i gsung mchid rgyun/ /rnam dpyod skal ldan shing rtas nyer drangs pa/ /mnyes gshin bskyud pas (92na)bral ba'i pad dkar mig /dga' ston zhabs bsil tshad med sgreng ba dang / /gzugs sku'i snang ba rab gsal chu shel dbang / /ma dag lnga brgya'i nyes mun 'joms pa dang / /thub bstan sa mos ba 'ad pa'i gnyen gcig pur/ /rdo rje'i khri la 'gyur med rtag bzhugs gsol/ /'jam gnyen pañja li ga'i stod g.yogs can/ /nyams 'gyur glu dbyangs len pa'i lus phra ma/ /sman ljongs gser ldan stegs las rab 'phags te/ /dbang phyogs 'dzin ma'i tshal der zlos gar sgyur/ /rab stims smra ba don yod rgyal mtshan mdo smad bya khyung brag gi gdan sar 'byor pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa'i 'phrin lan nga las nu'i zlos gar/ akhya( sgri ba su gar 5 ta sa ra / lo ka rdzo twa da sha ni sni tā tsa/ /ṣaṇ+ḍa ta gi tā ṣa lhu khubri ma3 byu sna li tho ka rnye tsa ma hā bi dzi tu/ /(92ba'i jig (sdeb sbyor dbang po rdo rje/)rten byed po rna ba brgyad pa yi/ /tshems dkar zla ba'i ma ma las 'khrungs pa/ /sngon med bsil sbyin mkhan po dbyangs can ma/ /mgrin par 'byud pa'i drug skyes glu 'di nyon/ /gzhung lugs mang po rab tu 'byams klas pa'i/ /grags snyan mkhri ka yi thod bcings can/ /thos bsam ri sras lha mos gtan 'dun gyi/ khyu mchog rgyal mtshan 'gugs mkhas de la springs/ /thub dbang chos kyi rgyal srid yangs pa'i khrir/ /rnam 'dren ma lus mgrin gcig blangs pa'i dbyangs/ /phun tshogs shis pa'i tshig gisamanga' gsol ba/ /tshad ma'i ston pa kun mkhyen btsong kha pa/ /mgon de tshur mthong byis blo'i snang ba'i ngor/ /yongs su 'dzin pa'i nor bu'i cod pan mchog /don kun grub pa'i rin cen khrir 'khod nas/ /—357

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyemagrin pa'i rgyud mang 'brol ba rna bar son/ /tshogs drug dbu ba'i rin cen do shal can/ /dar bab lang tsho'i chu klung smin legs ma/ /dus kyi rgya mtsho'i klong du ma sleb cing / /dge ba'i lhung lhung sgrog pa'i glu de snyan/ /bag med ste'u lag tu thogs pa'i srog /gcod byed gnyen po'i dug sprul gyis 'khril bar/ /mngar ba'i dri bsung ldan pa'i so so thar/ /ma la ya yi tshal du bder gnas sam/ /mi bsrun dgrar yang mnyes gshin bur lta ba'i/ /bsnyan sring mi mnga' kun la rang gi bde/ /gtong ba'i snying stobs cha shas yongs rdzogs pa/ /smon 'jug sems kyi zla ba shar ram ci/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i srin bu'i kha chu yi/ /bde chen srad bu thags su btags pa'i gos/ /stong nyid tshon (93na)gyis bsgyur ba'i za 'og can/ /lnga ldan ye shes kha dog bkrar mthong ngam/ /rnam 'dren tshangs gsung pi wang gcig gi sgrar/ khams dang dbang por 'tsham pa'i phra sbom gdangs/ /so sor snang yang sangs rgyas 'thob pa yi/ /thabs kyi nyams dang 'gyur bar go'am ci/ /'di snang e raṇ+ḍa yi 'bras smin pas/ /gtan bde'i ljon shing nyams pa'i khyog skam can/ /nyon mongs byin za'i phung po 'bar ba'i 'od/ /gnas ngan grong khyer ston pa'i gsal me bzhin/ /srid 'byor la chen dug gis nyer sbags pa'i/ /rnam dkar dge tshogs ro brgya ldan pa'i bcud/ /thar srog la gces dpyod ldan gyis za ba'i/ /go skabs kun mkhyen tshad mas gzhal nus su/ /de phyir bskal pa stong du rnyed dka' ba/ /'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i bstan pa la/ /legs zhugs thos bsam sgom pa'i skal bzang khyod/ /ma nor snying po'i nyams len gnad du gces/ /'tshams sprin rgya las grol min blang dor gyi/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar ston pa'i nyin mor byed/ /bdog pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba paṇ+ḍi pa'i/ /snyim pa'i lha yi lam du yud kyis song / /—358

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (porab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing lug lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag /shing lug lor gong mas gser yig pa tā dben mnyu shrī/ tā dben nor bu rgya mtsho/ tshul khrims khā rnams gnang sbyin bka' shog skyel bar 'ong ba log pa dang lhan cig par zung ju rab 'byams pa dngos grub yon tan dang 'phyong rgyas lkog grong pa mi snar btang ba'i dus phul ba'i zhu yig bsod nams nyi ma stong 'bar/ (93ba)pa tu u shrī gu sto nga rgya na no da ya ca pu byu saha nā swā to ra bi/ /ba da 〉 le skṛ na sto ṣa ra khyo da mā tsa kra ba rte su rwa de ba ka : rlug /e (me tog phreng 'dzin gyi sdeb sbyor/ sgo bsod nams nyi ma stong 'bar bas/ /rdzogs ldan snang ba'i dga' ston dar mdzad pa/ /rtsod dus 'khor los sgyur ba'i lha yi lha/ /'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i zhabs drung du/ /sa dbang lung gis nub phyogs gnam 'og gi /'gro kun lugs gnyis bstan pa gcig gyur pa'i/ /bdag por dbang bskur de'i chi kying gang gis/ /'jigs med gdong lnga'i rgyud kyi nga ros zhu/ /gser zhal bdud rtsi'i thigs pa'i gzegs ma can/ /thun 'tshams phyag rgya'i stegs las mngon 'phags pa'i/ /bka' shog dar ba'i rin cen skyes bzang bcas/ /nyams med son pa'i sman yon yid la 'brongs/ /deng dus gsang gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin ltar/ /g.yo med nyes pa'i dri ma rgyang bsrings te/ /lhar bcas (94na ji rgu'i gtsug na mtho ba'i khrir/ /zhabs rdul bkod pa'i gtam de rna bar 'jebs/ /'di na chos nor 'dod pa thar pa'i sde'i/ /gtsug lag lugs brgya'i sgo 'phar rab phye nas/ /rgya chen phun tshogs dpal 'byor mtha' klas par/ /spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por gyur skabs lags/ /bgrang yas dpag tshad kyis chod bsil zer gyis/ /skad cig kun+da'i 'dab ma ba 'ad pa ltar/ /rgya bod sa yis ring du bskal gyur kyang / khyod kyi snyan grags drung nas 'khor bzhin thos/ /lta bar mi bzod gzi brjid rta ljang can/ /mdzes shing lhun chags lha dbang brgya byin dpal/ /—359

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)srid zhi'i byed por tshangs pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /deng dus 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i mtshan gyi snyan/ /dbyig 'dzin mngal du stobs 'byor phun tshogs pa'i/ /nyi 'og rgyal po'i snyems ldan ches mang yang /gnam gyi mthongs nas 'jig rten mes po yis/ /'dzam gling bdag por bskos pa khyod nyid tsam/ /mi bsrun dug gi dad ldan lce gnyis 'phrul/ /rba rlabs nam mkhar 'phyo rnams bka' khrims kyis/ /nad sel sman gyi chu bor sgyur byed na/ /drang srong a ga sta la ngo mtshar ci/ /lus can yongs kyi bde sdug bar ma'i gru/ /bying 'degs las kyi dal 'gro'i klung chen nang / /dga' skye'i chu gnyer shugs ring snyan pa'i glus/ /bskal par bgrangs kyang 'dzad pa'i pha mtha' med/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis snang mun 'byed pa bzhin/ /skye rgu'i bde skyid khyod la rag las phyir/ /byams ldan spyan gyis 'jig rten kun brtse zhing / /mkhyen dpyod mdzad pa'i phyag gis dbugs dbyung gsol/ /sna tshogs grub mtha'i lta bar mtha' klas kyang / /gtan bde'i yid bzhin nor bu'i 'byung (94bsko grangs can/ /thub pa'i ring lugs zla ba'i ma ma la/ /srid zhu gzugs can snying po'i spun zla mdzod/ /sna mang theg pa'i rin cen them skas las/ /'gro rnams sku gsum khang par 'khrid byed pa/ /rgyal kun ngo bo rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /bstan la sngon bzhin dad dang ri mor mdzod/ /kun la snyoms pa'i bka' khrims dpal be lu /snying gar ri mo'i snang brnyan legs bkra yang / /log spyod gser can gsod la dpa' ba yi/ /'phrog byed sder mo'i rno ngar ldan par mdzod/ /gcam bus kha dog bsgyur ba'i chu gtsang dang / /snying nas gus pa'i rab dkar 'o ma'i bcud/ /ma 'dres 'byed pa'i mkhyen yangs ngang pa'i mchus/ /sa bon so sor btab pa'i 'bras smin mdzod/ /snyan tshig rin cen phra tshom gdu bu can/ /lugs zung don ldan mnyen lcug sor mo yis lha gcig thugs kyi rgyud mang bsnun byed na/ /blang dor sgyu dra'i zlos gar cis ma ston/ /mchog dman 'dren byed yul du mi bdag gi /gzugs su shar ba'i sgra 'dzin du kū la/ /ma dag dri ma'i tshogs rnams 'brud byed pa'i/ /legs bshad chu rgyun sbreng ba'i zol gyis rdzu/ /mi las nyer 'das 'od gsal lha yi bu/ /dus kyi bdag por gnam gyi she slong can/ /dbang phyug yon tan brgyad mnga' gang gi thugs/ / mes—360

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (0po tshangs pa min pa gzhal nus su/ /legs pa'i rtsibs stong 'bar ba'i 'khor lo yis/ /gling bzhir dbang sgyur mi rje lha yi rgyal/ /dpal ldan sa gzhi'i dbang phyug gong ma che/ /bskal brgyar seng ge'i khri la zhabs brtan gsol/ /brjed ngas glang gdong mche ba drungs chun pa'i/ /phebs tshogos khyen chad med pa'i ga rti ka /gser yig rma bya'i bzhon pa la brten nas/ /ljongs 'dir dga' ba'i sgro gzhog zlum por sgyur/ /spyan dkyus ring por rkyong ba'i nyi zer gyi/ /'bab stegs bdog pa'i skyes kyi yo ldan༄yi la/ /thun mas rtags kyi 'dab ma g.yo bzhin du/ 'ang lug gro zhun zla ba'i yar tshes phul/ /bya khyung chos rje rab stims smra ba don yod rgyal mas gyi tshon lan lnga brgya'i rang gzugs ston pa'i me long / pra sga ku nibha ba tsa lo ka a mṛ ta sa ba tswa yu na phu ba tsa pa re pa ra : : lha rmā/ ta : shu ti yam du rā k+ṣa ya gi ti da spu ṇa shrī ba ku khyi yi shu dha rma dza lā ka ro ka /mtho (sdeb sbyor dpyid kyi thig le/ )ris sa dz+nyā yi rgyud 'dzin pa'i/ /sngon med blo ldan phur bu gnyis pa yi/ /mgrin par g.yasasu 'khyil ba'i chos kyi dung / /'dzad med snyan pa'i glu der rna ba blogs/ /srid pa'i nags klung stug po gcod pa'i mtshon/ /dam pa'i chos kyi ral gri rnon po yis/ /bcad pas nges legs spang ljongasayangs pa'i ngogs/ /gtan bde'i chu skyes bshad 'dun can der springs/ /tshig sbyor du kū la yi gosagyon pa'i/ /'phrin yig gnyis skyes na tshod gzhen nu (95bcan/ /dag byed sngo ljang byu chun po'i rten/ /su sti'i sgra dbyangs 'brol zhing 'di na son/ /rgyal bstan dbyar skyes mgron du bsu mkhas pa/ /'jam mgon mkhyen dpyod g.yin gsos skad snyan can/ /gnyis skyes kun gyi rgyal po btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs 'di ko sngon med legs pa'i lam/ /tshul der thos pa'i sa bon legs btab pa/ /yang dag bsam pa'i rlan gsher gyis smin pas/ /sgom pa'i 'jam mnyen 'dab stong 'dzum pa yis bla med sku gsum go 'phang g.yur du za/ /'tshams sprin cod pan 'dzin pa'i rigs kyis mtho/ /gzhung lugs mang por dpyod bzod tshangs pa'i bu/ /mdo sngags lam gyi rim pa'i :thi ra'i/ /dbang bskur sngon byon mkhas mang skar tsho gos ba'i na/ /ngan song mngon mtho zhi bde sgrub pa'i lcags/ /thabs mkhas—361

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shertsi yis sku gsum gser sbyangs su/ /sgyur nus skyes bu gsum gyi gdams pa'i mdzod/ /srid zhi zhi dbul ba 'phrog pa'i dbang gi rgyal/ /bskal mang tshes kyi bgrod pa'i bya rog 'gros/ /'dod yon lam du len pa theg pa'i rtse/ /'dab bzang dbang pos skad cig gzhal nus pa/ /gsang chen chos kyi nying khu 'dus pa'i lam/ /deng dus grangs kyi lnga brgya'i mtha' min yang / /mkhas btsun rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i mig zhabrul la/ /sgyu ma'i rta bzhin rmongs pa'i skye bo rnams/ /bden 'dzin 'khrul pa'i mgo bo ci yang 'khor/ /bran nor 'du 'dzis bteg pa'i mthon po'i khrir/ /gdung rgyud sprul pa'i sku dang grub thob ces/ /dar zab gos kyi klubs pa lha yi gsob/ /don med 'ja' 'dras nor 'dzin lto ba gang / /kye ma kun mkhyen shākya'i ring lugs de/ /thos bsam bsgom pas spel la dman no zhes/ /'phyon ma'i zlos gar sgyur la bstan 'dzin skad/ /smra ba'i (96na)tshul la yid skye'i mchi ma ku/ /tshul bstan gtam gyi gur gum chus byugs pa'i/ /rmongs pa'i ra gan kun la ngom pa yi/ /gtam ngan ngo sor byed pa kun tsi ku'i/ /rgyal phran mang zhig deng dus 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /la la rang rigs rgan po'i ngag tsam dang / /ma mthun rtags su bkod nas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /tshad ldan gzhan la smod pa'i chos spong gi /'dam bying glang po thar pa'i srog 'bral snyam/ /lung don rigs pas gzhal nus legs bshad tshig /'dug na mu stegs grub pa'i mtha' las kyang / /len pa'i dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang bdag /dpyad bzod grub mthar phyogs ris ga la byed/ /'on kyang thog mtha' bar du 'khrul ba'i rgya/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rnon pos yongs bcad pa'i/ /rgyal kun ngo bo blo bzang grags pa yi/ /gsung la rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa thob/ /'ga' zhig zab cing don bzang ma rtogs par/ /tshe 'di'i 'byed thabs tsam gyi me long du/ /lto gos 'byor pa'i gzugs brnyan shar ro zhes/ /mos rnams dbang rtul dad pa'i rjes 'brang yin/ /zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba'i gru gzings la/ /brten nas 'khor ba'i chu gter las brgal te/ /nges legs rin cen gling du bgrod 'dod khyod/ /sngon bzhin dam bca'i bsam pa brtan po zung / /sum rtsen yul gru'i dga' tshal gsar pa na/ /'dren byed gzigs mor mtshar ba'i ut+pal rtser/ /sbrang rtsi'i bcud 362

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dza)bzang dmar ser ze'u 'bru'i rgya/ /'grol byed glu dbyangs sgrog pa'i bung ba 'khor/ /bdud rtsis myos pa'i 'jam ldan spu gos can/ /zab ljang ber gyi steng gos klubs pa yi/ /gdong lnga'i dbang po 'dod pas tshim pa'i tshe/ /yi ge'i ma na ka de zlos gar sgyur/ /shangs bkra shis rtse pa blo bzang dbang rgyal gyi 'phrin lan nges 'byung glog 'od gsal ba'i sgyu ma'i ltad mo/ (96ba/bha ཿ bhag tsa da pu ra mi te khyu rā 〈 tu : byu ā sa ta khra she sa ma te: tshu u dz+nyā/ /su bhū tar k+ṣa ma dhu ra nga la ki ti shā sa nywa di pya nga chu tsa pa la : mu kha pa tha/ /thams (sdeb sbyor dpyid kyi theg le/cad mkhyen par byed pa'i blo gros kyis/ /skal bzang sangs rgyas bzhi pa'i seng ge'i khrir/ /legs bkod snyan pa'i grags 'bar btsong kha pa/ /'dzam gling bstan pa'i bdag pos khyod la srungs/ /tshe ring gnam gyi she mong lung las kyis/ khred pa'i gtsug tor rtsa na ngal gso zhing / /gnasalnga rig pa'i 'dren byed stong ldan pa'i/ /mang thos 'chi med dbang po'i gtam 'di nyon/ /g.yas ru bkra shis 'dzin ma'i thig le'i rtser/ /blo gsal bzang po'i las ldan dal 'byor rten/ /dbang gi rgyal po lta bu rnyed dka' ba/ /thob de'i 'phrin yig tshigs su bcad pa son/ /srid pa'i rang bzhin thun gsum kun gsal ngos/ /sdug bsngal mun pa'i rum du mal 'cha' ba/ /zag bcas bde bar rlom pa'i glog 'od la/ /gtan mdun snying por re rnams (97na)ya ma brla/ /bcos min nges par 'byung ba'i ka pu ras/ /mi bzad las nyon tsha gdung drag po'i rims/ /zhi byed cho ga 'grub pa'i dang po sa /myang 'das 'du ba snyoms pa'i dga' ston can/ /drang srong dmod 'i pas bsgrubs pa mngal rdzogs mthar/ /gnyis med lcags kyi tim bu skyes min pa'i/ /tshangs spyod dpal gyi be'u snying ga na/ shar ba'i ri mo smin tshe phan bde'i dpyid/ /yid srubs sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'tshams sprin steng / /thos bsam 'phel 'grib 'byog po'i cha shas can/ /bstan 'dzin zla ba'i 'od gzi mthar byed pa'i/ /sngon med nyin byed 'jam dpal snying po'i zhabs/ /rgyal kun yab tu bsngags pa'i snyan po'i mtshan/ /mi shes mun pa gcod pa'i ral gri can/ /'jam dbyangs rdo rje rnon po'i sgyu dra'i gar/ /ngur smig 'dzin la rgol ba'i —363

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyeklan ka su/ /tshul de blo chen tshangs pa'i gdong pa bzhi/ /bzang po mdzad par lha la yid drangs pas/ /rig byed smra ba'i zhal sgor sprul pa'i gtam/ /grags pa'i 'chi med dbang po'i mdun sar gleng / /mdo sngags gtsug lag chos kun 'khrul med du/ /smra ba'i spobs pa ye shes kyis thob pa/ /tshad ma'i mgon po blo bzang grags pa yi/ /gzhung lugs ro brgyar spyod 'dod rna bar snyan/ /blo gsal 'gro la don bzang chos kyi bcud/ /bung ba sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan ze'u 'bru ltar/ /bla med zil dngar btung pa'i 'byung gnas can/ /'dren mchog dam pa'i nyam ring gnas pa spro/ /ma rig chu 'dzin sdug po sngon chags pa/ /'jig rten 'byul pa'i grong khyer sngo bsangs mar/ /rmad byung thugs rje'i 'thor rlung drag po'i mthus/ /phan bde'i snang gter rgyal kun pha mtha' yas/ /mkha' (97bskor dngos po kun gyi mtshan ma yi/ /dmigs su med pa'i stong chen chos dbyings dang / /sna tshogs gzugs sku dbang po'i gzhu ris can/ /rnam rtog pir gyis bris pas mtha' rdzogs min/ /mi bsrun kha rlangs 'thul ba'i gdeng ga'i gtsug /legs byas nor bu'i 'od stong 'bar ba can/ /rgya hor che rgu'i ston pa grangs med par/ /smod tshig ser bas nges legs lo tog gcod/ /ma 'dris gnyen gcig zas gtsang sras kyi gsung / khams dang dbang por 'tsham pa'i chos kyi sgo /tshur mthong byis blos gzhal nus skal pa dag /phra phyir sgrib pa'i gnyid la yur gyi dogs/ /pha mes rigs kyi 'byor pa'i thig le'i zla/ /ring spangs dmar ser gos kyi 'dab ldan pa'i/ /blo gsal lang tsho dar bab ut+pal khyod/ /dam chos nyin mo'i snang ba rtag sten rig /'di snang rna gong pad+ma'i phan po dag /kun rtog rab bkra'i ba mos bsnyigs byas shing / /phyi ma'i don grub chos kyi nor bu'i rgyan/ /ma rnyed dman pa'i tshogs kyang 'phya ba'i gnas/ /rnam dag tshul khrims rtsa ba ras tu brtan/ /mang du thos pa'i lo 'dab phang phung g.yo/ /bsam pa'i me tog bzhad rtser sgom pa'i 'bras/ /smin na gtan bde'i dpag bsam ljon par nges/ /skyes bu gsum gyi them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /'khrid chen brgyad sogs nye lam sgo 'phar brgya/ /legs phye zung 'jug 'og min khang bzang du/ /bgrod na dal ba'i rten mchog don yod byas/ /de skad don ldan nor bu be+e ḍūr+ya/ /snyan 'gyur tshig gi —364

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pesrad bu la brgyus pa'i/ /legs bshad rin chen spel legs do shal gang / /rnam dpyod bi shwa rkarma'i sor rtses bskrun/ /rgya gar paṇa chen mes po'i thod las babs/ khong dpang skal ldan shing (9ni hos legs par drangs/ /chos skyong bzang po ra hu'i zhal sgo las/ /'ongs pas grong tshig rnyog ma'i dri ma bral/ khres byar srid kun lung dang rigs lam du/ /blo gros shing rtas 'dren nus smon 'gro ba/ /dbyangs can mgrin par bzhad pa'i skal bzang glu/ /thos pas da lha'i dgongs don cung zad rig /de phyir gzu lums tshigs bcad du kū la/ /gdol gtam phung po rjen par ston pa'i ngag /snyan tshig za 'og gos su rlom pa'i 'ja'/ /gnad 'gag gzung du med la re ba bskyungs/ /'gro phan ming du bsnyad pa'i rnam g.yeng rlung / /mdog lnga'i shugs kyis dal med bskyod byas kyang / /tshigs sbyor 'dab brgya bzhad la thogs med pa'i/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i nyi 'od cung zad spros/ /'phrin yig lang tsho dar ba'i smin legs ma/ /'tshams sprin rgya yi mchu sgros 'dzum pa'i nang / /rab dkar thags bzang tshems phreng ngom bzhin du/ /nyams 'gyur stong gi glu dbyangs mgrin par len/ /bcu gnyis bgrang byar gaṅgā sgra 'dzin khur/ /bsten pa'i dka' thub rdzogs pa a ga stas/ /nyal 'gro'i tshogs rnams bdud rtsir sgyur ba'i tshe/ khyod kyi rna ba mdzes pa'i rgyan 'di spud/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me sprel lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag /bsam yas nas gnod sbyin chen pos spyan gzigs rten 'byung gi bdog pa dgos tshul gyi gsang ba rdo rje'i 'phrin lan sde brgyad las su skul ba'i pa༄ ha/ 'dzam gling kun na che ba'i rig sngags kyi/ /brtul zhugs grub pa pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya spyi bor legs bkod pa/ /sdebargyad dregs pa'i dmag dpon tsi dmar ba/ /gang gis rdo rje'i tshig 'phreng gsang ba'i rnga/ /snyan brjid rngam pa'i sgra dbyangs legs khrol ba/ /dar dkar —365

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kye(98bshog bu'i ngos su yi ge'i gar/ /bsgyur te snyim par son pa spro ba 'phel/ /zhi dro rab 'byams kun 'dus bka' brgyad lha'i/ /nub byang mchod stod dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /ye shes sprul pa'i lha yi sgyu ma mkhan/ /mi bsrun srog gi gshed mar rdzu ba bzhin/ /gcig tu gyur pa chos dbyings thig le'i klong / /du mar snang ba srid gsum kun khyab pa'i/ /zla ba gcig las gyur pa'i gzugs brnyan gyis/ /grangs med phyogs 'tshams ma lus khyab pa bzhin/ /mthu stobs rtsal gyis srid gsum g.yo nus kyang / /dam tshig srad bu phra mos 'ching nus pa/ khyab 'jug 'jug pa bcu pa'i ngang tshul can/ /gnod sbyin dbang po dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal ston/ /rang srung rdo rje btsan po'i go cha dang / /dgra dpung 'joms byed rno ngar 'dzom pa'i mtshon/ /stong gsum skad cig myul ba'i rta mchog sogs/ /mchid 'phreng yi ger 'khod bzhin 'bul byed na/ /zhi rgyas dbang gi 'phrin las yid bzhin nor/ /bsam pa'i re ba ma lus yongs stong zhing / /drag sbyor thog mdas dgra bgegs brag ri'i tshogs/ /thal bar rlog cig rigs rgyud srung ma che/ /rmad byung kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /ting 'dzin sor mos thags su nyer btags pa'i/ /snyan shal rab dkar dar gyi lha rdzas la/ /thun 'tshams rgya yis spras te legs par phul/ /mchoms phu nas btsan rgod rta ra bas 'phrin las sgrub rten dgos tshul rim gro'i skul ma dang bcas pa'i 'phrin lan dam ldan dpa' thod ga' cha zlos gar/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus kun 'dus pa'i/ /bdag nyid srid gsum bla ma pad+ma 'byung / /mgon de'i dge bsnyen btsan rgod rta ra ba'i/ /'phrin yig myang chen sku sha'i rten bcas 'byor/ /g.yang dam mi (99na)g.yel 'phrin las bsgrub pa legs/ /bsil ldan bod kyi rgyal khams bde ba'i thabs/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gsung bzhin sgrub dgos pa'i/ /rgyu mtshan rmed pa ji bzhin yid la
