babs/ /cang shes rta dang rno ngar ldan pa'i mtshon/ /sgra snyan phyogs las rnam rgyal ba dan sogs/ /yi ge'i 'phreng bar bkod pa ji bzhin du/ /bsrings yod bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par gyis/ /gangs kyi ri bo'i mdangs las khu ba yi/ /zla ba thags su byas 'dra'i lha rdzas la/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs —366

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dzadakyi rgyas spras te//gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i pho brang rtse nas bris//gong gi yig rigs kyi byed po 'bi lig thu nang so'i 'phrin lan bzhin ras 'char ba'i me long /kār su kuṇ+ḍa da rtoṣa kaṣ+ṭha bā lha ku yi:sa praṇi ta3te:pradz+nyā bī ṣ+ṭha kur su//na dīḥphya kā la:pati/be+e ro gog ha yo3he dzin ut+pan+da pa re par/'bi lig thu nang so'i yi ge gser zho bcu ja ko khra dang bcas pa bsrings pa 'byor/mi ring ba'i char yang tshe rabs mang por bsags pa'i legs byas kyi 'bras bu'i gzugs phung la ma 99ba)ba ho se:tan56su pha luX3be ste:skarnye shu/wa rje gul bishā sgyu du lānān+ta(gawa rtogrwa no shrīhe gagano:shār:rmā hot+ta ra su sprul//mthun nad gdon gyi 'tshe ba med cing /gnam sa'i dbang phyug gong ma chen po'i drung du yig rigs sna tshogs kyi sor mo'i zlos gar sgyur bar gnas pa spro//ga sdi ri sprudz+rasu yog:bhaṣaṇa pra bā dwa ra lhan du2shukla phyag re khu bi rles no3sgra4shaganā ma sa:/'u ste:u dum kar:samādhi rdza pi ta lha:྅:ṣaṇi bsnyanaṣ+ṭhad shrī la du tsā ra pun+ta mā bu na//ngos kyang sems can rnams kyi don gyi ched du zab mo rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa sogs rnam dkar gyi bya ba la brtson par gnas/slad nas kyang dpyod ldan khyod kyis ting nge 'dzin bzlas rjod gsol 'debs bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad 100na ) ra bi//su truḥte nā mo'i man snyir la:na pra ṣi tā〉〈sbo di pe khu nā/me tri nā pā ramanirmā kā ya su kar de shan sla kā le pa ri bā re8tā dwa nu dhi gya dzi ta pra tidz+nyā yudz+nyābye tat+pa sprug wi btsu/shu ta pa'i khrims sogs dge tshogs la nan tan byed pa dang /byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs 'di ngag tu brjod pa dang thos pa thams cad 'dzam bu gling du mgon po byams pas mchog gi sprul sku mdzad pa ston pa'i dus su 'khor du skyes nas rjes su 'dzin par mdo man rgyu lhas ka rok+ṣa su tsagrwa da tu dza na:udaka sus ri tā spo ta:kā bras dzā ratsal85/ra tsā ha ga rgyu shāḥtsa tu k+ki sba li si ta : sa shi sta//shrī rmādha rgya ka ṭa kai dhe/367

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'o ma hā/ las thos pas mi slu ba'i yid brtan rnyed nas bskur yod/ srung ba'i 'khor lo nas mi 'dor ba yid la 'grogs pa byed/ 'phros 'os kyang chu bo'i rgyun ltar gyis/ rten srung mdud dad rten snam dkar bzhi dang bcas/ (100ba)se na sa ཿ di go bi dza ya ga di pā : kho ta ma gi na rkaṭa sa mu rgyu ra mā ཿ she re ṇa hu 〉 ma su ni ku rngo ya tri lwa ṇa 〉na su nyi tho/ me spre lo be'u9 tsho mgos nya ba'i phyogs snga ma'i rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde chen po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas bris/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me bya lor bris pa'i chab sna(ga 'phrin yig khag /me bya yar 'brog lhun po rdzong nas khri dpon kun dga' tshe brtan rdo rjes dad pa'i 'bras gsar phul ba'i 'phro/ lan kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ /lha ni ku lu ma hā she te :ya : yu ska bi tsā ra ba kra tsa/ /le kha du r+yaku mā ra bri 'i ྅ bā lwa 3| ga na pā sna a : ta/ /legs sdeb sbyor dag pa'i snang ba/ ldan dbang po'i rigs kyi nags klung du/ /rnam dpyod 'dab ma nam yang snyigs min pa/ /sa skyong snga na med pa'i a shwat+pa/ /rmad byung ljon pa'i myu gu gzhon nu'i 'phrin/ /(101na)ri dwags snang brnyan thags kyi ri mo mā /shar ba'i zla ba bzhun ma kha tshar can/ /dbyid kyi rgyal mo'i mgrin snyan 'brol ba la/ /'khor lo'i yan lag myos pa'i 'bras bcas son/ /mi khom gnas ngan smag rum mun pa'i tshogs/ /'joms byed legs byas bye ba'i skya rengs mthar/ /dal 'byor rten gyi nyi ma 'od po ches/ /bde skyid 'dab brgya ba 'ad pa'i gtam de snyan/ /'di snang g.yeng ba'i khol por 'dzad pa la/ /gzhan phan ming gi sgro btags mkhan po yang / /gtsug lag rgya mtshor thos dang bsam pa yi/ /ngang tshul 'di 'dras 'tsho ba don ldan snyam/ /gtan du bde ba chos kyi tog mdzes can/ /phun tshogs 'byor pa'i chab srid gdugs dkar —368—

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (popo'i/ /nor bu'i yu ba khyod la nyer gtad nas/ /yab gcig mtho ris bdag po'i skas la 'dzigs/ /de phyir lugs gnyis dpal gyi be'u'i gzugs/ /blo dang brtson par rab ldan snying ga'i ngos/ /'khyil tshe dpa' mdzangs brtul phod 'jug pa bcus/ /kun las rnam par rgyal ba thob min nam/ /bkra shis ri mo g.yas su legs su la ba'i/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i dung dkar po/ /rab snyan ming tshig yi ger 'char ba'i 'phrin/ /dzaḥ yi bu mor co 'dri 'os/ /sgra 'dzin ba ku la yi 'dab ma'i rgya/ /'grol byed snyan tshig lus phra'i 'gram chang gi /gzegs ma 'thor tshe smra po phal cher gyi/ /tshig sbyor nyi ma byang gling ngos su song / /me bya sman lung bla ma rnam dpyod dang ldan pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rjer springs pa theg kun rtse mor bgrod pa'i glu/ (101ba) sutri sta 〉〉 rje ra nga the da shu kā pi 〉 su rwa sgo ni dhi ma stu su ra/ ā yu na gre ྅ te rga tasu mi ga lo go be sta : :bra rnyi ta rtir bī/ /mdo sdeb sbyor rma bya myos pa/ rgyud pad+ma'i ge sar skyugs pa'i rdul/ /snying po bka' gter bcud kyis myos pa yi/ /theg kun rtse mor bgrod pa a ti glu/ /len mkhas dpyod ldan bha ma ra der springs/ /legs byas chu gter bsrubs 'bras lus kyi zla/ /tshad du gzhal dka' srid pa'i lha lam ngos/ /bag la zha ba'i las ngan sgra gcan gyis/ kha bsgribs bde skyid cha shas gang gyur tam/ /dge ldan lugs 'dzin gna' bo'i skyes rabs khrir/ /zhwa ser rin cen cod pan legs 'chang yang / /rnam dpyod gser sbyangs 'khor los rigs bral gyi/ /thub bstan gling bzhir dbang bsgyur 'di na snang / /mi dge'i nad brgya 'joms pa sman gyi grong / /sprul zhing lta na sdug pa yar klungs nas/ /rig sngags drang srong grub pa tha skar skye/ /'khrul (102nas da lung zin dam pa'i rgyud ldan khyod/ /bco brgyad rig pa'i gnas kyi rgyud mang po/ /thos brtson spobs pa'i sor rtses bskul ba'i sgra /dam pa'i chos kyi glu 'bab dbyangs snyan pos/ /mtho ris gar mkhan khengs bskyung blo mig yangs/ /nye tshe'i nges 'byung sprul rgyas ma 'khril zhing / /tshul khrims bsil ba'i dri ngad cher ldang ba'i/ /tshangs spyod dpal gyi ma la yar skyes ljon/ /'khor ba'i tsha gdung ming mthar byed de mtshar/ /theg chen —369

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)shing rta bcu pa'i rigs sad nas/ /gzhan phan lhag bsam rgya che'i rā ma ṇa sa/ /'gyur med dam bca' bzhi ldan sems skyed mdas/ /bdag 'dzin lang ga'i mgrin pa sa la lhung / /sna tshogs 'gro blo'i mos pa man shel khams/ /kri yog sde gsum mtshon gyis kha bsgyur tshe/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i khang bzang du/ /'jug pa'i sgo rgyan mdzes byed nor bu'i 'phra/ /bka' nas bkar brgyud mdo rgyud sems phyogs kyi/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi chos tshul rgya mtsho che/ /drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi yid bzhin nor/ /mdzad med 'byung ba'i khungs 'di rmad du snying / /chos gter snying po dbus gter rtsa ba brtan/ /lho gter sdong bu nub gter yal ga rgyas/ /byang gter me tog shar gter 'bras bu smin/ /zab gter u rgyan thugs gter dpag bsam shing / /snga 'gyur ston gyi mkha' dbyings dngas pa'i ngos/ /gter ston rgyu skar 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /nyang ral chos dbang nyi zla zung 'brel gyis/ /'khor 'das nyam nga'i mun pa pha mthar sgrod/ /bla med ye shes bco sbyangs su war+ṇa/ /sgrib gnyis dngul chus gab pa tha mal mdog /smin byed dbang gi me yis bcir (102ba)ba las/ /rang rig gdod ma'i 'tshams sprin mdangs 'od 'phro/ /ting 'dzin rdzas kyis ngar btags dmod pa'i mtshon/ /rnon pos lcags srog grub kyang gcod nus pa'i/ /drag sngags 'bar ba'i thog gi mda' bo ches/ /'gal byed brag ri bsnyil la rings chas sam/ /drag po'i chas zhugs dpal chen stangs stabs kyis/ /dam can dregs pa'i dmag gi sna drangs tshe/ /bdud dpung zhig pa'i sgra dang lhan cig tu/ /snying yang shubs nas thon te lkog mar bros/ /'gal rkyen tha sreg zhi ba'i gshin po'i sar/ /tshe dpal stobs wor myu gu rab smin pa/ /phun tshogs 'bras bzang 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu de/ /ma btab par yang kham bas gsum dbang du byed/ /ka nas dag pa'i dbyings der rgyal kun gyi/ /mkhyen spyan stong gis gzigs kyang ma rnyed par/ /lhun grub mtshan dpe'i 'ja' tshon shar ba'i 'phrul/ /byed po rig pa'i rtsal gyi sgyu ma mkhan/ /ngo bo dmigs med brjod bral ye nas stong / /rang bzhin gsal 'tsher zhi khro'i sprin dkar g.yo/ /kun khyab thugs rje'i sprul sgyur gru char gyis/ /gser sbram skyed rdor 'khrul ba'i dbul phongs sel/ /sgron —370

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('am drug gi yon tan chu bo kun/ /snang bzhi'i rgya mtshor ngang gis gzhol ba'i mthar/ /chos nyid 'bab chu rdzogs par zad gyur kyang / /'od lus nor 'dzin lto bar dog min yangs/ /'dod sred kha chus rang nyid dam 'ching ba'i/ /bsam pa'i srad bu phra rags rgyu dang spun/ /lnga ldan ye shes tshon gyis btags pa'i dar/ /kun bzang gos kyi gzha' ris yid mkhar bkra /gangs can ra ba dkar po'i khor yug gi /lha gcig de dang dbyer med chos kyi dbang / /'khrul med zab gter bstan pa'i gdugs dkar po/ /gyen du 'degs pa'i snying stobs phrag par long / /tshig sbyor (103na)gzhen nu'i mdzes sdug mngon gsal yang / /zab brling don gyi rgan po'i blo 'chang ba/ /legs pa'i cha bsags bdog pa'i sgro ldan la/ /zhen nas khyod kyi mdun sar zlos gar sgyur/ /me bya sna dkar rtser zhang po khri dpon pa kun dga' dbang chen phun tshogs la springs pa lugs gnyis lta ba'i me long / sa dzo 'isho bha sa ṣ+ṭha rma sha ṅgā ga sha khri sa wa ra shrī wa da k+ṣi rgya ku khyi lu tsa/ /pā shu shom da na sheya ya snro ma tho ྅ 9 tu ཿ tra ka : phya ba rnyi ka: dus (sdeb sbyor me tog 'phrong can/)kun dge ba dam pa'i chos kyi dung / /mgrin par g.yas su 'khyil ba'i tshangs dbyangs sgra /med byung snyan pa'i bdud rtsi rna bar dpyid/ /sbyin mdzad zas gtsang sras kyis dge legs stsol/ /gangs can ra bar rgyal srid sna bdun gtsor/ /mang pos bkur ba dpal ldan rlangs kyi gdung / /lha gzigs phag gru'i bka' drin nyi zer gyis/ /legs bskyangs dgung blon brgyud kyi pad dkar dang / /gnam gyi she mong dpung pas sa kun la/ /mnga' sgyur (103ba)gong ma rgyal po hong di yis/ /srid zhi'i gtsug gi rgyan du dbang bskur ba/ /de'i chi kying gang ming du 'bod pa des/ /'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi gdung 'dzin sa skya pa'i/ /bstan srung mgon pos sprul pa'i rigs kyi bu/ khri skor rtags mgo dang bcas lung bzang pos chen po'i las ka 'dzin pa'i mi dbang der/ /rig gnas rgya mtshor smra ba'i spobs pa'i mgrin/ /gzengs su mtho ba'i lang tsho dar drag pa/ /'jam dpal rdo rjer 'brul te dbyangs can lhas/ /mgul par 'khrud pa'i drug skyes glu 'di springs/ /bsod nams phung po gzugs su snang ba'i khams/ /chos dang srid kyi —37/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyegatsug lag byed ba'i snod/ /dal 'byor 'dzam bu'i gser sbyangs nyer 'che'i lhad/ /yongs bral spro bde'i 'od gzi 'bar las ci/ /sna tshogs dkar ba'i las kyi 'bras bzang dang / /dpa' mdzangs 'phrul gyis rgyal phran rtser son pa/ /ang len mes kyi legs lam yangs pa'i shul/ /bzung ba'i brtul zhugs grub la bdag yi rang / /za hor gdung gi nor bu'i yu ba yis/ /bteg pa'i gtsug lag lugs brgya'i gdugs dkar po/ /blo bzang grags snyan bstan pa'i tog mdzes can/ /bod 'bangs phan bde'i grib bsil dal med 'khor/ /gtan bde'i si tā log pa'i chom rkun ma/ /'dod la mngon sred sgyu ma'i ri dwags kyis/ /skye rga na 'chi'i mya ngam thang chen por/ /'gro mang sems kyi dga' byed lha de ngal/ rdzong gzhis grong khyer gdengs ka 'bum phrag las/ /yid la tsher ltar rtsub reg de snyed pas/ /sa spyod klu dbang 'byor pa'i snying po kun/ /e raṇ+ḍa yi 'bras bu smin pa bzhin/ /ma rig mun 'thibs 'khor ba mtshan mo'i mal/ /dug (104na gsum gnyer slong nges 'byung skya rengs kyis/ /drangs pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i thun 'tshams mthar/ /gtan mdun nyi ma 'od po che de 'char/ /grangs med chos kyi pha mtha'i gnas lugs tshad/ /mkhyen pa'i srang gis gzhal nus btsong kha pa'i/ /ngo mtshar gsung rab glegs bam che rnams las/ /lhag pa'i sangs rgyas bka' de dmigs su med/ /de lta na yang rjes 'jug la la'i ngag /'brul pa'i mching bu dbang brtul dad pa'i rjes/ /'brang 'gas spyi bor bzung ste mkhas gzhan gyi/ /bstan bcos yid bzhin nor yang dor nas bshud/ /legs par bshad tshe grangs can ring lugs kyang / /thos dang bsam par byed pa'i dbang rnon bdag /kun slong dug chu myos pa'i gom stabs kyis/ /ris med thub bstan pad tshal ga la ji / /yig drug bzlas lung sbyor dngos rjes tshang tsam/ /rmi shes bla chen khra ta'i gral ring der/ /bcu phrag rig gnas skad snyan 'khrol ba'i bya/ /gzhan gsos blo ldan bdag chung dkar min 'bras/ /rgyal dar de sras sprul pa'i skur 'bod pa'i/ /sgro btags snyan pa'i phub ma 'gram pa'i 'og /tha mal ngan spyod nyal 'gro 'khyil ba'i deng / /ches cher snyigs ma lnga bdo'i byed pos sprul/ /longs spyod 'khor mang tshul 'chos mdzes pa'i gar/ /bstan —372

rgya bod sto sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la wen yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('a'adzin gzugs su bsgyur nas gzhan slu ba//thag khra sbrul du snang la dngangs pa'i grogs//rdzun mtshang gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i me long 'dra/ /nyon mongs chos ltar spyod pa'i dmod pa yis//gzhung lugasamang por thos pa'i mtshan ma stong //gzhan phan mig tu 14ba tha rdzus nas mos ldan lha//'drid pa'i tshul la yid skyo'i mchi ma ku//'dod pa'i ra gan tshul 'chos gser chu yis//bkrus zong tshong 'dus 'grim pa'i sgyu ma mkhan//skad cig tsam la lo brgya'i sdug bsngal ba'i//slu byed 'di la yid ston spyon pa'i gar//log rtog chu bor blun sgom gru zhig nas//sems kyi mgron por thar pa'i srog bral ba'i//phyag chen ming gis bsnyad pa'i dwags brgyud phal//ngan song klong du spro bas spron pa bzhin//de'i rigs mu lto'i chas kyi mi'u thung //stobs 'byor sa gsum 'dod kyang chags bral nyid //bya btang tha gu'i sto can gya gyu'i blo//gzugs su grub na mkha' 'di snod du chungs//kye ma de lta'i ngan phan spyod zhags pa yis//rang bzhin 'khor ba'i bsdun rar bcings mthong tshe//'jig rten khyim gyi bdag po ya rabs rnams//grags chen sangs rgyas de la mi ring nye//bka' btsan rgyal khrims gser gyi gdang bu rnams//'jam gnyen chos khrims dar gyis legs sbrel nas//sku gsum khang par bgrod la tshegasachung ba//mi dbang khyod kyis 'di phyi'i don gnyis ba//e ma chen po'i khungs ldan rigs kyis btsun//lha mi'i chos rnams sgrub la dpyod bzod mkhas//ya rabs chas kyi mdzes shing sgrigs kyis bzang /snyan 'gyur tshig gis bsngags 'os lha sras khyod//legs byas sna zhags ring brkyang myos bum gyis//rang rigs mes po'i khri la dbang bskur bas//chos srid bla nas blar 'degs btsun po'i las/khugs kyis gser ldan ma yang rjes su 'brang //rnam thos bu yi khengs 'phrog mtshan bzang sku//rjen par lta 10ldan ) bar ma bzod byed po yis/ /rin cen ga'u rna rgyan dkar dmar shal/ /rtsi ber snal gos 'ja' ris zol gyis bsgribs//mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i 'dab brgya nas//gsung gsang 'jebs pa'i ge sar skyugs pa'i rdul//btungs pa 'a ros myos chab 'bangs bud pa'i khyu//dga' ba'i glu len skyid pa'i gar gyis brel/shes byang snang na 'byams su klas pa'i blo'i//nyin byed 'bum phrag

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kye'achar ba'i thugs kyi mkha'/ /zab cing brling pa'i pha mtha' gzigs pa la/ /kun mkhyen tshad ma'i spyan gyis dkyus de thung / /'khor dang myang 'das kun skyed mdza' na mo'i/ /bzhin ras bkru ba'i lnga rig gaṅgā'i chu/ /blo gros rna bar 'dzin la ngal med pa'i/ /drang srong chu lha'i bu de khyod min su/ /sgyu rtsal drug cu'i shal la ki yi thags/ /za byed snga na med pa'i glang po 'dis/ /brgya byin rang gi bzhen pa'i snyems btang nas/ /blta phyir mig stong sprul te mkha' la 'ongs/ /mkhyen dpyod sa srung snas bus chab kyi rlangs/ ta shes bya nam mkha'i pha mtha' 'jal ba na/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i grags pa don ldan pa/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi dpe zlar deng 'dir grub/ /pad+ma'i skud pa ltar phra rig pa'i rtsal/ /blo gros ston gyi lha lam dngas pa'i ngos/ /mtha' yas srid pa'i gnas lugs rgyu skar tshogs/ /cig car shar yang dog pa med de mtshar/ /dpa' brtul yan lag stong gi sgyur thabs kyas/ /gzhan sde thal mar 'bigs nus nyag phran char/ /'bebs pa'i srid sgrub mdun sar dus mtha rlung / /'tshub 'dra'i bdud kyi dmag dpung chas kyang 'jig /phal spyod skad ngan brgyal yang ri dwags gtsor/ /stobs 'byor rams kyi mdangs (105ba)su bsgyur min pa'i/ /gong ma'i lung las cho rigs rtsal gsum kun/ /rdzogs pa'i gdong lnga pa de khyod du khums/ /lo 'bras stong bu mtshungs pa ljon pa'i shing / /skyed tshal ra bar bgrang yas 'phreng bkod kyang / /byang chub shing gi snying po a shwat+pa/ /grib ma gnyis pa'i grogs las gzhan na med/ /de phyir chos nor 'dod dang thar pa yi/ /gser sgong rang blo'i drod kyis yongs smin pa'i/ /'jig rten byed por grub zin khyod snyan du/ /bzhed skul pi wang rdung ba ngal ba'i rgyu/ /'on te cho 'brang dpal gyi be'u'i gzugs/ /snying gar legs 'khyil zhad por mdza' ba'i tshig /gtsug lag smig ma'i tshal rgyu gnag gi mos/ /gros su gleng bar 'os phyir tshul 'di gson/ /dgra sde rnam par gnon la dpa' ba'i rtsal/ /phyag na 'khor lo khros pa'i drag shul dang / /rang srid rdzogs ldan dus bzhin skyong ba la/ /nga las nu yi khengs pa thung ngur mdzod/ /ma 'dres 'bras 'byin bdud rtsi dug bum zung / /mi mngon thugs kyi chu gter klong sim nas/ /gsung 'jam 'dzum pa'i rlabs kyis gak+ṣ-i na sems sna/—374

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pekhrid tshe 'jug pa bcu pa'i spun zlar gyur/ /thabs kyis mtshang 'du snyan par smras ba yis/ /mi bsrun dgra sde'i seng ge'i blo brid nas/ /brtson ra khron par bcug ste srog 'phrog pa'i/ /brnag pa yid la 'chang ba dgra thabs mkhas/ /rgud tshe skyid pa'i tsan dan sdong bur 'khril/ /'byor na gnya' ba'i yal 'dab rtser zhen pa'i/ /gus chen kha gcig nas rkyong lce gnyis pa/ /thabs mkhas ri dwags lte ba'i dri yis gdul/ /dkar nag las kyis mtho dma' bar pa sa /bgrod pa'i bshul rjes 'brang tha grib ma'i 'bangs/ /gnyis min gcig tu sgril ba'i blo rtse can/ /snying gi thig ler skyong 'os sems kyi bu/ /rigs bzang bkra shis gser mig 'khyil ba'i nya/ /mi 'bral mgon skyabs srung ma'i chu bo'i klung / /gsol mchod bsten pa'i nor bu ke ta gas/ /(106na dgyes zhal mthon por drungs pa'i lha ngo bstod/ /mdzod spu'i zer gyi chas kyang 'chi ba'i mun/ /mthar byed tshe dpag med dang rnam par rgyal/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i ting 'dzin bzlas rjod kyis/ /las kyi me long ri mor mar mer byed/ /bag yod zhing pa'i lus phra ma'i mngal nang / /dus khrims sa bon kun+da legs smin pa'i/ /mtho ris myu gu'i khye'u bskrun pa las/ /thar pa'i 'bras bzang na tshod dar der gzigs/ /nyam nga'i 'byung po legs par mngon phyogasabam/ /brtson pas khrub tshe 'byung ba'i lce bcad nas/ /sbyin sogs rgyal sras spyod par gyur pa'i gser/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du mdzad med 'phel/ /rim gnyis lte ba 'phrin las rtsibs stong gis/ /bdud bzhi'i dgra tshogs las rgyal rnga bo che/ /rdung dang lhan cig zung 'jug thob pa'i dar/ /rigs kun bdag po'i khang bzang rtse mor phyor/ /de phyir 'tsho ba don ldan byed pa'i thabs/ /mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs 'thul ba nges gsang chos/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan bstan dang ston pa mchog /mjal zhing thos bsam byar yod skal ba che/ /dgag sgrub rnam par rtog pa'i dbang po'i gzhu/ /ma dag sems kyi 'char sgor snang ba'i 'phrul/ /bzo med rig rtsal dbyings kyi dag pa'i mkhar/ /kun rdzob chos kyi gzugs brnyan gar ma mthong / /a shad drod kyis nya yig zhu de'i rgyun/ /stong dang dbyer med zung du 'jug pa'i khams/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur smin dag zhing bcas/ /skal bzang khyod kyi bsgrub bya yin nam sems/ /—375

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyesu ste ka yi sgrar drangs shis rjod kyis/ /lha gcig rin cen myu gu bkram pa'i khrir/ /'bangs rnams byams pas bde bar skyong ba'i ched/ /yun du g.yo med 'tsho zhing gzhes shig gu /mnyes gshin brtse ba'i ma la ya yi rlung / /'gro 'ong chad pa med pas khyer ba'i dris/ /mngon sum mthong la sa yis ring bskal ba/ /(106ba〉brnag dka'i tsha gdung ming gi lhag mar byed/ /rab dkar lhag bsam chu bo bye ba'i rgyun/ /'bab pa'i yid kyi rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i 'phrin/ /brlang tshig dri bral zla shel bgrod pa'i 'gros/ /rang gi ngang tshul mi g.yel g.yar dam ga rjes/ /thags bzang du kū la yi gos gyon pa'i/ /tshig don lta na sdug pa'i gar mkhan zhig /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang rtse/ /mi rje 'chi med bdag po'i mdun sar song /me spre lo gong gi gser yig par byams gling sman pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dang mkhar sngon po'i dem ci dar gan chos rje byung ba phyir ldog pa dang lhan cig par jo rig thu dbon po ngag dbang blo gros mi snar btang ba'i dus kyi zhu yig rdzogs ldan pad dkar bzhad pa'i 'dzum mdangs/ kha sa rbu go me khyi la bri khya tsa kri tswa nā sa ha sru sa : la shā wa rti/ ma ñjisla ro ta r+ya ma hwa tsa pya da gro lo ka sha rnyan ra 〉ba skru la/ /(107na)gnam (sdeb sbyor nyer spyod/)sa'i dkyil 'khor kun la bsod nams kyi/ /rtsibs stong 'khor los mngan par dbang skur ba'i/ /'jig rten byed po tshangs dbang mi'i gzugs can/ /'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i zhabs drung du/ /rtsod dus snyigs mas sbags pa'i 'dam rdzab nang / /rdzogs ldan pad dkar 'dab brgyad rab bzhad pas/ /phan bde'i sbrang rtsi ster ba'i grags snyan sgra/ /rna ba'i bcud len gyur pas mchid 'di zhu/ /'jam dpal rdo rje rnon po'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /sa skyong rgyal po'i rnam par shar ba'i gar/ /mthong bas don dang ldan pa rdo rje'i sku/ /g.yo ba med de 'gro 'di'i bsod nams dpal/ /srid zhi'i gtsug tor rtse na rab bkra ba'i/ /bka' tham tshe ring gnam gyi she mong can/ /phyi nang gos dang sna tshogs rin po che'i/ /med byung bdog pa'i skyes dang bcas pa phebs/ /chos srid gnyis ldan gangs can dbus 'gyur 'dir/ /bde bar 'tsho ba'i sdom brtson ku swā li/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa'i/ /—376

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (sebastan pa phyogs brgyar spel ba'i 'dun par gnas/ khams gsum kun las rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /rigs ldan rigs kyi dbang phyug dam pa khyod/ /lha bcas skye rgu'i gtsug na mngon 'phags pa'i/ /gtam 'di dri za'i phang 'gro'i sgra las snyan/ /gang phyir rgyal dang rgyal sras snying stobs can/ /bsam bzhin 'khor los sgyur ba'i srid 'dzin par/ /tshad ldan gsung rab du mar legs gsungs pa'i/ /tshul 'dir the tshom khyogs la su zhig 'phyang / /nor 'dzin ma 'dis bteg pa'i khor yug steng / /gnas pa'i skye rgu'i re ba skong ba la/ /lha khyod dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa'am/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po gces par nges/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal rdzogs ldan dus (107ba)kho nar/ /'byung zhes chos mngon gzhung du bshad pa rdzun/ /bden na rtsod pa'i dus 'dir gnam dang sa/ /kun gyi dbang phyug khyod nyid su yis bskrun/ /bde skyid snang ba ster la nyin mor byed/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal la lha min bzang / /gtsug lag lugs brgya smra la 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /srid zhi'i byed por gong ma hong de'i mtshan/ /zhabs pad gser 'brug gis bteg khri chen por/ /bskal brgya'i bar du nam yang g.yo med cing / khrims gnyis gdugs dkar nor bu'i yu ba can/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du 'khor gyur cig /zab cing dkyil che gangs thugs byams brtse'i mdangs/ /dgyes 'dzum zhal gyi gangs ri las 'ongs pa'i phebasatshogs gang ga'i rgyun la 'gran pa dag /nyi zla'i 'gros ltar chad pa med pa zhu/ /lha mig rnam par dag pa'i spyan ras/ /gzigs pa 'bab rten rin cen 'phreng ba gsum/ /gzhen pa mchog dang 'jam phyug khres rnams la/ /rtags kyi re kha'i lang tshos rnam spras te/ /kun phan mgo yis nya ba gzhu yi khyim/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa la/ /sdo bzhi'i dpal mnga' dga' ldan pho brang zhes/ yi/ 'dzin ri ba'i khang bzang rtse nas phul/ /mnga' ris ru thog dbang po mang thos yon tan gyi khur ldan de mi bsrun gzhan rkyen gyis dbus gtsang phyogs su gzhi bab nas yun ring song mthar snyan tshig byung ba'i ma phrin lan gdung sel snang ba'i mchod sbyin/ (108na/bro ba she ya tsa da ta ga masho : gyu dzi snya ma ṇiḥ su 'e rnyi ta/ 2 bu ge sa ma dhu r+ya na ma me ra k+ṣaḥ ki ti tsa ta : lha—377

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyeg tsa/ /dge (sdeb sbyor dag pa'i snang ba/)ba'i yid bzhin nor bu las/ /phan bde'i 'dod rgu rab sbyin mkhan/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mtshan snyan po/ /srid rtser grags nges khyod la srungs/ /bgrang bya'i khur gyis yal ga 'khyogs na yang / /rnam dpyod blang dor 'bras bzang yongs dud pa/ /dpag bsam ljon pa'i spun zla gnyis pa de'i/ /'phrin yig snyan tshig 'phreng ba sug par son/ /gnam bskos shar phyogs gong ma'i lung las kyis/ /srid zhi'i gtsug tor rtse mor legs bcings shing / /gtsug lag rgya mtshor la jug pa'i spobs pa'i mgrin/ /gzengs su mtho ba'i gtam 'dir rna ba blogs/ /las nyon srad bu thags su nyer btags pa/ /stobs 'byor 'od bkrag 'tsher ba'i za 'og gos/ /bde sdug ri (108bso'i snang brnyan mtha' klas pa/ /byed po dkar nag sgyu ma'i sprul sgyur mkhan/ /skor gsum yul gyi log spyod ri dwags srog /'phrog 'dod rā ma ṇa yi sgyu thabs des/ /ngal mthar skye rgu'i bde ba si ta mo/ /mi bsrun 'bod grogs sprul pas khyer gyi dogs/ /lha gcig zhang dbon srid kyi ljon shing la/ /dman 'bangs ltos 'gro'i lus kyis nyer 'byud pa'i/ /tshul 'di dus kyi dbang gis skal ngan par/ /byed po gser mngal can der 'gro rnams bshud/ /de lta'i skye rgu'i ngang tshul chu shel dbang / /srid pa'i lha lam ngos su 'phel 'grib can/ /snying med e raṇ+ḍa yi 'bras bu la/ /mkhas khyod rmi lam rtsed 'jor cis mi rtog /mi bzad 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i rlabs 'phreng g.yo/ /zug rngu'i chu srin che ba rab gtsigs kyang / /legs byas mthun pa'i rlung gi shugs drag pas/ /dal 'byor gru gzings bde ba'i gling bgrod snyam/ /'khor mun mig sman ltar gnag mtshan mo'i mthar/ /legs byas skya rengs dang por shar ba las/ /thar pa'i snang ba 'bum sde'i mchod sbyin mkhan/ /dge tshogs nyin mor byed pa rtag bsten rigs/ /mched zla gnyis med bla med bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /dug gsum nad brgya 'joms pa'i thangs gsos sman/ /ster ba'i sngon med 'tsho byed zas gtsang sras/ /'di ko grags pa don ldan thams cad mkhyen/ /de'i gsung dri med gnam sngon bzhun ma'i mtsho/ /phyag chen rgan po'i rnyog mas sbags pa kun/ /'khon rigs 'jam mgon nor bu ke ta das/ /legs drungs dpyod ldan dga' ba —378

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dzadabaskyed bya'i yul/ /rang rigs rgan po'i ri bong cal rjes su/ /rgyug min dbang rnon chos kyi rjes 'brang khyod/ /grags skam mching bu'i do shal mi 'chol bar/ /legs bshad nor bu gtsug tu bsten de mtshar/ /'di na 'jam mgon mi (109na〉sku srid pa'i gar/ /legs sgyur shes bya kun gzigs btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs 'cha rtsod rtsom pas 'dzin rlom gyi/ /tshul 'dis dal 'byor 'tsho ba don ldan tsam/ /sman ljongs lta na sdug pa'i grong khyer nas/ /sman gyi bla ma be+e ḍūr 'od po che'i/ /sman rgyal gser mdog las 'ongs zil dngar gyi/ /sman yon des kyang khyod gdung sel gyur cig /rab snyan rgyud mang rjes su snyeg byed pa'i/ /rin cen sil sgra 'brol ba'i gdu bu 'di/ /blo gros 'dab gshog rab rgyas lus dkar ba'i/ /'khor lo'i yan lag can de'i rgyan du 'os/ /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa khyi lor bris pa'i chab lha/ga 'phrin yig khag /sa pho khyi lo gong nas shes rab bla ma/ bsam gtan dge slong sogs bka' shog gnang sbyin bzang po skyel bar byung ba'i lan se ra rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyang grags pa dang chus bskor smad pa nor bu gnyis 'bul bar btang pa'i dus kyi zhu yig gnam bskos rin r+sā cod pan/tri bha lha pa chi bya pya u ② su rā lha tsa lo ke shwa re 9 snyi ṇiñca su tsa/ /moku nā ra t+na tswa 〉 sko mo lo'i she ṣa〉be / ta spru la :bri sa ra ka /srid (sdeb sbyor me tog phreng can/) pa gsum gyi bla na rab mtho ba'i/ /rgyal por tshangs pas ma wa zhe par dbang bskur ba/ /rang rtagasarin cen cod pan dbu rgyan du/ /mdzes pa'i khyad par can gyur lha'i zhabs drung / /(109ba po khor ba'i ljon shing dman pa las gzhan par/ /lhag pa'i thar lam ma la yar skyes kyi/ /bslab gsum mngar ba'i drir spyod dge sbyong gis/ /rab dkar yid kyi kun+da bzhad de zhu/ /tshe ring gnam gyi she mong phyag rgya can/ /phun tshogs rin cen za 'og skyes dang bcas/ /gser yig pho nya'i lag sor gyis —379

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyethogs te/ /nub phyogs chos kyi mdun sar 'gog med phebs/ /bsod nams bye ba phrag brgya'i sa bon 'bras/ /rab smin dar bab sku gsung thugs kyi mkhar/ /chos srid nyi zla'i snang ba zung 'brel ba'i/ /'od kyis khams gsum khyon kun cig car bkang / /de tshe rtsod par rlom pa'i sdig to'i dpung / /ma rung mig sman ltar gnag mun pa kun/ /ming gi lhag mar btang bas rgya hor sogs/ /nyi 'og khams na phan bde'i 'od kyis dkar/ /ris med skye rgur skyed pa'i ngal stegs 'di/ /lha gcig bka' drin kho nar shes gyur na/ /'gro rnams bskal par bsags pa'i bdog pa kun/ /gcig tu spungs kyang 'jal nus pha mtha' phra/ khyod snyan grags pa dbyar rnga ltar gyur pas/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i 'jing ltar zab brling ba/ /mtha' dag brjod na gser mngal can gyi blo/ /rnam dpyod drod kyis smin yang cung zhig ngal/ /'di na chen po'i lung 'dzin klog pa mkhan/ /'gro la rjes brtse'i rab dkar lhag bsam dang / /chos kun dbu mar rtogs pa zung 'jug pa'i/ /snang tshul 'dis 'tsho dal ba don ldan tsam/ /'dzam gling yongs kyi phan bde'i srog gcig pu/ / gnam sa'i dbang phyug nor 'dzin skyong ba'i rje/ /dpal ldan gong ma rgyal po chen po'i zhabs/ /gser 'brug gis bteg khri la brtan gyur cig /chad pa med pa gaṅgā 'a chu bo'i rgyun/ /lam gsum dag las rtag tu 'bab pa ltar/ /gang gi bka' tham gser gyi zam po che/ /(110na)rgya bod yul du chad med 'dzugs par gsol/ /lha mig rnam par dag pa'i spyan ras kyi/ /yul du 'gyur byed rin cen 'phreng ba dang / /sna tsho gos 'jam po phrug gi grangs bcas pa'i/ /nyung ngu'i bdog pa'i skyes la rgyas spras te/ / rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa pho khyi yi lo/ /hor gyi zla ba gsum par yongs grags pa'i/ /gral tshes dge bar chos kyi sde chen po/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs gru 'dzin rtse nas phul/ /bla ma lha rtse ba'i sprul sku ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub lung las kyis 'dod pa'i re ba yongs su bkang ba'i tshe tham phud kyi tshul du snyan ngag gi ma phran yig byung ba'i lan mngon 'dod rtse dga' gsar ba'i glu/ na hā ba dza ma : ba dza / yu zhwa smi nāgi ka nā ba : hi ta ༷ r+gha/ /a dru r+ya sa ji gi tsa bha bya ba yi lu 〉 sle kha da ste spri na ku—38()

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pelu ( 2/ /lus(sdo rwa ra dang po rdo rje/thon kun la rjes su nyer chags pa'i/ /ma smad skye ba'i srid pa ring bzung ba/ /dam pa'i myu gu'i dus kyang dge ba'i 'bras/ /rigs med 'gro la ster bar byed de'i 'phrin/ /(110ba〉gan 'gyur rgyud du drangs pa'i ta'i ra/ /lci yang sdeb sbyor glu ru nyer khugs pa/ /sgra 'dzin yul du snyad byed sa'i zla ba/ /thags kyi ri mo rnam bkrar bcas pa 'byor/ /gcig shes kun tu grol ba'i sgron me yis/ /rmongs mun rum du bag la zha ba'i chos/ /drang nges dbyibs tshul kha dog rab gsal ba'i/ /sngon med sgyu ma'i ltad mor 'byams klas grang / /'on te grangs med las nyon ches phra ba'i/ /srad bu thags su byas las bde sdug gi /ri mo'i bkod pa sna tshogs 'char ba 'dis/ /kun rdzob chos kun nges par bden min nam/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo 'jig la nyer dpa' ba'i/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya'i mtshan gyi sgra bo che/ /'thob byed gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi/ /brjod don rtogs pa'i chos phung mkha' ltar yangs/ /'gro blo'i lha lam zad min dam chos kyi/ /dgu tshigs sge rags med pa srid min yang / /'char dang nub pa spangs pa'i dam bca' can/ /phyag chen sngon med nyi ma'i 'od 'di gsal/ /phal pa'i rlung las khyad par lte sngon can/ /rtogs pa don brgyud shugs kyis thub pa'i bstan/ /kun gsal 'gram par rgyu ba'i phag mo gru/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i grags pa phyogs kun snyan/ /gang gi ye shes me yis gnyis 'dzin lus/ /bsregs 'bras stong gzugs grub ldan grangs med pa/ /spel tshe gtsug na zla ba khengs pa'i gzhu/ /nyer gug gangs ri'i phag tu dka' thub bsten/ /nyams rtogs rgya mtshor ro gcig gling ras kyi/ /snying po'i zil dngar longs su spyod mkhas pa/ /'chi med rigs kyi zla ba gsar pa khyod/ yi/ba rigs kun+da'i tshal de ba 'ad la dpa'/ /'on kyang tha snyad rig pa'i dpal bes /snying ga'i ngos su mdzes dang lhan cig par/ /lung las gom pa gcig gis chen po'i sar/ /bgrod tshe tha gu'i lho can ngal bar bkod/ /snying po bde bar gshegs pa'i khang bzang du/ /'gro kun 'dren pa'i cho ga (111na)rdzogs pa'i ched/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i rin cen them skas la/ /'dzeg pa'i khur chen yun du bsten pa gces/ /don bzang sems kyi de nyid nar —381

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)son cing / /tshig sbyor sgro gshog rtsal kun yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /mi bskyud 'phrin gyi gzhan gsos skad snyan can/ /dpyid kyi pho nyar yang dag rgyu zhig gu /nyams dang 'gyur ba'i ro brgya'i dpal ldan pa/ /zas su bgyis snod zla ba bzhun ma li/ /mtha' klas gzugs brnyan bkra ba'i za ma tog /'tshams sprin gzhon nu'i mdangs kyis 'gyud de song / /stag rtse sprul sku ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub kyi snyan tshig gi 'phrin lan dam pa'i khyad par rab gsal/ 5 lu ṇ+ḍi gishunya so ga wa me 〉 da khyi ga〉 slo ba bo dhaḥ su ba tsu/ /ga lha ku ྅ ka ra so ra pra k+ṣa ju dasmi smi 6 ka ma lu sa mya : ya/ /thos(sdeb sbyor chu lhos phreng ba/)bsam drod kyi blo gros sto ba sto /lung rtogs gser gyi sgo nga legs smin pa'i/ /grub rigs khar nyal tshogs kyi byed pa po/ /bshesaganyen tshangs pa'i spun zla gnyis par springs/ /(111ba tshe legs byas ri dbang 'phrul gyis mngon 'thon pa/ /nyer len zla ba'i mched zla yongs 'du'i shing / /tshang tshing dman las khyad par 'phags pa'i chos/ /lhag bsam ro brgya'i 'bras bus dud las ci/ /gangs can ra bar mang pos bkur ba yi/ /lha gzigs rigs kyi 'khri shing myu gu'i rtser/ /gnas lugs don gyi skad snyan gzhan gsos gang / /nyer bsten dbyar gyi dga' ston rna bar 'jebs/ /ma rig rgyar chud 'khrul pa'i ri dwags 'gro/ /thar pa'i srog 'phrog dra ba gcod pa'i mtshon/ /gnyug ma sems kyi ral gri rnon po de/ /rnam dpyod phrag pa'i khyogs la blangs sam ci/ /log shes snang ngor sgyu ma'i rta glang tshogs/ /gso dang gsod pa'i tshul bzhin tha snyad du/ /phan gnod 'phrin las rten 'brel snang ba'i cha/ /rgyu dang 'bras bur nges pa rnyed de mtshar/ /bag yod tshul bzhin 'chos pa'i du kū las/ /sgrib min ngan g.yo'i smyos bum ches dkar bar/ /srid las rtsod pa'i mchan ma steng gsal ba/ /rnam bkra'i 'dren byed tshul gyis bag la zha/ /srid pa'i bde la chags bral dka' thub kyis/ /grangs med skye rgu'i lha rnams blo 'brid kyang / /phyogs chen mda' lnga'i shugs kyis dbang med du/ /chul min u mar brtse bas sa 'di gang / /phyag na 'jam mnyen chu skyes 'dab brgya'i mchan/ /snyan pa'i dbyar rnga can de'i ring lugs klog /g.yo med 'gog —382

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pepa'i chu 'dzin phag zha na/ /grub rigs thun gsum mun par nyal lam ci/ /ro 'dzin shar ri'i stegs las nyer 'phags pa'i/ /legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od brgya spros pa'i tshe/ /gtam med pad+ma 'dzum pa'i chu sgros nas/ /ze'u 'bru'i tshems dkar ston pa mtshar che'i gnas/ /phyag rgya gcig gi gnas lugasade/ khres pas chos kun (112na)grol lo zhes/ /sgrog pa'i skad gsang mthon po bzhin/ /re ba don dang ldan las ci/ /de'i phyir lugs 'di'i gdugs dkar po/ /'dzin khyod snyim pa'i za ma tog /man shel zhun ma 'khyil ba'i ngos/ /sna tsho gos ri mo ci yang gsal/ /'bri gung zhabs drung chos kyi grags pas chosargyal rin cen phun tshogs kyi rnam thar dang gshin rje khyab 'jug sogs kyi bu sta ka dang bcas chab shog gnang ba'i lan gsang gsum rgyan gyi lor lo/ dz+nyā na re rā ྅ ma ha taḥ sa mu dra lha ni ma chu 'i : ga dha r+ya ni rti/ /) guḥ bi byu spu ya ra tā tsā 'o lo ka r+ya ཿrje : ṣa tsa ka 7 shāḥ ye (sdeb sbyor dbang po rdo rje/)shesamachog gi chu gter chen po las/ /ngo mtshar sprul pa'i bsil sbyin mkhan po'i gar/ /gsang gsum mi zad 'khor lo'i cha shas kun/ /legs gang rig 'dzin gtsug rgyan rin po cher/ /(112ba〉sku gsum dag pa'i rang bzhin 'byam klas pa/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i byed por yongs shar ba'i/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan la/ /gzhan ngor nyer 'tshes gos min phan bde'i dpyid/ /sna tshogs theg pa'i chos kyis gdul bya yi/ /rang rang mos ngor 'jug pa'i gsung gi gdangs/ /'gro rnams theg pa mchog tu bkri ba'i glur/ /len 'di'i dpe slar dus gsum rgyal rnams brel/ /sgrib gnyis rtog bral dwangs pa'i thugs kyi mtshor/ khres bya'i gzugs brnyan ma lus yongs shar bas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'byung gnas 'og min zhes/ /logs su 'tshol ba byis pa'i blo gros bzhin/ /'di na srid las nges 'byung gi tā ma/ /dor nas ga' na phan smig rgyu'i ri dwags la/ /snyeg 'dod zhabrul ba'i blo yi rā ma ṇa/ /'khor ba'i thang la ngal ba lhur len tsam/ /'od stong pha mtha' yas pa'i thugs rje'i zer/ /si rgyu'i rgya mtshor 'phros pa'i yid bzhin nor/ /'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i rigs sngags 'chang / /pad+ma 'gyung gnas gdung sob khyod min su/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i rang bzhin 'jam pa'i dpal/ /dus dgrar —383—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kye'akhor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon pa/ /grub pas bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /mthu stobs grags snyan phyogs kyi mgrin par 'dzer/ /mjing yon lha sras dag pa'i smon lam gyis/ /yang srid skyur ra'i rigs su nyer bltams pa'i/ /sna tshogs rang grol nyin byed chu lha'i phyogs/ /gzhol yang sprul pa'i zla khyod 'od kyis gsal/ /stong chen phyag rgya'i dgu tshigs ska rags kyis/ shes bya nam mkhar pha mtha' 'ching nus pa/ /gnyug ma chos sku'i rang zhal ston pa la/ /'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i tshul la 'khu/ /snang bzhi'i 'bab chu zad min de srid du/ /'ja' lus gser ldan lto bar yongs 'bab pa'i/ /lhun grub chos kyis gdul (113na)bya smin mdzad pas/ /be+e ro tsa na gzugs gzhan gnyis pa bzung / /phyag rdzogs zung 'jug gser gyi myu gu dag /legs bkram chos srid gnyis ldan khri chen por/ /rig 'dzin bye ba'i shing rta chen po ba/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i bcas su rtag brtan gso/ /bcu gnyis khyim gyi bgrod pa'i lam yangs por/ khu6 skar 'phreng ba 'chad pa med pa bzhin/ /legs par bshad pa'i bka' mched gtam gyi 'phreng / /dzaḥ yi bu mo'i spun slar zhu/ /dri ma med pa'i spyan ras bh+ra ma ra / /nyams dang 'gyur ba'i tshal du 'jug pa'i rten/ /lha rdzas rin cen gnyis pa'i pad+ma dkar/ /rgya yi lang tshos 'khyud de phul pa dge /rgya gar gyi rgyal po shākya rā dza'i sras 'bring po shar phyogs nga ga la'i grong khyer la dbang sgyur ba rgyal po sha ha su dzas ma hā ma da sha bī gser yig su mngags te 'phags yul gyi bdog pa'i skyes bzang po byung ba'i dus bsrings pa'i 'phrin yig rigs stobs dpal gye mngan mtho/ sa tā ku 9 so ba rje sa na ta na su ma hā sa mu dra ma/ na ta/ bu d+dhi sa tā sa mūl pra lha re ྅ shā ri mi ta sto ga ska rjo mu na/ pra kṛ ti shu dha shā pa tri bi sta ra tri ka yapha la ba du shaḥ dam pa'i yon tan bsngags par 'os pa'i rgya mtsho chen po bsrubs pa las/ /byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba rab brtan phyin drug spyod pa'i yal ga can/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i lo 'dab rab rgyas sku gsum 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i/ (113ba) bi nā ya ka ka ྅ dru ma dha ri : sa 2 snye na〉 shu bha ma stu/ tsa tu rmu kha ni la ka ṇa/ ma hā bi ṣ+ṭaḥ de le sbo gaṇa pa ti gi shu ka rti kaḥ—384

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('abha skar shi taraḥdi lo ka ka rta/su763praṅgā ni rlu/rak+ṣa skyo/yang na bdulo spo ta su purkyen/bi bul lha mā yi shwa rlabarti rādz+nyā la:ku lo tsa ba la phyashādhar su/ma nu bya su pa ti twa ma yi dza yas/rnam 'dren dpag bsam ljon pa chos dang dge 'dun bcas pas khyod la dag gyur cing //gdong bzhi pa dang mgrin sngon khyab 'jug che//lha dbang tshogs bdag gzhen nu kārti ka/nyi zla la sogs 'jig rten byed po yi//legs bris gtso bo rnams kyis khyod la srungs//mchod sbyin mang por spel ba'i bsod nams kyis//yangs pa'i sa la dbang sgyur rgyal po yi//phun tshogs rigs dang stobs kyi dpal 'dzin pa'i//mi yi bdag po khyod nyid rgyal gyur cig/(114na)otru shi rbud shrīka pu rbo /ma:de sha sum hā rwadzā su lu:spubatā ku lhan rang ti sha ha su dzā/su kalpa tsa tu rba buḥshākya mu ni ti rādza shornyonganis shrī rbasidha ka yat+ta/sgyu nu su ra to ba hu pra pa tsan bā ṣa kasaḥzhe sgog phyo t+taradi sha dha wal gi re dza na bde smra na su shra ma ṇa lha gis su lha su garwa bha ya kawatsa mu ni shā sa na sman sgyu ha/ces shes pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa sngon du btang nas/rgya gar gyi rgyal po chen po shing swā la pa lta bu'i rigs las mi'i bdag po sha ha su dzā la/skal bzang gi sangs rgyas bzhi pa shākya thub pa zhes rgyal po zas gtsang gi sras don thams cad grub pa gang de'i rjes su zhugs te gsung rab mang po la klog pa kha ton dang /spong ba bsam gtan du spyod pa'i yul byang phyogs gangs ri'i ljongs su gnas pa'i dge sbyong ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes gsol pa/mi'i bdag (114ba khor pa ti ta wakā ya su paṇa sharadakā la sra59tsan+da pa di sta re/bi rgyu snyan:ga lwa yu shi spe bi bo dhi ra ṇi bṛhasu rta:rdzunas26mun/dwas su pra nā sa ma sta su pā la su bi mok+ṣa sum churaya sha ka rten4ta muṅgā haḥnu mo di toḥwa ti/sa brtson ma dha rā bdunashuta su dza〉྅ham bi/tribha wa na sus /daḥ

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)kha ma pa yi ba ta ma hā kā ruṇi ka /po khyod kyi sku zo mdog bde ba ston mtshan kyi zla ba nya gang ba ltar rgyas shing / rig pa'i gnas dang sgyu rtsal gyi ngang tshul la rnam par byang ba drang srong phur bu dang srid sgrub kyi mched zla can/ mnga' 'bangs kyi skye rgu mtha' dag bde bar skyong ba'i rnam par thar pa'i snyan grags rna ba'i sgor son pas spro ba dang rjes su yi rang bar gyur/ sa spru dz+nyā'i ming 'dzin pa don du mang por ma thos pa'i blun po spyi rtol can bdag kyang / khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad pha mar shes nas srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la dmigs nas snying rje chen pos yid drangs te/ (115na〉pano ni tā bi : ta mā rnye :/ gam na sa su kha sha sma rā dz+nyā sno g.ya sti sa zhe sa rnyo ྅ su karma pa rā kra me kho dwa swā ༷ la: /tha ma kho bā h+ma ṇa : khyi be da dha rāḥ sa ka la nā mā da rerka rta bye/ ba tra sa rnyi rta/ lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ldan par gnas/ 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgya'(po rnams kyi spyod tshul la rag lus pa kun la mnyen gshin pa'i mdzad pa bzang po brtul phod pas mnga' 'bangs rnams skyong zhing / dge sbyong bram ze drang srong rig byed 'dzin pa mtha' dag bla nas blar 'degs pa'i rtsa lag dam pa mdzad 'tshal/ shī ta rdza / ba ra/ shu dha spa ṭi ka phya la/ pa tre ri kasbi sa hi ti dzi kra mu na/ shu rnya sma ṭi ka su ka la k+ṣa da na sa rnyi rta/ ba ha ya pa ṭa bsta mu tsi tre/ a sa zhi ra tsi tra pa sa dī ji : sa lha rta/ zhes rten kha btags/ g.yang khri'u'i phud phor phud sder dang bcas pa brkos ma/ g.yang tre'u'i bum pa khebs bcas/ phyi gos khra'o/ /nang dar sman rtse yug dang bcas/ (115ba)pa la wa gso khru ra sha ra da ma ju ma mā sa shu kla pa' phya ༷ ti 4 bha dra ba ra bu dha sa ra k+ṣa / nu 〉 dha mi 'u ta su su ka lo/ shrī ma t+ta /la ga3dha rma su ma ཿ se na / shu lha/ rnam 'phyang gi lo ston zla 'bring po'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang po gnyis pa res gza' lhag pa dang / zla skar lha mtshams 'dzom pa'i dus dge bar/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde chen po nas dge /sa pho khyi lo hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin/ zab yangs mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa 'i srung ma dregs pa sde dpon chen po tsi —386

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rang snyan rgyud mang / (pedamar bas rim gro'i blang dor dang / ༅ dgos r+ṣa sna lnga'i spyan gzigs dgos tshul gyi rdo rje tshon lan rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs ra/ rgyal bar gyur cig ngo mtshar dbyangs kyi sgra/ /rdo rje'i gsung gi gsang ba dbyar gyi rnga/ /sgra 'dzin yul du thos tshe gtsug phud can/ /dga' ba'i zlos gar bzhin du sgyur la brel/ /gtum chen dregs pa bros pa gdong lnga'i skad/ /'jigs rung nga ros dgra sde glang chen gyi/ /klad pa 'gem yang dam ldan rig 'dzin la/ /blang dor ston pa'i snyan 'gyur 'di na 'jebs/ /rgyal gsung 'grel par byas pa glegs bam kun/ /klog cing khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde chen po/ /bkra shis grangs la srid zhus bya ba kun/ /myur du bskyud med sgrub pa'i 'dun par mchis/ /dbang (116na bzhus dpe zlar 'os pa'i gos zung lnga/ /ro mchog btung ba'i dpal ldan nyams med kyis/ /nyer mtshon kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /nor 'dzin lto ba bkang ste 'bul gyi bzhes/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa 'gro ba'i bde skyid dang / khyad par gangs can ra ba dkar po yis/ khor yug gcig tu gyur 'di legs srung bar/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i bka' bzhin g.yel med mdzod/ /mi mthun mun tshogs sel la 'od dkar can/ /bsod nams 'od stong 'bar bar nyin mor byed/ khams gsum dbang du sdud la yid bzhin nor/ /'jam po'i las rnams bcos kun myur du sgrubs/ /dug mtshon g.yul gshom ngan sems 'chang ba'i dgra /dngos dang bag la zha ba'i mda' lnga pa/ /lha chen drag por khros pa'i mig gi mes/ /rab sregasarjes med thal ba rlung la skur/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /bum pa bzang po ji bzhin bsams pa'i don/ /re ba skong mdzad chos skyong chen po yis/ /phun tshogs dkar po'i ba dan dbyings su phyor/ /snyan shal zung du 'brel ba'i lha rdzas dang / /gser skyems sa yi zla ba zho gsum la/ /thun 'tshams gsar pa'i lang tshos rgyas btab ste/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs cho me kyi dzinas phul/ /'khrul med kyi gling pa bcu gcig gi nang tshan gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i chos rgyud 'dzin pa gnam gong bla ma pad+ma las grub kyis kong yul gyi snga 'gyur bstan pa dar rgud byung ba la yid 'byung bas nyams gsos kyi skul ma dang bcas pa'i tshigs bcad kyi 'phrin lan bsams pa lhun gyis grub pa'i bden gtam/ /(116ba) nirmā rgya ni rti ཿ pha lha na : lha ya tsāni—387

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyemi t+ta pya bha nga la sa ha sra sa ti dza si ku/ kā shā ma lo da ya sa nā a nu bha wa dza 1 byum hā phra rā kra ma tsa ra k+ṣi ta ma : bi ghā/ /'od (sdeb sbyor dpyid thig )mtshan stong du 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis/ /snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i sprul pa'i gar/ /dri med gsal mtshor shar ba'i nus mthu'i rtsal/ /'dzam gling che ba'i rig sngags 'chang gis srungs/ /dman pa'i khyad par las gzhan theg mchog gi /rigs kyi bag chags sad pa mngar ba'i dri/ /na tshod lhag phran dus kyang yongs 'thul ba'i/ /rig 'dzin tsan dan ljon pa'i 'phrin skyes 'byor/ /bsod nams dkar ba'i cha shas rab 'phel ba/ /phun tshogs mngon mtho'i rten bzang bsil sbyin mkhan/ /nyer 'tshe sgra gcan mun gos rgyang bsrings te/ /bde skyid kun+da'i 'dab stong ba 'ad de spro/ /rnal 'byor gsum gyi dgongs pa'i chu bo kun/ /pad+ma badz+ra 'khor lo'i smin grol lam/ /'phrin las rgya mtshor 'dus pa'i mchod sbyin gyi/ /byed por rgyal dbang (117na)pad+mas khyod bsngags snyam/ /lha sras smon lam yongs 'du'i myu gu gang / /rab smin sangs rgyas rdo rje'i 'bras bu'i khur/ /mngon par lci ba'i zab gter ro brgya'i bcud/ /myong khyad sa 'dir 'phos pa'i legs bris bzhin/ /tshul min zhing bcu'i me tog mda' can sde/ /mngon spyod drag sbyor lha chen mig gi mes/ /mi rtag lam du 'god nus snga 'gyur gyi/ /bstan la gaṅgā'i rdul grangs bag la zha/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma'i sprin phung cher 'khrigs par/ /las bzhi'i 'phrin las char 'bab glog 'khyug kyang / /ka dag rang gsal rig pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /kun rdzob chos kyi snang ba dmigs su med/ khor yug ra ba gcig gis dkar ba'i 'gror/ /bsam pa lhun gyis grub par o rgyan rje'i/ /zhal 'ches rdo rje'i gsung gis mi slu na/ /kong yul gsang rnying ring lugs ces mi 'phel/ /gsal stong dag pa'i rang rig stong pa'i dbyings/ /lhun grub snang ba'i 'char sgo 'ja' tshon ltar/ /'gag med shar tshe kun tu bzang po zhes/ /grags can sangs rgyas lam de mi ring nye/ /'di na zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba yi/ /ring lugs 'dzin pa'i ris su nyer son kyang / thu kya'i rjes zhugs ris med grub mtha'i chos/ /sbyangs pas dang ba'i dad pa gcig tu dkar/ khyad par 'jam mgon mi yi srid pa'i —388

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('gar/ khri srong bod 'bangs 'gro la dgongs pa'i don/ /phan bde'i rtsa bar nges nas zab mo'i gter/ /dar ba'i lhag bsam dbyar gyi mtsho la 'gran/ /dpyid kyi dpal la chags pa'i mgrin pa nas/ /tshig don snyan sgrog khu byug gzhen nu yi/ /gshog rlabs shing gi ma ma'i mkha' yangs por/ khyu ba'i 'phur lding rtsed 'jor rtag tu rol/ /nyams 'gyur glur len chu shing brla can (117bsgo/ /thags bzang du kū la yi gos gyon nas/ /kong yul nags klung 'khrigs pa'i yul ljongs su/ /rig sngags 'chang khyod mig gi bdud rtsir song / /wa zha'i rigs las khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo gnas gsar chos rje mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan la 'phrin du gsol pa smin grol mtho ris chu bo/ a tu pra ṇa : ta sha sha pra ṇa ba khru pra stu na pa nyi kyi ka lngatsa/ rdzu wa nu bha lha rdo ba to ma ra khye ra ྅ ni mi t+ta dz+nyā la ya :me ga la /med (sdeb sbyor dbang yi rgyud/jung bdud rtsi'i btung bas rab myos pas/ /bskal bar mi shigs g.yung drung rdo rje'i srog /'tsho ba'i dngos po don dang ldan pa yi/ /'chi med 'od mtshan 'bar bas shis pa stsol/ /ye shes sna lnga'i 'od mdangs 'ja' ris can/ /gdan gsum tshangs pa'i rigs kun bdag po'i dpyid/ /'tshams sprin gos kyi zlos gar sgyur ba'i gzugs/ /ltar snang nyes dris gos min spro dga' brtas/ /ma dag kun 'khrud smin byed 'gaṅgā 'a chab/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan (118na)tshangs pa'i ral klung nas/ /tshad med 'bebs 'dis skal ldan shing rta de/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon zol gyis rgyu ba bzhin/ /snod bcud dag pa'i snang ba rten brten pa'i/ /'khor lo rab bkra'i ngo mtshar bkod pa yis/ /tha mal zhen pa bzlog tshe 'khor ba'i gnas/ /'og min zhing gi ngo bor 'byams su klas/ /ljon shing phal pa'i mngal gyisabaskrun min pa/ /a shā da brang steng bsrubs las skyes pa'i drod/ /mi bzad gtum mo 'bar ba'i rgod ma khas/ /lwa ba'i gos kyi chen pa thung ngur byas/ /a nya 'bar 'jag dga' bzhi bde ba'i nyams/ /'khor 'das dbyer med stong pa'i ngo bo sa /brjod bral ro gcig gyur pas zung 'jug sku/ /bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa la gom pa 'god/ /de'i tshul rnal 'byor dbang phyug ba ched srol gyi/ /lam dang —389

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'abras bur bcas pa'i gsang chen chos/ /snod ldan slob mar bshad bya bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /thob pa'i 'chi med bdag po khyod min su/ /thub bstan yongs 'du rdzogs pa'i dam chos kyi/ /gom pa gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sa/ /bgrod na mkhas rlom stobs ldan gzhu las skyes/ /phyogs re'i yon tan kun bzang 'og tu song / /'jam dpal rdo rje'i zhal lung rnon po yi/ /mtshon chas rmongs chen 'khor ba'i dra ba kun/ /bcad tshe dkar nag blta ba'i me long gi /khur 'dzin gshin rje'i pho nyas ngal ba btang / /tshogs bshad gser chus byugs pa'i ra gam zong / /cal sgrog rmongs pa'i bzhi mdor ches brin kyang / /blo chen khyim bdag rgan pos sa le sbram/ /dngos rdzu'i khyad par 'byed la su zhig gshud/ /'di na 'phags yul shing rta che gnyis kyi/ /legs bshad nor mchog skyes bu gsum gyi gzhung / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'dod rgu char snyil (118bsgos/ /'jam dpal snying po'i bstan la byi dor byas/ /lugs srol de dang zung 'brel zab mo'i chos/ /nges gsang theg pa'i yang rtse 'dus pa'i lam/ /dben gsum sgyu lus 'od gsal zung la jug par/ /mos blo'i bag chags kyis 'tsho don ldan tsam/ /dam pa'i ngang tshul ldan pa tsan+dan shing / gdul bya'i rlung gis ji tsam bskul ba yis/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i dri bzang cher ldang ba/ /kun khyab khyod kyi yon tan de med byung / /'bras ldan dus su drang srong a ga sdus/ /'od kyis ji tsam snang byas nyal 'gro'i tshogs/ /dug bral bdud rtsir gyur pa chos nyid de/ /rgyu skar gzhan la stes dbang gis khrung min/ /ma rig las 'khon 'jam dpal rdo rje dngos/ /yang dag don gyi dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /tshar chen yab sras brgyud par bcas pa yi/ /ring lugs ba dan srid rtse'i bar du khyod/ /dri bzhen lta ljang bdun gyis nyin mor byed/ /bsil ri'i sbubs nas grangs med 'dren pa bzhin/ /ma smad legs par bshad pa'i mchid 'phreng tshogs/ /tshad med sgra 'dzin bcud du stsol cig gu /'jigs pa med pa'i zab dang rgya che ba/ /dam pa'i chos kyi nga ro'i dbyangs snyan can/ /gdong lnga'i dbang pos bteg pa'i rdo rje'i bzhin/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor mi g.yo rtag brtan gsol/ /bkra shis dge mtshan 'khyil ba'i gsar tshes kyi/ /rtse dga' khong nas rgod pa'i gnam lo'i bzhin/ /—390

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('daga' ba'i 'dzum gyis bsu la mngon phyogs tshe/ /rab dkar bsod nams dar dang bcas te dge /rig pa'i gnas la mo pa'i blo can dwags po lcang ra ba mgon po tshe dbang rab brtan sgra rig pa slob par sgo ring mkhan po mang yul lo chen gyi gam du 'degs par phyogs pa'i tshe rnal 'byor gyi yi ge dgos tshul byung ba ltar bsrings pa mtho ris sa dz+nyā/(119na)sa dzo / ga ga na tsa nyu ta thu nu ha sta rna se no ñca la na ba te lha 'e khu ku / /diskru ba t+ta ma sa sti ṇiñca.ā ga me lha na bhu t+ta/ ma ga to yi she ṣa ba smo gnam (sdeg sbyor rab dkar ༅/ yos kun gyi bdag por spyi bo sa /legs byas glang po'i snas bteg bum pa yis/ /dbang bskur shar phyogs gong ma'i lung las kyis/ /chen po'i khyad par can du gyur pa'i gtam/ /gzhung lugs nyi ma'i dngos po bye ba'i gzugs/ /rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur cho ga yis/ /brdar bsadag dang ma dag bcu gnyis char/ /'byed pa'i 'jig rten mi gcig der springs pa/ /srid pa'i nagasaklung stug por dge tshogs kyi/ /sa bon smin 'bras zag phung tsan+dan ljon/ /nyes brgya'i sto 'gros 'khril min tshul khrims dris/ shwakya'i ring lugs pa la yar mdzes sam/ /'di na nyi zla'i 'od la stos min pa'i/ /dbyangs can mgrin chags lus phra'i 'gram chang gis/ /gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i me tog ba kul/ /phye bas thub bstan rna (119ba〉kong rgyan du mdzes/ /tshe rabs don ldan sgrub la snying stobs kyis/ /g.yo med dam bca' brtan po'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /thos dang bsam pa'i yid bzhin nor bkod pas/ /dpyod ldan grags snyan 'dod rgu phyogs brgyad 'bebs/ /tshul des gangs can ra bar mkhas byed kyi/ /do zlar mig rgyang ring pos nyer btsal kyang / /ma rnyed grib ma tsam las ched po sa /'dzin pa'i zla med nam mkha'i zla ba bzhin/ /mtho ris brda sprod chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /cig car btungs pa'i drang srong che khyod dang / /sngon gyi slob dpon chen po sa spru dz+nyā'i/ /khyad par gnas kyi dbye bas byas pa tsam/ /mkhasarlom sreg zas bzod min mdo rgyud kyi/ /sa bon blo gros gaṅgā'i mngal sbrum tshe/ /legs bshad gzhen nu rnam dpyod gar mkhan la/ /zhen nas log rtog glang po'i mche ba phyung / /dhī yig zhun ma mi yi gzugs can du/ /thub bstan za ma tog 'khyil btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs nor 'dzin 'dod pa'i 'dam bying —39/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)pa/ /'degs pa'i khyab 'jug khyod las dmigs su med/ /byang phyogs tsā mi'i chos rgyal rigs ldan lha'i/ /gna' bo'i mdzad bzang nyi ma thun 'tshams las/ /'gongs tsha lugs gnyis log spyod me khyer 'od/ /chos srid snang ba'i byed por khengs rnams mtshar/ khyim gzugs sgo nga'i sbubs nas lnga rig pa'i/ /skad snyan 'byin pa sngon tshe mang byung na/ /deng dus bstan 'dzin khur ldan ngur pa'i khyu/ /'dod sred ngag bkyal sgra yis sna ba gtser/ /shes byar srid pa'i gtsug lag chu bo kun/ /blo gros zla ba'i ma mar yongs zhugs kyang / /rnam dpyod rgya mtsho'i 'jing la 'phel nub dag /spangs pa'i smon gro paṇa chen chu gter bzhin/ /bcu phrag rig gnas mig stong ldan pa'i lha/ /(120na)dus kya g.yeng ba'i sa srung steng 'gying che/ /legs sbyar 'chad por bsgos pa'i sgra rig mkhan/ /de 'dra lha yi phur bu ma yin drang / /rnam dpyod yangs pa'i gom stabs mi ldan yang / /zhe sdang zug rngu'i shugs kyis log pa'i khung / /thogs med bgrod pa'i rtsal ldan lce gnyis pa/ /mi dge'i ra bar gar sgyur chos nyid yin/ /deng dus dbyar dgun 'dus pa'i chos kyi grwa /bsod nams myu gu bskrun pa'i zhing sa che/ khrims ldan ngur smrig gos 'dzin kho na las/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan gyis brlams ga la srid/ /'on te a mra'i tshal du e raṇ+ḍa/ /phang phung lo 'dab mdzes par nyer 'khrul nas/ /'bras bzang ro la spyod 'dod yun ring por/ /bsgugs pas bskal pa'i mtha' yang thung ngur byed/ /phra mo'i khyim gyi bug pa las 'thon nas/ /'dod yon mjug ma nyer thogs rmi lam ltas/ /bden gtam rlung la mi bskur rab byung phal/ /legs bshad sgra la mdzub mos rna ba 'gebs/ /thos bsam stobs 'byor me chu'i man shel khams/ /chos srid nyi zla'i reg bya'i tsha grang gi /khyad par go sa 'pho ba'i sgam bu phywa/ /'di 'dra lnga brgya'i rang mtshang nyid du zad/ /de phyir shar phyogs dwags yul nags ljongs nas/ /gtsug lag don gnyer lcang ra zla tshes can/ khyod snyan rlung gis drangs te brda sprod kyi/ /yon tan cha shes gang ba'i ched du song / /rigs mtho chas mdzes sgrigs kyis rab spa zhing / /legs bshad 'tshol ba gser ltar dkon dus 'dir/ /lo chen chos skyong bzang po'i lugs srol la/ /nyer bsam mkhas pa'i gsung rgyun stsol cig gu/ /deng —392

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / rtogedus phyogs rer sbyangs la kun mkhyen zhes/ /snyan grags dzornga ldir ba mang na yang / /'khor lo ma tshang shing rtas dngos po gzhan/ /'dren pa'i don byed nus pa ga la srid/ /tshad (120ba'i joms ga bur dri yis rlung skyed pas/ /skyes tshad sman du sgyur ba'i ro nus kyis/ /gdung ba'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sgyu thabs mkhan/ /sngon gyi drang srong che de thams cad mkhyen/ /bla chen grags skam mun pa'i khung bu la/ /skyabs su song min ris med mkhas bsten pas/ khong dpang bstan pa'i nyi ma 'od po che/ /rgyal bstan gling bzhi'i snang byed 'di na 'char/ /mgrin pa'i 'khor lo grol ba'i bang mdzod nas/ /snyan tshig dngos po zad pa'i pha mtha' ci/ /'di tsam nyams dang 'gyur ba'i bdog pa'i skyes/ /de las mangs na yi ge'i las su cha/ /tshig don nor ldan bya ma rta/ /bgrangs pas kun bzod ngal ba'i rdul/ / 'phreng ba mu tig dkar po yi/ /nam mkha' mdzes pa'i rked par 'ching / /su sti'i sgra las bde legs kyi/ zhes pa brjod pa'i gnyis skyes dbang / /dkar 'jam mdzes pa'i gos gyon nas/ /g.yas ru byang gi phyogs der song / /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa phag 31ra bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i dge bsnyen tshangs pa dung thod can gyis sa thog lo gsar gyi lha tshes thog ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan 'ong tshul byung ba ltar spyan gzigs tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas 'phrin du gsol pa lha rgyal snyan pa'i gad rgyangs/ rgyal bar gyur cig su sti'i dbyangs kyi spras/ /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa'i dar dkar po/ /srid pa'i rtse mor 'phyar ba'i tshangs pa che/ /lha chen sgra 'dzin bu gar gsol ba'i don/ /lkog gyur chos kyi snang tshul ma lus pa/ /ma 'dres mngon sum gsal pa'i spyan gyi dkyus/ /ring por gzigs la blang dang dor bya'i gnas/ /ston pa'i rdo rje'i gsung snyan glu ru long / /snang srid dregs pa yongs kyi spyi bo sa /bka' —393

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyertags phyag rgya gnyan pos zil gnon pa'i/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos pad+ma thod 'phreng gi /spyan sngar g.yar ngam khas blangs ma g.yel bar/ /bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba nag po'i dpung / /(121na khu) tog mda' can sde yis nyer brlams pa/ /gzugs can gzugs med rigs gyur gar gnas kyang / /mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis tshar chod mdzod/ /bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung dkar gyi/ /cod pan thod du bcings pa'i dge bsnyen che/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i dbang po'i mched zla yis/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir bde skyid char du phob/ /kun la brtse ba'i rab dkar lhag pa'i sems/ /byed pos thags su byas 'dra'i snyan shal dang / /mi zad 'dod pa 'jo ba'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /'chi med lam kun khyab par rab bkang ste/ /lnga ldan 'byung ba'i khams las legs sdi/ba pa/ /bgrang bya'i dpyid kyi dpal mo'i zhal gyi sgo/ /dang por 'dzum pas rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i mgron/ /bsu ba'i dga' ston dus su dza / / /sgyur byed kyi lo dbyar gyi dus ston la bab pa'i tshe grwa tshong 'dus nas bshan pa chen po bya khri mig gcig pas rgyal khams 'de thabs sgrub pa'i skul ma dang / ba dan rol mo sogs dgos tshul grwa phyi gzhis gnyer smon skyid par bskur byung ba'i 'phrin lan sa la rnam par rgyal0sgra dbyangs/ sal rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga bo che'i/ /sgra dbyangs srid pa'i rtse mor rab bsgrags pa/ /dregs pa'i dbang phyug bya khri mig gcig pa/ /dpa' bo'i gad brgyangs sgrog pa'i 'phrin yig son/ /zhe snang dmod pa'i 'bras bu khams gsum gyi/ /skye rgu'i bla tshe srog la dbang sgyur pa'i/ shar phyogs sku yi rgyal po'i blon po che/ /mi bzad gtum chen khro bo'i rna ba glogs/ /'dzam gling che ba'i brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang / /snang srid zil gyis gnon pa pad+ma 'byung / /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyas pa'i (121ba)bka' rtags kyi/ /rdo rje'i ri mo spyi bor mdzes khyod kyis/ /gangs ri'i rwa bas bskor ba'i bod yul 'dir/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /nad zhabrug mu shes 'gro la mi 'tshe bar/ /legs byas lang tsho dang ba'i 'bras smin mdzod/ /bde legs si tā 'phrog pa'i chom rkun ma/ /mi bsrun bsam sbyor ngan pa'i sgyu thabs mkhan/ /dgra dpung 'bod grogs mgrin pa mthu stobs mdas/ /—394

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pegacod pa'i ra ci'i bu yi brtul zhugs zungs/ /'od 'bangs bde byed bdud rtsi'i za ma tog /rku ba'i ma rung lha ma'i khyab 'jug la/ /drag rtsal 'khor lo 'bar bas rab bsnun pa'i/ /lha chen tshangs pa'i dpe zla khyod kyis sgrubs/ khyad par za hor rig sngags 'chang ba yi/ /chos srid sgrub la 'khru ba'i nag po'i sde/ /phyi nang steng 'og phyogs mtshams gar 'dug kyang / /dmar chen snying gi khrag dron zhal du drongs/ /rgyal khams spyi dang sgos kyi blang dor gzugs/ /'char byed thugs kyi ma yong snag med las/ /ji bzhin ri mo'i snang brnyan ma 'dres pa/ /lkog gyur mngon sum rjen par bstan du gsol/ /gangs can lha gcig lag na pad+ma'i gsung / /'bru drug g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung dkar sgra/ /sgrog par bskul ba ji bzhin don ldan du/ /bsgrub pa'i dam bca' snying gi dpal ber 'khyil/ /bdud sde las rgyal ba dan dmar po zung / /lha snyan dgyes rgur spyod pa'i rol mo dang / /gang bsams thogs med bgrod pa cang shes rta/ /gser skyems thags kyi zla ba'i lha rdzas bcas/ pa klu'i klung chen dal gyis 'bab pa'i lho/ /dge bas yon to kun tshang g.yon ru'i cha/ /dregs pa'i dmag tshogs 'du ba'i pho brang du/ /rigs sngags grub pa'i 'phrin yig zlos gar sgyur/ / (122na〉phag sto zla brgyad pa'i nang du tshangs pa wo po dung gi thor mas can gyis spyi sgos kyi rim gro'i blang dor sogs kyi skul mar tsher gseb bla ma blo bzang 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho rdzong sta mdzad pa'i gsung 'phrin lan lha gos gser 'brug gi ri mo g.yas 'khyil dang 4sa te wen dug sol ge me long dngas pa'i snang bas/ snang srid zil gnon mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /pho nya lha yi tshangs pa dge bsnyen che'i/ /blang dor ston pa'i 'phrin rten sug par son/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i lo tog 'joms byed pa/ /nag po bdud kyi skyin thang drag po'i mda'/ /zlog byed dge ba'i rig sngags nus mthu'i rtsal/ /me long nang gi bzhin ltar ston 'di spro/ /bka' sgrog thugs rten gso dang gsol mchod sogs/ /bgyid 'os rim gro'i blang bya der gsal rnams/ /le lo'i chu bo che las sgrol byed pa/ /bskyud pa med pa'i brtson 'grus zam pa 'dzugs/ /lha dbang khyod kyi mthu stobs rdo rje yis/ /nag po bgegs kyi lha min mo yi mngal/ /lhung —395

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyedang lhan cig rnam par rgyal ba yi/ /snyan pa'i rdza rnga srid rtse'i bar du sgrogs/ /gangs can lha gcig srong btsan skyes lha chos/ /byang phyogs swā la'i ljongs 'di'i rgyal blon 'bangs/ /bde zhing skyid pa'i gdugs dkar grib bsil la/ /rtag tu ngal gsor byed pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bod khams phung ba'i mu ge nad rims dang / /bsam ngan 'chang ba'i mtha' dmag g.yul gde|ma sogs/ /bzlog bsad spa bkong tshar gcod las sgrub pa/ /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i lung bzhin mdzod/ /gser gyi snye ma g.yur du za ba yi/ /phun tshogs 'dzam bu'i 'bras bu ro brgya pa/ /ji bzhin 'dod pa'i re stong bsam 'phel (122ba bo bang / /mdzod cig tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs sgrog gser 'brug g.yas 'khyil ba'i/ /rab dkar gos dar snyan shal gser skyems bcas/ /hor gyi zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes kyi/ /dga' ba dang por gru 'dzin rtse nas bris/ /sa phag har zla brgyad pa'i nang du dngos nams su thugs dam stong dgos pa 'i mchan ma gsal bar byung bar brten/ mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs 'ol khar chu tshan la 'gro skabs bsam yas su gnod sbyin chen por 'phrin du gsol ba bsam 'phe la dbang gi rgyal po/ zhi rgyas dbang gi dngos grub kun/ /stsol ba'i nor bu bsam 'phel dbang / /dgra bgegasanag po'i dpung 'joms par/ /gnam lcags thog gi rjes 'gro can/ /sngon tshe li yi yul gru na/khrims ldan khros pa'i dmod pa'i 'bras/ /srid gsum skye 'gro'i tshe srog la/ /dbang du sgyur ba'i mthu chen khyod/ /'jom gling che ba'i rigs sngags 'chang / /pad 'byung rdo rje'i bka' rtags kyis/ /zil mnan bdud rtsi lce thog tu/ /bzhag pa'i gnod sbyin tsi dmar ba/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag dpung gi /kha lo sgyur ba'i mthu stobs can/ /chos 'khor dpal gyi bsam yas sogs/ /gtsug lag skyong ba'i srung ma che/ /lha khyod bka' sdod tshul gnas pa'i/ /rje dpon spe dkar rgyal chen lnga/ /sprul pa yang sprul pho nyar bcas/ /thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i ched/ /lha rdzas phyi gos nang gi dang / /go mtshon na bza' gser gyi phud/ /cang shes sga srab kyis spras sogs/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas legs 'bul gyis/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i bstan pa srungs/ /srid 'byor chab srid mnga' thang spel/ /mu ge nad rims —396

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pe'akhrug rgyun chod/ /'gro rnams bde (123na da dpal la sbyor/ khyad par bdag sogs 'khor bcas la/ /dug mtshon g.yul gshom mthu bya dang / /steng 'og bar gsum 'byung po'i gdon/ /bar gcod nyer 'tshe zlog par mdzod/ /gdengs can dbang po'i gtsug rgyan las/ gang bsams lhun gyis 'grub pa ltar/ /srung ma khyod la bcol ba'i las/ /dus las ma g.yel sgrub par mdzod/ /hor gyi zla ba brgyad pa yi/ /phur bu tha skar dang 'grogs pa'i/ /bzang po dang po'i tshes dge bar/ khu1 'dzin gnyis pa'i rtse nas spel/sgyur byed ces pa sa mo phag gi lo gong nas mchod rten rab 'byams pa dang / mgon po dge slong gis gtsos pa'i gser yig pa mngags te gos dar nor bu'i khyad nor dang bcas pa bka' shog phebs pa'i lan 'bul bar gser rtag chos rje dang 'phyong rgyas bsod nams dbang po gnyis pa to ba'i dus phul ba bso de nams nyi ma rgyas pa'i dngos po/ dza skru〉 po dwa ra ku sa dzo dha ratsa grwa riḥ swā ga tho wa rnyi wa sha ge si la ā dz+nyā/ ba de :le shrī wa ra me kha phyi ka dzi ཿ shrīm khru 6 ka ku skyu ཿ dza ya su/ (123ba'i dzam (sdeb sbyor rma bya myos pa gling yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon kun la/ /bka' khrims rtsibs stong 'khor los dbang sgyur ba/ /sa yi brgya byin dpal ldan gong ma che/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs drung du/ /ma bris gsal bar shar ba'i zhal gyi khyim/ /ma bos snying gi khang bur rtag 'ongs te/ /ma 'thungs myos pa'i zil dngar ro bda' bas/ /ma blangs bsngags rjod snyan 'gyur glu yis zhu/ /deng dus bsod nams nyi ma'i dngos po brgya'i/ /lus kyis 'jig rten gsum po snang byas pa'i/ khri yid mang glu las snyan par sgrog pa'i gtam/ /yid la rtse dga' khong nas dgod pa'i dpyid/ /gser 'brug gtsug gi nor bus bteg pa'i rtser/ /gnam gyi she mong rang rtags lha yi bka'/ /bar snang mdzod kyi ri mo'i gos sogs rten/ /nyer son rmugs 'dzin 'byor ba'i g.yang zhig chags/ /'di na shākya'i ring lugs sa zla'i mngal/ /rnam dpyod drod kyis smin pa'i dge sbyong yang / /rang blo yangs pa'i sgo 'phar bzhi phye nas/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i rig byed spel 'dir gzigs/ /stong gsum mi mjed bdag po tshangs pa che/ /lha yi rmu thag ring po'i lam brgyud de/ /—397

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kye'adzam gling yongs kyi rgyal por shes pa la/ /hong de'i mtshan ldan khyod las dmigs su med/ /mtshon gyi bskal pa dar drag sdig to'i dpung / /'jig rten glang por spyod pa'i rtsod ldan ma/ /lha gcig spyan zur lhung ba'i mod nyid la/ /mngon sum tshad mas ma rnyed de ga re/ /gnam dang sa yi dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag /'jam dbyangs gong ma'i snyan pa thos pa'i mod/ /lha mi'i thun mong rgyal srid la dbang ba'i/ /nga la nu yi (124na sko thengs pa bag la zha/ /legs byas nor bu'i sgron me 'bar ba'i gzis/ /gtsug lag gzugs brnyan ma 'dres 'char ba'i sgo /the tshom khyogs la mi brten tshad ma sa /sgrub pas nyin mtshan dbye ba yongs mi phyed/ /'jig rten khams kun nad med lo legs shing / /tshe yang ring por gnas pa'i dge mtshan rnams/ /dus kyi bdag po'i las shugs kyis bsgrubs par/ /stesadabang tsam du 'khrul rnams blo gros rmongs/ /mnyes gshin byams pa'i snying thag ring po yis yangasapa'i sa chen pha mtha' 'ching nus pa'i/ /phal dang dam pa'i ngang tshul khyad par ni/ /mkha' dang phra mo'i bug pa las kyang che/ /dregs ldan rgyal phran shugs 'gro bye ba yis/ /por ba'i gser 'khor 'dren bzod sgyu rtsal can/ /las dkar rnam dpyod myos bum gzengs mtho ba'i/ /spos kyi glang po'i mched zla g.yin su zhig /e ma rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'i/ /'gro kun bde bar ngal gso'i stegs/ /lha mi'i dbang phyug khyod nyid kyi/ /drin du gcam bu min par shes/ /de phyir phan bde'i dpag bsam dbang / /re ba skong ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /chab srid nyi zlas 'jig rten kun/ /gsal ba de srid brtan par smon/ /lta na sdug pa'i grong khyer dbus/ /'chi med bdag po'i khang bzang du/ /gser gyi myu gu bkram pa'i khrir/ /lha khyod bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /'dzum ldan zhal gyi pad+mo nas/ /bka' mchid sbrang rtsi'i rgyun mngar po/ /mdzad med 'dzag pa'i ro bcud la/ /spyod pa'i dga' ston chad med stsol/ /rin cen 'phreng ba 'jam phrug sogs/ /rten gyi gdub bsil legs 'a tu gal pa'i/ /zhu mchid legs bris gar (124ba)mkhan ma/ /shar phyogs dbang po'i mdun sar sgyur/ /sa pha ga lo gad sgo zheng tshan gnis kyis 'bangs gyen log la brten pa'i sde gzar khol bur bslang ba'i dus hor zla bcu gnyis —398

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dza/pa'i lha tshe gsum gyi nyin bsam yas nas dregs pa'i sde dpon chen pos gtsang nyang smad phyogs su gzugs can gyi don la lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag cig 'gro dgos 'dug par rten 'brel gyi che ba'i go mtshon/ rol mo/ rta sogs dgos tshul byung ba 'bul bar mkhar ldan pa 'jam dpal btang ba'i tshe 'phrin du gsol ba sha khrag tshogs su rol ba'i dga' ston/ su sti sid+dhi/ dus ga sdo ma sang bshargyas kun 'dus dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen pos zab yangs mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gis thog drangs gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs kyi bstan pa dang zab gter skyong ba'i srung mar mnga' gsol ba'i dregs pa'i sde dpon gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po'i rdo rje'i gsung gi 'phrin yig 'byor pas yid spro/ slob dpon chen po'i dngos kyi slob ma za tor gyi sngags 'chang ā tsar+ya dharma pā la nas bzung pha mes brgyud pas rim par bsten cing bsgrubs pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho nas 'brel ba zab mo thogs pa sogs sngon gyi dam tshig nye bar dgongs pa'i snang srid dregs pa'i dmag gi dpung tshogs rnams gtsang nyang smad kyi phyogs su kha lo sgyur ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar sgrig dgos tshul la rjes su yi rang zhing / de don tho zur gsal ltar sngags dang phyag rgyasamang por spel te thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i rdzas su phul ba ltar dgyes pa skyed par gyur cig /che mchog he ru ka dang gsang ba'i bdag /pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis dam nyams dgra'i/ /don (125na)snying sha khrag bla tshe srog dbugs rnams/ /bshan pa khyod kyis zas su gtad min nam/ /sdo brgyad rba klong 'khrug pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /dregs pa'i sdod pon dmag gi dpung tshogs rnams/ /nyi ma nub phyogs nyang smad bsam grub rtser/ /rna bye 'phrul shugs kyis thogs pa med gshegs la/ /lha chos bka' las 'das pa'i dam nyams dgra/ /mi chos drin lan ngan 'jal 'bangs gyen log /dge 'dun sdoklung dkon cog khyad du gsod/ /sems can sdug la sbyor ba'i spyi yi dgra/ /dog bde gad kha sa pa nor bu dang / /lha sa sgo sna shag pa dngos grub kyi/ /bza' tshang bu tsha rigs rus bdun brgyud tshun/ /dran 'khrul grosang na gshom pa'i 'khor g.yog dang / /blo stobs brtson pas dpung pa'i shor 'degs pa'i/ /bkras sgang tshe ring gdong dkar rgyal mtshan sogs/ /bsam sbyor ngan pa 'chang ba'i dmag dpung gi /—399

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyesha khrag bstan srung khyod kyis tshogs su rol/ /dam nyams 'di rnams myur du sgrol ba yi/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i rno ngar mi ldan na/ /skye 'gro srog bdud sde brgyad dmag dpon du/ /grags shing zhal gyis 'ches la ngo re gnong / /de phyir lo dang zla ba ma 'gyangs par/ /gnyer du gtad pa'i dam nyams dgra tshogs kyi/ /pho brgyud shing sdong rtsa ba bcad ltar thong / /mo brgyud dgun gyi chu phran skems ltar thong / /bu tsha sgo nga brag la brdab ltar thong / /g.yog 'khor rtsa phung me yis bsregs ltar thong / /mnga' thang snum zad mar me bzhin du thong / /mdor na ming dang rjes tsam med par mdzod/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel dregs pa'i dmag tshogs rnams/ /(125ba〉dgra dpung thal bar brlag pa'i snying khrag gis/ /myos pa'i bzhin ras zla ba ltar phyar nas/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon mkha' la sgongs/ /pur rgyal bod 'dir nad 'khrug mu ge sogs/ /dus kyi chad pa kun zhi bde skyid 'phel/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rab rgyas shing / /rig 'dzin bdag gis bsams don lhun grub mdzod/ /rab dkar lha rdzas dang gyi snyan shal dang / /rin cen gser skyems zho yi 'khor lo bzhi/ /dmod nas shis pa brjod pa'i me tog la/ /'tshams sprin rtags kyi re khas mtshan par dge /sa pha ga ri bo mchims su gsang phug gi srung ma btsan rgod rta ra bas rim gro'i bskul ma dang / go mtshon sogs spyan gzigs dgos tshul skyel bar mkhar ldan pa 'jam dpal btang ba'i dus kyi 'phrin lan dmar chen skyems kyis myos pa'i gad brgyangs/bstan srung gnod sbyin chen po'i bka' sdod che/ /mchims phu gsang ba'i gnas kyi srung ma mchog /rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang rta ra klu gong gi /blang dor ston pa'i 'phrin yig son pas spro/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gsang gsum rol gar gyis/ /byin brlabs sgrags kyi yang rdzong mchims phu dang / /mkhar chu dpal gyi phug ring rnam gsum du/ /ki kai gshin rje'i las sbyor 'phral du sgrubs/ /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'joms pa spyi yi dgra /gad kha sa pa sgo sna shag sgo sogs/ /dam nyams 'bangs kyis gyen log 'khor g.yog dpung / /srung ma khyod kyis snying khrag da lta 'thung / /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir mi nad phyug nad dang / /dus kyi 'khrug pa nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / /thub pa'i bstan dang skye rgu'i bde skyid rnams/ /—4()(lha

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('dakar phyogs zla ba lta bur 'phel bar mdzod/ /mtshon cha rol mo khrab gdan thod chings dang / /rgya ja dngul phor dar mtshon rnam pa lnga/ /gser skyems dmod nas me tog dang bcas(126na)par/ /rtags kyi lang tshos spud de li khi rta/ /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags byi lor bris pa'i chab 3|ga 'phrin yig khag /kun ldan zhes pa lcags po byi ba'i lo tshangs pa dung thod can la spyi sgos kyi blang dor gsal bar ston dgos tshul dang bcas mchod sprin spro bar gso rig gtsug lag 'dzin pa'i drang srong dpon tshang byang ngos pa nang so dar rgyas btang ba'i dus 'phrin du gsol ba bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung dkar/ bkra shis ri mo mdzes pa'i dung dkar po/ /thor tshugs rnam par brgyan pa'i cod pan du/ /g.yas 'khyel dge bsnyen chen po tshangs pa yi/ /lha mig spyan gyis gzigs la snyan gyis gson/ /blang dang dor bya ston pa'i rdo rje'i gsung / /ji bzhin le lor ma lus lag dar bas/ /sa khams phag gi bgrang bya'i bgegs rigs rnams/ /zhi ba'i ngo mtshar sgo 'phar thog mar phye/ /'on te snyigs ma lnga bdo'i lus med dpung / /bstan 'gro'i phan bde 'phrog pa'i chom rkun ma/ /dngos dang bag la zhwa ba'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /sa 'og srin bu lta bur dpyad bzod dka'/ /bzang ngan mtha' dag sems nyid gcig pu yi/ /rnam 'phrul las gzhan dmigs su med na yang / /ma rtogs bden zhen sgrog gis 'khor ba 'dir/ /bcings rnams re dogs dbang gis sgo gsum mnar/ /mkhyen pa'i me long ngos su dus gsum gyi/ /snang tshul sgrib med gzigs pa'i pad+ma 'byung / /slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i zhal gyi lung / /lha khyod snyan gyi dbang po'i snod du gtams/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis stong gsum kun myul zhing/ /dpral ba'i spyan gyis snang srid ma lus pa/ /sal ler gzigs pa'i 'bras budon ldan ched/ /'byung 'gyur ma sbas lung du ston par rigs/ /mtho ris (126bskyon pa gnyis pa'i —40/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)rgyud 'dzin par/ /'chi med drang srong grub pa'i ring lugs mkhan/ /pho nya'i g.yar lam yas gsol dogs sel lan/ /dngas pa'i mtsho la zla ba'i gzugs bzhin ston/ /spyan gzigs tshogs 'khor thugs dam stong pa'i rdzas/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas rab spel lha yi lam/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung cher spros te/ /tshangs dbang lha yi mdun sa mdzes gyur cig /lcags byi 'bras ldan gyi dus ston la bab pa'i tshe bsam yas nas dregs pa'i bstan srung gnod sbyin chen pos rim gro'i blang dor gyi gsung 'phrin byung bar spyan gzigs 'bul ba dang bcas mkhar ldan pa bka' 'gyur gyi do dam la btang ba'i tshe 'phrin du gsol ba mi 'da' ldo rje'i dam tshig sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum rdo rje'i gar/ /pad dkar ze 'bru lasa'akhrungs sprul pa'i sku/ /rig 'dzin pad+ma'i pho nya gnod sbyin che'i/ /rdo rje'i gsung 'phrin blang dor bcas pa son/ /ring mo nyid nas mchod bstod lhur blangs shing / /lcags yos dam tshig gnyan po nyer bsgrags pa/ /rab dgongs cung zad tsam yang mi 'da' ba'i/ /gegs sel mthun rkyen sgrub pa dam pa'i tshul/ /'khrug rtsod nad yams mu ge la sogs pas/ /bod khams skye rgu mnar ba'i byed po kun/ /zhi byed gtsug lag khang dang thugs kyi rten/ /bzhengs 'dis phan bde'i snang ba ster ram snyam/ / 'on te lha srin 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs nad/ /zlog thabs rgyal khams spyi la sgrub 'jug pas/ /de don bsams pa lhun gyis 'grub pa'i grogs/ /bstan bsrung dregs pa'i dbang po khyod kyis khamadzod/ /sgos kyi rim gror brgya phrag 'dus pa'i sder/ /bsnyen (127na tha kur 'gyur ro cog gi bka' sgrog cing /bstan srung mchod dang mi 'da'i bcad rgya sogs/ /yid la ri mor bris pa lag tu dar/ /rig 'dzin slob dpon pad+ma thod 'phreng sogs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos rtsa brgyud bla ma yi/ /dam tshig rab dgongs sngags 'chang bdag cag gis/ /bcom pa'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod/ /dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul pa yi/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rgya mtshor bcas/ khrums kyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs gral tshes la/ /sde brgyad kun gyi yang rje'i spyan sngar spel/ /lcags pho byi lo 'phags yu pa wa ra ṇa si'i bram ze'i rigs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta ba la bha dra dang / go ku la gnyis kyis brda sprod pa'i —402

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pe bstan bcos pā ṇi byā ka ra ṇa zhes sngon med pa'i bstan bcos chen po bod yul du spel nas slar rang yul du bde bar 'khor ba'i gnas tshul dang bcas lcags kyi 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan rnam dpyod yangs pa'i blo gros/ sa rba 31 ga swā kā rta dra ཿ shenyi PROB PROB PROBPROB PROB PROB PROB PROBPROB PROB PROB PROB PROBPROB PROB PROB PROB PROBPROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBra to dhi mā du/ ba shu ba hom ཿ kra ma wa ra t+ta si na ma ki rtiḥ 'jig rten kun gyi byed pa po/ /gser mngal can dang pad dkar mig /gtsug na zla ba sna'i/kyi bdag /legs ldan rnams kyis khyod la srungs/ /sgra tshad shes bya thams cad la/ /rnam dpyod yangs pa'i blo gros can/ /mkhas mang 'du ba'i grong khyer che/ /wa ra ṇa si zhes su grags/ (127ba) ta su ma zlo yi ba ta su pra ti bha na sushi rwa ste/ ba sa bha dra go ku khye na ma hā pa ṇ+ḍi ta sa di thu/ 5 shi rba ta pya da ma dhu ra phyasu ra su zhi ṇa ( lha ri la dwa/ le 'a k+ṣa ra tsa n+da na 〈 ha ra tsi yu ba zhe na tsa skyu ku rnya/de'i dbus smra ba'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /spobs pa dge ba'i dpal thob pa/ /ba la bha dra go ku la/ /paṇa chen rnam gnyis bde ba'i ngos/ zhes pa brjod pa'i tshig snyan po'i/ /dbyangs kyi rgyud mang 'phrol bzhin du/ /'phrin yig tsan+dan tshu ha ra/ /rtags kyi lang tshos spras pa son/ /lha ma na bā ka ra she ten pa 'i bi t+ta sa la su dza na pya de/ shornyo da ni rta dha rma dha ra su pa 'o pa she stu bi du ṣ+ṭi6 waḥ so : te sro ta ma ste ma ཿ byā ka ra khyi pra ṇi maḥ tsa khyu ba sno ka ru tsi re 9 stos de sha 5 6 sdo kā shā tā/ gangs can ra ba dkar po yis/ /yongs bskor su la'i sman ljongs na/ /zas gtsang sras kyi lugs 'dzin pa'i/ /klog pa mkhan yang bde bar 'tsho/ /legs par sbyar pa'i bstan bcos mchog /brda sprod chen po pā ṇi zhes/ /zla ba lta bur dkar mdzes kyis/ /bod yul rmongs pa'i mun bsal nas/ /(128na)pu na rā pi ma sa na sha rba do ka bra h+ma ṇa che ne/ bi doṣa tsa kra yo ga su ka /ta spro ba sga ra saḥ di ka da smi na gta sto na gtas bo rgya shā ra bu d+dhaphya/ a nu bha ba pra kṛ ti ni ra sto gaṇa tā ti rnyi la ni rkye/ slar yang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul/ /rig byed smra ba'i bram ze'i sder/ /nyes pa'i skyon dang bral ba'i ngos/ /'byor ba'i gtam de rna ba'i —4()3
