rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)bcud/ /phyogs der rgyu dang mi rgyu ba/ /kun gyi dbang phyug bsod nams kyi/ /mthu yi rang bzhin lhun grub pa/ /mi yi bdag po'i tshul de nges/ /a wa ra su dha rna su mya pya mu kha tso ra ba to 'e bra natra/ ra k+ta bha ya sha ra ṇa du na da : ya lha ga wa khya bī rla/ u rba si rnya ra nā ma su pa tsata na ha ti ga su/ lha : ྈ ya ཿ sha ya : ga bra ti bi sa ru tsi raḥ gzhan gyi nor la rang gi bzhin/ /chom rkun lta bu'i 'tshe ba las/ /srung ba'i mi 'jigs skyabs kyi sbyin/ /ster la lus ngag 'bad pas brtson/ /u bam si dha ra zhes pa'i/ /bya ma rta la phan gdags pa'i/ /sems kyi bsil zer can gyi ngos/ /lhag bsam ri dwags gzugs brnyan mdzes/ /(128ba)me dha : dza ཿ du yo r+sārje su bha ṣi ta ka thā/ swa rba yo gaṅgā yo na dī ba to na shu ṭa ya ts+tsha n+tu/ ba r+ṇa pa ri sa mā hamra 'o lu ga tsa tu dza dzo sa rba ṇaḥ ma ྅ri ba rlu ba byu ri ka tu lu tsa kra pā ṇi sa hi ti//na k+ṣa ta su bo ༷ su rla ma gar su rwa sa ti nga/ he ma zhi ba kwa li pu ra po ta la 〉 liṇi rta/ blo ldan drang srong dzaḥ/ /zung gis legs skyugs legs bshad gtam/ /mtho ris chu bo gaṅgā 'a rgyun/ /chad pa med par stsal cig gu/ /yi ge yongs 'du'i 'khri shing rtser/ /rten gyi dza myu chu bo'i gser/ /sgom yongs 'du nyer dud pa'i/ /srang gi 'khor lo gang bcas te/ khyu skar rgyal gyis lags nya nyid / /nyin byed chu srin khyim zhugs pa/ /dgun zla tha chung dus gyi tshe/ /pho brang po ta la nas bris/ /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags glang 31ra bris pa'i chab hā/ga 'phrin yig khag /(129na/rtsegs glang phug pa dpal seng ba'i sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos lo gsar phul ba'i 'phrin pan 'jigs med smra ba'i snyan grags/ la : bi dza ya n+ta shrī si gi ti ma dhu ra ba r+ya tsa/ na nā su kha shi kasbra ra sa 'u 〉 le ka wa r+ṇa 'i/ rnam (sdeb sbyor kha sgo phan pa/)par rgyal bar gyur cig ces/ /phun tshogs —4()4

rgya bod dor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('asnyan tshig rgyud mang glu/ /rna ba'i bcud du dga' bde'i dpal/ /ster ba'i 'phrin yig rten ldan dang / /lhan cig 'byung ba gsum ldan pa'i/ ta shel dkar gos kyis klubs pa'i glu/ /kun dga'i rang zhal ngom pa yi/ /thog ma'i legs skyes dang bcas 'byor/ /ngag la mi 'jigs smra ba yi/ /dbang phyug 'phags yul snyan grags bzang / /gnyis pa swa la'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /rgyu ba khyod min las gzhan su/ /legs byas bye ba'i ri dbang gis/ /bsrubs pa lang tsho ka la sha /nges don bdud rtsi'i (129ba)bcud bzang pos/ /gtams pa grub rigs 'chi med dpal/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga sra ba'i gzhu/ /blo gros rgyud kyis 'gugs nus pa'i/ /gang gi rnam dpyod rab yangs pas/ /srid sgrub bsnyems pa'i ngal ba btang / /zas gtsang sras kyi lung rtogs bstan/ /phan bde'i gdugs dkar grib bsil la/ /bde bar 'tsho ba'i klog pa po/ /lhag bsam zla ba lta bur gsal/ /dkar min gos bu'i dri ma kun/ /dge ba'i chab kyis yongs bkrus pa'i/ /bgrang bya'i bzhin ras legs 'dzum pas/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i mgron de bsu/ /gzhom du med pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi/ /mi 'gyur khri la rtag brtan g.yung drung du/ /gnas par bden pa'i tshig gi shis rjod 'phreng / /re 'bras mchog gsum thugs rjes ci mi 'grub/ /gser ri'i sbubs nas nyin mor byed pa yi/ /'khor lo zad pa med par 'char ba bzhin/ /bkra shis gnam lo'i snyan tshig gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /legs byas skal ldan shing rta'i 'phrul gyis 'dren/ khyod kyi rnam dpyod drod ldan mngal yangs por/ /bden gnyis chos kyi gser sgong legs sbrum ste/ /legasabashad gdong bzhi'i mche ba las 'byungs pa'i/ /bsring 'os dbyangs can rgyud mang ci yang 'brol/ /nyams dang 'gyur ba stong gi rnam rol 'dren byed yul gyi dga' ston du/ /tshar du dngar ba'i snyan 'gyur tshig gi mtho ris ka shi mdzes dga' ma/ /rab dkar du kū la yi gos bzang lhab lhub dang bcas g.yon ru'i cha'i/ /grwa nang phun tshogs dge ba'i yul gru'i dga' ba'i tshal du gar gyis rtsen/ /(130na tshe:gas glang lo gong nas dmar sgyur rab 'byams pa dang dang gya bla mas gtsos pa'i gser yig pa mngags te gnang sbyin bzang po dang bcas bka' sheg phebs pa'i lan 'bul bar hang thod rab 'byams pa dang rten 'bul dpon chung gnyis btang dus—4()da

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shephul ba tshe ring gnam gyi shing rta/ tsakre ṇa kāñca ni ka phu ra sa ha sra di : yuḥ bu gi ri ra/ su na ya ka ñcim ཿ tsa/ sa ba smi ni sgri ka su wa rti ma ho t+ta 'i ( li pu da di gi dza ya ha ṇ+ḍi 'i nywa dzi ṇas tshe sdeb sbyor dpyid kyi thig le/ ring gnam gyi shing rtas legs drangs pa'i/ /rtsibs stong gser gyi 'khor los sa chen po/ /kun la dbang sgyur 'jam dbyangs gong ma che/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs drung du/ /dri bral yid mkhar lha khyod zhal gyi zla/ shar dang lhan cig grags snyan bsil zer gyis/ /spro dga'i kun+da bzhad tshe smra ba'i sgo'i/ /mchu sgros 'dzum dang /snan pas mchid 'di zhu/ /gnam bskos rtags kyi ri mos legs spras pa/ /mnyes gshin 'jibs pa'i bka' (130ba)tham skyes dang bcas/ /son tshe drang srong bsam gtan gsum pa ltar/ /yid la dga' spro'i kun rtog ci yang 'phel/ /lus can kun gyi tshangs gnas 'dab brgya par/ /rjes chags zhabs sen nyi ma 'od po che/ /'char nub spangs te zla med gnam bskos khri/ /rab brtan 'dzam gling skye rgu'i bsod nams dpyid/ /byams brtse'i grib mar 'gro rnams ngal gso ba'i/ /sku gsum 'bras bus dud pa'i yongs 'du'i ljon/ /zas gtsang sras kyi rjes zhugs klog pa mkhan/ /lhag bsam zla ba'i 'od la co drir gnas/ /rtsod ldan sdig lta'i lha min sgra gcan ske/ /dpa' mdzangs dam bca'i 'khor lo bzhi ldan gyis/ /bcad tshe tshangs pa rgan po ngal ba'i khur/ /chung ngur byas te zag bcas gnyid la yur/ /sna mang gzhan zer sgyu ma'i ri dwags rjes/ /'brang min zab cing brling ba'i 'phongs rkyen mangs/ /mi bsrun lang ga'i gtsug tor sar lhung tshe/ /yab gcig ra lha'i snying stobs phra mor byas/ /dkar nag rgya hor yangs pa'i yul gru yi/ /cher rlom bsnyems pa'i mche ba nyer phyung ste/ khrims gnyis mdongs mtha' nyon nas bag yangs su/ /rgyu ba'i la rta ka de khyod min su/ /tshur mthong chung ngu'i blo yi me long du/ /gang gi yon tan snang brnyan de tsam ste/ /lha khyod bsod nams phung por spungs pa'i tshad/ /kun mkhyen gzigs pa'i yul las gzhan du min/ /chab 'bangs phan bde'i sa chen rtsod ldan mtshor/ /bying las 'degs pa'i snying stobs dpal be'u'i/ /ri mo tshar du dngar ba khyod nyid las/ /srid pa'i khongs 'dir gzhan na dmigs su med/ /—406

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pede'i phyir byams brtse'i spyan dkyus ring po yis/ /mgron du bsus pa'i rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i grogs/ /phan bde'i 'dod pa 'jo (131na tha'i bsam 'phel dbang / /'bad med stsol dang mi rje lha yi rgyal/ /gzhom gzhig med pa tshe yi g.yung drung gi /ngo mtshar dpal gyi gzi 'od rnam 'bar ba'i/ /legs byas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len gyis/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor 'tsho zhing gzhes gyur cig /bka' mchid lha yi chu bo'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /lugs bzang tog gis mdzes pa'i gzi byin gyis/ /gzhan sder 'tshe min rang srid dga' sten du/ /gser yig lam gsum dag las tshad med zhu/ /'jam mnyen shog bu'i gzings la rten bcas nas/ /snyan 'gyur 'jo sgeg ldan pa'i ded dpon cha/ /dkar dmar shal dang 'jam phrug bdog pa'i skyes/ /bcas te gnam sa'i dbang phyug mdun sar song / /rab dkar du kū la yi gos ldan pa'i/ khyu mchog bgrang bya'i lang tsho dar bab tshe/ /bde skyid chus bkrus legs ldan gsos kyi bzhin/ /nya rgyas ri bong 'dzin ltar dkar tshe phul/ /lcags glang hor zla lnga pa'i nyer brgyad la bsam yas su bsam dar bstan 'dzin rdzong sta byas pa'i sa phag tshun gyi dbang drag gi 'phrin las rnams lhun gyis grub pa'i gtang rag dang bcas 'phrin du gsol ba rnam par rgyal ba'i dga' ston/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /ngo mtshar pad+ma'i sbubs su sgyur ba'i gar/ /srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma ka ras dge legs stsol/ /mgon des mchims phu gsung gi yang dben du/ /bde gshegs zhi khro 'dus pa'i bka' brgyad kyi/ /bcom ldan dregs pa kun 'dul dkyil 'khor du/ /legs bcug pe kur rgyal po mngag gzhug bcas/ khyad par rgyal po sde lnga'i pho nya ba/ /srid gsum srog la dbang sgyur tsi dmar ba/ /sngon gyi dam bca' g.yel bar gyur min yang / /'phrin las bsgrubs dang sgrub (131bskor spyar tshig 'di son/ /sgyur byed ces pa sa mo phag gis lo nyi ma nub phyogs gtsang nyang smad kyi phyogs su dam nyams mi bsrun pa rnams kyi sgyu 'phrul la brten glo bur du dus kyi chad pas mi bde ba'i skabs/ gnod sbyin chen po nyid kyis mngon spyod kyi 'phrin las bsgrub par zhal gyis mches pa ltar dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod sprin dang bcas 'phrin las —407

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)bcol ba'i don bzhin/ /rang phyogs srid sder bcas pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon mkha' la bsgrengs shing / /pha rol mi bsrun pa'i skye bo la la ni lnga pa'i grong khyer du song / /phal cher ni stobs 'byor longs spyod dang bral te lus sems la brnag dka' zhing lci ba'i chad pa nyams su myong ba sogs drag po'i 'phrin las 'grub pa'i sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag dang / slar yang phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing spur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir bde skyid kyi dga' ston 'phel ba dang / khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa bdag dang / skyabs 'og tu bcug pa'i slob bu/yon bdag 'bangs 'khor rnams kyi bar chad zhi zhing 'phrin las sgrub pa'i da 'chol legs pa'i rten du bkra shis pa'i snyan shal bkras btags che ba/ gser skyems zho bzhi/ bzang ja zur ma nyams pa/sman rtse yug gos yug dar yug khrab rmog 'khor gsum/ rta/ stag lpags/ ras yug dang bcab(hong zla lnga pa'i bral tshes la dge /lcags glang hor zla lnga pa'i nang du tshangs pa dung thod can la rgyal khams bde thabs kyi blang dor spyi sgos kyi rgyu mtshan gsol bar byang grong pa btang skabs gsol ba'i 'phrin yig gzugs brnyan gsal ba'i me long / phun tshogs bsam pa'i re ba yongs skong ba/ /lha chen tshangs dbang dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon/ /dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba'i 'bras bzang gi /cod pan yongs su dud pa'i sgra 'dzin du/ /(132na)mngon sum tshad mas gzhal bar nus min pa'i/ /lkog gyur bag la zha ba'i gnas lugs kyi/ /blang dor the tshom phyogs la 'chang ba rnams/ /dri tshig 'phrin gyi dbyangs snyan cung zad 'bros/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i zab gter gyi/ /lung du ma 'ongs gsal bar legs bstan kyang / /tshig brling rtogs par dka' bas mngon sum du/ /ma gyur de srid shes pa'i skal pa phra/ /kun rtog ri mor bris pa'i 'phrul snang gi /ngo mtshar bkod pa'i snang tshul 'byam klas pa/ /rang blo rang la lkog tu gyur min yang / /the tshom dra bar tshud de dpyad par dka'/ /de phyir dus rtags lung bstan sna tshogs pa'i/ /dogs gcod tho chung pho nya'i ngag gsal ltar/ /me long nang gi byad bzhin mngon sum du/ /ston cig bstan srung dbang po dung —4(/8

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pothod can/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang po thod 'phreng rtsal/ /gangs can lha gcig srong btsan sgam po sogs/ /rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ /rab dkar dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal lhug par ston/ /snyan shal gser skyems la sogs mngon sum du/ /legs bshams tshogs kyi 'khor lor bcas pa rnams/ /yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin dang lhan cig tu/ /snon nya'i shes rab phyogs kyi tshes la dge /lcags glang hor zla lnga par gra tshong 'dus su rgyal khams bde thabs kyi dri tshig gsol bar bsam dar ba btang skabs kyi 'phrin yig dogs sel chu nang zla gzugs/ mi 'gyur bde chen chos sku 'od dpag med/ /gdug pa kun 'dus longs sku rta mchog dpal/ /mtsho las skyes pa'i sprul sku thod phreng rtsal/ /sku gsum dbyer med thugs rje'i dga' ston stsol/ shar phyogs sku yi rgyal po'i pho nya che/ /stong gsum skad cig myul (132ba tha'i rdzu'aphrul can/ /las mkhan bshan pa bya khrid mig gcig pa'i/ /rdo rje'i gsung gi 'phrin yig sug par son/ /snga sor blang dor gsal bar byed pa yi/ /lung bstan gyis bskul rnam dkar dge ba'i las/ /bsgrubs shing slad mar byed dgos rim pa yang / /myur du skrun pa'i brtson pa mi dman tsam/ /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i dam tshig gi /rdo rje'i ri mo thod du legs bcings nas/ /bzang ngan gsal bar ston pa'i gsang ba'i tshe/ /ma sbas lhug par bstan la spro ba 'phel/ /brda yis bcings pa'i go bar dka' ba dang / /the tshom dbang gis dpyod par ma shes sogs/ /kun rtog sems kyi 'char sgo'i dri tshig 'ga'/ /tho chung dang bcas ngag lam nas gsal bar/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs zlog pa'i gnyen po dang / /mthun rkyen legs tshogs spel ba'i thabs tshul sogs/ /dogs sel dwangs pa'i mtsho la zla ba'i gzugs/ /'char ba ji bzhin ma sbas lhug par ston/ /snyan shal gser skyems rin cen phor pa sogs/ /spyan gzigs tshogs 'khor mthun pa'i dam rdzas rnams/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te/ /mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes la spel ba dge /lcags glang dor zla lnga pa'i nang du rigs rgyud kyi lha thang chen bshan pa lag dmar la 'phrin bcol spyan gzigs 'bul bar bu —409

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyeshud blo bzang dar rgyas 'khor zhag dang bcas btang ba'i 'phrin yig 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng / rgyal kun mthu stobs rdo rje'i rnon po'i mtshon/ /bdud sde phye mar 'thag pa'i brtul zhugs kyi/ /dbang phyug srid gsum bla ma thod phreng rtsal/ /mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rjes dge legs stsol/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin dus las mi g.yel bar/ /'i rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /bsam pa tsam gyis thogs med sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /las (133na tsheb khan bshan pa lag dmar spyan snga n+da/ /steng na gtor ma'i ri bo mkha' la snyeg /'og tu rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rnam par 'khyel/ /bdud rtsi'i btung ba bza' dang bca' ba sogs/ /'dod yon tshogs kyi 'khor los sna drangs te/ /dar zab gser skyems mthun pa'i dam rdzas rnams/ /ting 'dzin blo yis bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing / /yongs su bkang ste dgyes pa skyed byed na/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su skongs gyur cig /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig gnyan po dang / /rigs dang brgyud la bsten cing 'gro ba'i mthus/ /sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las rnams/ /bsam pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir bstan dang 'gro ba la/ /nye bar 'tshe ba'i nag po bdud kyi dpung / /bcom ste dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i dzo rnga cha/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du sgrog par mdzod/ /lha chen snyan gyi dbang por legs gsol nas/ /thugs dam skul bar byed pa'i 'phrin yig la/ /rab dkar tham kha'i rgya yis legs 'khyud de/ /dpa' bo dga' ston tshes la rnam par dge /sngon slob dpon chen po pa bla 'byung gnas kyis sprul pa'i rgyal po pe ha rar rgyal mtshan lnga'i dbang bskur ba'i grangs dbyibs dang mtshungs pa bsam yas be+e nar ltog tu tshugs na legs pa'i gnod sbyin tsi dmar ba'i rdo rje'i gsung gi 'phrin yig byung ba la brten/lcags glang hor zla bdun pa 'i tshes bco lnga la rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par snye thang drung chen shākya dbang phyug btang skabs gsol ba 'jigs med ga rdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs/ srid zhi'i brtan g.yo kun gyi spyi gtsug nas/ /legs bteg zhabs sen 'i ma'i dngos po brgya'i/ /'od kyis 'jig rten snang byed pad+ma 'byung / /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas byin phob cig /mgon de'i (133ba)bka' nyan snang srid dregs pa'i gtso/ /dpal ldan gnod sbyin chen po'i tsi dmar bas/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i blang dor gyi/ gdong lnga'i rgyud las drangs —4//lha

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('apa'i sgra dbyangs son/ /mi dge'i rlabs 'khrug le lo'i nyal 'gro las/ /brtson 'grus rlung gis bskyod pa'i rnam dkar gzings/ /phun tshogs dga' ston rin cen gling yangs por/ /bgrod thabs sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar gyis brel/ /spu sdug rnam bkra stobs chen dpa' gtum can/ /stag gi rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtser sgrengs la/ /gcan gzan dang mtshungs ma rungs dgra bgegs dpung / /thog mdas brag ri bcom pa bzhin du mdzod/ /glog ltar 'byug pa'i rtsal chen sgyu thabs mkhan/ /spre'u'i rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtser sgrengs la/ /'bod grogs mched zla'i khengs ldan brnag pa'i dgra /nyi mas mun pa 'joms la 'gran par mdzod/ /lha lam mthar thug nam 'phang gis spyod pa/ /bya rgod rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtser sgrengs la/ /ngan g.yo'i 'phur lding byed pa'i nag phyogs sde/ /don snying shugs nas bton te lkog mar drongs/ /dbang sngon mdangs 'dzin rno ngar mche ba gtsigs/ /spyang zhi'i rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtser sgrengs la/ /ri dwags bzhin du tshul 'chos yid grubs tshogs/ /zhugs kyis rtsa phung sreg pa'i rjes 'gror mdzod/ /rin cen rtog ldan 'ja' ltar rab bkra ba/ /za 'og rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtser sgrengs la/ /sde bzhi'i yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po las/ /'dod rgu'i char gyis yid kyi re stong mdzod/ /dar mtshon sna lnga'i snyan shal gser skyems dang / /lhan cig tshogs kyi 'khor lo bcas 'bul na/ /'phrin las bzhi ldan gaṅgā'i chu bo'i rgyun/ /nam yang chad pa med pa'i dga' ston stsol/ /(134na〉nga du thos pa'i dpyod ldan mnga' ris ru thog dbang po phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan tshangs rigs grub pa'i rnam dpyod/ bṛ t+ta sa ha 3 zhe te rje 'o ba dha ra tsa ba snga dī par beḥ 2 4 ge 'i ta 'a bra k+ṣa ta na la ཿ gu ru ta khru māḥ mchod (dzā ti'i sdeb sbyor 'phags ma )sbyin brgya pas 'dren byed stong bgrod de/ /nyi zla'i sgron me lag tu nyer thogs nas/ /bltas kyang khyod kyi rtser son mkhas pa dang / /ma rnyed phur bu'i spun zla der springs pa/ /rang blo yangs pa'i drod kyi mngal khur du/ /lnga rig gser gyi sgo nga yongs smin pa/ /tshangs rigs grub pa'i rnam dpyod mche ba las/ /legs 'ongs snyan 'gyur dbyangs can rgyud mang mgrin/ /yi ge'i gzugs kyi mkha' la rab —4//—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyeshar ba'i/ /lhag bsam zla dkyil thugs kyi ri dwags (134ba)gzugs/ /legs bshad 'od dkar 'phro ba'i li'i yol go'i/ /skyes bzang ga bur zegs ma ci yang 'thor/ /bsod nams 'khril shing rtser dud dal ba'i rten/ /legs ldan thar pa'i don chen smin pa'i 'bras/ /dus kyi sa la ma lhung rnam dkar dge'i/ /dbyar gyi nam mjug des bskyangs dngos po'i gshis/ /gtsug lag dri ma sbyong ba'i zhabs bsil du/ /mang thos khrus kyi mkhan po gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /chad med khyod blo'i rgya mtshor rtag babs kyang / /dog min zab cing yangs pa'i ngang tshul tsam/ /rigs med shes byar sbyangs stobs 'bod skyen mdas/ /dregs rmongs 'bod grogs bsnyems pa'i gtsug tor rtse/ /zhus pa'i sa la lhung tshe rā ma ṇa/ /gangs can rwa ba dkar por 'ongs pa bzhin/ /mdo rgyud tha snyad dka' ba'i gnad kyi mdud/ /'gro la 'phags yul paṇa chen tshogs rnams dang / /gang gi rig pa'i mchog dman khyad par ni/ /ji tsam brtags kyang ma shes 'phyang mo nyug /g.yo rgyus ma brid gna' bo'i spyod tshul la/ /thos bsam ro brgya bda' ba'i g.yang chags gang / /mthong tshe srid 'byor bu gar sred pa'i mjug /thogs pa'i chos ltar bcos rnams e raṇ+ḍa/ tags ldan tshogs bdag lang tsho nyams byed po/ /dus kyi skye rgu'i rnam dpyod na phra ba'i/ /bag med khrung khrung 'joms des bod gang tshe/ /sa spyod dbang po'i grags snyan yid kyi gsos/ /rigs mtho yar srid brgyud rlom bstan 'dzin gzugs/ /chu dang ber can tshogs kyis sbangs pa'i zas/ /sgra tshad bzo gso nang rig 'dab brgya'i bcud/ /btungs pa'i skal bzang bung ba 'di na bde/ /mi yi bdag po bgrang bya'i khur lci bar/ /lus 'khrugs duḥkha bcil nas ring po'i bar/ /srog gi 'tsho ba sgrub byed 'chi gsos sman/ /drang srong (135na)rig pa'i bcud len bsten par rigs/ /ma brtags zug rngu yid kyi tsher ma'i nad/ /blo 'das brjod bral sems nyid gcig pu'i 'brul/ /dpyad tshe 'khor 'das dbyer med lta ba'i dbyings/ /bden 'dzin kun rdzob chos kyi rdzun tshang rdib/ /lnga ldan sor mos zas kyi bya ba la/ /'jug pa'i mgrin pa bzang pos nor 'dzin mngal/ /dog mor byas mod shes ldan nyin skar tsam/ /bsams kyin mkhas khyod 'tsho ba don dang ldan/ /mi zad nyes brgya'i rlabs —412

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (po'aphreng yol med dug /dag byed bslu med mchog gsum a ga sdu'i/ /kun khyab thugs rje'i yan lag brgyad ldan chus/ /gang gi dkar min las kun 'khrud gyur cig /nyams 'gyur yi ger 'phos pa'i pi wang rgyud/ /don bzang sor mos brdungs pa'i smin legs ma/ /rnam bkra za 'og gos gyon 'jo sgeg bcas/ /chu lha'i phang par dga' ba'i gar gyis song /lcags glang hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la bsam yas su spyan gzigs 'bul zhing blang dor gyi rgyu mtshan 'bul bar mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs btang skabs gsol ban ma mkha' mdzod kyi dga' ston/ dus gsum rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzugs/ /srid pa gsum na che ba'i rig sngags kyi/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i sgyu 'phrul rol gar can/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal gyis dge legs stsol/ /sngon tshe lha yi dge slong legs ldan dang / /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje yis/ /dgra lha khyung chen 'bar dang spu gri 'bar/ /gsang mtshan btags nas dam tshig gnyer du gtad/ /mtsho skyes rdo rjes gangs can bstan 'gro yi/ /bde skyid spel bar rdo rje'i dam bsgrags pa/ /rigs kyi bdag po'i tshul du thod bcings pa'i/ /pe har rdo rje'i khyung chen (135ba'i 'brug 'dul/ /gang de'i bka' sdod dregs pa kun gyi gtso/ /sngon tshe li yi yul gyi rje bo'i sras/ /smon lam dbang gis khrag gi sgo nga las/ /btsan rgod gnod sbyin chen po tsi dmar ba/ /dpal chen rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po dang / /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad 'byung gis/ /bka' dang dam la btags pa'i srung ma khyod/ /sgrib bral lha snyan gsol pa'i tshig 'di gson/ /zhi khro kun 'dus grub chen bka' brgyad lha'i/ /nub byang phyag rdor dregs 'dul dkyil 'khor du/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung pad+ma sam bha was/ /dbang bskur rigs 'dzin dgra ltar lha khyod bskos/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga mnga' bdag myang ral dang / /chos dbang rgod ldem pad+ma dbang rgyal sogs/ /bka' gter rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /chad med yang skyor dam tshig bsgrags pa dgongs/ /za hor sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs brgyud dang / /tshe rabs du mar dam tshig lu gu rgyud/ /mi phyed phyag rgyas bcings pa nyer dgongs la/ /lkog gyur ston pa'i phung bstan sgra dbyangs sgrogs/ /gtor ma'i ri bo —413

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)sman raka mtshor bskyil nas/ /rtag tu lha khyod thugs dam skong byed kyang / /rten 'brel mtshon pa'i spyan gzigs thor gsal ba/ /nam mkha' mdzod du byin gyis brlabs te 'bul/ /mi bsrun glags lta gzugs can snang ba'i dgra/ /gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /nag po'i bdud sde dpung dang bcas pa yi/ /ru mtshon sa 'og snyol la tshar chod cig /bstan 'gro'i phan bde dkar phyogs zla ltar spel/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi'i 'dod rgu ma lus 'jo/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i rdza rnga srid ci rtser sgrogs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun sgrub par mdzod/ /cung zad pho nya'i g.yar lam nas (136na)gsol ltar/ /blang dang dor bya'i gnas rnams ma lus par/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ji bzhin du/ /gsal bar ston cig bstan srung gnod sbyin che/ khyu mchog gos dkar gyon pa 'phar ba'i lo/ /zla ba rgyu skar rgyal gyis legs nya ba'i/ /dkar phyogs dpa' bo dga' ston dus bzang por/ /gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang nas dge / rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu stag lor bris pa'i chab re|ga 'phrin yig khag /grwa phug sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos chu stag lo gsar gyi skyes 'bul bar snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa 'i 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan 'jigs med dge ba'i spebs pa/ 〉 si rnya ༷ rte me ce ra : ma lha u rta lo ke shwa rati rbe de sha/ sdi re 9 me ya pra ti bha na ཿ dru/ ho shrī shu bha ༷ li khri zhi na : ta/ /smra (sdeb sbyor dbang po rdo rje/)ba ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa'i blo'i/ /snyan grags tshangs pa'i yul sa las brgal bas/ /dpal ldan shes bya'i gnas la 'jigs med kyi/ /rmad byung dge ba'i spobs pa bzang po'i 'phrin/ /(136ba)dge tshogs byed po'i pir gyis legs bris pa'i/ /dga' skyid ri mo rnam bkra'i gos sngon can/ /sde bzhi'i rtse dga' khong nas dgod pa'i lo/ /gsar tshes skyes kyi bdog par bcas —414

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pepas na/ /bgrang bya'i phung pos btsugs min phra mo'i na/ /gzhen tshul tha snyad mdongs mtha' la brten kyang / /gang shar bzo med chos sku'i gser gyi mngal/ khur ldan rgan po'i blo can khyod nyid tsam/ /kun rtog yul gyi 'char sgo ji snyed pa/ /nyams dang 'gyur ba'i snyan tshig lam drangs tshe/ /'phags yul grags pa'i dpal 'bar dge ba'i dbang / khyod dang dbye ba'i khyad par ngas ma shes/ /mi rtog sems gnas me khyer 'od tsam gyis/ /thub bstan gling bzhi gsal 'dod grub rigs can/ /mang yang lnga rig cha shas nya gang ba'i/ /zla khyod rang gi grib ma mched por 'dzin/ khyab 'jug snyems pa 'phrog pa'i gya gyu'i gar/ /tshul 'chos gos kyis bsgribs pa'i ngang tshul dang / /gsong por smra ba'i dam pa'i rang bzhin dag /chu dang 'o ma ngang pas 'byed ltar gsal/ /bkra shis glu ru len pa'i rgyud mang sgras/ /rna ba bdud rtsi'i dpal gyi bang mdzod du/ /lan cig min pa'i byed po khyod nyid kyis/ /bdag yid kun dga'i bcud len nyams su bstar/ /'di na lhag bsam ches dkar dpung pa yis/ /chos srid zung du 'jug pa'i bstan pa'i khur/ /bteg nas rdzogs ldan dus ba'i na skye rgu rnams/ /spyod pa'i thabasatshul spel la ngal med tsam/ /dge bcu kun tshang swā la'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /srid mtha'i bar du gzhom med g.yung drung ltar/ /bden pa'i tshig tu brjod pa don ldan pa/ /mchog gsum thugs rje chen po'i mthus grub grang/ /(137na gser ri'i sbubs nas nyin byed 'char ba ltar/ /mdzad med phun tshogasaganam lo tshes so cog mas brjod dbyangs kyi rgyal mo snyan pa'i sgra/ /ri mo g.yas 'khyil mgrin pa'i lam nas sgrogs/ /lhun pos chu gter bsrubs par ma byas pa'i/ /sngon med zla ba rnam bkra'i ri mo can/ /'phrin yig rlung gi shing rtas nyer drangs nas/ /grwa nang 'chi med lam du bde bar song / /lcags glang hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum la bsam yas nas gnod sbyin chen pos gsung 'phrin byung ba'i lan skal bzang bsgo brgya phye ba'i gtam snyan/ phun tshogs srid zhi'i legs byas bye ba'i gter/ /bsam pa tsam gyis sgrub pa'i dbang gi rgyal/ /bstan srung gnod sbyin chen po tsi dmar ba'i/ /lha chen dgyes pa'i gsung gi sgra dbyangs snyan/ /snang srid dregs pa yongs kyis lus btud nas/ /bka' nyan mngags gzhug 'bangs—415

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)su dam bcas pa'i/ /dbang drag rol pa'i gzhal yas khang gi rtser/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa'i mthus/ /bar du gcod byed dgra bgegs nag po'i sde/ /ming gi lhag mar gyur dang lhan cig par/ /chos dang srid kyis bsod nams phung po'i gter/ /grub pa'i skal bzang sgo brgya phye bar nges/ /slad mar zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi/ /'phrin las bsam pa ji bzhin lhun grub par/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ /mdzod cig sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag dpon che/ /rnam par bkra ba'i lha rdzas snyan shal dang / /sa zla'i rin cen skyems bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /mi zad nam mkha' mdzod (137ba)du legs sprul te/ /legs ldan dbang po'i mdun sa mdzes gyur cig /chu stag hor zla gnyis par mchoms bu rta ra bas blang dor rten 'brel sgrig pa'i skul ma byung bar mthun rdzas spyan gzigs dang bcas ta bsring ba'i 'phren lan lha r+sha 'a zla pos 'char ba'i rdzing bu/ zhi mo kun 'dus bka' brgyad rten brten pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag nyid gsang ba'i phug /mchims phu gsung gi dben gnas legs srung ba/ /lha btsan rgod po rta ra'i ri mo son/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang snga dra'i char/ /bsangs mchod gser skyems ba dan mkha' la bsgrengs/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa o rgyan rnam thar dang / /phyir zlog rim gro'i blang dor 'phral du zin/ /zhi khro rnam rol dmar chen gtor ma la/ /brten nas mdud sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /spyi sgos phan bde'i legs tshogs sgrub pa'i thabs/ /'gyangs med myur du bsgrub pa'i mdun sar gnas/ /rang phyogs srung byed btsan po'i go cha dang / /pha rol thal bar rlog pa'i rnon po'i mtshon/ /gling bzhi skor ba'i rta sogs mthun pa'i rdzas/ /mi 'dzad nam mkha' mdzod du brlabs te spel/ /rab dkar dar gyi snyan shal gser skyems bcas/ /chu dang gos su klubs pa stag gi lo'i/ /kun phan dbo yis nya pa'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /bzang po gnyis pa'i tshes la bris pa dge /chu stag hor zla gsum pa'i nang du bod khams bde thabs la bsam yas su bteg skabs mdo sngags gleng gi srung ma kha che dmar po sa ngos 'phrad nang mthun rdzas dgos tshul byung ba'i 'phrin lan dbang rtags rdo rje 'bar pa'i cod pan/ dregs pa kun 'dus —416

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('dakyil 'khor 'khor lo cher/ khrag 'thung (138na)dbang drag pad+ma he ru gas/ /dbang bskur rtags kyi rdo rje'i con pan can/ /gnod sbyin dmar po'i 'phrin yig lha dar 'byor/ /'gro la rjes brtse'i rab dkar lhag bsam gyis/ /drangs pas bdag gzhan mnyam rje'i sems dpa' che'i/ /dgon gnas srid mthar nyams pa med skyong ba'i/ /g.yar dam ji bzhin mthu stobs bskyed de spro/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i dge bsnyen mthu bo che/ /lha mi ngos 'dzom rten 'brel lhun gyis grub/ /slad mar 'phrin las bsgrub rten spyan gzigs rnams/ /spel ba ji bzhin dam bca' g.yel med mdzod/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'gro ba'i bde skyid rnams/ /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur rab tu spel/ /mi bsrun yid srubs sde dang bcas pa'i dpung / /bcom pa'i ba dan srid pa'i rtse mor phyor/chu stag zla ba bzhi par 'phyos nas bshan pa rdzong btsan pas blang dor gyi skul ma dang mthun rdzas dgos tshul byung ba'i 'phrin lan dbang drag rol pa'i lha rgyal/ dmar zlum mig dkyus bstan pa'i mel tshe mā /lta ba'i bya ra mig g.yel btsan rgod che/ /dbang drag rnam par rol pa'i bshan pa yi/ /lha rgyal dbyangs su len pa'i 'phrin yig 'byor/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i brtul zhugs grub pa'i rtsal/ /'dzam bu'i gling na zla bral o rgyan rjes/ /bka' rtags phyag rgya gnyan pos zil mnan pa'i/ /g.yar dam ji bzhin sgrub pa'i gtam de snyan/ /sa 'og srad bu thugs su btags pa'i dar/ /lkog gyur gnas lugs dpral ba'i 'dren byed kyis/ /mngon sum gsal mthong gsang tshig blang dor rnams/ /bstan pa'i tshig don yid la ri mor bris/ /lha khyod thugs dam skong ba'i mthun pa'i rdzas/ /dngos 'byor ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /dpal 'byor 'dod (138ba kho'i gter du byin rlabs nas/ /dregs pa'i dmag dpon dgyes skyed dga' ston spel/ /dgra lha rdzong btsan bshan pa dmar po yis/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis sgrubs shig ces/ /gnyer gtad tshig 'phreng chu zla'i yar gyi ngo / /dkar cha'i zla ba tshes pa'i dus su dge /btsun mo tshal gyi dgon pa gsar du spos grub pa'i chu stag hor zla lnga pa'i lha tshes la/ gtsug lag khang gi rtser dga' ston gyi —417

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyergyal mtshan la dzugs dgos tshul lha chen tshangs pa'i gsung lhar btsugs pa'i dus bsrings pa'i 'phrin yig bkra shis rtags kyi dpal ri bar/ e ma khrims(ldan 'du ba'i ga rjo la/ /sder bcas sna lhun gyis grub pa'i yangs thog rtser/ /bkra shis rtags kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba dang / /lhan cig lha chen dgyes pa'i bso sgra ldir/ /dkar phyogs zla ba tshes pa yar gyi ngo / /gza' skar 'phrod kyis dge ba'i dus bzang por/ /thor tshugs dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba can/ /tshangs dbang dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal ngom de mtshar/ /'da' dka' pad+ma thod 'phreng rdo rje'i gsung / /ji bzhin gangs can bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel/ /rig 'dzin bdag gis gnyer du gtad pa'i las/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du lta bur re ba skongs/ /rang rgyud legs dus sde snod 'dzin pa yi/ /'dus sde zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i gling / /sngon bzhin bsrung dang spel ba'i 'phrin las rnams/ /'bad med sgrubs shig dregs pa'i sde dpon che/ /lha rdzas snyan shal zung ldan sa'i zla ba/ /mi 'dzad nam mkha' mdzod du byin brlabs nas/ /chu stod zla ba'i dkar cha rtsom pa la/ /mngon du phyogs tshe gru 'dzin rtse nas dge /(139na/lngags glang hor zla dang po'i nang du 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khrir gsar du phebs pa khang shi rgyal pos lha khang ser po'i bla ma bsam blo mi rgan chos rjes gtsos pa'i gser yig pa chu stag gi lor mngags te gnang sbyin bzang po dang bcas/ bka' shog phebs pa'i lan 'bul bar lam pa spyan snga dang rgya tshe ring gnyis gtang rag du phul ba sa gsum rnam par gnon pa'i gad rgyangs/ ṛ〉 pa ti ba li ka rma 0 dru da snru me tri bi ༷ bi shā snya pa 'i 2 sha a rnya ka rā khyi yi tsi t+tag sme / nu pa/ sa pa da kro ti a ho 'i she te nyi na dwa bla di be ba bha ma ka sa la tsa mkhru se sha da yaḥ ra dz+nyā pa khru li maḥ dus sdeb sbyor lcags kyi mda'/ kyi bdag po'i las shugs dar drags sa gsum rnam par rab gnon kyang / /nga rgyal sdig lta'i rtsub sems dang bral 'gro kun byams brtses rjes skyong ba'i/ /dam pa'i rang bzhin ngo mtshar khyad par dman tshul las 'phags lha yi lha/ /gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbang phyug gong ma rgyal po'i zhabs drung du / /rab dkar brtse ldan lhag bsam chu shel dbang / /ris med 'gro ba'i kun+da ra rjes chags pa'i/ /sdom brtson mang du thos —4/8

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (popa'i klog pa mkhan/ /spobs pa dge ba'i mgrin bteg mchid (139ba'i di zhu/ /gnam gyi she mong ri mo rab bkra'i bka'/ /gzengs stod skyes bzang mu tig 'khri shing char/ /'bebs snod bsod nams gser zhun las grub par/ /'phyur por 'khyil bas lag pad snying gar zum/ /mgon khyod 'jam dpal gzhon nu mi yi rjer/ /nyer bstan gsang gsum rdo rje'i rnam rol la/ /skye rga na 'chi srid pa'i gdon chen pos/ /nam yang rdzi bar nus min rang gi gshis/ /'bangs rnams phan tshun mnyen gshin 'bru bcud smin/ /ring por 'tsho dang phun tshogs 'byor pa'i dpal/ /gang gi rnam smin shing rta bdun pa yis/ /drangs pa'i rdzogs ldan nyi ma shar 'di spro/ /gting zab ma rgan 'khor tshor bde skyid chu/ /tshad med 'bab byed lhag bsam kha ba'i gos/ /mi 'bral rtag gyon gaṅgā'i yab gcig nga / /rgyal bstan 'degs pa'i dpung pa rtse mor bsnyegs/ /mi bdag lang tsho'i cha shas ma gang pas/ /ches phra'i na tshod dang po'i zla tshes kyang / /dpa' mdzangs rtul phod bco lnga'i 'od dkar can/ /rnam dpyod dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i 'od stong 'phro/ khyod drin ga bur gzegs ma re res kyang / /srid pa'i gdung ba 'phrog nas bsil ba'i zer/ /mngon 'dod rtse dga'i snang ba ches 'bar bas/ /'gro kun snying gi kun+da ra cis mi bshad/ /rtsol bar ltos min gang bsams 'grub byed pa'i/ /yid bzhin cod pan 'chang ba khyod rjes su/ /sems bral kun bzod ma ni 'brang byed na/ /'bangs min yid can med la su zhig mtshar/ /sngon byon yab mes khrims gnyis(140na bdugs dkar po'i/ /yu ba rigs sras thu bo la gtad na/ /phan bde'i grib bsil srid gsum yongs khyab pa'i/ /dge bcu kun ldan gos dkar 'gro la sbyin/ /brgya byin gtsug nor reg la ltos min par/ /mi yi lus la legs bris yon tan kun/ /rdzogs pa'i khyod gdong sde bzhi'i zhal ldan yang / /mnga' 'bangs skye bos ma mthong 'dren byed skyon/ /bsod nams gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong can/ /srid pa'i gtsug tor rtse mor rab 'phags pa'i/ /zhabs sen nyi dkyil gling bzhi'i nam mkha' la/ /rtag tu 'char ba'i yid smon 'grub gyur cig /chen po'i lung las 'dzin las dgyes pa'i spyan/ /nam yang mi gtong gzigs pa'i bka' mchid skyes/ /bsil —4/mi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheri'i sbubs nas ri bong 'dzin pa 'bum/ /'char yang mi mdzad rang gi dpe slar bstan/ /gnam bskos rgyal khab yangs pa'i gan mdzod du/ /brtan g.yo'i phra rags dngos po kun 'jug pas/ /mdongs gsol rten gyi rin cen 'jam pa'i dpya/ /'gyur med mtshams sprin gsar pas rgyas btab pa'i/ /lha mir bcas pas khengs pa'i gdong smad de/ /dpral ba sa la reg nas 'dud pa'i yul/ /gtsug lag lugs brgya'i pho brang ga la bar/ /dang ba'i yid kyis phul ba dza byu/ /gong ma rgyal po shun dzi mtho ris kyi skas la 'dzegs nas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i khrir lcags glang hor zla dang por rigs kyi sras khang shi rgyal po phebs pa na legs po 'bul ba'i thog mar shis pa brjod pa sngon du 'gro ba can kyi zhu yig chu stag lam pa spyan snga sbrel po rdzong sta byas skabs phul ba gsar pa'i lha zhal tshes (140ba)pa'i gtam snyan/ bha ba da ma sa sba sa kā la ni sapu ṇa pa tā dī rga yu kha rā za tho tu/ 〉 go ma he sha di ka ma khriḥ dzin pa ra 5 te mi napya da myu la yoḥ srid (rdzoXrd4yi rma/tha zhi phun tsho gos kun shong bsod nams snod/ /tshe ring gnam gyi shing rtas nyer bskrun pas/ /sa gsum dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gong ma che/ /mtshan snyan yid kyi ngal gso'i zhabs drung du/ /e ma srid na mngon mtho lha dang mi/ /kun gyi phyag dang legs lho 'bul ba la/ /ma g.yeng 'di na gus pas zhu ba'i 'phrin/ /snyan 'gyur glu la mgon khyod snyan gtad dang / /mang bkur 'khor los sgyur ba rgyal po'i khab/ /gsar 'brug sder lngas bteg pa'i khri chen por/ /gsar pa'i lha khyod changs pa rgan po yis/ /'gro kun gtsug tor rtser mdzes rgyal por bskos/ /sngon byon yab gcig mtho ris gnam gyi skas/ /'dzegs nas 'chi ba med pa'i gtsor gshegs tshe/ /'dzam gling mi yi bsod nams mthu chen pos/ /thob (141na)khyod rtsod pa'i dus kyi nga las nu/ /sa zla bye ba'i srang gis nyer rngan zhing / /brgya phrag g.yo sgyu'i 'phrul gyis khrid min pa'i/ /gnam thig drang po'i rgyal khrims 'gro kun la/ /'debs pa'i ngang tshul mig gtong khyod kyi lugs/ /lha gcig gna' bo'i khrir phebs nges pa'i gtam/ /'di na thog mar thos pa'i dga' ston du/ /bdog pa skyes su 'bul ba'i sngon 'gro'i sgor/ /mgrin pa'i lam nas shis pa'i tshig 'di brjod/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan sangs —42(lha

rgya bod tor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la phun yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pergyas bden gnyis chos/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun dkon cog gsum/ /gser mngal khyab 'jug mgrin sngon la sogs pa'i/ /'khor 'das dpal gyis lha khyod shis gyur cig /gser 'khor yid bzhin nor bu btsun mo mchog /dgung blon glang chen rta dang dmag dpon te/ /rin cen sna bdun sngon 'gro'i chab srid 'od/ /bskal par skye rgu'i gdung mun mthar byed shog /mi bdag bka' drin ma la yar skyes dri/ /lus can kun gyi snying la 'thul ba'i ngad/ /sdug bsngal tsha bas nyen zhi bsil ba'i bde/ /rtse dga' rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dpal dgod shog /gnam gyis spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang bskur bas/ /rin cen pod can 'chang ba'i rgyal po'i rigs/ /srid bzhi'i gtsug lag kun la mkhasapa'i rgyud/ /gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar chad pa med gyur cig /'dzam gling yongs kyi bde skyid ngal gso dang /khyod zhabs mi 'gyur srog gcig byung pa'i stegs/ /gzhom med rtag pa'i rang bzhin g.yung drung du/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams mthus grub shog /phun tshogs rten 'brel sgrig pa'i zhu 'phrin bcud/ /dag pa'i snyan dbang be+e ḍūr za ma tog /'khyil rten rin (141bcun 'phreng ba 'jam po'i phrug /spel ba'i sta gon cho gas 'di na brel/ /gangs can nor 'dzin dpal mo'i sa'i thig le/ /lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi 'dabs/ /rang byung 'phags pa mched kyi zhing khams mchog gru 'dzin ri bo'i spo nas phul ba dge /chu stag hor zla bdun pa'i dgag dbye'i thog rigs kyi srung ma thang ོ rgyal ba bshan pa lag dmar la khrab gdan/ go r+sha/gos dar/ rta/ gser skyems sogs 'bul bar 'phyos chang khyim pa btang skabs gsol ba phun tshogs bzhi'i 'dzum ldan/ dmar zlum 'khyil ba'i sdang mig nyi ma'i gzis/ /nag pa bdud sde'i mun pa mthar byas nas/ /sdebazhi'i bzhin ras 'dzum ldan skya rengs ma/ /'char byed sprul pa'i rgyal chen rigs kyi lha/ /brlang por spyod pa'i dgra snying dron mo'i khrag /btungs pas ma ngoms bam chen 'dam lta bur/ /rdzi ba'i stang stabs da dung ma yol kyang / /stong gsum skad cig myul ba'i rdzus la can/ /gtso las gzhan min nub byang dkyil 'khor lha/ /gnas gsum dur khrod kun myul pho lha'i tshul/ /sol nag thang chen gas la'i —42/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)srungs mar/ /bshan pa lag dmar lha srin dmag gi dpon/ /'byams klas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar brgya/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas rab phye ba'i/ /dngos bshams sprul pa'i spyan gzigs legs bstar na/ /dam can sgo lnga'i dbang po dgyes dgur rol/ /lha kye bstan 'gro'i bde 'phrog dgra bgegs steng / /dgra lha khyung 'bar drag khros mtshon rnon po/ /mngon spyod gnam lcags rdo rje 'bar ba'i thog /phab ste phye mar 'thag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /srid zhi'i dngos (142na)kun rang gir dbang byed par/ /dus kyi bdag po'i las shugs btsan po'i spun/ /gdung ba kun zhi ring po'i tshe dang 'byor/ /mang pos bkur ba'i rjes 'gror khyod kyis sgrubs/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan sum rtsen gyi/ /'dun sa'i rtser brgal 'chang dang lhan cig tu/ /snyan brjid rdza rnga sgrogs par bskul ba'i 'phrin/ /nor 'dzin 'bras bu dud la phyogs tshe dge /chu stag hor zla bdun pa 'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin skyur lung chos sde spyi tshogs kyis mi 'gyur brtan pa'i rten 'byung bsgrig par po ta lar 'byor skabs gnas srungs khyi la sdug rgyal pos ched du bzos pa'i gdan sogs kyi rten dang bcas 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan mi shigs rdo rjes dpa' ba'i gad brgyangs/ thub bstan bshad sgrub legs spel 'dus pa'i gling / khrims ldan phun tshogs bcud du rab 'khyil ba/ /g.yel med bsrung bar g.yar dam btsan po can/ /nor skyong sgyu dra'i rol gar ldan pa'i 'phrin/ /mi shigs rdo rjes rnam par dpa' ba'i stan/ /zla ba zhun mar 'khyil ba'i thags kyi dar/ /'chi med btung ba'i rab dkar yol gor bcas/ /ngo mtshar rten 'byung sgo brgya rnam par phye/ /yid srubs nag po'i gdong ba yongs smad cing / /gangs can phan bde'i 'od snang 'dren byed pa'i/ /zhi khro rnam par rol pa bka' brgyad lha'i/ /'phrin las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rtag tu 'char/ /srid pa gsum na che ba'i rig sngags kyi/ /brtul zhugs grub pa pad+ma thod 'phreng bka'/ /mi 'da' rdo rje'i cod pan nyer bcings nas/ /bstan 'gro'i mel tshe rtag tu skyongs shig gu /rnam par bkra ba 'chi med dbang po'i gzhu /byed pos thags su nyer btags snyan shal dang / /gser skyems (142ba tshe sna dzad pa med pa nam mkha' mdzod/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas brlabs te spel/ /—422

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('chu stag hor zla gsum par bsam yas rab gnas la phyin skabs grwa tshong 'dus nas bya khrid mig gcig pas stag lo go gsol chen mo'i dus lha srin sde brgyad thams cad 'tshog rgyu yin pas/ sku chas dgos tshul 'byung ba ltar lo de'i hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad la snyan shal bkras btags/ gos phyi nang / gser skyems/ khrab gdan/thod/sha gos/ lham/ rta/ mdung dmar/ 'khor gsum/bzang rnga/ ras yug sogs mchod sprin spro bar lcang lo can pa bstan 'dzin dpal bzang btang skabs gsol ba'i 'phrin yig bde skyid nyi ma shar phe 'od snang/mdzo shes ri mo ba po ba'i mig gi sgor/ khrid pa spyod pa'i snang tshul kun shar tshe/ /lkog gyur gnyid slong mngon sum skya rengs kyis/ /bde skyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dren pa'i lha/ /shar phyogs dung sgo phye ba'i pho brang nas/ /rgyal chen mon nag pu ta'i zhal gyi khyim/ /tshems dkar ze'u 'bru ngoms pa'i 'dzum ldan du/ /sgyur ba'i blon po bya khrid mig gcig bu/ /rang srid 'chi med bde bar ngal gso ba'i/ /stobs chen rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan can/ /'phrin las nor bu mdzad med skyug pa'i gter/ /'chang khyod gnod sbyin dbang po'i spun zla bzhin/ /srog dbugs sha khrag bzar rngams rings pa'i gar/ /rnam 'gyur dpa' bo'i rol pa mtha' klas kyang / /dkar nag las kyi tshul la mel tshe mkhan/ /thub bstan rin cen skyong ba'i dpal du shis/ /snang srid zil gnon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /dbang rtags rdo rje'i 'phreng ba thod bcings pa'i/ /ri mor rab 'bar g.yar dam bskyangs pa'i thig /drang po gnam gyi dgu tshigs(143na ti la 'gran/ /gyen zlog 'bangs kyi gya gyu ngan 'chang snying / /lkog mar 'byin dang lhan cig khengs pa'i mgo /rkang stegs sa la lhung ba'i rgyal thabs kyi/ /dbang drag ru mtshon bsgreng bar khyod bsngags so/ /nyal 'gro bdud rtsir 'khyil ba 'bras ldan gyi/ /lha rgyal dbyangs su len pa tshes brgyad dus/ /gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor gang ba mchod pa'i sprin/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas 'di na spel/ /rdul bral dri med 'phrin shog rdzing bu la/ /blang dor zla ba'i snang brnyan grangs mang yang / /zab gsang phra zhib ri dwags gzugs 'char ba'i/ /lung bstan nam mkha'i zla ba mngon sum ston/ /sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i gan mdzod nas/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs dpal gyi be'u'i gzugs/ /snying gar dga' ba g.yas su rab 'khyil ba'i/ /bsams don 'grub pa'i bkra shis—423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)lhun grub mdzod/chu stag hor zla brgyad pa'i yar tshes la tsher gseb nas tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs kyis spyi sgos kyi rim gro'i blang dor dang bcas te 'phrin yig byung ba'i gsung lan gtam snyan g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung dkar/ gnag snum ral pa'i thor tshugs rtser/ /g.yas 'khyil snyan pa'i dung dkar pos/ /legs spud dpal ldan tshangs pa yis/ /gsung 'phrin lha dar rten bcas lhor/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid can/ /pad+ma ka ra zhes grags pa/ /gang de'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i/ /g.yar dam g.yo med ji bzhin spro/ /gangs can ra ba dkar po yi/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho sa /rdo rje lta bur gnas dgos pa'i/ khyu mtshan yid kyi thig ler sim /nag po bdud kyi sder bcas las/ /rnam (143ba)par rgyal ba'i thabs kyi tshul/ /rim gro'i blang dor ma lus pa/ /g.yel med brtson pas nyams su bstar/ /lha mchog yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /snyan shal mdzes byed lha rdzas dar/ /gser skyems zho yi 'khor lo bcas/ /yar tshes dge bar dza yas/ /chu stag hor zla brgyad pa'i nang du grwa ar dge rgyal po bya khrid mig gcig pa dang brgyud gcig tu byed pa de bar skabs su khog zhugs ma byung ba 'dug par mon bu klu btsan gyi khog g.yar nas thog babs kyi tshul du zhugs nas mthun rdzas gsol mchod gsar rtsom bcas dgos tshul dang khog pa su 'tshol 'phrin yig byung bar dgos cha spel pa dang bcas te lan du bsrings pa dam tshig ri mo rnam bkra /a ho mi bsrun brlang po'i gos smin lcags/ /rigs 'dzin pad+ma ka ra'i mthu rtsal rtsis/ /bstan srungs dbang po'i gser du legs bsgyur ba'i/ /bya khrid mig gcig bshan pa'i 'phrin yig 'byor/ /nyi zla mkha' la 'char ba yol min ltar/ /rtag tu bstan pa'i bya ra g.yel med du/ /sgrub pa'i g.yar dam gnyen po legs bsrung ba'i/ /gtsug na rdo rje'i ri mo bkra des shis/ /lkog gyur chos rnams mngon sum ji bzhin du/ /lta ba'i sgrib bral lha mig rab gsal bas/ /gzhal ba ji bzhin ston pa'i gsang ba'i tshig /ma brjed yid kyi yol gor rtag tu bstan/ /sngon gyi khog pa'i brgyud pa can gang dang / /deng dus gsar du g.yar po byung ba gnyis/ /mon bu klu btsan de dang gros mthun ngos/ /lha khyod gang bzhed cig la 'tshol bar mdzod/ /rgyal chen dpe har sku lnga gtsor ston la/ /blon po bya khrid —424

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (semig gcig sger gsol zhig /dgos tshul ji bzhin tshig gi srad bu la/ /legs brgyus gsar pa'i 'phreng ba rnam par spel/ /byang (144na)phyogs gangs can swā la'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /thub bstan yongs 'du rgyas pa'i grib bsil la/ /lus can ma lus bde bar ngal gso ba'i/ /phan bde'i sgo brgya 'byed pa'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ /lha dar gser skyems la sogs bdog pa'i skyes/ /thugs dam stong pa'i 'dod rgu'i mchod sbyin mkhan/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya bden pa'i mthus/ /dgyes zhal ston zla lta bur ngoms shing rol/ /chu stag hor zla brgyad pa'i nang du 'phyos chos 'khor steng rgyal po'i las mkhan btsan rgod kyis mthun rdzas dgos tshul byung ba'i 'phrin lan nam mkha' mdzod kyi za ma rtag /pad+ma rā ga'i rdul brtsegs lhun po la/ /nyin byed 'od kyis 'khyud pa'i gzi byin can/ /gnod sbyin btsan rgod bshan pa dmar po yi/ /'phrin yig lha dar rten dang bcas pa 'byor/ /spyi dang khyad par phan bde spel ba'i thabs/ /dmar zlum spyan gyis gzigs nas legs ston pa'i/ /blang dor yid kyi rin cen rtsig ngos la/ /kun rtog pir gyis ma bskyud gsal bar bris/ /sdebargyad kun gyi ral pa'i cod pan rtser/ /bka' rtags rdo rje'i phyag rgya nyer 'god pa'i/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal gyi spyan snga sa /g.yar dam ji bzhin bstan 'gro'i mel tshes skyong / khyad par gangs can ra ba dkar po yi/ khor yug gcig tu gyur pa'i rgyal khams 'dir/ /nad mug 'thab rtsod rgud pa kun zhi zhing / /bde skyid dga' ston la sbyor 'phrin las sgrubs/ /cang shes bzhene pa dang bcas mthun pa'i rdzas/ /nyer bskul ji bzhin dngos bshams ting 'dzin gyis/ /'dzad med (144ba)nam mkha' mdzod kyi longs spyod du/ /brlabs te sgo gsum dgyes pa bskyed phyir spel/ /shes bya'i gtsug lag mang por lta ba'i mig yangs mnga' ris ru thog dbang po phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis mdo sdud pa/ byamasachos bzhi rnams skad shan sbyar thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang po'i zhus dag ma/ gso dpyad kyi gces bsdus rin cen 'phreng ba/ mkhyen brtse lo tsā ba'i sde tshan bdun pa skad shan sbyar dang bcas pa'i glegs bam ma phyi'i g.yar por ched gtad bya ma rta mngags te snyan tshig gi 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan rnam dpyod mu tig gsar pa'i 'khri shing / sa kṛ tho da shi ra dza n+ma—425

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)taḥ bi tsā ra mu sti na bya sa kṛ t+ta sa bha r+ṣa ta/ sdeb sbyor rig gnas/ ya/ ba ta ( ya na tisdu zhe ma go pra mā shu bha sta la pu ka te li rnya/ legs (sdeb sbyor rig gnas/)byas glang chen spyi bo las skyes pa'i/ /rnam dpyod mu tig gsar pa'i 'khri shing cher/ /ji snyed shes bya'i gnas lugs sar 'bab pa'i/ /dge ba'i 'bras dkar smin pa de la springs/ /blo gros rgan pa'i rtser (145na)son ral klung nas/ /nyams 'gyur 'phrin rten gaṅgā'i rgyun babs tshe/ /gdong bzhi tsam gyis tshangs pa khyod nyid las/ /lhag par 'dzin pa'i kun rtog yid la bris/ /rgyal gsung sdud pa byams chos pu sta da: /rgya dpe'i legs sbyar skad dang shan sbyar ba/ /don ldan thams cad mkhyen nges zha lu bas/ /dri med spyan ras kyis btsas 'khrul med gnas/ /skad rigs mi gcig sde tshan bdun pa rnga5 /rab dbye mkhyen lo'i blo gros kyis spobs dang / /srog gi ka ba 'dzugs pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /gces bsdus rin cen 'phreng mdzes 'byor de spro/ /skye ba'i 'phreng ba mi zad 'khor ba'i mtha'/ /'tshol byed zug jus gtams pa'i snod yin kyang / /dal 'byor mtshan nyid ldan pa gang gi lus/ /bde bar rang gnas 'byor 'tsho'i gtam de snyan/ /'di na thos bsam ba kū la yi kha /rnam g.yeng nyi zla'i 'od kyis phyed min kyang / /skye thob shes rab lus phra'i 'gram chang gis/ /phye ba'i 'dab ma ba 'ad 'di ma snyigs tsam/ /sngon byon mkhas mang gdong lnga'i dbang po'i shul/ /stobs 'byor rams kyis bsgyur ba'i kha dog la/ /mtshar byed bstan 'dzin dbyar gyi srin 'bu ltar/ /gang tshe khyod nyi zla med nam mkha'i zla/ /thos bsam rtsa ba sbom por bskyed bsrings pa'i/ /lnga rig dza lha'i gser gyi snye ma yis/ /dud khyod g.yas ru'i phyogs der rang nyid kyi/ /grib ma tsam la mkhas pa'i mched por 'dzin/ /dbang rtul drang srong dmod lhungs blo dman mngal/(145ba)/phyag tshan ming btags lcags kyi tim bu bdun/ /nyer btsas ltar snang chos kyi sdig smin pas/ /dwags brgyud grub rigs tha gu'i lho can bzhin/ /'dzam gling rgyan gyur kha spu can rnams kyis/ /gzhung rgya 'grol ba'i sa dge'i mkhas rnams dang / /jog rdzun 'phrul gyis gzhan blo brid pa rnams/ khyad par shes pa'i blo ldan nyid las su/ /de lta na yang rig lam smra ba'i grar/ /ma —426

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dzadartags 'chad rtsod phrag par khur blangs can/ /dpyad na e raṇ+ḍa yi snying po'i gshis/ /'di'ang skal ngan dus kyi byed po'i skyon/ /'on te deng dus lnga brgya drug pa'i skabs/ /da gdod lung gi phrag gsum 'ong nges na/ tagang dpang lta bu'i nges par kun mkhyen 'gas/ /thub bstan nyi 'od gsal snyam yid kyis gsos/ /mi bdag tha snyad pha mtha' zad min phyir/ /gzung 'dzin pha rol rlung rig dngas ma'i 'ja'/ /rdor sems snying dbus bzhengs pa'i ye shes lha/ /rang snang de la ngo 'phrod zab lam gnad/ /ma smad spobs pa dge ba'i mgrin pa nas/ /gleng bar 'os pa'i sna'i/dang srid kyi gtam/ /a 'dus ka 'phreng srad bur rtag rgyu ba'i/ /ngang tshul de las ldog min khyod kyi lugs/ /mgrin pa'i pad mtshor dbyangs can ngang mo dkar/ /nyams 'gyur skad snyan sa spyod rna ba la/ /'brol tshe rjes chags mtshon pa'i mthun 'tshams sprin/ /thags su btags pa'i sa gzhi mdzod 'di'o/ /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu yos lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag /grwa sdings po che nas sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos chu yos gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ston spel bar snyan ngag gi lam na drang pa'i 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan/ legs bshad ro brgya'i (146na sko yang chags/ gro byung ra mā snya rma hwasu ga rā sgo ga a rba spu swā ra ga ta rmi ma lwaḥ kha ba rnga su ka lwa di no 'u ku 5 she pa tole kha ba rta ga tsi tā ta ku 1/ zab (sdeb sbyor lag 'gro ltung ba/)brling blo gros rgya mtsho chen po las/ /sgra don snyan 'gyur nyams ldan rlabs kyi 'phreng / /gnam lo'i dus kyi dang por yol min par/ shes pa brjod pa'i 'phrin yig rten bzang 'byor/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i bum bzang nas/ /legs bshad skyug pa'i gzigs ma shog bu'i snod/ /'khyil ba ro bda'i g.yang chags byed po khyod/ / drang srong phur bu mi yi zol gyis 'ongs/ /sna tsho gos tha snyad tshig gi sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /gang shar bzo med chos skur —427—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shenges rnyed pa'i/ /thos don snying por spyod pa'i rnal 'byor che/ grub rigs bstan pa'i ched du bder 'tsho spro/ /'di na zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba yi/ /gna' bo'i khri la rang rigs srol 'dzin yang / /thub bstan ris su ma bcad gzhud lugs (146bskong / /phyi nang gtsug lag rgya mtshor spyod pas brel/ /yid 'phrog lta na nyer sdug mdzas byed ma/ /chu dar gos kyis klubs pa bgrang bya'i zhal/ /'dzum ba 'ad nas brtsams rdzogs ldan dga' ston gyi/ /rtse dga' dgod pa'i khur chen phrag par lan/ /grub ris phal gyis spobs min gnas lnga'i gzhu/ /rnam dpyod rgyud kyis bkug pa'i mda' bo ches/ /log rtogasasbyin skyes grong khyer 'bigs byed gang / /su la'i ljongs su gnas pa'i mgrin sngon bzhin/ /slu 'drid sgyu mar chags pa'i 'phong rkyen gyis/ /chen po'i ri dwags rjes su steg min par/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i sī ta legs skyong nyid/ /dwags brgyud mdzes rgyan sngon med dga' byed lha/ /ngag la smra ba'i dbang po'i 'dod pa kun/ /'jo ba'i snyan grags lha yi rnga bo che/ /srid pa gsum du brdungs pa'i khor yug las/ /brgal pa'i dpal ldan bzang po'i skal can kye/ /ngan spyod dris sbags rgya ras ring lugs zhabs/ /bsil bar na tshod chung ngu'i dus nyad nas/ /dag byed khrus kyi mkhan pos gaṅgā khyod/ /log pa'i g.ya' bral de srid chad med sgrongs/ /gsar tshes phun tshogs sgo brgya phye 'di nas/ /byams mgon dbus 'gyur mchog sprul rnam rol pa/ /de srid bkra shis 'phrin yig skyes bzang rgyun/ /nyi zla'i 'grosakyi rjes su cis mi rgyu/ /rnam bcu'i chos spyod bstar bar rtag khrus pa'i/ /dam pa'i tshul la rangs pa'i rab dkar blo/ /som nyi ra ri ldan min 'od dkar can/ /bsil zer phon dzor 'phro ba 'dis mtsho zhe no/ /mdzes byed kyi lo khra 'brug nas tshangs pa chen pos me tog mchod pa'i thog gtsug (147na〉pag khang du 'phan gdugs bla bre dgos tshul byung ba'i 'phrin lan phan bde'i gdugs mdzes legs 'khyil/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma'i gar/sis rgya mtshor pad+ma'i ze 'bru'i rtser/ /legs sgyur 'dzam gling che ba'i rig sngags yong / /brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang po pad+ma 'byung / /gang des spyi bor rdo rje'i ri mo bkod/ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi lcer blud nas/ /dbang bskur dam tshig nyer bsgos srog bdag che/ /lha chen tshangs pa'i —428

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pe'aphrin yig rten ldan son/ /chos rgyal mes dbon gyis bskrun ga smyo la/ /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i sgrub pa'i gnas/ /zung 'brel gangs can phan bde'i rtsal lag la/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung nyer spel zhing / /bsten cing bsgrub pa'i dam can srung ma dang / /rigs dang brgyud la 'go ba'i dgra lha sogs/ /dgyes zhal bco lnga'i zla ba ltar ston pa'i/ /skul byed rdo rje'i tshig 'phreng rna bar 'jibs/ /mtha' 'dul gtsug lag khang bzang kun gyi gtso/ /g.yon ru dpal gyi khra 'brug chosa'akhor du/ /gdugs mdzes bzang gos las grub bla bre 'phan/ /nya rgyas tshes la 'byor nges 'di spel lo/ /rab dkar gangs kyi ra bas yongs bskor ba'i/ /bod yul bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas pa dang / /rig 'dzin bdag gis bcol pa'i 'phrin las bzhi/ /thogs med sgrubs shig g.yas khyil dung thod can/ /lha khyod mdzes pa'i snyan shal ring po mā /'phyang byed 'ja' tshon lta bur bkra ba'i dar/ /sa zla'i skyems ldan 'phrin yig lag thogs pa'i/ /pho nya yar lungs sman gyi ljongs su song / /mdzes byed kyi lo bsam yas nas dregs pa'i sde dpon chen pos bod khams bde thabs la dmigs nas byang chub chen po'i spyan sngar mar me'i rgyun btsugs mthun rkyen du bre'u mar gyi khal ldan gsum dgos tshul byung ba ltar ma ṇi ba dkon blo (147ba)btang skas sol ba brgya phraganyi 'ad45phan/ sal rnam par rab rgyal ba'i/ /ba dan srid pa'i rtse mo sa /bsgreng ba'i gnod sbyin tse'u dmar/ /snang srid dregs pa'i sdod pon che/ dgod dang drag shul 'jigs rung ba'i/ /nyams ldan gtum chen dpa' bo'i gsung / /tshangs dbyangs gsang tshig rdo rje'i 'phrin/ /ri mo'i lam du shar te son/ /phan bde'i ma la ya yi ngad / kha ba'i ljongs 'dir 'gugs byed pa'i/ /mi 'gyur lhun grub gas lar/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung spel ba spro/ /yams nad mu ge'i 'jigs sel sogs/ /spyi sgos don du mar me'i rgyun/ /'dzugs pa'i mthun rkyen drel gzhen gsum/ /rtsi bcud khur gyis rnam par lci/ /bde gshegs zhi khro sras bcas kyi/ /zan g.yang lhun grub pho brang cher/ /dkar tshes nya rgyas dus bzang por/ /slebs nges pho nya shul du zhugs/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus thod 'phreng rtsal/ /bka' bzhin thub bstan rab spel zhing / /bod 'bangs skye 'gro ma lus pa/ /bde zhing skyid —429

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyepa'i dpal la sbyor/ /rig 'dzin bdag dang bsrung 'khor du/ /nyer chud bcas la dug mtshon g.yul/ /ngan shoms byed pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /lus sems phrol la rdul du rlog /nad gdon kun zhi tshe dpal rgyas/ /mi nor zas gsum 'du ba sogs/ /bsams pa ji bzhin lhun grub par/ /mdzod cig bstan srungs mthu rtsal can/ /lha rdzas dar mtshon snyan shal dang / /gser skyems rtse mo'i grangs kyi zhor/ /thun 'tshams rgya yis nyer spras te/ /snang srid dregs pa'i 'dun sar spel/ / 'phags yul wa ra ṇa mi'i pa ṇ+ḍi ta go kū la'i tshong pa shar phyogs rgya nag gi rgyal khams su btang ba'i tshe 'phrin yig byung ba'i pan chu yos hor zla dgu pa'i tshes brgyad la bsrings pa mkhas pa dga' bskyed/ (148na)bra hā shu kla pa bla na tra su rnyetsa khyu ga ṇa pa te: pa ñca snya na bi du pa ṇ+ḍi ta go spru la ma the ku sa sa rba pa 'e wa rje salha/ na sha : dza pa yo rgya/ a k+ṣa na sha bhā ṣi ta ma hre ba sto rba ma de li // gser mngal can dang pad dkar mig /gtsug na zla ba tshogs bdag gis/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍita/ /go kū lar ni shis par mdzod/ /snga phyir bsrings pa'i yi ge rten/ /nyams med sug par nyer son zhing / /'dren byed yul du gyur pa'i tshe/ /brjod don yid la ri mor bris/ /ma ga dha ma la ma dza pa zhu rtam dhu ya sha ga rje/ /spyi re de sha pa bha ga 'i le : ma ba ta ti rā sa/ /sa rba sa twa ma /le da ya su na/ sho rnyo da na/ /ta ga na pa sa ra shu ma ṇa sa snya na su rdzu ba ka /'phags yul ma la yar skyes nas/ /mkhas khyod snyan grags dri bsung ni/ /thag ring yul gyis nyer bskal yang / /drung na 'khod ltar ches cher dngar/ /sems can kun la ris med du/ /brtse ba'i mgon po zas gtsang sras/ /de'i rjes nyer thugs dge sbyong bdag /rang gi gnas su bde bar 'tsho (148ba)ya snro ka sa ti — shi skye 4 te ga tu ma tru ga ta/ bha ba ta khro dhi ta ཿ kha ྅ pa bā ga nirā sa dha/ lo ka spa ta bra shā spyu tā be do ka su ba ra pra rta/ gang dang thabs cig 'khod pa'i grogs/ /rtswa ṇa ra bgrod bshul 'dir 'ongs par/ /dngos dang brgyud nas phan pa'i sgo/ /lus ngag yid kyis 'bad pas bsgrubs/ /'jig rten mes po tshangs pa'i bu/ /rig byed smra ba'i brtul zhugs —43(/—

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pomachog /lha twa mā da sgo rgya shrī 'i tā ta tsa ba ga ba sku sa ra khru sa wa ṇi ta lu ca sra PROB PROBba tsi sno sa lha/ sho bha ཿ r+ṣa sha rwa sko le ka ṭa ra sa gi ro li 〉/ 'dzin khyod sngon bzhin bde ba nas/ /bsring 'os nyi zla'i 'gros ltar 'tshal/ /rin cen sa zla zha'i 'khor lo/ /gsum longs dang yug rten dang bcas/ /mdzes byed lo yi 'bras ldan dus/ /pho brang dmar po ri nas bris/ /(149na༄dzes byed kyi lo hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu ba ni re nyin/ dpal ldan tshangs pa dung thod can gyis tsher gser bla ma blo bzang 'jam dbyangs pho nyar mngags te ring por 'tsho ba'i rten 'byung du stag gdan legs pa zhig dang bcas gsung 'phrin byung ba'i tshe rgyal khams spyi'i lung bstan dgos tshul dang bcas lan gsol ba bdud las rgyal ba'i dga' ston/ gnag snum ral pa'i rtse na bkra shis dung / /rab dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba'i cod pan 'chang / /skabs 'gar li byin ha ra'i mtshan snyan can/ /bstan srungs dbang po'i gsung 'phrin lha dar 'byor/ /lkog gyur chos kun mngon sum rab gsal ba/ /lha mig rnam par dag pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /gzigs pa ji bzhin spyi sgos blang dor rnams/ /lha bdag 'phrin nang lhug stsal spro dga' brtas/ /bdud las rab rgyal dpa' bo stag gi stan/ /tshe dpal 'phel zhing dbang byed 'ja' ris can/ /sra brtan srungs 'khor lcags ri mtshon pa'i 'jag /ring por 'tsho ba'i rten 'byung lhag par 'grig /srong btsan skyes lha dpal ldan tshangasapa'i mtshan/ /drag por khros pa'i li byin ha ra che/ /g.yar dam gnyan po nam yang mi g.yel bar/ /rtag tu las kun bsgrub la gcig tu rang / /snyigs mar spyod pa'i dus kyi 'gyur ldog gi /rgyal khams spyi yi bzang ngan lung bstan dang / /de 'dras ngan sel bzang po spel ba'i thabs/ /snang tshul gsal ba'i shog khra bkod rigs snyam/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /sgyu 'phrul rol gar pad+ma thod 'phreng gi /dam tshig ri mo thod du gsal ba bzhin/ /'phrin las rnam/ bzhi ma lus lhun grub mdzod/ /zla rgyas thags kyis ri dwags gzugs bkra (149ba)ba/ /lha rdzas du kū la yi phon rdzar can/ /sa zla'i gser skyems zung du bcas pa ni/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du spel ba dge /chu yos hor zla gsum pa'i nang du grwa tshong 'dus nas bshan pa bya khrid mig gcig pas gsol mchod gsar rtsom zhig dang —43/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyebacas sbug chol/ gser rnga dgos tshul byung ba bzhin lo de kha'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i lha tshes thog de don rnams spel ba dang rgyal khams spyi'i lung bstan dgos tshul dang bcas 'phyos chang khyim pa blo bzang dngos grub btang skabs 'phrin du gsol ba kun khyab snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs/ rig rtsal 'jigs pa med pa rdo rje'i skur/ /grub pa'i zlos gar pad+ma thod 'phreng gis/ /dbang bskur rang rtags phyag rgya nyer gtad pa/ /bya khrid mig gcig gnod sbyin bshan pa cher/ /mtsho skyes gsung gsang 'phrin las don bcu zhes/ /nyang ral gter byon gtso bor gyer dgos kyang / /res 'ga' myur sgrub lam mkho'i gsol mchod 'di/ /lha rgyal bkra shis dbyangs snyan ming du chags/ /phun tshogs 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dga' ston la/ /srid gsum dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'bod byed pa/ /kun khyab snyan brjid sgra dbyangs rol mo'i tshogs/ /lha khyod snyan gyi dbang po dgyes phyir 'brol/ /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par gangs can 'dir/ /lkog gyur slad mar 'byung ba'i snang tshul rnams/ /dri med spyan gyi me long ngos shar ba/ /zhib rgyas lung bstan rab gsal yi ger 'khod/ /gangs kyi ra bas yongs bskor bod yul 'dir/ /nad mug 'khrug sogs nyes tshogs bzlog thabs dang / /sgos kyi blang dor rim gro'i rim pa rnams/ /'gag med rdo rje'i glu dbyangs nye bar (150na khod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'phrul/ /rgya gar paṇa chen gzugs shar pad+ma 'byung / /gang de'i dam tshig gnyan po nyer dgongs la/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun thogs med sgrubs/ /dar mtshon sna lnga'i snyan shal gser skyems zung / /mi 'dzad 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gter bum bzhin/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas brlabs te rab spel na/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs sgrogs/ /nyang stod 'brong rtse lhun grub kyi gling pa blo bzang nor bus snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i ma phrin lan gtsang phyogs mun sel gsar pa'i zla tshes/ : bha pya nā : bi nyi go sa twa ma gye 'i kha sa ni 6 yo ba ni yu pi ta nu/ /pañca ba dh+wa / pu nyu mā nā su ru ṇa ma gro yu ཿ rka ka rti ka ste thu ba stu/ /gzung 'dzin pha rol rang rig rdo rje sems/ /ngo 'phrod gnas lugs lang tsho na phra yang / /lnga rig mdongs mtha' la zhen mkhas ming lha'i/ /rtser son da rti ka yi gtam 'di nyon/ /blo rtul 'khor los gcod min rnam dpyod —432

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('asrog /'tsho (150ba)ba'i snyan tshig rig byed bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /spobs pa ches dge ro brgya bda' ba'i g.yang / /mgrin par chags de'i nyams 'gyur 'phrin rten son/ /smon 'gro lo tswa'i nyin byed nub pa'i shul/ /rmongs mun khrod rgyu rigs mthun 'ug pa'i srol/ /deng dus sgra snyan gsar du nyer tshes zla/ /g.yas ru'i mkha' la khyod shar yid kyis gsos/ /sbyin tshul bzod goms sa bon legs btab las/ /dal dang 'byor ba'i snye ma dar drag rtser/ /gtan bde'i gos smin la 'tshe ba mo yis/ /reg min dag tshogs brlan gyis skyed bsrings spro/ /rnam g.yeng ri dwags kyis 'drid gzhan phan phongs/ /rkyen 'dod 'brul pa'i rjes su 'brang ba nga / /lhag bsam rnon po'i mde'u sa dman lam gyi/ /lang ga'i gtsug tor bcad de 'di na bde/ /mi shes 'thibs mun nyal ba'i ma rig gnyid/ /stug po las slong thob pa'i skya rengs mas/ /gnas lnga'i tsha zer dkyil 'khor nyer drangs te/ /legs bshad snang bas khyod kyi snying dbus gsal/ /'phags yul kha spu can gyi gzhud brgya'i bcud/ /myangs pa'i 'jig rten mig gcig shong dpang dang / /chos skyong bzang po'i rjes 'brang mkhas rnams kyi/ /rnam thar 'dzin la mosapa nyin skar bzhin/ /gtsug lag smra ba'i glu dbyangs mi ldan yang / /'dod yon gzhan lus khrag la rjes chags pa/ /bstan 'dzin rnon po'i mchu can dug sbrang khyu/ /tshul des rang gzhan bslu la mchi ma dku/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos phung gaṅgā skyes/ /brda sprod mngon gsum tshad ma rig pa yis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gtso sbyangs gser 'khor los/ /thub bstan gling bzhir sgyur byed rgyal (151na)thabasamakhan/ /ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i sprul bsgyur mtha' klas par/ /'jig rten grags pa'i cha tshang mi 'gog bzo/ /'gro la srog 'tsho'i mi 'jigs sbyin gtong sgo/ /rab phye tshe yi rig pas gzhan rjes 'dzin/ /blo dang brtson pa nye dang sgyur thabs kyis/ /lhun por nor rgyas nyer dkris sgra don mtshor/ / sgril bsasnyan dngags sa srungs gom 'gros can/ shes bya'i nor 'dzin mdzes pa'i rgyan du rgyu/ /tha snyad zad pa med pa'i nags klung nas/ /sdeb sbyor mngon brjod zlos gar sa mchog dri/ /shes rab bser bus legs drangs ldang ba'i ngang / /yid gdung sel la bde ba'i ngal gso'i stegs/ /'on te srid 'byor —433

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shermugs 'dzin rjes 'gro dang / /kun rdzob tshig lan mkhas pa'i rtser son yang / /gang shar sems kyi 'khrul ngor rtogs min par/ /'khor ba'i zug rngu rgya mtsho'i chu ris bzhin/ /de phyir klu sgrub gsung rab dri med rgyun/ /drang nges chos kun yongs gzigs btsong kha pa'i/ /mdo rgyud rin cen spel ba'i them skas che/ /legs ldan thar pa'i khang bzang 'jug pa'i lam/ /dkar nag grib ma nam yang gtong min pa/ /skye 'chi'i 'phreng ba mi 'dzad 'khor ba 'dir/ /bsam bzhin bsams na 'tsho ba don ldan chos/ /nyams bstar dam bca'i rus pa snying la chug /sbyangs stobs mngon sbyor mi dman gangs ri las/ /brjed ngas dri ma 'khrud pa gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /tshig sbyor mgrin pa gzengs mtho'i lam gsum par/ /dal med 'bab la su zhig klan ka la jug /ris med skye rgur gcig tu dkar ba'i blo/ /mngon sum mtshon byed du kū la gos can/ /tshig don ka la piṅkar 'khu ba'i (151ba)glu/ /len pa'i gar mkhan chu lha'i phang bar song / /grwa sdings po che nas phug pa sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos shing lug lo gsar gyi thog phun tshogs rten 'byung spel ba'i 'phrin yig da ti'i gzhung lugs dang mthun par byung ba'i lan kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ bā ki de bī sa ra sto pa yigle su bha ṣi khya dza ྅ ta 'i : shu bha sga 1 tsa/ /kā dzib sa ṇa sa 4 ba sa mi ya sha lha ya mtho lha gi tsi bra la 'a k+ṣa ra/ ngag (sdeb sbyor me tog 'phreng can/skor dbyangs can lha mo nyer zhugs pas/ /legs bshad rgyud mang 'brol la dge ba'i dbang / /ngur smrig gos kyis klubs pa'i snyan grags can/ /dpal ldan skal pa bzang po'i 'phrin yig rten/ /dge legs chu yis lci ldan gnam lo'i sprin/ /bkra shis snyan brjid glu dbyangs ldir ba'i 'brug /'dzum zhal phan bde'i dga' ston bsu ba'i skyes/ /kun dga'i zlos gar bsgyur ba'i do rar son/ /sngon goms bsod nams sa bon nyer dud las / /thos bsam sgom pa'i mu tig 'khri shing (152na)char/ /'bad med dal 'byor rten gyi 'dzin ma las/ /babs khyod bde bar gnas pa'i gtam de 'jibs/ /'di na chos nor 'dod dang thar pa'i sgo/ /tshogs gnyis tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gis/ /phye ba'i bdud rtsis rab myos zhar la yang / /bstan —434

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('a'agro'i bde skyid rtsa lag grangs med sgrub/ /'dod yon zhes pa'i mun gtibs khung bu mā /semasaganas gti mug la g.yur 'khyil ba'i sprul/ /ma rig rtog par rlom pa'i sgom chen rnams/ / gdol gtam phung sgras shes ldan rna ba rtser/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rten 'brel bcu gnyis la/ /nges par 'byung min brag skyibs nags khrod ljongs/ /gnas tsam grol bar 'dod na lug pa dang / /byang bon grub pa'i go 'phang mthor shes sam/ /thos don bsam mthar bsgom pa'i bser bu yis/ /chos kun sems su nges pa'i tsan+d+ra dri/ /brjod bral gnyug ma'i ma la ya klung nas/ /drangs tshe gzung dang 'dzin pa'i tsha gdung bcil/ /gang snang sems nyid gcig pu'i cho 'phrul du/ /gnas skabs rang ngo shes pa gdod ma'i gshis/ /gsal stong zung du 'jug pa'i rol pa las/ /gud na phyag rgya'i zab lam 'tshol rnams zhabrul/ /tshul de shes pa gangs can sman ljongs na/ /mig rgyang ring pos btsal kyang nyid tsam las/ /ma mthong dgas brgyud grub pa'i ring lugs gang / /deng dus ri mor bris pa'i mar me bzhin/ /smra ba'i khyu mchog khyod blo'i skyed tshal du/ /rnam dpyod lus phra'i 'gram chang dngar po yis/ / phye ba'i snyan dngags me tog ba kū la/ /srid 'byor nyi zla'i 'od kyis ga la 'byed/ /don ldan brjod pa'i 'dab stong grol ba'i sgor/ /lhaḥyig (152bskom ra ser zhun ma 'khyil ba'i stsal/ /snang srid sgra don rgyan gyi nyams 'gyur du/ /spel mkhas phur bu'i spun zlar da gdod nges/ /kun mthong mig sman bdud rtsi'i bcud bsten nas/ /nyi zla'i sgron me thogs te srid pa gsum/ /myul yang bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas gzhal bar/ /gang gi blo gros do zla ngas ma rnyed/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la 'phags yul mkhasarnams dang / /nyid kyi rig pa'i mchog dman mes bos kyang / /ma shes kha spus dbus tsā ra paṇa chen tshogs/ khyad par dbye ba'i sgam bu phya de su/ /bag yod kyis btsun shes byar mas klas mkhas/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i bzang po'i sems ldan kyang / /thos chung sgom par khas 'che'i 'dam khrod du/ /pad dkar bzhin du gcig bur gnas de dal/ /'on te ma snyigs rgyal bstan 'phrog byed rkang / /dag byed lhag bsam yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /sgreng mkhas skal ldan shing rta'i mched zla khyod/ /—435

— rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)ngang tshul 'dis 'tsho dal ba don dang ldan/ /bde skyid dpal gyi nyi ma bsod nams mkhar/ /'pho med rtag tu 'char ba bden pa'i tshig /oṃ yig thog mar bkod pa swa sti'i skur/ /len de bsil ldan yul gyi tshangs pa'i bu/ /snyan 'gyur ka la piṅka ltar 'jebs tshig /don bzang dpyod ldan snying la ro brgya'i bcud/ /sgron me'i bskal bar tshes pa'i gnam lo'i mthar/ /de srid gaṅgā'i rgyun rjes snyegs shig bu/ /sngon rabs rang ris phal gyis ma thob pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i gos sar khyod son snyan pa'i dar/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du ring brkyangs pa/ /rjes dpag tshad mas gzhal ba 'dis kyang ngo / /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing 'brug lor bris pa'i chab sna(ga 'phrin yig khag /sngon du lung bstan gyi bskul ma (153na)byas pa bzhin shing 'brug hor zla dang po'i nang du tshangs pa dung thod can gyis lkog gyur dngos su ston pa 'i shog khra dang bcas rdo rje'i gsung 'phrin lan gling bzha skad cig myul ba'i gnya snyan/ dkar po tshangs pa'i rigs kyi lha/ /skabs 'gar li byin ha ra'i mtshan/ /rnam sprul cir yang ston mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje'i gsung 'phrin lha dang son/ khams gsum skye 'gro'i lus ngag yid/ /spyod tshul lkog gyur gnas lugs tsho kun/ /dri med rnam dag spyan ras kyis/ /gsal ler gzigs pa'i mngon shes mkhan/ /bod dang bod chen rgyal khams kyis/ / dbus dang phyogs mtshams 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /blang dang dor bya'i lung bstan gyi/ /tshig 'phreng ri mor 'khod 'di spro/ /lhun po gling bzhir bcas pa rnams/ /skad cig myul ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bder rab spel ched/ /g.yel med bya ra mdzad de legs/ /lha gcig srong btsan skyes lha che/ /de'i bstan yun ring gnas byed par/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpung skyed ces/ /zhal gyis 'ches la bdag yi rang / /'ja' tshon lta bur rnam bkra ba'i/ /snya na shal gser skyems zho gsum grang / /rgya ja lo ma'i bam po can/ /sngags rgyas nam mkha' mdzod —436

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pedu spel/ /thub bstan spyi dang btsong kha pa'i/ / chos srid nyi zla zung 'brel rgyas/ /'jig rten khams kun bde skyid ldan/ /bdag gi bsams don lhun grub mdzod/ /chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan grags pa'i bsti gnas 'ol kha rin cen sgang nas 'phyong rgyas ri bo bde chen gyi mkhan zur pa grags pa don ldan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang mkhasang 'a gyis ring por 'tsho ba'i rten 'byung gi dngos po dang bcas 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan shes bya'i mtha' 'jal ring(153ba)po'i mig dkyus/ shā ta bi rla 5/ 〉 bā ka rā gar+bha sa kā la cas bhā ba ba khyuḥ/ /bā khyu ti bha do tsa shā tā ྅ kho mi tra ba ta rnyi yu la kha yo rgya/ /thos (sdeb sbyor rma bya'i 'gros/)brtson drod kyis smin pa'i gser mngal las/ /mtha' klas shes byar srid pa'i rig byed kun/ /smra ba'i spobs pa ches mtho'i gdong bzhi pa/ /bshes gnyen mes po'i blo can 'phrin rten son/ /sbyangs stobs yon tan phung por brtsegs pa dang / /lhan cig bgrang bya'i khur lcis na smin kyang / /cha mnyam 'byung lnga'i na chur dge ba'i glu/ /lhag bsam mgrin par len pa'i gtam de snyan/ /lus brtas mig mi 'dzum la phrag dog pa/ /'khor ba'i las rkyen zug rngu lha min dpung / /mchog gsum dbang phyug mda' yis mthar byas te/ /dbus 'gyur 'chi med 'dun sar dngos cag bde/ /'di na dam par zhal 'che'i rdzun thob kyis/ /gzhan slu'i khas len skal par thob min kyang / /don ldan rten bzang tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon/ /ji bzhin gnas par mi smon shes ldan su/ /deng dus gangs can dpal (154na mo'i bzhin ras ngos/ /mdo rgyud tha snyad rnam bkra mig gi dkyus/ /ring pos lnga rig pha mtha' gzhal byed pa/ /bshes gnyen khyod las gzhan du ngas ma rnyed/ /sdig pa'i dri bral gang blo 'phrog byed rkang / /bag yos mtho ris chu gos rtser bkod pas/ /blun sgom phyag rgya'i sbyin skyes dogs bral zhing / /rang bstan sum rtsen rgyan du lha rnams dga'/ /zhwa ser mnabs pa'i ring lugs chu 'dzin dbus/ /mkhas nyid legs bshad dbyar rnga'i da dir la/ /skal bzang rma bya brod pas gar bsgyur kyang / /blo rtul ngur ba'i tshogs la dga' ba ci/ /rigs dang skye brgyud btags ming chu shing la/ /bstan 'dzin snying por re ba'i rmongs dad kyis/ /thos bsam 'bras smin dpyod ldan a ma'i tshal/ /—437—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'ador ba'i bod rgan rang mtshang dgod re bro/ /theg pa'i gol ra grangs nges bcu gnyis khyim/ /ma 'dres sgang gshong rgyu ba'i tsha zer can/ /gsung rab gling bzhi snang khyod ring 'tsho ba/ /nges par don dang ldan phyir de don sgrubs/ /'phags yul kha spu can rnams zab mo'i don/ /dpyad nas bsgoms pas grub pa'i sar gshegs kyi/ /da dung thos bsam tshul la yid gzhus sa tshe/ /'ja' lus sa la mngon sum rgyu ltar rnyed/ /rtag tu gang gi grags snyan 'gro 'ong dang / /chabs cig mol mchid si rgyu'i spun zla yi/ /tshul der gcig tu dkar ba'i kun rtog thags/ /sna tshogs bkod pa'i ri mo gsal 'di'o/ /'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba ngam ring mkhan chen tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyis ring por 'tsho ba'i rten 'byung gi bdog pa dang bcas snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan ngang pa'i bu mo'i mgrin rnga/ /(154bka dharmo pa : ra wa ta ro da lha no ma ti ༷ pyu ra tā bi tsho : khya da shu ba du shu ra sa sa bhāṣa yi pra ga ta ta sto ma u pā byu yo skre shi tā ka ra ma ṇi ba ya ni ka le na /chos (sdeb sbyor dbyid kyi thig le/)phung rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i blo gros rdzings/ /brtson 'grus rlung gis mang thos rin cen gling / /rab bgrod legs bshad nor bu'i 'byung khung can/ /mkhan chen 'jig rten mig gcig der springs pa/ /'jam dpal ral gris rgya bral mgrin pa'i mdar / /rnam grol longs spyod 'khor lo'i rdzing bu sa /dbyangs can ngang pa'i bu mo 'jo sgeg can/ /phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs 'khrol ba'i 'phrin rten son/ /'khor ba'i nags khrod bsod nams sha snyi gas/ /bskyed bsrings mngon mtho'i rten bzang sa srungs bu/ /mkhas btsun bzang por grub pa'i gom stabs kyis/ /tshul des ring por bder 'tsho don dang ldan/ /'di na shong dpang bstan pa'i chu gter che/ /ma smad sbyangs stobs khyab 'jug sgyu thabs kyis/ /lnga rig zil dngar blo gros za ma tog /'khyil ba'i (155na sgom dpyod gzhan la mi smon tsam/ /nges 'byung brang steng srubs las skyes pa'i me/ /'dod sred rgya mtshor chags bral pha mtha' na/ /bag med tshang tshing bsreg pa'i rgod ma kha/ /thar pa'i mkha' la snyeg 'bad nyid du 'khum/ /sna tshogs 'phro 'du'i sems kyi ri gzar chu/ zhes bzhin rigs kyis gyen bzlog gnas cha'i mtshor /—438

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ḍa'arnam rtog rlabs bral ting 'dzin stims klas khyod/ /dpe zla gangs can grub ris rnams kyis min/ /chos dang gang zag bdag lta ri bo'i rkang / shes rab rdo rje rtse brgyas rab bcom ste/ /gnas lugs mthong ba'i bslab gsum dbang po nyid/ /zhwa zer mnabs pa'i bstan la mdzes pa'i rgyan/ khri/da lnga'i lam 'khyams sgrib pa'i lus can bdag /tshe byin brlabs zhes rdzun 'drid gzhan khrel rgyu/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i zla tshes skyabs 'gro'i zhag /thabs kyis bgrod pas 'chi med cha shas 'gengs/ /drin las rang bdes gus par dad pa'i sgro /btags ming rgyu mtshan shes nas dga' ldan bstan/ /snying dbus skyong khyod yun 'tsho'i thabs bsten nas/ /da dung 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba sgrubs/ /bod 'bangs nyes brgya'i dug gzhil bde skyid chab/ /yan lag brgyad du sgyur byid ṛ ṣi nga / /mol mchid gaṅgā rna bar 'dzin pa la/ /bgrang bya'i khur gyis mi lci rtag tu bde/ /gzhung lugs bye bas spobs mtho'i lus brtas shing / /ris med 'gro la rjes chags mchu sgros dmar/ /lhag bsam mdangs ldan pañca li da'i gos/ /gyon te gangs can phur bu'i 'dun sar song / /yar klung bying pa bde legs shar 'ol kha stag rtse'i rdzong sdod skabs kyi 'phrin lan dge bstan snying dbus 'chang ba'i bden (155bgi to/ ā dzi rwa 5 nu bha sa dz+nyā tswa ni rta byu swā ma me tri ka li bha rma mā na ṭa ka /ās mā dza sga : gyu 2 mo khri pa la khyuḥ su pra gi ya tha la swā ya :tsa/ /rgyal (sdeb sbyor me tog 'phreng can/sko/na mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang gzugs rnams/ /rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i zlos gar can/ /kun 'dus kha sbyor bdun ldan btsong kha pa/ /dge legs char gyis khyod la shis pa stsol/ /zhwa ser bstan la gcam bu tsam min par/ /snying gi 'dab stong rnam par ba 'ad pa'i dbus/ /ma smad dang ba'i ze'u bru g.yur za ba/ /bde legs ming can bying ba'i yid rten 'phrod/ /skye mang bsod nams byas pa'i drod gsher las/ /rtsa ba sbom por skyed bsrings mtho ris rten/ /lang tsho'i yal 'dab rgyas pa a mra'i ljon/ /dge tshogs 'bras bu'i dud pa'i gtam de spro/ /chos brgyad thig le mchog mar chags pa'i gdong / /gzhan phan rig byed bzhi yi 'byung gnas zhes/ /'dod yon gnyis la rtag g.yur tshangs 439

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyepa'i spun/ /'di na bla chen tshul gyis rang (156nasgo go bskor/ /laṅka'i grong khyer kha ba'i sman ljongs su/ /'phos 'dra mkha' la snyeg pa btsan rdzong de/ /gnam bskos rgyal po'i lung bzhin mi yi rjer/ /snyem pa'i khur chen ring por bstan par rigs/ /srid pa'i tshang tshing sdug por las shugs kyis/ /tsher rnon yid la zug rngu'i ri gzar ngos/ /ldog pa'i chu bo srid de steng gnon rdo/ /mang zhig rlung gis g.yeng ba bya sgro'i skyon/ /'byung zhabrugs tsha grang nad kyi gnyen po'i sman/ /rang byung khrus kyi rdzing bu grangs med pa/ /sprul zhid lta na sdug mtshungs 'ol kha der/ /yun du lus zungs bde thabs zhan la 'grub/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pas/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhal gzigs 'gro ba mdzad/ /gsang gsum 'khor los byin rlabs ngo mtshar gnas/ /'og min zhing gi dpe zla grangs las 'das/ /bar 'dir sa yis ring por bskal min pas/ /re zhig phyogs der sgo gsum ngal gsos te/ ta shog bu'i lam du ka 'phrong gaṅgā 'a rgyun/ /don rlabs yol ba med la klan ka su/ /yid srubs sde bcas mig gis bzod min pas/ /gzhom med lnga ldan ye shes rdo rje'i khams/ /ting 'dzin dus mes bzhu blug gur khyim dbus/ /rang sems dag pa'i dbyings su mos khyod sba/ /rnam 'dren thub pa'i gdung gi sha rī ram/ /mthong bas don ldan yid kyi gdung sel zla/ /sngags mdung rlung gi shing rtas nyer drangs te/ /phan bde'i ga bur gzigs ma 'phro 'di mtshar/ /mdo sdud pa/ byams chos/ sde tshan bdun pa/ gces bsdus kyi glegs bam rnams bshus zin pa'i ma dpe mang thos ru thog dbang po la phyir bskur skabs bsrangs pa'i 'phrin yig drang srong kun (156bskyo dga' ba'i gar/ ro gaḥ shu ṣ+ṭhaḥ shu ཿ su m+bhaṇa 1 4 khri : rdu sna jo pra bhā PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBPROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBpra ṣa tu sta khri shā ra ku sluḥ ka ṅgā ra/ gangs (sde pa sbyor sna tshogs lha mo/)can lta na sdug pa'i grong khyer du/ /nad sel sman rgyas srog 'tsho'i mchod sbyin mkhan/ /sprul pa'i drang srong yid las skyes kyi spun/ /tshangs rigs 'dzin pa'i dpyod ldan de la springs/ /chos 'bar bsod nams 'bras dud 'du phung nyi/ /zug rngu'i rngul bral ston gyi mkhar shar nas/ /lugs zung snang ba 'bum sde'i tsha zer tshogs/ /lan —44()

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('bargya ra spro ba'i tshul las g.yin du ci/ /'di na mngon par rtogs pa'i zla tshes pa/ /lang tsho'i na tshod ma rdzogs ches phra yang / /gsung rab mang po thos pa'i 'od dkar gzi/ /phyag chen rgan po'i skar tshogs kyis bzod min/ /bshad sgrub shing rta bcu pa'i dpal 'byor la/ /phrag dog dwags
