brgyud laṅka'i grong gnas te/ /zog rdzun mgrin bcu brtsegs pa'i dam bca'i snying / /lkog (157na sgor 'byin pa'i sa lo dga' gyed lha/ /dri bcas bod yul bstan pa'i nyal 'gro kun/ /legs drungs yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo sa /bsgyur la dpyad bzod brgyal brtag ā ga sdu/ /blo bzang grags snyan bstan pa'i mkha' la shar/ /tshul 'chal ngur smig klubs pa 'phyon ma'i gar/ /thos chung grub pa'i sa brnyes mo gsham bu/ /mu lho'i chas kyis 'drid nas thub pa'i bstan/ /snyigs byed dka' thub bsten rnams lhag spyod bzhin/ /'on te mtha' 'khob skyes kyang dbang rnon mthus/ /log pa'i slob dpon ngan pas ma bslad par/ /tshad ldan bstan dang mjal khyod chos pa'i tshul/ /'dzin rlom dal gyi do zla ga la yin/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rten 'brel bcu gnyis las/ /rgyal thabs dbang bzhi'i sa bon rab smin pa/ /rnam grol 'khri shing rtser chags snye ma'i bcud/ /spyod gang blo gros skal pa gcig tu bzang / /don la lta zhog tshig tsam la rdugs pa/ /mi yi sha tshugs can gyis gang mthong tshe/ khres rab rnon po'i ral gris rmongs pa'i rgya/ /bcad khyod yun 'tsho don ldan thabs 'bad rigs/ /chu klung lus phra skad snyan glur len zhing / /gling ldan grogs su dal med rgyu byed na/ /gnyen gshin ri mor spel thogs bya ma rta/ /brjed ngas zam par 'gro 'ong rtag tu bsten/ /skad gnyis shan sbyar gso rig kā la sha/ /rab dkar du kū la yi mgul chings can/ /mdzes rgyan dpag bsam me tog 'dzum pa'i mdangs/ /thun mtshams gzhon nus 'byud pa'i rtse dga' dgod/ /khro mo zhes pa shing pho 'brug gi lo gong nas mchod rten rab 'byams pa dang chos (157ba 'phel dge slong gis gtsos pa'i gser yig pa mngags te bzang kos rin po che'i khyad nor dang bcas bka' shog phebs pa'i lan 'phul bar/ dka' bcu blo bzang bkra shis dang tshe chen dar rgyas gnyis btang ba'i dus phul ba tshangs rigs dgyes zhal 'char ba'i me long / u ri sa ha ka ka—441—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kye3rgya tsa kri ma hā go ba sho ba rte na bu rgya bha bo nyi tshe 'o : co sko dza sha dza skru di pā ༷ smubha ga bu dwa la ཿ de ba su pa dru la ke /rtsibs(sde pa sbyor me tog 'phreng can/sko steng gser gyi 'khor los sa chen por/ /mnga' sgyur bsod nams srid pa'i gtsug tor du/ /mngon par 'phags pa'i dbang phyug 'dzam gling ma'i/ /bzang po'i skal bar nyer thob lha'i zhabs drung / /mi shigs tshe yi g.yung drung khyil ba'i gzhir/ /mtha' yas mtshan dpe'i ngo mtshar rnam bkra'i mthus/ /nor 'dzin skyong bar 'chi med rdo rje yis/ /sra brtan srog gi ka ba tshugs gyur cig /skyob pa de gsung tshul bzhin nyer bsgrub pa/ /dkon cog rin cen rnam gsum thugs rjes (158na bong / /srid pa'i mes po nye dbang mgrin sngon sogs/ /mtho ris bdag pos phun tshogs deng 'dir stsol/ /spobs pa gzengs mtho'i mgrin las su sdi'i glu/ /len pa'i sngon 'gror bkra shis me tog char/ /'bebs shing sa mchog tsan dan bdug spos dri/ /dngar por 'thul dang lhan cig mchid 'di zhu/ /gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis la bar med du/ /springs yig mi 'gyur phyag rgya'i ri mo rnams/ /rab 'bar bka' shog rin cen phyi nang gos/ /bzang po'i rten gyi gnang skyes sug par son/ /lha gcig stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi/ /mgon por tshangs ris grub pa'i tog gyur kyang / /gcig tu dgyes zhal lhug par bdag cag gi /legs byas me long gtsang mar 'char 'di lags/ /'jam mgon 'gro la rjes brtse'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /mang bkur rgyal khab khri la mi lus zol/ /nyer bstan 'phags chen dam par skye rga dang / /na 'chi'i zug rngu tshad mas gzhal nus min/ /'on te gzugs sku brgya phrag nyi ma'i gzi/ /'bar bas dus 'dzin mche ba'i smag rum mun/ /mthar byas 'gro 'di'i mngon sum yul gyur pa'i/ /gtam snyan snying la bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bzhin/ /'di na gle snod gsum par mngon rlom bdag thu kya'i bstan pa thos bsam sgom pa sogs/ /rnam dkar kho nas 'dzin pa'i ngang tshul gyis/ /'tsho ba'i dal 'byor don ldan bsgrub pas g.yeng / /gang gi legs byas snod du srid dang zhi'i/ /yon tan ma lus shong yang snyems bral ba/ /dam pa'i rnam par thar la dad sems ngor/ /kun rtog dra ba mtha' dag gcig tu bsdems/ khyod mtshan sgra 'dzin bu —442

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dzad(158bskor lung tsam gyis/ /lus sems mnar ba'i gdung ba drung 'byin na/ /zhabs rdul gtsug tu cod pan la 'chang tshogs/ /sum rtsen 'dun sa'i dga' ston cis mi myang / /mtho ris them skas la gshegs rang gi rigs/ /mes rnams mkhyen can stong mnga' brgya byin nyid/ /chos nor 'dod thar zhal bzhi'i mchu sgros 'dab/ /'dzum pa'i sa 'di tshangs pa nyid min su/ /phra mor mi brnyas mdzangs mkhas dkyel che'i blo/ /drang srong phur bu'i khengs pa 'phrog nus gang / /gzhan 'phrul bdag po'i dmag la ba spu'i rtse/ /mi 'gul dpa' zhing rtul phod khyed kho na/ /btsan po'i las zhugs dar la drag pa'i rjes/ khams gsum snod kyi dngos po yod do cog /'brangs na lus can yongs kyi yan lag lnga/ /sa la reg pa'i phyag gis cig mi brel/ /rig sngags log pa'i rtsod dus ro langs ma/ /'gro ba'i bde 'phrog chom rkun ming tsam yang / /mi grag gling bzhi'i mi rnams phan tshun yid/ /gnyen gshin gsar pa'i rdzogs ldan nyid kyis sprul/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za grul bum sogs/ /rgyal khab chab sgor pus btsugs thal sbyar gtam/ /thos tshe sa yis bskal yang lta 'dod blo/ /dbang phyogs 'dun sa che der lan brgyar brgyugs/ /rtsod ldan tshe tshad dzaskru'i snye ma yis/ /chos dkar rgya mtsho'i snying po btungs pa'i 'bras/ /brgyad khrir lha khyod 'tsho zhes gser sbyangs su/ /'gyur bar mchog gsum mthu yis 'grub byin rlobs/ /'jig rten yongs kyis gang la skyabs song na/ /bde skyid mdzad mi shes pa nor bu'i dpya/ /btsan po'i bka' khrims drang thig 'debs pa'i phyag /ring por brkyangs te skye rgu yongs la stsol/ /smra ba lan cig rgyal po'i lung las kyis/ /nub phyogs chos srid bdag por dbang bskur de/ / (159na)gnam gyi she mong mthu yis don ldan gtam/ /spel legs gsar pa'i 'phreng bas gzengs bstod cig /'jam phrug gos mnabs zhu mchid mi na kāḥ /rin cen chas kyis mdzes pa'i 'jo sgeg can/ /rgyud mangs glu las drangs pa'i brjod don tshig /nyams 'gyur stong gi gdangs snyan mgrin par len/ /brtan g.yo kun gyis btung bya'i pho brang du/ /gser 'brug mar gad 'dab rgyas ber klubs tshe/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i dpung pas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /bla nas blar 'degs gru 'dzin rtse nas phul/ /—443

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyenyang stod 'brong rtse lhun grub gling pa'i rig byed pa blo bzang nor bus snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i 'phrin lan drang srong bse ru'i rjes 'gro /da k+ṣi zhe ku spra le shrī wa bi tsā ra la 'a k+ṣa mo rā sa 〈 khu su lha kha she ni/ swa rbani ti thu ku 〉 du / la su rnga se ya na sho tri ta dhi rnyi tswa mu sa ra/ rnam (sdes sbyor me kho phreng can/)dpyod g.yas su 'khyil ba'i mgrin pa nas/ /nyams 'gyur sgra ldan legs bshad 'phrin yig dung / /rten bzang du kū la yi rab dbyangs can/ /rna ba'i bcud du len pa'i glu de snyan/ /(159ba)bgrang bya'i khur gyis mi lci na phra yang / /blo gros rtsal gyis rmongs chen glang gdong mche/ /phyung nas mkhas mang legs bris gsar 'gying khyod/ /zug jus ma gtses bde bar gnas la spro/ /'di na rang phyogs la chen gya gyu'i 'phrul/ /rten 'brel lugs 'byung 'khor bar rtag khrus pa/ /bstan 'gro'i don bor tshul 'chos bla chen spyi'i/ /rang bslu'i rnam thar 'dzin la gcig tu brel/ /chos dkar la goms nya phyis khog yangs por/ /paṇa chen smon 'gro'i gsung rgyun musti ka /thos bsam srad bur brgyus te dpyod ldan gang / /brgyan zhes gtam de rnar gson yid kyi gsos/ /dbyangs can ma la ya rlung reg bya yis/ /mi shes yid kyi gdung bcil sgra don ro/ /brgya phrag snying la bda' ba'i mdza' na mos/ /spobs pa dge ba'i dbang khyod mgrin nas 'khyud/ /ring po'i sa sa bskal la gnas shes ldan gang / /kun rtog ri mor bris tshe nyer gnas blos/ /blta 'dod mig dbang phyogs su bgrad byas kyang / /'khrul pa'i rang snang mngan sum ston pa bzhin/ /'di nang sgrub don grong tshig zla zer gyis/ /rtog ge sgom chen kun+da'i kha 'dzum yang / /blo gsal snying gi ba kū la 'byed pa'i/ /gtsug lag 'gram chang g.yin na brin mkho chung / /sgrib pa'i lus can bdag 'drar gsol 'debs pa/ /zas gcod me lnga bsten pa'i drang srong ltar/ /ngal brgya'i dka' thub len tsam las gzhan du/ /'bras bu e raṇ+ḍa yi snying po bzhin/ /'on te skyas thob tshe 'dir sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /mgrin pa'i mdud grol las 'ongs tshigs su bcad/ /rdul phran lhun por sgro 'dogs snyan ngag lugs/ /(160na than phyir mkhas nyid re ba stong ched spel/ /da dung mtha' med shes bya go la'i khyon/ /blo gros shing rta bdun pas legs gzhal zhing / /phyogs 'dir sgra —444—

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dza)'dzin 'dab stong bzhad byed pa'i/ /ra byung tshig don snang 'od spror ma ngal/ /mig rgyang ring pos btsal kyang deng gi dus/ /bcu phrag rig gnas la mos khyod tsam las/ /ma rnyed tshul der rab dkar dngas pa'i blo/ /zla zhun thags kyi ri mo 'dis kyang mtshon/ /shing 'brug tor zla dgu pa'i nang du tshangs pa dung thod can gyi sku khog dang tsher gseb bla ma gnyis rdzong sta mdzad pa'i blang dor gyi rdo rje'i gsang 'phrin byung ba'i lan dang / dogs sel du lo de'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i lha tshes la byang sgrom pa spyan gzigs tshogs 'khor dang bcas rdzong sta byas skabs 'phrin du gsol ba the tshom mdud 'grol/ srid gsum zil gnon he ru ka /pad+ma thod 'phreng spyan snga sa /zhal bzhes lha chen tshangs pa yi/ /rdo rje'i gsung 'phrin sug par son/ /gang der gsal ba'i spyi sgos kyi/ /blang dang dor bya'i rim pa rnams/ /le lo'i dbang du ma gyur par/ /myur 'grub nyer bsdogs skabs su gnas/ /cung zad dpyod par ma shes pa'i/ /the tshom mdud pa 'grol slad dang / /lkog gyur gnas 'ga' 'dri ba la/ /bya ma rta ni ched du mngags/ /g.yar dam rdo rje'i ra ba las/ /nam yang 'da' ba med pa'i phyir/ /dregs pa'i dbang phyug che khyod kyis/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis sgrubs/ /spyan gzigs tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs/ /dngos bshams mchod pas nyer mtshon pa/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs te/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye phul/ /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing sbrul lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag /grwa sdings po che'i sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos/ shing sprul lo gsar phul ba'i snyan tshig gi lan gser dang ra gan dbye ba'i me long / (160ba) bi tsā ra tā tsa kra ཿ ni nā yi si rnyo dhi swā bha hā khyi 'i 9 86 pa nāye/ la sa mya k+ṣa rā the ba ti gi phya ga bre ma dhe rā sa ta di lha lco sa su myo/ rnam (sdeb sbyor lag 'gro lhung ba/dpyod tshangs rigs grub pa'i blo gros kyis/ /dbyangs can rgyud mangs gdangs las —445

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)nyer drangs pa/ /'phrin yig shis brjod glur len rab snyan sgra /rmad byung dus kyi thog mar 'brol de 'jibs/ /legs smon bden tshig bdog pa'i lde mig gis/ /yongs yod phun tshogs rten cing 'brel 'byung sgo /sum ldan 'byung ba'i brang 'gro mar gad gos/ /klubs pa'i gnam lo'i rang zhal ngoms tshe 'grig /mang por bsags pa'i tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i mngal/ /smon lam ri dbang bsgril las nyer 'thon pa/ /'du phung nyi ma grung ris mkha' dkyil du/ /rtag shar nges don 'dab brgya bzhad de spro/ /'di na chos nor 'dod dang thar pa'i sgo/ /ris med kun la gtong ba lhag pa'i sems/ /rab dkar kha ba'i (161na)sa 'dzin rjes 'gro las/ /ma smad lugs brgya'i gaṅgā chad med 'bab/ /sgom par mos pa tshul 'chos rlom pa'i dri/ /rnam dag gzur gnas gang blo'i shel bum las/ /phyi nang gtsug lag /legs bshad rnyog med klung / /sbrengs 'di gangs can bstan pa'i 'khas su bsil/ /ma yengs dam bca'i ri dwags rjes bsnyegs pas/ /mtha' bral gnas lugs sī ta ma zin kyang / /ka tsan 'phong gis 'tsho ba'i dpyod ldan can/ /ra :'i bu nyid rmongs chen laṅka'i gshed/ /sgrib gnyis 'ching rgya grol ba'i rang rig rtsal/ /spang rtogs yon tan rdzogs pa rdo rje sems/ /rang zhal rjen par mthong min de srid du/ /rnam rtog chos skur sems pa log shes tsam/ /'on te chos kun sems nyid gcig pu yi/ /mngon nga/ra 'phrul las nges rnyed phyag rgya'i lam/ /mda' bsnun bzhed gzhung nyams su rab bstar nas/ /gzhan la ston pa'i tshul der cis mi rang / /srid zhi'i dge legs chu bo mtha' klas pa/ /'du ba'i mang bkur pho brang chen po 'dir/ /bgrang bya gsar tshes mdzad mtha' min de srid/ /kun dga'i zlos gar 'chad med sgyur cig gu/ /legs sbyar skad las bsgrubs pa su sti'i tshig /skye ba lnga pa'i dung gi sgrar drangs te/ /dkon cog mthu yis dus kun bde legs su/ /spel bar smon de khyod la shis gyur cig /don bzang lang tsho dar drag lus phra ma/ /snyan tshig mgrin pa'i dril chung legs 'khrol ba/ /rab dkar thags bzang du kū la gyon nas/ /dge dbang ngur smrig gos can 'dun sar song / /shing sgrul zla ba dang po'i nang du/ bsam yas nas bstan srungs gnod sbyin chen pos rdo rje'i gsung 'phrin byung (161ba)bar/—446

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pedogs sel gyi dris rmed dang bcas spyan gzigs kyi mchod sprin gya nom pa spros te byis pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse btang skabs gsung lan yid gnyis mdud grol/ gzhes zhig bral ba gsang gsum rdo rje'i khams/ /mtsho skyes sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul rol gar mkhan/ /brtul zhugs grub pa pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid des byin phobs/ /gang thugs bde stong zung 'jug dwangs ma'i rtsal/ khrag 'thung dpal chen che mchog skur shar ba/ /bde gshegs zhi khro kun 'dus bka' brgyad ltar/ /mchod bstod dregs pa'i srung ma chen po yi/ /dri med dmar zlum spyan gyi me long ngos/ shes byar srid pa'i chos kun yongs shar bas/ /'byung 'gyur lung du ston pa rdo rje'i tshig /dbyar rnga ltar sgrog gsung 'phrin 'byor bas spro/ /zab gsang blo yis gzhal bar nus min dang / /rtogs par sla yang dpyod par ma shes so/ /som nyi'i dri ba zhib cha g.yar lam nas/ /gsol ba ji bzhin the tshom mdud pa khrol/ /gangs kyis bskor ba'i spur rgyal bod yul 'dir/ /mtha' dbus lha 'dre'i gdug rtsub kha rlangs kyis/ /mi phyugs nad rims tshog rtsod 'tshe ba kun/ /zhi zhing phan bde'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod/ khyad par rig sngags 'chang ba bdag cag gi /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /sgrub la bstan bsrung gnod sbyin chen po khyod/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i dbang po'i mched slar mdzod/ /bkras btags gser skyems rgya ja phyi nang gos/ /rno ngar mtshon cha rlung gi shugs 'chang rta/ /tshogs 'khor dngos 'byor mchod dang ting 'dzin gyis/ /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye phul/ /khro phu slob dpon ngag dbang bstan 'dzin (162na ne bang pos snyan ngag gi 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan phur bu'i skrun zlar sgrog pa'i pi wang / rā pā :ñcakra ka ra ka dha : do ku ma shī ta : du ga pu sto/ bru ཿ le 'a k+ṣa razi tsa ro t+ta tsa ma stu dza na ba ta u lte/ sa(sdos sbyor myos ma/)zla'i 'khor lo lnga ldan spyi blugasa'achang / /dkar 'jam du kū la yi gos gyon pa/ /rnam dpyod yangs pa'i 'phrin yig tshangs pa'i bu/ /dbus 'gyur swā la'i sman gyi ljongs su son/ /de tshe ring goms khyod blo'i gangs ri las/ /nyams dang 'gyur ba stong ldan gaṅgā'i klung / /lci yang sdeb sbyor dbu ma'i 'phreng mdzes can/ /gtsug lag chu gter —447—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyechen po'i slong du babs/ /'dod khro gti mug gis sbar zug rngu'i mes/ /lus sems ljon pa'i sdong bu ma bsregs shing / /'dab rgyas me tog g.yur du za ba'i rtser/ /legs bshad 'bras bzang dud pa'i gtam de snyan/ /'di na nges legs nyin byed 'bod 'dod pa/ /srid zhen cha phra'i skya rengs 'char rtsom yang / /don med mtshan rum g.yeng ba gnyid po cher/(162ba) /g.yur ba'i ngang tshul 'di la rang zhe khrel/ /mkhas nyid rnam dpyod dzam+bha'i snye ma yis/ /btungs pa'i lnga rig rgya mtsho chen po kun/ /dpyad gsum dag pas gser du bsgyur ba'i rgyan/ /rang ris blo gsal yongs kyi rna bar mdzes/ /mi shis gdol gtam rnyog pa'i dri 'byud pa/ /gtsug lag mtho ris chu bo a lha'i rgyun/ /grub ris pad dkar mig gi zhabs bsil bar/ khyod min skal ldan shing rta dmigs su med/ /phyi dul tshul 'chos lus kyi lha lam ngos/ /chags sdang sgang gshong go lar kun rtog zla/ /dal med rgyu bas gtan bde 'dab brgya'i kha/ /zum byed bsam gtan pa'ang 'phyon ma'i gar/ /rags pa'i 'gyu ba bag la nyer zhi bas/ /gcig tu yengs 'dra'i sems kyi gnas cha la/ /zhi lhag zung 'brel mnyam par bzhag rlom yang / /srid rtse'i ting 'dzin thob pa'i lhag spyod bzhin/ /mang thos spobs pa'i kha 'phang mthon po yis/ /legs nyes rnam par dbye ba'i mig bgrad nas/ /bltas kyang deng dus gangs can ra ba 'dir/ /gnas lnga rig pa khyod las ngas ma rnyed/ /shong dpang shing rta bcu pa'i rigs kyi bu/ /brda sprod 'phong gis 'tsho ba'i dpyod ldan gang / /log rtog laṅka'i mgrin pa bcad pa'i gtam/ /sum rtsen dbang po'i 'dun sar lha rnams gleng / /'on te tha snyad chu yi zla gzugs bzhin/ /tshur mthong byis blo brid pa'i sgyu ma'i gar/ /dpyad de rang sems 'di la gcer bltas tshe/ /brjod bral gnyug ma'i gnas lugs las ma mthong / /da dung 'phags yul kha spu can rnams kyi/ /tshul bzhin mang por thos don legs bsam na/ /ma smad thar pa'i khang bzang nyams dga' bar/ /gtan bde ro brgya'i phun tshogs g.yang zhig chags/ /ma 'ongs dbus (163na7gyur 'chang du mi pham mgon/ /mgon de mngon sum byon dang mtshungs pa'i sku/ /sku brnyan mthong bas don ldan dus rnams kun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin spro khyod skal bzang dpyid/ /rten —448

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('a'abrel lugs 'byung 'khor ba sgrib lus can/ /bdag 'dra skye 'chir rang dbang ma thob kyang / /'dren rlom chen po phal gyi rnam thar bzhin/ /sgrub ces gcam bur smra ba'i g.yar dam 'cha'/ /blo gsal kun la skyes su nyer 'os pa'i/ /sgra don snyan 'gyur tshig la zad pa'i mtha'/ /med phyir 'phrin yig cha shas yongs gang zla/ /pho nya rlung gi shing rtas chad med drongs/ /rgyud mangs sgra las dam pa'i chos kyi gtam/ /rab drangs tshig don snyan 'jibs glur len pa/ /dri za'i gar mkhan dmar 'jam stod g.yogs can/ /blo ldan phur bu gnyis pa'i mdun sar song / /mchims phu brag dmar rong btsan gyis yang 'gyur lung bstan dang bcas mthun rdzas dgos tshul gyi gsung 'phrin byung ba'i lan las bzhi lhun grub/ gangs can lha gcig khri srong lde'u btsan gyi/ /skyes lha brag btsan rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /stong gsum skad cig myul ba'i dpa' bo che'i/ /rdo rje'i gsung gi 'phrin yig sug par son/ /ngan g.yo'i sems kyi rtog pa 'og 'gyu'i 'phrul/ /rtsub sbyor thags su 'thag la g.yel med du/ /dus kun dmar zlum spyan gyis nyer gzigs nas/ /lkog gyur mngon sum ston la rjes yi rang / /bde ldan zhing gi mgon po snang mtha' yas/ /mtsho skyes sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul rol gar mkhan/ (163ba)pad+ma thod 'phreng dam las mi 'da' bar/ /bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs rgyas pa'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ khyad par gangs can ljongs 'di'i bde skyid rnams/ /spel 'dod bdag gi rab dkar lhag pa'i sems/ /bsam pa ji bzhin zhi rgyas dbang drag kun/ /lhun gyis sgrubs shig dregs pa'i dmag dpon kye/ /lha dar gser skyems sgra snyan mdung dmar dang / /sga srab kyis mdzes cang shes la sogs pa/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mthun pa'i dam rdzas kyis/ /sgo lnga dgyes pa bskyed pa'i ched du spel/ /0pa ring mkhan chen lo tsā ba tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyis ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung tshan grangs dang bcas 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan gnas tshul gsong por smra ba'i gto/ twa da nā dhi ka su su bo dhi sa twa na/ dzu la sa ra ma khyu ya : bhaṭa ḍa ka ma hā mi tri ka ku mu t+ta ma dzi rta dha smo sa da snu mi ka ma ho pa khyu yi ka lo kā rmadi/ bdag pas g.yin gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems bzang pos/ rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i dbus na —449

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shemangon par 'phags pa'i bshes gnyen chen po gzhen nu rgyal mchog gi chos kyi gdan sa pa mkhan chen 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu skad gnyis smra ba gang / (164na tshe rgya k+ta yaḥ no/ ro pa 〉 pu na rayi ba nyu 2 bha rba sha ta da ḍa sgyu ga ༷ taḥ shu ཿ shī la slo ta ga mi na ye k+ṣa ma bri klo sgyun pra dz+nyā shi su bhū ta ba rnyu bhaḥ a ga la/ ring min gyi char yang yang srid mang por nyes brgya'i dri mas ma sbags pa' tshul khrims dag pa'i zhing sar sbyin gtong bzod brtson bsam gtan dang shes rab kyi tshul la goms pa'i sa bon yongs su btab pa dri med smon lam chu lud/ bra dha ṇa gi rosmra no tu da na su sa ཿ ha ga lha : ri ga sa rlu rmi sa mā ni sto gsu tsa r+ya/ : sa hi ta tritsa kra su su pha la pa ri gu ru// a rga la zla ra ta ma tho/ drod gsher gyis bskyed pa'i 'du phung gi myu gu g.yur du za zhing / tshangs par mtshungs par spyod pa'i slob dpon 'dus grwa rnams dang chabs cig par 'khor lo gsum gyi 'bras bzang yongs su dud pa nas/ don rgyan gyi lam nas drangs pa'i 'phrin gcig yun ring por brtan (164bar ya su le 'a k+ṣa ra di : rka la ti — / a the bad tsi tu she ta ni to sa su ba rta tu lu tsa kra :: te na no na sha na yu khya ma na so : ṣarka sgru ti/ a smi nyam khyu de sha sto ṭa pa khu : rla spru la sa ma/ par gyur cig pa'i shis pa brjod pa'i rten du bkras btags su war+ṇa srang gi 'khor lo dang bcas pho nya bas nyams med du bgrod pa yid kyi sman yon du gyur/ 'di na'ang 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub ris su ma chad pa'i gzhung lugs la spyod pa'i klog pa mkhan du gnas/ yo sto gsu pa sgo ko pa ju yi ti ma mu ni rwa tsa nag snyi ra gu sta ga sa ru dri ta sa rba dz+nyā ma dz+nyā shrī ga lha na mu khyi sa pra ba tsa na 4sta parda/ ā gi ka da sha : khya rba ba shrī dha shā ku nya sgo ta bu ji ba/ ma thub gsung zab gsang gi mdud rgya kun mkhyen 'jam dpal snying pos bkrol ba'i gsung rab la brten nas/ dal 'byor don ldan du sgrub nus kyi go yul khong du chud kyang / bla chen spyi'i zog chos brgyad g.yeng ba'i khol por mdzad pas/ gtan 'dun 'grub pa sogs/ (165na/hā gu rus mā rgya su rke nā gi n+ta rma tā swā—450

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa ra bo snyan rgyud mang / (se/ dwa sa 'i ye na/ pa bla ya rba si sgrud mu sa swā nā rba ma ha ta ya na swā pa/ a tra 2 khye nar hi na sa ka la ga grwa ba 6 ha ma dhi ka dha ra pra da ga ni 3 lu ste na/ dgos don che bar ma mchis kyang / tshur mthong gi mchog dman mtha' dag mgrin gcig par bdag gces 'dzin lhur len pa ngang tshul yin pas/ ring por 'tsho thabs la 'dun brtson nan ltar 'gyid cing / nyid cung zhig bro 'tshal par le lor ma lus pa'i myur du gzhil/ di ( 5 rba ze ta smon bi rli ka ka ro mi/ twam lnga ro gya ma la she no gta sa tā ra sha sa bye ba rli ka ga sa sko te yuḥ nā di ba spra raṇi/ tsi tu ra k+ṣa ga tshoḥ ma rta ga nu / la ba sta : sa hi ti bi sha kha su pra dz+nyā pa k+ṣa bha drati tho li khri rta/ byed la brtson pa dang / mol mchid gaṅgā'i klung ltar 'tshal/ rten bsrung mdud/ rung mthun gyi gos dang bcas nam thong gi zla ba'i shes rab phyogs kyi bzang po'i tshes la bris/'bras ri bo che nas/ stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub kyis chagashog phebs pa'i lan ri bo rlung gisabaskul dka'i bden gtam/ (165ba〉pa hā shu rgyu nye ka mu 1 ni ka tra sa rba dha ཿ rmu dri ta tu ya dud ya dha rma kā ya ga mā : ku rba na ha ra na rti ka shrī ba ra 1 si dha 〉 dha rmi ga su ༷ r+bheya : rnyu bha ṭa nā ka : : de sha ra sne/ a sgyu ra shu bha pya pa spu ྅ mi pa bla snya/ ga zheme ka : bu — 'i nā di pa ra mi tā ga ṇa ga lham ga to pa swā sgyu na ni mi sto da ha ra phyashrī tha la tā rāpā rgyu ba bha sa ma tri bha rte tu sgru kho/ ṣaṇ+ḍa shā ba ya ba to ba tsa ne na 3 leno tshe / dza ga nā mi khya ḍa phu re/ yi — sgo :ku/ stong chen phyag rgya gcig gis chos kun cig car rgyas btab ste gang shar chos sku'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar mkhan dpal phag mo gru pa'i ring lugs pa kun gyi gtsug na mngon par mtho ba rje btsun stag lung rin po cher/ ring min gyi dge ba'i char yang mtha' slas pa'i bskal par lan gcig ma yin par goms pa'i spyin sogs pha rol du phyin pa'i tshogs kyi phung po chen pos nye bar bsgrubs pa'i mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba'i sku gzhan snang tsam du yang zo mdog bde/ yan lag drug cu ldan pa'i gsung gis ris su ma chad pa'i/ (166na)na bha ba sha—451—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)n+ta su su na dharma nas ka la no rā ga lhan pa ti shu ti sum na shu ska2sheṣa pa/lortadha na ṅgā pa hā tiṣ+ṭha rta ma nu gi ni nā/gu ru bkrabs swā mas tsa tu:ga mibar+ṣas rab da rtan/gdul bya rnams kyi re ba skong /dri bral mkhyen pa'i spyan gyis srid zhi'i gnas lugs mtha' dag chags thogs mi mnga' bar gzigs te spyi dang /khyad par mdo stod nor 'dzin gyi char 'khod pa'i yid can rnams kyi mgon dang brling dang dpung gnyen du bsdu ba/dwa dz+nyā k+ṣa bcecus hi ta yu lte na ma no ha ta ka lha rta/a smin pi ta spro ba ro bāka su bdan ti shālhan sti tsatri ba lo nā:dwa hu shu shu te〉su dhi yuwaṇi kā la pusta ka siñca dhi ma treteng/u pa pak+ṣita dhe|shrī/rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel ba nas bka' tham rten ldan phebs pa yid kyi sman yon du gyur/'di na'ang rgyud thog tu smin pa'i myong ba rngo thogs pa cung zad ma mchis kyang skom pa ba tshwa'i chu bzhin mang por thos 'dod kyi blos yig nag gi dpe gsog/(166ba)ma t+pa/la ka su shā sa nan sha bṛḥto ma hormi kar sde sham tru rdus dha na:kā la su sgrubo ga tre ṇak+ṣa ya to3hiXyu shā ba bhasnro la kā rgyus tu3ta pa/pu rbemahā gi ro ha to ka ti bidza hā rāstu di rā2tsa/pa tsam du gnas nye char phyogs der dpal ldan thang pa'i bstan pa nyams gsos kyi rlabs chen mdzad pa'i cha shas tsam las ma zin cing dus kyi nges pa zhag gis zad pa'i dgongs pa som nyir gyur tshul ci ste med par gyur na'ang /snga sor re bo cher gshegs shing ji tsam bzhugs chog pa sogs rgyal po/k+ṣatri yadi bha tar mu1phal twamasmusde shana3ta dharma ṅgā stobako kritab spyi rāXzhi ta di tsa s+thā bha ri ta/kurba gam+bharakwa sha hri to ṅgā toko spo ta sgyu k+ṣa de ya meḥbhā ra gaṅgā yuḥn di bskus dang hong tha'i ji mched gnyis la mol pa'i 'bras bu las 'di nas rang dbang du gyur pa ma yin pa chos dbyings su gcags pa bzhin da lam gyi dus 'gyang ba sogs kyang gnas tshod de ltar du gnang ba zab gsal thugs kyi slong du gcags pa'i bka' gnang pheX tshogs gaṅgā 'a klung ltar zhu/rten gos yug dang /

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('a(167na〉mi khya pa ṭa skrur la nge sa khyu rta/ bi shwa ba so sa sba ཿ ra bi sha kha di ga sa spya diya dza me da // bcas/ sna tsho gis dbyig gi lo nam thong zla ba'i dmar cha'i rgyal ba gnyis pa la phu95/rig byed pa blo bzang nor bus/ go dge pa lha rnams la snyan ngag bslabs tshul gyi 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan tshangs dbang dgongs pa dkang bar khegs sgo brjod pa'i dbyangs snya/lha ma rgya ka shrī mā khya ga smi sno 5 ti marnya sgoḥ derwa ga mi rka rma sa bhā ཿ so ni 〈 tsā tu ba sha snya pya mu : bha 0 byu pra / dzā la rwa 'e ri2 4 rta/ cher (sdeb spyor sna mas lha mo/)rlom me khyer 'byug pa gangs ljongs mkhar/ /'jam dbyangasagong ma'i lung las rta bdun pas/ /legs drangs srid zhi'i gtsug na mtho ba'i 'od/ /rab 'bar nyin mor byed pa'i gtam 'di nyon/ /rig byed sbyang stobs brgya byin gtsug tor rtse/ /reg tsam nyid nasacher rmongs mi lus kyang / /skad cig mang thos lhar gyur dpyod ldan gyi/ /rab snyan phang 'gro'i sgra 'brol 'phrin rten son/ /skye mang chos dkar sa bon btab pa las/ /mngon mtho'i myu gu (167ba khor drag stong bu'i rtser/ /yon tan 'bras dud zug rngu'i skyin thang gis/ /gzhom med dbyar gyi lang tsho brtas te spro/ khres byar srid pa'i chu bo gang gi blo'i/ /dzam+bha'i snye mas btungs pa'i phung po rnams/ /brda sprod snyan tshig sa slar yongs smin las/ /legs bshad gtong ba'i sgo brgya 'byed de med / /'gro 'dren phal cher bzang rdzu'i mun khung du/ /nyal tshe rig gzhung sgron me 'degs khyod la/ /blta phyir lha dbang 'dren byed stong sprul bar/ /drang srong dmod pa'i zol gyi mthu yis bsgribs/ /tha snyad spros pa mig sgyu'i cho 'phrul du/ shes nas nang don sī ta 'tshol 'dod pas/ /sgrib gnyis 'bod sgrog mgrin gcod nyer bsdogs la/ /mos nyid snga na med pa'i rā ma ṇa/ /dge sdig spel mar grib bzhin rtag 'grogs gdugs/ /'gro kun bla na dal pa med 'khor kyang / /mngon sum mthong ba'i 'ja' la byisapa ltar/ /so sor 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod mthu phra mang / /tshe ring gnam gyi she mong dpung pa yi/ /rtsod dus gser gyi 'khor los yongs sgyur lha'i/ /lung gis thos don ched 'ongs blo gsal rnar/ /nyams —453

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kye'agyur glu dbyangs rgyud las drangs de 'jibs/ /'dzam gling yongs kyi bsod nams gzugs can bzhin/ /grub pa'i 'jam dbyangs gong ma dgyes bskyed nas/ /lha mig spyan ras kyis btsa'i thabs tshul la/ /'bad pa bstan 'gro'i bde skyid ngal gso'i stegs/ /rnam bkra rig pa dpyid kyi dpal mo'i mngal/ /sbrum pa'i sdebs legs yal gsar pa'i phreng / /mgrin pa'i pad mtshor bskyed pa'i chun po yi/ /do shal ske 'dzin rgyan du (168na)brgyud mar spel/ /nyi zla'i sgron me thogs te lhun po'i spor/ /'dzags nas myul yang shong dpang rjes zhugs sa/ /rnyed dka'i dus 'ar khyod la yi rang blo/ /rab dkar thags kyi du kū la 'dis mtshon/ /shing sprul lo gong nas gdugs dkar lha khang gi sku gnyer sbyor rgya chos rje dang / cha dkar dar rgan chos rje'i dpon po gnyis ka gser yig tu mngags te/ bka' shog 'phrin yig nang spyan bzang po dang bcas phebs pa'i lan 'bul bar/ star sdong dka' bcu blo bzang rab brtan dang / lho ngos rgyas pa gnyis rdzong sta byas skabs phul ba'i zhu yig gnam sa'i bdag por nges brjod gang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs/ tsa tu rdi ba ka le lu ge tsa kra ba rta smo re ga zhi twa bre 〉 tā nā dzu ma se/ bi tso rna/shu khyo sa tsa nga tra zlo ga rta shi ma tā na me ta khru 〉 le/ gling (sdeb sbyor lag 'gro lhung ba/) bzhin rtsod dus 'khor los sgyur ba'i lhar/ /bsams bzhin mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal khab khrir/ /'jam dgon dag zhing them skas las byon pa/ /dpal ldan gong ma chen po'i zhabs drung du/ /(168ba)gcam bus snyan par sgro btags chen po'i ming / /ma yin nges par gnam sa bar med pa/ /bka' 'bangs sgyur la yid ches dang ba'i sems/ /dbang rnon chos kyi rjes su 'brangs te zhu/ /dam pa'i ngang tshul 'phel 'grib med zhal zla/ /rtag tu dgyes pa'i cha shas nya gang las/ /bka' sgo/ga rten ldan ga pur gzigs ma 'bum/ /'phros tshe snying gi kun+da khong nas ba 'ad/ /mngon sum sa la rgyu ba'i bsod nams gzugs/ /ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar sku'i snang brnyan/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i ngo bor lhun grub pa/ /yid can yongs kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag bzhin/ /'di na shākya'i rjes zhugs sdom brtson bdag /lha khyed bka' drin grib bsil la brten ngos/ /'gro la che che/dkar bsam pa ston zla ltar/ /—454

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('gasal ba'i tshul la gcig tu yid dam bca'//dge legs chu gter 'jings zab rgya che yangs//gnam bskos rgyal po'i mtshan nyid ro brgya bro//yon tan zad mi shes pa'i gter chen pos//nga lasanu de gang ga dpe zla bzhin//tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan bka' mchid phang 'gro'i sgra//rtsa ba'i bcud du blangs tshe gdung ba'i tshogs//rab bcil snying la sim pa'i reg bya 'di//bsnyen srid med khyab lha gcig mdzad pa'i gshis//bka' drin dran pa'i lhag bsam gaṅgā'i yab//tshes dkar snying gi dbusasu bag zha ba//sgrib bral mkhyen pas gzhal ba'i ngang tshul 'dis/khyed kyis shes bya thams cad mngon sum gzigs//brlang spyod phyogs su blo lhung bdud kyi sde//kun las rnam rgyal bden pa'i spring yig bka'//nor 'dzin sto bar gnas sgo cog kun gyi//gtsug tor rtse mor ri bo bzhin du brjid//yab gcig skye rgu'i bdag pos 'jig rten khams//mi bdag skal bar sbyin pa'i dbang thang las//snod bcud yongs kyi dngos kun rdzogs ldan dus//gnas 'gyur phun tshogs dga' ston 'di ngo mtshar//skye rga na 'chi'i gnyis 'dzin 'ching rgya las//rnam 169na ) grol 'jam dbyangs mi yi gzugs 'dzin nyid//gzhan snang tsam du gser 'brug ster lnga pas//bteg pa'i khyil bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog/gong gi 'dun sa che nas gangs can bar//sa yi bskal pas ring yang gnyen gshin thugs//brtse bsartag tu mi bskyud bka' gnang tshogs//yan lag brgyad ldan rgyun bzhin 'dzad med zhu//dang ba'i yid ldan lus btud spos bsregs nas//zhu mchid mdongs gsal bdog pa'i skyes phul bar//gnam sa'i dbang phyug spyan ras kyis btsa' ba'i//yid la kun tu dga' ba'i mchog sbyin stsol//khro bu slob dpon ngag dbang bstan 'dzin dbang po zur pa thog thug ma'i rten dang sa byung ba'i snyan tshig gi lan rang grib grogs su 'dzin pa'i tshul lhag par brjod pa/(sneṇa bi muk+ta dzā yakā yasga mo so:ta tshan+da rwa/ken/maḥgadig tra mniXrda/bru6ṇi bī ṇi dza lnga ya ka zhe/mthong sdeb sbyor byed mnya pa'i mit+ta las4nga po'i snang ba/bas rnam par grol ba rgyal ba'i sku//snyan tshig legs sbyar sdeb sbyor shing rta yis//dbus tsā ra kha ba'i ljongs 'dir 'dre/ mkhas khyod//mgrin par dbyangs can rgyud mangs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'akhrol ba bzhin/ /(169ba)mi yi sha tshugs ba lang ltar rmongs pa/ /ma yin gtsug lag bye ba'i cha shas nya/ /yongs gang dal ba'i rten bzang kun+da'i gnyen/ /nyes brgya'i sprin tshogs dang bral gtam de snyan/ /'di na gal chung chos su nyer byas te/ /srid 'byor lhur len bla chen gral tshud kyang / /thos bsam skya rengs kyis drangs bskyed rdzogs lam/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyi 'od mi dman tsam/ /deng dus 'gog pa'i brtul zhugs ltar bcos nas/ /mi tshe stong par yol ba'i nags klung khrod/ /mang thos lo 'bras g.yur za'i yongs 'du gang / /rang gi grib ma tsam la grogs su 'dzin/ /rmongs chen glang po'i mche ba nyer phyung ste/ /legs sbyar cha bsags sgro ldan mdongs mtha' la/ /zhen nas mkhas mang 'chi med gral snyeg pa'i/ /na gzhen blo rgan gdong drug khyod min su/ /dag pa'i lha yi mig dbang nyer bsgrubs nas/ /srid gsum phra rags 'jal ba'i kun rtog blor/ /gnas kyang sgra don snyan ngag smra ba la/ /gang gi dpe zlar 'os pa ngas ma rnyed/ shes bya nam mkha'i mtha' de blo gros bya'i/ /rnam dpyod gshog rlabs zad min bar myul yang / /rtogs pa'i sbal pa phra 'di kun rdzob chos/ /rnam rtog chu gnyer lta bu'i gshis lugs skyon/ /don dam stong chen gcig gis rgyas 'debs grus/ /srid zhi'i chu gter brgyal 'dod ches mang ba/ /phyin drug spyod pa'i skye ba mi ldan na/ /dman lam slong du bskal par 'khor gyi dogs/ /chos brgyad snying la zhen pa'i tshul 'chos kyi/ /'phyon ma'i zlos gar spangs pa mi la rje'i/ /rnam thar bzung na sngon byon grub ris kyi/ /yang dag bstan pa'i bgrang byar ci mi 'os/ /gnyen gshin (170na〉skud kyi gangs can las 'ongs pa/ /legs bshad 'phrin yig yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /mgrin pa'i 'khor lo grol ba'i lam gsum las/ /'bab pa'i rlabs 'phreng nam yang yol med shis/ /rab mdzes du kū la yi re ji can/ /rab dkar lhag bsam mi sgrib gos tsam ste/ /rab yangs blo gros ldan pa'i mkhas rnams la/ /rab 'byams legs bshad phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs snyan/ /—456

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (porab byung bcu gcig pa'i me rta lor bris pa'i chab lha(ga 'phrin yig khag /me rta sdings po che sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos/ gnam lo gsar tshes kyi legs skyes 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan/sgrub pa'i dam 4'a pha rol du phyin par bsngags pa/ grwa ra sa jo ma ru tsi bha r+ṣa ha lwa ṇa ma tho : she ye :〉 ca sa mu dri ka pā la la :/ tsā tu rba se na na ba sgyu ba tsa le na so hi ཿ bhū ཿ su gi tsar ṇa gi ca na zhi ka khru/ rab (sdos sbyor dpyid kyi thig le/ )dmar spu sdug ldan pa gnam lo'i rta/ /bkrashis dge mtshan rgya mtsho'i sga srab can/ /sdo bzhi'i gsar 'gros bang gis phan bde'i sar/ /dkyus thog gcod pa'i thog ma'i dga' ston tshe/ /(170ba)ngag la tshangs dbang sras mo nyer zhugs pa/ /snyan grags phyogs kyi mthar khyab dpyod ldan gyi/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i bi wang las/ /nyamasadang 'gyur ba'i rgyud mangs 'brol te son/ /rtag tu gsong por smra ba'i mthu brtas pa/ /bden tshig grub pa'i shis brjod 'phreng ba dang / /lhan cig bdog pa'i skyes kyi mu tig char/ /'bab pa'i 'khri shing gnyis pa mngon sum bzhin/ /skye bar phyin drug spyod pa'i rgya mtsho che/ /smon lam ri dbang sgril las rab 'thon pa/ /'du phung yongs 'du'i mched zla grub ris kyi/ /bstan pa'i nam mkhar cha thun gang 'di mdzes/ /'di na 'gro kun bde skyid rgyal bstan du/ /nges nas mi nub spel phyir thos bsam sgom/ /bsgrub 'dod brtson pa'i shugs ldan rang gi sems/ /zla 'od stong gis 'khrud pa'i gangs ri bzhin/ khyod blo yangs pa'i mig rgyang ring po yis/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i pha mtha' yongs ga' kha bas/ /'phags yul tsan+d+ra go mi'i rnam par thar/ /ljongs 'di'i 'gro la mngon sum ston pa bzhin/ /sngon byung grub pa'i ring lugs ljon pa'i tshal/ /rtsod dus rlung gis sbar ba'i chags sdang mes/ /bsregs pa'i sdong dum tshangs pa'i yul sa las/ /brgal bar rtsom 'di snyigs ma'i rang mtshang skyon/ /nyon mongs —457

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)nad kun gso byed sman gyi bla/ /phag gru'i thugs rjes gang gi snying dbus su/ /sim pas snying po grub pa'i rgyal mtshan rkang / /'dzin pa'i dam bca'i pha rol phyin nam snyam/ /'on te dus ngan gdul bya tha rgod sar/ /nges don sa bon phal cher chud gzon rgyu/ /mi zad tshig gi gter la mtha' med kyang / /thos pas joms med shes ldan spyi yi lugs/ /mkhas khyod 'dzum pa'i g.yar ngo las skyugs kun/ /legs bshad ro brgya bda' ba'i phung po ste/ /slad mar 'dzad med (171na gnam lo bzed zhal du/ /rtag par 'khyil ba'i dga' ston lhur byos shig /mol mchid 'phrin yig dri za'i gar mkhan can/ /bkra shis re kha thags ris rab bkra'i gos/ /mnabs te thun mtshams rtags kyi dga' ma yis/ /'khyud pa'i rtse dga' khong nas dgod 'di'o/ /me rta bsam yas nas bstan srungs gnod sbyin chen pos/ mgo brnyan can gyi rgyal mtshan gsar du bzo bzheng gi sta gon skabs/rgyal mtshan gyi khrar 'os pa'i gos phyir bsrings dgos tshul gyi gsung 'phrin mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs la bskur ba ltar/ 'phyong rgyas lcang gling pa bsod nams dbang po 'phul bar btang skabs kyi 'phrin gsol gnod sbyin dgyes zhal rab 'dzum/ mthu stobs gnam lcags rdo rje yis/ /dgra bgegs brag ri phyer 'thag kyang / /sgrub po'i re ba skong ba la/ /yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal/ /bstan srungs gnod sbyin chen po zhes/ /dregs pa kun gyi dbang phyug che'i/ /rdo rje'i gsung shog thun 'tshams kyi/ /phyag rgya'i lang tsho'i spros pa 'byor/ /dus gsum sangasargyas ma lus pa'i/ /bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar 'kha bzhes g.yar dam las/ /nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i phyir/ /blang dang dor bya'i gnas rnams kun/ /mngon sum gzigs pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /bstan la yid spros brjed med du/ /ji bzhin bsgrub pa'i 'dun sar gnas/ kha dog sna lnga'i gos sdug dang / sham bur 'os pa'i dar yug gsum/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas 'dzad med kyi/ /nam mkha' mdzod du sprul nas 'bul/ /gangs can bstan 'gro'i bde skyid dang / /sa dbang rgyal po'i mnga' thang spel/ /rigs 'dzin bdag gi bsams pa'i don/ /lhun gyis grub par mdzod cig kye/ /snyan shal dang dkar zung 'brel dang / /sa yi zla ba zho bzhin bcas/ /bod yul dbus kyi rdo rje gdan/ /—458

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pe(171ba)pho brang po ta la nas bris/ /'bri gung ka tshal bla ma dkon cog lhun grub bcas gsang chen snying mar gsal shing grub brnyes des 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan theg mchog bdud rtsis myos pa'i mi shigs srog gi ka ba/ si spro la ba ཿ shrī yi rdo lo :ya yadz+nyā kha spro na sa rāte/bha ba shi ba rdza dza ( hā rāḥ 〉da na ka dhi nga na yurmi nga sri/ dmar (sdeb sbyor 'phags ma/)ser dpung pas bteg pa'i ut+pa la'i/ /ge sar nas gdengs mkhyen pa'i ral gri yis/ /srid zhi kun tu rmongs chen dra ba rnams/ /gcod mdzad 'jam dpal rdo rjes khyod byin rlobs/ /gtsug lag mang por lta ba'i blo gros mig /nam mkha'i pha mtha' 'tshol ba bzhin bgrangs kyang / /theg kun rtse mor son pa rdzogs pa che'i/ /rnal 'byor mchog la gzhol de'i 'phrin rten son/ /skye mang nyer goms legs byasas bon tshogs/ /dar drag yongs smin (172na lhan bzang yongs 'du'i ljon/ /lang tsho'i yal 'dab phang phung g.yo ba'i rtser/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'bras bu dud de spro/ /'di na sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi ltar bsags chos/ kha bshad rang rgyud dregs por lus bzhin du/ /gzhan smin 'gro phan la rdzu'i slu brid mar/ khrel yang nyer 'jug smyon pa'i zlos gar bzhin/ /zab gsang chus gang bshes gnyen khron pa yis/ /rjes su bsnyegs kyang phyogs de'i yid can phal/ /'thung 'dod sems kyi gdung ba rta rnga'i cha/ /brgya phrag gshags pa'i tshad bzhin rnam par phra/ /'on te ches rmongs skye rgu sbyin skyes dbus/ /gsar rnying gdams pa'i bdud rtsi rab btungs nas/ /nges legs srog gi zungs thob dpyod ldan khyod/ /ljongs 'di'i lha min dbang po sgra gcan bzhin/ /chos kun ye nas dag pa'i mkha' dbyings ngos/ /snang bzhi'i 'ja' tshon rang rig rdo rje sems/ /mngon sum rang ngo 'phrod las sangs rgyas pa/ /gud nas 'tshol bar byed rnams byis pa'i blo/ /ma dag 'dod pa'i khams na rnam smin lus/ /gnas bzhin longs sku'i zhing khams myul nus pa/ /pad 'byung dri med bshes gnyen snying thig lam/ /nyams bstar dal 'byor thob 'tshengs 'di ko mtshar/ /dkar po'i ba gam mthor brtsegs la'ang khyab/ /yid srubs cho ga rdzogs pa dgra bgegs gshed/ /nag po mngon spyod lcags ri'i khor yug nas/ /drag sngags —459

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedamod pa'i mtshon char 'bebs te 'jibs/ /sngon byung 'jam yig 'khrul pa'i ri dwags rjes/ /bsnyegs nas mkhas grags sī ta 'tshol 'dod pa/ /mi bskyod nag po'i cod pan 'chang ba sogs/ /mang zhig chos spong mya ngam thang la 'khyams/ /de phyir rang bzo chos ltar bcos ston (172bsgo khan/ /ltar snang bshes gnyen ma yin mu tig btsan/ /rim brgyud rat+na slar byon cho so kyi grags/ /bsten gang bsod nams brgya phrag bskal par bsgrubs/ /da ste sngon thos bsags pa don ldan ched/ /sgrub sde brgyad dang bye brag zil gnon sogs/ /yi dam chos srungs bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod dang / /bdag gzhan bstan pa'i don por las kun rtsoms/ /ka dag snang bzhi'i bogs dbyung dhū ti'i lam/ /rdul dkar 'bar 'dzag mi shigs 'khor lo'i khyon/ /yongs gang lhan skyes bde chen gdod ma'i zhal/ /lta ba'i rnal 'byor la g.yur skal bzang dpyid/ /phra zhib gcod tshe rtog ge'i tha snyad la/ /goms par rigs med a 'thas 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi ma dros klung chen las/ /gong 'phel nyams rtogs sku bzhi'i rgya mtshor 'bab/ /blang dor rang nyams bstar mi nus bzhin du/ /gzhan sbyor smra ba dam pa'i tshul min kyang / /spobs pa dge ba'i mgrin las legs bshad kyi/ /rgyud mangs glu ru len la zad mtha' ci/ /yid kyi kun+da bzhad nus mchid 'phrin zla/ /rigs 'dzin gdung gsob khyod blo'i gser ri nas/ /rtag 'char dza ཿ yi bu mo'i 'gros/ /lam gsum bgrod pa'i rjes su rkang 'jog rigs/ zhag bu'i ra bar yi ge'i zlos gar mkhan/ /nyams 'gyur mgrin pa'i dril 'brol g.yon mig ma'i/ /gos bzang du kū la yi kha rdzar can/ /rab dkar lhag bsam kha dog mtshon 'di'o/ /dbu ru ska btsal gyi bla ma rig sngags 'chang ba dkon cog lhun grub kyis snyan ngag gi 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan 'jam mgon snying la zhugs pa'i bden gtso/(173na〉( ga smo no ta ci ka a ra ba tu dwa mi ba rgyu tshwa ༷ sha tsatu rdi : ti ma rga/ 5 bla ro rmu khru r+sha ra ra ba ྅ da : su ba 〉 wa spro she teḥ ma ྅ni zhisto ta ca ༷ bi/ don (sdeb sbyor rma bya myos pa/dzin theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor gyis/ /'od gsal snang bzhi'i lam la nyer goms kyang / /mang thos rgya mtshor snyan ngag 'dzam bu'i 'bras/ /'phrin rten gser —460

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dza/gyi snye ma legs smon son/ /rnam dkar las kyis 'phangs pa'i rten bzang zla/ /tshor ba duḥkha'i nyer 'tshe ra ri dang / /mi ldan thos bsam sgom pa'i cha shas kun/ /yongs gang gzhan phan gzigs ma spro de snyan/ /'di na sngon bsags dkar min sa bon las/ /nad kyi zug rngus mnar yang dag byed sman/ /mtho ris lha yi chu bos rab bkrus nas/ /mi shigs srog gi ka ba 'dzugs la brel/ /ring min sgo gsum bag med las dben par/ /'jam mgon zur phud lnga pa zhi khro yi/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i lam bzang la/ /gcig tu gzhol khyod 'bad pa don dang ldan/ /(173bskon ma sa ltar gdangs mche ba rno dbal rtser/ /cher snyigs brlang spyod mi bsrun dgra bgegs srog /mi rtag lam du bkod tshe yid srubs dpung / /snying shubs nas mthon lkog mar bros te brgyal/ /nag po'i sder khros phyag rgya zil gnon lha/ /kun la ches 'jam rna bar snyan pa'i gsung / /dbyangs su 'tsher ba rigs lnga'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /tshe 'dir phung po 'od skur smin de mtshar/ /tshul 'di o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa dang / /gnubs chen brgyud par bcas pa'i bka' srol rnams/ /'phrul med 'dzin pa'i sngags 'chang mu thi la'i/ /'phreng ba tshar du dngar las gzhan na su/ /rig pa'i lam du shes byar gang srid nor/ /mkhyen dpyod shing rtas 'dren mkhas lo paṇa gyi/ /rnam thar la dad ba spu'i 'khri shing tshogs/ /gdung ba'i lho phyogs rlung gis cir yang ldang / /'on te chos kyi pha mtha' tshad bzung bral/ /tshe 'di'i chu bo sum gnyis lo yis brgal/ /de phyir mkha' 'gro'i kha rlang bun ne pa/ /theg mchog snying por gzhol ba gtan 'dun snyam/ /mkhas dang dam par rlom mal dman pa'i ro/ sha thar langs pa'i lan gsum lce rkyong ba/ /gcod pa'i nus ldan das phyir dngos grub gser/ /re ba'i blun mang phung bar mchi ma bku/ /tshul des yid 'byung bsam gtan khung bu n+da/ /ka dag snang bzhin gcig tu gzhol sems kyang / /mkhan slob chos rgyal bzhed don bod 'bangs kyi/ /bde thabs sgrub la snying las lcid du che/ /thos bsam don yod nyams bstar rigs 'dzin khyod/ /ring por 'tsho ba'i thabs tshul mi dman ngos/ /ma dag dri ma 'brud pa'i zhabs bsil du/ /'phrin yig legs bshad gaṅgā rnam par sgrongs/ /blo brid spro/61—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyenyams dang 'gyur bar sgro btags pa'i/ /kun rtog sna tshogs ri mor bris pa'i bya/ /tshe ring don ldan rkang 'thung 'dab khyer nas/ /dbu ru mtha' 'dul gtsug lag khang der 'phur/ /mang thos ru thog dbang po'i snyan tshig gi 'phrin lan srong btsan rigs kyi zla ba (174na 'ab gsal/ so gro / kho hrīpra da yo mi PROB PROB PROBPROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB/ lha bri bla : shrī gu ṇa batre ba snu ba mo myu ṇa hi ga / pi dzā yi ti ka 'e kho/ legs (sdeb sbyor rma bya myos pa/)byas gnam gyis rab byin mthon po'i rigs/ /sa spyod brgyud du nyer btsas mi yi bdag /srid zhi'i phun tshogs yon tan snod gyur pas/ /rmongs pa'i dgra las rnam par rgyal de'i 'phrin/ /rang blo mtshon pa'i ras dkar nor 'dzin las/ /sa zla'i 'khor lo cha shas yongs gangs can/ /bkra shis thags kyis bsil zer 'bum 'phro ba/ /pho nya'i lag sor shar ri'i rtse nas thon/ /nyin zhag rer yang chos dkar dge ba'i dngos/ /spel nus mkhas khyod don ldan bzang po'i rten/ /'tshe med bde bar 'tsho ba'i gtam snyan po/ /phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs de yas bskrun nus min/ /'di na gtsug lag kun la blta ba'i mig /rgyang ring shes bya'i mtha' myul la g.yengs kyang / /snying po bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug mchog gi lam/ /rdo (174ba)rje'i rnal 'byor spyod par lhod med tsam/ /lha nyid lo mang smin pa'i na tshod dang / /lhan cig srid zhi'i yul rnams gzhal nus blo/ /ches sgam chos nor 'dod thar zhal gyi sgo/ /bzhi ldan ljongs 'dir gnas pa tshangs pa'i spun/ /gang gi mgrin pa skye ba lnga pa'i dung / /rab dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba'i sgra dbyangs las/ /ma smad blang dang dor bya tshar dngar ba/ /'dzad med rna ba'i bcud du ci yang len/ /'bangs rigs brlang por spyod pa'i sprin rum las/ /srong btsan rigs kyi zla ba mthar byed pa/ /tshe ring gnam gyi dpung ba'i dri ba'o zhe shugs/ /las dkar dgun gyi pho nyas 'dren nam snyam/ /dpa' gtum zhe sdang dbang gis g.yul ngo sa /ba spu ldang ba tu ru ska yi dpung / /rtag tu rang rgyud sdig dang mi 'grogs kyang / /rgyal rnga lan brgyar brdungs pa dngos po'i gshis/ shes bya'i pha rol zad mthar ma sbyangs pa'i/ khyod yon med phyir slad mar bsgrub bya ba/ /a hang mi shigs srog gi ka ba de/ /—462

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('a'adzugs ched tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon po bstan/ /chud mi 'dza' bar gang bsags la yun du/ /bsod nams gser gyi phung por sgyur nus pa/ /byang chub sems kyi chu gter chen po'i gong / /dge tshogs 'dzam bu'i 'bras bu lhung de med/ /kun rtog pir gyis bris pa'i ri mo la/ /'di rjes tshad du gzung bar nus min yang / /lugs zung 'brel ba'i gleng 'os gaṅgā'i rgyun/ khog bu'i lam gsum ngos su chad med drongs/ /mang bkur rgyal khab chen por nyer btags gos/ /lhab lhub gyon pa'i 'chi med gar mkhan ma/ /snyan tshig mgrin pa'i dril chung 'khrol bzhin du/ /mi bdag gnas lnga rig pa'i gam du song / /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me lug lor bris pa'i chab sna(ga 'phrin yig khag /spre'u zhes pa me lug lo gsar dus phug pa sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang po'i sdeb legs tshigs su bcad pa'i 'phrin lan dam pa'i tshul las mi 'gong ba'i gta pa/(175na)sri ka la bya shī ta tsa ma re tā bhā PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBna 3 lo/ so da : shrī wa ka sa ta stu to 3 gi sa ma su ya sha 'e khyi/ lhag (sdeb sbyor myos ma/)pa'i bsam pa rnga yab dkar po yis/ /sems pa'i dri bzhen reg bya ris med 'gror/ /legs ster dam pa'i tshul las mi 'gong ba/ /ngag gi dbang phyug snyan grags bzang po'i 'phrin/ /chos nor 'dod thar dngos kun yongs spel pa'i/ /snyan tshig pi wang su sti'i rgyud mangs las/ /rab drangs glu dbyangs len pa'i me na ga: /snyim par bdog pa thogs te nyer son spro/ /gang brtsams las rnams dge ba'i gser gyur pa/ khyod lus 'dzam bu'i snye ma thub bstan mtshor/ /gnas par bde gshegs kun gyis mgrin gcig tu/ /bden tshig srog gi zungs su brjod dam snyam/ /'di na las dkar 'phen pa dar drag pas/ /srid zhi'i gtsug lag 'khyil snod 'du phung yang / /thos bsam bsgom pa bsgrub pa'i rten —463

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyebazang du / /(175ba)ring du bde bar 'tsho de don ldan snyam/ /'phags yul mkhas pa'i grags 'phar rta dbyangs de/ kha ba'i ljongs 'dir gzugs gzhan bzung nyid la/ /ngo mtshar blta ba'i slad du mi zla dang / /gza' skar tshogs kyang mkha' la 'ongs pa bzhin/ /dug gsum nad brgya'i gnyen por phyag rgya che/ /gcig shes kun grol sman dkar chog thub kyis/ /grub ris zug rngu bcil tshe sprul pa'i grong / /lta na sdug de grwa nang 'phos pa bzhin/ /skye bar bsod nams bsags pa'i gdugs dkar po'i/ /grib mar mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams ngal gso ba'i/ /snying stobs rin cen yu ba rnam dpyod kyis/ /'dzin la shes ldan khyod nyid brel ba bzhin/ khro med kun la byams pa'i ngang tshul gyis/ /brlang por spyod pa'i ste'u 'phyar ba dang / /sri zhu'i tsan dan byug par bde sdug gi /kun rtog rnam mkhyen srang la gzhal kyang mnyam/ /brnag dka' snyigs ma'i gzhan rkyen tsher dong stan/ tsheng bal 'dab ma brtsigs pa'i mal bzhin du/ /'jam mnyen bde bar spyod pa bzod pa'i go /ldan de rgyal sras spyod gang kyi thabs mchog /kun rdzob chos tshul nam mkha' pha mtha' bzhin/ /ji tsam bcad kyang zad pa'i skabs med pas/ /rnam rtog gang shar ri mo shog bu'i ngos/ /'dri ba gcig tu yi ge'i las su cha/ /nyams 'gyur rna bar 'bab pa legs bshad chu/ /bkra shis bdud rtsir bsgyur la mi 'gyur gzer/ /dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i drang srong ā ga sdu/ /srid pa de srid rtag par 'char zhig gu /nga thags kya zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ /thun 'tshams rgya yi ri bo gzugs brnyan can/ /phun tshogs dge ba'i yul gru'i shar ri nas/ /'thon tshe mkhas khyod blo yi kun+da ba 'ad/ /(176na) tshangs pa dung gi thong tshugs can la sa zla/ ja gos phyi nang / rta sogs bdog pa tshan grangs kyi spyan gzigs dang bcas dus rtags lkog gyur byi lung bstan zhu bar 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin rdzong sta byas pa'i skabs gsol ba'i 'phrin yig zur phud bkra shis g.yas 'khyil/ snang srid dregs pa yongs kyi srog snying la dbang sgyur pad+ma ka ra'i pho nya ba/ /bkra shis g.yas 'khyil dung dkar zur phud la/ /legs spud lha chen tshangs pa deng /'dir dgongs/ /sa zla dar zab rgya ja bzhon pa sogs/ /bdog pas nyer mtshon ting 'dzin me long —464

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa ra bsnyan rgyud mang / ('du/ /yongs shar sgo gsum dgyes skyed mchod pa'i tshogs/ /thugs dam skong phyir nam mkha'i khyon kun 'gengs/ /dge dang mi dge'i ltas kun dkar nag gi /las gos rang sems 'khrul ngo'i cho 'phrul kyang / /kun rdzob snyigs mar spyod pa dus ngan gyi/ /legs nyes tshul la 'gro rnams so ma nyi 'chang / /de phyir lkog gyur chos rnams dri med spyan/ /dpral ba'i dbus nas mngon sum gzigs pa bzhin / /zhib pa pho nya'i ngag nas gsol ba la/ /rdo rje'i gsung gis blang dor gsal bar ston/ /mtsho skyes pad+ma tshe dbang rigs 'dzin gyis/ /spyi bor bzhag pa'i rdo rje'i ri mo de/ /nam yang gzhom shigs med phyir dam tshig las/ /ma 'da' bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel bar mdzod/ /shar phyogs sku'i rgyal po'i blon po bya khrid mig gcig par gser skyems/ rkang 'thung phur ma/ gos phyi nang / dung chen/ rgya gling /bzhen pa sogs spyan gzigs dang bcas legs nyes ltas kyi lung bstan zhu bar zhang tsha dkon cog rnam rgyal btang ba'i dus gsol shā na yig dgyes pa'i 'dzul zhal rab gsal/dregs pa'i sdod pon pi hā ra/ shar phyogs sku yi rgyal po yi/ /blon po bya khrid mig gcig pa/ /dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal deng 'dir ston/ /gser skyems rgya ja'i btung ba dang / /'jam mnyen lha rdzas phyi nang gos/ /stong gsum skor ba'i bzhon pa dang / /snyan brjid (176ba)rol mo'i mchod sprin spel/ /stod smad dus kyi 'tshub 'gyur sogs/ /sdig 'bras sngon 'gro'i mtshan ma rnams/ /rab zhi gangs ljongs bde ba'i thabs/ /pho nya'i ngag nas legs gso lo bzhin/ /nyer 'tshe'i sdig 'bras zla 'od kyis/ khyab pa'i mun pa ltar sangs te/ /phan bde'i snang ba 'od 'bar ba'i brgya phrag thabs tshul gsal bar ston/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus o rgyan rjes/ /li byin hā ra rje blon rnams/ /bod yul bsrung bar nyer bskos na/ /g.yel med 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs/ /dregs pa'i sdod pon gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po la gser skyems/ rgya ja gos phyi nang / cang shes sogs spyan gzigs dang bcasate legs zhes blang dor gyi lung bstan zhu bar mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs bto skabs gsol ba'i lon yig yongs 'du'i ljon pa/ bde gshegs zhi khro kun gyi nus mthu'i rtsal/ /gcig tu grub pa'i rang gzugs pad+ma 'byung / /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin de yi pho nya ba/ /snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon spyan snga sa /phyi nang gos dang —465

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegaser skyems rgya ja sogs/ /dngos 'byor mchod sprin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /nyer spel nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar brgya/ /rab phye thugs dam skong phyir 'bul byed na/ /pho nya'i ngag las zhib tu gsol pa ltar/ /spyi dang bye brag kun la legs nyes dang / /ngan rigs bzlog cing bzang po spel ba'i thabs/ /lkog gyur mngon sum ji bzhin bstan du gsol/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba dgra sde'i dpung / /lha khyod mthu stobs nus pas rab bcom ste/ /'jig rten kun bde bstan srid legs tshogs rnams/ /gyen nas gyen du 'degs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /za hor rigs 'dzin bdag gis gnyer bkol ba'i/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /bsam pa tsam gyis 'bad med lhun grub pa'i/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa lta bur mdzod/ /me lug mon 'dzum lang gi rgyal po bi ra bha rtsi'i sras kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa glang po che sal rab brtan du stings pa'i mche ba'i khyad nor dang bcas pho nya mngags pa'i lan du bsrings pa'i 'phrin yig lhag bsam/ (177na)zla tshes/ ta/ gta supu tsa na shi khyu sa hā gta tsatri lo ka ka rta lha da de pa : 6 si rnya ka spru la dha ra ka/ bri/gu ḍa pā la hā rā dza rdu la du bi rwa lha : da pu tra / la ཿ ka lu kha shu bha ga ro mi iti a the ba da/ de bzhin gshegs pa de'i gsung slob mar sa bcas pa' tshogs dang 'jig rten gyi byed po gsum sogs lha dang drang srong grub pa'i rigs 'dzin rnams kyis/ sa chen po bde bar skyong ba'i rgyal po 'dzum lang bi rā bha rtsi'i sras la phun sum tsho gos pa'i dpal ram/ rba tsa na/ a na sathi ba de sha na ra pa ti / u ke la dza r+sha ba tu ta / pu ཿ kṛ ta na pha la ka pa ta ba tāri ra ni she dzi ka /u ge ma hā ba la 8 ྅ mi sa r+sā re tsa kra ba yi bha ya ka kwa la/ ha mur / pra shī ta ma na tsa lbo ba sdu/ pa stsol bar mdzod cig ces shis pa brjod nas/ nye ba'i char yang mi'i bdag po tshe rabs mang bor bsags pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po ri bo dngos su rgyu ba lta bu'i 'bras bzang nye bar dud pa'i 'du ba mchog tu snyoms shing / stobs kyi dpung pas sa'i dkyil 'khor la rang byon du spyod/ (177ba/dha ta bha ke le ya ma ཿ ha : pra r+bhe 9 ke da sa pha li ba—466

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa ra spu snyan rgyud mang / (sesdu sa 〉 pā ya na sa sto ṣa bha ya so dza na na/ ā ga zhi bo dha dha rme ka rta ba ra bi rlase na pa tra ta mā nā/ yi ku sha la slo ma nye sa rba lo ka / shu lha spri ka ma na mu ti lga bun ra yi de ge dha ke /bzhin pa nas/ rnam par dag pa'i bsam pa zla ba lta bur dkar bas pho nya ched du mngags te glang po che sa la rab brtan gyi mche ba'i khyad nor sogs bdog pa'i dngos po bsrings pa legs tshogs su gyur/ 'dir yang shākya'i rjes su zhugs pa'i sdom brtson sdosnod gsum pa'ang 'gro la dge ba'i/ ṭī nā nā lha yi mā na gi ya tsā mi tra ka ro4 ḍi sa tā na di ba tade 'i/ 〉 ḍi sa hi da ta ra k+ṣa ga — / ྅byu ka pa tra/ pa / ba ra di rnya tshwa pa na te/ ā hāsgyi na sa shā kli ti dza ya di na / ma hwa ko ṭa po ṭa la / li kha // blo can du gnas/ slad nas kyang sa thag ring yang phan tshun yid gcugs pa'i bsam pa bzang pos bsrings 'os chu bo'i rgyun ltar 'tshal/ rten bsrung mdud/ dngul gyi tha sbag gos yug dang bcas chu stod kyi nya ba'i dkar cha'i rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la pho brang chen po po ta la nas bris/(178na〉pe lug gong nas re khe dge slong dang / blo bzang phun tsho gis gnyis gser yig tu mngags pa'i bda' shog gnang sbyin nga ba'i phebs lam dang / rgya sog skye rgu rnams kyi bde thabs gzhung don gyi rgyu mtshan gsol bar kha che'i bsod snyom pa chen po shākya shrī'i gdan sa pa mkhan chen tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang khang gsar rab brtan gnyis rdzong sta byas skab phul ba'i zhu yig 'jig rten byed por nges pa rnyed pa'i gtam/ pu rgya dza skru shā ka nā ra tsa ka ta sma ga pra kho sgo ti ba ma tratu lha bo sti 'a ga ca ma 9 mya pyad nā gi rwa dzi na su bha sto/ kā la ba tu si rnya ma phya rwa dzame yi nya di ya sa kha hi ta ṅgā ya shi ta la du mi na be t+ta ma su ma ji sto ṣa pya da myu la/bsod (ldeng sbyor zlum tho/)na mas dzaskru'i gser 'khor rtsibs stong mkha' la 'phags pa tsam nyid na/ /srid pa'i gtsug tor rtse mos yongs 'dud zhabs sen rdul dmar legs bstan pa'i/ /dus kyi bdag por grub pa'i che bas rgyal po nga las nu gnyis pa/ /phan bde'i grib bsil yongs 'du gsar pa 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i zhabs drung du/ /lha kye spyan sngar gsol ba'i sngon 'gro'i sgor/ /bkra shis bden —467

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyetshig me tog man+da ra/ /'thor dang lhan cig tsan dan ljon pa'i spos/ /dri bsung dngar por 'thul te mchid 'di zhu/ /snyan 'jibs dbugs dbyung ri mo dam pa'i gsung / /mang bkur rgyal po'i bka' (178ba)rtags rab gsal ba/ /ngo mtshar bdog pa'i gnang skyes gya rnam bcas/ /mngon sum sug par son pa'i skal bzang thob/ /tshangs pa'i yul las 'chi med dmu thag las/ /'dzam gling skye rgu'i mgon du phebs pa'i lha/ /mtshan dpe'i gzugs sku'i gzi byin brgya phrag nyi'i/ /'od 'bar ji bzhin rgyas pa'i gtam de snyan/ /'di na kun la ma 'dris 'gro ba'i bshes/ /thub dbang rjes zhugs sde snod gsum pa yang / /mgon khyod bka' khrims gser gyi gnya' shing ltar/ /rab snyi'i phang bar bde ba'i ngal gsor gnas/ /sna bo'i gtsug lag mang shes dkyus rings mig /lta ba'i blo gros bsnyems ldan skar tshogs 'od/ /lha gcig na tshod ches phra'i zla tshes kyis/ /gzil gyis gnon de rang gi gshis lugs yin/ /chos nor 'dod thar sgo 'phar bzhi phye nas/ /'dzad med mchod sbyin sems ldan mtha' dag la/ /btang yang 'dzam gling mi yis khyod kyi gdong / /da dung gcig las ma mthong gang gsan ngos/ /sa dbang snying stobs rus sbal gzugs can gyis/ khams gsum skye rgu'i phan bde'i sa 'degs pa/ /mngon sum spyod yul gyur bzhin mtho ris su/ khyab 'jug 'tshol ba'i 'khrul pa'i sems deng la/ /legs byas dar drag shugs ldan 'phong skyen mdas/ /log spyod lha min grong khyer phyer 'thag kyang / /kun la lhag bsam rab dkar zla ba yi/ /cod pan 'chang ba'i bde 'byung khyod kho na/ /dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi pa'i khyu mchog (179na)tu/ /mi bdag 'jigs med rgyud kyi nga ro'i dbyangs/ /blangs tshe phyogs bral dregs byos glang po rnams/ /phyag dang mdongs gso la ba bgyed pa'i khur gyis brel/ /'on te khro med byams brtses yangs pa'i sa/ khor yug gcig tu gnas so cog gi 'gro /bde bar skyong ba 'phags chen rgyal po yi/ /ngang tshul 'di las gzhan du ga la g.yo/ /nub phyogs dag zhing mgon po tshe mtha' yas mdzod spu mi shigs 'khor lo'i 'od snang gis/ /'chi bdag mun bcil lha khyod lus can gyi/ /gnyen du bska la pa rgya mtshor zhabs brtan shog /gang gis chen po'i lung dang lag rtags kyis/ /dbang bskur dkyus —4(nyis

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pespyan gzigs pa'i snod gyur pa//'dzum zhal las 'ongs bka' mchid ro bda'i g.yang //rtag tu snying gi dpal bor chags par mdzod//gzigs pa 'bab ched lha mi'i dpal 'byor rnams//rgyal khab chen por 'du ba dngos po'i gshis//de phyir mkhyen spyan dag pa'i me long ngos//rin cen phrug sogasagazugs bas ci yang bkra/blun tshig zhu mchid sran ma'i me tog phreng //pad dkar chun por rlom pa'i spobs mtho yis//skye rgu'i bdag po'i zhabs rten khri 'phang du//dang ba'i yid kyis phul ba dza ( //mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i ska btsal bla ma dkon cog lhun grub 'du ba stigs pa las grol ba'i tshe 'phrin yig byung ba'i tso zug phy-i bod rgya grol pho/179bar phyid kyi pho waṃ glu/shu bla ni/bhā ga bstobadz+ra his/prat+yak+ṣa/sto:tsa tu shrīḥraḥyo gyi mā:mān+ta bi rdas sbar bi rlob ho:lta tasutsa tsit+ta li kha yurnya/ye spyosbyor rma bya myos pa/sgos dag pa'i bcom ldan rdo rje sems//mngon sum rang ngo sprod pa snang bzhi'i lam//rnal 'byor mchog la gzhol ba'i rig sngags yong//sdom brtson mang du thos de'i 'phrin rten son//nyer len lang tsho'i lo tog la 'tshe ba//'dus nad skyin thang lha min 'phrul gyi gdon//zil gnon tshangs pa'i brtul zhugs 'khor lo yis//mgrin 'chad deng dus bder gnas thob pas spro//'di na rang rgyud glang po 'dul thabs la//'bad min sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi ji bzhin du//mang thos lhur blangs ming tsam yi ge sa/'god pa'i dka' thub ngal bas gcig tu brel//gto bde lta ci tshe 'di'i 'dun ma yang //sgrub par nus min phyugs kyi 'du shes can//mngon mtho'i 180na rten du rlom nas ring 'tsho'i thabs//brtson pa rnams la'ang legs so ster byed na//rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab skyed tshal du//thos bsam sa bon nan to drod gsher gyis//legs smin dal 'byor a mra'i sdong po khyod//srung byed tsher can ra bas rtag bskor 'os//rgyal dbang pad+mas byin brlabs mtho ris chab//gter sgom rang byung khrus kyi rdzing bu mchog/bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad la chog thub sman//bsten nas nyes brgya'i dri ma zhagi da par rigs//dman lam kun+da ba 'ad pa'i sa spyod zlas//bsgrun min gzhan phan 'dab brgya 'dzum pa'i //6/srong btsan bzhed pa'i gangs can sa'i me rtsa//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gas lar bcas sri zhus brtson de legs//rang dgon sbar sbug tsam la dus gsum rgyal//sras bcas brten par dril bsgrags mes dpon gyi//thugs dam lha khang 'phrin las sgo dgag pa'i//chen po'i rnam thar 'ga' la mchi ma dku//lnga ldan la sogs skyob pa nas 'ongs zong //dwags brgyud tshong 'dus la brin mod na yang //rin cen phun tsho gos thugs kyis gsang mdzod nor//chos grags ded dpon las thob khyod nyid tsam//sna tsho gis 'phrin las bzhi yis gdul bya rnams/khams dang dbang por bstun nas rab 'dul zhing //tshe 'dir snang gsum zad par bskyel nus pa'i//blo ldan khyod kyi 'dun ma yang rtser son//gser ri'i sbubs nas 'char ba'i nyi ma la//'di zhes grangs kyis tshad gzung nusamin ltar//gnyen gshin bskyud pa med pa'i mol mchid rgyun//dzaḥ 180ba tha bu mo'i spun zlar byos//ma smad ro 'da'i g.yang chags ljon pa'i 'dab//thun 'tshams mdzes pa 'phrog pa btung ba'i rgyun//lha gos yol gor gcig tu legs 'khyil ba//thogs te dpyid kyi pho nya phyogs der 'phur//rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa sprel lor bris pa'i chab 31ga 'phrin yig khag/sa spel gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i chos kyi khrir rigs kyi srasang ga dbang kun dga' bkra shis pa'i skabs la khri chen 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug la legs skyes 'bul bar 'dar pa blo bzang dbang phyug rdzong sta byas skabs phul ba'i zhu yig byams pa'i bos dang tsho mched zla/ste'u rtos ra na yan shekhri rtse dz+nyā dwa ya nyi nu bhabakuṭ+wā zhin lha/badz+ra na twa pra:ma yabasko sri biṅgāṅgā re hi su spo ta lha snarat+na/zhing sdeb skyor chu 'dzan phreng ba/khams rgya mtsho'i rnam 'dren ma lus pa'i//mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i phung po gcig gyur pa/khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul can//rig 'dzin bye ba'i gtsug rgyan rin po cher//181na ) ring min rnam par dge ba'i dus kyi char//mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung 470

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('thugs//'gyur med g.yung drung ngo bor legs bzhugs pa//bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i nyer 'tsho'i dpyid//'di na lang tsho yol bas rgan po'i grar//chud kyang lung rtogs yon to na phra ba//srid pa chu zla lta bur mthong bzhin du//rtse gcig sgrub g.yel rnam g.yeng khol por gnas//'od gsal 'chi med dmu thag la babs pa'i//rang ris gdung las brgyud pa'i rgyal ba'i sras//'khon ston 'jam dpal gzhen nu'i khrir phebs la//bde gshegs slob mar bcas pas me tog 'thor//dkyil 'khor kun gtsor bzhengs pa'i he ru ka/mi bzad khro bo 'bar ba'i stang stabs kyis//rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la bka' bsgos te//yid srubs sde bcas 'jig pa'i gtam de snyan//byams pa'i 'dus pa dang po ji bzhin du//mchog dman bar par bcas pa'i tsho gos rnams la//theg chen chosa'akhor thog mar legs bskor ba//slob bshad zab don spel ba'i sngon 'gro'i sgo//na tshod lang tsho'i sgong rgya ma grol kyang //mkhyen brtse nus pa'i skad snyan 'gyur khugs can//rgyal sras ka la piṅka'i rnam thar la//mkhas rlom 'dab chags phal gyis bskrun nus min//gdung brgyud rim par byon pa'i zhal gdams sogs//mgon khyod thugs gsang dpal gyi be'u mā/gtams pa'i chos kun bum pa gang byo'i tshul//stsal te bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol rigs//'jigs med seng ges bteg pa'i khri chen por//rdo rje'i skyil krung bskal par rtag bcas nas//zab dang rgya che'i chos kyi 'khor lo yis//'gro rnams smin grol lam la 'god 181ba par gsol//mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs zhal khyim 'dab stong sgo//'dzum dbus tshems 'phreng ze'u 'bru bzhad rtsa nas//snyan 'gyur phebs tshogos bhā ma ra yi glu//thos 'dzin lam du chad pa med par zhu//rab dkar lha rdzas kha tshar ldan pa'i zla//rtags kyi rigs dwags gzugs brnyan mngon gsal pa//zur phud lnga pa rim byon bsti gnas su//lhag bsam mkha' la bgrod de phul ba dge/sa sprel gyi lo gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya pa khri thog tu gdung brgyud rin po che ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis phebasaskab leg bya'i dga' ston 'bul bar 'dar pa blo bzang daXng phyug rdzong sta byas skabs phul ba'i zhu 'phrin rigs gsum chos kyi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)lor los sgyur ba'i gto snyan sgo brgya dang po/ bra h+ma ṇa rje sha ha rnya do de bi tho tsho : pra dza 〉 〉 hi: mi rnyi ke tu khu pa tā kha sa : me/ rgya 'e ge PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB/mes sdeb sbyor me tog phreng can/po 'phrog byed mgrin sngon brgya byin sogs/ /lhar bcas skye rgu'i gtsug gtor sa 'dzin rtser/ /zhabs sen thun 'tshams gos dmar ngal gso ba'i/ /mtshungs med bdag chen chos rje rin po cher/ /(182na)ring bskyed thugs kyi ri bo tshogs gnyis mtshor/ /sgril las legs thon mtshan dpe gzugs sku'i nyi/ /brgya phrag gzi 'bar 'jig rten gsum snang ba'i/ /sgron mer byed pos gcig tu sbar ba bzhin/ /mgrin pa skye ba lnga pa'i g.yas 'khyil dung / /tshangs dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i sgrar drangs pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i lam bzang snyan 'gyur glu/ /skal ldan yongs kyi rna ba'i rgyan du 'jibs/ /dri bral thugs kyi me long gsar pa'i ngos/ zhes byar srid do cog kun 'char bas na/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de/ /zhing khams g.yin du 'tshol 'dod byis pa'i blo/ /'di na sdom brtson sde snod klog pa mkhan/ /blo gros gzings kyis gcug lag rgya mtsho'i mtha'/ /gzhal bar brel yang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog /klu dbang gtsug gi nor bu dor min tsam/ /rigs gsum mgon de 'gro la rjes chags gar/ /mi yi srid pa rgyun chad med bzung ba/ /rang rigs chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i khrir/ /byon pa'i gtam snyan sgo brgya dang po phye/ /gaṅgā 'a rdul snyed dkyil 'khor bdag po mā /gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs ma lus pas/ /dbang bskur lung du bstan tshe gangs ljongs 'dir/ /dpal ldan chos skyong mngon sum 'ongs pa bzhin/ /ma rig mun stug las 'khon 'jam mgon rigs/ /cha phra'i na chod zla ba gsar chos kyang / /nyan rang rgan po'i rgyu skar zin gnon par/ /sras bcas phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas legs so ster/ /'gro 'dren (182bdam bca' nam yang mi gtong ba'i/ /ngag dbang thugs bskyed lhaḥyig zhun ma'i khams/ /'khon brgyud nya phyis khog tu dang drag pa/ /mu tig 'phreng dkar 'dzad pa med 'di mtshar/ /rgan po'i blo gros 'chang ba'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /dus gsum rgyal kun yab tu rtag gyur kyang / /gzhen nu'i tshul gyi zur phud lnga —472

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (seldan pa/ /mi yi srid pa'i zlos gar ci yang rtsen/ /smin grol rgyud bshad lung dang man ngag rnams/ /gsan bsams bsgom ba'i pas gtan la legs phab ste/ /sa skya'i bla chen ring lugs dbyar mtsho ltar/ /spel ba'i snying stobs go cha dang du bzhes/ /bde ldan dag pa'i zhing gi mgon po dang / /dbyer med tshe mtha' yas par byin brlabs nas/ /chos srid nyi zla zung du 'jug pa'i bstan/ /'dzin par mchog gsum thugs rje'i mthu skyed shog /zab yangs thugs kyi gaṅgā'i yab gcig las/ /bka' mchid dzaḥ yi bu mo'i rgyun/ /dbus 'gyur nor 'dzin lus phra'i lto ba sa /gzhan yang chad pa med par 'bab tu gsol/ /phun tshogs rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i sgo/ /sgrig byed bdog pa'i dngos po khra shar dang / /ri mo spyan ras btsa' phyir lha rdzas gos/ /mnabs te rgyal bla'i yar tshes dge bar phul/ /sa sprel lo gsar thog lcog gra sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i 'phrin yig dang legs skyes byung ba'i lan sgom chen rgyu skar dbus na gsal ba'i zla ba/ (182na)pi ka ྅ re kho da ya mā la ga༄ ñcadha rma kā ya su ka bi bya so ga sba na ga mo mu dra lha shā sa na dha ka su ba kro ta lnga khi tsi t+tayu rnya/ kun (sdeb sbyor nye dbang rdo rje/)rtog ri mor 'char ba'i sgyu ma'i tshogs/ /chos skur rang ngo shes pa'i yo lang can/ /gnas lugs phyag rgya'i bstan pa 'dzin rnams kyi/ /rgyan cha ga ṇi ga tu mdzes de'i 'phrin rten son/ /gang shar sems su nges pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bzang ngan blang dor bral yang btags tsam du/ /bsod nams shing rta stong gis 'drangs pa' lus/ /dal 'byor nor bu g.yo med brtan de spro/ /'di na chos nor 'dod thar sgo phye nas/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla nas blar 'degs kyang / /rtsod bral smin srol zung 'jug rdo rje'i theg /mkhas grub yongs kyi shul du 'jug 'dod tsam/ /yal ga'i ri dgas gser sbyangs zhun ma'i gos/ /klubs pa'i gnam lo dang por shar ba'i tshe/ khres brjod me tog 'phreng ba (183ba spel legs can/ /bdog pa'i skyes kyi tshan grangs gcig tu dge /ka tsan brda sprod mtho ris chu bo'i rgyun/ /blo gros lto bar 'jug pa'i drang srong khyod/ /sgom chen rgyu skar dbus na zla ba ltar/ /rang gi grib ma tsam la grogs su 'dzin/ /gtsug lag mang po thos shing bsams pa yi/ /rnam —473

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)dpyod lang tsho rgyas pa'i rkang pa zung / /blang dor sa la gom pa 'god pa yang / /grub rigs tsū ta'i khrod du chud dka'i gnas/ /'on te bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun la/ /sbyangs stobs mig rgyang ring pos nyer gzhal tshe/ /drang srong phur bus khyod kyi ngang tshul la/ /blta phyir nam mkha'i lam du nges par rgyu/ /de tsam 'brul ngo'i 'char sgo snyan tshig gi khud mangs glu ru blangs pa rna ba'i bcud/ /ma lus ri mor 'dri na rnam rtog mtha'/ /zad pa med phyir yi ge'i gron las ci/ /deng nas mi pham mgon de ma ga dhar/ /rnam gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor min par/ /bgrang bya gsar tshes kun tu nyams 'gyur stong / /'phrin yig mgrin pa'i pad mtshor glur longs shig /khyod blo rigs med yid can ma lus la/ /gcig tu dkar ba'i lhag bsam mtshon pa'i ched/ /dri bral kha tshar ldan pa'i du kū la/ /thun 'tshams rtags kyis lang tshos spud 'di'o/ /me lug gi mjug dang sa sprel gyi lo 'gor sa g.yos dar 'od dkar sogs ltas sna tshogs byung skab bsam yas su bstan srungs gnod sbyin chen por lung bstan zhu bar bto ba'i 'phrin yig spyan ras me long ngosakyi ri mo/ / sprul pa'i chos rgyal mched lnga'i bka' gnyan mchog /tse'u dmar po 'bar ba spun bdun gtso/ khams gsum skye rgu'i srog bdag bshan pa che/ /g.yel (184nas da dri ba'i tshig 'dir lha snyan gtod/ /mjug ring 'ja' ris sogs su kha mtshon gyis/ /dpyod dka'i mkha' la ltas gsar shar ba 'di/ /rnam snang gsang sgrom gter gyi lung byang du/ /'od dkar skya rengs bshad dang som nyir gyur/ shar phyogs tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i dwags yul sa/ /mang por g.yos dang dus min g.yu 'brug skad/ /bsgrags sogs sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i sngon 'gro yi/ /tshul la shes ldan phal cher 'khyog blo 'chad/ /bod 'bangs phan bde bsgrub thabs pad+ma'i lung / /ji bzhin ba ched pa'i sngon rabs dam pa 'gar/ /dus gnad rten 'brel yid srubs rgyu thabs kyis/ /ma 'grig ljongs 'di'i lus can las dman mthu/ /'di na 'gro la lhag bsam padartsa ltar/ /dkar yang de don sgrub rngo thogs dka' zhing / /bya byed blang dor tshur mthong byis blo yis/ /rtogs min mun par 'phang pa'i nyag phran bzhin/ /lha khyod dpral ba'i dbus na dmar zlum spyan/ /—474

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('chos kun mngon sum blta la dri bral bas/ /pho nya'i ngag nas gsol ba'i smreng rnams la/ /dam tshig gnyan po ma bral lung du ston/ /gser skyems rgya ja lha rdzas phyi nang gos/ /go mtshon cang shes rta sogs mthun pa'i rdzas/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas rmugs 'dzin mdzod bzhin du/ /'bul na bstan srungs dbang po dgyes skyed mdzod/ /bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs dpung / /sdebacas snying gi khrag dron gsol ba dang / /lhan cig bdag sogs rig 'dzin sgrub po yi/ /bstan srid legs tshogs yar ngo'i zla ltar spel/ /rig pa'i rtsal rgya snang srid 'khor 'das chos/ /kun la dbang sgyur pad+ma thod 'phreng gi /(184bzhil shes ma g.yel bod 'bangs bstan dang 'gro'i/ /mel tshe mdzod cig dregs pa'i sde dpon kye/ /sa sbrel mchims phu gnam the'i lung bstan gyi dogs dpyod bgyid par chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse btang skabs kyi 'phrin mig the tshos mdud 'grol/ rgyal dbang pad+ma thod 'phreng gi /mngag gzhug lha chen gnam the yi/ /'phrin yig dar dkar rten dang bcas/ /sug par son pas spro ba 'phel/ /mi mthun nyes kun zhi ba dang / /phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan rnams/ /'phel thabs blang dor bstan pa'i don/ /yid gnyis dra ba'i gzeb tu tshud/ /de don zhib tu pho nya yis/ /dri ba g.yar lam nas gsol bar/ /tshul bzhin lag tu bstar bde ba'i/ /gnas lugs gsong por gsal bar ston/ /gser skyems dar mtshon snyan shal dang / /rgya ja tsho gis kyi 'khor lor bcas/ /mchims phug gsung gi dben gnas mchog /skyong ba'i mthu ldan dbang por dge/me lug gi 'jug dang sa sprel gyi lo 'gor 'ja' dkar sa g.yos dang / dus min gyi 'brug sogs byung skabs tshong 'dus su bshan pa bya khri mig gcig par lung bstan zhu bar chang khyim pa btang skabs 'phrin du gsol ba/ thugs mtshor shes bya kun gsal/dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma thod 'phreng gi /dam tshig rdo rje'i ri mo gtsug tor rtser/ /rab bkra ji bzhin yol med las sgrub pa'i/ /bshan pa gnod sbyin bya khrid mig gcig pa/ /'gro kun rang gi las nyon 'khrul pa'i mdangs/ /phyi rol mkha' la shar ba mi dge'i ltas/ /sgyu ma'i rta glang rjes 'gro dkar —475

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyemin 'bras/ /mngon sum don byed nus la 'byog blo 'chang / khol bur sna tsho gos sa gzhi g.yo ba dang / /dus min 'brug skad nam zla'i (185na po tshes 'gyur sogs/ /mtshan mas bod 'bangs mnar bar 'gyur snyam nas/ /nyes mangs gnyen po sgrub zlor gcig tu 'dun/ /'on te lkog gyur rtogs pa'i mngon shes dang / /mi ldan 'ol ci tsam du lag bstar ba/ /'phyug med gnad du 'gro bar ma nges pas rang sems gzhan phan bsam pa dkar bar zad/ /dregs pa'i dbang phyug khyod thugs mtsho nang du/ khres byar srid pa'i zla gzugs 'bum phrag kyang / /dog min rnam par yangs pas dri ba'i lan/ /the tshom mun pa mtha' dag drungs nas phyung / /thub bstan yongs 'du'i rtsa ba mi g.yo brtan/ /khrims gnyis zung 'brel yal 'dab rab tu rgyas/ /grib mar lus can tshogs rnams ngal gsor spyod/ /bcol ba'i las bzhi'i 'bras bus dud par mdzod/ /spyan sngar spel ba'i mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshogos/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas mkha' khyab yid 'ong bar/ /sprul pas thugs dam gnyen po skong gyur te/ /dgyes zhal 'dzum ldan rdul bral zla ltar ston/ /me lug gi lo mjug dang sa sprel gyi le 'gor sa g.yos dang 'ja' dkar sogs byung skabs bsten srungs tshangs pa dung thod can la lung bstan zhu bar rab 'byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin rdzong sta byas te 'phrin du gsol ba gsang mdzod phyag rgya 'gyed pa'i lde mig /snyan pa'i dbyangs 'khrol skye ba lnga pa'i dung / /gnag snum ral pa'i rtser mdzes tshangs pa kye/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa spyan ras kyis/ /nyer btsa' smreng du gsol ba'i lha snyan gtod/ /'dzam gling brtul zhugs grub pa'i rig sngags long / /sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod 'phreng gi /zab gter lung du bstan pa'i dus rtags gzugs/ /gnam sa'i ri mor (185ba po'ang 'di som nyer 'gyur/ /lha khyod dpral ba'i dbus kyi ye shes spyan/ /rdul bral me long gtsang ma'i ngos yangs por /lkog gyur shes bya'i snang brnyan kun 'char ba'i/ /tshul la nges rnyed dri bya'i yul du 'khums/ /rims 'khrug dbul sel bod khams bde thabs dang / /de'i gzhi shākya'i bstan pa ring du gnas/ /sa spyod rgyal por dge ba'i thabs tshul sogs/ /rgyal dbang pad+mas gter kha mang por bstan/ /'on te gzhan —476

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('phan 'dren rlom chen po 'ga'i/ /snying la bdud kyis nyer brlams nges pa'i tshul/ /bkag ste rang che bsgrub pa'i rnam thar gyis/ kha ba'i ljongs 'dir sngon chad mang zhig mnar/ /dregs pa'i ded dpon rnams kyis mngon sum du/ /gzigs pa ji bzhin bdag blo ston zla ltar/ /dkar yang bod 'bangasal sman bsgrub bya yi/ /las rjes chu la bris pa'i ri mo bzhin/ /da dung sems kyis bzod min phan pa'i thabs/ /bsgrubs zin rnams kyi 'bras bu smin tshul dang / /slad mar bya 'os ston sogs blang dor gyi/ /gnad rnams rdo rje'i tshig gi lung du ston/ /gser skyems phyi nang gos dang rgya ja sogs/ /mi 'dzad nam mkha' mdzod du ting 'dzin gyis/ /brlabs 'di yab gcig srog bdag tshangs pa dkar/ /dgyes par rol la 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs/ /sa sprel zla ba gsum pa'i nang du bsam yas su chos rgyal chen por spyan gzigs tshogs 'khor dang bcas lung bstan zhu bar chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse rdzong sta byas skabs 'phrin du gsol ba btang snyoms gnyis las slong ba'i rdza rnga/ dmu rigs klu yi tsha bo rdzu 'phrul can/ /gcig las du mar sprul pa'i chos rgyal che/ /snang srid dregs pa'i dmag sna 'dren pa'i gtso/ /dri bral lha yi (186na)snyan dbang deng 'dir gtod/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag mchog /mtsho skyes rdo rjes bod yul bstan srungs su/ /bskos na deng dus mi dge'i ltas mang bar/ /bzlog thabs blang dang dor bya lung ston rigs/ /nad yam mu ge g.yul 'brug la sogs pa/ /dkar min 'bras kyi ljongs 'di mnar gyur na/ /bro bor dam bca' rdo yi ri mo ltar/ /grags pa'i gtam yang ming gi lhag mar zad/ /gtsug tu rdo rje'i ri mo 'gyur med rtags/ khog tu brlams tshe ston pa'i skabs mchis na/ /don po g.yar dam srog bzhin gces bzung nas/ /ru bzhi'i lus can mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod/ /rigs 'dzin bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams kyang / /thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub pa dang / /som nyir gyur ba'i blang dor dri ba'i tshig /me long nang gi byad bzhin lta bur ston/ /bkras btags gser skyems rgya ja gos phyi nang / /rno mtshon cang shes tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas byin brlabs te/ /'bul gyis dgyes zhal zla ba —477

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)ltar ngoms shig /chos rgyal chen po dang lhan du gnod sbyin las mkhan yang spyan drangs te lung bstan zhu bar chang khyim pa btang dus 'phrin du gsol ba/ dregs pa'i sde dpon gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar po'i spyan sngar snyan shal sogs thogs la phul ba bzhin sngon nas rgyu mtshan smreng du gsol ba ltar/ da lam chos rgyal chen po spyan drangs thog zhal gyis 'ches pa'i blang dor mtha' dag ston par mdzod/ zhib pa pho nya'i g.yar lam nas gsol ba ltar yin/ tshes bzang por dge /(186ba)sa sprel zla ba gsum pa'i nang du mchims phu lha mo rigs 'dzin ma'i rdo rje'i gsung 'phrin byung ba'i lan du chang khyim pa btang skas kha sol ba ga por smra ba'i gto/ pad+ma thod 'phrong bka' nyan can/ /rigs 'dzin lha mor la gcig ma'i/ /'phrin yig lha rdzas rten dang bcas/ /sug par son pas bdag yi rang / /gsung gi gnas skyong sprul pa'i skur/ /nyams pa'i gtam dang dngos po yis/ /sbrags par rgyal khrims kyis mnar bar/ /phan pa bsgrub slad sems la gzhol/ khyad par ral gcig lha mo yis/ /rang gnas dgos pa'i ngo chen gyis/ /gangs ris zla ba shar ba bzhin/ /slar yang lhag bsam 'phel ba'i gsos/ /bod khams bde ba'i thabs tshul rnams/ /bstan pa'i blang dang dor bya yang / /ma brjed snying la rab sim pa/ /rdo la bris pa'i ri mo bzhin/ /dar tshon gser skyems ral gri dang / /longs spyod tsho gis kyi 'khor lor bcas /pad+ma'i gsung gi gnas skyong ba'i/ /bstan srungs dbang mo'i spyan sngar spel/ /sa sprel44sag rta ra pho bu nor bu sgon pa'i wen lan ngor so'i re skong / dben rtsa bshan dmar khang pa nas/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i 'phrin yig son/ /der 'khod don la dogs pa'i gnas/ /byung rnams pho nya'i ngag nas gsal/ /log par rtog pa'i the tshom gyi/ /dra ba mtha' dag gcod pa dang / /mi mthun phyogs kun rab zhi zhing / /mthun rkyen 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /snyan shal zung 'bres gser skyems te/ /rno ngar ldan pa'i ral gri dang / /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa yis/ /lha khyod sgo lnga tshem par rol/ /sa sprel sa skyong 'phrin las rgya
