mtsho dang bstan 'dzin da yan (187na)rgyal po gnyis kyi dgongs rdzogs su/ bka' 'gyur rin —478

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pepo che tshar re ba tshengs rgyu'i do dam du gzims shag pa dkon cog dar rgyas/ stag ru ba tshe dbang bkra shis/ cha dkar nga a pa gsum btang skabs bar gcod sel ba'i ched du thang chen rgyal por spyan gzigs dang bcas 'phrin du gsol ba bsam pa ji bzhin lhun grub/rigs rnams kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /rgya gar paṇa chen gzugs sprul thod 'phreng rtsal/ /phyag na rab 'bar rdo rje'i ri mo'i gzugs/ /gtsug tor me long ngos shar srung ma kye/ /pha mes rigs kyi dgra lha mthu rtsal can/ /bshan pa lag dmar 'khor bcas spyan lam du/ /dngos sprul thugs dam skong bar byed pa'i rdzas/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye legs 'bul na/ /thub pa'i lugs 'dzin bshad sgrub sde rnams 'phel/ /bod 'dir nad yams g.yul 'khrug dbul phongs zhi/ /rigs 'dzin bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las kun/ /bsam pa ji bzhin lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /rgyal rnams gsang gsum mdzad pa'i rab dang phul/ /mdo rgyud gsung rab glegs bam brgya phrag gzung / /'dri bar nyer 'tshe'i bgegs rigs kun bzlog cing / /mthun rkyen legs tshogs ngang gis 'grub par mdzod/ /lkog gyur blang dor lung bstan gsal por ston/ /yid srubs bdud sde'i ba dan sa la stol/ /dkar po chos kyi rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtser/ /sgrongs la snyan pa'i rdza rnga phyogs bcur sgrogs/ /0sprel ra ba smad chos skyong gis skyes tshan grangs dang bcas rim grong dgos tshul gyi bskul ma'i 'phrin yig byung ba'i (187ba〉zha tso ༅khyo lhar pho dbyar rnga/ lha btsan dregs pa'i dbang phyug chen po yi/ /gsung 'phrin ring 'tsho'i skyes kyi tshan grangs dang / /gegs sel rim gro'i blang dor lung bstan bcas/ /ma nyams thun 'tshams rgya yis spras pa son/ /phun tsho gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i sgo/ /brgya phrag cig car sgrig pa'i sta gon bzhin/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /'bad pa med par lhun gyis sgrub par mdzod/ /snyan shal gser skyems ra la gri zhags pa sogs/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas sngags rgyas rab spel nas/ /chu shel dbang po sa ga dang 'grogs pa'i/ /sngon ma'i phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis par dge/sa sprel ar ge rgyal pos rim gro'i bskul ma bsrings pa'i wen lan rdo la bris pa'i ri mo/ /phun tshogs dge ba'i yul gru cher/ /grags pa'i g.yu ru grwa nang nas/ /bstan srungs bshan pa dmar po yis/ /blang dor —479

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyeston pa'i gsung 'phrin 'byor/ /chul bzhin bgyid par sems pa yi/ /ri mo rdo la bris pa bzhin/ /mtshungs par khyod kyis 'phrin las bzhi/ /sgrub pa'i dam bca' brtan por zungs/ /lha rdzas gser phud mtshon cha bcas/ /bzhed pa skong ba'i dam rdzas su/ /brlabs te sa gas nya ba'i zla'i/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la dge/snga 'gyur chos tshul rgya mtshor mkhas shing grub brnyes ska btsal bla ma dkon cog lhun grub kyi 'phrin lan yid srubs sde bcas bshig pa'i (188na skyo dbyangs/ sa re shā n+taḥ kro dha ka ya wa ༷ ta ka spre : gu ṇaḥbi 'a li ta mahā shrī he ruka pya : bha bya ku ga zhi (sde po sbyor kha sgo ta yang ma/khong khro bo ma lus pa'i/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyi/ /rnam rol che mchog he ru ka /rigs kun bdag pos shis par mdzod/ /yang srid mang por chos dkar bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /snying gi za ma tog tu yongs 'khyil bas/ /tshe 'dir shes bya'i gnas rnams tshigs chung ngus/ khong chung rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'phrin rten son/ /na tshod rgan po'i khur dang lhan cig tu/ /lung rtogs yon tan 'bras bu rab dud pa'i/ /gtan 'dun sa le sbram gyi 'byung khungs khyod/ /dzaskru ljon pa'i mched slar deng 'dir 'grub/ /nges par dal 'byor chos kyi cha shas kun/ /gang bas sgrib gnyis mun sel gzugs phung nyid/ /sna tshogs zug rngu lha min dbang po (188ba tha/ /mche ba'i phrag las ring du brgal te spro/ /phongs pas rgyal po'i mdzod nor bgrang ba ltar/ /bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas mang nyer thos kyang / /don med 'di snang 'dun mas blo brid pa'i/ /rab rmongs kho bo mnog chung g.yeng gzeb chud/ /sngags rloms ri mo'i mar me sgyu dra'i gar/ /ma yin chos grags dpyad gsum dag pa'i lung / /ji bzhin mnan sreg 'phang las thog mda' yis/ /yid srubs dpung bcas bsheg pa'i sgra de snyan/ /ma 'dris kun la khyab pa snying rje'i rtsal/ /chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs pa'i khro rgyal gyis/ /'khrul ngo'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i khrag dren rgyun/ /rngub zhal cher gdangs srid gsum za ba bzhin/ /sde dpon sum cu'i gom pa dgra snying la/ /nyer bkod gsod rtags ka ra lha ra'i rjes/ /bzhag pa'i mod la dga' rab dbang phyug dpung / /mya ngan khang bur sor mos —48(/—

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('a'agram pa 'degs/ /cher snyigs lnga brgya tha ma'i chu klung du/ /log smon 'grub pa'i dam sri 'byung po'i dug shar rnams dag byed zhi khro rol pa yi/ /zab gsang chu lha'i bu de gzhan na ci/ /yod yod theg mchog rgya mtsho'i drod lding yang / /don du rngan sbyin dag tsam gtong ba'i chu/ /rnyed dka'i ban sngagasatshul la khrel dgod sgra/ /sems med dbyar sprin mgrin rnga sgrog pa bzhin/ /rnam 'byed shes rab ri bo sgril min par/ khyod blo chu gter slong gab (1pon)lung rtogs zla/ /ma mthong mkhas rlom rdzing bu'i ri bong can/ /mtshar 'dzin rnam dpyod rdul gyi cha bzhin phra/ /snga 'gyur ring lugs rtsa ba ches sbom zhing / /rtse mo thub bstan gnas pa de srid mkhan rab bras thos bsam yal gar smin grol 'bras/ /dud pa'i byed po deng dus khyod du 'khrums/ /'du 'dzis ring tsam bas myo/ gtan pa kun la/ /grags mod mchog tu sems nyid gnyis 'dzin las/ /yongs dben rang rig don gyi thod 'phreng rtsal/ /rang zhal mngon sum mthong ba'i gnad gsang gces/ /thos bsam multi la yi 'khri shing char/ /sngon goms legs byas rgya mtsho'i mthus babs pa/ /rtsol bar bltos pa min yang rdo rje gsum/ /g.yo med dam bca'i tshul la lhag par rangs/ /bka' gter bstan srog khyod ring 'tsho ba dang / /zungs su gyur phyir hūṃ ti'i ka ba yis/ /thabs shes a hang 'gyur ba med byin du/ /rlob par rtsa gsum thugs rje'i mthu dpung skyed/ /dbyangs can spyan ras nyin byed brgya phrag tu/ /phog pa'i shes rab te se'i gtsug tor las/ /chos dang 'brel mchod gaṅgā chad med pa/ /rang gi ngo bo mi gtong dngos po'i gshis/ /snyan ngag nyams 'gyur stong ldan sha mi sgrib/ /rten gos du kū la yi kha tshar can/ /gyon pa'i 'phrin yig 'chi med gar mkhan ma/ /srong btsan sprul pa'i gan+dho la der song / / lugs zung la blta ba'i dpyod ldan ru thog dbang po phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis ring 'tsho'i rten byung du 'dog pa'i skyes dang bcas snyan tshig gi 'phrin (189brdzig byung ba'i lan nyi bu las kyi me long dor ba'i gtam snyan/ su ri tā zhi go da 3 kwaru/ yu mi grwa u ma lu/ tsi rnya smo ṇi grwa tswa re sto ka 〉 spyo sa shu / spo/ thugs (sdeb sbyor gleg phreng /) rje gaṅgā'i chu rgyun gyis/ /dus kya pho nya'i dri ma kun/ /dag mdzad yid bzhin 'khor loms/ /—481—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyedapyod ldan khyod la dge bar mdzod/ /spobs pa mang thos rnam par sbyor ba yi/ /yon tan cha rdzogs chu shel dbang po las/ /don rgyan 'phrin yig 'od zer dkar 'jam dar/ /ga bur ngad ldan sems kyi kun da'i dpyid/ /'khor mtshor srid bzung mong brtul 'dam rdzab kyis/ /ma gos gnas lnga rig pa'i 'dab stong khyod/ /zug jus ba mos ma reg legs bshad kyi/ /sbrang rtsi mdzad med gtam snyan rna ba'i bcud/ /'dir gnas thos bsam sgom 'bras mi ldan yang / /na tshod rgan po'i sdong po tshes sbom pa/ /chos brgyad khang bu lo ma'i grib bsil ngogs/ /'gro (190na sgoms ngal gsor spyod 'dod rmongs 'dun tsam/ /dkon cog thugs rje bskul ba'i mgrin rnga'i glu/ /snyan tshig rgyud du drangs pa'i sgra dbyangs dang / /lhan cig bdog pa'i skyes kyi tshan grangs bcas/ /phun tshogs rten 'brel sgo brgya bsgrigs 'di spro/ /las nyan gyis 'phangs sgrib pa'i lus can nga / /mi zad skye 'chi'i gzhan dbang rjes gong yang / /'gro mang 'drid pa'i sgyu thabs lhur blangs nas/ /ring 'tshor khas 'che'i thog rdzun khrel dgod rgyu/ /kye ma lkog tu ma gyur rang rgyud la/ /mngon sum ston du byed pa bdag gcig pu/ /ma yin bod 'bangs gzhan phan 'dren pa sa /rlom pa'i bla chen phal gyi rnam par thar/ /'on te sa spyod khyod kyi lhag pa'i sems/ /gaṅgā'i yab gzhag spun zla las babs pa'i/ /bden tshig rgyu 'bras ( yan lag brgyad ldan klung / /chos nyid rgya mtshor 'bab de gang gis ldog /sras bcas rgyal bas byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /bdag yid dad pa'i za ma tog 'khyil bas/ /nyi ma'i bu ngal las kyi me long che/ /dor te bskal bar gnyid la cis mi g.yur/ /tshe dang yon tan kun gyi rtser son pa'i/ /spur rgyal bod kyi tshangs pa rgan po nyid/ /da dung sdo bzhi'i g.yar ngo 'char ba'i mig /bgrad nas phan bde'i gzigs mor yun du ltos/ /srid pa'i gnas lugs brjod pa'i tshig gi mtha'/ /mdzad pa'i go skabs med phyir mi pham mgon/ /dbus 'gyur yul grur chos 'khor bskor min par/ /bcu gnyis khyim du nyi zla'i 'gros bzhin 'tshal/ /pad rag zhun ma'i khu ba nyer 'bab pa/ /rkang 'thung (190ba)phur ma'i bam po'i rtser son pa/ /mkhas khyod btung bar 'os phyir chom rkun gyi/ /mi phyed thun 'tshams rgya yis spras 'di'o/ /—482

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('alha r+sā sgos pa dung thod can gyis blang dor rim gro'i skul ma sa pa'i gsung shog byung ba'i lan tshul 4sto sgrub pa'i bden gto/ rnam 'dren yongs kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa rnams/ /rgya gar paṇa chen gzugs su legs shar ba/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje pho nya mthu rtsal can/ /lha chen tshangs pa'i gsung 'phrin dar dkar 'byor/ /spyi dang khyad par yongs la nyer 'tshe ba/ /yid srubs sde dang bcas pa'i smag rum rnams/ /mthar byed thub gsung klog sogs rnam dkar dge'i/ /lung bstan nyi mas bde skyid snang ba spel/ /lkog gyur mtha' dag me long byad bzhin ltar/ /rab gsal blang dang dor bya ma lus pa/ /ji bzhin nyams su bstar mod slad mar yang / /stol ba'i spyan gyi gzigs nas ma 'a sum ston/ /deng dus mi bsrun 'byung pos rgyud brlams nas/ khungs ldan srung mar rdzub 'a mig 'phrul mkhan/ /byung snyigs ma'i dus kyi skal ngan yang / /lha khyod mthu stobs rdo rje 'bar bas cho mes/ /'bras dkar rin cen spungs pa'i chos grwa che'i/ /bstan srungs sngon chad khog zhugasangs pa la/ /dog cha'i gnas med ring min 'byon 'gyur pa'i/ /rgyu mtshan rnams kyang yid kyi dpal ber 'khyil/ /lha snyan mdzes par byed pa/'i do shal du/ /zla zhun thags su btags 'dra'i lha rdzas zung / /gser skyems sa zla'i 'khor lo dang bcas te/ /mgos lha'i dkar cha'i dus tshes bzang bar dge /sa sprel lho 'byug pas tshur rgol byas par (191na7dong len du dpung bcug skabs bsam yas su lha sa nub pa rin cen rdzong lta byas te gnod sbyin chen por spyan gzigs dang bcas phyin bcol du gsol ba rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i mel tshe mkhan/ /dpag dka'i mthu stobs mnga' ba'i rgyas la gyis/ /sdebargyad dmag gi kha lo sgyur ba'i dpon/ /chos rgyal sde lnga sprul yum blon por bcas/ khyad par skye rgu rnams kyi srog pa'i rtsar/ /rang bzhin las kyis grub pa'i bla che'i gshed/ /dpal ldan gnod sbyin dbang po'i tsi dmar ba/ /bka' gnyan dregs pa'i tshogs kun snyan gson kye/ /lho rong sna tshogs grub mtha' 'dzin mang po'i/ /mnga' 'bangs g.yo sgyu shed kyis thob pa yis/ /ma tshim tshur rgol sgom chen mas dang ming / /gzung nas 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'phrog la gzigs/ /rang zhabs sa mtshams 'dzin pa lhur blangs kyang / /—483

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyelan chags bu lon snyeg 'dra'i bsam sbyor la/ /gzung dang dpang mdzod bden brdzun drang shan phye/ /pha rol dgra dpung mngon spyod las kyis sgrol/ /dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i dpung tshogs bshams pa'i g.yul/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i lha ngo gzengs bstod de/ /snyan pa'i gtam dang lhan cig 'phyar ba'i dar/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du legs sgrongs shig /dngos bshams thor gsal spyan gzigs kyis mtshon pa/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas legs sprul nam mkha'i mdzod/ /ji bzhin 'bul bzhes pho nya'i ngag gsol lan/ /rdo rje'i gsung gis gsang ba ston par mdzod/ / 9 sa sprel nyo 'brug pas tshur rgol byas par gdong len gyi dpung (191ba )bcug skabs lcang lo can pa bstan 'dzin dpal bzang rdzong sta byas te tshong 'dus su chos skyong bshan pa bya khri mig gcig par spyan gzigs dang bcas 'phrin bcol du gsol ba gzhan sde mi rtag lam du 'god pa'i mtshon snon/ log 'dren snying gi khrag dron skan sgra dang / /bcas te dgyes gsol srog gis bshan pa che/ /bstan srungs chen po bya khrid mig gcig pa/ /srid gsum skad cig myul ba'i lha khyod gson/ /gter ston dri med kun dga'i bar bkab tu/ /lho bod bde ba'i gshed mar sgom chen gzugs/ /'byung ba'i lung bstan dus babs deng gi skabs/ /bsam sbyor rtsub mos tshur rgol byed par dgongs/ /gzugs can dmag dpung bshams dang lhan cig par/ /bod skyong dregs pa'i g.yul gshoms mtshon rtse sa /lho 'brug srid sder bcas pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /mi rtag lan bu bkod la dbyings su sgrol/ /gser skyems go mtshon cang shes mthun rdzas kyis/ /dregs pa'i dbang po khyod bzhed yongs bkang ste/ /chib pa yar lam nas gsol legs nyes rnams/ /lkog tu gyur kyang gsal bar smreng du gsol/ /sa sprel lo 'brug pas tshur rgol byas par gdong len du dpung bcug skabs chang mkhyen pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse la mor rdzong sta bgyis te chos skyong tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can la spyan gzigs dang bcas 'phrin bcol du gsol ba blang dor bzhin ras gsal ba'i me long / lkog tu gyur kyang khyod kyis mngon sum du/ /gzigs pa'i dri med spyan ldan srog gi bdag /tshangs pa dkar po dung gi thor tshugs can/ /'bod pa'i sgra la snyan gyi dbang po gtod/ /rtag tu 'brug —484

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('artsod sna 'dren 'gro ba'i bde/ /'joms bzhin sgom chen ming 'dzin lho 'brug gi /tshur rgol byed 'di bden rdzun bshan 'byed gnyer/ /(192na jigs pa'i sdod pon dpung tsho gos ma yin nam/ /rang sabazung kyang da dung mtho 'tsham par/ /de lan 'jal phyir bshams pa'i g.yul ngo 'dis/ /gzhan srid sde bcas bcom nas rgyal ba'i rnga/ /brdung ba'i sgra dbyangs 'dzam gling kun khyab mdzod/ /o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas bod yul 'di'i/ /bstan 'gro'i srung mar bskos pa khyed rnams kyis/ /'di lta'i gnod byed thal bar mi rlog na/ /zhing bcu'i gshed ma grags pa ming du zad/ /dngos sprul thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas 'di/ /sgo lnga'i dbang por sim ste dgyes bskyed nas/ /cung zad ngag gi lam nas gsol ba ltar/ /blang dor me long nang gi byad bzhin ston/ /sa sprel lha 'brug pas tshur rgol bgyis par gdong len du dpung bcug skabs thang po cher lcang lo can pa bstan 'dzin dpal bzang rdzong sta byas te thang chen rgyal po chen por spyan gzigs dang bcas wen bcol du gsol ba ha ha'i gad brgyangs/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po shing bya can gyi blon/ /bshan pa lag dmar mthu stobs rdzu phrul bdag /spyan sngar dam skong mchod sprin tho gsal ltar/ /'bul gyis zhi rgyas dbang gi las kun sgrubs/ khyad par mi bsrun bsam dang sbyor ba yis/ /tshur rgol lho 'brug dmag gi dpung tshogs kyi/ sha khrag srog dbugs cham chem zhal gsol ba'i/ /drag sbyor mthu yis gzhal sde sba bkong zhig /bod yul skyong ba'i lha srin sdobargyad kyi/ /zhal khyim mthon po'i dbyings su dpangs stod nas/ /rang srid dpa' bo'i dpung tshogs rnams rgyal ba'i/ /(192ba)sngo sgra ha ha'i gad brgyangs phyogs bcur sgrogs/ /dpral ba'i dbus na nyi ma ltar 'khyil ba'i/ /dmar zlum spyan gyis steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun/ /gzigs nas bgyi bar 'os dang 'os min rnams/ /ston cig pha mes brgyud pa'i bstan srungs kye/ /—485

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)tshab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa bya lor bris pa'i chab 31ga 'phrin yig khag /sa bya lo gsar dga' ston thog lcog gra sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i 'phrin yig bdog pa 'i skyes dang sa bsrings pa 'byor ba'i lan lnga rig gser sgong sbrum pa'i rgan po/ ma : de she da mo po statsā tu dri to me di ni pu k+ṣi na po dzi ta myu raḥl yo da k+ṣi 'o ku khyi lu gri ba ta gi tate ka sta shrī khri ru lta ṇ+ḍi yaḥ 'phags khung sbyor rdze ton phreng ༅/)pa'i yul du zhi bar nyer 'bod pa/ /bzhi ldan sa bya gsar du tshes pa'i dung / /phun tshogs g.yas 'khyil shis pa brjod pa'i glu/ khyod mgrin rgyud mangs sgrar blangs rna bar 'jebs/ /(193na 〉 legs bshad don gyi skyes bzang mi na gaḥ /bdog pa'i tshan grangs gos kyis rab klubs nas/ /dpyod ldan 'dun sar dga' ba'i gar bsgyur ba/ /blang dor 'byed pa'i mig gi gzigs mor che/ /mang thos nor gyi lci ba'i khyod lus pa/ /zug rngu'i chu gter glong las gyen 'degs pa/ /bsod nams gzugs can bzhin byas rus sbal gyi/ /ngal ba'i khur chen ma btang tshul la spro/ /'di na thos bsam sgom par mos blo'i nyi/ /rnam g.yeng rlung gis mkha' la lhag brel yang / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i snang ba 'od po ches/ /thub bstan 'dab stong bzhad la mi dman tsam/ /bgrang bya'i gzings kyis na tshod chu bo yi/ /sum gnyis tsam las bcad par gyur min yang / /lnga rig gser sgong gang blo'i mngal sbum pas/ /gcig tu rgan por gyur te phyang mo nyug yi/ba brgyud kha ba'i rdul brtsegs ches dkar ba/ /srid zhan na bun 'khor ba gshis yin tshe/ /chos brgyad ri dwags gzugs brnyan dang bral ba'i/ /mi la sngon med zla bar gang gis bston/ /'on te deng dus kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /mar mi dwags po'i rnam thar dri ma med/ /'dzin kyang shong dpang bstan pa'i nyin mor byed/ khyod min phur bus btsal kyang ma rnyed ngal/ /deng nas mi pham mgon de 'phags yul —486

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan pag tu 'god pa ra po snyan rgyud mang / ('du/ /loms sprin gos kyis ma man bas de srid bar/ /gsar tshes dus ston 'phreng bar spel kun tu/ /nyams 'gyur snyan pa'i glu ru rtag longs shig /nam yang gang gi rgyud la dug gsum gyis/ /brlang por spyod pa'i rtsub rag dang bral ba'i/ /zhi (193ba'i jam ches dkar mched por 'os pa'i rten/ /'phrin yig lus phra'i bag yod gos su klubs/ /sa sprel gong na bar klung tshe mchi dang / ta dben lta / shrī'i dbon po gnyis gser yig tu mngags pa'i bka' shog /gnang sbyin sog bod gzhung gi bde thabs snyan du gsol bar zhal gyis 'ches pa'i lung bzang po dang bcas byung ba'i pheb lan gyi zhu yig 'bulaskyel du thang sag zlog dpon blo bzang 'jam dbyangs dang / khang gsar rab brtan rdzong sta byas skabs phul ba 'gro kun phan bder sbyor ba'i gto snya phang 'tsho sgra dbyangs/ ba ha ba ma hā rā tsa tā swā re dza skru di po 〉 ṣa tsa gro : snyirdza sa ni/ ni ṣa ma / sa twa u ban ba ma 4 kā (shu kro khru :sto khyi di ba sgru la yoḥ mang (sdeb sbyor me rtag phreng ba/)pos bkur ba'i rgyal khab chen po na/ /'dzam gling yongs kyi gtsug tor rtser mdzes khrir/ /'khod pa'i mod la rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i mgron/ /'gugs mdzes 'jam dbyangasagong ma'i zhabs drung du/ /(194na)su sti ka yi sgra las nyer drangs pa/ mas brjod tshig gi me rtag legs 'thor zhing / /tsan dan sdong po'i dri bzang rab 'thul te/ /mi phyed dang ba'i yid kyis mchid 'di zhu/ /lha gcig bka' lung gnam gyi she mong rtags/ /gser 'byug sder lngas yongs su bteg pa dang / /phun tshogs bdog pa'i gnang skyes gya nom bcas/ /son tshe khyod zhal ma lnga zhe sum mthong bzhin spro/ /mkhyen brtse'i sa bon rgyal rigs gser sgong du/ /smin pas nor 'dzin la gnas tshangs pa che/ /gzugs sku rdo rje lta bur rtag brtan pa/ /lus can yongs kyi bsod nams zong gis bsgrubs/ /de tshul thos pa'i mod la rab dka'i sa/ /thob 'dra'i yid dbang bde bas 'byams klas tshe/ /sna tshogasakun rtogs bag la nyer zha ba/ /bsam gtan dang po'i mig mi 'dzum rjes 'gro/ /rtsod dus gser gyi 'khor lo mkhar 'phags pa'i/ /gang gi drin gyis 'gro rnams rdzogs ldan bzhin/ /spyod pa'i grib mar sde snod gsum pa yang / /thub pa'i bstan la ri mor bgyid 'dun tsam/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun —487

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)gyis mgrin gcig par/ /skye rgu'i mgon du gtsug nas dbang bskur bas/ /lha khyod bltams pa'i dus la 'jig rten du/ /rnam smin ches dkar dge ba'i mtshan mas khyab/ /mi bdag bsod nams brgya phrag nyi ma'i lus/ /'bar bas srid 'di'i dregs (194ba〉rdon smag rum kun/ /pha mthar byed na rgol ngan me khyer 'od/ /'joms la mtshar du 'dzin pa byis pa'i blo/ /legs byas nya phyis yangs pa'i khog pa nas/ /rtag tu 'bab pa'i phan bde'i mu tig char/ /spyod pa'i dbang thang dar drags skal bzang can/ /sngon byung gtam las deng sang khyod nyid tsam/ /'khor ba'i phun tshogs yod rgu bstar ba las/ /lhag pa khams gsum snod 'dir ga la zhig /gtan 'dun thar pa'i zhing du rgyud lnga'i 'gro/ /sbyor nus nges par don ldan dam pa'i chos/ /de tshul nyi ma'i gnyen gyi gsung rab tshogs/ /'brul med legs grub zhwa ser 'chang ba'i bstan/ /rgya dang hor gyi nor 'dzin yangs pa'i gzhir/ /spel nas mya ngan med pa'i rnam thar skyongs/ /'phags chen dam pa rgyal po'i srid bzung nas/ /'gro mang gtan bder 'god pa gshis yin na/ /'jam mgon thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan khyod/ /dkon cog gsum la ri mor mdzad par rigs/ /mes dad yad mes bsod nams stobs kyis rgyal/ /yab gcig dus kyi bdag por gnam gyi bu/ /rim byon bzhed pa'i lugs gnyis khrims kyi srol/ /zla med mkhyen pa legs drung gsal bar 'os/ /dgyes pa'i spyan gyis dus kun nyer btsa' ba'i/ /'dzum zhal lhug par bstan pa'i bka' mched 'phreng / /bskal pa'i pha mtha' rdzogs min rab stsol ba'i/ /dga' ston bdud rtsi yid la rtag 'bab mdzod/ /lhar bcas skye rgu'i ral pa'i cod pan du/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i (195na sta skyel mo krung bcas nas/ /zhabs pad tshe mtha' yas ba'i mgon po ltar/ /bstan smon mchog gsum mthu yis 'grub byin rlobs/ /srad bur brgyus pa'i dkar dmar rin cen shal/ /sna tshogs 'jam phrug khras sogs bdog pa'i rten/ /dri med rnam par dag pas 'dren byed du/ /thogs slad thun 'tshams rgya yis mngon par 'khyud/ /pa chu bo'i gser gyi mdangs 'dzin pa/ /tshe ring bya yi gnam lo'i nag pa'i zlar/ /dngos po kun gyis btud yul pho brang char/ /dang ba'i yid kyis phul pa —488

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('dza byu/ /sa bya bsam yas mdo sde mchod pa'i thog rgya drug pa dbang 'dus btang skabs chos rgyal chen por 'phrin du gsol ba nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'byed/srid gsum dbang phyug gnag snum ral pa'i rtser/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng bka' rtags zla tshes pa'i/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal gsang yum blon po sogs/ /bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas kye/ /deng nas mi 'gyur lhun grub gtsug lag khang / /bod 'bangs phan bde'i bsod nams zhing gnas par/ /mdo sde mchod pa'i dus kyi dga' ston du/ /tho gsal bdog pa nam mkha' mdzod du spel/ /drag shul gnam lcags thog gi rjes 'gro phyir/ /dgra bgegs nyer 'tsho'i mthu stobs thal bar zlog /phun tshogs 'dod pa 'jo la dpag bsam gyi/ /mched zlar gyur pas bsam ba'i re ba skongs/ /thub bstan nyi ma 'gro ba'i bde skyid mkhar/ /nam yang 'char nub spangs te rtag gnas shing /gangs can ljongs (195ba 'di'i nad 'brug rgud pa'i mun/ /rab zhi kun dga'i snang ba ches cher spel/ /tshe ring 'dab chags gnam lor nyer shar ba'i/ /snon gyis nya ba spre'u zla ba yi/ /dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes bzang bar/ /gtsug lag lugs brgya'i 'dun sa che nas dge/sa bya bsam yas mdo sdomachod pa'i dus stan thog rgya brug pa dbang 'dus btang skabs bstan srungs gnod sbyin tshe'u dmar po 'phrin du gsol ba rdzogs ldan dga' ston/ sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po yis/ /bka' nyan dregs pa'i dmag dpon che/ /srog bdag gnod sbyin tsi'u dmar ba/ /dri bral lha yi snyan gyis gson/ /mdo sde mchod pa'i dus ston la/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas brlabs pa'i skyes/ /deng nas ji srid spel ba'i ched/ /pho nya bdog par bcas te mngags/ /thog med sgrub pa'i rtsal ldan pa'i/ /dpag par dka' ba'i rdzu phrul gyis/ /zhi rgyas dbang gis las rnams kun/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten ma lus dang / khyad par spur rgyal bod yul 'dir/ /rtsol ldan nyes brgya'i zug rngu kun/ /rab zhi rdzogs ldan ltar spyod mdzod/ /srid gsum che ba'i rig sngags 'chang / /pad+ma thod phreng spyan snga sa /ji ltar dam bcas zhal bzhes pa/ /nam yang g.yel ba med par mdzod/ /—489

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags khyi 31ra bris pa'i chab sna(ga 'phrin yig khag /lcags khyi'i lo gsar dga' ston gyi thog sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos snyan tshig lam nas drangs pa'i 'phrin yig bdog pa'i skyes dang bcas bsrings pa 'byor pa'i lan thos sgo mo zung du 'jug pa'i (196na btam/ e ma la 〉 gi sud pya khyu na bu pa stu ya no gan+ta shu kla su ba sta pya rā tra/ da sha ka te khu so she mi ṇa wa ya kokhyu mu khe phyu lha na ṇa gi ta la // e zho lo/drug sdeb sbyor me tog phreng wo/sgo phun tsho gos 'dod rgu'i nor skyongs mkhan/ /dri med du kū la yis gos gyon nas/ /phyogs 'dir bde skyid dga' ston spel ba'i sgo/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i thog ma'i dus kyi tshe/ bya rnya ka ( ya cu zhe ba ri ta sto na praspo 4 ma hwa mu dra pa d+man+ta taḥ ma ju da ga su sha ra : sto ṭa ta nā kā ṣa : ba rta ga skye swāyu sto khru ta mtha' yas shes bya'i gnas kun mang thos pa/ /gshis lugs phyag rgya chen por 'byams klas pa'i/ /'phags yul mda' bsnun ljongs 'dir ngur smrig gar/ /bsgyur 'dra'i snyan 'phrin bdog pa son pas spro/ (196ba)bu shā ka lbe khuhi shī ta dha rmo ga pha 6 su dwa ka swa bha dra bra ti ཿ drumaḥ si dha shā sa rgya ba tshu sku : ྅gru ba rgyu da PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBPROB PROBPROBPROB mang chos dkar sa bon btab pa'i 'bras/ /legs smin mtho ris rten bzang yongs 'du'i ljon/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i nags klung mdzes rgyan du/ /thos bsam yal 'dab dar drag gtam de snyan/ shā sa mukhyekhu) dwa da sho go la : rkye ma dhi di nā kā rma tā ra smi naḥ tā 〉 bi hā pa sa : ra rna yakā bi shu ba khyi na ཿ so dzi shu gta tsaḥ 'di na thub bstan bcu gnyis go la'i khyim/ /'jal ba'i blo gros nyin byed 'od po che/ /rnam g.yeng shing rta bdun gyis dal med du/ /drangs kyang thos bsam 'dab stong bzhad nus tsam/ / (197na thu na ne ma rtsi bu pa ra ྅ 7 rgya na dha rme ka na sti—490

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('ani / mu ne shā sa zhe/ tsi ta kṛ tā rla stoṭa su swā sko ta bi sgo sdi rdzo〉 smra su rja khyu ma 6 hi/gnas lugs rtogs rdzu'i lkog gyur g.yin 'drid chos/ /ma yin nges par thub pa'i bstan pa la/ /ri mor bgyid nus rgya bod brda dag gi /gtsug lag spel tshe shong dpang brgyud zin snyam/ da ṇ+ḍi tu lha 'igata pra ཿ tra gra/ khye khyis sba ཿ ྅: tho dzā ma sto hā/ ga yi rwa se 3 tā su ma yo ta ku gaṅgā sa 1 te na ba stu ra 〈 nā ma tu/ chu tshod srang dbugs zhag zla'i srad bu la/ /rab rgyus bgrang bya'i 'phreng ba rdzogs min par/ /rna ba'i bcud du 'os pa'i snyan tshig skyes/ khyab 'jug zhabs bsil ji bzhin chad med sgrongs/ (197ba) pa k+ṣe sgo noXnon ti sdu nya ste ku khyi chu de/ gi pra shīta ste sa stu ga 2 she no da hā re de 'u/ dbang (sde po sbyor sgrog phreng /)phyogs gan mdzod nas 'ong dar/ /zla ba zhun ma 'khyil 'dra 'di/ /'gro la rab dkar khyod kyis sems/ /mtshon par byed pa'i dpe ru bstan/ /mnga' ri gung thang pa mang thos rab 'byams pa bshes gnyen rnam rgyal gyis snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan lnga rig gsol ba'i nyin byed/ (198na)phu bo bo dha nu ba rlak+ṣa rnyi sa ra di rna ma sa rān+tiya ta rtir taḥ bā smi ka nywa ra bī 'o dan yi rta rma ga ka ba rwa so | tā yo rgya le 'i : baḥsngon (sde po sbyor me tog phreng tso/tshe|nyams yangs pa'i blo mig dkyus ring pos/ shes bya'i pha mtha' 'jal ba'i dpyod ldan gyi/ /nyams 'gyur rgyud mangs las drangs chos kyi glu/ /thos 'dzin bcud 'bab 'phrin yig bdog pa son/ /bcu gnyis rten 'brel zhing sa gshin pa la/ /legs byas sa bon smon lam drod gsher gyis/ /rab smin mngon mtho'i snye ma g.yur za ba/ /na 'chi lha min gdon gyis ma gces spro/ /gnyis 'thung mi yi gsob zhugs gar mkhan rnams/ /yun gnas sgyu thabs 'bad pas lhur len na/ /dal 'byor don ldan bsgrub khyod bskal pa 'di/ /rdzogs min de srid 'tshol yang yun mi ring / /las nyon mthus grub lus can so skye bdag /dam par 'khor slob tshogs kyis (198bsko| btags nas/ /nyer bteg lkog tu ma gyur rang blo la/ /khrel yang da dung gzhan 'drid rdzu—491—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shel bstan/ /phyogs re'i gtsug lag shes pa'i blo ldan pa/ /nor 'dzin sto bar mang zhig rab sgrum yang / /sgra tshad bzo gso nang rig kun shes khyod/ thub bstan gling bzhi gsal byed nyi ma bzhin/ /gang gi snyan pa ta myu ra yi sgra/ /thos pas brgya byin mig stong rab bgrad nas/ /lhun po'i spo la skyil mo krung bcas te/ /nyi zla'i sgron me mkha' la 'degs pa bzhin/ /sgo nga'i sbubs na gnas kyang mgrin rnga'i sgra/ /'brol ba'i ka la piṅka mthong ba'i tshe/ /'phur lding rtsed 'jos lha lam 'geng ba'i bya/ /ma yeng ca cos rna ba gcer ba'i rgyu/ /grags dang 'byor pas bstan 'dzin gzugs brnyan tsam/ /ma yin khyod kyis thos bsam sgom pa la/ /thub rnams dgyes pa'i legs so'i dbugs dbyung bar/ /me tog tshogasakyang dga' bas 'dzum pa bzhin/ /thams cad mkhyen nges blo bzang grags pa yi/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i drang nges 'byed pa'i gsung / /rgyal ba'i bka' ltar ches brling rab zab deng / /dbyis phyin 'grol nus u dum wā ra'i spun/ /kho bo gzhung mang thos pa'i grar zhugs kyang / /bla chen grags skam gzhan dbang khos po yi/ /thos dang bsam pa'i pha rol ma phyin pas/ /mes kyi gnam ru 'gugs nus yang tsha min/ /'on te 'phags yul rgyan drug mchog gnyis gzhung / /smra ba'i dbang phyug dkon chog chos 'phel gyi/ /drin las cung zad thos rnams rang blo yis/ /ji tsam dpog nus 'grel la spro 'dun (199na khyom/ /rang rigs rgan po'i ngag rgyun lhur len pa/ /blo chung rlongs pa kun gyi gshis lugs te/ /legs par bshad tshe phyi nang chos kun la/ /sbyang ba mkhas pa'i tshul yin khyod kyis sgrubs/ /lta bar phyag rgya'i sgro btags blo byas chos/ /rgya gar kha spu can la yongs ma grags/ /smin grol zab gsang las byung zung 'jug lam/ /nyams su bstar na 'dun ma'i lang rtser son/ /de'i tshul 'khon rigs 'jam dpal rdo rje dang / /kun mkhyen bu ston mnyam med btsong kha pa'i/ /gsung rab yongs spo' ljon pa rnyed bzhin du/ /blun sgom sdong du mngal ba'i khur du zad/ /bran 'khor 'du 'dzi'i rlung gis rtas drangs nas/ /snyan po'i skyes rabs nyi zla'i 'od gsal ba/ /mdo rgyud ba kū la'i kha mi 'byed pas/ /yang dag bshes gnyen lus phra'i 'gram chang sten/ /ming tshig yi ge'i dar gyi srid bu la/ /—492

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pelegs bshad mu snyi ka yi 'phreng brgyus pa/ /dpyod ldan sna tshogs mgu ba'i skyes bzang po/ khyab 'jug zhabs bsil mched por rtag tu sgro/ /'jam dbyangs tshad med gar sgyur mang bkur bab/ /chos dkar 'dod rgu'i cha shas gzigs ma'i rdul/ /ljon shing phur ma'i ba mo mthun 'tshams rgyas/ /spras te blo ldan khyod kyis btung bar spel/ /lcags khyi gong nas khang shi'i rgyal pos chos 'phel dge slong dang bsod nams dge slong gnyis gser yig tu mngags pa'i bka' shog gos dar rin po che gnang skyes bcas byung ba'i lan 'bul bar chab nag ri bo dga' ldan gyi bla ma blo bzang chos 'phel dang bkras rab pa gnyis rdzong sta byas skabs 'phul ba'i zhu leg khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i bden (199ba tshe gtam/ bicar rmi dwa dwa mi me go pra dzu ga rje bra su ma kya sa rdza sā : gi 6 lha gaḥ ku mu chu bi bhā PROB PROBdhī : sti dha ti la nywa sto dhi : tha ba di swā ra 〉 le/ 'jam (sdeb sbyor lag 'gro lhung ba/sgo nyen brtse bas rigs med skye rgu'i rnar/ /rab snyan dbyangs bdun glur len ngag gi lha/ /gzhen nu'i ngang tshul 'dzin yang rgan po'i blos/ khams gsum zil gnon dbang phyug dam pa'i drung / /swa sdi gar drangs phun tshogs brjod pa'i sgra/ /bkra shis me tog char bsnyil tsan dan gyi/ /bdug spos mngar po'i dri bsung 'thul bzhin du/ /dang ba'i yid kyis spobs mthor bteg nas gsol/ /mgon khyod 'jam dpal rdo rje me'i zlos gar/ /bsgyur phyir rgyal kun yab gcig sa bcu'i tshul/ /'dzin pas nyon mongs sgrib rgya las grol nas/ /skye rga na 'chi'i gdon gyis ga la rdzi/ /'on te tshur mthong dman blo dang bstun nas/ /mang bkur rgyal po'i rigs su srid bzung sku/ /(200na)snyan med lang tsho'i nyi ma 'dzam gling 'gro'i/ /legs byas mkha' la rang bzhin 'bar 'di spro/ /rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya seng ge yi/ /rjes zhugs sdom brtson sdosnod gsum pa yang / /dus kyi pho lha'i zhags pas ma bcings par/ /thos bsam sgom la sgo gsum gzhol bar gnas/ /lha gcig mdzad pa'i gtam snyan thos pa'i mod/ /kun rtog pir gyis yid la gang gi sku/ /nyar bris gsal bya'i dga' bde'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sa yis bskal yang mngon sum mthong ba bzhin/ /chos srid gnyis ldan khrims btsan gser gyi shing / /rgya mtsho'i —493

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyematha' klas 'gro ba yongs kyi gnyer/ /lci bas rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston 'di/ /gnam gyi she mong dpung pas bkug pa bzhin/ /lha bcas 'jig rten yongs kyi ral ba'i rtser/ /zhabs sen zla ba tshes la mtshar du ci/ /phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ /kun gzigs zhing gi mgon du sngags min nam/ /yid can brgyad khri'i tshe lor 'khor lo sgyur/ /'byung ba gsung rab mang por bshad pa brdzun/ /bden na bsod nams gser 'khor mkhar 'phags mod/ /gling bzhi kun gyi gtsug tor 'dud 'di ci/ /yab gcig shun tsi dmu thag skas 'dzegs nas/ /tshangs pa'i yul sar mes po'i tshul bzung ste/ /sa chen skyong ba'i gdugs dkar lha khyod la/ /gtad pa'i grib mar 'gro rnams bde bar 'tsho/ /brgya byin rdo rje gsod pas lha min mo'i/ /mngal lhung gcig tu ya mtshan de bas kyang / /gang gi 'jigs pa med pa seng ge'i sgras/ /dregs ldan yongs kyi lkog mar snying brobashamatshar/ /ched (2yob)du byas pa min par zla ba'i 'od/ shar ba tsam rgyas kun+da ba 'ad byed na/ /'jam mgon mi yi srid pa bzung khyod kyis/ /'gro rnams bde bar skyong ba ngang tshul yin/ /phyi nang rig pa smra ba grub pa'i mtha'/ /'dzin pa'i slob dpon mang yang lus can rnams/ /mngon par mtho dang nges pa'i lam yangs por/ /sbyor ba'i bslu med 'dren pa zas gtsang sras/ /mgon de'i lugs 'dzin shing rta che gnyis las/ /legs 'ongs zab rgyas chos kyi gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /cig car 'thung ba'i drang srong dzaḥ/ /kun mkhyen btsong kha pa las gzhan su zhig /de bstan lung rtogs chos dang 'dzin pa'i sde/ /mchog gsum nyer bkur gzugs can snying po dang / /mes dbon rnam gsum thang sogs sngon byon gyi/ /rnam thar 'dzin 'os khyod min g.yin na ci/ /tshe mtha' yas pa'i thugs gsang dpal be'u'i/ /bdud rtsis nyer gtams bum pas mi yi rje/ /bskal brgyar 'chi ba med par dbang bskur te/ /sras bcas rgyal bas bden tshig brjod gyur cig /'dzum ldan dgyes zhal go la'i khyim yangs nas/ /bka' mchid chad pa med rgyu nyi ma'i 'gros/ /don bzang snang ba rgyas pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdag snying 'dab brgya rtag tu ba 'ad par mdzod/ /mgrin pa skye ba lnga pa'i ri mo las/ /ma smad tshig don snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs —494

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pecan/ /rin cen 'phreng ba 'jam phrug bdog pa'i skyes/ /mdzes pa'i dar dpyangs lhab lhub ci yang g.yo/ /nor skyong gos dkar klubs pa'i bgrang bya yi/ /ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor tha skar gyis/ /(201na)mngon par rgyas tshe 'jig rten dbang phyug gnas/ /gru 'dzin gzhal med khang nas gus pas phul/ /lcags khyi sngags 'chang chen po dkon cog lhun grub kyi kun bzang dgongs 'dus kyi glegs bam dang bcas 'phrin yigazung ba'i lan dbu ru'i smag wo sel ba'i zla ba/ ra khru swā ra ma khyi lo ཿ ha phya ba da pā dz+nyā nā ya tsā sgyu lha bapā ga mu spuḥ bi du ma stu : sa tā tsa ni ra sto na hi li kha de ba rdzo na ne skyu tso : yu sa/dkon (sdeb sbyor byed mnyam pa'i brit+ta las bud med ma tsos pa/〉nag rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor spro bsdu'i bdag /phun tshogs mkhyen brtse nus pas smin grol pas/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang por lhun grub pa'i/ /'phrin yig lha rdzas dar gyi rtan ldan son/ /deng dus lhag bsam bdud rtse nyer 'jug pa'i/ /'du phung zla dkyil ra ri'i dri ma dang / /mi ldan thos bsam sgom pa'i cha shas nya/ /yongs gang khyod kyi ngang tshul thos pas spro/ /'di na dug gsum gyis bskyed rang 'dod la/ /'gro phan rnam (201bdakar 'phrin las gtam snyan pos/ /g.yin 'drid bla chen spyi zog sgyu thabs kyis/ /dal ba'i rten bzang stong par mdzad la g.yengs/ /'on te bshes gnyen mang bsten bka' drin las/ /thub gsung de 'grel rgya bod mkhas grub gzhung / /'chad nyan yid la goms blo'i bag chags mthu/ /yang srid mang por sad pa'i re smon tsam/ /ma zhig zhib por rdzu ba'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /rigs mthun zog gter ding mang rjes 'gro ba/ /ma yin 'khrul med pad gling thab mo'i chos/ /kun bzang dgongs 'dus glegs bam bsrings la rang / /dpal ldan skyur ra'i rigs chos rta ljang can/ /dus kyis chu lha'i thun 'tshams phag nyal tshe/ /rje btsun rat+na'i lugs 'dzin zla ba gang / /dbu ru'i smag rum sel ba'i byed por shar/ /lhag bsam tshangs skud nyer 'chang bram ze bdag /de tshe snyan tshig ril pa spyi blugs nas/ /legs sor brjod pa'i a rgya'i chab kyi rgyun/ /zla khyod mchod pa'i yon du spreng la brel/ /sgra tshad bzo gso grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i gzhung / /ma sbyangs sgom chen lag rdum brag 'dzeg mod/ /ha cang thos par 'byams pa'i rtog ge dang / /—495—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shetha snyad mkhan rnams ba tso'i smra ba bzhin/ /de phyir dam pa'i drin las rab nos pa'i/ /sgrub sde brgyad dang sgyu 'phrul 'dus pa mdo/ /theg dgu'i yang rtse lhun grub rdzogs pa che/ /nyams bstar 'di dang phye ma'i gtan 'dun sgrubs/ /las nyon gyis 'phangs skye rga na 'chi'i rgyu/ /chud pa bdag 'drar rang dbang ma mchis kyang / /nyid kyis ring por 'tsho zhes mol pa'i don/ /'grub pa rtsa gsum 'khor lor gsol 'debs (202na〉bgyid/ /yul dus ring bskal rgya bal hor sog nas/ /gser yig nyi zla'i 'gros 'dra'i ngang tshul la/ /bsams tshe skyud pa med pa ri mo'i khur/ /khyer ba'i pho nya'i 'gro 'ong chad med sgrubs/ /ro ldan bdud rtsi bcud du 'bab pa'i shing / /nyer thogs tshe ring don ldan gnyis skyes kyis/ /brjod bya rjod byed thabs shes 'dab brkyangs nas/ /sdom brtson rig pa 'dzin pa'i gam der 'phur/ /lcags khyi hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i lha chos la tshangs pa dung thod chen po ra spyan gzigs tshogs mchod dang bcas lung bstan zhu bar grwa tshang nyer pa blo bzang sbyin pa btang pa'i tshe 'phrin du gsol ba the tshom mdud pa 'grol ba'i phyag rgya/ snang ba gdod nas rang gi sems nyid du/ /yongs grol snang bzhi'i lam gyis 'pho ba che'i/ /sku 'grub 'chi med pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /lha chen khyod kyi zur phud rtse mor mdzes/ /bcu gnyis dam tshig cha ldan nyer gsol zer/ /lha snyan 'dab stong ba 'ad pa'i mod nyid la/ /lung bstan ge sar dgod pa'i bcud mngar pos/ /skal bzang bung ba snyan 'gyur glu len mdzod/ /mchod yon zhabs su bsil sbreng sngon 'gror bcas/ /nyer spyod 'dod yon phyi nang gsang mchad kun/ /ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa'i shel tshon bzhin/ /rnam bkra tshangs pa'i thugs dam nyer bar skongs/ /dngos 'byor bdog pa thor gsal longs spyod tshogs/ /mi mdzad nam mkha' mdzod du nyer brlabs nas/ /dbul pa'i byed por pho nya ched mngags pa/ /dri med spyan gyi ras mas bca' bar mdzod/ /the tshom dra bar chud pa'i kun rtog kun/ /ri mo zur bkod g.yar (202ba〉par nas gsol ltar/ /rdo rje'i gsung gis gsal bar lung ston zhes/ /skul byed 'phrin yig dus sbyor bzang por dge /—496

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (perab byung bcu gzhig pa'i lcags phag lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag /lcags phag lo gsar dus lcog gra sprul skus snyan tshig bsrengs lan grub rigs bstan pa'i sgrog tu song ba'i bden gtam// yaphya gi yi no ta bha sma rā ma ha : sga mya PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB/ be+e ro ṅgā shā sle ko da ya ya la ཿ myu ṇa : rā ṇi pu rba u sa nu bha khya/ gang (sdeb sbyor sna tshogs lha mo/〉she mgrin pa ma dres mtsho chen las/ /snyan tshig gaṅgā 'bab 'phrin skyes dang bcas/ /'gal byed gnam lor ches pa'i phun tshogs sgo/ /phye ba'i thog mar son la rjes su rang / /lha min chom rkun gdon gyis ma phyogs par/ /dal ba'i rten bzang bdud rtsi'i za ma tog /ring 'tsho'i sgyu thabs 'khor lo bzhi ldan can/ /tshangs pa'i brtul zhugs 'chang ba'i gtam de snyan/ /'di na ji snyed gnas lnga rig pa'i cha/ /phyogs tsam mthong bas rgan (203na)po'i khur 'dzin yang / /ji lta'i de nyid mngon sum rtogs pa'i blo/ /phra bsad dung gzhen nu'i ngang tshul bzhin/ /'khor ba'i shel la dug gsum tshon 'char ba/ /sgrib pa'i lus can kun gyi rang mtshang ste/ /gtan bde'i dbang gzhu bkra ba mi la'i mtshan/ /zla med nam mkha'i zla 'dra khyod nyid tsam/ /mthon po'i ri rtser gnas pa'i bu chung phal/ /thang 'khyams deng dus phyag rgyar rlam pa'i khyu/ /chos srid gnyis bral gsum par gnyid g.yur tshe/ /grub rigs bstan pa'i lag tu khyod song bzhin/ /rtag chad mun sdug g.yang sa'i dogs bral nyid / /legs bshad snang gsal tha snyad rig pa sngar/ /rnam dpyod nyi ma gang blo'i mkhar shar ba/ /bstan la zol zog med pa'i bya bar 'khyams/ /rtogs pa nang nas rdol ba grub pa'i rtags/ /phyir ston sngon dus dbyar rto ltar mod ding / /byings rmugs sgom du rlom pa phyi ba yi/ /nam mkha'i mdzub ris 'di la tshig dgod bro/ /stobs 'byor rin cen 'byung gnas sar snyeg ched/ /kun rtog 'og 'gyu ngal med rtag 'gro'i chu/ /mngon —497—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyegyur 'dod pa'i sgra bskyungs bya gzhag gis/ /btang ba'i 'phyon ma'i gar gyis 'gro mang 'drid/ /rtag 'grus grog skam rgya mang ngal ba tsam/ /legs byas ri rtse'i chu rtol gyen ldog min/ /chog shes ci byas bde ba chos pa'i rtse/ /'dod yon spyad kyang srid 'phel khyim gyi bdag /ngo tsha'i tshangs skud dag byed ku sha'i phon/ /yon tan spyi blugs 'chang ba'i bram ze khyod/ /deng nas bgrang bya brgya phrag tshes kun la/ /bkra shas rgyud las snyan 'gyur glu ru longs/ /dge ba'i rgyu spun mtha' klas nyer (203bang tags pa/ /bsod nams ri mo bkra ba'i du kū la/ /dpyod ldan drang srong phub ru khyod nyid kyi/ /mdzes byed stong g.yogs gos su klubs 'di'o/ /rab byung bas gcig pa'i chu yos nyang smad zha lu gser bkang gi chos grwar las gshin mchod pa'i tshe sde brgyad yal ba med pa'i skad gtong ba'i lam yig 'dri bdag nag po'i rkan sgra/ na mo badz+ra bhe ra wā ya/ rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po nas/ /rgya bal bod kyi mkhas grub rim par byon pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka'/ 'jam dpal rab tu khros pa dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi lung / gong ma'i lung gis de'i chi kying gang zhes srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan du dbang bskur zhing / dus dgra'i dbang po'i rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bas go bar byed pa'i gtam/ srid pa gsum na gnas shing rgyu ba'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa spyi dang khyad par mnga' ris skor gsum/ dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ mdo khams sgang gsum/ rgya bal hor sog gi yul gso so'i bla ma/ slob dpon rgyal blon/ /rdzong sdod/ gnyer las 'dzin/ rgan dmangs/ ko gru lcags gsum gyi lam gnyer/ /sne mor mngags pa dang bcas pa'i skye rgu mtha' dag la zlo ba/ yosalo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer dgu la chos grwa chen po dpal zha lu gser bkang gi gtsug lag khang du/lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og 'jigs rung thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer chen po nas dam can chos kyi rgyal po yab yum ma gshin dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ /mchod pa dang / gtor mas mnyes par byas nas bstan/—498

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dzad(204na'i dzan gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams zha khas pad brtan pa dang / bstan pa spyi sger dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / bstan dgra rnams tshar gcad pa'i 'phrin las zhu rgyu yin pas/gzugs can mi rnams ngo mtshar gyi ltad mo mig gi bdud rtsir bsten pa dang / gzugs med rnams mchod gtor len pa la 'bad par rlung sems las su rung ba'i rnal 'byor pa 'di pho nyar mngags pa yin pas khyod so sos bkur sti grogs su gang 'gro dang / mtsher babs su gnas mal stob pa/ ka gru lam 'phrang la sgrol 'don sogs mthun rkyen du 'gro ba gyis/ gzugs med rnams kyis kyang 'di pa'i 'gal rkyen sel ba dang / mthun rkyen spel pa'i grogs kyis/ gal te gnod 'gal byas tshe gshen rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa rab tu khros nas 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zas skal du gtad na mi skrag pa e yin/ mdzes byed kyi lo khrums stod zla ba'i nyer lnga la pho brang chen po ta la nas bris/lcags glang cha dkar da rgan chos rjes bka' 'gyur rgyu'i mthing shog sogs dngos po mang du byung ba'i lan smon lam dag pa'i mtshams sbyor/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma 'a lus pa'/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa kun gyi bdag /chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pas/ /dad ldan khyod la dge legs stsol/ /mngon par mtho ba'i rten bzang po/ /ring min char yang nad gdon sogs/ /mi mthun nyes pas ma gos par/ /sgo gsum bde bar legs gnasashing / /gnam sa'i dbang phyug gong ma che/ /dgyes pa'i bka' stsal dbugs dbyung bas/ /phyogs de'i bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs su/ /'gyur ba'i bya rtsol don ldan ngos/ /yi ge bkra shis kha btags bcu/ /gos bzang (204ba)srang do zho lnga'i gser/ /dngul gyi lha gzugs rnam pa brgyad/ /ja ser dang bcas nyams med 'byor/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab bri ba'i gzhi/ /mthing shog ko dra bzhi bcu drug /rnga mo brgyad dang ling yug bcas/ /lhag bsam blo yis bsrings pa legs/ /gnas skabs bsams pa'i don grub cing / /myur du sangs rgyas thob pa yi/ /bsngo smon dkon cog rin cen gsum/ /dbang por byasate nan tan bgyis/ /slar yang sangs rgyas de sras dang / /nyan rang sgrob ma dang bcas par/ /gsol ba btab nas khyod nyid la/ /phan pa'i skyabs 'jug yun du byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung —499—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)dang / /de'i sku srung mdud rten bsdus sgra/ /phrug chen skyer kha 'don ma drug /ring 'gag srab 'thug gzan gnyis bcas/ /lcags mo glang lon ma mthong zla'i/ /gral tshes dge bar bod yul gyi/ /rdo rje'i gdan gyur 'phrul snang dang / /zung 'brel gru 'dzin rtse nas bris/ /lcags sgrul khal kha tsho pa bdun dang o rod tsho pa bzhi phyi nang gi gzhung rnams spel ched du gnyer ba'i pho nya dang bcas mngags pa'i dus spyir lhab shog du bsrings pa mnyes gshin mja' ba'i mdud pa/ sa 'di'i mchod sbyin brgya pa gnam bskos bdag /phun tshogs bsod nams stobs kyi dbang phyug bkas/ /phul byung lha yi bla mar dbang bskur ba/ /tā la'i bla ma badz+ra dha ra'i gtam/ dben sa sprul pa'i skus gtsos/ byang phyogs yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi gzhir 'khod pa'i lus can spyir phan pa bsgrub pa'i bsams ldan kun mkhyen shākya'i rjes su zhugs shing gnas pa rnams la zlo ba/ deng gi dus khyed rnams mchog tu rnam par dkar ba'i 'bras bu las grub pa'i lus 'tsho'i ljon pa (205na)rab tu brtan cing / rang rang gis bgyid par 'os pa'i thos bsam sgom pa'i yal 'dab mngon par rgyas par gnas sam/ 'di phyogs su nyi ma'i gnyen gyi ring lugs pa'ang 'du ba snyoms shing / stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa spel ba dang /lus can kun la gcig tu dkar ba'i bsam pa yar ldan du mchis/ nye ba'i char da lta dbus gtsang gi ljongs su bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po 'byor te/ mnga' 'bangs mtha' dag dge ba'i lam la 'god cing / bstan pa rin po cher gus mchod lhur len par gnas skabs bzhin/ de phyogs 'khod pa rnams la yang dri smed byed par mchod yon thun mong nas 'di pa rdzong sta byas yod cing / snga sor de phyogs dang rgan nang so can la yi ge dag bcos su bgyis pa'i don bzhin gzhung bzang po spel ba'i bstan pa'i khur blangs kyi do dam byas 'dug pa'i gnas tshul 'byor pas yid spro/ dge ba mtha' dag rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs nan tan du bgyis yod pa dang / slad nas kyang bstan pa rin po che dbyar mtsho ltar spel ba'i mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub pa dang / phyogs der 'khad pa'i skye bo mtha' dag la phan bde 'byung ba'i phyir/ phan tshun du yid gnag pa'i bsam pa mtha' dag ring du —500

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pespangs te/ mdza' gcugs kyis bcings pa'i gzhung bzang po sngar rgyun bzhin du gnas pa'i dod bgyid dgos shing / gal te blo mi bsrun pa 'ga' zhig gis rang rang gi yon bdag sogs phyogs su bzung ste lugs gnyis dang mi mthun pa'i smad pa las 'gal tshe/ dam can rgya mtsho dpang du btsugs pa'i mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis lus sems la brnag (205brda ka' zhing lci ba'i chad pa 'bebs pa la mi 'jigs sam/ smras pa don ldan du bgyis pa rnams la gnas skabs mthar thug kun tu dge ba'i ting nge 'dzin bzang po'i skyabs 'jug byed pa yin/ zhes 'phags pa'i yul du bṛ ṣa zhes 'dod cing / bod skad du myos ldan zhes bsgyur ba/ lcags mo sbrul gyi lo'i khrums stod zla ba'i phyogs gnyis pa'i rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi lugs zung gi sgo 'phar cig car 'byed pa dga' ldan pho brang nas bris/ byang phyogs yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi gzhir 'khod pa'i khal kha'i rgyal po/ tha bu nang mi bzang dmangs dang bcas pa mtha' dag la zlo ba/deng gi dus khyed rnams mchog tu rnam par dkar ba'i 'bras bu las grub pa'i lus 'tsho rab tu brtan cing / rang rang gis bgyid par 'os pa'i blang dor gyi gnas rnams phyin ci ma log par 'dzol med du gnas pa'i skabs su mchis sam/ 'di phyogs su dpal ldan shākya'i 'phrin las pa'ang 'du ba snyomasashing / stobs bcu mnga' ba'i ring lugs spel ba dang / lus can kun la gcig tu dkar ba'i bsam pa yar ldan du mchis/ gos ma rnams gong dang 'dra ba la/ gal te blo mi bsrun pa 'ga' zhig gi byed pasasmras pa las 'gal tshe/ zhes pa nas gong dang 'dra bzhig /khal kha'i rgyal po/ mi bzang sdod mangs dang bams pa laganang ba'o/ /kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras po'i 'phrin las par ming yongs su grags pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde/ ming gzhan jing gir gan gyi yul du tā la'i bla ma badz+ra dha ra zhes pa'i gtam/ dad stobs ldan pa dza sag thu rgyal pos gtsos pa'i khal kha'i rgyal (206na)po rgyal rigs dbang tha bu nang mi bzang sogs lugs zung gi bya ba'i kha lo sgyur ba mtha' dag la zlo ba/'gro ba kun la gcig tu sman par mdzad pa'i phan dang bde ba'i dpung gnyen dam pa/ rgyal ba nyi ma'i —501—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)gnyen gyis mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i rgyu sgrub byed kyi thabs su gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis bka' 455 ba mtha' dag /brje dud bya'i snying po mi dge ba bcu spong ching / dge ba bcu bsgrub par gsungs pas/ sngon gyi 'dzam gling yangs pa'i rgyal khams su byon pa'i chos ldan rgyal po rnams kyis dge ba bcu'i khrims la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don rlabs po che bskrun pa ltar skye rgu kun gyi phan bde 'byung ba/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la rag lus shing / de yang yul so so'i sa chen po skyong ba rnams kyis rgyal khrims chos bzhin du spyod pa la rag lus pas/ sngon nas rgyu mtshan rim/ par song ba ltar/ phyogs de'i phyi nang kun tu phan tshun mtha' dag mnyes gshin pa'i ngang tshul can gyis/ rang rang gi mnga' ris la chog shes pa dang / sdig spyod kyi tshul la ngo tsha shes shing / sngon nas ga snyen dang mdza' grogs su gyur pa'i khrel yod la rabs kyi spyod tshul nan tan du bgyis pa'i gzhung bzang po bde 'jags kyi lhag bsam gyi khur chen po dang ldan pa dgos tshul zhib pa er te na chos rje'i ngag nas smreng ba ltar/ brjod pa'i 'bras bu yang dag par smin pa nan tan gal che tshul 'dir bsam sbyor ngan pa'i kun dkris kyis log par 'bu na/ dam can rgya mtshos chad pas lus ser/sa la brnag dka' zhing lci bar mi 'gyur ram/ smras pa don dang ldan pa rnams la gnas skabs su legs nga 'i don rnams 'grub cing mthar thug rdzogs (206ba)pa'i byang chub mchog la reg pa'i bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs yid la 'grogs par byed/ 'phags yul a dha rar 'bod pa/ kun 'dzin zhes pa/ sa pho byi ba'i lo chu she pa dbang ngo/ kro bzhin gyis nya ba'i yar tshes dge bar chos sde chen po dpal /sngan 'bras spungs nas bris/tshangs pa dung thod can gyis blang dor gyi lung bstan mdzad pa'i lan du gsol ba chos kun bsgribs med gzigs la bsngags pa/bde ldan mgon po 'od mtshan gang gyi dbang / /mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i rnam rol pa/ /srid gsum zla bral rig sngags 'chang ba yi/ /pho nya bstan srung lha mchog tshangs pa che'i/ /mgrin pa ri mo g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / /blang dang dor bya gsal ba'i sgra dbyangs can/ /gsung 'phrin lha dar thun —5//2

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('amatshams phyag rgya yis/ /rgyas btab bya ma rta yis nyams med son/ /rab dkar kha bas bskor ba bod yul 'gror/ /nyer 'tshe'i nad yams zlog thabs mes dbon gyi/ /chos 'khor stod smad mchod dang gsung rab sgrogs/ /sgos rim lha gsos skang ba dgos tshul nges/ /las nyon gdon gyi 'ching rgya ma grol bar/ /'khor ba'i zug rngu lus grib ltar 'grogs kyang / /gnas skabs rang bzhin bde ba'i thabs tshul kun/ /rdo rje'i gsung gis bstan pa bzhin du bsgrub/ /lha khyod dpral ba'i dkyil na dmar zlum spyan/ /lkog gyur shes bya sgrib med gsal gzigs pas/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i thabasatshul rnams/ /ma sbas mngone sum lta bur slar yang ston/ /zhi rgyas dbang gis 'gro ba rjes 'dzin cing / /gdul dka' 'dul la drag sbyor 'phrin las tshogis/ /thogs med sgrubs shig pad+ma thod 'phreng gi /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bca' nye bar dgongs/ /dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i dar tshon gyi/ /snyan shal sna lnga gser skyems (207na dang bcas pa/ /mdzad med nam mkha' mdzod du byin brlabs nas/ /lha chen thugs dam gnyan po skong phyir spel/ /ka tshal bla ma rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub kyis lcags phag zla ba bcu gcig par snyan ngag gi 'phrin yig thong ba'i lan lha sngags me shes rol gar/ he ma ni ka spu ri bu twa mā mā ma sa ma nu ra khya dī ti yo hi dha rmi rla sha/mo'i ka 2 6 swā 〉 ma do'i du rna mo dra na 'a bu tsi stu du le lu sti kaḥ gangs (sdeb sbyor mnya pa'iXt+ta la me tog phreng ༅/) can lha gcig sras po'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /mtshungs med rat+na gnyis pa chos kyi grags/ /zhal lung bdud rtsis legs myos rig 'dzin gyi/ /rgya ldan 'phrin yig rten bzang sug par son/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i cha shas nya gang zhing / /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'od kyis srid zhi'i smag /mthar byed mkhas shing grub pa'i sngon med zla/ /nyer 'tshe'i mkha' glang dang bral rna ba'i bcud/ /'di na chen po'i rigs dang go sa tsam/ /gzhan snang 'drid pa'i sbyor bar 'gro phan zhes/ /bla r+pā rnam thar 'phyon (207bsgo'i gar bsgyur ba'i/ /stong zad gru yis tshe 'di'i sum gnyis brgal/ /ka dag me long ngos su zhi khro'i sku/ /snang brnyan lhun grub lha sngags ye shes kyis/ /yid srubs las —503

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyergyal bsrung bzlog 'phrin las rnams/ /bsgrub pa'i rnam par thar der bdag yi rangs/ /mkhan slob chos sgo skye sprul chen po'i gdung / /cher rlom tshang tshing stug po g.yur za yang / /rin chen phun tshogs ring lugs dzasbu'i ljon/ /legs bshad 'bras bu'i ro bda' khyod nyid tsam/ /de phyi a lha mi shigs srog gi ka /gzhom med rdo rje'i khams su bsgrub nus pa/ /rtsa rlung thig le gzungs sngags bcud len sman/ /zab gter gdams pa'i snying po nyams su longs/ /dbang dang rim gnyis ye shes las gol ba'i/ /gnas lugs phyag rgya gzugs med lha yi rgyu/ /tshe 'dir phung po 'od skur grol nus pa'i/ /rdzogs chen nyams su bstar ba gtan mdun rtse/ /gang gi mgrin pa'i 'khor lo ma dres mtsho/ /legs bshad yan lag brgyad ldan rtag 'bab bzhir/ /'phrin yig chu lha dbu ba'i do shal can/ /chad med bdag blo'i rgya mtshor phob cig gu /don ldan brjod pa'i ri mo 'dren byed zur/ /lhung phyir ljon pa'i shing gi bam po'i ngos/ /rtags kyi spu sdug bkra ba'i ko ki la/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang phyug mdun sar 'phur/ /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu byi lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag /chu byi rdzings po che sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos gnam lo gsar tshes kyis legs skyes spel ba'i snyan tsheg gi 'phrin la na bden gtam rlung mi bskur bar mngags pa/ (208na〉ka khyo / lo pra ti bha na khru lu she pa t+ta pya : k+tari gi 6 le khaḥ swā la ṅgā ri ra kha ཿ de bya ñja rlu sde khe 2 6 ka ti ka ni ñca ba rtiḥspobs (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i z-i t+ta las me tog 'phreng can/)pa'i mgrin pa bteg nas shis brjod 'phreng / /nyams dang 'gyur khugs glu ru blangs pa'i 'phrin/ /bdog pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i mi na gaḥ /snyim pa'i ra bar gar stabs ci yang bsgyur/ /mtshun lhas ngang gis ma srings bskal par gnyid/ /g.yur byed tshe yi g.yung drung nya phyis khog /mkhas khyod 'tshe ba'i mu tig dar drag pa/ /dwags brgyud bstan srog zungs —504

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (posu gyur de legs/ /'di na rnam gsum sde snod klog pa mkhan/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa'i zhe bcad ma nus kyang / /bka' dang dgongs 'grel du mar thos bsam gyi/ /bzang po'i bag chags brtas la zol zog med/ /rgya bod brda dag sdeb sbyor snyan ngag gis rtsis/ /lo paṇa mkhas rnams bgrod pa'i lam po cher/ /rnam dpyod shing rtas legs bshad nor bu'i dpya/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon khyod grags (208ba)rna bar 'jibs/ /byang chub rgyu tshogs thub pas sngon bsags pa'i/ /bden gtam rlung bskur gcig shes kun grol zhes/ /snyan gyi bu ram dngar yang mi la rjes/ /dar blo'i rtsod pa ma bzlog gang gi skyon/ /de phyir klog tsam mi shes lus bsrangs nas/ /lta stangasang nga nas dal 'byor stong zad las/ /rnam gsum shes rab bskyed la nges sbyar na/ /bdag g.yin bslu ba'i cho gar mi 'gyur drang / /rang zhal gsar du ngoms pa'i bgrang bya nas/ /bskal pa'i pha mtha' de srid phan bde'i srog /'tsho 'dod lhag bsam zla ba las 'dzags pa'i/ /ga pur thigs 'phreng spro ba gcig tu 'dun/ /tshangs ris grub pa'i blo gros rgan po khyod/ /su sti'i pi waṃ 'khrol dang lhan cig par/ /phun tsho gos me tog ma na ra yi char/ /lnga phrag bcu yi pha mtha' snyeg sar phob/ /kla klo'i grong khyer nor gyis gang ba la/ /mtshar du 'dzin pa byis pa'i blo gros te/ /legs par bshad la dpyod ldan tshogs mgu bas/ /snyan tshig rgyud mangs sor rtser rab bskul zhig /yi ge'i tshig don lang tsho rgyas pa'i zla/ /rten gyi chu shel dkyil 'khor la gnas brdzun/ /bden na thags kyi ri mo mngon sum du/ /gsal ba'i ngang tshul 'di la su zhig bsnyen/ tha kya seng ges cho 'phrul bkod pa'i rdul/ /bye ba phrag brgya kun gyi gzigs mo sa /legs shar mnyan yod mchod pa'i dkar po'i cha/ /rgyal ba dang por gru 'dzin rtse nas bris/ /lcags phag gong nas me reng byang gi tshogs gser yig brgyad pa tsam 'byor skabs bka' shog gos dar phyi gnang sbyin byung ba'i legs 'bul gyi zhu yig dang bcas bsam grub dga' ldan gyi bla ma blo bzang bstan 'phel dang lcang lo can pa bstan 'dzin dpal bzang gnyis btang skabs su phul ba'i zhu 'phrin 'dzam gling gtsug tor mdzes rgyan/ (209na) na ra sa ni dha khyu tu nāspu ta tswa nyi byu hā mā ya mā li : ta ) pa/ gi mo taḥ ba du ra gam na tsa nu ྅ du rdu se swā—505

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesgyu shā stu pa dwa da r+sha rka na/ lha gi sha ra/ zhing (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i prit+ta las rgyun chags dang po gtam pa'i char 'bebs/khams rgya mtshor ngo mtshar bkod pa sgyu 'phrul rol gar gaṅgā'i rdul/ /'gro ba'i dbang por 'tsham par legs ston kun gzigs mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ / (209ba)lha ni ka tsa pa ridza skru sta lha pa ko — 'i 9 khru bi tho sa spro rā ṇa ka kwa na sa ni/ ga gan ba su dha re shā riḥsnya pa te/ rnyi la ko dha ma ho t+ta ma nya lha ma to mu la tā/ 'dzam gling yongs kyi gtsug tor gyis bteg mang pos bkur ba'i gser gyi khrir/ /gnam sa'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i tshul 'dzin dpal ldan gong ma chen po'i drung / /su sti ka zhes shis pa nyer brjod pa'i/ /me tog sil ma 'thor zhing dri zhim spos/ /rab 'thul dbang po'i phyogs su bzhin ras dngom/ /gus tshul 'gog med sngon 'gro'i sgo phye ste/ /ris med lus can mdza' shes don rnams kun/ /lhun grub bu ram shing pa'i rjes zhugs nas/ /rnam gsum sde snod gzhung la klog pa mkhan/ /sdom brtson rgan pos dang ba'i mched 'di gsol/ /rgyal ba'i yab gcig zur phud lnga ldan pa/ /sgrib gnyis zad par spangs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos/ /thun mong gdul byar sa bcu'i tshul bzung yang / /skye rga na 'chi'i zug rngus ga la brdzi/ /de phyir lha (210na)mi'i mgon po khyod nyid la/ /snyun 'dri smed pa byis pa'i blo gros tsam/ /'on te 'jig rten mthun par 'jug pa 'di/ /yongs kyi srol lags nor 'dzin skyong ba gson/ /skad rigs rgyan gos bya rtsol tha dad pa/ /bgrang yas skye rgu'i bsod nams tshong thong gis/ /bsgrubs pa'i gang sku zo mdog rgyas pa'i gzi/ /brgya phrag nyi ma'i 'od la 'god de spro/ /mgon po khyod gsung 'jam snyan kun bzod gzhir/ /rgyu bar gtogs so cog gi dbugs dbyung yang / /brlang spyod dregs ldan phrag par btsan po'i khrims/ /gser gyi gnya' shing 'dzin ri gcig tu lci/ /'gro rnams bu gcig ltar brtse byams pa'i thugs/ /pad+ma'i 'dab bzhin mnyen kyang mi bsrun ster/ /gtum drag gsang ba kun 'chang mthu stobs kyis/ /'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rwa rtse phyogs bcur gdengs/ /'dzum zhal lung gis nyer mngags byang gi sogs/ /gser yig dgu grangs lag pad gyis bteg pa'i/ /gnam gyi she mong ri mo'i bka' rtags can/ /—506

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (ja )don bzang gnang skyes dang bcas lhor te spro/ /'di na lnga phung bro nad dang bral zhing / /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde dbyig 'dzin khyon/ /bla nas blar 'degs lhag bsam rus sbal khur/ khyab 'jug khengs pa'i ri bo snyil la brel/ /mi rje khyod snyan tshangs pa'i yul sa sa /grags pas sum rtsen bdag po'i ral pa'i rtser/ /zhabs sen kun phan 'god chad mtho ris skas/ /babs te sa 'dir yong la rings sam snyam/ /tshul des yid drangs ri rgya pa lhun po yis/ /chu gter mtshams las ske rags yan 'thon te/ /nyi zla zung gi sgron me rab sbar nas/ /(210ba)blta phyir g.yo med gcig tu gnas pa bzhin/ /gser 'brug tshang 'khyil lnga ldan sder mo yis/ /bteg pa'i rin chen khri la dbang phyug khyod/ /zhabs zung bskal brgyar mi g.yo rtag bzhugs pa/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i mthu yis 'grub byin rlobs/ /yangs pa'i sal gnas so cog gi 'gro/ /bka' drin grib mar mi brten mchis min yang / /yab rjes bstan pa gcig tu lung las kyis/ /dbang bskur dngos cag lha khyod ched du sems/ /de phyir sngon nasabyams brtse'i gru rdzings kyis/ /phan bde'i rin chen gling du drangs pa'i kha/ /snyogs pas spyi brtol bskyed de yang gsol pa/ /mi khrel dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal lhag par ston/ /bde skyid srog gi ka ba 'dzug pa'i sman/ /bka' yig bdud rtsi snying gi za ma tog /byams mgon dbus r+sār byon min de srid du/ /nam yang chad pa med par 'geng bar gsol/ /spyan ras gzigs pa 'bab brten rin chen 'phreng / /'jam phrug sna tshogs bdog pas nyer bteg pa'i/ /zhu mchid rgyan rgyas spud pa'i mai na ga: /gnam bskos rgyal po'i khab tu zlos gar bsgyur/ /nyal 'gro'i gos sngon klubs pa byi ba lo'i/ /chu shel dbang po dbo yis legs nya ba'i/ /dbyid kyi lang tsho ngom pa'i dus dge bar/ /rang byung 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang nas phul/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i dbang phyug ka tshal bla ma dkon cog lhun grub kyis nged 'brum nad las grol ba'i legs skyes dang lhan cig par rme ru bla ma brag sgo rab 'byams pas pad+ma bka' thang la rtsod pa'i lan gyi shog dril 'di ji ltar byung zhes dris pa'i 'phrin lan nam mkha'i ske rags/ (211na)ta ba shrī pa swa ha rba pā : khya mo rta ga tā swā ra 〉 snye ru rā ཿ ṇa—507

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyesha zhe/ pra ba k+ṣe 'i gi 6 ba nyu pa ñcamā sta na bi byo sta ta ཿ kha tu tsi hā yu khya/ khyod (sdeb sbyor mnya pa'i phrit+ta las las wo lhung ba/ mgrin pad+ma'i 'dab stong grol ba'i rtser/ /dbyangs can bung ba rjes chags rgyud mangs sgrar/ /gtsug lag bye ba'i glu ru len mkhas pa/ /gnas lnga rig pa smra de'i 'phrin rten 'byor/ /sdig 'bras go la'i khyim dbus mi rgyu bas/ /nyis brgya zug rngu sgra gcan dang bral ba'i/ /dal rten zla ba thos bsam sgom pa'i cha/ /yongs gang phan bde'i bsil zer 'gyed de snyan/ /'di na rdo rje'i tsher mas bcings pa'i rgya/ /thabs mkhas 'phrul gyi mtshon chas nyer bcad nas/ /sgo gsum bde bar bag pheb gtan gyi 'dun/ /sgrub 'dod yid kyi ri mo ma yal tsam/ /rtog ge'i tshig bshad sbun pas myos pa'i glang / /log rtog khog por brjod pa'i gom stabs kyis/ /snga 'gyur pad rdzing rnyog pa mda' lnga'i stobs/ /cher 'phel lnga brgya tha ma'i dus kyi skyon/ /deng dus skyed byed (211ba)ngan pa'i khron pa la/ /mtshang 'dzin blo mig dkyus thung byis pa rnams/ /rgyal khams shes bya'i pha mtha' ma mthong bar/ /mu cor smra ba'i kha de bdud kyis phye/ /thub rnams grangs med 'gro ba'i bsam pa dang / /mtshungasapa'i rnam thar bkod pa mtha' klas kyang / /tshad 'dzin blun po'i snying stobs rang gi mtshang / /'bad pas ched du gzhan la dngom pa bzhin/ /dpal sbas dug g.yos nus bral rtogs brjod dang / /las bcu rnam dpyod drang nges dgongs don ltar/ /pad 'byung phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam thar mkha' /pha waṃ gshog pa'i rtsal gyis gzhal nus min/ /nor skyong srang mdor sgrog pa'i skad gsang la/ /seng ge ba spu'i rtse yang mi 'gul bzhin/ /lung rigs khas len bral ba'i gdol gtam la/ /mkhas rnams brgal zhing brtag pa ngal ba tsam/ /'on te skye mangs goms pa'i sa bon tshogs/ /rab smin gnas lngar sbyangs stobs yongs 'du'i ljon/ /legs bshad 'bras bus dud pa'i dpyod ldan khyod/ /smra ba'i spobs pa gzengs su mngon par mtho/ /de phyir sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan gyi/ /rnam thar nyes pa'i dri bral chu bo'i klung / /log rtog rnyog mar byas rnams drungs pa'i gtam/ /ke ta ka nor gsar du bskrun 'di mtshar/ /tha snyad tshig gi mtha' la mdzad pa med/ /nges don snying po'i yang snying rdzogs pa che/ /snang bzhi'i lam —508

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('bazang 'od gsal longs sku'i zhing / /myul ba'i ngang tshul 'di la gcig tu smon/ /rnam gsum yo ga'i rdo rje rnal 'byor mchog /'chi med zil dngar yid kyi za ma tog /nyer gtams 'di dang gtan gyi mdun ma kun/ /g.yel med pa k+ta'i rgyun ltar rtson cig gu/ /don ldan rten bzang ring por 'tsho ba'i thabs/ /mi dman rtag tu khrus pa lhur len ngos/ /mol mchid mtho ris chu bo blo gros kyi/ /gdong bzhi'i ral pa'i slong nas rtag 'bab mdzod/ /rkang 'thung 'dab ma'i snying po nyer (212na)brtsegs te/ /bam por byas pa ro brgya bda' ba'i bcud/ /sa srungs mched zlar 'khru ba'i bdog pa la/ /thun mtshams rgya yis mi phyed dam du bcings/ /dpyid kyi pho nyas drangs pa sos kyi bzhin/ /mdzes sdug lang tsho ngoms pa nam mthong zla'i/ /dmar po'i phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa la/ /mang bkur rgyal po'i khab kyi rtse nas bris/ /byams gling mkhan po rtses dang nub sgo steng pa'i rab 'byams pa byams pa rgya mtshos grub mtha' mi gcig pa du ma kha bsgyur bar na brtsams pa' mi bsrun sgyu 'phrul rol gar gyi skabs chu byi 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan 'dam khrod pad dkar/ mi tri ya 41 kra brjo pa 2 spyi hi sa mā yi ta sno rma pā k+ṣi rgyu tshu lha ba kaḥ/ /pa sko ma ju sla ba ta su rdo na nasti ma ho pa dha shu 'a dzi yi zhi ya ku ka /gnyen (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i phrit+ta las me tog 'phreng can/)byams pa sangs mdangs so nyer ston cing / /tshul 'chos pha wang 'phrul gshog legs ngom gling / /'dam khrod gnas kyang de dris gos min pa/ /mkhan chen pad+ma dkar po'i 'phrin rten son/ /rnam gsum sde snod bcud kyis rab (212ba gtams pa/ /dal 'byor lang tsho rgyas pa'i za ma tog /nyes brgya zug jus 'tshe ba dang bral te/ /thos don bsam la ngoms med tshul der rangs/ /dngos cag dam par sgro btags snyan grags kyis/ /'gro mangs 'drid pa'i sgyu thabs bla chen spyi'i/ /rnam thar gzung la 'byor pa med na yang / /tshe 'di'i mdun ma don med khol por zad/ /sngon goms dge ba'i bag chags ches cher phra/ /dkar sgrib sdig lhung sa 'dzin lta bur spungs/ /rang zhe rang la 'brel ba'i spyod tshul 'dis/ /gzhan phan 'dren par rlom pa smyon pa'i gar/ /rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen khyod nyid kyis/ /rnam —509

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyedapyod dgu tshigs ring por nyer brkyangs ta/ zhes bya'i pha mtha' bcings tshe dga' ldan nas/ / 'jam dpal snying po dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal ston/ /deng dus blo gsal mkhas rnams rna ltar dor/ / 'phrin las rdzas la re ba'i 'chad nyan pa/ /chu med khron pa'i rjes su 'jug pa kun/ /skoms pa'i gdungs pas mya ngam thang du 'khyams/ /gna' bo'i chos kyi pha gzhis ring du skyur/ /lta grub gzhan gyi zhing khang ma rnyed pa'i/ /sdodagon zung gi mkha' la shes ldan khyod/ /zla bral gcig pur gnas pa'i zla ltar skyo/ /snying med er raṇ+ḍa yi 'khor ba la/ /nges par 'byung ba'i gtam 'di gcam bu'i tshig /min na gzhan gyi chos lugs snub 'dod pa'i/ /chags sdang tshig gi smra ba 'dis kyang nongs/ /nag po rdza ma'i mdog de dkar po sa /bsgyur bar sgam bu phyus kyang ma nus na/ /rang gi bstan la mi phan g.yin gyi rgyud/ /bsreg pa'i cho ga 'di la ngo mtshar ci/ /phyogs de'i (213nas btsun 'phyon ma'i gar mkhan 'gas/ /mthon po'i ra rtser nyi ma bsro ba'i tshig /mdzes mdzes gleng bar 'brul na phub ma yis/ /bkab pa'i chu dong nang du lhung gis dogs/ /paṇa chen shākya shrī'i chos lugs kun/ /deng sang ming tsam kha ba'i ljongs 'dir lus/ /rnam dag sdom pa'i rgyun de sa lugs la/ /btsongs nas tshogs chen sde bzhi ngal gso mjad/ /bsam gling bde chen bya 'dabs spyil pa de/ /phan bde legs bshad gling pas bdag gir bzung / /slong ngam mi slong khyed gtso ster mi ster/ /grwa tshang khur len rnams la rag gam snyam/ /glang lo'i dus kyi chad pa sel ba la/ /rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i gsung rab mang du sgrogs/ /gsod sar khrid pa'i dud 'gro'i srog mang blu/ /sāts+tsha khri tshar btab na legs par mngon/ /nged la zab mo rdo rje'i rnal 'byar gyi/ /thugs dam med phyir rtag pa ga la 'ong / /kun gyis mo mar mnga' gsol de don bzhin/ /skar nag rtsis kyi ju zhags phal cher bden/ /puṇ+ḍa rī dzi'i 'dab mar rgyu spun gyi/ /ri mo rab gsal pañca li ga'i dar/ /thun 'tshams rgya yi phang par ngal gso zhing / /skam po gra nang rgya mtsho'i gling der song / /chu byi sdings po che sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos gnam lo gsar tshes kyi legs skyes spel pa'i snyan tshig gi 'phrin lan —510

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dzadaganyis skyes rgan por bsngags pa'i glu dbyangs//(213ba)ba ca ne 1 thi tsushrī tso tswa kru tho zhi gi ba su rwa ba〉 8 ma hi lha rgya riḥ/ zhi khyi rba pā k+ṣa kā smyu su bha bya ྅lha ma : ha spa kyi bha tsa 〉 smi ni khe/ngag (ldeng sbyor mnyam pa'i mit+ta las me tog phreng ༅/)dbang 'jam dpal 'khor lo'i yan lag ldan/ /mgrin mtshor zhugs pa'i snyan tshig khrol ba'i sgras/ /grags pa phyogs bral rnar 'jebs skal bzang can/ /blo ldan phur bu'i mched zla der springs pa/ /spong bdun srad bur bsgril ba'i tshangs skud dang / /rnam thar gtsang dag ku sha'i chun po 'chang / /legs bshad spyi blugs chu rgyun chad med pa/ /bkra shis dbyangs su len pa'i bram ze khyod/ /bag yod bgrang bya'i dus kyi thog ma sa /snyan 'jebs tshig spyor daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung lugs rgyud/ /sdeb gzugs yi ge'i glur 'bab dri za'i snyems/ /'phrog pa'i ngo mtshar gzigasamor dngar 'di spro/ /dwags brgyud chos kyi ding mun 'jig rten zla/ /dkar dbus thos bsam sgom pa'i nyi ma khyod/ /nyes brgya'i chu 'dzin dang bral rgya ras kyi/ /bstan srog ring (214na gyi ung cho ga rdzogs pa bzhin/ /sgra snyan smra ba'i dbang phyug lo chen dbang / /gnyis pa khyod las gzhan du rnyed min kyang / /tshe 'di'i bya ba btar ba'i mi la rje/ /ngur smrig zol gyis brdo snyam 'phyang mo nyug /phyag rgya gcig gis kun rdzob byed pa'i gzugs/ /stong chen dbyings su btab pas rnam rtog tshogs/ /chos skur rang ngo sprod tshe gdul bya rnams/ /'og min gnas su 'tshang rgya'i re ba skyangs/ /de phyir gangs can sgrub brgyud ring lugs kyi/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag khyod du nges rnyed na/ /bde ldan zhing gi mgon po'i ngang tshul bzhin/ /mi 'gyur thabs la brtson pa cis mi rigs/ /'di na zhi 'tsho'i dpon rigs klog pa mkhan/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa'i snying phur ma thebs kyang / /shes bya'i lha lam gzhal ba'i blo gros kyi/ /nyi zla'i bgrod par 'grus la mi ngal tsam/ /bskal bzang 'di yi 'dren pa stong gi mtha'/ /rdzogs min gnam lo shar ro cog gi tshe/ /mgrin pa'i ri mo 'dzum pa g.yas 'khyil las/ /bkra shis skad snyan dung dkar sgrogs shig gu/ /bsnyen srid med par kun la gang gi sems/ /dkar ba'i lhag bsam 'di zhes mtshon byed du/ /ra ri'i dri bral dar dkar kha rdzar can/ /thun 'tshams khu bas byugs pa'i —51/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyergya yis spras/ /bza' shing ra ba'i khor yug gis bres pa/ /'chi med grong khyer sal 'phos pa'i spun/ /rig pa'i 'byung gnas g.yo ru gra nang gi /lcog bu'i shel dkar 'phreng bas mdzes der song / /tshangs pa dung thod can gyi sku khog dbon po sangs rgyas rin 'a na tshod smin ches pa'i dus kyi chos nyid lta bur gyur tshe ring sor ma (214ba)lon par rigs kyi tsha bo la khog zhugs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gsol bar bdog pa tshan grangs tshogs kyi 'khor lo dar tsos khang gsar rab brtan chu glang zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la btang skabs 'phrin du gsol ba lha zhal tshad med ston byed spel legs phreng rgyas/ /zhi dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i/ khyab bdag dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung / /spyan sngar thub bstan skyong bar zhal 'ches pa/ /g.yas 'khyil dung thod dpal ldan tshangs pa kye/ /ris med thub pa'i bstan dang skye rgu yi/ /phan bde'i legs tshogs spel ba'i khur chen pos/ /nyin mtshan g.yel med bya ra mjad na yang / /tshur mthong sems can rnams kyis rtogs pa dka'/ khyad par srong btsan rgyal po'i skyes lha che/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir gcig tu brtse mod kyang / /blang dor mngon sum lung du ma bstan na/ /blun rmongs byis pa rnams kyis ga la shes/ /de phyir lus can khog par ye shes kyi/ /snang ba'i gzi byin spar nas sngon byung dang / /ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur da lta'i spyod tshul kun/ /ston phyir spel legs 'phreng bzhin chad pa med/ /bod 'dir khog zhugs 'di yis mjug bsdus nas/ /li yul sham+bha la dang o rgyan sogs/ /gnas g.yin 'tshol zhes gsang gsang dngos stsol bar/ /phal cher the tshom dra ba'i 'khyogs la 'phyang / /thun mong lcags kyi sa skyong mi dbang gis/ /da lta'i sku khog gnyen mdun tsha ris la/ /phebs par stsol ba de bzhin zhal 'ches pa/ /rdo la bris pa'i ri mo ga la 'gyur/ /'on kyang da lta'i 'di nyid nam mtsho'i bar/ /gsar 'byung ma dgos lnga pa'i lam gyur tshe/ /snga sor g.yar dam mdzad la 'gyangs med du/ /lha khyod khog tu zhugs par (215na/nan tan gsol/ /gzhan yang spyi dang bye brag blang dor gnang / /dpral ba'i spyan gyis mngon sum gzigs pa bzhin/ /bslab bya'i lung bstan mtho ris chu bo'i gos/ /bka' mchid rgyal mtshan mdzes pa'i rgyan du klubs/ /mchod sprin tshan grangs thags la tsho gis 'khor bcas/ /dam ldan zur gyi rig sngags 'chang ba'i brgyud/ /—5/2

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (perab brtan rdzong bdar bgyis pa zhib cha kun//ngag gi lam nas 'bul bar lha snyan gson//dri bral bkra shis thags kyi lha dar zung //mi phyed 'tshams sprin rgya yis nyer btab nas//chu glang hor zla dang po'i dkar cha yi//rgyal ba gnyis par dmar po ri nas dge/chu byi hor zla brgyad pa'i nang du 'dzum lang rgyal pos bdog pa'i skyes 'phrin yig dang bcas mi sna dzā la bhaṇ+ḍa ri can byung ba'i lan gya 'go brgyangs shis brjod glu dbyangs/bde gshegs sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i tshogs//tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug drang srong gis//nor 'dzin skyong ba 'dzum lang mi bdag la//dus kun bkra shis dge ba'i dpal stsol cig/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu glang lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag/chu glang nag zla'i 'jug tu bar ma nad cung zad 'phar ba'i dus legs nyes kyi lung bstan zhu bar grwa tshang gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pa spyan gzigs tshogos chas sogs gya nom pa dang bcas tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can gyi spyan sngar mngags pa'i tshe 'phrin yig tu gsal ba lha zhal mthor 'degs bskul ba'i dbyangs snyan/rgyal kun mthu stobs 'bar ba rdo rje'i gzi//sdebargyad dregs pa'i gtsug bkod dbang sdud pa//'dzam bu'i gling na che ba'i rigs sngags mkhan//pad+ma 'byung gnas dus gsum sangs rgyas gtso//mgon de'i bka' nyan lha chen tshangs pa gang //bkra shis215bdung dkar g.yas 'khyil thod bcings pa//mthon por zhal khyim bteg nas dgyes pa'i 'dzum//tshems 'phreng mu tig ze'u 'bru rgod par mdzod//'di na slo bur 'tshe ba zug rngu yis//sgyu ma g.yar khang cung zad bro 'tshal bar//phan thabs rim gro'i nyer bsdogs bgyid tshul gtam//lha snyan dbang por pho lha'i ngag nas gsal//slad mar bdud rigs gnod pa de tsam gyi//bzlog dka'i blang dor ye shes spyan ras kyis//gzigs tshe gsong por smra ba rdo rje'i tshig/lung bstan lhug par gsungs shig

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)dge bsnyen che/ /sna tsho gis spyan gzigs bye brag thor gsal ba/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du byin brlabs nas/ /mthun pa'i rdzas su 'bul na 'phrin las rnams/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i dga' ston stsol/ /chu glang nag zla'i mthug tu 'bam nad cung zad 'phar pa'i dus legs nyes kyi lung bstan zhu bar rgyal thang pa lhun grub rgya mtsho spyan gzigs tshogis chas dang bcas bsam yas su rgyal po li byin ha ra dpon blon gyi drung du mngags pa'i tshe 'phrin yig tu gsal ba snang rmi lang ba'i ste long /dregs pa'i sdod pon li byin ha ra yi/ /bga' sdod chen po gnod sbyin yang le ber/ /thugs dam bskul tshig lha khyod snyan gsol na/ /dmar zlum gsal ba'i spyan de phyogs bcur gzigs/ /'di na glo bur 'tshal ba'i bro nad la/ /gegs sel bsod nams tshogs gsog bgyid skabs kyang / /lkog gyur ma rig skyon gyi nyer 'tshe las/ /grol lam ma grol bdag gis cha ma 'tshal/ /de phyir thogs pa med pa'i mngon shes dang / /snang srid 'char ba'i me long la gzigs nas/ /bdud dpung g.yul las rgyal ba'i thabs kyi rigs/ /gsal (216na)bar ston cig sde brgyad dmag dpon che/ /gnas tshul zhib char gsob dang mthun pa'i rdzas/ khra shar tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'bul ba la/ /ched du pho nya 'di la nyer mngags na/ /lung bstan rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs mgur nas long / /pha ma brgyud pa'i srung ma khyod nyid kyis/ /nyin mtshan dus drug skyong ba mdzad mod kyang / /yang bskyar nan gyis gsol na dbang drag dang / /zhi rgyas 'phrin las ma lus lhun gyis sgrubs/ /chu glang nag pa zla ba'i mjug tu 'bam nad cung zad 'phar ba'i dus legs nyes kyi lung bstan zhu bar rgyal thang pa lhun grub rgya mtsho bdog pa'i tshan grangs tshogs chas dang bcas tshong 'dus su bshan pa bya khrid mig gcig pa'i drung du mngags pa'i tshe 'phrin yig tu gsol ba mi shes mun pa sel ༅ nyi ma/shar phyogs sku yi rgyal po'i bka' sdod che/ /bshan pa lag dmar bya khrid mig gcig pa'i/ /spyan sngar thugs dam skang rdzas tha gsal dang / /tshogs 'khor nam mkha' mdzod gyi mchod sprin spro/ /'di na glo bur nad kyis 'tsho ba'i gegs/ /sel byed legs byas sgo 'phar 'byed skabs kyang / /ma shes lkog gyur blang dang dor bya'i rigs/ /gang 'dug lha zhal mthon por —514

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pebateg nas stsol/ /pad+ma thod phreng bkar btags rdo rje'i rgya/ /spyi bor bkod pa'i dam tshig can khyod kyis/ /bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i ba dan dkar/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du bsgreng bar mdzod/ /chu glang nag zla'i 'jug tu 'bam nad kyis bro 'tshal ba'i dus legs nyes kyi lung bstan zhu bar nyang stod pa kun dga' don grub tshan grangs tshogos mas dang bcas rigs kyi srung ma thang chen chos rgyal bshan pa lag dmar gyi drung du mngag pa'i tshe 'phrin yig tu gsal ba gas r+ṣa khro bo 'bar ba'i gad brgyangs/ za hor brgyud pa'i pha (216ba〉stes rigs kyi lha/ /thang chen bshan pa lag dmar mthu rtsal ldan/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel bcol ba'i 'phrin las kun/ /lhun gyis sgrubs shig gnod sbyin shing bya can/ /dar zab rgya ja tsho gis kyi 'khor lo rnams/ /sngags rgyas nam mkha' mdzod du byin brlabs nas/ /dbul bar pho nya 'di pa nyer mngags na/ /thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su skong gyur cig /glo bur nad sel rim gro mang bgyis mod/ /slar yang bslab bya'i rim pa lhug stsal du/ /dpral ba'i dmar zlum spyan gyis gsal gzigs pa/ /rdo rje'i gsung gi gsang ba bsgrig tu gsol/ /chu glang ston zla'i yar ngo la tshangs pa chen po'i lung bstan bsto blang dor tshul bzhin bstar bar brten zug rngu las rnam par grol ba'i gto rag dbul bar gra k+ṣe gnyer pa blo bzang snyen pa bto pa'i tshe phren du gsol ba don 'bras mdzo sum smin pa'i gad rgyangs/ sgrib bral dag pa'i ye shes spyan ras kyis/ /lkog gyur shes bya'i gnas kun legs gzigs pa/ /dpal ldan lha yi lha mchog tshangs pa che/ /bkra shis g.yas 'khyil dung gi thod mdzes kye/ /rab snyan mgrin pa'i rgyud las drangs pa'i lung / /dngas pa'i mtsho la zla ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /ma 'dres blang dor 'bras bu deng smin par/ /nges rnyed ngang pa'i rang blo gcig tu dad/ /dbang drag zhi dang rgyas pa'i 'phrin las rnams/ /legs grub gtang rag kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /tshogs 'khor bdog pa'i dngos po khra shar bcas/ /'bul bar 'di pa ched du nye bar mngags/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng sangs rgyas gnyis pa des/ /bsgrags pa'i g.yar dam gnyan po nyer dgongs la/ /'byung 'gyur dngos ston nyes brgya yongs sel ba'i/ /dbugs dbyung rdo rje'i (217nab sung gsang glu ru long / /mthu —515

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shestobs 'khor lo dam bca' bzhi ldan gyis/ /dgra bgegs mgrin pa dum bur gcod pa dang / /chabs gcig 'dod pa'i re ba kun skong ba'i/ /dngos grub char gyis nor 'dzin 'gang bar mdzod/ /chu bya zan g.yang mdo sde mchod pa'i thog dga' ston gyi legs skyes 'bul bar kha rog gong pa btang ba'i tshe sprul pa'i chos rgyal li byin ha rar phul ba'i lon yig dam tshig rdo rje'i cod ༅/ ye shes rab 'bar rdo rje rtse lnga can/ /gsal ba'i ri mo gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /li byin ha ra snang srid dregs pa'i gtso/ /'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus 'gying spyan snga sa /mdo (lha mchod chen mo'i dga' ston thog /sngon bzhin bdog pa khra shar legs spel te/ /zan g.yang lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag der/ /pho nya ched mngags cang shes nyon te bgrod/ /nyes tshogs mun pa sel ba'i zla ba khyod/ /phan bde'i la dkar po ba 'ad pa dang / /khams gsum 'dod pas myos te dbang bsdus nas/ /dgra bgegs 'dab stong kha de zum par mdzod/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dar dkar po/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du legs bsgrengs te/ /thos 'dzin snyan pa'i dbyangs dang mi 'bral zhing / /phan bde'i ro brgya bda' bas yid tshim mdzod/ /'chi med pañca li rka'i dar zab kyi/ /lha snyan mdzes byed rgyan gyi rten dang bcas/ /chu shel dbang po gdu bus nya ba yi/ /yar ngo'i tshes la po ta la nas dge /chu glang zan g.yang mdo sde mchod pa'i thog dga' ston gyi sems skyed
