'bul bar kha rog gong ba btang ba'i tshe gnod sbyin tse'u dmar por 'phrin du gsal pa dbang drag grub pa'i rol gar/ byu ru lhun po nyi ma 'bum gyi gzis/ /'byung bas bsgrun min srid gsum zil gnon zhal/ /(217brdzi brgyad dbus na mngon par mtho ba'i lha/ /btsan rgod gnod sbyin chen po tse'u dmar/ /mdo sde'i lha mchod dga' ston sngon bzhin du/ khra shar dang bcas pho nya nyer mngags na/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las sgrubs shig gu /zla ba thags su bskrun 'dra'i dar dkar gyi/ /snyan shal legs spel rta bdun dbang po can/ /'khrig pa'i khyim du dga' bder spyod pa yi/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes la dge /rigs kyi srung ma thang chen bshan pa lag dmar la spyan gzigs tshogs 'khor dang bcas 'phrin las bsgrub pa ra gsal ba dgyes —516

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ḍa'adzi po pad dkar khongs sa pa/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dar dkar po/ /srid pa'i rtse mor bsgreng ba'i rigs kyi lha/ /gdug can khrag gis lag dmar bshan pa che/ /g.yar dam rdo rje'i mdud pa rab dgongasashig /don dam dbyings su rnam par nyer zhi ba/ /gnas skabs drag por khros pa'i sprin nag dbus/ /nga ro'i gad brgyangs 'brug gi sgra chen pos/ /las bzhi'i rma bya dga' ba'i mngal 'dzin par/ /zad pa med par yongs su spyod pa'i rdzas/ /'dod yon lnga ldan tsho gis kyi 'khor lo yis/ /'chi med lam gyi dpal kun mdzes byed pas/ /dgyes pas zhal gyi pad dkar khongs nas 'dzum/ /'od mtshan stong du 'bar ba'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /rgya gar paṇa chen gzugs su shar ba'i gar/ /srid pa gsum na che ba'i rig sngags 'chang / /pad 'byung sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i dam tshig bzhin/ /gangs kyi ra bas bskor ba'i khor yug ljongs/ /nad 'brug mu ge'i mun pa mthar bskrad nas/ /phan bde'i nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od po che/ /rdo phral rta ljang bdun gyis drang bar gsol/ khyad par bdag gi (218nas dpal zla ba'i cha/ /rnam par gang byed dkar phyogs bgrod pa ltar/ /rab 'phel dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa yi/ /lang tsho'i dpal gyi do zlar khyod kyis sgrubs/ /dngos 4 bag la zha ba'i nag po'i dpung / /dgabagegs sder bcas mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal/ /skyin thang drag pos bcom pa'i lo tog ltar/ /ming gi lhag tsam lus pa med par choms/ /rnam par dag pa lha mig ye shes spyan/ /dri ma med pas lkog gyur chos kyi gzugs/ /mngon sum snang ba ji bzhin blang dor gyi/ /snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs rna ba'i rgyan du mdzod/ /'byung ba lnga dang ldan pa'i khams/ /sgyur byed bgrang bya'i rta zla ba'i/ /dkar phyogs bzang po gnyis pa'i tshe/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal du shar/ /chu glang lo gnam gyi lha 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po mchod rten rab stims pa'i dpon po bstan 'dzin dge slong dang bsam blo a zhang yer te na rab mas chos rje gnyis mi snar rdzong bdar gnang ba'i bka' shog gnang sbyin byung ba'i lan 'bul bar chos lung mkhan chen lung rig rgya mtsho dang skyid stod pa gnyis btang skabs phul ba'i zhu yig 'dzam gling bsod nams dpal 'bar/ ālu rdi : kwa sha su ma ཿ pā ra kra me 9 ba la ta sgo kra wa rti ga ga na : myu khri shā ra ma—517

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheñja sto ṣa dri rwa (nu la/ tshe (sde bro sbyor mnyam pa'i phrit+ta las me tag phreng ༅/)ring gnam gyi she mong gis stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba gnam sa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i drung du/ 'dren pa mnyam (218ba thad bu ram shing pa'i ring lugs 'dzin par khas 'ches pa'i sdom brtson gnas lnga rig pa smra ba gang gis dad pa'i yid kyis kun nas blangs te sa baḥsu sta ka ri 6 ti meg lo bha wastu zhes bkra shis pa'i tshig gi 'phreng ba brjod cing spos bsregs me tog 'thor dbang bcas gsol ba/ deng gi dus kyang gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa la dbang phyug pa'i bdag nyid gong ma rgyal po nges pa'i don du 'phags mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs mi'i srid pa bzung ba la skye rga na 'chi'i 'tshe ba lta ga la zhig kyang mtshan dpe'i lang tsho yongs su dar ba'i gzugs sku tshur mthong gi skye bo ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs can rnams kyi snang ngor gzhom zhig dang bral ba rdo rje'i rang bzhin can brgya phrag nyi ma'i 'od la 'gong ba'i zo mdog bzang zhing sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi'i chos la byang chub pa/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa ltar dpa' mdzangs rtul phod par ngo tsha dang ldan zhing chog shes pa ya rabs bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las g.yo ba med bzhin pa ni 'dzam gling skye rgu mtha' dag gi bsod nams kyis rin btsal te nyos pa las g.yin du ci las sems/ ched du nged la dgyes pa'i spyan ras kyis nye bar bca' ba'i zhal 'dzum lhug par bstan te gser 'brug gi khor mo yug gis bteg pa'i gnam gyi she mong las byung ba'i bka' rtags kyi re khā sa mtshan pa'i bka' shog dngul mdong srang drug cu yong ba cha gsar gyi rgyan can/ dngul gyi bya ma bum gser gyi mdzes rgyan gsol ba/ dngul gyi hun ta ka gnyis/ bzang gosayug nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ kha btags nyin mo bde legs ma lnga/ rtags brgyad pa btags/bzhi (219na)bcu'i gnang rten dang bcas bstan 'dzin dge slong dang er te na rab 'byams pa gnyis gser yig tu mngags te/ bde skyid kyi lo bcu gnyis pa ston zla ra ba gro bzhin gyis nye bar sug par son pas drang srong bsam gtan gsum pa bzhin du yid la spro dga' ci yang brtas/ 'di na'ang 'brum dkar gyis bro 'tshal ba las grol ba dang bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i 'dun pa tsam la sgro btags te —5/8

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pelha'i bka' lung gis legs so byin pa'i dbugs dbyung ba'i tshig gis me tog gtor ba bzhin dkon cog rin po che'i thugs rjes 'du ba snyoms ngos rnam 'dren shākya seng ge'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa dar ba dang de'i mthu las 'jig rten thams cad bde legs su 'gyur ba'i lhag bsam ston zla ltar dkar ba sngon chad lha mi'i bdag po gang gis bka'i lung phud de gnam 'og gi skye rgu mtha' dag bstan pa gcig tu gyur ba'i lung bzang po'i bka' drin la brten nas gzhan phan gyi bgyid 'os rnams lag tu lon par gnas/ gser dngul zangs lcags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba 'dzam bu gling gi skye rgu rnams tshe lo brgyad khri ba'i dus ma gtogs mi 'byung bar gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa las bshad na'ang lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin grub pa rnams kyis rtsod ldan kyi dus 'dir stobs kyi 'khor losasgyur ba'i rgyal por 'os pa ni 'di nyid do zhes mgrin gcig tu bsngags pa la brten nas 'jig rten gyi mes po tshangs pas ka ba med pa nam mkha'i mthongs kyi sgo phye/ rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis yongs su gang bas spyi bo nas dbang bskur te tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gi dpung pas nor 'dzin gyi (219ba)dkyil 'khor mtha' dag rang byon du gyur pa'i byed pos mi'i bdag po gang gi bsod nams kyi mthus nyi 'og gi rgyal phran blon 'bangs thams cad zil gyis gnon par ma zad mchog dman kun gyi bsam pa'i yul las dgongs pa'i blo gros kyi tshad gang gis kyang gzhal bar nus pa ma yin pa stong spyi phud kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur pas khams gsum yongs kyis pus mo sa la btsugs te mgo bo 'dud pa'i gnas mang pos bkur ba'i khri chen por zhabs sen mnar ba'i 'phreng ba bkod pa tsam nas yab rje gong ma'i dus pas bsu rang 'gro ba'i yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung tsam la yang ma ltos par lha gcig dam pa'i mtshan gyi nyin byed shar ba'i mod la rtsod dus mun pa'i smag rum ma lus pa ming gi lhag mar byas te 'jig rten kun tu nad 'khrug mu ge sogs dus kyi chad pa thams cad dang bral lo tog sbrum pa/ tshong dang khe spogs kyis mtshon longs spyod kyi gter sgo ni bye tshe yang ring por gnas pas sim pa'i tshor ba sha stag myong ba dge ba'i mtshan ma mtha' klas pa byung ba kun —519

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)mi'i bdag po nyid kyi bka' drin las gor ma chag pa bzhin/ slad mar yang bstan dang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor sku tshe mgon po tshe mtha' yas pa'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs te brtan par bzhugs par ci gnang / nged kyis kyang de bzhin du 'grub pa'i mchog gsum dam par gsol ba 'debs shing bden pa'i tshig brjod pa dgongs pa zab mo'i slong du nye bar bzhugs te gser gyi zhal sgo las 'thon pa'i bka' mchid bslab ston bzang po yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du/ zhes spyan ras kyi gzigs pa cung zad 'bab pa'i rten/ byu dra'i shal ba gcig /mu men gyi shal ba che chung (220na)gnyis/ mu men rdog bzhi/ sbur len gyi shal pa che chung / snam bu sngo thig nyi shu rtsa bdun/ rgya thig nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ ljang thig nyi shu rtsa bdun/ dkar rkyang nyi shu rtsa lnga/ dmar thig nyi shu rtsa gsum/ sngo rkyang nyi shu rtsa bdun dang bcas bag yod ces pa chu mo glang gi lo hor zla dgu pa'i gral tshes dge bar rang byung 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gtsug lag khang po ta la nas phul/ /chu glang zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcag la tshangs pa dung thod can gyi drung du spyan gzigs tshogs kyi mchod sprin bcas lung bstan zhu bar grwa tshang gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pa btang skabs kyi 'phrin gsol lkog gyur gsal ba'i me long / rgyal ba kun dngos pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal gyi pho nya/ 'jig rten dbang phyug srong btsan sgam po'i skyes lha/ lha chen tshangs pa chen po'i spyan sngar grwa tshang gnyer pa rdzong bdar bgyis yod pa gang gi thugs kyi me long gtsang mar lkog gyur shes bya'i gzugs brnyan ni 'gog med du 'char/ dmar zlum spyan gyis snang zhing srid pa'i chos kun rjen par gzigs/ rta mchog rlung gi shugs can la chibs nas/ stong gsum skad cig gis bskor te lus can rnams kyi bya byed la spyod dam pa'i chos par khas 'ches pa rnams kyi ngang tshul dang rig 'dzin rnal 'byor spyod pa kun gyi lta sgom gyi drod myur bar mdzad pas rgyal khams spyi dang khyad par bod dang rgya hor sogs kyi skye rgu'i bde sdug /sgos kyi blang dor sogs dpal gyi mgur nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis lung ston par gsol ba'i rten du lha rdzas kyi snyan shal gyis mtshon dngos bsham yid sprul gyi mchod pa'i sprin dang bcas smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes la dmar po ri'i pho brang nas dge /—520—

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pechu glang hor zla bcu pa'i tshes gsum la rig sngags chang ba'i dbang phyug mnga' ris pa dkon cog lhun grub kyi 'phrin lan a 'dusakwa ra'i 'phreng ba/(220ba)me ja to rwa sa/ gi ra mu khyu ta ba rje sa tsā 'i ya sha bha rba lha ṣi ma taḥ/ku bu ra la ya t+ta si yi : / ku skyo ta me dwa ku stu ra sgo khyi ga laḥ/ ka (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i phrit+ta las metog phreng yi/)ra'i ro ltar mngar ba'i legs bshad rnams/ kha dog 'ja' bzhin sgra don rgyan mtshar ba'i/ /ga bur ngad 'thul 'phrin rten son pa'i mod/ /nga las nu blo'i rjes 'gro'i spro ba 'phel/ /ca re mkhas bsten yon tan nor gyis phyug /cha lugs ngur smrig gos kyi bag yod btsun/ /ja chang 'dod la sred bral chog shes ldan/ /nya rgyas zla ltar lhag bsam dkar ba nyid/ /ta ler mnga' ris stod nas dbus su brtol/ /tha dad gnas lnga rig par rab sbyangs pas/ /da lta mkhas dang grub pa'i snyan pa dang / /na tshod lhan cig mthor son grags pa 'bar/ /pa ri mi ta rgyud sde'i lam bzang gis/ /pha rol thar pa'i gling du bgrod pa'i bgegs/ /ba glang lta bu'i rmongs mun rab bcom pa'i/ /ma smad rnam par dpyod pa mkhas rnams rangs/ /tsa ma rī pa'i bstan pa'i (221na)snying po 'dzin/ /tsha grang khyad bsad bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa che/ /dza ya'i dgongs pa ji bzhin nyams bstar bas/ /wa ler gnas lugs mngon sum rtogs las/ /zhwa ltar rdo rje'i slob dpon gtsug na bsten/ /za byed seng ge lta bu'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /'a 'ur sdo brgyad bran du nyer bkol nas/ /ya mtshan mngon spyod rnam 'phrul spro de 'jigs/ /ra gdengs rdo rjes snang srid zil gnon pa/ /la lar ma yin kun skyabasapad 'byung gis/ kha dag bstan 'dzin rig sngags 'chang ba khyod/ /sa steng 'di ru rdo rje ltar brtan shog /ha cang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dpyod ldan pa'i/ /a mra'i sdong po lta bur g.yur za der/ /ha ri ta ga'i bcud mtshungs shong dkar rtser/ /a don bzhin du 'jigs med rgyas btab bsrings/ /—52/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing stag lor bris pa'i chab 3|ga 'phrin yig khag /kun dga' zhes pa shing stag lo gsar gyi tshe sding po che sprul sku'i 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan legs ldan dpyid kyi dga' ston/ nāb so ba khru 'o stu ma hā tā la ma khye dza nā pya da ba sto sa sa sno ṣ+ṭha kaḥ sa rba ra ba sga minyi da ta smo lha sa rnyo ma na ཿ shi ra khya yi : tra kaḥ/ gsar (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i skṛ t+ta las me tog 'phreng ༅/)pa'i bgrang bya yangs pa'i thang chen po/ /bde skyid spang ljongs gos kyis nyer klubs par/ /kun dga'i mdza' ba ster ba'i legs ldan dpyid/ /yid kyi shes ngos pir gyis bris tshon bzhin/ /e ma yul dbus 'gyur 'chang du stod 'grel ba'i rjes su (221bskor brangs te ā nan+da zhes grags pa/ ri kha ba can gyi sman ljongs 'dir gtsug lag spor thang dang bstun te shing pho stag 'byung ba sum ldan gyi gnam lo gsar du tshes pa dga' ba dang po'i dus su/ bag yod gtsang sbra'i brtul zhugs brtan po can/ gnas lugs rang ngo phrol ba'i ral khur brjid/ /bla gos ras gzan khrag par gcig tu gzar/ /rnam dpyod tshangs skud spyi blugs 'chang ba khyod/ /'du phung 'khyugs pa med pa'i lang tsho brtas/ /mang thos spobs pa dge ba'i mgrin bteg nas/ /brjod pa don ldan phun tshogs gtam gyi glu/ /bgyid pa'i sngon 'gror me tog 'thor de mtshar/ /de ltar grwa nang phun tshogs dge ba'i yul gru'i char zla ba'i dum bu mtshar du dngar 'dra'i spong ba bsam gtan gyi lcog bus khor yug tu bskor ba'i dri gtsang khang gi bya 'dabs nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas mang po la blo gros kyi lus stobs yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnyis skyes ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos su sti ga'i sgra las drangs pa'i 'phrin yig legs skyes kyi bdog pa ched du bsrings pa sug par son/ de tshe sde snod gsum pa'i drang srong yang / /lus sems sim pa'i tshor ba nyams myong gar/ /char sprin stug par mig gtod rma bya —522

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ( dze/yis/ /dbyar rnga thos pas mod bzhin ci yang sgyur/ /kye zla ba'i 'phreng ba go la'i rgyu lam ltar nam yang chad pa med pa'i ngang nas brtsams te ma pham mgon po ma ga dhar mchog gi sprul pa'i skur bstan min de srid kyi bar du lo'i thog ma'i dus kyi dga' ston chad med du spel bar rigs so/ /de ltar bskul tshig 'dren byed yul 'gyur ched/ /'jam mnyen dar gyi kha rdzar can 'dis kyang / /phan bde'i snang bas skye rgu kun khyab pa'i/ /(222na ji na 'brel sgo 'phar yongs phye dza ( / /shing stag hor zla gnyis pa'i nyer brgyad la rigs 'dzin chen po dkon cog lhun grub kyi 'phrin lan thos bsam sgom mthar phyin pa'i gtam snyan/ yu bya to dru ma swā kā pa dha shu pa tswa re klo tā ba tra : ri sha tswa lha ga tā/ bu d+dhaphu slu me hā kā la ṅgā tu rgya 'a khe sma hi rmu dra nā ཿ bhu dze yu sa kaḥ/ na (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta las me rta ge phreng ༅/)tshod sdong po smin kyang thos bsam gyi/ /rnam dpyod yal 'dab phang phung g.yo ba'i rtser/ /goms pa'i 'bras dud rig 'dzin tshe de'i 'phrin/ /rten gyi phyag rgya ma nyams su ga par son/ /deng dus sgyu ma'i lang tsho ma snyigs shing / /lha sngags ye shes rnam par rol pa'i gzis/ /yid srubs smag rum mthar byas rdo rje gsum/ /g.yung drung lta bur brtan pa'i gtam de snyan/ /ci'i phyir dkon cog phun tsho gos nyin mor byed/ /chos dbyings nub ri'i phang gzhol dbu ru'i cha/ /mun par gyur tshe mkhas grub zla ba khyod/ shar (222ba)bas phyogs de'i 'gro kun snang bas khyab/ /za hor rig sngags 'chang gi gdung 'dzin bdag /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen lam bzang lta zhog gi /thun mong dngos grub tsam yang ma 'grub rung / /'gro 'dren snyan pa'i gtam gyis mi mgo bskor/ /mya ngan med pa'i thugs bcud drang srong mtshon/ /rnam sprul rin chen phun tshogs bzhad pa'i srol/ /rnying rgan phal gyis shes pa'i re med steng / /phyogs der rtogs pa khyod min ngas ma mthong / /'di na dge bstan khri la dbang bskur nas/ /bsgrig rtsom de 'dra med pas las yin rung / /gangs ljongs re che kun la dbyar chu'i drod/ /tsam las ma rnyed nub 'phangs 'bad pas bkod/ /byis blo zhabrul pa'i snang bar nongs pa'i tshogs/ /yod snyam cung zad rang sems dma' zhum par/ /shes ldan khyod thugs gang nas legs so'i —523

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2cesgras/ /dbugs dbyung 'di yis ci bder ngal gso byas/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i rgyud kyi snying po'i bcud/ /gnubs chen gdams pa'i myu gu me'i spu gri'i/ /ngag 'don lag len 'jug bde'i reg zig rnams/ /'bad pas 'phral bshus glegs bam 'di ko bsrings/ /dgra gdon tshang tshing bsreg pa'i ye shes me/ /pad gnubs man ngag zab don yid bzhin nor/ /gtsug bsten rig sngags 'chang ba'i gdengs can dbang / /stod smad kun tu nyin mo'i skar ma 'dra/ /chang bzi'i blo shed 'drer 'tshong brtul zhugs kyis/ /gang dran zan gong nor skyong sto ba sa /sdugs la rnga gog drag rdungs cher brtson pa'i/ /sngags rlom de yang ri mo'i mar me bzhin/ /stang stabs kyis kyang lha srin bran 'khol ba'i/ /gos dkar rigs 'dzin sngon byon mang byung ding / /gsar ma'i mig bltos snying rul ngur smig can/ /stag tshang gnas pa'i wa skyes 'jol mo 'dra/ /de tsam ches cher snyigs ma'i (223na)gnas tshul rnams/ /snyan tshig sdeb sbyor dam pos ma bcings par/ /rang rgyud dkor gyis rengs pa'i kha 'chal gtam/ /lhug par bris la mkhas khyod mi khrel 'tshal/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' ma zad nyid lta bu'i/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i sdom brtson rab dkon pas/ /pad 'byung ji bzhin 'pho ba chen po'i sku/ /bsgrubs nas bskal brgyar brtan pa'i thabs tshul mdzod/ /mtho ris 'chi med chu bo gaṅgā de/ /chad med rgya mtsho'i slong du 'bab pa ltar/ /nam yang bskyud pa med pa'i 'phrin yig rgyun/ /lha ldan 'dzin ma'i ldum rar 'khyil cig gu /tshangs spyod dpal la gnas pa dge slong gis/ /btung bar 'os pa rgya ja'i bem po la/ pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs 'dzin lag rtags kyis/ /nyer btab dbu ru'i phyogs su bde bar song /kun dga' zhes pa shing stag lo rgya hor 'dzin stangs ma gcig pa'i dus kyi chad pa'i dbang gis tsi ṇa'i lho brgyud kyi yul gru'i g.yul 'khrug byung ba'i tshe gong nas sog po'i bya ba byed mi ya mu nas la du jar go chi can gnang skabs bka' lan 'bul bar khang gsar rab brtan dang 'bum brang bsod nams dbang po gnyis btang ba'i zhu yig g.yung drung 'khyil ba/ ā yu ༷ lha kha rugrabā la su tsa kra sha ba rti ka ga ga na bhā PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBPROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB/ tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gi stobs 'khor los sgyur ba gnam sa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal —524

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (sepo'i drung du/ rab tu dang ba'i (223ba 〉 sems kyi sgo nas spos bsregs me tog gtor te gsol ba/gnam ka ba med pa'i sgo phye nas 'jig rten gyi mes po tshangs pas stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba mang bkur gyi rgyal sar dbang bskur ba 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po deng gi dus kyang 'dzam gling skye rgu yongs kyi bsod nams kyi dpal du sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo g.yung drung gi rang bzhin ltar 'gyur ba med cing thugs rje'i mthu dpung mngon par rgyas pa'i gzi byin gyis lus can mtha' dag phan dang bde ba'i dpal la spyod bzhin pa nas/ mi sna sog po'i bya ba byed mi ya mu'i mi bzang la du ja ra go chi can hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu dgu 'tsham por 'byor ba'i bka' shog nyin mo bde legs lnga bcu'i rten dang bcas phebs pa yid mchog tu spro zhing gus pa 'phel bar gyur/ 'di na rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras po'i rjes su zhugs pa'i sdom brtson klog pa mkhan yong 'du phung po mdog bde zhing gang gi bka' drin la brten nas nyi ma nub kyi phyogs rnams lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas bde bar skyong ba'i skabs su gnas/ da lam sku'i 'tsham 'dri zhu bar khang gsar rab brtan dang 'bum thang bsod nams dbang po gnyis rdzong bdar zhus pa sngar rgyun bzhin thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar gzigs pa'i bka' gnad bslab ston bcas pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin zhu/ rten shal dmar po legs pa dang bcas shing stag hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gnyis la rang byung 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gtsug lag dmar po ri nas phul/mnga' ris sngagasang chen po dkon cog lhun grub kyi 'phrin lan ka la piṅka'i dbyangs la bsngags pa/ (224na)swā dza yartsi t+ta dz+nyā la pra ṇi ཿཿ gi ri bā li ta ni rma rje rā ba ge lha da ya: shā kya ga zha PROB PROB PROBso ga 〉mu dra bha sma dha la ko ṭiḥ ra the/ sras (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta las me tog 'phreng can/)bcas rgyal ba'i thugs mtshor smon lam ri/ /bsgril las sprul pa'i sa srungs mkhyen brtse'i 'gros/ /thub bstan sa la lhod por legs rgyu ba/ /phyag rdzogs grub rigs bye ba'i shing rta cher/ /ring min lha sngags ye shes bzhu blugs pa/ /gsang gsum mi shigs rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /skal bzang gdul —525

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyebya'i snang ngor bsgyur bzhin du/ /snyan tshig chab shog rten ldan sbyor te spro/ /'di na sngon bsags las sprin sdug po'i nad/ /sman dpyad tshogs gsog dri bzhen shugs drag pos/ /mthar bskrad 'du ba snyoms pa'i nyi zer gyis/ /sim pa'i 'dab stong bzhad la gcig tu brel/ /skye mangs goms pa'i bag chags — 'bras/ /skyu ra'i bka' brgyud chu mtshor lhungs pa las/ /nyer sad dam pa'i ngang tshul su wa skyoḥ /dar drag snye ma'i ro bda' (224ba)ches cher mngar/ /na phra rnam dpyod mdongs mtha' la zhen nas/ /'gro 'dren rgan mangs bsnyems pa'i glang po'i mche/ /nyer phyungs gong ma'i gdan sa mtho ris sar/ /'gying ba'i na rti ka de gzhan na su/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor sgyur chos kyi grags/ /rnga yab dpal gyi ri bor gshegs pa brdzun/ /bden na mgon de'i rnam par thar pa'i cha/ /gang ba'i zla ba dbu rur shar 'di ci/ /lo mangs shes byar goms rloms ngur pa'i khyu/ /grong gtam ca cos rna ba gtser byed na/ /sbyangs phra sgo nga'i sbubs rgya ma grol bar/ /legs bshad ka la piṅka'i sgra dbyangs snyan/khyod mgrin gser pad las skyes tshangs pa'i rigs/ /spobs mtho smra ba'i gdong pa bzhi sprul nas/ /dbyangs can thig le mchog mar dam 'byud par/ /'phya ba'i mig sngon can te ngal 'gram bteg /tshur mthong byis blos 'jal nus tha snyad la/ /mtshang ci lkog gyur chos kyi sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /dag pa'i spyan zur lhung ba'i mod nyid la/ /dngas mtshor zla ba'i gzugs bzhin gsal de rmad/ /zil gnon grub pa'i brtul zhugs phyag rgya yis/ /'khor 'das srog dbang thob tshe lha ma srin/ /lus med lus dngos bstan nas bka' 'bangs su/ khas 'che'i rnam par 'phrul la ci zhig gshung / /de tsam kun rtog 'char sgo'i rang gdangs gzugs/ /'dzad med yi ge'i 'phreng bar spel mod kyi/ /dam pa'i spyod tshul pha mtha' yongs gzhal tshe/ /gser mngal can yang ngal ba'i gnyid la g.yur/ /snang srid dbang sdud mtsho skyes rdo rje bzhin/ /bag la nyal chos dngos mjal rjen ston pa'i/ /phebs tshogs mu thi la 'phreng sdeb tshig gi /srad bur brgyus te chad pa med par zhu/ /bkra (225naXs kha dzar can dang smin legs ma/ /thun mtshams rgya yi rtse dgas rol bzhin du/ /nam mthong zla ba'i shes rab phyogs kyi cha/ /bzang po gnyis —526

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pepa'i dus la phul ba dge /rab byung ban gcig pa'i shing yos dpal zha lu gser bkang du 'chi bdag la kyi gshin rje yab yum 'cham pa'i sngon 'gror snang srid lha srin sdebs la skad gtong ༅ lag yig dpa' bo'i gad brgyangs/ pa ra ma gu ru ñca ya mā ri de rlu rwa dhi| te swā hā/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i gshed skor gyi rgyud la brten nas mkhas shing grub brnyes lā li ta/ bir+sha pa/ dpal 'dzin sogs 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub/ rwa skyo mal zhang gnyis te phyogs 'di'i srol 'byed sngon byon dang / 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje yab sras sogs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka'/ bdud sde'i gshed du 'jam dpal drag por khros pa 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i lung /gong ma'i lung gis de'i chi gying gang zhes srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan du dbang bskur zhing / 'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon 'jam dpal dus dgra'i sngags 'chang ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gtam/ khams gsum na mngon par rgyu ba'i gzugs med snang zhing srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad/ gzugs can gyi skye rgu spyi dang /bye brag stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum/ smad mdo khams sogasakyi 'dzin mar 'khod pa'i lha sdo mi sde/ bla ma che phra/ sa skyong ba'i mi'i rje bo/ dpon chen/ dpon skya/ rdzong sdod gnyer las 'dzin/ (225ba bo ma ga ar jag gi 'grim 'grul/ ko gru lcags gsum gyi mnyan gnyer/ lam 'phrang srung mi sogs mchog dman bar ma'i skye rgu mtha' dag la springs pa/ ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub dang / gsang chen rnying ma'i sngags 'chang gos dkar lcang lo'i 'phreng can mthu chen g.yung ston rdo rje dpal ba gnyis kyi sa yos lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang du 'chi bdag gshin rje'i grong khyer thod pa lcags kyi khang pa nas las kyi gshin rje 'khor sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa dngos 'byor chas su zhugs pa'i stang stabs dang / ngo bo rnal 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug pa'i chos srungs so skye phal gyi mig —527—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)gi yul du ma gyur pa sa gzhi bar snang gi khyon gang ba spyan drangs te/ dam rdzas gtor ma'i ri bo dang /dmar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho bskyil ba sogs phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod cing thugs dam bskang / spyi bor rdo rje bzhag lce thog tu a skṛ ta blugs te bstan 'gro'i phan bde 'joms pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i dam tshig bsgrags shing / 'phrin las gnyer du gtad pa'i dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dmar chen gtor ma dman pa'i srol btod par mdzad pa'i rgyun ding sang gi bar du ma nyams par 'dug pa nas/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing yos hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang du ma nye mchod pa 'dzugs rgyur skye rgu rnams ngo mtshar ltad mo'i dga' ston dang / lha srin sde brgyad rnams dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tshogs su rol pa'i mgron la shog cig pa'i brda 'grems su rlung sems la nang byan chud pa'i rnal 'byor brtul zhugs spyod pa 'di bzhin song ba khyod (226na)gong 'khod rnams kyis gzhis lam byed gsum thams cad du zhag babs su gnas mal gtong zhing /bza' btung mkho rgu'i longs spyod stob pa dang / ko gru'i mnyan pos kyang 'phral sgrol gyis/ gal te gnod 'gal du 'gro ba byung na yul gru'i dpon che chung dang rdzong sdod so sos khrims kyi brda 'ded btang na mi 'jigs sam/ go bar byed pa'i yi ge shing stag smin drug zla ba'i gral tshes dge bar gtsug lag lugs brgya'i 'dun sa pho brang chen po po ta la nas bris/ /shing stag tor zla bcu gcig pa'i nyer brgyad la khra 'brug chos skyong tshangs pa'i 'phrin lan g.yar dam 'gyur ba med pa'i gtam/'phrin las g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung dkar pos/ /thor tshugs rab mdzes lha chen tshangs pa yi rdo rje'i gsung gi 'phrin yig lha dang bcas/ /pho lha'i sug par thogs te son pa spro/ /dus gsum bder gshegs kun 'dus thod 'phreng rtsal/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig ri mo gtsug tor rtser/ /gsal las nam yang mi 'gong bstan dang 'gro/ /phan bde bskrun pa'i g.yar dam de rmad byung / /lus can bsod nams rgya mtsho spel ba'i zhing / /chos 'khor stod smad rnams la sri zhu dang / /srid gsum dbang mo rigs kyis srung ma la/ /gsol mchod bskul don yid kyi thig ler son/ /dkar min las kyis bskyod pa'i rtsod 528

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rang snyan rgyud mang / (popa'i mun/ /byang phyogs 'thibs pa sel la gcig zhol mod/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon khyod kyi mthu stobs nyis/ /rab sangs dga' bder sbyor ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ /snyan shal rkang 'thung phur ma gser skyems la/ /'tshams sprin 'od bkra'i rgya yis nyer bcings te/ /g.yo ru khra 'brug gnas skyong spyan snga sa /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya legs par spel/ srin po zhes pa shing yos logs ra kyi tshe sprul sku ༅ dbang snyan grags kyi snyan tshig gi lan dbyangs can phang 'gro'i bsnyems(226ba〉phrog /lha ba sha rnye ma sgo rā sgo bakho 'i tsa rnya tho le 〉 da na su k+ṣa rā du shu haḥ la kha ta sbu ra to 'i ta ga su nga su : yulha ga ca na : rta ཿ ri ka: srid (sdeb skyor mkho pa'i brit+ta las me kho phreng tso/)dang zhi bar snyan pa'i gtam gyi rgyud/ /rnam dpyod sor mos bskul ba'i 'gyur khugs las/ /'phrin yig ta'i ra las drangs pa'i glu/ /dbyangs can phang 'gro'i bsnyems pa 'phrog pa bzhin/ /spel legs bdog pa sngon 'gros dus kun tu/ /dge bar 'gyur ba'i shis brjod man+da ra/ /thod bcings 'di ko 'chi med lus phra'am/ /'on kyang ngur smrig 'dzin zhes 'phyang mo nyug /ring min char yang dge sbyong klog pa'i gzhung / /mang thos bsam dang sgom par legs gzhol ba/ /zo mdog bde ba'i rnam smin dkar po la/ /spyod thos rangs pa'i yid dbang kun dga'i dpyid/ /phra yang btsan po'i las rjes 'brangs pa'i 'bras/ /bslu med rgyal gsung nges dbang gzhan dag nas/ /'tshol bar bltos min mngon sum mthong chos la/ /chu gter rgod pa'i 'dzum (227na)rlabs ci yang g.yo/ /'di na nyin zhig srad bur bgrang bya'i 'phreng / /drug cur nye ba'i rtsis gdab mkhan po'ang / /sred pa'i lcags kyus nyer btab sems kyi glang / /rnam g.yeng shalbi dar rgyu'i rol rtsed tsam/ /gtsug lag mang sbyangs ngag gi spobs pa'i dbang / /yongs thob snyan pa'i grags 'bar skal bzang pa/ shes bya'i pha mtha' ma rnyed ngal ba'i sems/ /ma yengs phyag rgya'i mal du bag phab bzhin/ /'gog pa'i bsam gtan 'thug po'i chu 'dzin la/ /blta ba'i yang dag 'jog blo'i mdongs mtha' can/ /lhag mthong dbyar rnga bsgrags min thar pa'i sgro/ /zlum por bsgyur ba'i dus de ring zhig bskal/ /zas gtsang sras bstan lung dus lnga brgya'i nang / /sgra tshad bzo gso la sogs —529

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherig pa'i gnas/ /'chad nyan don dang ldan na mang thos khyod/ /sgom blo'i khur des shing bzang pags 'og rgas/ /zag bcas gnyid las langs te tshangs pa yis/ kha ba'i ljongs 'dir gang gi dpe zla zhig /ma rnyed mtho ris gnas kyi sarba dz+nyāḥ/ /ched du sprul par nges las gzhan du ci/ /ma 'dris kun dang mdza' ba'i snying rje'i gter/ tags bya'i pha mtha' gzhal ba'i spyan dkyus ring / /rgol ngan klad pa 'gems pa'i dpa' rtul gyis/ /rigs gsum sgyu dra'i gar de khyod kyis bsgyur/ /chos tshul rgya mtsho smra la dbyig gi gnyen/ /rtsom la dge dbang bla gos gsar pas klubs/ /brjod pa rnam dag btsun pa zla ba yi/ /mched po nyid las gzhan du su yis rnyed/ /'dod yon 'dam bying dwags brgyud shing rta ding /kha lo sgyur byed gcig pu las gzhan par/ /lha dbang mig stong bltas pas ma (227ba)rnyed phyir/ /'khor ba zad min de srid gzhol cig gu /bskal par rdzogs dka' gnam lo tshes so cog /skyes bzang snyan 'phrin chad med bskul ba'i rten/ /sna tshogs ri mo bkod pa'i dar dkar po/ /pho lha'i snyim pas thogs te phyogs der song / / shing stag tshangs pa dung thod can gyi sku khog sangs rgyas phun tshogs dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa'i tshe snyan shal gser skyems dmod nas dang tsos ris kyi tsha bor bab pa hor zla bce gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la yid ches sngon du gyur par brten shing yos hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu gnyis la mchod sprin tshogs mchod dang bcas dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa btang pa'i tshe 'phrin gsol lha zhal bag mar sgo pa 'i dga' ston/ su sti'i sgra las drangs pa'i phun tshogs kyi/ /ngo mtshar dbyangs kyi 'phreng ba sngon btang nas/ /bkra shis g.yas 'khyil dung dkar thod bcings pa'i/ /lha chen tshangs pa chen por ched gsol don/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel ba dang / /legs nyes blang dor lung du ston pa'i phyir/ /sku rten khog pa gsar par 'gyangs med du/ /byon par yid kyi spro ba ci yang brtas/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs mkha' khyab kyi/ /dam skong mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgor/ /mtshon byed dngos bshams dpyad khra zur gsal bzhin/ /'bul bar pho nya mngags ltar dgyes skyed cig /sangs rgyas gnyis pa mtsho skyes rdo rje yi/ /spyan sngar dam bcas 'kha bzhes ma g.yel bar/ /thub —530

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('bastan spyi dang mnyam med btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs srid mtha'i bar du rgyas pa dang / /dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang gi /khrims gnyis gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong can/ /nor 'dzin kun la khyab nas lus can rnams/ /bde zhing skyid pa'i dpal la (228na tshe cur par mdzod/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang bum pa bzang po bzhin/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /bsgrub par mdzod cig mthu chen lha'i tshangs pa/ /'byung ba sum ldan shing me yos kyi lo/ /rgyal bas bdud dpung bcom pa mnyan yod kyi/ /dkar phyogs dpa' ba dga' ston tshes bzang por/ /pho brang po ta la yi rtse nas dge /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing yos lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag /shing bos tsher gseb pa chos skyong 'a po khog tu zhugs kyang lo rer lan re tsam la mi phebs pas mdangs mdzad skabs ho me zla gnyis pa'i nang du rgyu mtshan gsal bar chang khyim pa blo bzang dngos grub btang pa'i 'phrin gsol phan bde'i sgo 'byed/dregs pa kun gyi sde dpon srog gi bdag /lha chen tshangs pa sngon gyi zhal bzhes bzhin/ /mi yi rten la mngon sum nyer brlams pa/ /yongs kyi yid la spro ba'i rtse dga' brtas/ /lung rtogs nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam rnyed pa'i mgon/ /rgya bal bod sogs byon pa ches mang yang / /snang srid dbang bsdus sde brgyad bran 'khol ba/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng tsam las gzhan du ci/ /slob dpon gang de'i bka' rtags phyag rgya las/ /mi 'da' gangs can bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i ched/ /lo rer thengs gcig min par mchog dman gyi/ /re ba skong slad sngar bzhin khog zhugs gsol/ /phebs na skyon du 'gyur ba med snyam med/ /ljongs 'dir bzlog dka' mi dge'i las slong spo/ /yang na rdzogs ldan lta bur blang dor lung / /bstan la bltos pa min pa yid la drang / /spyan gzigs khra shar tshogs kyi 'khor lo bcas/ /'bul —531

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebar mngags pa'i pho nya'i g.yar lam nas/ /'i kha par phul lan lhug (228ba)par rtsol zhig ces/ /bskul rten bkra shis lha yi dar 'dis spras/ /shing yos tshangs pa dung thod can gyis rim gro bskul ba'i gsung 'phrin byung ba'i lan rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs/ rgyal bar gyur cig bstan srung tshangs pa che/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon dung thod srog gi bdag /dpal gyi mgur nas lha gtam snyan pa'i 'phrin/ /rab dkar dar rten 'byor bas sim pa thob/ /mngon sum mi yi khog tu nyer brlams te/ /sku yi rnam 'gyur gsung gi brjod pa dang / /zab yangs thugs kyi mkhyen pa sngar byon gyi/ /tshul dang mthun la yid ches spro dga' brtas/ /gegs sel rim gro'i blang dor ji snyed kun/ /rnyog bral rdzing bu'i nang du zla gzugs bzhin/ /gsal bar rdo rje'i tshig gis lung bstan pa/ /mi bskyud sems kyi dpal ber gcig tu 'khyil/ /snang srid sde brgyad yongs kyi srog snying la/ /dbang sgyur e ṇ+ḍi ya na'i slob dpon che'i/ /dam tshig nyer dgongs las bzhi bsgrub bo zhes/ /zhal gyis 'ches la rangs pa'i mos pa thob/ /gser skyems lha rdzas zung 'brel mchod sprin la/ /thun 'tshams rgya yis legs 'byud dbos nya ba'i/ /dmar cha'i dga' ba dang po'i tshes kyi nyin/ /gru 'dzin ri bo'i rtse nas spel ba dge /shing yos rdo dga' ldan rnam rgyal nas klu rgyal 'dzin pa la gsung gi 'phrin lan gdengs can dga' byed/ gdengs can gtsug na nor bu rab 'chang pa/ /'dzin pa lag mang klu yi rgyal po ches/ /blang dor dngas mtsho'i zla ltar gsung 'phrin rten/ /nyams med son pas yid kyi spro dga' brtas/ /spyi dang sgos kyi rim 'gro tshul bzhin bgyid/ /srung ma khyod kyis (229na tha stan 'gro'i legs tshogs spel/ /'jig rten khams su char chu dus 'bab cing / /lo tog sbrums sogs bde skyid dpal la sbyor/ /mthun rdzas gser thums klu sman ril bu dang / /dar sngon yug bcas nag pa zla ba yi/ /yar tshes dge bar bod yul rdo rje gdan/ /pho brang dmar po ri nas bris pa dge /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i srin po zhes pa shing yos kyi lo 'jam dbyangs bla ma sa chen ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug dang kun —532

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rang snyan rgyud mang / ('amakhyen mkhyen brtse'i rigs dbon gnas gsar ba ngag dbang bsod nams kyis thog drangs snod ldan mang por dge sdings rdo rje'i pho brang du khyab bdag zhwa lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos tshad ma bzhi ldan slob bshad kyi smin grol gdams pa'i sgo 'phar che ba'i tshe sa skya khri chen la phul ba'i zhu yig yang chos 'khor lo sgyur ba'i gtam/ /dza sbu'i ba b.ri shā sa na ga ma na su shi na/ sa dra sno/ pa : tra/ 'dzam gling bstan 'gro yongs kyi dpal mgon dam pa rin po cher phul/ ga ṅga : du ra sa mā nā ni tu dzi go no lha sa rba / la sa 6/ra khyi ā khya tsa tu rje na mo kha dha mi na ṇa dza sa rā ka bra // gaṅgā'i (dza khi sdes sbyor 'phags ma'i dbyangs/)rdul snyed las 'das rgyal rnams kyi/ /yon tan thugs bskyed drod kyis rigs kun bdag /gser sgong yongs smin sde bzhi'i zhal sgo can/ /chos phung rgya mtsho'i 'byung (229bskonas mes po cher/ /nye ba'i char yang lha sngags ye shes kyi/ /gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyis 'khor lo'i gar/ /'dzam gling skye rgu'i bsod nams mchod sdong du/ gyur 'di yid kyi kun dga' bskyed pa'i gsos/ /ring nas bdud bzhi'i dmag dpung mthar byas pa'i/ /mtshan dpe'i lang tsho bkra ba'i lus brtas par/ /snyun 'dri byis blor nges mod tshul bstan tsam/ /med de skal bzang lus can legs byas dpyid/ /'di na phra mo'i na tshod zla ches nas/ /thos bsam 'phel 'grib byed pa'i blo dman bdag /srid pa'i nyes skyon mthong bzhin chos brgyad gdon/ /snying btab smyon pa'i gar mkhan lta bur gnas/ /'di gsal lha rigs tshangs pa'i ral klung nas/ /'jam dbyangs thugs rje'i yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /gangs can bstan pa'i khyab 'jug zhabs bsil du/ /tshad med lung rtogs rgya mtshor 'khyil ba med/ /gtan bde'i nor bu don gnyen mgron po rnams/ /brtse chen bla ma'i thugs bstod gru gzings la/ /brten nas thar pa'i rin chen gling 'khrid pa'i/ /ded dpon mchog de khyod min gzhan na ci/ /yang srid nyer lngar 'jam pa'i rdo rje yis/ /rjes bzung lnga rig 'chad nyan sgra bo che/ /sa skya lo sto'i bstan pa gangs can kun/ /yongs khyab spel bar bsams ban spyon nam snyam/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gdan khri pad can steng / /zhabs rdul dmar 'od lhungs pa'i 'dren pa khyod/ /sa gsum skye rgu'i tshogs kyi (230na)—533

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegatsug tor rtser/ /rdo rje skyil krung gcig gis khyab pa 'dra/ /yab chos rgyal srid bor nas khyim bdag gi /brtul zhugs lhur len mdzad pa 'ga' byung mod/ /grags pa'i mtshan snyan ched du bstan spel don/ /byon nges ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhabs/ /mgon des sa skya'i bla chen yab sras kyi/ /ring lugs gdugs dkar yu ba nyer gtad kyang / /da dung lhag mar lus rnams 'chad nyan gyis/ /spel ba'i khur 'degs gang gi res su bab/ /he ru gaḥdangos blo gros rgyal mtshan bar/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan snyan nas snyan brgyud pa/ /slob bshad smin grol gdams pa nyin byed kyis/ /bod yul gdul bya'i snang ba ches dkar mdzod/ khyab bdag blo gsal zhal lung bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /nges par skal bzang mtha' dag snod gyur kyang / /kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rigs dbon la/ /bum pa gang 'byo'i tshul du rjes bzung gsol/ /gdong lngas bteg pa'i rin chen khri steng du/ /'og min zhing gi gtso bo'i rjes 'gro bar/ /bskal pa ma stongs de srid g.yo med du/ /bzhugs nas chos 'khor rgyun chad med bskor mdzod/ /phal dang dam pa'i khyad par gnam sa ltar/ /rang bzhin bzang po kun la mi gtong mod/ /thugs kyis nam yang mi 'dor mnyes gshin pa'i/ /bka' mchid nyi zla'i bgrod rjes rkang 'jog gsol/ /zhu yig pad+ma'i tshal du spyan ras kyi/ /ra yig gnyis pa'i 'phur lding g.yo ba'i slad/ /lha gos margad (230ba〉pa dog la rgyas spras te/ /rgyal khab dmar po ri nas phul ba dge /ra po 'byung bcu gcig pa'i srin po zhes pa shing yos kyi lo rigs kun khyab bdag mkhan chen zha lu ba rin cen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos shab dge sdings rdo rje'i pho brang du rje btsun sa skya pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug dang /rdo rje 'chang 'a ka' 'gyur ba'i dbon gnas gsar pa ngag dbang bsod nams kyis thog drangs snod ldan 'ga' zhig la gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad gnang ba'i tshe brtan bzhugs kyi tshul du phul ba slob bshad bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ma ho pa : badz+ra dha ra mahā ti shu lha/ su : ñca sa 5 4 su pa ṇi tsa kra ma ṇ+ḍi n+ya ཿ tu ri pas re sha ba rti ba/ kā ṣa pya ba sta rnyi sa ri tu ba ra to / ma to stu co sa tu ta re ṇa yaḥmakhan chen rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por dge /kha (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i git+ta las dbang tsho rgyud/〉sbyor bdun ldan —534

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snya ngag tu 'god pa ra po snyan rgyud mang / (pegaser gyi 'khor lo yis/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gling bzhin mnga' sgyur kyang / /thun mtshams gosakyi rdzu bag la 'tshel ba/ /mchog gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gang / (231na)/yongs dag snang stong he ru gaḥyi sku/ /sgrib 'bras snyan rdul rnyog mas sbags pa'i gnas/ /srid min 'khrul ngor ston kyang deng gi dus/ /sgra gcan las grol zla ltar gsal ba spro/ /'di na tshe rabs dkar min gyis bskyed nad/ /yan lag zug rngu'i tsher byung tsher ba'i ro/ /gtan bder zhen pa'i don med rnam g.yeng mal/ /dge sdig 'dres ma'i gnyid la rang zhe khrel/ /gshegs bzhugs gang du skal bzang gdul bya la/ /dbang por 'tsham pa'i chos sbyin bdud rtsi yis/ /thar pa'i srog rtsa 'dzin pa'i 'phrin las 'dis/ /nyi ma'i gnyen la gdung sems bags kyis zha/ /mkhas rlome mang pos mthong thos ma gyur pa/ /rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol lam chen por/ shes ldan phal cher drangs tshe 'di las gzhan/ /au ṇ+ḍi yā na'i gsang mdzod logs su med/ /rang shul 'dzin slad bran gyis smig rgyu la/ /nyal 'gror sgro btags mched min rgyud sdo bzhi'i/ /phra rags phyag bzhes gsol bar byang gling rje/ /skye ba'i rnam par 'phrul la som nyi bral/ /rigs gsum sgyu 'dra'i gar mkhan 'khon gyi gdung / /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos sa skya'i rje btsun dang / /kun gzigs mkhyen brtse'i dpon sogs dam chos kyi/ /bdag por rang nor sprod pa'i tshul la mos/ /mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo'i zhal gyi rlangs/ /ma nyams rnal 'byor dbang phyug gdams pa'i gnad/ /lam dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i gsung ngag 'di/ /gsang chen (231ba khu64kyi snying po'i nying khu yin/ /tsho gis par tshig tsam bshad pa'i na yam gyis/ /thun mong gdul bya tshim dang mi 'dra ba/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan slob bshad sa skya pa'i/ /gdung brgyud rim byon rnams kyi gces pa'i nor/ /bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi gtad pa'i bstan/ /'dzin mkhas kun spangs chos rje'i thugs kyi sras/ /blo gsal rgya mtsho'i rjes 'brangs ma gtogs pa/ /sa brdzus phal gyis rtogs pa'i skal ba phra/ /zab zab dpyad na khungs med phyag rgya'i sgom/ /ngal ngal sbyangs mthar skyid sgyur rtog ge'i chos/ /snyan snyan rang gzhan blo brid tha snyad gzhung / /'grig 'grig phal gyi do zla ga la yin/ /mgon khyod bstan 'gror smin pa kho 535

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)na'i las/ /mdzad kyang khyad par yang dag don gnas pa/ /snyan brgyud ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi lung / /gsungs tshe dpal ldan chos skyong gzugs gzhan bsgyur/ /mi 'gyur rdo rjes mchan pa'i re khā 'a steng / /mi g.yo zha khas zung skyil mo krung bcas nas/ /mi yi seng ge'i bstan pa srid mtha'i bar mi 'jigs mkhyen brtse nus pas spel ched bzhugs/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje khrag 'thung dam tshig bzhin/ /ma hā kā la'i sde dpon gur gyi mgon/ /stobs 'phrog gdong bzhi pu tra beg tse yis/ /bzhed stongs lha min gdon gyi dpung rnams choms/ /rigs byed ma dang tshogs bdag 'dod rgyal gyis/ /srid zhi'i tshe dang dpal 'byor dbang thang char/ /phob la rang bstan kha'u brag rdzong pa'i/ /bshad nyan dpag bsam snye ma g.yur za mdzod/ /(232na)ring zhing yangs par brkyang ba'i ljags bzang las/ /bka' mchid chos kyi dga' ston snyan pa'i sgra/ /rna ba bdud rtsir byed pa skal pa'i mtha'/ /rdzogs min de srid chad pa med par gsol/ /gar dbang tshe dpag med pa'i mgon po sa /rten 'byung sgo brgya bsgrig pa dngos po'i dpya/ /chom rkun bsrung ba'i khro shar thun mtshams rgyas/ /legs spras sa ga zla ba'i yar ngor dge /shing yos bsam yas mdo sde mchod pa'i dus ston 'bul bar sbyar ra dngos grub btang ba'i tshe sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen por 'phrin dugs la pa dgyes zhal r+sā zla ltar ngams/ bde ldan gar dbang thugs rje'i 'od zer sne/ si rgyu'i chu gter 'dab brgyar zug pa las/ /rdzus skyes pad+ma thod 'phreng srid gsum na/ /brtul zhugs zla bral rig sngags 'chang ba'i rje/ /mgon des lha sras gtsor gyur dmag gi dpung / /yongs mngags hor gyi sgom gra'i ka ca'i rjes/ /nye bar 'brangs tshe zan g.yang lhun grub kyi/ /srung mar mnga' gsol li byin ha ra che/ /dri med dag pa'i spyan ras btsa' ba'i rten/ /kun bzang mchod sprin thor gsal snga mkho ltar/ /rmad byung mdo sde mchod pa'i dus spel bar/ /dgyes bzhin rdul bral ston gyi zla 'drar dngoms/ /gangs can gtan bde 'phrog nus 'dod lha'i mdas/ /snying zin phyogs bzhi mtshams nas langs pa'i dgra /stobs ldan gang du 'dug kyang mngag gzhug bcas/ /'jig (232brten phyi ma'i ltad mor myur du khrid/ /mang bkur rgyal khab khrims gnyis gser gyi shing / /mchog dman yongs kyi gnya' ba mnan —536

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (popa'i ljid/ /rngul chu gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin chad med du/ /'bab pa'i 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis sgrubs/ /mi bsrun dregs pa'i sde dpon tshul bzung ba/ /gtum drag rtsal gyis bdud snying 'dar nus kyang / /dpal chen ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /gzhan don bsgyur las chos kyi dbyings su zhi/ /sgron dar zla ba thags su nyer btags pa/ /'phrin gsol thun mtshams rgyas spras yongs bteg nas/ /rta ljang gling khyim zhugs pa'i dkar cha'i tshes/ /pho brang dmar po ri yi rtse nas dge /srin po'i lo zan g.yang du mdo sde'i dus ston gyi thog legs skyes 'bul bar sbyar ra dngos grub btang ba'i tshe las mkhan gnod sbyin r+pā po tshe ru dmar por phren du gsol spugs drag dpa' bo'i sgos sgra/ li yul tshangs spyod rgyud zhabrug dmod pa'i 'bras/ /'bar ba spun bdun srid gsum 'jig rten na/ khyu dang mi rgyu'i srog gi bdag gyur gtso/ /sde brgyad yongs kyi dmag dpon tse dmar ba/ /e nyi yā na'i sangs rgyas gnyis pa des/ /gser gyi rdo rje ri mo gtsug tu bkod/ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bcud kyis tshim byas nas/ /rgyal bstan mel tsher mnga' gsol yang le ber/ /chen por rlom la las dbang dam sri sa gyur sogs rgya bod bdud rigs 'gong po yis/ /'gro mang sems bsgyur skye rgu'i bde 'phrog pa/ /lus med 'phrul dpung 'joms pa'i rtsal shugs (233na tha skyed/ /sad ser nad rims mu ge ltas ngan 'bras/ /stobs ldan dpa' bo khyod kyis bzlog nus mod/ /gal te sems can las kyi mthu btsan na/ /gzhil thabs blang dor lung du ston par rigs/ /sde snod gsum las mdo sde lha dang mi'i/ /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi mchod sprin thog /sngon bzhin thugs dam skong ba'i spyan gzigs rdzas/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas rgya cher spel/ /gangs can rgyal khab gser gyi tog mdzes 'od/ /'bar ba nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'dzin pa'i gzis/ /'dzam bu'i shing gis legs mtshan yul khams kun/ /zil gyis gnon pa'i 'phrin las ma lus sgrubs/ /ring por brkyang ba bkra shis dkar po'i dar/ /lha khyod snyan gyi rgya mtshor rab spud de/ /chu shel dbang pos sa ga dang 'grogs pa'i/ /snga ma'i phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum par dge /shing yos khra 'brug tshangs pa chen pos rim gro'i bskul ma dang sbrags sbug chol dgos tshul byung ba ltar spyan gzigs tshan grangs —537—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)dang bcas 'bul bar yar 'brog sgrog mkhar pa btang skabs rdo rje'i gsung lan su sdi'i sgra dbyangs/ swa sti'i sgra las drangs pa'i dbyangs snyan pos/ /lha rgyal bkra shis mgrin nas blangs pa'i glu /bde legs me tog char dang lngan cig par/ /len par tshangs pa'i sgra 'dzin cung zad gson/ /gsung 'phrin rdo rje'i tshig gi 'dab brgya pa/ /blang dor lung du ston pa'i ze'u 'bru/ /don bzang snyan pa'i sbrang rtsi yongs (233ba'i jag tshe/ /yid dbang kuṇ+ḍa 'a dga' ston ba 'ad la brel/ /bde ldan zhing gi mgon po snang mtha' yas/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa rig sngags 'chang ba'i tshul/ /'dzin mdzad pad+ma kā ra'i pho nya ba/ /srog bdag lha yi ge dpon nye bar dgongs/ /gangs kyis yongs bskor su la'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /kun mkhyen shākya'i bstan pa dpag bsam ljon/ /dang ba'i phan bde'i grib mar lus can rnams/ /sim pa'i tshor ba myong ba'i las sgrubs shig /thugs dam skong byed snyan pa'i rol mo sogs/ /mthun rdzas grangs gsal sngags rgyas nyer brlabs nas/ /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'byed na/ /dgyes pa'i spyan gyi ras ma lhung zhig gu /sgrib gnyis des bskyed nad gdon zug rngu zhi/ /lung rtogs tshe dpal srid zhi'i yon tan rgyas/ /mchog thun dngos grub mtha' dag dbang du sdus/ /'khor 'das nyes brgya'i dgra dpung drag pos choms/ /yar la dkon cog mchod sogs rten 'brel sgo /bsgrig thabs blang dor mtsho la byed lta bur/ /gang gsal le lo'i sgrog tu ma tshud par/ /brtson pa'i thang la dkyus thog gcod par 'dun/ /rgyal blon snyan shal mdzes byed dar dkar po/ /zung 'jug rten ldan snron zla'i yar tshes la/ /sa yi thig le g.yo ru khra 'brug gi /gnas srung chen po'i 'dun sar spel ba dge /shing yos hor zla drug pa'i yar (234na lhas la tshangs pa dung thod can gyi drung du spyan gzigs tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas 'jig rten bde sdug bi lung bstan zhu bar 'phyos chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse btang skabs gsol ba'i 'phrin yig lha chen snyan gyi sgo 'byed/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus mthu bzhu blugs khams/ /mtsho skyes sprul skur shar ba pad+ma 'byung / /srid gsum 'gran zla bral ba'i rig sngags 'chang / /zhabs rdul dregs pa'i gtsug tor rtser mdzes bsngags/ /srog bdag gong gi sdod pon tshangs pa che/ /snyan gyi dbang po gtod la dri ba'i lan/ /—538

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dzadalha mig dag pa'i spyan gyis 'jig rten khams/ /myul nas sba bsri med par drang por stsol/ /gangs can sman ljongs yul 'dir sad ser than/ /mi phyugs sna tshogs nad rigs mtha' dbus kyi/ /ma rungs 'byung po 'khrugs pa'i ltas ngan 'phrul/ /mang dag shar 'dir 'bras bu ci zhig 'byung / /stod smad lho byang rtsod pa'i 'ur langs sogs/ /dus kyi chad pa phyir ldog 'gro ba rnams/ /bder 'god blang dor lung bstan zhu ba'i tshig /thor gsal zhib cha pho nya'i ngag nas gsal/ /spyan gzigs khro shar thun mtshams mi 'gyur rgyas/ /yongs btab chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes la/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas nyer brlabs mchod pa'i sprin/ /rgyal khab lte ba dmar po ri nas spel/ /shing yos gong nas stag lung sku skye dang blo bzang dge slong gis gtsos pa'i gser yig pa bka' (234ba tshe sgog rgyun gyi gnang sbyin thog khams phyogs mi bde ba'i rtsa rkyen mkha' 'gro phyir dbyung bar legs so'i 'dog pa gya nom pa stsal ba'i tshe zhu yig rten pa ras 'bul bar chag mig mkhan chen rin chen bkra shis dang gnas gsar ba mkhyen rab rnam rgyal btang ba'i dus phul ba 'gro kun gtsug tor 'jog pa'i 'bor tsho ri mo/ pa spro la sa ni ma sa kri ya ༷ r+sha dza skru di she na snyi jo da su 'a natra kaḥ re kha kho bā li ko ba du na bha ba shā stu ṣ+ṭha ba sa rba ta sto ma to spru la tā/ zhabs (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta las me tog 'phreng can/) pad mtshan bzang 'khor lo'i mu khyud rtsibs/ /'dzam gling yid can spyi bor shar ba'i bar/ /ri mo gnam gyi she mong dpung pa yis/ /srid zhi'i dngos po kun gyis bstod bya'i drung / /'jam mgon skye rgur rjes chags me long ngos/ /tshangs pa mi yi gzugs su yongs shar der/ /spos bsregs me tog 'thor ba sngon song ba'i/ /bcos min dang ba'i yid kyis 'di skad gsol/ /gser 'brug ster lnga 'khyil bas gyen bteg (235na)pa'i/ /gnam gyi she mong ri mo rab bkra ba/ /bka' shog dbugs dbyung ched du bsngags pa'i tshig /spel legs snyan 'gyur pi wang rjes 'gro'i rten/ /dngul gyi yol go bzhi dang bzang gos yug /nyer bzhi bkras btags nyin mo bde legs lnga/ /nan ching kha btags bzhi bcu gser gyi sga /cha tshang nyams med son pas spro ba 'phel /nges par mtshan dang dpe byad rnam bkra'i sku/ /ma dag 'gro ba'i dbang por bag zha yang / /gzi byin —539

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)nyi ma 'bum la rab 'khu bas/ /ci ste brgya byin yin snyam 'phyang mo nyug /yongs kyi rnar 'jebs drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsung / /yid la bde ba ster ba'i zil dngar can/ /phas rgol klad pa 'gems la drag po'i sgra /sgrogs tshe lag na rdo rje gzugs g.yin bzhin/ sha shes byar srid do cog gi gnas lugs zla/ /dri bral thugs mtshor legs shar kun mkhyen pas/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi byed po khyod nyid las/ /logs nas bskal brgyar btsal kyang dmigs su med/ /de phyir snyun dri gsol ba byis pa'i blo/ /tshur mthong tsam mod 'on te thun mong ngor/ /mang bkur rgyal khab gser khrir g.yo med gtam/ /rgyud mangs glu yis thos 'dzin dga' ston bcin/ /lha gcig bka' drin bsil ba'i grib ma la/ /spyod pa'i sde snod gsum pa klog pa mkhan/ /ris med sems can bde bar smin pa'i (235ba thad/ /rdul bral ston zla des kyang mi bsgrun tsam/ /skye rgu brgyad khri'i tshe dus 'khor lo bzhis/ /sgyur bar chos nyid yin par mtshar du ci/ /rtsod ldan brgya pa'i lo la kun bzod mtha'/ /stobs kyi dpung pas 'ching 'di gcig tu med/ /btsan po'i las shugs grangs snyed tshangs pa yis/ /tshe ring gnam ngos bris pa zad min par/ /mnga' thang gzhom par 'dod pa'i skye bo dang / /dbang phyug smyon pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin la sdang / /log spyod lam las ldog phyir byams pa'i thugs/ /mi bzad rdo rje thos pa'i dpa' rtags kyi/ /dpung tshogs yan lag rnam ba'i khi dbang phyug bar/ /mig gsum pa des 'gran kyang cung zad ngal/ /brlang spyod gnya' nas gnon pa'i khrims kyi rgyud/ /snyems pa'i gnam ru mngon sum 'gugs na'ang / /nyam chung mi 'dor brtse ba'i chus brlan pa'i/ /phan bde'i gser gyi snye ma g.yur du za/ /legs byas phung por spungs pa srid pa'i rtser/ /snyengs kyang chog shes mi byar gsung rab las /bshad phyir skyil mo krung gcig bskal mtha'i bar/ /bca' ched tshogs chen bsod nams gsog par bskul/ /nga las nus sogs sngon byon 'khor sgyur dang / /mtshudas pa'i char srid 'dab stong bzhad pa'i khams/ /rdo rje'i dngos por mchog gsum thugs rje yis/ /brlab par smon pa'i 'dun pa gcig tu spro/ /bde ldan zhing gi mgon po 'od mtha' yas/ /'chi (236na thad bdud rtsi'i bum pas lha khyod —540

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dzadagatsug /dbang bskur srog gi ka ba nyer btsugs nas/ /bskal brgyar sku tshe'i g.yung drung 'khyil bar shog /byams pa'i 'dren byed gzigs pa lhod med brdar/ /gnam gyi lung bzang bka' shog gser yig rgyun/ /ma pham dbus sā ra 'chang du 'byon min par/ /nyi zla'i bgrod pa ji bzhin chad med stsol/ /mching gsol ri mor lha mig dag pa'i spyan/ /dkyus ring zur tsam lhung ba'i 'bab rten du/ / dkar dmar rin chen 'phreng ba snam phrug sogs/ /bdog pa'i skyes la rtags kyi lang tsho bkra /lhab lhub gos ljang g.yo ba yos kyi lo/ /zla ba gro bzhin gyis nya'i yar tshes la/ /dbang phyogs 'dun sar dga' ba'i bzhin bteg nas/ /phul bas phun tshogs dga' ston rgyas gyur cig /shing yos hor zla brgyad pa'i lha tshes thog bsam yas su dregs pa'i sde dpon chos rgyal li byin ha rar spyan gzigs tshogs 'khor dang sa gegs sel gyi lung bstan zhu bar chos rje zin gnon rdo rje rdzong bda' byas skabs 'phrin du gsol ba don gnyis yongs bo'i ljon pa/ bha ta hor gyi sgom gra'i ka ca rnams/ /lha sras blon por bcas pa'i dmag dpung gis/ /drangs pa'i rjes 'brangs li byin ha ra zhes/ /sde brgyad yongs kyi sde dpon chen po kye/ /za hor rigs la chags pa'i dgra lha che/ /pha mes brgyud nas bsten pa'i srung ma mchog /phyi rol rang rgyud dregs pa'i gzugs (236ba'i dzin yang / /don du sems nyid gcig pu'i rnam 'phrul tsam/ /mngal gyi dri bral mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes/ /sangs rgyas gnyas pa gang de'i dam tshig bzhin/ /gangs can bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid kun/ /bla nas blar bteg dbyar mtsho'i rjes 'gror spel/ /ban bon mthu byed skye bo'i dug mtshon sogs/ /sngags 'chang bdag la sdo ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /zla tshes ltar dkar mche ba rnon po'i rtser/ /mi rtag lam du bkod la rdul du rlog /gnas skabs tshe dpal dbang phyug yongs 'du'i ljon/ /yal 'dab phang phung rgyas pa'i rtse mo sa /gtan mdun thos bsam sgom pa'i chos kyi 'bras/ /yangs smin ro brgya bda' ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /kun rtog sems kyi 'char sgor dpyad mi bzod/ /ma rtogs lkog gyur dri ba pho nya yi/ /g.yar lam nas 'bul the tshom nyer gcod pa'i/ /lung bstan rdo rje'i tshig gi gsang ba sgrogs/ /snyan shal gser skyems la sogs thor gsal bzhin/ /—541—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22) sna khyod thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i ched/ /hor zla brgyad pa'i dkar cha'i tshes bzang bar/ /bstan srung chos rgyal chen po'i spyan sngar dge /srin po'i lo khrums zla'i lha tshes thog zan g.yang srung ma tse'u dmar por thun rdzas tshogs mchod dang bcas dri smad kyi rgyu mtshan zhu bar gnubs ban zil gnon rdo rje btang dus 'phrin gsol dam tshig gcig pa'i lha snyan yongs bskul/ sngon nas g.ya' dam gcig pa rigs kyi lha/ /gnod sbyin bshan pa'i gtso bo tse'u dmar/ /(237na skong srid dregs pa'i dpung gi kha lo pa/ /thugs dam bskul ba'i tshigs la cung zad gson/ /'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i sku 'grub pas/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi spyi mes rig sngags 'chang / /pad+ma thod 'phreng snyan grags dbyar skyes rnga/ /grags pa phyogs bral rna bar 'god mkhas des/ /gangs can gtsug lag khang dang de 'dzin pa'i/ /rab 'byung dbu zlum sngags pa lcang lo'i sde/ /rgyal bstan skyong ba'i mel tshe mkhan po mā /dam la btags nas khyod nyid bskos min nam/ khyad par gter brtan mnga' bdag nyang ral sogs/ /rigs 'dzen rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tsho gos rnams kyis/ /rnal 'byor bdag ge srung mar bka' bsgos ba'i na/ /bsams pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /gangs can phan bde 'phrog pa mtha' bzhi'i dmag /mi bsrun dgra bo'i snying khrag la thung ba dang / /chabs gcig 'dre ngan 'gong po dam sri yi/ /tshe srog nus stobs ming gi lhag mar thong / /the tshom mdud pa 'grol byed dri ba rnams/ /pho nya'i ngag nas phul bas blang dor gyi/ /gnad gsang ma lus bkral te rdo rje'i gsung / /sba sri med bar lung du ston par gsol/ /rnam mang spyan gzigs tshogs kyi 'khor lor bcas/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas nyer brlabs te/ khrums kyi zla ba'i yar tshes dge ba la/ /sde brgyad rba klong 'khrug pa'i gnas der dge/(237ba/ rgya nag lho phyogs su dus 'khrug byung ba'i skor la bka' rtags gnam gyi lung bzang po bkras btags nyin bde ma da nga rtags brgyad ma bzang gos kyi gnod sbyin dang bcas dkon cog mer rgan dkar bcu dang rgya tha'i thung rab 'byams pa gnyis gnang ba dang lhan du bka' lan 'bul bar mi sna sbrel po rdzong bda' zhus skabs phul ba'i zhu yig 'phrin las gdugs dkar/ ā u rdirgyu kha tu gra ba la su tsa kra ba rti ka ga ga na : : shrī shu za ma lha stokho ta ma rwa lha 'i le/—542

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dzadatshe ring gnam gyi she mong gis stobs kyi 'khor ༷ ba gnam sa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i drung du/ mi phyed dang ba'i yid kyis dri bzang po'i spos bsregs bkra shis pa'i me tog gtor nas mi yi bdag pos skye rgu thams cad bde legs su mdzad par gyur cig ces bkra shis pa'i tshig sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gsol ba/ deng gi dus nyid na'ang 'dzam gling skye 'gro mtha' dag gi bsod nams kyi zhing dam par lha yi lha tshangs pa mi yi gzugs can du bsgyur nas 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i gser gyi khri chen por zhabs zung gi 'khor lo mngon par bkod de mthong na mi mthun pa med pa'i mtshan bzang lang tsho rgyas pa'i gzugs sku nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin ltar (238na)'bar/mchog dman bar pa'i rna bar snyan zhing 'jebs pa drug cu'i rjes 'gro'i dbyangs snyan pos bde skyid kyi lam du bkri /srid dang zhi ba'i blang dor gyi gnas mtha' dag la sgrib pa med pa'i mkhyen pas snyigs ma'i dus kyi yid can rnams kyi spyod tshul dang mthun par zhi drag gi las sna tshogs kyi 'jug pas tshar gcod rjes su 'dzin pa'i 'phrin las kyi gdugs dkar po gcig gi grib mar rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i sems can mtha' dag ngal gsor mdzad pa nas/ 'dir yang dgyes pa'i spyan ras nam yang lhod pa med pa'i gnam gyi she mong gi ri mo yongs su gsal ba'i bka' shog rten bkras btags nyin mo bde legs ma nyi shu/ rtags brgyad kha btags sum cu/ gosa'i yug legs pa gsum gyi gnang sbyin dang bcas stsal pa gser zhal dngos su mthong ba lta bu'i dga' ba thob/ 'di na'ang sems can thams cad kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po dpal ldan shākya seng ge'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong dang lus can gyi bde skyid spel ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa mi dman par gnas/ da lam gong du 'tsham 'dri'i zhu yig rten 'bul bar rab 'byams pa don grub rgya mtsho dang ngag dbang grags pa gnyis rdzong bda' zhus pa mkha' ltar yangs pa zab gsal thugs kyi klong du gcugs pa'i bka' gnang phebs tshogs chu bo'i rgyun bzhin zhu/ zhu yig rten byu ru'i 'phreng ba dang bcas shing yos hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu (238ba)gcig la rang byung 'phags pa'i gzhal yas khang dmar po ri nas phul/—543—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyeshing yos sde pa blo bzang sbyin pa'i khri 'don skabs 'bri gung sprul sku rin po che dkon cog 'phrin las bzang po'i chab shog snyan tshig gi tshigs su bcad pa'i lan chos grags gnyis pa 'i rang zhal me long / ṇa bi she dwa she dwa ka sgyu ga tu ka kaṣ+ṭha na pa stong yi rā ba ba : ya na /ba rta su ma rdzi ta shā ཿ nī rlung ཿ bha rnya ba sta ཿ dzha nasu ra mā ha ra the/ mkha' (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bye t+ta las me tog phreng can/)byab phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs kun gyis/ /mgrin gcig lnga bde'i lus can 'dren pa por/ /legs bsngags su sti'i sgrar drangs me tog char/ /yongs bsnyil grub rigs rgya mtsho'i shing rta cher/ /grangs med gdul bya gser re rol mtsho'i dbus/ /'phrin las rin chen rnam bzhi'i bang rim rtser/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i spyan stong rab gsal ba/ /'dren mchog lha dbang chab shog rten ldan 'byor/ /deng dus kun gyi mthong (239na skong gcig mchungs par/ /mchan dang dpe byad ri mo rab bkra'i sku/ /ma dag skye rgu'i ngor yang gzhes bral ba/ /tshe yi g.yung drung khams su brlabs de spro/ /thos bsam sgom la mos rlom bdag blo'i rtse/ /bstad kyang rnam g.yeng dri bzhan gyis bskul nas/ /don chung 'di snang mkha' la dal med du/ tanang bal stes dbang rjes 'gro'i ngang tshul tsam/ /lha sngags ye shes bdag nyid sku gsung thugs/ /gsang ba mi zad rab 'byams 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa'i sgyu 'phrul rol gar gyis/ /chos kyi grags pa sa 'dir slar 'ongs snyam/ /bgrang yas zhi dang khro bo'i grong khyer dbus/ /rang las mi gzhan rten dang brten pa'i gtsor/ /stong nyid snying rje'i nyams ldan shes rab mang / /mnyam sbyor bde chen gar mkhan che mchog bzhin/ /mi bsrun 'bod grogs mgon du rnga yab kyi/ /dpal gyi ri bo'i rtse mor thod 'phreng rtsal/ /bzhugs brdzun snang srid dregs pa bskyar 'dul du/ /gzho stod gter sgrom phyogs su byon nam snyam/ /chog thub dkar pa'i sman gyi gzung 'dzin bro/ /dbyungs nas rnam rtog chos skur rgya yan pa'i/ /stong chen sems gnas gcig gis rgyas btab tshe/ /mda' bsnun zhabs de mkha' spyod gnas su bros/ /skyu ra gnam gyi brgyud las sngags 'chang rigs/ /phag gru'i lung rtogs shing rta 'jig rten mgon/ /ring lugs mkha' gzugs bstan srog pad+ma'i (239bsku/ra /rdo rje'i —544—

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pekhams su bsgyur ba'i byed por nges/ /lha sras mu de'i yang srid chos kyi rgyal/ /rje btsun rat+na'i zab gter yid bzhin dbang / /thugs kyi dpal ber 'chad pa gces pa'i nor/ /'chad nyan bsam sgom rgya chen spel bar gsol/ /mtshungs med rnam dpyod lang tsho rgyas pa'i mgrin/ /legs bshad snyan pa'i sgra 'khrol g.yas 'khyil las/ /bka' mchid rgyud mangs klu yis thos 'dzin ltar/ /drug dmar brtsegs pa'i rna brgyangs skyongs shig gu /dkyus ring 'dren med zur gyis g.yo ba'i rten/ /lha rdzas du kū la yi stod bkris pa'i/ /nyams dang 'gyur ba 'chi med gar mkhan ma/ /dbu ru'i phyogs der ri mo 'bul bar song / /shing yos zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu bdun la tshangs pa dung thod can gyis lung bstan nyung ngu zhig ched du skyel mi gtong ba mdzad pa'i gsung lan mngon shes 'char ba'i me long / swasti dza ya bi dza ya da brarmi ṇa/ lha rgyal dbyangs su len pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gsol ba/ kun rdzob gzhan snang tsam du rang rgyud brlang por spyod pa'i smon lam gyi mthu drag por brtas pas skye 'gro yongs kyi bla tshe la dbang ba de'i tshe gsang ba'i bdag po rta mgrin dbang rgyal pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal sogs kyis dam la btags nas srog bdag ging gi rgyal por mnga' gsol/ nges pa'i don du dpal chen po che mchog he ru ga'i ye shes rol pa'i cha las mngon par 'phros te sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi nub byang mchod bstod dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor du brten pa lha'i gar mkhan dpal ldan tshangs pa (240na)dung gi thor tshugs can gyis mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gsung gsang ba tshigs su bcad de ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan lha dar dkar po'i rten dang bcas pho nya ched du mngags par rig pa 'dzin pa'i grangs su gtogs par rlom pa bdag kyang sems kyi spro ba ci yang 'phel/ gang gi rnam sprul mtha' dag klas pas sngon nas sprul pa zhig phyogs der gnas te chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i 'khrungs lhar mdzad cing / ngo bo mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus bha ta hor gyi yul nas dregs pa mched lnga ka ca'i rjes su byon pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis dbang bskur dam la btags te zan g.yang mi 'gyur —545

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shelhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gis gtsos stod smad chos 'khor kun skyong zhing / kha ba ri'i ljongs su gtogs so cog gi bstan dang 'gro ba'i mel tshe mdzad par mnga' gsol ba'i rdo rje 'bar ba'i dam tshig gi ra ba las nam yang ma bral bar nye char yang 'gro ba mi'i khog tu brlams par rjes su yi rangs shing / ding sang snyigs ma'i dus ches cher bdo ba'i skye rgu rnams blang dor tshul bzhin mi shes par legs nyes ston pa'i ched du khab tu bzhugs pa las/ gzhan du dregs pa'i sde dpon stong gsum skad cig tu bskor ba'i rdzu 'phrul can dag 'gro ba mi la brten pa'i don las ma mchis pa'i phyir na/ding sang gi dus 'dir stod smad bar gsum la spyi sgos kyi (240ba)lung bstan rgyas pa zhig lo 'di'am phyi ma'i 'gos tsam la mdzad par bskul ba dri med ye shes dag pa'i klong du bcags par 'tshal/ rten bkras btag bas kya snyan shal/ gser skyems zho gsum/ 'phrin las thams cad 'grub pa'i gos ljang yug dang bcas smin drug zla ba'i shes rab kyi cha bzang po dang po'i dus la dge /shing yos hor zla bcu gcig pa 'i yar tshes gsum gyi nyin srog bdag tshangs pa chen po dung thod can la tshogs 'khor spyan gzigs dang bcas dri smed gsol bar dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa btang pa'i tshe 'phrin yig bden gtam dbyangs su 'tsher ba'i pi wang /zhi dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i byed po kun tu bzang / /thun mong 'gro ngor rgya gar paṇa chen tshul/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod 'phreng bsngags/ /mgon des srog bdag sde dpon tshangs pa gang / /che mchog khrag 'thung gtsor gyur bka' brgyad lha'i/ /nub byang dregs pa'i gzhal yas chen po sa /dbang bskur dam btags bstan pa bsrung bar bskos/ /de phyir bsil ldan sman ljongs yul gyi cha'i/ /chos 'khor stod smad mdo rgyud bshad sgrub sde/ /spel ba'i ngur smrig 'dzin dang gos dkar can/ /sngags 'chang yongs kyi dgra lha ma yin nam/ /bde skyid gangs kyi ri bo ches dngas par/ /sdig 'bras glang po'i na bun nyer 'khrigs pa'i/ /dus 'dir sngon gyi g.yar dam rab dgongs te/ /bod 'bangs bstan 'gro'i mel tshe dpung bskyed rigs/ /yongs la lkog (241na)tu gyur kun rjen pa mā /gsal ba'i lha mig dag pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /gzigs nas 'byung 'gyur g.yin ngo bsrung —546

rgya bod sto sog gi mag dman bar pa rnams la tshon yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rang snyan rgyud mang / (pemin pa'i//gzugs med gtam gyi mda' de drang por phongs//ma dag dug lce rnon pos thub bstan srog/'phrog pa'i sto 'gro bzang por tshul 'chos mkhan//gang yin rgyal gsung dpang du nyer bzhag ste//chu dang 'o ma 'byed pa'i dus min nam//de 'dra'i chom rkun rang gzhan grub pa'i mtha' mang por snang ba lha khyod kyis mkhyen mod/sgyu ste sem nyir gyur na rnga yab gling //bgrod nas mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rjer dris//ru bzhi sgang drug mi bde'i byed po kun/khrag thigs tsam yang lhag mar ma lus pa//dregs pa'i sde dpon 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis//rkan sgra sgrog bzhin tshogs kyi 'khor lor rol/snang stong zung 'jug sems kyi ma 'gags gdangs//dam can srung mar shar las gzhan min par//mchod bya mchod byed bral yang kun rdzob tu//spyan gzigs mig 'phrul rjes 'gro mkha' khyab spro//dug gsum ga hril pa'i mtsho la byed dbyibs ltar//bde sdug med kyang sgyu ma dang mtshungs pa//the tsho me sel byed dri ba pho nya yi//g.yar lam gsol bar sgra 'dzin dbang po gtod//gos dmar lhab lhub g.yo ba gser gyi 'brug/g.yas su 'khyil ba gnam lo'i tshes kyi dus//lha rdzas snyan shal phon thar can dang bcas//dmar po ri yi 241ba ) pho brang rtse nas dge/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me 'brug lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag/me 'brug hor zla dang por rigs kyi srung ma thang chen bshan pa lag dmar la spyan gzigs dbul bar 'bum thang bsod namasadabang po bto skabs kyi mun gsol /phreng dpa' tsho gad brgyangs/ka ma la yi ze'u 'bru rgod pa'i rtser/kha dog rab dkar rdzus skyes gzhone nu'i tshul//ga na zhugs kyang phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas//nga rgyal dregasaldan tshogs kyi gnyen gcig bsngags//ca co snyan pa'i dbyangs dang rol mo 'brol//cha shas yongasardzogs dam rdzas gtor ma bshams//ja chang ga / skyems btung ba sbreng byed na//nya rgyas zla 'dra'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)lha khyod dgyes 'dzu pa ston/ /ta thā ga ta'i bstan pa bsrung ba la/ /tha tshig zhal bzhes 'gyur med bshan pa che/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus 'di sa /na ma rer yang mthu stobs nus rtsal bskyed/ /pa tra'i ri mo dang mtshungs sna tshogs sems/ /pha rol rgol ngan yid srubs snying zhugs te/ /ba mo'i rig pas lo tog bzhes pa ltar/ /ma lus tshar chod rjes med rlung la skur/ /tsa na yin kyang pha mes brgyud pa'i lha/ /tsha grang khyad du sad nas legs mchode phyir/ /dza zhes 'bod phyir dar tshon g.yab byed na/ /wa ler thogs med spyon la 'phrin las sgrubs/ /zhwa yi tog ltar sde brgyad rje bo khyod/ /za hor brgyud pa'i dgra lha mthu rtsal can/ /'a 'ur sgra yis stong gsum 'geng bzhin du/ /ya mtshan las bzhi bsgrub pa'i chu 'phrul ston/ /rwa gdengs rdo rje 'bar ba'i phyag rtogs (242na)rgya/ /la la'i sde brgyad ma yin kun gyi gtsug sha rjen ri mo gsal por shar mdzad pa'i/ /sa gsum bla ma pad+ma'i dam tshig dgongs/ /ha har drag po'i bzhad sgra dgod pa dang / /a la la zhes dgyes tshul lhan cig tu/ /ha ri can dan dre bzhin ston mdzad par/ /a mra lta bu'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho spel/ /me 'brug gi lo bsam yas pe dar lcog gi zhig gsos grub nas gnas gsar par chos skyong dpo na blon thog mar phebs pa'i tshe dga' ston spel bar zur khar don grub dbang rgyal mngags pa'i 'phrin yig lha rgyal dbyangs snyan/ ekhri yā na'i 'dab stong bzhad pa'i rtser/ /lta bas mi joms mtshan dpe'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal/ /rang byung sprul pa'i sku des dge legs stsol/ /phyi rol gshin rje'i bshan khar sde brgyad gnas/ /nang du dam can 'du ba'i pho brang che/ /gsang ba bdag po'i bde chen gzhal yas khang / /phun tshogs bkod pa'i dus ston thog ma la/ /bkras btags gser skyems phyi nang bzang gos ja/ /zur gsal grangs ldan tshogs kyi 'khor lo bcas/ /sprul pa'i bstan srung rgyal po chen po khyod/ /dgyes bskyed ched du 'bul bas thugs dam stongs/ khu kya seng ge'i ring lugs grib bsil du/ /'jig rten gsum gyi 'gro kun ngal bsos shing / /sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las rnams/ /bsgrub pa'i g.yar (242ba)dam nam yang g.yel med mdzod/ /lha snyan mjes par byed pa'i dar —548—

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('dakar po/ /ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor rjes 'gro bar/ /thun mtshams mdangs ldan rgya yis nyer btab ste/ /nam mkha'i nor bu 'khrig khyim zhugs tshe dge /gtum drag las mkhan bshan pa'i tshul 'dzin kyang / /nges don gnod sbyin khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul/ /gsang mtshan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /sgrib bral sgra 'dzin dbang po cung zad gtod/ /mtshan dang sku yi rnam 'gyur bgrang yas kyang / /gcig pu nyid las gzhan min pad+ma 'byung / /rdo rje'i ri mo gtsug bkod dam dgongs la/ /gangs can bstan 'gro'i bde skyid yun du spel/ /lha srin rba slong 'khrug pa'i gzhal med khang / /gsar bskrun thog mar dge ba'i legs skyes su/ khra shar bdog pa bza' btung 'dod dgu'i rdzas/ /dam skong ched du dngos bshams yid kyis sprul/ /brnag pa'i sems yong dgra bgegs snying gi khrag /drod rlangs yal ba med par hub kyis drongs/ /chos dang srid kyi legs tshogos ma lus pa/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i mthu stobs nus dpung bskyed/ /snron gyis nya ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bzang por/ /ring por brkyang pa'i snyan shal dkar po la/ /mi 'gyur rtags kyi mtshan mas legs spud de/ /dmar po ri yi pho brang rtse nas dge /sme 'brug khra 'brug nas tshangs pa chen pos thun rdzas dgos tshul ltar spun bdun pa phun tshogs dbang po mngags pa'i che ba 'phrin yig tshangs dbang 'bod (243na sko/ rgyal dbang pad+ma ka ra yis/ /mchod bstod dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor cher/ /dbang bskur lha chen srog gi bdag /dpal ldan ging gi rgyal po kye/ /ma g.yel thugs kyis nye bar dgongs/ /lha gcig srong btsan sgam po des/ /gangs can sa yi me btsa' sa /legs bskrun khra 'brug gtsug lag khang / /bsrung ba'i mthu stobs rtsal ldan khyod/ /gzi byin nyi ma ltar 'bar bas/ /nag po bdud sde'i mun pa gcal/ /rnam 'dren bshad sgrub yid can tshogs/ /bskyed pa'i ba dan dkar po phyor/ /ma da na sags btung ba dang / sha zan bza' dang bca' ba bshams/ /phyi nang gos bzang gser skyems kyis/ /mtshon pa'i 'dod yon mchod pa spel/ /swā la'i sman gyi nags ljongs 'dir/ /g.yul 'khrug mu ge nad rims sogs/ /rtsod ldan dus kyi nyes brgya'i dri/ /mthu stobs mtho ris chu bos khrus/ /dus kyi chad pa'i ming tsam yang / /mthar byas sim pa'i bde ba la/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla —549

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheyi/ /skye rgu ma lus sbyor zhig gu /da skru ra yi mdangs 'dzin pa'i/ /dkar 'jam dar gyi snyan shal bcas/ /chos srung chen po'i 'dun sa mā /ston zla'i yar tshes li khi snya/ /me 'brug hor zla lnga pa'i lha tshes la ging chen tshangs pa chen por tshogs mchod spyan gzigs dang bcas 'phrin gsal lha rgyal dbyang snya/ e ṇ+ḍi yā na'i chu gter klong nas 'dab stong bzhad pa'i (243ba)ze'u 'bru'i dbus/ /dpag yas 'od 'bar gar gyi dbang po'i sgyu dra'i zer 'phreng 'phros pa las/ /mtshan dpe nyer gsal lang tsho'i mdzes sku lo brgyad gzhen nu'i tshul 'chang ba/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus khro rngams gzugs kyis lha srin dran 'khol pad+ma 'byung / /mgon de'i phyag cha rdo rje'i ri mo gtsug tu bkod pa'i rjes gsal zhing / /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi'i thigs pa ljags kyi dbang por myangs pa'i mod/ /ji ltar zhal bzhes dam las mi 'da' rdo bar bris pa'i snang brtan ltar/ 'gyur med srog bdag ging chen tshangs pa g.yas 'khyil dung gi thod can kye/ /ma da na'i phung sha sna bza' bca'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo phyur bur spungs/ /'jam mnyen rnam bkra'i phyi nang gan gos gser skyems ja bzang go mtshon sogs/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis brlabs nam mkha' mdzod kyi mchod pa'i sprin/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon 'khor bcas spyan snga thugs dam skong ba'i ched du dbul/ /gnyis med bsrung ba'i ring lugs spyi dang khyad par kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /bshad sgrub rkang 'thung 'phreng ba'i grib mar 'jig rten gsum gyi yid can tshogs/ /brgyad khri bgrang bya'i 'gro ba ji bzhin sdug bsngal ming yang mi grags par/ / ring po'i tshe dang 'byor pa'i dbang phyug mig gi 'dzum gyi mched zlar mdzod/ /bye brag swā la'i sman gyi ljongs 'dir mes dbon rnam gsum dgongs pa ltar/ /dge bcu'i (244na thams las sim pa'i tshor bas skyid pa'i nyi ma dgung 'char zhing / /phas rgol khyab 'jug log blo'i mngal du drang srong dmod pa'i 'bras grub pas/ /rang srid sdebacas yar ngo ches mtho'i rgyal rnga brdung ba'i las mdzod cig sha khrag drod rlangs ma yal zar rngams khro gnyer smin mtshams ri mo can/ /dpa' bo'i chas ldan che ngar shugs kyis yab sher bdud ltar rab 'jigs kyang / /zhi zhing ches dul lha yi dge bsnyen dgyes pa'i —550

rgya bod hong sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pe'adzum gyi zhal sgo las//lkog gyur chos kyi gnas lugs gsal ba'i lung bstan pi wang rgyud la drongs//dkar phyogs lha rnams rgyal ba'i bswo sgra sgrog pa'i yar tshes la//thos 'dzin mdzes byed rgyan du nyer 'os du kū la yi kha tshar dang //thugs dam bskul ba'i 'phrin yig rgya can pho nya'i sug pas legasabateg nas//dbu ru stod phyogs sde brgyad 'du ba'i 'dun sa cher song dza 0 //chu glang bshan pa bya khrid mig gcig pa g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu byon nas lo gsum tsam bzhugs te sku phebs ma byung ba me 'brug zla ba lnga par khog zhugs gsar du byung ba'i tshe legs skyes kyi spyan gzigs 'bul bar spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtsho btang ba'i mun gsol lha rgyal gad brgyangs/lha rgyal bswo sgra ldir ba bkra shis glu//mgrin pa'i rgyud las nyer drangs rab dkar dar//bstan srung snyan gyi rgyan du legs spud nas//'phrin gsol don la ye shes spyan gyis gzigs//rgya gar paṇa chen dus 244ba / gsum gsal ler mkhyen//'khor 'das yongs kyi spyi dpal thod 'phreng rtsal//brtul zhugs grub pa'i bka' las mi 'da' ba'i//bya khrid mig gcig bshan pa'i dmag dpon gyi//rgya gar g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug dang //zung 'brel tsan dan 'thug po'i nags tshal du//byon kyang bod yul srung mar zhal 'ches par//mi g.yel khog tu brlams pa'i gtam de snyan//lkog gyur rjen par gzigs pa'i 'dren byed gsal//stong gsum skad cig bskor ba'i rdzu phrul che//legs nyes bya ra bltal lhag par 'grus//de phyir blang dor lung du ston par rigs//gsar du khog zhugs thog ma'i rten 'brel sgor//thugs dam skong rdzas kha ma zur 'thus dang //bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rnams//nam mkha' mdzod du byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul//'jig rten khams bde thub pa'i bstan pa dar//rig 'dzin bdag gis bcol ba'i dbang drag dang //zhi dang rgyas pa'i 'phrin las ma lus pa//'dod pa'i re skong dpag bsam yongs bor mdzod//spangasaljongs margad mdangs gyon sgron gyi zla//dkar po'i phyogs kyi gang ba gsum pa'i tshes//lhag pa lha mtshams dga' mar rab brtse ba'i//'grub sbyor dus su sarba dza / //'phyos bzhan ba sgrib bzha pa'i 'phrin lan las kun bsgrub pa'i sgo 'byed/6khri yā na'i nub byang si rtse'i klung //

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kye(245na)dri med 'dab stong ke sa ra yi rtser/ /rgyal kun 'dus pa'i sgyu 'phrul med po che/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal gyis gaṅka ra/ /lha rdzas dar dkar rten dang bcas pa'i 'phrin/ /blang dor gsal bar ston pa a dar+sha/ /mtshams sprin 'od brgya dang 'grogs pho nya yis/ /ma nyams sug par son pa mchog tu spro/ /dkon pa sgrib btsan mthu dang nus pa'i bdag /gter gyi srung ma gnod sbyin bshan pa che/ /rlung gi shugs can rta mchog la zhen te/ /stong gsum myul nas bstan 'gro'i mel tshe mdzod/ /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par bod yul 'dir/ /nad rims dbul phongs g.yul 'khrug la sogs pa/ /nyes brgya kun zhi bde skyid la sbyor zhing / /rigs 'dzin bdag gis bcol ba'i las kun sgrubs/ /zla gzhen thags su btags 'dra'i snyan shal dang / /zho yi 'khor los sa le sbram gyi skyes/ /'phyos lung dkar ba'i sde brgyad 'du gnas der/ /chu stod zla ba'i dmar cha'i dus la dge /lho kong gi dpung 'jug skor pa bsam yas su dregs pa'i sde dpo na chen por 'phrin 'chol gyi spyan gzigs spel bar phu gu lung pa lha dbang rdo rje bto skabs pon gsal drang por thig 'debs/ rang rig don gyi sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung / /mngon sum ngo bo ma 'phrod gcig pu'i ngor/ /zangs mdog dpal rir mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes/ /sde brgyad bran du 'khol de'i pho nya ba/ /'jigo rten dregs pa'i dmag dpon tse'u dmar/ /zab mo gter gyi srung ma yang le ber/ /(245ba〉spyan sngar dngos bshams yid sprul mthun pa'i rdzas/ /snang sems gnyis med sgyu ma lta bur spro/ /lho mon shar phyogs kong po'i yul gru nas/ /langs pa'i dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i gtam/ /snyan po rna ba'i bcud du dngar ba la/ /sngar bcol grub pa'i gtang rag tshul du phul/ /rang g.yin bde thabs ched du chings kyi skor/ /phan tshun gnyis lo'i don kha 'brug phyogs nas/ /snga sar lugs la ma song byas gyur tshe/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i lhag bsam yid la dkar/ /lang shor kho na'i rgyal po nga lung gtam/ /byas nas lab dan gal te ma 'grig na/ /bden rdzun legs nyes lha mig spyan ras kyis/ /gzigs la drag po'i 'phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /sa phag tshun nas sems can bde thabs la/ /bsams te rim gyis 'pham khur byas pa'i tshul/ /lha srin sde brgyad rnams kyis ma mkhyen —53 2

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (0na/ /dpral ba'i mig kyang ri mo'i gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /rgya dar dkar po'i snyan shal dmod nas bcas/ /smin drug zla ba mngon spyod las sbyor kun/ /thogs med grub pa yar ngo'i gral tshes la/ /sde brgyad rba klong 'khrug pa'i 'dun sar spel/ /a na la zhes pa me 'brug gi lo 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i bka' shog gnang skyes spel bar jo ra che bla ma dang khang dbu mdzad gser yig tu 'ongs pa me sprul phyir ldog pa'i tshe 'bras spungs 'dul ba slob dpon zur pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang rta 'bul nang so gnyis rdzong bda' byas skabs phul ba'i zhu yig 'khor la'i (246na ji mo 'char ba'i me long / tri bha ba ga sha kha ho rade ba nā ra ya sa tse shwa re sa re na ga na sto hi pra la ke na ba du le na se ma me hā sani tsa kra : 6 re kha ka 'i tsi ta tso t+ta pya da pa rla tsa spro kā ra ma ( sto ṣa ka sdi rā dzaspru la 8sgyu te rmu khā nyi da sha ka twa/ / 'jig (sdeb sbyor mnyag pa'i brit+ta las zlum po/)rten gsum gyi gtsug tor rtser 'dzegs lha dang mi yi dbang phyug tu/ /tshe ring gnam gyi she mong shugs kyis mang pos bkur ba'i khri chen por/ /'khor los mtshan pa'i ri mo rnam bkra zhabs zung skyil mo krung bcas pa/ /jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i drung du pus btsugs bzhin ras mngon phyogs nas/ /rab dngas shing shun lo ma'i gos kyis klubs/ /bag yod mchod phyir thogs dang tshangs skud 'chang / /tshe spel bden tshig bum bzang du rba' rtswa/ /thogs pa sngon 'gros ched gsol mgrin pa bteg /bskal mang tshogs kyis bsgrubs pa'i legs byas nor/ /phung por spungs kyang cha tsam
