bsgrun dka' ba/ /gzi byin nyi ma'i (246ba)dngos brgya 'phrog nus sku/ /'dzam gling skye rgu'i gtsug na 'bar ba'i ngang tshangs pa'i dbyangs la nyer mos 'ching ba'i mdud/ /lhod por 'grol ba tshig don snyan 'jebs gsung / /yi ge'i gzugs shar bka' rtags phyag rgya can/ /srid pa'i dngos po yongs bsdus gnang rten bcas/ /lha gcig zab yangs thugs kyi dpal be'ur/ shwakya'i rjes zhugs dge sbyong gyi na ba/ /nam yang ma dor mtshon phyir gser yig des/ /snyim par son tshe kun dga'i mchog sbyin thob/ /'di na lha lam mthas khyab 'gro rnams la/ /lhag bsam ston zla ltar dkar klog pa mkhan/ /nyi 'og mtshungs med 'khor sgyur —553

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyekhyod drin las/ /gtan mdun bsgrub la 'tshe med sim par gnas/ /rgyags pa'i snyems bral dman la brtse ba'i spyan/ /dkyus ring kun la ngal gsor 'jug byed rdzas/ /phan bde'i mchod sbyin gtong ba'i ma ma la/ shar phyogs rgyal por 'bod pa'i mtshan gyis snyan/ /dbul ba'i gdung sel phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i ljid/ /ma bzod nor 'dzin bu mor rngul chu'i rgyun/ /rgya mtshor tshad med babs kyang rnam thos bus/ /'gran pa'i ngal ba da dung mi gtong mtshar/ /lha /khyod bdud gzil gnon ting 'dzin la/ /snyoms zhugs yan lag rnam bzhi'i dmag gi dpung / /rab khros gtum drag 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i rtser/ /rgol ngan kla klo'i klad khrag ci yang 'thor/ /don snying lkog mar thon yang rkang pa'i rjes/ /(247na)lam lam rgya mtsho'i mthar bros bsnyegs pa la/ /bka' bsgos wang gi las 'dzin dmag dpon tshogs/ /zhe sdang srin po rgyu la 'gran pa bzhin/ /skye mang sdig bsags nag po'i rnam smin gyi/ /rtsod las cher rtsod dus kyi chad pa'i mun/ /mgon khyod thugs rje'i nyi mas myur sangs nas/ /rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i snang bas cis mi khyab/ /dzam bu hrī sha'i shing gis mdzes brgyan gling / /sa yi dkyil 'khor yongs khyab yod do cog /yid can rnams kyi bsags pa'i bsod nams mthus/ /mi bdag bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /dgyes zhal 'dzum pa ma dros mtsho chen las/ /chos nor 'dod thar chu klung rnam bzhi'i rgyun/ /'dzin la mi ngal dbus 'gyur kun bzod lto/ /'gengs la yal yol med pa'i thugs rje bskyed/ /dkar dmar rin chen sna tshogs 'jam phrug sogs/ /bdog pas rab bteg zhu mchid spyi brtol tshig /byams ldan ma la bus pa'i ngag bzhin du/ /mkhyen brtse'i dbyings su khrel ba'i go skabs ci/ /zla ba bzang por mchog gi dang po'i rgyud/ /thub pas lho phyogs 'bras spungasamachod rten cher/ /legs gsungs nag pas nya ba'i yar tshes la/ /lus btud thal sbyar dang ba'i yid kyis phul/ /—554

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (serab byung bcu gcig pa'i me sbrul lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag/me sgrul hor zla bzhi pa'i nang du thang chen rigs kyi srung mar lhos chang khyim pa gzhon pa gsol mchod spyan gzigs 'bul bar bsha shā tshe lgog sol lha gyo 0 0 byangs/byon:na 247bgyi khyon gyur de ltar zhi bzhugs ban pa'i//sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa//e nyi yā na'i slob dpon zhabs sen zla//byang chub bar du mi 'bral gtsug rta me rgyan//mgon des khrag 'thung pad+ma he ru ga'i//dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur dam bsgrags pa//sprul pa'i chos rgyal gnod sbyin shing bya can//blon po bshan pa lag dmar deng 'dir dgongs//'dod yon lnga ldan ba lam bza' bca' yi//phung po phyur bur spungs pa ri bo bzhin//sman phud khrag chang na dkar btung ba'i mtsho//rlabs 'phreng zegs mas 'chi med lam kun 'gengs//gser skyems phyi nang dar sogs dngos bshams dang //yid sprul nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye bas//pha mes brgyud pa'i bstan srung mthu ldan khyod//'khor bcas thugs dam dbyings su skong gyur cig/ma rungs brlang por spyod pa'i bsam sbyor gyis//glags lta'i gzugs can dgu dang gzugs med bgegs//gang du gnas kyang dmar zlum spyan ras kyis//nye bar gzigs la thal ba'i rdul du klog/tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dbang thang sogs//chos srid legs tshogs bla nas blar spel bar//phul ba'i zhu 'phrin snyan pa'i lha rgyal sgra//sol nag thang chen gtsug lag khang der bsgragadamar zer can gyi lo bsam yas mdo sde mchod pa'i skyes 'bul bar spun bdun lhun grub rgya mtsho bto ba'i 248na dus bstan srung chos rgyal dpon blon la tshon du gsol ba las bzhi lhun grub/dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thamasacad kyi bdag nyid zhi dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo khyab bdag he ru rkaḥrgya gar paṇa chen gyi tshul bzung nas brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang po pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal gyi spyan sngar bstan dang 'gro

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22) ba'i phan bde spel bar zhal gyis 'ches pa sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen por dmar ser can gyi lo snron gyis nya ba'i mdo sde mchod pa zhes lha dang mi'i dga' ston chen mo'i thog mchod pa'i sprin phung sngar bzhin spro bar 'di pa ched du mngags pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten spyi dang khyad par kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir bkra shis dang bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba dang bye brag bdag sogs dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'phrin las thams cad lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/zhes snyan shal tho zur gsal dang bcas dkar cha'i dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la dmar po ri nas dge /sku gcig la mtshan brgyad du bstan par ma zad grangs med pa'i 'gro blo'i dngas mtshor zla ba 'bum phrag gi gzugs brnyan 'char ba bzhin khams dang bsam par mthun pa'i ngo mtshar gyi cho 'phrul mtha' klas par ston na'ang e ṇ+ḍi yā na'i sa rgyu rgya mtsho'i gling du gtsang byed 'dab brgya'i dbus su rdzus skyes pa pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal gyis dam tshig gnyan po nye bar bsgrags pa kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal (248ba)gyi spyan sngar hor zla lnga pa'i nang du lha mi'i mchod pa rgya cher spel ba mdo sde chen mor grags pa'i thog sngon ltar thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su skong bar 'di pa ched gnyer mngags pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bde legs phun sum tshogs pas khyab pa dang / khyad par phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnas pa'i gzhi dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i rgyal khams su nad mtshon mu ge'i 'tshe ba bzlog cing 'phung byed kyi rgol ba ngan pa thams cad tshar gcod pa sogs bdag sogs rnams kyi bsam don lhun gyis grub par mdzod cig /ces lha dar gyi snyan shal tho zur gsal dang bcas snron zla'i yar tshes la dge/dmar ser can gyi lo chu stod zla ba'i tshes gcig la tshangs pa dung thod can gyi spyan sngar mchod sprin spros te lung bstan zhu bar star sdong ba bta pa'i dus kyi 'phrin gsol bde skyid 'od dkar/ bde ldan zhing bi ra/gon por rtag bzhugs snang ba mtha' yas chos kyi sku/ /gru 'dzin la dgyes phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba spongs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /si rgyu'i dngas mtshor pad+ma'i sbubs 'khrungs rnga yab gling pa sprul pa'i sku/ /dbyer med zhabs rdul thod du 'ching —556

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pob lha mchog tshangs pa'i rnam rol sku/ /sa gsum cig car g.yo ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ khams gsum sems can srog la dbang sgyur yang / /mchog gsum gtsug bsten dam las mi 'da' ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung shel ging che/ /(249na ji ba lnga pa'i dung dkar thod du bcings/ /'jam mnyen lhab lhub dung dkar ber chen gyon/ /rdul bral ston zla ltar dkar 'dzum zhal can/ /dngoms nas bde skyid 'od dkar legs spro ba/ /snyan snyan tshig tsam la 'chel ma yin par/ /dung dung lha khyod khog tu brlams pa'i 'bras/ /zhim zhim rtogs par dka' ba'i lkog gyur chos/ /gsal gsal rdo rje'i tshig gis lhug par ston/ /rnam 'dren don kun grub pa'i bstan pa'i srol/ /rnam dag lung dang rig pas 'dzin pa la/ /rnam dpyod zla bral 'jam mgon btsong kha pa'i/ /rnam dkar 'phrin las srid mthar spel bar mdzod/ /ma smad skye rgu'i bde skyid 'joms pa la/ /mi bsrun smon lam log pa'i kla klo'i sde/ /mu med yid srubs sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i shing / /me ltar 'bar ba'i mngon spyod las kyis sregs/ /srong btsan sgam po'i 'khrungs lha tshangs pa'i snyan/ /snyan khung ut+pal 'byed la gsong po'i tshig /tshig don 'brul med gsol lan chu mtsho'i zla/ /zla snang bzhin du mngon sum ston zhig gu/ /dbang gzhu lta bur bkra ba'i spyan gzigs sogs/ /dbang po tshim byed thugs dam bskang pa'i rdzas/ /dbang phyogs sde brgyad 'du ba'i pho brang cher/ /dbang drag 'phrin las bsgrub phyir dbul ba dge /me sprul bar khams nas rta tshag sprul pa'i skus ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung spel bar dbon po ngag dbang bkra shis btang ba'i dus gsung 'phrin tshigs bcad du byung ba'i (249ba pon nyin byed gnyis pa'i rang gzugs/ se dha na wa dha ṭa ta ཿ ri rdiṇa ma kyi byu le ྅ rmo tso da 〉 kho bā gi rta/ /ta spri nā kā sha ta smo da ye ka ta mu dra rla 'apra dzi PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB /spel (sdeb sbyor mnya pa'i prit+ta las me tag phreng ༅/〉spogs tshig rgyan tam+bu ra yi rgyud/ /blo gros sor mos yongs bskul gsung 'phrin glu/ /der gsal bdog pa'i skyes dang chabs cig par/ /phyag rgya'i ri mo rab bkra sug par son/ /bskal mang tshogs kyis bsgrubs 'bras snang brnyan zla/ /mtshan bzang cha rdzogs rnam dpyod ga bur rdul/ /nyes brgya'i tsha gdung bcil bar bsngags —557

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shepa'i gtam/ /sgrog la g.yeng ba'i gnyis skyes mang zhig khrel/ /mdo stod nor 'dzin dpal mo'i legs byas kyi/ /mngal yangs khur du lci ba gang gi sku/ /deng dus rdo rje'i kham ba / su rgyal kun gyis/ /mgrin gcig bgros nas byin gyis brlabs sam snyam/ /'di na rang don sgrub blo 'phyon ma'i gar/ /gzhan phan (250na)gtam gyis 'drid pa'i tshul 'chos mkhan/ /zin med g.yeng ba'i khol por zad pa'i gru/ /na tshod klung chen sum gnyis lhag bcas brgal/ /ring gnas rten 'brel bsgrigs thugasa'iston zla'i 'od/ /zil gnon rab dkar bzhed don dang len mthu/ /las nyon dbang song bdag 'drar ches dman kyang / /sgrub rlom rang blo lkog tu gyur pa bzhin/ /'on te yun 'tshor sa gu tsi yan chad/ /mi 'dod gdon gyis ma btab rnyed dka' bas/ /mang po'i bgrang byar 'tsho thabs ma rtogs gong / /phud pas rang don bsgrubs la brtson min su/ /ngag la rnam dag brjod par dbang phyug pa/ /chos dkon legs bshad mchog dman yid can mun/ /sel ba'i nyin byed gnyis par grags pa'i gzugs/ /mes pos ma byas mngon sum gsal ba ltar/ /'gro la snyoms par byams brtse'i chus brlan pa'i/ /ris med la jug pa 'phrin las 'dab stong gi /chun po thod du 'ching ba mig mi 'dzum/ /thun mtshams gsar pa'i gos kyis dkris 'di ci/ /rnam 'byed yangs pa'i shes rab spang ljongs ngos/ /rang byung snyan tshig me tog legs bkra yang / /thos bsam dbyar gyi lang tsho mi gtong bar/ /gang thugs dngas mtshor dam pa'i gzugs brnyan dngom/ /dbus 'gyur kun bzod ma 'dir khyod zhabs kyi/ /'khor lo'i ri mo myur gsal ba ched de srid/ /mgrin pa'i ma dres chu las mo la mchid klung / /lhung lhung (250ba)sgrar bcas chad med dbab cig gu /spyan zur dpyid kyi rgyal mo nyer 'bod pa'i/ /'phrin yig gzhan sos skad snyan 'gyur khug can/ /thor gsal bdog pa'i ga9|ga rlabs rab bskyod nas/ /dbang ldan phyogs kyi lha yi lam ngos 'phur/ /chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa rigs 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar grags pa'i bka' babs zab don yol med kyi rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i tshogs 'don tshigs bcad dang / na bza' skor/rdor dril sogs tshan grangs smin grol gling du mang 'gyed gtong bar phu gu —558

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (ṭ+wāṃlung pa rtsi rig rgya mtsho 'dzin pa blo bzang yon tan btang ba'i du phul spur ta gling gnyis par gsol ba'i bden gtam/ deng theg pa rim dgu'i rgya mtsho kun nas 'khyil ba'i dbus su lha sngags ye shes kyi 'dab stong mngon par ba 'ad pa'i lte bar ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i gar mkhan rgyal dbang pad+ma kā ra gnyis pa'i rang gzugs gangs can skye rgu'i legs byas kyi dpal du 'od gzi mngon par 'bar zhing sgrib gnyis yongs su gzhil byed bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i zab don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i smin grol dang thun mong du grub pa chen po brgyad dang zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las mchog dman gdul bya'i khams dang dbang por nye bar gang 'tsham du 'jug pa'i snyan grags lha'i du: lha'i sgra dbyangs spyi dang khyad par dza brik+ṣa sa mtshan pa'i gling chen po'i gzhir 'khod pa'i lus can yongs kyi rna lung mdzes par byed pa las gzhan du ci/ 'di na'ang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po gzhan (251na)snang tsam du tshangs pa'i rgyal por bstan cing bod skyong rgyal po'i sku lha zur phud lnga pa bsnyen mchod bkang ba'i rim pa la sgo gsum mi 'da' ba'i bcad rgya bdun gnyis lha gcig bgyis pa zin pa'i spyod yul yangs par gnas/ sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen po nyid rdo rje'i khri la sku tshe g.yung drung gi rang bzhin du brtan pa na bzhugs nas zab gter 'phrin las kyi sgo 'phar dus su 'byed par bka' babs rgyal ba'i sras po gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rat+na gling pa'i rnam par thar pa dang mtshungs par mdzad nas dus gsum sangs rgyas dpal e ṇ+ḍi yā na'i slob dpon chen po ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i 'gro la thugs lhag par brtse ba'i phan bde'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag tu 'byed pa'i bzhed pa lhun gyis grub pa'i rten 'brel du rtsa gsum thugs rje'i drod gsher gyis ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu yongs su smin pa ro bda'i bcud la longs su spyod pa'i bden pa brjod pa'i tshigs bcad bdog pa tshan grangs thogs la o rgyan smin grol gling 'dus grar mang 'gyed dang bcas 'di pa ched du mngags pa lo chen be+e ro tsa na dang rgyal sras rdo rje gling pa sogs bod yul skye rgu'i gnyen du rim par byon pa'i smon lam gyi mthu btsan pos bsams bzhin sprul pa'i rnam par rol pa'i dgos don gyi gtso bo byang chub sems dpa' —559

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)rnams kyi spyod pa rlabs po che'i 'phrin las kyi gdugs dkar po'i grib bsil du ches cher snyigs mar spyod pa'i lus can spyi dang / khyad par ljongs 'dir 'khod do cog (251ba)bde bar ngal gso ba'i slad du tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa gcam bu tsam min par thugs nye bar bstad de zhal gyis 'ches pa dang / phebs tshogs chu klung skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun ltar chad med 'tshal/ rten bkras btags dang bcas dmar ser can gyi lo ma rga shi lha'i gral tshes la rang byung 'phags pa'i gzhal med khang nas phul/ /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa rta lor bris pa'i chab 3|ga 'phrin yig khag /sa rta lo gsar thog gra lcog grwa sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos nyams 'gyur stong gis spud pa'i 'phrin lan rtogs pa'i rgya mtsho brdol ba'i yo bhi/ ram byu dwa rā da r+sha dha me ska — rā pa sa rbo da ya/lha gi shu ra 5 sha sashu dhi su go mi 'i dwa 7 tsa/ yangs (sdeb sbyor sdeb sbyor ma sgo ta yangs ma/)pa'i blo gros me long du/ /chos phung gzugs brnyan kun shar ba/ /ngag gi dbang phyug snyan grags kyi/ /dpal mnga' mkhas btsun bzang po yis/ /sum ldan 'byung ba'i gsar 'gros (252na)bang dngom zhing / /se shig kha khyar mthon pos dkyus thog gcod/ /yab lha skya bdun zhon pa cang shes lo'i/ /dga' ston cho ga bstar ba'i 'phrin rten son/ /tshogs gnyis brgya byin gtsug tor gyis reg pas/ /so skye'i mi lus byang sems 'phags pa yi/ /me zhal gzugs su bsgyur ba'i don ldan rten/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i nyer 'tshor dang de spro/ /legs byas drod kyis chos nor 'dod thar gser/ /mngal sbrum rnam dpyod gdong bzhi'i tshal yangs por/ /dbyangs can ngang mo'i rkang gdub sil 'khrol bdag /lhag bsam ston mtshan chu shel dbang por 'gran/ /gzung 'dzin rgya mtsho'i pha mthar gnas lugs te/ /rnam rtog chos skur rjen —56()

rgya bod sto sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la phren yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / rtogemathong phyag rgya che'i/ /ring lugs spel la khyod las gangs ljongs 'dir/ /gnyis pa kun mkhyen yul der dmigs su med/ /klog tsam mi shes gnag rdzi skad cig la/ /smin ma gzengs mtho'i grub thab shwa mo ltar/ /rdol tshe blo gros rgyud kyis lnga rig gzhu/ /'gugs pa'i dge dbang sa 'dir gzugs gzhan bzung / /'chad par dbyig gnyen grib mar bltos min grogs/ /rgol ngan spobs pa 'phrog la chos kyi grags/ /nyams 'gyur rgyan mang spel bar dpa' bo'i zhabs/ /dwags brgyud grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i zol gyis brdzu/ /tshul 'chos sgro gshog gzhan 'drid 'brug gi sgras/ /'dod yon mngal khur sgom zhwa'i gtsug phud can/ /phyogs lhung sprin la mig gtod than skad glu/ /len (252ba)pa'i bstan 'dzin rma bya kye ma hud/ /rgyal dang 'gog snyoms bsam gtan sgron me la/ /zhi ba'i khang bzang du zhakhrul 'jug sems kyis/ /gtan bde'i srog 'dor sgom chen phye ma leb/ /de 'dra lha min gdon gyis snying btab bzhin/ /mi g.yeng yid kyi 'dzin phur brtan po nas/ /sgom med khyab gdal gnas lugs yo lang cher/ /'khrid la khyod dang gling chen ras pa gnyis/ /spang rtogs dbye ba tshad mas gzhal nus min/ /gzhi yi de bcasa'abras dus de bral ba/ /chos sku'i khyad par shes nas sangs rgyas zhes/ /grags can rang sems lasags mi 'tshol ba'i/ /rtogs pa'i rgya mtsho khyod kyi klong du brdol/ /phur bu'i blo gros mnga' yang snyems pa bral/ /'khrul pa'i yo lang zhig kyang tshul khrims gtsang / /thugs rje zla nya gang yang 'phel 'grib bral/ /phyogs lhung spangs kyang snod ldan gdul byar chags/ /gtsug lag du mar bslab sbyangs grangs kyi tshad/ /'gram pa'i ngos su bris dang chabs cig par/ /slar skyes pad rtsa'i khu bas nyer byugasamadangs/ /gzhan phan sems kyi kha dog ston pa bzhin/ /phag gru'i ring lugs kun bzod snyigs ma'i mtshor/ /bying tshe thos bsam sgom pas gyen 'degs par/ /rus sbal gzugs su bsgyur ba'i 'phrul po che/ /mig sngon swā la'i ljongs 'dir 'ongs las ci/ /dwags brgyud khog stong pi wang ches yangasapor/ /legs bshad skad snyan 'brol ba'i rgyud gcig khyod/ /srog gi 'tsho ba rdo rje rang bzhin du/ /bslu med mchog gsum (253na7thu yis 'grub byin rlobs/ /byams pa'i 'dus pa dang por 'tshog —561—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)pa la/ /g.yeng bas brel gyur de srid gnam lo'i zhal/ shar ba'i thog mar shis brjod glur long zhes/ /mda' bsnun mched pa'i dge sbyong gang der bskul/ /sgang gzhongs med par kun la rtag snyom pa/ /sngon song byams brtse'i rang sems mtshon pa'i dar/ /thun mtshams rgya dang 'grogs te gra yi nang / /phun tshogs dge ba'i yul gru chen por spel/ /bod khams kyi nad yams sogs dus kyi chad pa gzhil thabs kyi dri smin la spyan gzigs tshogs 'khor dang bcas spun bdun pa lhun grubargya mtsho bsam yas su bto pa'i 'phrin gsol dmo tshig sgra dbyangs/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /sgyu 'phrul rgya gar paṇa chen tshul/ /pad+ma kā ra'i bka' rtags kyi/ /ri mo gtsug tor rtser mdzes pa/ /kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ khyung chen klu 'dul gseg shang can/ /tse'u dmar gnod sbyin yang le ber /sna tshogs zlos gar ston mdzad kye/ /bza' bca' btung ba'i tsho gos 'khor dang / /gser skyems phyi nang gos dang ja/ /dngos bshams thugs dam bkang ba'i rdzas/ /'gro ngor mtshon byed tsam spel nas/ /ting 'dzin gyis sprul mchod pa'i sprin/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'byed na/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi ma lus pa/ /thogs pa med par bsgrub tu gsol/ /lkog gyur chos rnams mngon sum du/ /gzigs pa yal yol btang snyoms kyi/ /(253ba)/dbang du ma gyur bya ma rtar/ /rdo rje'i gsang tshig rjen par gsungs/khyad par gangs ljongs yams nad sogs/ /dus kyi chad pa gzhil ba'i thabs/ /ston dang srung bzlog mi mdzad na/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje'i dam las 'gongs/ /de phyir sngon gyi zhal bzhes ltar/ /re ba 'grub bskul 'phrin yig rten/ /snyan shal dang bcas nag zla yi/ /rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i dus su spel/ /sa rta tshong 'dus nas bshan pa bya khrid mig gcig pas lung bstan rdo rje'i gsung 'phrin ring du gnas pa'i rten 'byung du kha gang ma dang tsos sku khog rjong bda' byung du kyi phren lan zla gzugs dngas mtshor 'dren pa'i shing rta/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa rnams/ /chu skyes ze'u 'bru sprul pa'i gar/ /rnam rol pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /thugs rjes lus can mtha' dag skyongs/ /gang gi dam tshig ra ba la/ /mi dral dregs pa'i sde dpon gtso/ /sku yi rgyal po mdun na 'don/ /bshan pa bya khrid mig gcig kye/ /gang gi gsung gsang rdo rje'i tshig /'byung 'gyur —562

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnam mol 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa ra spu snyan rgyud mang / ('alung du ston pa dang / /lhan cig ring por gnas pa'i stan/ /spel ba'i rten 'byung legs par 'gris /sngon du bod khams bde thabs sogs/ /spyi sgos rim gror sher snying mdo/ /bye ba bklag pa bsgrubs zin gyis/ /gangs ljongs phan bde'i dpal la sbyor/ /slar yang las kun bsgrubs gsol ba'i/ /'phrin rten sa yi zla ba zho/ /zung 'brel dar tshon sna lngar bcas/ /bstan srung chen po'i spyan sngar dge /(254na tshes rta lo zan g.yang mdo dzimachod par legs skyes spel bar dar nga pa btang ba'i dus sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po li byin ha ra dang las mkhan gnod sbyin chen po yang le ber la gsol ba'i 'phrin yig lha rgyal stan pa'i sgra dbyangs/bswo bswo lha chen rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs/ /tshangs pa'i yul sar 'then pa ta'i ra'i/ khyud mangs glu las nyer drangs 'phrin gsol bar/ /sgra 'dzin gtod cig li byin ha ra kye/ /mtshams sprin gos klubs cang shes bgrang bya'i lo/ /zan g.yang mdo sde'i dus bzang mchod pa cher/ /mdzad med nyer spyod nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo/ /phye 'dis thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas stongs/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus rnga yab gling pa yis/ /gtsug tu rdo rje'i phyag rgya nyer bkod nas/ /bstan 'gro'i srung mar khyod bskos zhal 'ches ding / /ri mo mig gsum pas kyang ci zhig dbyi/ /de phyir gangs ljongs skye rgu'i chu klung du/ /nad rims mu ge ga thug rtsod rnyog ma kun/ /mthu stobs nor bu ke ta gas bsgrungs nas/ /phan bde'i snang brnyan gsal bar mngon sum ston/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas rigs 'dzin sa ha ra'i/ /sngags rlom a ti'i rnal 'byor spyod pa po'i/ /'dod pa'i re ba skongs la dpag bsam gyi/ /yongs 'du'i mched por lha khyod rtsal gyis sgrubs/ /bdag blo rmonges mun mal las nyer slong ba/ /lkog gyur lung ston rta ljang dbang po'i 'gros/ /yig ngag go la'i sgang gshongs mthong dma' la/ /bltos min snang ba'i 'od zer stong phrag phye/ /bgrang yas lha min mngon 'dod rtsed 'jo sa /kun dga'i mdza' ba legs 'dzu pa 'dun sa(254ba)cher/ /snyim par 'phrin rten thogs pa'i bya ma rta/ /gom stabs lhod por bsgyur ba'i gar gyis rtsen/ /mthon por lha ngo 'degs pa su sti ga'i/ /glu dbyangs spobs mthong chags pa'i mgrin pa nas/ /len la gnod sbyin gser gyi shang shang can/ /gsang mtshan kun khyab rdo rje drag rtsal dgongs/ /gling bzhi —563

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegling phran dper byas gas la'i/ /rten dang brten par bcas la sri zhu sa /mdo sde'i mchod pa bstar ba'i dga' ston thog /tshar du dngar ba'i spyan gzigs dngom par brel/ /dus kyi chad pa kha rlangs lce gnyis dug /mthar byed dregs pa'i mthu rtsal rlakhas po ches/ /ri dwags lte ba'i dri ngad rab 'thul mod/ /phan bde'i cho gas gangs can dkar por mdzod/ /bdag yid 'o mtshor yangs sim gtam snyan po/ /rkang gdub sil sgrar bcas te mgrin pa'i sgra/ /'khrol pa 'phrin las 'khor lo'i lag pa yis/ /'phur lding rnam rol ngang tshul da gdod sgrubs/ /re ba'i myu gu bskyed du bsrings pa'i 'bras/ /nyams nus dgra bgegs skyin thang drag po'i dpal/ /'joms byed mthu stobs dus mtha'i me dpung rtsar/ /reg 'jam char gyi zegs mas sim par mdzod/ /'ja' lus 'pho ba che grub 'chi bdag gi /g.yul las rgyal bas 'jigs med thod 'phreng rtsal/ /rgya gar paṇa chen g.yar dam gnyan po gang / /nam yang mi 'gong bstan srung khyod kyi gshis/ /spangs ljongs margad gos kyang dbyar gyi dus/ /nyin byed 'grig pa'i khyim zhugs snron gyi slar/ /snang srid lha srin yongs kyi dmag dpon che'i/ /'dun (255na)sar sum rtsen longs spyod mched zla sprul/ /chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i gsang yum gter lung bzhin yar 'byog nas bri lcam byon skabs legs skyes spel bar bu lung rtsis rig smra ba blo bzang yon to btang skabs 'phran du gsal ba zung 'jug phan bde'i snye ma/ dha phya dha tu na k+ṣa ya sgog sma ra sa bai ཿ kā byu sa rba bha dra ma rudhe sa — ru tse ba tsi tra ka pya : shi ya sti ba dz+ras twa/ shwa ta spru la pa ñca ga tra ka tri dzā ti lwa di na ka tā ba ho : ta spu ba rta tsho ya gadhi kwa bya ke ti bha k+ṣa rā ka bā ra gu rla/ chos (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i phrit+ta la'i zlum po/)dbyings zad mi shes pa'i snying po rang rig don gyi kun tu bzang / /ma 'gags rang gdangs gzha' tshon ltar bkra khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /rigs brgya rigs lnga rigs gsum la sogs gcig pu nyid las du ma'i gar/ /legs bsgyur rnam 'phrul gaṅgā'i rdul las ding byon rje btsun bla ma mchog /gzhom med 'pho ba chen po rdo rje'i skur/ /grub nas bgrang bya'i 'phreng ba mang brgal yang / /sgrib lus sgyu thabs —564

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la tshon yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa ra go snyan rgyud mang / (seston gang bstan 'gro'i dpyid//g.yung drung ltar bzhugs 255bskon grags rna ba'i gsos//theg dgu'i 'jug lam phra zhib mtha' klas sgor//gdul bya'i khams dang dbang por 'tsham pa'i blo//'khrid byed drug cu'i dbyangs kyis yid can rnams//grol tshe rgyal gzhan zhi ba'i dbyings bzhugs bzhin//shes bya'i srid kun sgrib bral rjen pa sa/yongs 'char rnam pa thams cad mkhyen thugs kyis//mngal skyes o rgyan mkhan po deng sbyon na//gtsang byed pad+ma ra co 'dri byis blo'i tshul//lnga rig tshangs skud lang ba'i gnyis skyes nga //swasti'i sgrar drangs shis brjod sngon 'gro sa/a 'dus ka 'phreng tshig sbyor ku sha yi//chun po rna gong gzar nas mgrin pa 'degs//thugs bskyed sa bon mngar po dar drag las//tsho gis gnyis rtsa sdong yal 'dab phang phung rtser//'phrin las 'bras dud sngon med yongs 'du'i ljon//gangs can nags klung dbus na g.yur du za//rnam rtog pad+ma'i skud pas 'ching ba'i nus//nyer bral brtul zhugs chang gis rab myos glang //spyod pa'i gom pa gcig gis sangs rgyas sar//bgrod tshe rlabs chen dka' thub ngal rgyur zad//e dbyings dga' bzhi'i ye shes 'dren pa'i ma//wam yig bde chen zung 'jug mdza' na mos//nam mkha'i zla ltar zla med mkhar chen bza'i//mched po ekhri yā na las 'ongs ci//nang du dh+wa ti'i rtsa 'khor mdud rgya kun//lhug par grol ba'i rten 'brel phyi rol du//rang skal zab gter lus pa med pa'i sgo//'byed 'di bstan 'gro'i bsod nams bye bas rnyed//bgrang yas dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho 256nad+ku bsdu/ /byed por zhi dang khro bo mtha' klas pa'i//rigs brgya'i khyab bdag yab yum zung 'jug tu//bzhengs la me tog phal cher phyogs der 'dzum//bde gshegs rnams kyis rin chen bum bteg nas//dbang bskur rig ma'i tsho gos kyis glud byangs len//byang sems yongs kyis shis brjod khro bo yis//bgegs skrod lha mos mchod sprin spro 'di med//'og min zhing gtsor nges pa lnga ldan skur//'tshang rgya dngos pa'i gshis yin swā la'i ljongs//bcu gsum rdo rje sa chen rab mnan pas//dag dang ma dag mnal kyang gcig tu mnyam//rgyal kun spyi gzugasarnga yab gling pa yi/ /zab gter chos nor 'dod tha/ gdong bzhi pa/ /gan jag thang ta'i las lo'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)gser sgong du/ /deng smin bod chen 'gro rnams skal bzang byas/ /rtsod las ches snyigs lnga bdo mi yi lus/ /mgon khyod thugs rje brgya byin gtsug tor rtses/ /reg pa'i mod la rdzogs ldan lha'i gzugs su/ /rab gyur phan bde'i cho ga nyer grub ma'/ /rang rig yongs dag pad+ma 'od snyo 'dir/ /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin ngo bor legs bzhengs nas/ /bka' gter nam mkha'i nor bu khyab brdal du/ /'char bar rtsa ba gsum gyis bden brjod cig /bcu gnyis go la'i khyim lam nyi zla'i 'grod/ /chad min de bzhin chos srid zung 'jug dang / /'brel ba'i bka' mchod ta'i ra yi rgyud/ /snyan po rna ba'i rgyan du yang yang 'brol/ /dar dkar gos gyon mtshon byed zur gsal gyi/ /gsar 'gros gom ldan la can bya (256bsgo rta/ /o rgyan smin grol chos kyi gling yangs por/ /song ste dam pa'i phyag sor pa khror 'phul/ /rig byed 'dzin pa po 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tsho gos dbang po 'du ba tshogs pa'i tshe dpon tshang dar mo bas sman dpyad kyi nad gzhil bar byas skabs snyan pan gi 'phrin yig phrengs lan gdung sel zla ba'i chu rgyun/gi rmi dza ba skye ba lha ya : marla sa ha lha : swā dha rma na mā na tri bi rdzi kaḥ gā ba le sdomu ka shwa ta ha ཿ tsa ta grwa pa bāya sa ra bya lha go ya la/ sil (sde la sbyor mnyas pa'i brit+ta la me tog phreng ༅//brol gdu bus 'khor lo'i phyag sor gyis/ /chos kun gnas lugs mtha' dag rgyud mangs glu/ /len pa'i smin legs zla bzhin ngang mo dkar/ khyod mgrin 'o mtshor slar spyon ngag stsol zhig /skye bar tshangs ris bag chags yongs sad mthus/ /lha dbang grub pa'i blo gros dar drag pas/ /nyams 'gyur tshig don rgya bod sdeb sbyor phreng / /spel legs 'phrin yig du kū la rten 'byor/ /mi dge'i sa bon sgrib lus zhing gi sar/ /nyer btab zug rngu'i rim pa (257na bo byung ba'i shul/ /sgo gsum sim char 'bras dkar snye ma'i bskyed/ /bsrings pa'i cho ga deng rdzogs rna ba'i dpyid/ /bden gtam zla zer 'phog lus bde drod kyis/ /rngul chu'i thigs 'khyil yid dga'i rgya mtsho che/ /'phel ba'i kun rtog khye'u chung ro nus rjes/ /mdzes mar chags pa'i ba sbu tsher ltar rtsub/ /las nyon gyis 'phangs rnam smin nag po'i dug /rab bral sgo gsum rnyog med dngas pa'i klung / /bde skyid yan lag brgyad ldan lha yi chur/ /sgyur byed ri —566

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la sun yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pe'aphen legs byas shing rtas drangs//sa 'dir mtho ris sman pa tha skar skyes//mngon sum rgyu tshe lta na sdug pa'i grong //mthong bar yul gyi bskal snyam ngal ba'i khur//sangs pas sprul zhing gzhan 'tshol re ba bskrungs//margad khu bas rnyed byugs spangs ljongs mtha'/khor yug ljon pas yongs bskor skyid tshal na//bder gnas bsam gtan dang po'i ting 'dzin gyis//drangs pa'i shin sbyangs des kyang bsgrun du med//rnog chung zas skom tsam gnyer phyugs 'dra'i mi//ring por gnas la brtson na gtsug lag gzhung //mtha' klas lta ba'i mig yangs mes po'i rigs//blo ldan khyod srog 'chi ba don yod snyam//mang thos gaṅgā mo mngal sbrums pa'i sras//legs bshad 'dam bu'i tshal skyes gdong drug lha//gnyis pa rnam dpyod gar mkhan la zhen te//ches rlome glang po'i mche ba dbyung bar brel//rgyan mang bud shing 'o ma bur sogs kyi/khyad par 'byed la spobs pa dge ba'i dbang //257bstong lo'i ut+pal dor shul snyan tshig gi/spel legs pad dkar chun po thod bcings 'dra//brit+ta dzā ti ngo mtshar rtogs byed pa//rin chen 'byung gnas rlabs 'phreng yol med dbus//rkang bzhin bcas pa'i lci yang yid bzhin nor//blo gros gdengs spu'i rtse na 'od du 'bar//'dab bzang dbang po bzhon par byed nus pa/khyab 'jug sgyu thabs 'phrul la ma snyems shig/mtha' klas ming gi mngon brjod skad rigasas/khres rab gom pa gcig gis bcings 'di mtshar//'khor 'das 'phel 'grib dang bral nya gang zla'i/ /gdan steng rnam kun mchog ldan bde stong gar/ /yongs bsgyur kā la tsakra'i phyi nang gzhan/ /'jug sgo grub mtha'i mkha' khyab khyod blos gzhal//spyan snga mngon shes drug ched dka' thub kyis//ma bsgrubs lkog gyur dngos ston mig gsum pa'i//g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i gtsug lag gis//mtho ris sarba dz+nya yi spun slar byas//brgyad cu'i skor mgo spor thang khra mo sa/'gro 'di'i bde sdug so sor dbye ba'i rdel//'jam mgon gsung gi bdud rtsi khyod snying du//'khyil na kong rtse 'phrul rgyal dmigs gzhan med//sngon goms brang steng rgya bod yi ge'i rigs//lus 'gyur ban sprod rgod ma kha yi mes//drang srong usba'i spun gang thu mi las//// po hor gyi yi shes khyad par byas//'du zhabrugs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)nad sel rang byung khrus kyi rdzing / /rin chen bcud len sbyor bas nyi ma'i bu'i/ /me long rin mor byed pa sha ba ri'i/ /mngon byung gtam rgyus so ma nyi deng dus (258na)bral/ /bder gshegs snying po lcags khams nang rig rtsis/ /bsgyur ba'i sgo 'byed tha snyad lde mig dang / /yongs bral bla med ye shes kun gsal mtha'/ /'jal 'dod mkhas rlom byang bstan phug pa'i nyi/ /slad mar mang por thos la spro dga'i sems/ /gzengs su bstod dang shes ldan 'chi med kyi/ /'dun sar yangs pa'i blo gros phur bu yi/ /rjes su bgrod pa'i sgoms 'gros lhug par bde/ /ming tshig lha lam 'phrin yig chu 'dzin sbubs/ /rnam dag brjod pa dbyar gyi rnga gsang sgras/ /rna ba bdud rtsi'i mngal khur 'dzin pa'i mod/ /sems kyi rma bya zlos gar yang yang bsgyur/ /lkog min mthor brtsegs bsam don lhun grub la/ /mthong bas kun yid yongs sman brtan 'phrog pa/ /ma smad phun tshogs dbang po'i lag pad du/ /snyan 'phreng gser 'iXgrag gis 95spyid //ga sdo/gas spel/ /sa rta gong nas co yi bla ma no mo dge slong dang a zhang a ra ti na rab 'byams chos rje gnyis mi snar gnang ba'i skabs bka' shog gnang sbyin byung ba'i lan 'bul bar snar thang mkhan po ngag dbang bkra shis dang lha rje thabs mkhas gnyis rjong bda' byas skabs phul po'i zhu yig mchog tu dge ba'i gto/ tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gi stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba gnam sa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i drung du/ pa sangs nam gru'i 'grub sbyor mchog tu dge ba'i dus gnam gyi lha mi'i dbang phyug /'jam dbyangs gong ma mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal khab chen po'i phyogs su bod yul gyi lte ba 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gtsug lag khang (258ba)dmar po ri nas/shākya'i sdom brtson sde snod gsum pas yid dang ba'i sgo nas kha phyogs te bhu mi bra smo t+ta ma rā dza kā la sarba dwa o su sti maṅgal bha — zhes legs sbyar gyi sgra las drangs te sa'i tshangs pa/ gong ma rgyal po dus kun tu dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /ces shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gi 'phreng ba sngon du 'gro bas me tog 'thor zhing dri zhim po'i spos bsregs lag pa'i pad+ma zum ste gus pas gsol ba/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams mtha' klas pa'i skye rgu'i don du tshangs par spyod pa po/ /mkhas pa —568—

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pepaṇ+ḍi ta sa la gnas pa'i grub thob rnal 'byor spyod pa gling gcig nas bzhi'i bar du dbang sgyur ba'i 'khor los sgyur pa'i rgyal po/ khams kyi rgyal phran/ mdun na 'dren/ khyim bdag /'gro ba dman pa/gru rdzings/ zam pa/ chu mtsho rin po che sogs sprul pa sna tshogs su ston par gsung rab rin po che lasabashad cing / khyad par byang chub sems dpa' gzhan don du 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i srid pa 'dzin par gsungs pas rtsod pa'i dus 'dir stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i mi'i bdag po gang nges pa'i don du/ 'phags mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs lus can kun gyi mgon dang skyabs dang gling dang dpung gzhan du byon par gor ma chag mod/ 'on kyang snyigs mar spyod pa'i sems can ma dag pa rnams kyi ngor yang grangs med pa'i bskal pa nas bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis bskrun pa'i/ sku rin po che brgya phrag nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu spungs pa (259na〉ltar gzi mdangs lhag par rgyas shing / dri za'i rgyud mangs stong gis bsgrun par mi nus pa'i gsung gis mchog dman bar pa'i yid can mtha' dag tshar gcod rjes 'dzin sogs gang 'tsham gyi sgo nas yid bde ba'i tshor ba nyams su myong / 'jig rten gyi rgan po blo glos kyi rtsal dang ldan pa rnams kyis lan brgyar bsams kyang yid kyi yul du 'char bar dka' ba gtsug lag bye ba'i phra rags thams cad mngon sum mkhyen pas 'jig rten gyi mes po tshangs pa'i blo gros la 'gran pa'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor g.yo ba med pa sku gsung thugs rdo rje lta bur brtan pa nas/ bka' shog rin po che rked dkris la gser byugs pa'i dngul srang drug cu'i mdong mo gshig /gos chen dpus legs yug nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ kha btag bas che ba lnga dang chung ba bzhi bcu/ shel dam gcig dang phor pa gnyis bcas no mo gon dge slong dang er te na rab 'byams pa gnyis kyis khyer nas sug par sprad pa gser zhal dngos su mthong ba lta bu'i yid la spro dga' ci yang brtas/'di na'ang ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa shākya seng ge'i zhi bde don du gnyer ba'i gdul bya rnams la bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor sogs nyan thos dang rjes su 'brel ba'i sde snod/sems can thams cad mar shes pas 'gro ba gcig gi don du'ang rang bde 'dor bar nus pa rlabs —569

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)chen gyi spyod pa la dga' ba rnams kyi ched du byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod/ myur du sangs rgyas 'thob (259ba)par 'dod pa'i dbang po rnon po rnams la gsang sngags kyi theg pa sogs bka' stsal ba'i tshul la yid kyis mos pa thob ste/ bstan la zhugs shing bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du nyams su len par mos blo tsam thob pa'i shākya'i btsun pa'ang 'gro la lhag pa'i bsam pa dkar zhing spyi bo gnam bstan gyi rgyal po gang gi bka' drin las ga' na 'tshe med par bde bar gnas lags/ da lam rgyal po chen por 'tsham 'dri zhu bar dpal snar thang chos sde chen po'i mkhan chen ngag dbang bkra shis dang / gso rig 'dzin pa ngag dbang thabs mkhas gnyis rdzong bda' bgyis pa gser gyi them pa brdzis nas gser zhal mngon sum du mthong zhing dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal lhug par bstan pa'i bka' mchid bzang po chu bo'i rgyun bzhin zhu zhu/ zhu yig rten bkras btags/ shal dkar dmar/ mu men gyi 'phreng ba/ snam phrug sogs tho zur gsal la rtags kyi lang tsho bkra bar sa pho rta'i lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i gral tshes dge bar bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan lha ldan sprul pa'i gzhal med khang dang zung du 'brel ba rang byung 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang dmar po ri nas gus pas phul ba dge legs su gyur cig /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa lug lor bris pa'i chab sna(ga 'phrin yig khag /don grub ces pa sa lug gi lo gsar thog gra sdings po che nas sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang pos 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan ta'i ra'i rgyud mangs/ (260na)swā ra swa sna 'u yu khya 'i ṇi sma na sgru na ba PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBkā spu/ ba rte ༷ shā sti go thri ga smra khyi ka tshwa ma ta bi swā be sto : tsa : tra ka kloḥ/ dbyangs (ste bskyor 47 pa'i phrit+ta la sna tshogs lha mo/༄na gtam gyi sbyor ba'i rgyu ras/ /yid dbang kun dgar byed nus rnam dpyod rtsal/ /bsgyur tshe blo ldan phur bu rang grib la/ /gdung sel mngon sum rgyu ba'i mched —570

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pepo gang / /phra mo'i na tshod zla ba tshes pa nas/ /lang tsho'i nya rgyas de srid lnga rig gi /gtsug lag ri dwagasagazugs la rtag 'grus pa'i/ /legs bshad ga bur gzegs 'thor dngos po'i gshis/ / rtsol min nyams 'gyur yid byangs shugasang du/ /mgrin pa'i 'khor lor len pa ngang mo dkar/ /'phrin yig rkang gdub sil sgra blo gros gom/ /lhod por 'degs las 'brol ba thos 'dzin dpyid/ /skyes kyi rtse mor son ba gtsug lag gtam/(260ba)/spel legs man+da ra 'phreng shes ldan mgrin/ /brgyan las gzhan min zang zing bdog pas kyang / /gsar tshes gnam lo'i dga' ston gcig tu med/ /kun bzod lte ba yongs gang su war+ṇa/ /gzhal yas rnyed dka' yon tan phung po'i gter/ /mkhas khyod zo mdog bde ba'i nyer len des/ /thub bstan rgyan du byed pos sprul pa bzhin/ /'di na rgan po'i khur ljid ri bo'i spun/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i shing bal yal yul can/ /grags skam rlung gis che rgu'i gtsug bgrod par/ /me tog phal cher khrel bas 'dzum mam snyam/ /stong chen phyag rgyar bzang rdzu'i byang bstan phug /gnas lugs nyi zer mi 'char gti mug mal/ /nyal mang log lam gnyid lasaslong ba yi/ /bshes gnyen skya rengs khyod las gzhan ma rnyed/ /mtshams sprin bla gos sbubs nasagayem spyod kyis/ /rang rigs srog la rgol ba'i chom rkun mkhan/ /ma yin bag yod brtul zhugs ngo lkog dang / /bral khyod gangs ri'i ljongs kyi nye ba 'khor/ /don kun lhun grub gnam lo tshes pa'i thog /bkra shis dbyangs su len pa mes po'i bu/ /gtsug lag bye ba'i tshangs skud legs 'chang bas /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i sgo brgya 'byed pa bzhin/ /deng nas mos pas nges gsang smin grol lam/ /nyer 'god dga' ston cho ga de srid bar/ /rna bar sim pa'i 'phrin yig dri za'i glu/ /snyan po yid kyi gsos su rtag spel zhig /gaṅgā'i yab cig (261na tha zhin ras dngom pa'i dar/ /thun 'tshams lus phra'i rtags kyis nyer 'byud de/ /lcog bu cher sbreng chos sku'i yo lang du/ /stims klas spong ba'i sar bsrings la lci/ /don grub ces pa sa lug gi lo gsar dus rdo rje brag nas rigs 'dzin sprul sku rin po ches gnang ba'i chab shog gi lan pad 'byung —571—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheganyis pa'i rang spyo/ kho pi khu rgya gno ba khru dha rma su dha to rtsa ba : ruṅgā ni tho sa sto ga kaḥ yasdo mi ni rma ra smi rgya ga mu sdi ka sri ba khyu / la tsa kre ma hā ba rta ne/ /mkha' (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa 'i brit+ta las metog phreng wo//byab mkha' yi rdo rje chos dbyings gdangs/ /ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs pa nyin mor byed/ /gang 'dul sprul pa'i 'od kyis 'gro ba'i mun/ /sel mdzad rigs 'dzin 'khor los sgyur rgyal cher/ /sgra don (261ba)tha snyad tshig gi srad bu la/ /ched brgyus rtsol par bltos min mgrin pa'i mdud/ /rnam grol nyams 'gyur stong gi ro bro ba'i/ /chab shog dbyangs can rgyud mangs rna bar 'jibs/ /'phags yul skad las phyogs 'dir don grub pa/ /'jam dbyangs rgyal po'i khab tu gyi yi zhes/ /gser zhun gos su yongs klubs sum ldan lo'i/ /bgrang bya'i dga' ston tshar dngar yid kyi gsos/ /gzod ma nyid nas 'ja' lus 'pho ba che/ /'chi med rigs 'dzin brnyes po'i gral ring por/ /bzhugs kyang thun mong 'gro ngor snang ba'i sku/ /mi gzhig gangs ljongs legs byas shing rtas drangs/ /thub bstan yongs 'du sa brtol grib bsil du/ /ris bral lus can 'tsho thabs lhur len pa/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i cha shas ma gang yang / /lhag bsam nya rgyas des kyang mtshon min dkar/ /las nyan mthu yis rang dbang nus dman rung / /bden tshig grub khyod nan tan rtag gsungs bzhin/ /ring 'tshor rtsa gsum thugs rje bskul pa'i glu/ /dal med mgrin par len la gcig tu spro/ /seng ge'i ngar sgra cher sgrogs yid srubs sde/ /tshar gcod 'chol ba'i khro rgyal gro bo lod/ /mkhyen rab blo ldan mchog sred rigs kun kyi/ /bdag por pad+ma rgyal po khyod dngos byon/ / srid zhi'i mun bcil nyi ma 'od kyi zer/ /spro mdzad shākya seng ger legs sprul pa/ /rang snang rig mar mnyam sbyor pad 'byung ding / /tshangs spyod pad+ma sam+bha'i zlos gar bsgyur/ /rnga yab gling dbus laṅka 'a rgyal khab rtser/ /'bod (262na)sgrogs gnyen por 'phrin dī ma'i 'phrul/ /dngas shel ngos 'char gzugs bzhin dam sri'i gshed/ /ljongs 'dir mched por rig sngags 'amang khyod bstan/ /lnga bdo'i sems can 'dren la mig mi 'dzum/ /thugs bskyed snying stobs go char rgyal kun gyis/ /mgrin gcig bsngags na gdul dkar nges 'byung —572

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pebs/ /zhi bder gzhol ba ched sems dpa'i mdzad pa min/ khri srong legs byas skya rengs kyis drangs pa'i/ /lo paṇa thugs kyi gsang mdzod bka' gter nyi/ /gangs ljongs mkha' la 'phel 'grib med 'char ba'i/ /byed po khyod las tshad ma'i yul gzhan min/ khyad par paṇa chen mched dang dbang po'i sde'i/ /dri bral ring lugs mtho ris chu bo'i rgyun/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i rgya mtsho rab 'dren pa/ /skal ldan shing rta'i snying stobs phrag par bzhes/ /sngon dus thub gzhung dar tshe chos phung tshad/ /spel las ding sang pad+ma'i skud pa bzhin/ /phra 'dir tshigs bcad gcig bshad don chen du/ /dgongs te 'chad nyan srog gi ka ba tshugs/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje bdud blon gyis gshe bas/ /rje 'bangs snod ldan 'dzin la ma gnod ltar/ /smin grol gdams pa srid mthar mi nub ched/ /log sgrub 'khor gyi skyo ngal ring du spongs/ /'byung po'i kha rlangs ches ngar snyigs dus 'dir/ /'jam dpal rdo rje khro bo'i skur bstan pa'i/ /stang stabs gcig gis snang srid phyag rgya'i tshogs/ /thams cad zil gyis gnon la (262ba)g.yol med gces/ /spyi dang bye brag gsang chen rnying ma yi/ /mgon por srog gi ka ba nyer btsugs te/ /a lha mi 'gyur rdo rje bzhu blugs su/ /lhun grub rig 'dzin sa la bzhugs ched gsol/ /bgrang yas zhi khro'i rten dang brten pa kun/ /rig pa'i rtsal du shar grol stabs cig pa/ /rnam gsum yo ga'i lha sngags ye shes kyi/ /'phrin las srid pa'i mtha' rnyed 'jug par rigs/ /thub bstan rdo rjes mtshan pa'i brag ri'i ngos/ /mi gzhig skyil krung gcig gis bdud bzhi'i tshogs/ /zil gnon 'og min zhing gi mgon po ltar/ /'khor ba stongs min bar du brtan gyur cig /gnam lo'i bzhin dngom bkra shis 'dun sa cher/ /dga' ston deng nas dbus 'gyur mi pham mgon/ /byon min de srid tshad med phebs tshogs 'gros/ /go la'i rgyun lam nyi zla'i 'gros bzhin zhu/ /mes pos pad+ma'i rtsa ba thags ris su/ /sprul tam zla ba zhun mas byugs sam zhes/ /som nyi'i 'khyogs la 'phyang byed lha rdzas kyis/ /gang gi rnam dag thugs bskyed mtshon nam snyam/ /don kun grub pa'i cho 'phrul ma la ya'i/ /dri bsung dngar pos log lta'i tsha gdung rnams/ /rab gzhil rta chen zla ba'i thabs kyi cha'i/ /rgyal ba dang por phul ba —573

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)dza yan+tu/ /khyab bdag bla ma bka' 'gyur ba chen po 'i dbon ngag dbang blo gsal mchog ldan gyi dog bde lho mos gzhis dar sa pho rta'i lo ston dus nas dbu btsugs te brag rdzong ma'i bsnyen chen mdzad pa gegs med du grub tshul (263na)gyi gsung 'phrin byung lan slob gad nyi ma'i dngos brgya/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos kun rgyud gsum gyi/ /dregs par yongs shar sems nyid gcig pu'i 'phrul/ /gsal stong zung 'jug don gyi nag po cher/ /rnam rol slob bshad bstan pa'i srog shing che'i/ /rang rgyud rdo rje lus kyi 'khor lo lngar/ /sna tshogs las grub bla ma he ru da: /lcam dral bran g.yog 'ja' ris ltar bkra ba/ /du mar shar yang ro gcig chu zla'i gar/ /bde stong zung du 'jug pa nye lam gyis/ /sgru ti'i mdud brgya nyer grol rdo rje'i skur/ /zug rngu kun mkhyen gzigs pa'i yul min na/ /zo mdog bde ba'i mtshar 'dzin byis blo bzhin/ /sa brdzus chen por rab rlom 'ur rgyangs mkhan/ /phal gyi rna bar nam sen rdo rje'i phrag /gzhom med bsrung ba'i rdzong las bzlog bsad mnan/ /sa skya'i bla chen sog 'dzin khyod nyid tsam/ /gur gyi mgon po rnam 'phrul khro bo bcus/ /yongs bskor dus mtha'i me phung 'bar ba'i rtser/ /yid srubs sder bcas rab bsreg skyed rim gyis/ /dgra bgegs dpung tsho gis ming gi lhag mar byas/ /gsang sngags bzlas brjod dbyar rnga bsgrags pa'i mod/ /zab don chos kyi rma bya mngal sprum dang / /lhan cig bstan 'gro'i bde skyid gshog sgro'i gdugs/ /zlum por 'khyil ba'i zlos gar 'di rmad (263ba bang / /phyi rol dam can rtsa khams me long du/ /yongs gsal sems snang don gyi nag po che/ /dgyes mdzad 'khor lo'i mgon las gzhan min par/ /ye shes rang ngo 'phrod pos grub mtha' snyogs/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas bka' 'gyur ba'i/ /rigs dang chos kyi sku yi dpon gyur khyod/ /tshar chen bla ma'i ring lugs spel ba la/ /snying po'i mtshan can byin rlabs mngon zhugs snyam/ /gur rgyan dgongs don grangs bzhin nyer bsnyen pas/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog grub mtshan shegs med du/ /yongs rnyed rgyal rnga brdung dang chabs cig par/ /dkar po chos kyi ba dan srid rtser 'phyar/ /slad mar gnyan lo'i thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /tsa tu rmu kha'i tshe sgrub —574

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pesrung 'khor sogs/ /zab las ches zab lha sngags ye shes kyi/ /rnal 'byor mchog la gzhol par gcig tu bskul/ /dam pa'i gas bar 'os pa rkang 'thung gi /lo ma'i rtse mor nyer son bam bo la/ /thun mtshams rgyas spras dbo zla'i dkar cha yi/ /rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la'i khi ta ma/ /sa lug gi lo snga 'gyur gsung rab spyi dang khyad par snying thig gi rtogs pa klong du gyur pa'i khams pa rdzogs chen pa'i 'phrin lan kun slong (264na〉lta da sgo/no: ti so tsi ta spu ta : mu dro ྅shā ta ko bsdi na swā dha rgya ka bhāsti na/ ṅgā tu rko: ma hā : gu ro rnye kha yu ཿ bu dha pi tho kā t+yā na bha rba na hi/ dal (sdeb sbyor mkho pa'i dz+ra t+ta las me sto phreng tso/〉khyor rten bzang zhing sa gshin po la/ /thos pa'i sa bon bsam sgom drod gsher gyis/ /yongs smin don ldan snye ma g.yur za ba/ /khams stod rdzogs chen bla ma'i 'phrin rten son/ /tshe rabs mang goms legs byas mthu bo ches/ /theg pa kun gyi rtse rgyal a ti la/ /bzang po'i bag chags sad khyod lce btsun gyi/ /rjes su bsnyeg ched ring por 'tsho ba bzhin/ /'di na mdo rgyud tha snyad gzhung 'grel 'gar/ /sbyangs stobs lhod pos bgrod pa'i gnyis mthung bdag /brtson pas rtse gcig sgrub la ma bsgril bas/ kha bshad ba sdu'i smra ba kho nar zad/ /nyams myong la ba'i rgyu skrun med bzhin du/ /gzhan rtogs (264bzhags sel bogs 'don 'jam phrug thags/ /som nyi'i grang reg bsal la yid brton par/ /rung ba'i sha gos mkha' dbyings pad+ma'i grogs/ /na tshod phra nas srid bder ma chen par/ /gtan 'dun bsgrub blo'i rtsa ba sbom po'i shing / /smin grol bgrang yas thos pa'i yal 'dab rtser/ /nyams len ro bde'i 'bras las mchog gzhan gang / /sum cu'i yongs 'dzin u dum wā ra'i 'phreng / /thod bcings khyad par chos rgyal lha gral nas/ /snying tig bdud rtsis ngomasapa'i sgra gcan khyod/ /thar lam srog gi ka ba gcig tu tshugs/ /mkha' spyod o ḍi ya na'i gsang mdzod dang / /dbyer med pad+mā ka ras sgrub pa'i khang / /mang por ting 'dzin mi g.yo g.yar dam gyis/ /gnas kyi gang zag brlabs pa gdon mi za/ /lo gsum 'dab sbyar bug sgo tsam bsten par/ /mtshar du rtsi na bgrang bya bco lnga'i bar/ /rtse gcig bsgrub la rab brtson ngang tshul dang / /lha rnams mkha' ngos—575

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyelegs gso'i me tog 'thor/ /longs sku'i zhing mang myul ba thod rgal gyi/ /dkar ser khra mun sgron ma drug gi gnad/ /nan tan bgyid khrod rang rig kun tu bzang / /rang zhal mthong ba'i bar du dar yol tsam/ /chos nyid mngon sum pha mthar phyin pa ding / /dkon na gong 'phel snang ba yongs shar gang / /snga 'gyur nags klung stug po logs pa'i dbus/ /sngon med yongs 'du'i ljon pa khyod du nges/ /(265na)tshad phebs rdzogs na chos nyid zad sa sa /'byol la ha cang mi ring pha rol na/ /skyon bral yon tan kun tshang rang gi sems/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang du btags pa yod/ /de phyir snga 'gyur grub brnyes ches mang ba/ /phung po 'od skur grol mod cher snyigs dus/ /nyin mo'i skar ltar dkon kyang mi 'byung mtha'/ /ma bkag skyid lug med par 'bad pas sgrubs/ /rtog pa yod na lta ba min smra dang / /zhi gnas mi g.yo lhag mthong nya ltar 'khyug /sems gnas ltem po spros bral dngos 'dod sogs/ /sa dge dwags brgyud grub mtha'i rigs mang mod/ /dgag sgrub blang dor bral ba rang shar bar/ /cer gyis bltas pa'i mtsho rlabs mkha' sprin bzhin/ khyab gdal gdod ma'i gshis lugs chos kyi dbyings/ /'pho 'gyur bral ba mnyam rjes gnyis med lam/ /bzang ngan rtog pa'i 'phro 'du ji snyed tshogs/ /shar grol dus gcig byung tshe 'khor yug tu/ /ka dag ye grol klong du yongs 'byams las/ /gnas 'phror bltos min snang tshad chos kyi sku/ /dga' rab shrī sring pad 'byung bi ma la/ /be+e ro so zur gnubs nyang la sogs pa'i/ /bka' gter gnad la sbyangs dman rnying rlom 'gas/ /phyag rdzogs ma phyed sra sre'i chos skad mang / khyod kyis sngon chad brtson pas nyams bstar kun/ /snying tig snying (265ba)po'i dgongs don ji lta bar/ /ma rtogs log rtog med pa rnam dag lam/ kho nar song ba'i tshul la gcig tu rangs/ /kṛ kri'i rmi ltas dus bab chos gzugs spyod/ /tshon ris sems kyi shel ngos shar ba na/ /don chung g.yeng ba'i gzeb tshud thos bsam dang / /sgom pa'i gleng mo ma phyed skal ba phra/ /'on kyang ljongs 'dir bgrod dus shar tshod rnams/ /mol mchid 'ong bar ma zad snga 'gyur bstan/ /'dzin nges gdung gis btsun dang skyes rabs kyi/ /'phreng mdzes mang por gtugs pas sgro 'dogs chod/ /—576

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('tshe 'di'i 'khri ba bcad nas nyams len la/ /dril don gzhan phan sems bskyed kyis zin phyir/ /skal ldan smin grol bkod pa'i bsod nams tshad/ /chu gter chig gus bgrangs kyang gzhal nus min/ /slad mar rtse gcig sgrub pa kun bzang gi /rnam 'phrul mchod sprin rtsa gsum spyan snga sa /nyer spro'i dam bca' brtan po ma btang ngos/ /gleng 'os mtho ris chu bo tshad med kyis/ khyod mig dri bral mkha' dbyingasazla ba'i ngos/ /phyag mtshan sku gzugs ri mo yongs bkra ba/ /mtshon byed bkra shis dar dkar thun mtshams rgyas/ /btab pa chu stod kyis nya'i dmar char bris/ /sa mo lug gi lo 'bri gung sprul sku rin po ches gter sgrom du tshe chog dang rdo rje gro bo lod kyi sbyin sreg gnang nas phyir phebs bsams shog byung ba'i lan bgrang yas zhi khro'i rol gar/ (266na)pra kri pā ni tu dha rma su ka ye nyi sna/ ṅgā tu rnyesto ga kā yo da ma n+ta bha nu/ཿ/ sa rba bi ṣ+ka ra lha ba ba bha sno rma na rta ya / lu la tswa mu rta: rnyu ra dwa/ rang (sdeb sbyor mas pa'i prit+ta las me tog phreng can/)rig gdod nas chos skur dag pa'i gdangs/ /ma 'gags longs skur shar ba'i gzhal ris zer/ /kun khyab 'gro la dngos snang sprul pa'i gar/ /bsgyur mdzad rigs 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug rgyan der/ /daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung lugs las 'ongasayi waṃ khog /yangs por mkhyen dpyod rgyud mangs nyer 'brol ba'i/ /chab shog dar dkar gyis bteg bya ma rta'i/ /'jo sgeg dri za'i bu mor skyengs pa ster/ /bgrang yas zhi khro'i lha sngags ye shes kyi/ /rnam rol sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ches/ /tshur mthong byis pa'i 'khrul ngor gzhom zhig skyon/ /bral de spyi dang bye brag bstan 'gro'i gsos/ /ne'u sdu'i klog 'dra'i ngang du rgan po'i gral/ /(2slob mi dag gcig tu sgrub la gzhol 'os kyang / /da dung rnam g.yeng chu gnyer rjes 'gro 'dis/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor stong par zad kyis dogs/ /drag po'i 'phrin las sgrub gnas gter sgrom der/ /'chi bdag g.yul tshogs bzlog pa'i cho ga dang / /gnod byed 'byung po'i ster bcas ma dpal rtser/ /bsregasatshe pad+ma ka ra dngos byon tam/ /mjing yon lha sras gnam lcags me 'bar gyi/ /yang srid chos grags byin rlabs thugs klong nang / /zhugs khyod snga 'gyur bstan la mngal skyes kyi/ /sgro ḍi ya na'i slob —577—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedapon gsar byon bzhin/ /snyan grags lha yi gaṇ+ḍi cher brdungs sgra/ /srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrags tshe mig mi 'dzum/ /phal cher rgyu skar zol gyis dbu ru'i cha'i/ /mkha' ngos bgrod la gcig tu brel lam snyam/ /stag chen rlung ltar 'phyo steng gar dgu'i nyams/ yongs bsgyur rdo rje'i phur mtshon gzas pa'i rtser/ /yid srubs snying de brgya phrag bkas na yang / /da rung mi 'dzad skye rgu'i las nyon skyon/ /'jam dpal tshe bdag lha khung gdangs zhal du/ /log par 'dren no cog chur khrag dron gyi/ /dbu ba 'khrigs pa'i bar nas 'gro kun la/ /rjes chags snying rje'i tshems phreng gcig tu dkar/ /rigs gsum 'dus pa dug sdong nag po yi/ /lto bar 'jig rten gtams pas ma tshims par/ /ljang dmar nag po'i khro zhal tshangs ris las/ /brgal tshe blta phyir mes pos gdong bzhi sprul/ /drang srong dmod pa'i thal brdabs gcig gi bar/ /sde brgyad (267na)bya sgro mgar gyis sol mal ltar/ /gyur tshe rgyal bas lung bstan mya ngan med/ /sprul las slar yang yang sprul mched por dogs/ /de tsam blo dman 'og 'gyu'i 'char sgo ste/ /zhi khro kun 'dus che mchog he ru kur/ /bzhengs la ma tshang sras bcas rgyal ba yi/ /rnam 'phrul tshang mas gzhal kyang dmigs su med/ /dregs ldan blun pos gtsug mchod lha srin gyis/ /cher bsngags dngos po'i gtong len gzhal 'drid mkhan/ /bla chen phal gyi ngang tshul khyod nyid kyi/ /rnam thar mthong bas chu shing snying por 'khrums/ /ches dkon theg mchog snying po'i 'phrin las rgyun/ /'khor ba'i mtha' rnyed skal bzang gdul bya'i don/ /sku srog g.yung drung nya phyis khog yangs por/ /tshe yi mu tig phyur bur khengs gyur cig /nam yang mi bskyud bka' mchid mtho ris chab/ / mkhyen rab gser mngal can gyi ral klung nas/ /babs pa'i legs bshad dbu ba'i do shal phreng / / ming tshig yi ge gaṅgā'i 'gros ba'i na zhu/ /dkar mdzes lus phra'i sor mos ma btags shing / /dkar gsal ston zla zhun ma 'khyil min par/ /dkar 'jam reg bya'i khyad chos kha dzor can/ /dkar phyogs e yig shar tshe rgyasaspras te/ /skyu ra gnam gyi sngags 'chang rim byon las/ /pad+ma'i rgyal tshab rin chen phun tshogs sogs/ /rigs 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ltar chad med kyi/ /mdun sar dang bas phul ba dza yan+tu/ /—578

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (ses lug tshong 'dus nas chos skyong bshan pa bya khrid ma gcig (267bza dzi pa'i khri 'don gyi legs spel du tshan grangs byung skab de lan goganyer mags pa'i tshe tshon dug sol spub po shi lta rgyal/yid can yod do cog gi rnam 'dren che/ /yang sgos gangs can ljongs kyi lha gcig pu/ /dran pas gdung sel pad 'byung bka' rtags gtsug /rab mdzes bshan pa bya khrid mig gcig dgongs/ /lung bstan gyis zin mi bdag chu stod zla'i/ /yar tshes dga' ba gnyis par mang bkur khrir/ /mnga' gsol legs spel ched du khog zhugs rten/ /gsung 'phrin tshan grangs bcas te 'byor bas spro/ /'di na dam po'i bcad rgya dang 'grig kyang / /sne len ngo so thogs pa'i bdag rkyen byas/ /go gsol dus chen gra bsgrig khyad snga nas/ /rang yul myur bgrod cho ga sngon du bstar/ /'gro mang las kyis bskrun pa'i dkar nag 'bras/ /so sor smin pa bcos su dka' mod kyang / /lcags khams gser 'gyur ji bzhin blang dor la/ /brtson na bde skyid sgo 'phar cis mi 'byed/ /de phyir lkog gyur mngon sum gsal ba'i spyan/ /dmar zlum phyogs bcur gzigs nas legs spel dang / /nyes sol rdo rje'i lung bstan sgra bo che/ /mgrin bteg lha rgyal dbyangs su da 'tsher zhig /oḍi ya na'i tsan dan sdong po'i 'og /zhe dgu'i zhag bar mi g.yo'i skyil mo krung / /mdzad par 'gal ba med mod ring min du/ /khog zhugs bstan pa'i bya ra sngon bzhin mdzod/ /dngos bsham yid sprul mchod pa'i bye brag gis/ /thugs dam gnyan po skong phyir rab 'bul na/ /dga' mgur rol pa 'phrin (268na tshe pas rnam pa bzhi/ /bsgrub pa'i bkra shis yar ngo'i zla ltar spel/ /sa lug gi lo rnam gling paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags 'khor zhag dus snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i 'phrin yig byung lan shes bya'i gnas kun gsal ba'i me long / rta ga le 'i 9 pa klo snya rā tu ba bha k+ta ra be+e ḍa su gi ta suri : kha naḥ bi kra ma swā ra kā ( su ke tu rtsa tso de na tsi : ru tsā zhi na gus da ho/ khyod (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i prit+ta las me tog 'phreng can/)mgrin pi waṃ khog pa yangs po nas/ /nyams 'gyur rgyud mangs 'brol ba'i glu dbyangs 'phrin/ /rnam dpyod dbyangs can sor rtses bskul ba dang / /lhan cig rten gyi gdu bu ngom de mtshar/ /tshangs pas mtha' btsal ma rnyed zag bcas mal/ /gnyid la g.yur byed —579

rgya la dbang snga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)bsod nams chu gter las/ /nyer thon lang tsho'i zla ba yon tan gyi/ /nya gang legs bshad bsil zer 'gyed de spro/ /'di na bsam sgom ga tho zhe nu'i gar mkhan ma/ (268ba)/cung zad thos pa'i gos kyi sgrib g.yogs can/ /chos brdzu blo brid mar me'i khang bzang nang / /rang gzhan phan bde'i phye leb 'debs sam snyam/ /'khor rtsa khyim thab drag po'i dka' thub rgya/ /nges 'byung lus med 'jam mnyen mdas phug pas/ /bag yod khrims kyi u ma dkar mo'i bzhin/ /bstan pa'i mod der gtan mdun nu zho 'dzag /rab rmongs glang gdong mche ba nyer phyung ste/ /rnam lnga rig gzhung mdong mtha' la nyon nas/ /mkhas mang mig mi 'dzum gyi gral bsnyeg pa'i/ /mched po khyod las g.yin pa dmigs su med/ /lcang lo'i phreng ba ring dor dge ba'i dbang / /tsan+d+ra go mi dge slong gzugs gyur tam/ /rtsod ngag chos grags khengs phyog 'di gang zhes/ /lhun pos nyi zla'i sgron me bteg nas blta/ /srog 'tsho'i bdud rtsir gzhon nus gsos kyi spun/ /rgya bod yi ge'i rig byed sa sto ṭa/ /sdeb sbyor brda dag kun la zhus chen gyi/ /sngon byon skad gnyis smra ba'i rjes 'gror brel/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum shes byed grub pa'i mtha' /lkog gyur dngos mthong g.yul las rnam par rgyal/ /spor thang rgya nag mkhas ba ched gtsug lag tshogs/ /blta ba'i mig yangs de ko su yis bskrun/ /mngon brjod bzo rig phyag tshad dbye ba dang / /dpyad pa brtag thabs lugs kyi bstan bcos sogs/ zhes byar srid 'jal blo sna ring po'i dkyus/ khyab 'jug gom pa gcig gis des kyang min/ /sde snod rgyud sde ba ku la yi kha/ /thos brtson mdzes ma'i 'gram chang mngar po yis/ /phye tshe chu (269na81sa 'dzum byed nyi zla zung / /dal med nam mkhar bgrod pa ngal ba tsam/ /g.yu ru bza' shing nags klung rab 'khrigs khrod/ /rnam mang thos sras 'byor par 'gran nus gling / /pha yul skyid pa'i gzhis der bag pheb nas/ /ches dkar dge legs spyod yul gcig tu yangs/ /yid 'ongs khyi'u chung yongs bskyod sngon 'gro'i sgor/ /lus phra gtong len gnyen gyi sbyor ba'i rtsis/ /ngan bsgyur bzang por spel mkhas bla mkhyen du/ /'phrul rgyal kong rtse'i khengs pa thung ngur byed/ /lhang lhang snyan pa'i glu dang dga' ba'i gar/ /rtse dga' khong dgod phun tshogs dus ston che/ /—580

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (poku mu da yi dpal bzhin ya rabs kyi/ /bzang spyod mi chos gtsang ma'i ngang tshul 'jebs/ /de phyir an+da rnyil zhun dbu 'phreng rgyan/ /pak+ṣa'i chu klung bu mo brgal dka' ba/ /mkha' mig zhag par ci bder bgyid 'os zhes/ /smra ba'i ro 'dzin cung zad brkyang min nam/ /ri mo g.yas su legs 'khyil ba'i/ /mgrin pa skya ba lnga pa'i dung / /snyan tshig sgra dbyangs thos 'dzin gyi/ /rgyan du yang yang bus shig gu /kun rtog 'khrul ngo'i gzugs brnyan rnams/ /mngon sum thags su shar 'dra ba/ /rab dkar kha tshar can 'di la/ /rtags kyi mtshams sprin mdangs 'od gsal/ /nyi ma srang gi khyim spyod pa/ /dbyu gus zla nya phyi ma'i phyogs/ /ā yig 'char ba'i tshes dge bar/ /rgyal khab dmar po ri nas bris/ /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags sprel lor bris pa'i chab 31ga 'phrin yig khag /lcags sprel lo gsar (269ba〉tre tshe sdings po che sprul sku'i 'phrin lan shel dkar tshon ris/ su tho di sta nā ཿ bhimā yin : ma khyo bi nā ro ra ga mya su sa mū rta dzi 1 su mā mu sha se 0 khre ga rdzi rngo ma n+yale 'a : mā rta du ta tho ta u lte/ legs (ldeb sbyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta las lag 'gro lhung ba/) byas gting mtha' mi mngon chu gter dbus/ /rnam dpyod lto 'gro'i gdengs kha mdzes pa'i lce/ /snyan tshig phuṭa sgra sgrog dang chabs cig par/ /'phrin rten nor bu dngom 'od deng 'dir son/ kha ba'i rdul brtsegs gosaklubs ma rka ṭa/ /sum ldan khams kyi bgrang bya'i zla bzhin ngos/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i ri dwagasagazugs shar ba/ /laṅka'i pho brang rtsig par 'gran gyis dogs/ /gzhom bral chos sku'i klong du skye rga dang / /na 'chi dmigs su med kyang bro 'tshal ding / /sprin bral nyi zer lho byang phug pa sa /'char la sems med sa gzhi dgod pas 'dar/ /'di na mdo rgyud tha snyad bkrag po ches/ /byis yid 'drid pas drug cu brgal lo'i mthar/ khrid (270na thad ga don med log lam ma 'phyan par/ /thos bsam —581—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)lang tsho dar bar rang blo bde/ /dkar 'jam shog bu'i pad phor snod yangs por/ mas brjod tshig phreng me tog phyur bu sa /nyer spungs mgrin pa'i sor rtses 'thor ba la/ /mes po'i rigs brgyud khyod smin gang gis 'dzin/ /gser ri'i sbubs nas nyi zla chad med du/ /'char bas 'dab ma ba 'ad 'dod ba ku la/ /skugs sdod snying thag srid pa'i pha mtha' mā /rdzogs min tshul der pad dkar sa mos 'dzum/ /rig byed rdzun gyi gdong bzhi ldan mang yang / /nges don zag bcas ma la du sems gnas la/ /bskal brgyar gnyid g.yur sngon med brad+ma ṇaḥ/ /gling ras bstan par gcig shar ṛ shi'i spun/ /rnam 'dren mos pa rab byon dga' ston par/ /gnam lo'i thog mar su sti bha wastu'i/ /snyan por gtam gyi pi waṃ rna ba'i bcud/ /'phrog byed zhabs bsil bzhin du rtag sbrengs shig /nam mkha'i ngo bo nyer stong li khi ta/ /lha rdzas kha rdzar can gyi steng bzhag nas/ /rig pa'i 'byung gnas g.yo ru gra nang du/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal po u yig shar tshe spel/ /lcags spre'i lo stobs kyis 'khor / ba 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung gi kha lo bsgyur ba tsam gyis log par 'khru ba'i rkun mthu san gu sde bcas ming gi lhag mar gyur ba'i tshe legs skyes 'bul ba'i thog mar bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs sngon 'gro'i zhu yig dang bcas bsam blo rab 'byams pa tshul khrims rnam rgyal dang blo bzang tshe ring mngags skabs phul ba'i zhu yig phyogs thams cad la rnam par rgyal ba'i gtam snyan/ /tshe ring gnam gyi she (270ba〉pong gi stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba gnam sa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i drung du/ dbyar dus kyi char rgyun zad mi shes pas 'dzin ma'i khor yug mtha' dag nye bar brlan te phra mo'i rdul tsam yang ldang ba med pa'i ston gyi dga' ston la bab pa'i chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor ltar dkar ba gsal ba'i dga' spro'i yid kyis kun nas blangs te dbang po'i phyogs der 'dud de bdug spos 'bul zhing me tog 'thor ba dang bcas yongs la sngon 'gro 'gog med du byed pa'i cho ga bstar te gsol ba/ gzod ma nyid nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bgrang du med pa 'du bgyis pa'i rgyal ba'i sras po 'jam mgon zur phud lnga pa gdul dka'i sems can rnams rjes su chags pa'i brtse ba dang / snying —582

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('astobs phul du byed pa'i smon lam gyis mngon par bskul te thugs rje dang 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa dus las mi yol bar gnam ka ba med pa'i mthongs nas babs te 'dzam gling yongs kyi lha gcig por mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal khams gser 'brug sder mo lnga pas bteg pa'i khri chen por zhabs zung gi pad+ma rnam par bkod de mtha' klas pa'i gtsug lag dang sgyu rtsal gyi tshul la byang ba'i blo gros kyi mthu dang / rgyal po'i rigs kyi che bas nyi 'og gi dregs ldan mtha' dag zil gyis gnon pa rdo rje rin po che'i rgyan khyad par du gyur pa'am/ yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po ltar srid zhi'i legs tshogs kun gyi 'dod 'jor bzhugs pa ni dngos po'i gshigs lugs nyid las gzhan du ci/ 'di na'ang lus can mtha' dag gi mgon dang / skyabs dang (271na gling dang / dpung gnyen dam par gyur pa 'dren pa mnyam med shākya seng ge'i bstan pa rin po che bla nas blar 'degs pa'i khur phrag par blangs pa'i grib bsil du rgyud lnga'i yid can rnams ngal gso bar smon pa'i lhag bsam dkar bar gnas/ nye lam ched du 'bul ba'i snying po gnam dang sa'i dkyil 'khor kun la dbang phyug pas srid zhi'i byed po tshangs pa mi'i gzugs su rnam par rol bar 'bangs phra mos rgol ba'i klan ga'i skabs ci mchis kyang / bar skabs su ma hā tsi na'i lho phyogs kyi yul gru 'ga' zhig tu bsod nams ma yin pa'i 'brasabur 'u san gu'i ngan g.yo'i 'brul 'khor brtsams pa nyi ma'i 'od dang srin bu me khyer bzhin du su cing bcu gsum gyi yul kun tu bkra shis dang bde legs su gyur pa'i gtam rna ba'i bcud len du son par brten/ gtsug lag bye ba'i sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i mdun sa chen por legs skyes kyi bdog pa khra shar 'bul bar bsam blo rab 'byams pa tshul khrims rnam rgyal dang blo bzang tshe ring gnyis rdzong bda' zhus par/ lha mig dag pa'i spyan ras kyis nye bar bca' ba'i bslab ston phebs tshogs chu klung chen po'i rgyun ltar zhu/ drag po zhes pa lcags pho spre'u lo hor gyi zla ba lnga pa'i gral tshes dge bar rang byung 'phags pa'i gzhal med khang dmar po ri nas phul ba'i zhu yig /mas dro chu bzang nas rigs 'dzin dkon cog lhun grub kyis bris thad bzhengs pa'i gser ris kyi mthun rkyen dgos tshul gyi —583

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kye'aphrin lan theg mchog rtse mor son pa'i rgyal rnga//(271ba〉yu rgya de sha nā shā ka bha rba ka de lo tsa na lusha ku lha gri ma ni mi ṇa:ma dha co spro na tsi t+ta pya bu / gra gaṅgā gar t+na ni rwa sto ga bi dz+nyā dhar/ thub (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i phrit+ta las me tog 'phreng can/)pas lung bstan a shwa ka yi srid/ /gangs can lha gcig mjing yon sprul pa'i gar/ /dbur smyon thugs sras lung rtogs rtser son pa/ /rig sngags 'chang ba dkon cog lhun grub nyid/ /dbu ru mtshan mo'i smag rum nyer len zla/ /'phel 'grib zad bral bde ba'i cha gang zhing / /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i 'od dkar spro ba nas/ /blo ldan kun da bzhad gtam snyan por bcas/ /daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung dngos lha pa'i don gyi rgyan/ /nyams 'gyur rgyud du drangs pa 'phrin yig gi /rten bzang 'khor lo gnyis ldan su war+ṇa/ /rgya yi lang tsho ngom zhing son pas spro/ /na rgan byis yid 'khrul snang bkrag po ches/ /chos sde che zung 'dun sar nyer 'khrid par/ /gzhan phan rlom pa'i (272na)ngang nas rgyal khab che'i/ /rang gnas khang bur g.yeng ba'i gzeb tu tshud/ /tha snyad mdo rgyud spros pa dbang gzhu la/ /bden chen byis pa'i sbar mo mi gdeng bar/ /phung po 'ja' lus skur grol rdzogs pa che'i/ /bdud rtsis myos pa'i lha de khyod min su/ /ye dag chos sku dmigs med stong chen dbyings/ /lhun grub ma 'gags gdangs shar gar dgu'i nyams/ /rnam rol 'khor 'das phyag rgya ma lus pa/ /zil gnon grub pa'i rnal 'byor khyod mthar phyin/ /drang srong dmod pa'i rtse brgya rab gdengs mod/ /bdud rigs lha min mo'i mngal cig car du/ /lhung ba'i rnam dpyod mig stong ldan pa gang / /chu bzang ri bor gnas zhes lha rnams gleng / /ting 'dzin sngags rgya rdzas kyi 'phrul po che'i/ /sgyu ma'i rta glang med bzhin srog phral ltar/ /chos kun sems nyid gcig pur ngo 'phrod tshe/ /srid zhi'i bde sdug 'phrul snang bag la zha/ /de 'dra bla ma'i drin gyi go yul tsam/ /mkhas khyed snyan gyi bu ram mngar ched las/ khyud thog ma smin rang gi ngang tshul la/ khrel yang da dung ne sdu'i smra bar zad/ /snying dbus rig rtsal nyi zer chu sgron sgor/ /thon par zhi khro'i sku gzugs stims klas kyang / /ras bris snang brnyan gzigs mor g.yengs pa'i dkyus/ /ring por bsod nams tshogs mthar rdzogs min mtshar/ /—584

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pegaser sbyangs zhun mas bkrag mdangs spel ba'i rgyur/ /zho 'khor do dang bskul rten sa le sbram/ /rig byed bzo bo'i gla yon mthun rkyen du/ /mtshams sprin rgya yis lang tshos mngon par 'byung / (272ba)/gaṅgā'i yab gcig gtsug tor rtse mo las/ /chu klung bu mo snyan 'jebs glu len pa/ /tshad med dngos po'i gshis bzhi khyod mgrin nas/ /legs bshad gtam gyi rgyud mangs rtag 'khrol zhig /'phrin yig gzhan gsos dbyangs kyis bos pa'i mgron/ /lha rdzas kha tshar g.yo ba'i gos dkar can/ /dpyid kyi rgyal mo dbu ru'i gser ldan char/ /gom stabs bskyod nas rig 'dzin 'dun sar song / /lcags spre'i lo gong nas bka' shog gnang sbyin gya nom pa dang bcas stsal ba'i zhu lan 'bul bar shar pa chos rje dang bsam grub sgang pa ngag dbang dpal bzang bto ba'i dus phul ba'i zhu yig skye rgu'i bsod nams 'bror lo/ che ring gnam gyi she mong gi stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba gnam sa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i drung du/ dzam bu brik+ṣa'i ljon pas mtshan pa'i gling chen po'i dbus na mngon par mtho zhing brjid pa mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal khab pho brang chen po pi cing gi gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por zhabs zung gi pad+ma mngon par bkod pa lta bu la/ lha'i lha mi'i dbang phyug dpal ldan 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po ga la ba'i phyogs der sdom brtson sde snod gsum pa gang gis lus rab tu btud de dri zhim po'i bdug spos 'thul zhing me tog gtor nas gnam dang sa kun gyi khyon la dbang phyug pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po chen po sku tshe nyi zla dang mnyam zhing rigs brgyud chab 'bangs dbyar gyi chu gter lta bur 'phel ba'i bkra shis dge mtshan gyis dus kun tu khyab par gyur cig ces shis pa brjod pa'i tshig sngon du btang ste zhu ba/ grangs (273na khu shed pa'i bskal pa nas legs byas kyi tshogs rlabs po che tshangs pa'i yul sa las kyang brgal bar nus pa'i phung po bla nas blar 'phyur ba'i rgyu dang 'dzam gling skye rgu'i bsod nams kyi mgon skyabs gling dang dpung gnyen du 'phags chen dam pa'i thugs bskyed kyi smon lam bzang pa'i rkyen la brten nas lhun gyis grub pa'i sku rin po cher brgya phrag nyi ma'i gzi byin 'phrog par nus pa lhang nge lhan ne lham mer gsal/ cha lugs spyod lam skad rigs mi gcig —583—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shepa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi khams dang mthun par rab snyan gsung gi rgyud mangs tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar 'jibs/ rdo rje rin po che phra mos kyang rin po che'i rgyan phal pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa ltar rgyal po'i bu na tshod chung ngus kyang blon po'i tshogs rnams zil gyis gnon na na tshod dar la bab pa'i blo gros tshangs pa rgan po'i ngang tshul lta bur 'dzin pa'i mkhyen pa gtsug lag rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gsang gsum rgyan gyi 'khor lo g.yung drung gi rang bzhin du brtan par bzhugs pa nas gser gyi zhal sgo nas nye bar thon pa'i lung bzang po'i bka' shog gnang sbyin gya nom pa dang tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gi bka' rtags pad+ma ra ga'i gzi 'od 'bar ba nyams med du mchod rten bla ma bstan 'dzin dge slong dang phyag na rdo rje gnyis la gnang ba sug par son pas gser zhal dngos su mthong ba lta bu'i dga' bde drang srong bsam gtan gsum pa'i ngang tshul la 'gran par gyur/ 'dir gnas dge sbyong rgan po'ang 'phel 'grib zad pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'i (273ba po khyu phung sim pa'i tshor ba myong zhing /cher snyigs gdul dka'i 'gro ba 'dul bar thugs rje'i mthu dpung lhag par che ba bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya seng ge'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che sems can kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing du spel bar spro ba dang brtson pa phan tshun 'gran pa'i ngang du gnas/ sems can thams cad la rgyu med par ma 'dris pa'i byams brtse dang ldan pa ni sa chen po la gnas pa'i rgyal sras rnams kyi ngang tshul yin pas 'jam dbyangs rgyal po'i srid pa 'dzin pa gang gis yangs pa'i rgyal khams mtha' dag bde skyid la bkod pa ltar skye rgu ma lus pa rjes su 'dzin pa'i rnam par thar pa las ma 'das pas bdag sogs rnams kyis ched du gsol ba la bltos pa min kyang sa'i dbang phyug chen po'i legs byas kyi mthus 'jig rten kun tu gnod sbyin bang mdzod kha phye ba lta bu'i dpal 'byor rgyas shing nad mtshon gyi bskal pa ming gi lhag mar byas nas tshe yang ring du gnas pa sogs dus kyi bdag po'i che ba phun sum tshogs pa'i ched du gser 'brug sder lngas bteg pa'i khri la bskal brgyar g.yo ba med par brtan par bzhugs ngos/ yab mes gnam gyi lha rim par byon pa'i mdzad bzang bstan 'gro'i phan —586

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('bade spel ba dang 'dir yang gzhung bstan pa gcig tu gyur pa la brten nas sngon bzhin du thugs brtse ba chen pos ma dor ba'i lung bzang po'i bka' gnang chu klung skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun ltar zhu/ zhu yig gi lang tshor lha mig dag pa'i spyan ras 'bab pa'i rten rin po che dkar dmar gyi 'phreng (274na)ba 'jam phrug kha dog sna tshogs tho zur gsal la rtags lor dang bcas drag po zhes pa lcags sprel hor zla brgyad pa'i gral tshes dge bar rang byung 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang dmar po ri nas phul ba shri dza ( / /lcags sbrel bal po'i rgyal pos sdopa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sa spyod pa'i rgyal por bskos pa'i khri 'bul ga mi sna ched du byung pa'i tshan shog gi lam g.yas 'khyil phyogs kun khyab pa'i dung dkar/nub phyogs ni pa la'i nor 'dzin gyi khyon legs byas kyi 'khor lo mngon par 'phags pa nyi ma'i rgyud lha'i lha mi'i dbang phyug /kho khom rgyal po chen po'i bka' tham rten sba ri gcig /stong ja ltang tse gcig /mu zi ltang rtse gcig /bur ltang gcig rnams pho nya ba bho la ka dang la wor gnyis kyis nyams med du son/ /bskal pa mang por bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po yongs su bsags pa las grub pa'i mi'i bdag po'i sku gser gyi ri bo lta bur snyun mi mnga' bar 'bangs kyi dbus su lhun chags shing legs byas kyi mthu yongs su brtas pa las byung ba'i yul khams kun tu nad mtshon mu ge'i chad pa zhi zhing chab 'bangs kyi khor ra khor yug mtha' dag klas par mkho dgu'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs shing tshe yang ring por gnas pa'i dga' ston la spyod bzhin par bzhugs par yid kyi spro ba mchog tu 'phel/ 'di na'ang lha dang bcas pa'i yid can mtha' dag gi 'dren pa gcig pu ba dpal ldan shākya seng ge'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa dang skye rgu'i phan bde spel ba la blo mig gi spyod yul yangs par gnas/ bod dang bod (274ba)chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyis mang pos bkur ba'i khrir siju na'i lo chu stod kyi zla bar rgyal sar gsar du bskos pa mi'i bdag po nyid kyi snyan du dngas pa'i legs skyes spel bar 'di pa gnyis ched du mngags par rjes su yi rangs par gyur/ sngar nas bal bod dkar tsho gcig pa la phan tshun thams cad g.yo ba —587

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyemed pa gzhir bcas shing slad nas kyang phebs tshogs gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar chad pa med pa 'tshal/ rten kha btags bzang gos phyi nang dang bcas ru drar 'bod pa'i lo tha skar gyi nya ba'i tshes dge bar rgyal khab chen po po ta la nas phul/lcags pho spre snye'i lo hor zla bcu pa dang bcu gcig par mjug ring 'od dkar sogs sna tshogs byung bar brten rgyal khams bde dog dang bzlog thabs kyi dri rmed gsal bar bsam yas rgyal chen dpon blon gyi spyan sngar snying thang nor bu btang ba'i 'phrin yig mun cu snang ga sto/ snang srid dregs pa yongs kyi sde dpon du/ /smon lam mthus grub rmu bdud dkar po rje/ /legs ldan gsang bdag gis btul khyung chen dang / /spu gri 'bar grags li byin ha ra kye/ /kun rdzob rdzun pa'i snang ba 'phrul po che/ /don dam ka dag dbyings su ro gcig kyang / /gzung 'dzin gsher gyis yongs bskyed rnam rtog 'jar/ /rmongs pa'i skye bo phal cher mgo bo 'khor/ /ye stong sems nyid chos sku'i rgya mtsho las/ /bzang ngan bar ma'i rlabs phreng nyer 'khrug pa/ /'jig rten grags tshod mi 'gog blang dor rnams/ /ma 'dres bstar pa dpyod ldan rnams kyi lugs/ /ches snyigs 'gro ba'i snying la lha min gdon/ (275na)/btab pas sdig blta'i sa bon dar drag las/ /phyi rol mi shes gzugs brnyan chu zla ltar/ shar tshe som nyi'i yid ngor yur bas ngal/ /lha khyod srid gsum rab mthong dpral ba'i mig /ldan phyir mtshan rtags rgyu dang 'bras bu kun/ /gzigs pas bstan 'gro skye rgu la 'tshe ba'i/ /nyes mun kun sel snang ba cis mi sbar/ /thub rnams spang rtogs mnyam yang gangs can gyi/ lha gcig sngon gyi thugs bskyed kyis 'grub pa/ /pad+ma'i dge bsnyen rdo rje gab pa gter/ khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul khyod g.yar dam dgongs/ /dngos bshams sngags rgyas mang spel mchod pa'i sprin/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor nas dri ba'i tshig /pho nya'i ngag nas gsol lan gsong po'i gtam/ /lung bstan 'gags med rdo rje'i dbyangs sgrogs shig /rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul chos rgyal mes dbon 'bangs/ /sgo gsum bde ba'i tshor ba srid mtha'i bar/ /myong bar las sgrub zhal 'ches g.yel med pa'i/ /lha rgyal tshangs ris yul sa'i rtse mor 'then/ /'jam gnyen phon rdzar g.yo ba'i snyan shal bcas/ /rgya nag spong thang —588

rgya bod hong sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pokhra mo lcags bya'i lo/ /thog mar shar ba yar ngo'i tshes dge bar/ /pe gar chos rgyal chen po'i spyan sngar dge /sdebargyad rje bor las smon dus gcig tu/ /'dzom pas khrag gi sgo nga brdol ba las/ /skye 'gro'i srog gi bdud gcod btsan rgod che/ /drag rtsal stobs ldan gnod sbyin tse dmar ba/ /sprul pa btsan rgod rol (275ba)ba skya bdun rnams/ /gsung mchog rta mgrin dkyil 'khor chen po sa /srog snying blangs nas dbang bskur dam tshig phog /bstan pa'i mel tshe byed pa'i gnyer khar bskos/ /me ri 'bar ba'i gnyan ri dmar nag mdun/ /brag dmar srin po langs 'dra bcu gcig ngos/ /thod phreng rtsal gyis bka' bskos dam bsgrags pa/ /gnod sbyin kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /e ma srid pa'i shel dkar ngos yangs por/ /sna tshogs 'brul rtog tshon brgya'i mdangs gsal ba/ /ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings su mi rnyed kyang / /tshur mthong 'gro blo the tshom dra bar 'jug /ngan spyod rgyu las 'bras smin snyigs dus 'dir/ /gnam sa bar gyi mtshan ltas bzang ngan 'bring / /sems nyid gcig pu'i rnam par 'khrul pa sa /ma shes kun rdzob lam mnar a thang chad/ /ru bzhi zhi rgyal khams la 'tshe nyes brgya'i dri/ /'khrud pa'i dkar phyogs mtho ris chu bo'i chab/ /lung bstan lam gsum 'dren pa'i mngon shes mkhan/ /skal ldan shing rta khyod las dmigs su med/ /zan g.yang gis mtshon gangs can ga rjo la/ /'dzin stong ngur smig gos dkar mchod gnas sde/ /rnam gnyis srung mar pad+ma ka ra zhes/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dngos des ma bskos sam/ /sde brgyad rba klong 'khrug pa'i pho brang cher/ /'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs 'khor mthun rdzas rnams/ /snyim par thogs pa pho nyas dri ba'i tshig /gsol bar rdo rje'i gsung gsang lhug par ston/ /nag po'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' rtags su/ /dar (276na)dkar rten dang bcas pa'i li khi ta'i/ /don bzhin dbang drag zhi ba rgyas byed las/ /thogs pa med bsgrub dge legs deng stsol zhig /lcags pho spre'u'i lo hor zla bcu pa dang bcu gcig par 'jug ring 'od dkar sogs ltas sna tshogs byung bar brten rgyal khams bde dog dang bzlog thabs kyi dri rmed gsol bar tshangs pa dung thod can gyi spyan sngar chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse btang ba'i —589

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)'phrin yig 'phrul sel me long / /ris med 'gro la thub rnams rjes brtse yang / /gangs can skye rgu gcig tu thugs rje'i dpung / /rgyal g.yin yongs kyis 'gran bral pad+ma 'byung / /'dzam gling che ba'i rig sngags 'chang des skyongs/ /gang gi spyan sngar stod smad chos 'khor sogs/ /mchod gnas sdoganyis skyong bar zhal 'tshes pa/ /gnam gyi lha chen tshangs pa dung thod can/ /ma g.yengs snyan gyi dbang po cung zad gtod/ /chos sku ka nas dag pa'i bde chen klong / /bzang ngan bral yang gnyis 'dzin sems kyi ngor/ /dge dang mi dge'i kun rtogs bkrag po ches/ /sgyu ma'i rta glang lta bur 'gro rnams 'byul/ /de phyir thag khra'i sbrul dang smig rgyu ltar/ /sgro btags ca co'i gtam gyi rdzun pa'i 'bras/ /tshur mthong byis blo nyer 'drid cho ga la/ /dngas bkrag 'dod sred bskyed nus dngos po'i gshis/ shes byar srid kun khyod spyan me long du/ /dri med gsal bar 'char bas ma rtogs dang / /log rtog mdud pa 'grol phyir bya ma rta/ /spyan gzigs tshogs kyi 'khor la thogs te mngags/ /snyan 'jibs rna bar mngar ba bu ram ro/(276ba)/kun gyi yid bder gling ba mi chos lugs/ /drang tshig srid sgrub mda' ltar lung ston pa/ /snang srid dregs pa'i spyi srol yin phyir gsungs/ /rtag tu las bzhi sgrub par zhal bzhes pa/ /rdo yi ri mo mig gsum pas mi dbye/ /snyan shal dang bcas dus kyi rgyal po che/ /tshes bcu'i mchod par spel ba dge legs 'phel/ /lcags po spre'u'i lo hor zla bcu pa dang bcu gcig par mjug ring 'od dkar sogs ltas sna tshogs 'byung bar brten rgyal khams bde dog dang bzlog thabs kyi dri rmed gsol bar tshong 'dus bya khrid mig gcig pa'i spyan sngar skyid thang nor bu btang ba'i 'phrin yig chu nang zla gzugs// srid pa gsum na mthu stobs la/ /'gran bral o rgyan rdo rje 'chang / /mtsho skyes badz+ra'i zhi sko ra/ /lkog gyur mngon sum gzigs de kye/ khar phyogs sku yi rgyal po che/ /mthu ldan mon bu pu tra yi/ /blon po bya khrid mig gcig par/ /mthun rdzas tshogs mchod 'bul ba'i don/ /gnam la phod dkar 'od dkar 'char / /sa la than ltas sna tshogs pa/ /ka dag dbyings su mi rnyed kyang / /rmongs pa'i mi rnams so me nyir 'god/ /de phyir su la'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /'byung 'gyur mi shes mtshan ma'i 'bras/ /—590

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('bazlog byed lha mig gis gzigs nas//gser yig pa 'dir lung bstan gsol//dkar min las kyis lnga brgya'i 'gro/zug rngus mnar ba mi sel na//bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen du//zhal gyisabazhes de ming du zad//dpag dka'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul can//bshan pa srog gi bdag po yis//dgra bgegs bdud
