dpung tshar chod la/277na/dkar po'i dar chen srid rtser phyor/kha tshar ma nyamasa'achi med kyi//reg bya'i snyan shal dang bcas te//'phrin yig snying po don gsal ba//dregs pa'i sde dpon 'dun sar spel//lcags pho spre'u'i lo hor zla bcu pa dang bcu gcig par mjug ring 'od dkar sogs ltas sna tshogs byung bar brten rgyal khamasabade dog dang bzlog thabs dri ṣ+ka gsol bar thang 'a bshan pa lag dmar gyi spyan sngar skyid thang nor bu bto ba'i skrun yig don sa rabs/dregs pa rgyal chen sku lnga'i go//lho phyogs yon to shing bya can//blon po bya rgod thang nag ces//bshan pa lag dmar deng 'dir dgongs//za hor sa skyong rig sngags 'chang pha mesabargyud pa'i srung ma khyod/ /dgyes zhal zla ba ltar dngom zhing / /lha snyan dbang po deng 'dir gtod/ /gnam rtags 'od dkar nor 'dzin gzhin//mi sdug mtshan ltas ngan pa'i 'bras//kun rdzob 'khrul ngor shar ba yi//'jig rten grags tshod gang gis 'gog/bstan dang de 'dzin mdo sngags ste//sa spyod rje 'bangs tsho gis rnams la//nyer 'tshe'i smag rum sangs nus pa'i//lung bstan nyi 'od deng 'dir spros//mthu stobs rdo rje rtse brgya pas//gdon rigs lha min mo yi mngal//lhung dang lhan cig bde skyid mig/stong phrag bgrad nas blta bar byos//spyan gzigs tsho gos kyi mchod pa rnams/khung ngu ting 'dzin sngags rgya yis//mang por spel nas 'bul byed na//las bzhi lus pa med par sgrubs//don gyi snying po kun tshang ba'i//277ba po thun yig me tog man+da ra//thod bcings pho nya me na ka/bkra shis lha rdzas thogs te song //o rod bo shog thu rgyal pos mgo dkar gyi sde 'bum phrag bco lnga tsam 'di gar sbyor 'jags byung skabs rdo rje brag nas rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog gis legs mdzad pa'i gsung lan snga 'gyur ༷stan pa'i nyin byed//ā bye b.rā gon ras twa'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)bo to 〉 te na ba rta khyu ra ga ga na sa kaḥ ba 1 khu ni rma su ma yu spu mā lha klu lo khyu ra sargya stu dzi 5 lha ra khru twa/ gzod (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa 'i ༷ t+ta las dbang po'i rgyud/〉pa nyid nas 'gro la rjes brtse'i thugs/ /dang por bskyed de ding bar nam mkha'i mtha'/ /gzhal bar sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul zad mi shes/ /rigs 'dzin kun gyi gtsug rgyan rin po cher/ /rtog ge tha snyad sbyangs la bltos min par/ /dhū ༷'i mdud rgya grol bas 'khor 'das chos/ /'bad med klong brdol snyan 'jebs chab shog rten/ /son tshe 'phang 'gro'i sgra la skyengs pa byin/ /nyes dris gzhan yang ma gos sku gsung thugs/ /dpal chen phur bu'i lha (278na)sngags ye shes kyis/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs bcom pa'i sgra bo che/ /tshangs ris yul sar yongs sgrogs gtam de snyan/ /bgrang bya'i khur gyis lci ba'i rgan po bdag /thos bsam sgom pa na phra byis pa'i yid/ /chos brgyad 'ja' la sbar 'dzin blo brid kyis/ /dal rten chu bo'i sum cha stong par brgal/ /mi bsrun dregs pa'i kla klo gnyis 'thung klad/ /'phrog byed bsod nams kyis 'gems bo shog thu'i/ /'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ro'i dbyangs/ /byang phyogs gangs ri'i rtse mor gcig tu bsgrags/ /g.yul ngor mtshon cha gdengs pa'i mod nyid la/ /stod hor sa spyod pus btsug gdong smad nas/ /dpung bcas 'dud tshe rtsod dus 'khor los sgyur/ /mi 'byung bden gtam da gdod rlung la bskur/ /skye mang ser sna'i mdud grol gtong phod kyis/ /phyed gnyis sa ya'i mnga' 'bangs sbyin pa'i sgo/ /rab 'byed pho nya rin chen du ma yi/ /lag rtags thogs 'byor mi srid srid 'phrul bu/ /kun rdzob dbu mar rtogs rnams 'khor ba yi/ /phun tshogs e raṇ+ḍa yi snying po ltar/ /gzigs kyang kṛ kri'i rmi lam gyis zin pa'i/ /chos tshugs can rnams 'gram chu ldang la 'brel/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa ye stong snang ba 'di'i/ /sems nyid gcig pu'i rnam 'phrul ka dag mtha'/ /kun rdzob legs skyes tshan grangs (278bdabang po'i gzhu/ /ma 'gags rang gdangs shar ba de med byung / /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs sras sna nam pa/ /gos dkar lcang lo'i phreng 'dzin rig sngags 'chang yang srid mang brgyad mthar ding ngur smig gos/ /mnabs pa'i 'khor lo'i mgon khyod byon tam ci/ /snga —592

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('a'agyur bka' gter bstan pa chu bo bzhi/ /phyogs brgyar legs 'bab 'byung khungs rigs 'dzin rje/ /ma dros mtsho chen mchog gi sprul sku'i gar/ /'og min zhing gi gtso ltar rtag bzhugs gsol/ /rdo rje rat+na'i mtshan 'dzin gling pa sogs/ /ngo mtshar zab gter dbang lung 'khrid bka'i rgyun/ /brgyar gshags rta rnga ltar phra srog 'thud par/ /zhal 'ches gsung mchid nyi zla'i 'gros bzhin zhu/ /lha rdzas chu shel dbang po nya gang bar/ /rtags kyi ri dwags mtshan ma rab bkra ba/ /pho nya dri bzhen gom stabs go la'i ngos/ /bsgyur te pad+ma'i gdung tshab phyag tu phul/ /lcags spre hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin dpal ldan tshangs pa dung thod can la spyi sgos kyi blang dor lung bstan zhu bar chang khyim ngag dbang mkhyen brtse btang dus gsol ba'i 'phrin yig ma 'dres gsal ston ngo mtshar bkod pa/ a ho dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus pa'i/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa gcig bsdus mtsho skyes rjes/ /gtsug na rdo rje'i ri mo nyer bkod pa/ /dpal ldan tshangs pa chen po deng dgongs kye/ /chos (279na thun ye nas stong chen dag pa'i dbyings/ /kun rdzob 'brul pa'i snang ba dmigs med kyang / /chu nang zla gzugs tshur mthong byis blo can/ /thag khrar sbrul gyi dngangs skrag myong ba bzhin/ /rmi lam yul shar sna tshogs bde sdug dang / /sgyu ma'i seng ge'i mche ba gtsigs pa ltar/ /kun rtog ri mor bris pa ca co'i sgra/ /dal med rna ba'i bu gar tsher ma'i grogs/ /bdag gzhan ma nyams rang la gces 'dzin blo/ /brgya phrag 'ching ba dam pos bcings pa'i mthus/ /ngan 'bras thog tu 'bab bam mi 'bab ces/ /'khyog po'i yid kyi gnya' shing phrag par lci/ /de phyir lkog gyur rtogs pa'i mngon shes dang / /bral bas sgrib med gsal ba'i spyan yangs pa/ /dung thod lha yi sde dpon khyod nyid la/ /gsang tshig 'dri ba'i pho nya 'di bzhin mngags/ /spyan gzigs tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'dis mtshon te/ /yid sprul nam mkha' mdzod kyi mchod pa'i sprin/ /dregs pa'i dbang phyug chen po'i 'dun sa sa /spel na dgyes pa'i lha rgyal lan gsum then/ /chu shel dbang po rgyu skar mgos nya ba'i/ /yar ngo'i lha chos dge ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /gnam bskos rgyal po'i pho brang chen po nas/ /spel ba phyogs dus kun tu shis gyur cig /—593

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags bya lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag /lcags bya lo snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyin byed dbang chen rnam sprul thugs sras sprul sku'i 'phrin lan chos kun zad pa'i (279ba)rang gdangs/ u gi ta / sdu ga ṇa bi na : tā bhi tso rwa da tā rna lha shā shā khya mā ma: haḥpū rba tswa slu sa kho 〉 da mu sdi ga to ba tsa la ba ཿ tsa rta ma na : ha sa/ gzod (sdeb sbyor mnya pa'i prit+ta las metog phreng yi/)ma nyid nas tshogs gnyis chu gter las/ /mngon par bskrun pa'i mi shugs sgyu 'phrul gar/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i mkhar 'phags sngon med nyi'i/ /gsung 'phrin rten 'od yid kyi chu skyes ba 'ad/ /bdud sdes glags lta'i na bun mi 'thul ba/ /gzugs sku gaṅgā'i yab cig rnam dkar las/ /tshad med mkha' la bsnyeg par dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal kun thugs rje'i zla bas byugs pa bzhin/ /mtsho skyes brag gi nye 'dabs 'brog dgon par/ /gcig pur rigs 'dzin bla ma rang sems su/ /ngo 'phrod ka dag 'dus ma byas pa'i klong / /chos sku'i yo lang rgyun chad med de mtshar/ /ltar snang 'du zhabrug zug jus ma gtses par/ /sgo gsum bde ba chen po ro bde'i bas/ /myong (280na)ba gang gis mdzad par mchog gsum rnams/ /dgyes pa'i spyan gyis rtag tu btsa' las ci ris med grub mtha'i kha 'dzin che phra ding / /tshe 'di'i bya bzhag 'khol por 'phyan mthong tshe/ /chos brgyad 'ching ba grol khyod rnam par thar/ /lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug gnyis pa bzhin/ /snga 'gyur ring lugs 'dzin la snying stobs khur/ /phrag par blangs rlom phal cher sgyu ma'i rta/ /blun po'i mig sngar brgyug pa'i mdzes chos kyi/ /chu dong phub mas g.yogs la 'gro mang 'khrid/ /tshul 'chos mchog 'dzin la la sgam por bsnyems/ /chags lam gtsor 'don 'ga' zhig khyim spyod dngos/ /mtha' gnyis lhungs las pad 'byung dgongs ba ched kyi/ /dbu mar gnas pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ /de phyir —594

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (dzadamachog sprul mnga' ris paṇa chen thugs//gting nas khrel ba'i gsong po'i 'ur rdo yis//skye bar brlom dang sngags brgyud khengs ldan gyi//dbu zhabs la bsnun bzhin ras rdza ltar gnag/de tsam dngos po'i gnas tshodi thol skyes su/shar mod don dam 'khor 'das ma lus pa//rang rig kun tu bzang po'i ngo bo sa/rtogs pa'i dag snang sbyong las gzhan du ci//'di na lcags khams 'dab chags gnam lo'i nang //sgyu lus khang rul ma gas ches sra yang //lha sngags ye shes rnal 'byor rtag 'grub par//nges pas gang thugs bde ba'i ngal gsor mdzod//dbang chen sprul pa'i gar 280bsogasakhyod nyid kyi//rang bzhin brjod pa'i yon to kho na las//phul byung rab btags sogs kyi dogasamed phyir//bcos bsgyur med pa'i zhal 'don mdzad par rigs//chos dbang sangs gling la sogs gter chos su//gsung 'di rnyed pa'i yid ches ma mthong yang //pad gling gsum pas mdzad las zur khyad can//ma thon phyir na 'di don kho nar nges//don gnyis bgrang bya'i 'phreng gi rgya mtsho las//sgrol byed tshe mtha' yas pa'i thabs kyi gzings//dam pa'i ded dpon khyod kyis 'dren pa'i dus//chu khyi'i ston 'jug nye len 'tsham par go/me long rdo rje mkha' lding rjes mi la du//snyoms las bdag 'dra'i bung bas mi bgrod kyang //rtsa gsum thugs rje'i dri bzhen la brten nas//'chi med grong du 'jug par gcig tu smon//slad mar sku yi 'tsho skyong pha lam gyi/khams las legs grub rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog/mda' lngas g.yo bar ma nus bdud bzhi las//rnam par rgyal ba'i brtson pa sgrubs shig gu//go la'i khyim du chad med nyi zla'i 'gros//ji bzhin gcam bu bral ba'i mol mchid chu//rig pa 'dzin khyod zhal sgo tshangs pa yi//ral pa'i klung nas nam yang tshad med 'tshal//ya rabs skyes su 'os pa btung ba'i rtse//bdud rtsi lo ma'i bam por mtshams sprin rgyas//btab ste sngon byon dam pa'i rjes zhugs pa//gtan mdun legs bsgrub dben pa'i gnas der song //281na skog bya hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang du bya rigs gdung gis mngon par mtho ba sa skyong rdo rje rnam rgyal gyis snyan tshig lam na drang pa'i gsung lon byung ba'i lan gas gsol/ snya/uḥste bo mya snyim ṇi bi mā la tol

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyesmyi guṇa kā ma ma ha ba r+ṣa kaḥ me PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBPROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROByu ji kaḥ mtho (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta las dbang po'i rgyud/)btsun gdung gi nor bu dri med las/ /phun tshogs yon tan 'dod dgu'i char chen po/ /blo gros 'dzin mar shong ba ya rabs kyi/ /tshul ldan lha sras gzhen nu'i 'phrin rten son/ /yan lag bcu gnyis srid pa'i rgya mtsho cher/ /sku 'tsho'i rdzings 'jig rgyud mangs dang po sa /rab gdungs brag ca mthar byas chos nor 'dod/ /thar pa'i rin chen gling bgrod rna ba'i gsos/ /sdom brtson sde snod gsum par (281bakhis 'tshe'i zla/ /thos bsam sgom cha ma rdzogs chos brgyad kyi/ /ri bong gzugs la mtshar 'dzin lnga pa'i mgron/ /ma gnyer sgyu mar zhen rlom 'di na bde/ /thos brtson drod kyis rnam dpyod sa zla'i sgong / /smin pas lnga rig thig le mchag ma la/ /chags pas gdong bzhi sgrub pa tshangs pa'i bu/ /gnyis pa lho rgyud kun gzod sto na mdzes/ /gna' bo'i sa spyod gzugs brnyan gangs can gyi/ /lha min kun snang mtshor gsal legs nyes kyi/ /rnam 'gyur 'phrul la blo ldan phur bu yang / /dang bas blta phyir khyod drung yang yang 'khor/ /srid gsum snod bcud yid kyi srang bcug nas/ /'degs pa'i nga rgyal 'gro skyabs gser can lto/ /mkhas blun dbye ba'i sder mos 'dral nus pa/ /sa 'di'i sna tshogs gzugs can khyod min su/ khyung nag rigs kyi thig le dga' byed lha/ shes rab rgyud las 'phos pa'i nyag phran gyis/ /rmongs chen laṅka'i mgrin pa gcod pa dang / /mkhas grags sī tar brtse ba'i cho gas brel/ /legs ldan rigs 'dzin ta'i 'i bu dang gnyen/ /sbrel ba khyab 'jug sgyu thabs rnam bkra yang / /'dab chags phal pa'i bzhen pa tsam gyi ched/ /ngo srung thag gu'i ska rags des kyang dman/ /byu ru'i zhags ring brkyang nas blang dor rnams/ /zhag dang nyi mar ma 'phul brtson pa'i rlung / khri1gas drag bskyod pas lugs gnyis go la'i khyim/ /rang 'gros nyi zla'i mched la 'gran par rigs/ /lugs zung gdugs dkar yu ba (282na tshe pab mes kyis/ /gtad nas rdul dang mun pas bsgrigs pa'i khrir/ /mi yi bdag por bskur tshe gong ma'i srol/ /legs 'dzin khur chen blo gros phrag par long / /byar gnyal dbang phyogs ri bo'i rtse mo nas/ /tshes 596

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('gasum zla med zla khyod shar ba'i mod/ /lho rgyud skye rgu'i bde skyid sa mos tshal/ /bzhad pas snyan grags ge sar dri bsung 'thul/ /'jig rten khyim gyi bdag po sdig spyod du/ /smra yang lhag bsam chu 'dzin stug po nas/ /dge ba'i 'brug sgra bsgrags tshe gtan mdun gyi/ /rma bya'i mngal khur sbrum las gzhan du ci/ /sems gnas 'thug por 'byams pa'i sgom chen pa/ /dgag sgrub tshig skam la chen ston chen dang / /tha snyad rdzun gyi 'brul 'khor bskor des kyang / /nges legs grong du bgrod la cung ma nye/ /gzung 'dzin mtshan mo'i smag rum pha rol na/ /sa lam skya rengs mas drangs dge sems nyis/ /sgrib bral snang ba'i 'od brgya spros min par/ /ngal brgya'i dka' thub 'byul pa'i 'khor lor zad/ /rigs kyi yi dam bsnyen dang srung ma mchod/ /tshe dang shes rab spel ba'i 'dod lha bsgrub/ /mtho la phu dud dma' ba'i skyong bran sogs/ /mdzangs pa'i ngang tshul g.yar dam gces par 'tshal/ /gcam bu'i na bun 'khor min gsong po'i 'phrin/ /nyams 'gyur kha ba'i rdul brtsegs las babs pa'i/ /snyan tshig lhung lhung sgrar bcas 'bab pa'i klung / /mi bskyud lam gsum ngag tu rgyu bar rigs/ /(282ba)bza' dang chang du gzhal min yid can la/ /gcig tu rab dkar lhag bsam dag pa'i mdog /'di zhes mngon sum mtshon byed thags rings su/ /nyer bskrun kha tshar ma nyams pas kyang ngo / /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag /chu khyi lo gong nas dpon po dge slong dang a chi thu dge slong gnyis gser yig par mngags te rten dpangs mtho ba bcasabaka' sheg byung ba'i lan 'bul bar tor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu bdun la thang chen mkhan po dung dkar sku skye tshangs dbyangs ga sgra dang ngag dbang rin chen bto ba'i dus phul ba'i zhu yig dge legs 'a byed dngom brgya/ gnam sa'i dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i drung du/ yid dang ba'i sgo nas me tog gtor te gsol ba/ tshe ring —597

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyeganam gyi she mong gi lung btsan pos gnam dang sa'i dkyil 'khor bar mtshams med par dbang phyug pa'i rgyal srid bdun ldan gyis che bas mtho ba/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i lha mi'i bdag po deng sang gi dus na'ang seng ges bteg pa'i gser gyi khri chen por mi 'jigs pa stobs kyi dpung pa las 'khrungs pa'i ngo mtshar mtshan bzang dang ldan pa'i thugs gsung sku'i bkod pa srid pa gsum na mtshungs pa med pa mngon par mtho ba gser gyi lhun po ltar shin tu brjid cing zhabs zung mi shigs rdo rje'i rang bzhin brtan po'i rtsa ba 'dzam gling skye 'gro mtha' dag gi spyi bor bkod de khrims gnyis nyin mo'i dbang phyug gi snang bas yid can yongs kyi srog gi ka ba brtan po nye bar 'dzin pa nas bka'i gser 'khor nam mkhar 'phags pa tsam na 'dod dgu phun sum tshogs par sbyor ba'i bka' shog gnang rten (283na〉skyed dkris gser byugs pa'i dngul mdong / gser byugs pa'i bya ma bum/ dngul phor gnyis/ kha btags che ba lnga/ chung ba bzhi bcu/ gos yug nyi shu dang bcasami sna dbon po dge slong dang a chi thu dge slong gnyis la stsal ba bde skyid kyi lo nyer gcig pa'i sa gas nya pa'i gral tshes la phebs pa dang lhan cig tu yid kyi rgyad pa ma lus pa zhi ste spro ba 'phel 'di na'ang gang gi thugs rjer brten 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya seng ge'i ring lugs pa dge slong sde snod gsum pa'ang sgo gsum g.yar khams bde zhing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dri ma med pa la ri mor bgyis te bla nas blar 'degs pa'i thabs rtsol la lhag bsam gyi sgo 'phar phye ste nyi ma nub phyogs kyi 'gro ba rnams kyang phan bde'i lam bzang la bkri ba'i blo gros kyi 'jug pa mi dman zhing dog char brten rang gzhan gyi don chen bsgrub pa'i ched du lha sngags ye shes kyi nyams len gtsor bton gyi bcad rgya'i skabs su gnas/ gang cir gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bslab ston snying gi ze'u 'brur blug ste slar yang sku'i 'tsham 'dri gser zhal 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi 'thung bar thang chen mkhan po dung dkar sku skye dang ngag dbang rin chen sbrel po rdzong bda' zhus pa sngar las bzang po bzhin rnam pa thams cad du rgyal thabs kyi mdzad 'phrin tshad ma mchis pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus —598—

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (peltar bsod nams stobs kyi mtshan thos pa tsam gyis kyang rgol ga mtha' dag zil gyis gnon pa dang sku (283ba thi'i nga bde ldan zhing gi mgon po bzhin brtan par bzhugs pa la mchog gsum dpang por byas nas gsol ba 'debs pa yin/ slad nas kyang thugs brtse bas dgongs te bka' mchid kyi 'khor lo chad med nyi zla'i 'gros ltar zhu/ zhes zhu ba'i yi ge spyan ras kyi bung ba 'bab stegs su rin po che sngo dmar ser gsum gyi shal ba re/ 'jam phrug sngo thig bugs nyi shu rtsa lnga/dkar po brgya drug /rgya thig bcu/ dkar thig bgragasum/ ser thig bdun/ ljang thig bgragacig /sngo rkyang bco brgyad/ dmar po dgu /rgya tshos bcu drug /ljang gu bcu drug dang bcas rnga chen gyi lo hor zla ba drug pa chu stod kyis nya ba'i dmar cha'i tshes bzang por rang byung 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang dmar po ri nas phul/ /chu khyi lo rdo rje brag na rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las kyi chab shog gi 'phrin lan gcig la du ma'i rnam ༅ra/sna nam sgyu dra'i lang tsho tshes dar ba/ /lha sngags ye shes rol pa'i gzi byin gyis/ /mi bsrun smag dras yongs bcil gsang gsum mgon/ khyab bdag he ru gar te khyod gcig bsngags/ /snyan tshig tsam gyi gsong gtam zla dkyil la/ /'gran pa'i brtse gdung drag pos nyer bskul te/ /dngosamadza'i brtse dga' mgron du legs bsu ba'i/ /tshul la yi rang spro ba lhag par 'phel/ /'di na lasanyon gyis bskyed 'dod zhen la/ /rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las yin no zhes/ /rlabs chen blo brid rgyu stobs 'phrul po ches/ /dal rten stong zad (284na gtong bar rigs pa bzhin/ /'on te skye mang dge mthus bshes gnyen 'ga'i/ /dgongs zin 'chad rtsod rtsom par bag chags tsam/ /sad la re la tsho snang tshul kho na nyid/ /bzung bar ci 'dir sdod las gas skabs bral/ /dung dung wo mas mi 'bral rtag bzhugs te/ /'jigs 'jigs log 'dren sdodapung rab tu bcom/ /mang mang mchog thun dngos grub legs phab pas/ /yang yang bsams don stsol mdzad srung ma che/ /phyi rol dregs tshogs bran bskul srin po'i gzugs/ /nang du rtsa khams yongs dag he ru gaḥ /gsang ba rang sems—599

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)nges rnyed gsal stong mgon/ /'phral du 'grogs dang mthar thug blo bag bro/ /ma yin gnas skabs zol la brten dgos pa'i/ /srung ma'i g.yar dam dang du len mchis pa/ /dge sbyor mi nus nyin gcig lo bas kyang / /ring por brtsi ba'i ngang tshul su 'dod soms/ /gtan gyi bde ba lta shog 'di snang gi /ched du brtson pas 'dis mtshon gter lung nas/ /'phreng sogs bshad par thams cad 'dod dungs kyis/ /yal 'dor mi nus byis pa'i blo gros tsam/ /gang shar sems kyi rol shar rnal 'byor par/ /blang dor bzang ngan bral bas 'tsho na yang / /rnam dkar dger nges de steng ma khel ba'i/ /yo lang rmi lam yul gyi 'char sgo yin/ /'on kyang rnyed dka' dal 'byor rin chen lus/ /ring por gnas tshe rang gzhan don gyi (284ba)ched/ /legs mod tshad ma bzhi ldan bka' drin gyis/ l+le yang mkha' spyod zhing bgrod su zhig 'tsher/ /sgro btags nyen kha'i phreng ba nyer bsgrigs dbyangs/ /ches cher blangs nas bcad rgya'i ming snyan po/ /dge snying khrod du tsu ta'i rkang gnyis pa/ /song dogs bsnyen sgrub rnam g.yeng so sor spel/ /don dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro ba por/ /legs byon mchog gi sprul pa'i zlos gar la/ /bstan srung dbang po'i ru nga phrag dog pas/ /'bren cing do zlar gyur pa mi srid kyang / /kun rdzob bla dpon 'gran slar rab mang dang / /sngon mtho rgya yi khongs su ma tshud bcas/ /yongs kyi yo ga'i gtam la rab 'jigs shing / /nges par 'da' dka'i tshig las 'gal gyi dogs/ /na tshod rgan po'i sdong po bskyed bsrings pas/ /ma snyigs lo 'dab rgyas pa'i grib ma sa /nyer zhugs tsha reg rab bsal dga' spro'i dpal/ /myur du spyod pa'i smon lam yang dag zhu/ /—600

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la tshon yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / ('arab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu phag lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag/bsam yas nas gnod tshun r+pā pos dkar po ba'i don skor ched du chu phag zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu drug la byung ba'i phrin lan drang pho bden rdzo/zhi dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i/khyab bdag khams gsum zil gnon srid pa gsum//dbang sdud yid bzhi nor ltar 'dod don rnams//stsol mdzad sangs rgyas kun dngosapad+ma 'byung //bka' nyan dregs pa'i sdod pon sum cu yi//gtso bo gnod sbyin tshe'u dmar po'i gtsug/rdo rje rab bkod lce la bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /285na ) blud pa'i dam tshig nyer dran gsung phrin ༅ / /sangs rgyas sras bcas gsang gsum nyin byed gzi//brgya phrag 'bum 'khyil pad dkar 'chang ba'i mgon//gling dgu'i 'gro ba'i rmongs mun mthar byed par//srong btsan sgam pos bstan pa'i gzhi ma btsugs//'jam dpal rnam 'phrul khri srong lde'u btsan gyis//ngo mtshar bgrang yas bkod pa chesazab pas//zan g.yang gis mtshon gtsug lag dkor char bcas//bsrung na zhal 'tshes mdzad par yi rang gyur//de phyir pad+ma ka ra'i rjes 'jug gis//rten dang brten par bcas pa'i khur 'dzin pa//dus babs gzhan ngor khur len byed spro na//hal rtse sogs su dam bsgrags ma bsnyel lam//snga 'gyur bstan 'dzin nus ldan kun grags kyis//phyi nang bar gyi gso thabs sri zhu'i tshogs//rgya chen srol btod legs sor lha khang rnams//bdag zung ming tsam lus pa skyon med snyam//mol mod 'pho yang rnying bstan sgor zhugs las//sa dge gar 'brug gzhan mar gnyer sprod pa//sa dbang rgyal po'i mnga' thang rgyas bsnyad de//'jig rten dregs byed kun kyang 'phyang nyug brel//gangs can spyi dang khyad par snga 'gyur gyi//bstan 'phel lus can bde bar mtha' 'dul dang //yang 'dul ru gnon lasogs gnas chen rnams//bkur sti phu dud bshad par rab brtson pa'i//gu ru'i rjes zhugs gnyer

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheka pho shar (285ba)kyang / /da lta'i dkar po'i ming 'dzin 'di nyid la/ /gung med brten thabs sa zhing rkyen theg pa/ /ci 'gab gleng bar spro bas bya ma rta/ /gnam lo'i rang zhal ma dngom tshun rdzong ba/ /o rgyan dam tshig gnyan sogs nyer dgongs te/ /pha rgyu'i gzugs can rjes 'brangs mi 'tshal bar rdo rje'i gsung phrin blang dor gsal bar ston/ /de skad gsol rten dbang gzhu'i mdangs tshang ba'i lha dar gser skyems zho yi 'khor lor bcas/ khrums zlar mar ngo'i dus tshes bzang po la/ khru 'dzin spo nas sdom brtson rgan pos phul/ /khrag skug gi lo tor zla ba gnyis pa'i lha tshes la gnod sbyin tse'u dmar por tshogs 'khor mchod rdzas dang bcas deng rang gi rkang lag gi nad ro 'phar ba dang bod khams bde thabs kyi lung bstan zhu bar dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa btang pa'i tshe gsol phrin snyan tshig tshangs pa'i nga ro/ rgyal kun gsang gsum mi zad gcig bsdus nas/ /mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan thod 'phreng rtsal/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas khams gsum dbang sdud cing / /srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /mi bsrun gshed du drag shul khro gtum can/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug gnod sbyin rgyal po che/ /dmar zlum ye shes spyan gyis nye bar gzigs/ /chos 'khor gtsug lag srid na yod do cog /khyod la gnyer gtad dam bcas ma bsnyel bar/ /stong gsum skad cig myul te blang dor gyi/ /lung (286na tha stan gsal por ston cig srung ma'i gtso/ /stod smad bar gyi dge dang mi dge'i tshogs/ khyad par 'gro ba'i las nye zhe des bskyed pa'i/ /'thab rtsod kyis mtshon nyer zhi skye rgu rnams/ /phan bder sbyor pa'i thabs mchog gsal por ston/ /gtor ma'i ri bo sman rag rgya mtshor bskyil/ /dar zab mchod sprin sngags rgyas rgya cher spel/ /dgyes skongs rgyal dbang pad+ma ka ra yi/ /dam tshig gnyan las ma 'da' srung skyobs mdzod/ /chu phag hor zla gnyis pa'i lha tshes la shar phyogs sku'i rgyal po'i blon po bya khrid mig gcig par tshogs 'khor spyan gzigs dang bcas nged rang gi rkang lag gi nad ro 'phar ba'i skab spyi sgos kyi lung bstan zhu bar lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po btang ba'i gsol phrin zla ba'i cas/ rigs rnams yongs kyi bdag po kun tu bzang / /paṇa chen tshul bzung mtsho skyes rdo rje —602

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (seche'i//bka' rtags ri mo'i gzugs brnyan spyi bo'i gtsug/me long ltar shar rjen mthong dgra lha kye//bsten bsgrubs mchod pa'i srung ma mthu rtsal can//sku yi blon chen 'khor bcas spyan lam du//dngos grub mchod pas thugs dam skong byed rdzas//mi zad nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar phye//'bul bsathub bstan de 'dzin bcas pa'i sde//spel zhing gangs can ljongs kyi skal ngan zhi//rnal 'byor bdag gis ji ltar bcol ba'i las//ma lus thogs pa med par sgrub par mdzod//lha khyod dpral ba'i dbyings na nyer shar ba'i//dri med ye shes spyan gyis srid zhi yi//lkog gyur cho me rnams gzigs nas pho nya la//gsang tshig snyan pos blang dor gsal por ston//slad mar ci 286bdagos don chen bsgrub pa'i ched/zhes byar srid kun zla gzugs 'bum phrag kyang //dog bral shin tu yangs pas dri rmed lan//som nyi'i mun tshogs mtha' dag legs par sol/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing byi lor bris pa'i chab shog 'phrin yig khag/shing byi gnam gyi 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal pos blo bzang dge slong dang cha dkar bla ma'i dbon po dge slong gnyis la bka' shog gnang sbyin dang bcas rdzong bda' gnang ba'i lan 'bul bar spom mda' mkhan ོ blo gros rin chen dang bka' bas mid bzhin mngag skabs phul ba'i zhu yig phun tsho gis snyan grag g.yas 'khyil/287na ) dzi6bo tsā khya niḥbitsārari pa/car pra dza brtse:rma hā/tsakre bo 'ashā la dha ri tri ba bral brtin rin+d+raglur rā sgo sprul hri//bgrang sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i mit+ta yi ge bstoganyis pa skye 'gro la rnam grangs bzhi stong so drug bod pa las/sto dang sus brgya rgya tswa mi pa dbang yi rgyud ces bya ba/yas rgyal kun rnam dpyod waṇi ga 'dus gter//zur phud lnga ldan skye rgu'i dpung gnyen cher//stobs 'khor tshul gyis 'dzin ma'i khyon yangs por//dbang sgyur mi rje lha rgyal dam pa'i drung //stobs bcu'i rtsal mnga' bu ram shing pa yi//ring lugs nyer bzung 'gro la lhag pa'i sems//ches dkar bgyid /༷ su nyi ka phreng sgra//snyan gyi dbang por 'dren pa'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2kyesngon 'gro'i sgor/ /phun sum tsho gos pa'i bkra shis me tog char/ /rab 'thor tsan dan sdong po'i dri dngar po/ /'thul bzhin dang ba'i yid kyis rtse gcig tu/ /yongs bsgrims spobs mtho bskyed de 'di ltar gsol/ /tshogs gnyis chu gter che las nyer thon pa'i/ /phul byung bdud rtsi'i bcud 'khyil mtshan bzang sku/ /bde skyid 'chi med dpal ster gtam snyan po/ /rna rgyan tshangs dbyangs do zlar byed pa dang / /lhan cig gnam gyi she mong bka' rtags che/ /sder lnga'i gser 'brug skad gsang sgrog lta bus/ /legs bteg dngos po'i gnang skyes gya nom bcas/ /son tshe khyod zhal mthong 'dra'i dga' spro 'phel/ /dpag g.yas bsod nams zim char rgyas brlan pa'i/ /gsang gsum mi zad yongs 'du ri ljon 'bras sa/ /ci 'dod re skong yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /lus can rnam dkar mtha' klas zong gis bsgrubs/ /med byung mdzad phrin tsha zer 'od po che/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde 'bum phrag pad+ma'i tshal/ /yongs ba 'ad rgol ngan smag rum gzhil ba'i slad/ /byed por gnam gyi mthongs nas lha khyed bskos/ /log par 'khu ba'i lha min sgra gcan ske/ /brtul phod dam bca' rnam bzhi'i 'khor lo yis/ /bcad pas mes po ngal khur rab lci ba/ /btang ste zag mal gnyid du g.yur las ci/ /gting mtha' mi mngon thugs kyi rgya mtsho cher/ /brtan g.yo'i(287bathags tshogs yol ba dang bral rlabs/ /srid rtse'i bar 'phyur sdo bzhi'i yid bzhin nor/ /bar mtshams med gang mi len su zhig bston/ /lhar bcas yid can kun gyi cod pan du/ /zhabs sen bkod la byis rnams mtshar 'dzin kyang / /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus gsung gcig gis/ /bde ldan zhing gi mgon por yang dag bsngags/ /bsod nams nya phyis rgya che khyon yangs las/ /tshad med 'bab pa'i legs byas mu tig char/ /mi 'dzad dbang thang dar drag rdzogs ldan dus/ /sngon byung gtam tsam deng sang ches cher med/ grub mtha'i bzhed gzhung phyi nang rigs lam nas/ /nyer drangs smra ngan mang yang lus can rnams/ /gnas skabs mngone mtho mthar thug thar pa dang / /kun mkhyen go 'phang la sbyor shākya'i bstan/ /de yi srol 'byed klu sgrub thogs med kyis/ /bkral ba'i zab rgyas chos tshul chu klung gter/ /rnam dpyod hub gcig 'dren pa'i drang srong mchog /khams gsum 'gro —6(14

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (geba'i bla ma btsong kha pa/ /sangs rgyas de gsung theg gsum dge 'dun bcas/ /bsnyen cing bkur bar gzugs can snying po dang / /mya ngan med dpal mes dbon thang rgyal sogs/ /sngon byon rnam thar khyod min su yis gzung / /de phyir 'od dpag med mgon mnyam bzhag ste/ /rtsi bcud kyis gtam bum pas mi yi rjer/ /dbang bskur bskal pa rgya mtshor mi 'gyur ba'i/ /sra mkhregs ka ba brtan po nye bar tshugs/ /dpag dka'i tshad kyis chod kyang zla ba'i 'od/ /phog pa'i mod la kun+da nyer ba 'ad bzhin/ /mtha' yas sa yi ring por bskal na yang / /thugs rje'i mdzad pa bzang pos cis mi stong / /(285)rta bdun zer gyis smag rum sangs byed na/ /bstan dang 'gro ba nyer 'tsho 'byung ba'i gzhin/ /rag lus brtse ba'i spyan dkyus tshes yangs pos/ /legs gzigs mi 'jigs spobs pa deng 'dir stsol/ /chos nor 'dod thar gyis gtsos gtsug lag gi /brgya phrag lugs bzang sgo 'phar yongs su da par/ /blar mtho'i mnga' thang dpal 'byor chos btsan bkas/ /rang gi longs spyod skal bzang slar yang bskrun/ /dus rnams kun tu dgyes pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /btsa' ba'i 'dzum zhal lhug par rab bstan nas/ /nam mkha' gzugs g.yin ma gyur de srid bar/ /stsol ba'i dga' ston yid la rtag 'bebs mdzod/ /'dren byed ngang mo rol gar bsgyur ba'i rten/ /rin chen do shal sna lnga'i snam 'phrul khres/ /'jam mnyen pad rdzing ngogs su thun mtshams kyi/ /rtags mtshan 'dab brgya gsar pa rab tu g.yo/ /margad zhun mar 'gran bzod byi ba'i lo/ /'byung ba sum ldan sa ga zla ba yi/ /gral ches dge bar kun gyis btud bya'i gnas/ /pho brang chen por phul ba bi dza ya/ /shing byi lo nas gser yig pa a chi thu dge slong dang bstan pa gsal byed gnyis khal kha dza sag thu'i don skor la bka' shog gnang sbyin bka' ngag dang bcas ched gnyer rdzong bda' gnang ba'i lan 'bul bar rab 'byams pa blo bzang nor bu dpal gdong ngag dbang grags pa mngags pa'i tshe phul bskye rgu'i bde skyid nyi ma dgung shar/ /tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gis stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba gnam sa'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i drung du/ su sti ga'i sgra las nye bar drangs te shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gi me tog phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'thor zhing dang ba'i mi phyed pa —605

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (22)dang bcas pa phul du byung ba'i (288ba)dad ldan bsregs pa'i dri bzang gis phyogs kun yongs su khyab pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gsol ba/ 'jig rten gyi mes pos gnam ka ba med pa'i sgo phye nas gang la'ang 'jigs med stobs kyi dpung gis mnga' sgyur ba mang bkur gyi khri mi shigs mi 'gyur g.yung drung gi rang bzhin ches yangs por dbang bskur ba 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po deng gi dus nyid na'ang 'dzam gling skye rgu mtha' klas pa'i bsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab cing zad mi shes pas thog ma med pa nas bsgrubs pa'i dpal yon dam pa sku mthong na mi mthun pa dang bral ba'i mtshan bzang po nyi ma bye ba 'bum gyis kun nas dkris pas mchog dman bar ma'i yid can mtha' dag gi blo mun ma lus pa nye bar bsal lo zhes pa'i gtam snyan shin tu 'jebs pa drug cu'i dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro rna ba'i bu gar son pa dang / chabs cig par dgyes pa'i spyan ras nam du'ang lhod pa med pa'i ring nas/ tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gi bka' rtags pad rā ga gi gzi 'od 'phro bzhin pa/ gnang sbyin bkras btags nyin bde ma bcu/ rtags brgyad bcu phrag gnyis/ rin po che'i dpyad pa le tshan/gser mdong / dngul gzheng / mdzod gos yug sna tshogs sum cu'i dngos po gya nom pa dang bcas a chi thu dge slong dang bstan pa gsal byed ched du rdzong bda' gnang ba sug par 'byor ba'i gser zhal mjal ba ltar yid la spro dga' ches cher 'phel/ 'di na'ang dge sbyong sde snod 'chang ba po lus kyi zo mdog bde zhing / gang gi thugs rjer brten nas nyi ma nub phyogs kyi lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i khyab cha mi dman zhing / lhag par lus can thams cad kyi mgon skyabs (289na ti pung gnyen gcig pu pa bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi nang nas snying stobs 'gran zla ma mchis pa snyigs ma'i mgon po ston pa thub pa'i dbang po rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras po'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che bla nas blar 'degs pa'i khur lci'i brtson pa nye bar blangs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i grib mar skye 'gro mtha' dag ngal gsor spyod pa'i lhag bsam kun+da ltar dkar ba'i bgyi ba yar ldan du gnas/ /dza brik+ṣa'i ljon pas mtshan pa'i gling 'dir lha mi'i drang srong rigs 'dzin grub thob rnams kyis rtsod —606

rgya bod hor sog gi mchog dman bar pa rnams la 'phrin yig snyan ngag tu 'god pa rab snyan rgyud mang / (pepa'i dus stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba 'byon par yongs su bsngags pa bzhin mi'i bdag po khyod kyi sku bsod kyi mthus 'jig rten gyi khams su nad 'khrug mu ge sogs skal ngan gyi chad pa thams cad ming gi lhag mar gyur te char chu dus babs kyis rtsi shing nags tshal rgyas shing lo tog sbrums pa las sgor khe spobs thon pas mtshan mi 'dzad pa'i longs spyod kyi gter sgo brgya phrag phye zhing bskal 'tsho'i tshe bsod nams dbang thang gi sim mtshor sha stag gi dge mtshan la spyod pa'i bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag dam pa'i gzhir 'tsho bzhes tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon po ltar sku tshe byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin lhun gyis grub par dkon cog rin po che rnam pa gsum dpang por bgyis nas bden tshig brjod sags pa dgongs pa zab mo'i klong du bzhugs pa'i bka' mchid bslab ston bzang po 'chi med lha'i chu bo'i rgyun bzhin zhu/ zhes lha mig dag pa'i spyan zur g.yo rten rin po che'i shal dkar/ snam phrug tshos kha sna tshogs kyi khrel sngags la rtags kyi tshim bus spras te mig dmar zhes pa shing byi hor zla drug pa'i tshes gcig la rang byung 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang dmar po ri nas phul/—607
